```coq
Definition audit_ide_rule_counted {N D A F} (EN : encoding N) (ED : encoding D)
    (r : audit_ide_registry A F) (state : Map.t (IpTab.fact N D) F)
    (rule : audit_ide_rule N D F)
    : option (IpTab.fact N D * F) * list (audit_ide_machine_call N D F) :=
  let key := IpTab.fact_encoding EN ED in
  match rule with
  | AuditIdeSeed dst value => (Some (dst, value), [IdeMachineCase 0])
  | AuditIdeUnary source dst suffix =>
      let found := Map.get key source state in
      match found with
      | None => (None, [IdeMachineCase 1; IdeMachineFactRead source state found])
      | Some value =>
          let output := audit_ide_compose r value suffix in
          (Some (dst, output), [IdeMachineCase 2; IdeMachineFactRead source state found;
             IdeMachineCompose value suffix output])
      end
  | AuditIdeBinary first second dst between after =>
      let left := Map.get key first state in
      match left with
      | None => (None, [IdeMachineCase 3; IdeMachineFactRead first state left])
      | Some a =>
          let right := Map.get key second state in
          match right with
          | None => (None, [IdeMachineCase 4; IdeMachineFactRead first state left;
              IdeMachineFactRead second state right])
          | Some b =>
              let one := audit_ide_compose r a between in
              let two := audit_ide_compose r one b in
              let three := audit_ide_compose r two after in
              (Some (dst, three), [IdeMachineCase 5; IdeMachineFactRead first state left;
                IdeMachineFactRead second state right; IdeMachineCompose a between one;
                IdeMachineCompose one b two; IdeMachineCompose two after three])
          end
      end
  end.

Fixpoint audit_ide_enqueue_counted {N D F} (ids : list nat) (pending : list nat)
    (queued : FinSet.t nat) : (list nat * FinSet.t nat) * list (audit_ide_machine_call N D F) :=
  match ids with
  | [] => ((pending, queued), [IdeMachineCase 6])
  | id :: rest =>
      let present := FinSet.mem nat_encoding id queued in
      if present then
        let '(result, events) := audit_ide_enqueue_counted rest pending queued in
        (result, IdeMachineCase 7 :: IdeMachineQueueMember id queued present :: events)
      else
        let next := FinSet.add nat_encoding id queued in
        let '(result, events) := audit_ide_enqueue_counted rest (id :: pending) next in
        (result, IdeMachineCase 8 :: IdeMachineQueueMember id queued present ::
          IdeMachineQueueAdd id queued next :: events)
  end.

Definition audit_ide_step_counted {N D A F} (EN : encoding N) (ED : encoding D)
    (r : audit_ide_registry A F) (st : audit_ide_machine N D F)
    : option (audit_ide_machine N D F) * list (audit_ide_machine_call N D F) :=
  match audit_ide_machine_pending st with
  | [] => (None, [IdeMachineCase 9])
  | id :: rest =>
      let queued := FinSet.remove nat_encoding id (audit_ide_machine_queued st) in
      let rule := Map.get nat_encoding id (audit_ide_machine_table st) in
      let prefix := [IdeMachineCase 10;
        IdeMachineQueueRemove id (audit_ide_machine_queued st) queued;
        IdeMachineRuleRead id (audit_ide_machine_table st) rule] in
      match rule with
      | None =>
          (Some (AuditIdeMachine (audit_ide_machine_rules st) (audit_ide_machine_table st)
            (audit_ide_machine_incidence st) rest queued (audit_ide_machine_values st)
            (audit_ide_machine_probes_rev st)), prefix ++ [IdeMachineCase 11])
      | Some rule_value =>
          let key := IpTab.fact_encoding EN ED in
          let values := audit_ide_machine_values st in
          let '(derived, rule_events) := audit_ide_rule_counted EN ED r values rule_value in
          let '(next_values, probe, update_events) :=
            match derived with
            | None => (values, AuditIdeProbe rule_value None false false, [IdeMachineCase 12])
            | Some (dst, incoming) =>
                let old := Map.get key dst values in
                match old with
                | None =>
                    let new_values := Map.set key dst incoming values in
                    (new_values, AuditIdeProbe rule_value (Some dst) true false,
                     [IdeMachineCase 13; IdeMachineFactRead dst values old;
                      IdeMachineFactWrite dst incoming values new_values])
                | Some previous =>
                    let joined := audit_ide_join r previous incoming in
                    let equal := audit_ide_equal r joined previous in
                    if equal then
                      (values, AuditIdeProbe rule_value (Some dst) false true,
                       [IdeMachineCase 14; IdeMachineFactRead dst values old;
                        IdeMachineJoin previous incoming joined; IdeMachineEqual joined previous
                          equal])
                    else
                      let new_values := Map.set key dst joined values in
                      (new_values, AuditIdeProbe rule_value (Some dst) true true,
                       [IdeMachineCase 15; IdeMachineFactRead dst values old;
                        IdeMachineJoin previous incoming joined; IdeMachineEqual joined previous
                          equal;
                        IdeMachineFactWrite dst joined values new_values])
                end
            end in
          let '(todo, seen, enqueue_events) :=
            match audit_ide_probe_key probe, audit_ide_probe_changed probe with
            | Some dst, true =>
                let lookup := Map.get key dst (audit_ide_machine_incidence st) in
                let ids := match lookup with Some xs => xs | None => [] end in
                let '(result, events) := audit_ide_enqueue_counted ids rest queued in
                (fst result, snd result,
                 IdeMachineIncidenceRead dst (audit_ide_machine_incidence st) lookup :: events)
            | _, _ => (rest, queued, [IdeMachineCase 16])
            end in
          (Some (AuditIdeMachine (audit_ide_machine_rules st) (audit_ide_machine_table st)
            (audit_ide_machine_incidence st) todo seen next_values
            (probe :: audit_ide_machine_probes_rev st)),
           prefix ++ rule_events ++ update_events ++ enqueue_events)
      end
  end.

Fixpoint audit_ide_loop_counted {N D A F} (EN : encoding N) (ED : encoding D)
    (r : audit_ide_registry A F) (fuel : positive) (st : audit_ide_machine N D F)
    : audit_ide_machine N D F * list (audit_ide_machine_call N D F) :=
  match audit_ide_machine_pending st with
  | [] => (st, [IdeMachineCase 17])
  | _ => match fuel with
    | xH => let '(result, events) := audit_ide_step_counted EN ED r st in
        (match result with Some next => next | None => st end, IdeMachineCase 18 :: events)
    | xO p => let '(middle, first_events) := audit_ide_loop_counted EN ED r p st in
        let '(result, second_events) := audit_ide_loop_counted EN ED r p middle in
        (result, IdeMachineCase 19 :: first_events ++ second_events)
    | xI p => let '(middle, first_events) := audit_ide_loop_counted EN ED r p st in
        let '(last, second_events) := audit_ide_loop_counted EN ED r p middle in
        let '(result, step_events) := audit_ide_step_counted EN ED r last in
        (match result with Some next => next | None => last end,
          IdeMachineCase 20 :: first_events ++ second_events ++ step_events)
    end
  end.

Definition audit_ide_machine_model_event {N D F} (EN : encoding N) (ED : encoding D)
    (event : audit_ide_machine_call N D F) : nat :=
  let fact_key := IpTab.fact_encoding EN ED in
  let emission code := audit_encoding_weight (audit_key_bits_weight code) in
  let nat_work id := audit_unary_conversion_weight id +
    id * audit_key_bits_weight (encode nat_encoding id) in
  64 + match event with
  | IdeMachineRuleRead id _ _ | IdeMachineQueueMember id _ _ =>
      audit_get_weight (encode nat_encoding id) + emission (encode nat_encoding id) + nat_work id
  | IdeMachineQueueRemove id _ _ =>
      audit_remove_weight (encode nat_encoding id) + emission (encode nat_encoding id) + nat_work id
  | IdeMachineQueueAdd id _ _ =>
      audit_set_weight (encode nat_encoding id) + emission (encode nat_encoding id) + nat_work id
  | IdeMachineFactRead key _ _ | IdeMachineIncidenceRead key _ _ =>
      audit_get_weight (encode fact_key key) + emission (encode fact_key key)
  | IdeMachineFactWrite key _ _ _ =>
      audit_set_weight (encode fact_key key) + emission (encode fact_key key)
  | _ => 0
  end.

Definition audit_ide_machine_model_work {N D F} (EN : encoding N) (ED : encoding D)
    (events : list (audit_ide_machine_call N D F)) : nat :=
  64 * S (length events) * S (length events) +
  fold_right (fun event n => audit_ide_machine_model_event EN ED event + n) 0 events.

Definition audit_ide_machine_model_budget {N D F} (EN : encoding N) (ED : encoding D)
    (events : list (audit_ide_machine_call N D F)) : nat :=
  64 * S (length events) * S (length events) + 64 * length events +
    fold_right (fun event n => (audit_ide_machine_model_event EN ED event - 64) + n) 0 events.

Definition audit_ide_incidence_size {N D F} (state : audit_ide_machine N D F) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun row n => length (snd row) + n) 0
    (Map.elements (audit_ide_machine_incidence state)).

Definition audit_ide_machine_nat_keys {N D F} (state : audit_ide_machine N D F) : list nat :=
  audit_ide_machine_pending state ++ FinSet.elements (audit_ide_machine_queued state) ++
  map fst (Map.elements (audit_ide_machine_table state)) ++
  flat_map snd (Map.elements (audit_ide_machine_incidence state)).

Definition audit_ide_machine_fact_keys {N D F} (state : audit_ide_machine N D F)
    : list (IpTab.fact N D) :=
  flat_map (fun row => audit_ide_rule_keys (snd row)) (Map.elements (audit_ide_machine_table state))
    ++
  map fst (Map.elements (audit_ide_machine_values state)) ++
  map fst (Map.elements (audit_ide_machine_incidence state)).

Definition audit_ide_machine_nat_width {N D F} (state : audit_ide_machine N D F) : nat :=
  fold_right Nat.max 0 (map (fun id => audit_key_bits_weight (encode nat_encoding id))
    (audit_ide_machine_nat_keys state)).

Definition audit_ide_machine_fact_width {N D F} (EN : encoding N) (ED : encoding D)
    (state : audit_ide_machine N D F) : nat :=
  fold_right Nat.max 0 (map (fun key => audit_key_bits_weight (encode (IpTab.fact_encoding EN ED)
    key))
    (audit_ide_machine_fact_keys state)).

Definition audit_ide_machine_input_budget {N D F} (EN : encoding N) (ED : encoding D)
    (fuel : positive) (state : audit_ide_machine N D F) : nat :=
  let event_bound := (32 + 3 * audit_ide_incidence_size state) * (2 * Pos.to_nat fuel + 1) in
  let nat_max := fold_right Nat.max 0 (audit_ide_machine_nat_keys state) in
  let nat_width := audit_ide_machine_nat_width state in
  let width := Nat.max (audit_ide_machine_nat_width state) (audit_ide_machine_fact_width EN ED
    state) in
  64 * S event_bound * S event_bound +
    event_bound * (66 + 3 * width + S nat_max + nat_max * nat_width).

Definition audit_ide_rule_counted_statement : Prop :=
  forall N D A F (EN : encoding N) (ED : encoding D) (r : audit_ide_registry A F) state rule,
    fst (audit_ide_rule_counted EN ED r state rule) = audit_ide_rule_result EN ED r state rule.

Definition audit_ide_enqueue_counted_statement : Prop :=
  forall N D F ids pending queued,
    fst (@audit_ide_enqueue_counted N D F ids pending queued) = audit_ide_enqueue ids pending
      queued.

Definition audit_ide_step_counted_statement : Prop :=
  forall N D A F (EN : encoding N) (ED : encoding D) (r : audit_ide_registry A F) state,
    fst (audit_ide_step_counted EN ED r state) = audit_ide_machine_step EN ED r state.

Definition audit_ide_loop_counted_statement : Prop :=
  forall N D A F (EN : encoding N) (ED : encoding D) (r : audit_ide_registry A F) fuel state,
    fst (audit_ide_loop_counted EN ED r fuel state) = audit_ide_machine_loop EN ED r fuel state.

Definition audit_ide_machine_model_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall N D A F (EN : encoding N) (ED : encoding D) (r : audit_ide_registry A F) fuel state,
    let '(result, events) := audit_ide_loop_counted EN ED r fuel state in
    result = audit_ide_machine_loop EN ED r fuel state /\
    length events <= (32 + 3 * audit_ide_incidence_size state) * (2 * Pos.to_nat fuel + 1) /\
    audit_ide_machine_model_work EN ED events <= audit_ide_machine_model_budget EN ED events /\
    audit_ide_machine_model_work EN ED events <= audit_ide_machine_input_budget EN ED fuel state /\
    64 * length events <= audit_ide_machine_model_work EN ED events.

(** Source: run/reports/AUD-API-final-20261101/graph-ssa/ide-producer-model.md *)
Record audit_ide_generated_run (N P D F : Type) : Type := AuditIdeGeneratedRun {
  audit_ide_run_rules : list (audit_ide_rule N D F);
  audit_ide_run_keys : list (IpTab.fact N D);
  audit_ide_run_initial : audit_ide_machine N D F;
  audit_ide_run_final : audit_ide_machine N D F;
  audit_ide_run_generator_events : list (audit_ide_generator_call N P D F);
  audit_ide_run_initial_events : list (audit_ide_initial_call N D F);
  audit_ide_run_loop_events : list (audit_ide_machine_call N D F)
}.
Arguments AuditIdeGeneratedRun {N P D F}.
Arguments audit_ide_run_rules {N P D F}.
Arguments audit_ide_run_keys {N P D F}.
Arguments audit_ide_run_initial {N P D F}.
Arguments audit_ide_run_final {N P D F}.
Arguments audit_ide_run_generator_events {N P D F}.
Arguments audit_ide_run_initial_events {N P D F}.
Arguments audit_ide_run_loop_events {N P D F}.

Definition audit_ide_producer_counted {N P D A F} (EN : encoding N) (EP : encoding P)
    (ED : encoding D) (L : lattice A) (r : ide_registry A F) (q : ip_problem N P D)
    (weight : ip_edge N P D -> option D -> option D -> F) (start : N) (seed : option D)
    : ide_registry_summary N D F * audit_ide_generated_run N P D F :=
  let '(rules, generator_events) := audit_ide_generator_counted EP r q weight (start, seed) in
  let keys := audit_ide_summary_keys q in
  let '(initial, initial_events) := audit_ide_initial_counted EN ED rules in
  let fuel := audit_ide_machine_fuel r keys rules in
  let '(final, loop_events) := audit_ide_loop_counted EN ED r fuel initial in
  (IdeRegistrySummary (audit_ide_machine_values final) (rev (audit_ide_machine_probes_rev final)),
   AuditIdeGeneratedRun rules keys initial final generator_events initial_events loop_events).

Definition audit_ide_generate_index_plain {N P D F} (EP : encoding P)
    (arcs : list (audit_ide_arc N P D F)) :=
  fold_right (fun arc index =>
    let kind := audit_ide_arc_kind arc in
    let row := match Map.get (IpTab.kind_encoding EP) kind index with
      Some xs => xs | None => [] end in
    Map.set (IpTab.kind_encoding EP) kind (arc :: row) index) Map.empty arcs.

Definition audit_ide_generate_matches_plain {N P D F} (EP : encoding P)
    (index : Map.t (ip_kind P) (list (audit_ide_arc N P D F)))
    (arcs : list (audit_ide_arc N P D F)) :=
  flat_map (fun call => match audit_ide_arc_kind call with
    | IpCall site =>
        let returns := match Map.get (IpTab.kind_encoding EP) (IpReturn site) index with
          Some xs => xs | None => [] end in
        map (fun ret => (call,ret)) returns
    | _ => [] end) arcs.

Definition audit_ide_ground_rules {N P D A F} (EP : encoding P) (r : ide_registry A F)
    (q : ip_problem N P D) (weight : ip_edge N P D -> option D -> option D -> F)
    (root : IpTab.vertex N D) : list (audit_ide_rule N D F) :=
  let vertices := IpTab.vertices q in
  let arcs := audit_ide_arcs q weight in
  let index := audit_ide_generate_index_plain EP arcs in
  let matches := audit_ide_generate_matches_plain EP index arcs in
  audit_ide_indexed_rows r vertices arcs matches root.

Definition audit_ide_fuel_model {N D A F} (r : ide_registry A F)
    (keys : list (IpTab.fact N D)) (rules : list (audit_ide_rule N D F)) : nat :=
  let nr := length rules in
  let nk := length keys in
  let rank := S (audit_ide_bound r) in
  64 + audit_unary_conversion_weight nr + audit_unary_conversion_weight nk +
  audit_unary_conversion_weight rank +
  nr * Pos.size_nat (Pos.of_succ_nat nr) + nk * Pos.size_nat (Pos.of_succ_nat nk) +
  rank * Pos.size_nat (Pos.of_succ_nat rank) +
  audit_multiply_weight 2 (Z.of_nat nk) +
  audit_multiply_weight (2 * Z.of_nat nk) (Z.of_nat rank) +
  audit_binary_weight 1 (2 * Z.of_nat nk * Z.of_nat rank) +
  audit_multiply_weight (Z.of_nat nr) (1 + 2 * Z.of_nat nk * Z.of_nat rank).

Definition audit_ide_producer_model_work {N P D A F} (EN : encoding N) (EP : encoding P)
    (ED : encoding D) (r : ide_registry A F) (run : audit_ide_generated_run N P D F) : nat :=
  let keys := audit_ide_run_keys run in
  let rules := audit_ide_run_rules run in
  let output := audit_ide_machine_probes_rev (audit_ide_run_final run) in
  audit_ide_generator_model_work EP (audit_ide_run_generator_events run) +
  audit_ide_initial_model_work EN ED (audit_ide_run_initial_events run) +
  audit_ide_machine_model_work EN ED (audit_ide_run_loop_events run) +
  audit_ide_fuel_model r keys rules +
  64 * S (length keys) * S (length keys) +
  64 * S (length output) * S (length output).

Definition audit_ide_producer_model_budget {N P D A F} (EN : encoding N) (EP : encoding P)
    (ED : encoding D) (r : ide_registry A F) (q : ip_problem N P D)
    (run : audit_ide_generated_run N P D F) : nat :=
  let keys := audit_ide_run_keys run in
  let rules := audit_ide_run_rules run in
  let initial := audit_ide_run_initial run in
  let fuel := audit_ide_machine_fuel r keys rules in
  let output_bound := (32 + 3 * audit_ide_incidence_size initial) * (2 * Pos.to_nat fuel + 1) in
  audit_ide_generator_input_budget EP q +
  audit_ide_initial_input_budget EN ED rules +
  audit_ide_machine_input_budget EN ED fuel initial +
  audit_ide_fuel_model r keys rules +
  64 * S (length keys) * S (length keys) +
  64 * S output_bound * S output_bound.

Section IdeProducerContract.
  Variable solve : forall {N P D A F : Type}, encoding N -> encoding P -> encoding D ->
    lattice A -> ide_registry A F -> ip_problem N P D ->
    (ip_edge N P D -> option D -> option D -> F) -> N -> option D -> ide_registry_summary N D F.

  Definition audit_ide_producer_counted_statement : Prop :=
    forall N P D A F (EN : encoding N) (EP : encoding P) (ED : encoding D)
      (L : lattice A) (r : ide_registry A F) (q : ip_problem N P D) weight start seed,
      ide_registry_laws L r -> ip_problem_wf q -> In start (ip_nodes q) ->
      (match seed with None => True | Some d => In d (ip_facts q) end) ->
      let '(result, run) := audit_ide_producer_counted EN EP ED L r q weight start seed in
      let rules := audit_ide_run_rules run in
      let keys := audit_ide_run_keys run in
      let initial := audit_ide_run_initial run in
      let final := audit_ide_run_final run in
      result = solve EN EP ED L r q weight start seed /\
      rules = audit_ide_rule_spec EP r q weight (start, seed) /\
      keys = audit_ide_summary_keys q /\
      initial = audit_ide_machine_initial EN ED rules /\
      final = audit_ide_machine_loop EN ED r (audit_ide_machine_fuel r keys rules) initial /\
      ide_registry_summary_map result = audit_ide_machine_values final /\
      ide_registry_summary_probes result = rev (audit_ide_machine_probes_rev final) /\
      length (audit_ide_run_generator_events run) <=
        16 * (1 + length (ip_edges q) + length (IpTab.vertices q) +
          audit_ide_arc_count q + audit_ide_matching_occurrences EP q + length rules) /\
      length (audit_ide_run_initial_events run) <= 20 + 16 * length rules /\
      length (audit_ide_run_loop_events run) <=
        (32 + 3 * audit_ide_incidence_size initial) *
          (2 * Pos.to_nat (audit_ide_machine_fuel r keys rules) + 1) /\
      length (audit_ide_probe_updates (ide_registry_summary_probes result)) <=
        length keys * S (audit_ide_bound r) /\
      audit_ide_producer_model_work EN EP ED r run <= audit_ide_producer_model_budget EN EP ED r q
        run /\
      64 * length (audit_ide_run_loop_events run) <= audit_ide_producer_model_work EN EP ED r run.
End IdeProducerContract.

(** Source: run/reports/AUD-API-final-20261101/graph-ssa/ide-check-types.md *)
Inductive audit_ide_check_event (N P D A F : Type) : Type :=
  | IdeCheckEdge (edge : ip_edge N P D)
  | IdeCheckPair (edge : ip_edge N P D) (x y : option D)
  | IdeCheckWeight (edge : ip_edge N P D) (x y : option D)
  | IdeCheckEval (f : F) (a : A)
  | IdeCheckOldWeight (edge : ip_edge N P D) (x y : option D) (a : A)
  | IdeCheckLe (left right : A).
Arguments IdeCheckEdge {N P D A F}.
Arguments IdeCheckPair {N P D A F}.
Arguments IdeCheckWeight {N P D A F}.
Arguments IdeCheckEval {N P D A F}.
Arguments IdeCheckOldWeight {N P D A F}.
Arguments IdeCheckLe {N P D A F}.
Record audit_ide_check_counts : Type := AuditIdeCheckCounts {
  audit_ide_check_edges : nat;
  audit_ide_check_pairs : nat;
  audit_ide_check_values : nat;
  audit_ide_check_comparisons : nat
}.

Definition audit_ide_check_zero : audit_ide_check_counts := AuditIdeCheckCounts 0 0 0 0.

Definition audit_ide_check_add (a b : audit_ide_check_counts) : audit_ide_check_counts :=
  AuditIdeCheckCounts (audit_ide_check_edges a + audit_ide_check_edges b)
    (audit_ide_check_pairs a + audit_ide_check_pairs b)
    (audit_ide_check_values a + audit_ide_check_values b)
    (audit_ide_check_comparisons a + audit_ide_check_comparisons b).
Definition audit_ide_check_event_counts {N P D A F} (event : audit_ide_check_event N P D A F)
    : audit_ide_check_counts :=
  match event with
  | IdeCheckEdge _ => AuditIdeCheckCounts 1 0 0 0
  | IdeCheckPair _ _ _ => AuditIdeCheckCounts 0 1 0 0
  | IdeCheckWeight _ _ _ => AuditIdeCheckCounts 0 0 1 0
  | IdeCheckLe _ _ => AuditIdeCheckCounts 0 0 0 1
  | _ => audit_ide_check_zero
  end.

Definition audit_ide_check_trace_counts {N P D A F} (events : list (audit_ide_check_event N P D A
  F))
    : audit_ide_check_counts :=
  fold_right (fun event total => audit_ide_check_add (audit_ide_check_event_counts event) total)
    audit_ide_check_zero events.

(** Source: run/reports/AUD-API-final-20261101/graph-ssa/ide-strict-check.md *)
Fixpoint audit_ide_strict_all {X Event : Type}
    (f : X -> bool * list Event) (xs : list X) : bool * list Event :=
  match xs with
  | [] => (true, [])
  | x :: rest =>
      let '(ok, here) := f x in
      let '(later_ok, later) := audit_ide_strict_all f rest in
      (ok && later_ok, here ++ later)
  end.

Definition audit_ide_strict_value {N P D A F}
    (old : ide_problem N P D A) (r : audit_ide_registry A F)
    (weight : ip_edge N P D -> option D -> option D -> F)
    (edge : ip_edge N P D) (x y : option D) (a : A)
    : bool * list (audit_ide_check_event N P D A F) :=
  let L := ide_lattice old in
  let f := weight edge x y in
  let new := audit_ide_eval r f a in
  let prior := ide_weight old edge x y a in
  let forward := OrderLattice.leb L new prior in
  let reverse := OrderLattice.leb L prior new in
  (forward && reverse,
   [IdeCheckWeight edge x y; IdeCheckEval f a;
    IdeCheckOldWeight edge x y a; IdeCheckLe new prior; IdeCheckLe prior new]).

Definition audit_ide_strict_pair {N P D A F}
    (old : ide_problem N P D A) (r : audit_ide_registry A F)
    (weight : ip_edge N P D -> option D -> option D -> F)
    (edge : ip_edge N P D) (xy : option D * option D)
    : bool * list (audit_ide_check_event N P D A F) :=
  let '(ok, events) := audit_ide_strict_all
    (audit_ide_strict_value old r weight edge (fst xy) (snd xy)) (ide_values old) in
  (ok, IdeCheckPair edge (fst xy) (snd xy) :: events).

Definition audit_ide_strict_edge {N P D A F}
    (old : ide_problem N P D A) (r : audit_ide_registry A F)
    (weight : ip_edge N P D -> option D -> option D -> F)
    (edge : ip_edge N P D)
    : bool * list (audit_ide_check_event N P D A F) :=
  let '(ok, events) := audit_ide_strict_all
    (audit_ide_strict_pair old r weight edge) (ip_pairs edge) in
  (ok, IdeCheckEdge edge :: events).

Definition audit_ide_check_strict_traced {N P D A F}
    (old : ide_problem N P D A) (r : audit_ide_registry A F)
    (weight : ip_edge N P D -> option D -> option D -> F)
    : bool * list (audit_ide_check_event N P D A F) :=
  audit_ide_strict_all (audit_ide_strict_edge old r weight)
    (ip_edges (ide_graph old)).

Inductive audit_ide_strict_all_execution {X Event : Type}
    (step : X -> bool -> list Event -> Prop) : list X -> bool -> list Event -> Prop :=
  | AuditIdeStrictAllNil : audit_ide_strict_all_execution step [] true []
  | AuditIdeStrictAllCons x rest here_ok here later_ok later :
      step x here_ok here ->
      audit_ide_strict_all_execution step rest later_ok later ->
      audit_ide_strict_all_execution step (x :: rest) (here_ok && later_ok) (here ++ later).

Inductive audit_ide_strict_value_execution {N P D A F}
    (old : ide_problem N P D A) (r : audit_ide_registry A F)
    (weight : ip_edge N P D -> option D -> option D -> F)
    (edge : ip_edge N P D) (x y : option D)
    : A -> bool -> list (audit_ide_check_event N P D A F) -> Prop :=
  | AuditIdeStrictValueRun a :
      audit_ide_strict_value_execution old r weight edge x y a
        (let new := audit_ide_eval r (weight edge x y) a in
         let prior := ide_weight old edge x y a in
         OrderLattice.leb (ide_lattice old) new prior && OrderLattice.leb (ide_lattice old) prior
           new)
        [IdeCheckWeight edge x y; IdeCheckEval (weight edge x y) a;
         IdeCheckOldWeight edge x y a;
         IdeCheckLe (audit_ide_eval r (weight edge x y) a) (ide_weight old edge x y a);
         IdeCheckLe (ide_weight old edge x y a) (audit_ide_eval r (weight edge x y) a)].

Inductive audit_ide_strict_pair_execution {N P D A F}
    (old : ide_problem N P D A) (r : audit_ide_registry A F)
    (weight : ip_edge N P D -> option D -> option D -> F) (edge : ip_edge N P D)
    : option D * option D -> bool -> list (audit_ide_check_event N P D A F) -> Prop :=
  | AuditIdeStrictPairRun x y result events :
      audit_ide_strict_all_execution (audit_ide_strict_value_execution old r weight edge x y)
        (ide_values old) result events ->
      audit_ide_strict_pair_execution old r weight edge (x, y) result
        (IdeCheckPair edge x y :: events).

Inductive audit_ide_strict_edge_execution {N P D A F}
    (old : ide_problem N P D A) (r : audit_ide_registry A F)
    (weight : ip_edge N P D -> option D -> option D -> F)
    : ip_edge N P D -> bool -> list (audit_ide_check_event N P D A F) -> Prop :=
  | AuditIdeStrictEdgeRun edge result events :
      audit_ide_strict_all_execution (audit_ide_strict_pair_execution old r weight edge)
        (ip_pairs edge) result events ->
      audit_ide_strict_edge_execution old r weight edge result (IdeCheckEdge edge :: events).

Definition audit_ide_check_strict_execution {N P D A F}
    (old : ide_problem N P D A) (r : audit_ide_registry A F)
    (weight : ip_edge N P D -> option D -> option D -> F)
    (result : bool) (events : list (audit_ide_check_event N P D A F)) : Prop :=
  audit_ide_strict_all_execution (audit_ide_strict_edge_execution old r weight)
    (ip_edges (ide_graph old)) result events.

Definition audit_ide_check_strict_execution_exists_statement : Prop :=
  forall N P D A F (old : ide_problem N P D A) (r : audit_ide_registry A F) weight,
    exists result events, audit_ide_check_strict_execution old r weight result events /\
      result = audit_ide_finite_compatible_check old r weight.

Definition audit_ide_strict_pair_count {N P D A}
    (old : ide_problem N P D A) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun edge n => length (ip_pairs edge) + n) 0
    (ip_edges (ide_graph old)).

Definition audit_ide_strict_check_contract : Prop :=
  forall N P D A F (old : ide_problem N P D A)
      (r : audit_ide_registry A F) weight,
    let '(answer, events) := audit_ide_check_strict_traced old r weight in
    let edges := length (ip_edges (ide_graph old)) in
    let pairs := audit_ide_strict_pair_count old in
    let values := pairs * length (ide_values old) in
    audit_ide_check_strict_execution old r weight answer events /\
    answer = audit_ide_finite_compatible_check old r weight /\
    audit_ide_check_trace_counts events =
      AuditIdeCheckCounts edges pairs values (2 * values) /\
    length events = edges + pairs + 5 * values.
```

```coq
(** * Concrete implementation-primitive bridge for the generated IDE stages

    Card: AUD-IDE. The propositions bind fixed source recurrences on retained actual maps.
    Work is at the published source-block granularity, not kernel or native steps. *)
Definition ide_generator_literal_event_work {N P D F} (EP : encoding P)
    (body : P -> nat) (event : audit_ide_generator_call N P D F) : nat :=
  let E := IpTab.kind_encoding EP in
  64 + match event with
  | IdeGeneratorIndexGet kind before _ =>
      16 + (match kind with IpInternal => 0 | IpCall p | IpReturn p => body p end) +
        16 * Pos.size_nat (encode E kind) + audit_trie_get_source_work (encode E kind) before
  | IdeGeneratorIndexSet kind before after =>
      16 + (match kind with IpInternal => 0 | IpCall p | IpReturn p => body p end) +
        16 * Pos.size_nat (encode E kind) +
        audit_trie_update_source_work (encode E kind) (Trie.get (encode E kind) after) before
  | _ => 0 end.

Definition ide_initial_literal_event_work {N D F} (EN : encoding N) (ED : encoding D)
    (node_body : N -> nat) (fact_body : D -> nat)
    (event : audit_ide_initial_call N D F) : nat :=
  let E := IpTab.fact_encoding EN ED in
  let body := ide_fact_body EN ED node_body fact_body in
  64 + match event with
  | IdeInitSeq _ count _ => 64 * S count
  | IdeInitTableSet id rule before _ =>
      8 + 2 * S id + audit_trie_update_source_work (encode nat_encoding id) (Some (id,rule)) before
  | IdeInitQueueAdd id before _ =>
      8 + 2 * S id + audit_trie_update_source_work (encode nat_encoding id) (Some (id,tt)) before
  | IdeInitIndexGet _ key before _ =>
      8 + body key + audit_trie_get_source_work (encode E key) before
  | IdeInitIndexSet _ key before after =>
      8 + body key + audit_trie_update_source_work (encode E key) (Trie.get (encode E key) after)
        before
  | _ => 0 end.

Definition ide_machine_literal_event_work {N D F} (EN : encoding N) (ED : encoding D)
    (node_body : N -> nat) (fact_body : D -> nat)
    (event : audit_ide_machine_call N D F) : nat :=
  let E := IpTab.fact_encoding EN ED in
  let body := ide_fact_body EN ED node_body fact_body in
  64 + match event with
  | IdeMachineRuleRead id before _ =>
      8 + 2 * S id + audit_trie_get_source_work (encode nat_encoding id) before
  | IdeMachineQueueMember id before _ =>
      8 + 2 * S id + audit_trie_get_source_work (encode nat_encoding id) before
  | IdeMachineQueueRemove id before _ =>
      8 + 2 * S id + audit_trie_update_source_work (encode nat_encoding id) None before
  | IdeMachineQueueAdd id before _ =>
      8 + 2 * S id + audit_trie_update_source_work (encode nat_encoding id) (Some (id,tt)) before
  | IdeMachineFactRead key before _ =>
      8 + body key + audit_trie_get_source_work (encode E key) before
  | IdeMachineIncidenceRead key before _ =>
      8 + body key + audit_trie_get_source_work (encode E key) before
  | IdeMachineFactWrite key value before _ =>
      8 + body key + audit_trie_update_source_work (encode E key) (Some (key,value)) before
  | _ => 0 end.

(** Trace-output administration is an explicit quadratic allowance for all append/reversal
    traversals. Recursive source iterations are separately represented by their case events. *)
Definition ide_generated_primitive_adequacy_statement : Prop :=
  forall N P D A F (EN : encoding N) (EP : encoding P) (ED : encoding D)
    (node_body : N -> nat) (site_body : P -> nat) (fact_body : D -> nat)
    (r : ide_registry A F) (q : ip_problem N P D) weight start seed,
  let arcs := audit_ide_generate_arcs_counted weight (ip_edges q) in
  let index := audit_ide_generate_index_counted EP (fst arcs) in
  let matches := audit_ide_generate_matches_counted EP (fst index) (fst arcs) in
  let rules := audit_ide_rule_spec EP r q weight (start,seed) in
  let init := audit_ide_initial_counted EN ED rules in
  forall fuel,
  let machine := audit_ide_loop_counted EN ED r fuel (fst init) in
  fold_right (fun e n => ide_generator_literal_event_work EP site_body e + n) 0
    (snd arcs ++ snd index ++ snd matches) <=
    ide_generator_source_work EP site_body (snd arcs ++ snd index ++ snd matches) /\
  fold_right (fun e n => ide_initial_literal_event_work EN ED node_body fact_body e + n) 0 (snd
    init) <=
    ide_initial_source_work EN ED node_body fact_body (snd init) /\
  fold_right (fun e n => ide_machine_literal_event_work EN ED node_body fact_body e + n) 0 (snd
    machine) <=
    ide_machine_source_work EN ED node_body fact_body (snd machine).

(** * Generated IDE machine with real per-invocation dictionary bodies

    Card: AUD-IDE-GEN. Each external callback is executed by its supplied counted adapter
    once, and its actual typed call/body pair survives every bind and recursive iteration. *)
Section Bodies.
Context {N D A F : Type} (EN : encoding N) (ED : encoding D) (r : ide_registry A F)
  (adapters : audit_ide_registry_adapters r) (node_body : N -> nat) (fact_body : D -> nat).
Let Call := audit_ide_machine_call N D F.
Let Key := IpTab.fact_encoding EN ED.
Definition ide_body_internal (event : Call) {X} (value : X) : exact_counted Call X :=
  exact_call event (audit_ide_machine_model_event EN ED event +
    ide_machine_source_extra EN ED node_body fact_body event) value.
Definition ide_body_read (state : Map.t (IpTab.fact N D) F) key : exact_counted Call (option F) :=
  let result := Map.get Key key state in ide_body_internal (IdeMachineFactRead key state result)
    result.

Definition ide_rule_with_bodies_counted (state : Map.t (IpTab.fact N D) F)
    (rule : audit_ide_rule N D F) : exact_counted Call (option (IpTab.fact N D * F)) :=
  match rule with
  | AuditIdeSeed dst value => exact_case 2100 (exact_return 2100 (Some (dst,value)))
  | AuditIdeUnary source dst suffix => exact_case 2101
      (exact_bind 2102 (ide_body_read state source) (fun found => match found with
      | None => exact_case 2103 (exact_return 2103 None)
      | Some value => exact_case 2104
          (exact_bind 2105 (exact_external_call (ide_compose_adapter adapters) (value,suffix)
            (fun out => IdeMachineCompose value suffix out))
            (fun out => exact_return 2106 (Some (dst,out)))) end))
  | AuditIdeBinary first second dst between after => exact_case 2107
      (exact_bind 2108 (ide_body_read state first) (fun left => match left with
      | None => exact_case 2109 (exact_return 2109 None)
      | Some x => exact_case 2110 (exact_bind 2111 (ide_body_read state second) (fun right =>
        match right with
        | None => exact_case 2112 (exact_return 2112 None)
        | Some y => exact_case 2113
            (exact_bind 2114 (exact_external_call (ide_compose_adapter adapters) (x,between)
              (fun out => IdeMachineCompose x between out)) (fun one =>
            exact_bind 2115 (exact_external_call (ide_compose_adapter adapters) (one,y)
              (fun out => IdeMachineCompose one y out)) (fun two =>
            exact_bind 2116 (exact_external_call (ide_compose_adapter adapters) (two,after)
              (fun out => IdeMachineCompose two after out))
              (fun three => exact_return 2117 (Some (dst,three)))))) end)) end)) end.

Definition ide_enqueue_with_bodies_counted ids pending queued
    : exact_counted Call (list nat * FinSet.t nat) :=
  let '(result,events) := @audit_ide_enqueue_counted N D F ids pending queued in
  ExactCounted result (fold_right (fun event rest => audit_ide_machine_model_event EN ED event +
    ide_machine_source_extra EN ED node_body fact_body event + rest) 64 events)
    (map AuditCall events) [].

Definition ide_update_with_bodies_counted (rule : audit_ide_rule N D F)
    (values : Map.t (IpTab.fact N D) F) (derived : option (IpTab.fact N D * F))
    : exact_counted Call (Map.t (IpTab.fact N D) F * audit_ide_probe N D F) :=
  match derived with
  | None => exact_case 2120 (exact_return 2120 (values,AuditIdeProbe rule None false false))
  | Some (dst,incoming) => exact_case 2121
      (exact_bind 2122 (ide_body_read values dst) (fun old => match old with
      | None => exact_case 2123
          (let next := Map.set Key dst incoming values in
          exact_bind 2124 (ide_body_internal (IdeMachineFactWrite dst incoming values next) next)
            (fun next => exact_return 2125 (next,AuditIdeProbe rule (Some dst) true false)))
      | Some previous => exact_case 2126
          (exact_bind 2127 (exact_external_call (ide_join_adapter adapters) (previous,incoming)
            (fun out => IdeMachineJoin previous incoming out)) (fun joined =>
          exact_bind 2128 (exact_external_call (ide_equal_adapter adapters) (joined,previous)
            (fun out => IdeMachineEqual joined previous out)) (fun equal =>
          if equal then exact_case 2129
            (exact_return 2129 (values,AuditIdeProbe rule (Some dst) false true))
          else exact_case 2130
            (let next := Map.set Key dst joined values in
            exact_bind 2131 (ide_body_internal (IdeMachineFactWrite dst joined values next) next)
              (fun next => exact_return 2132 (next,AuditIdeProbe rule (Some dst) true true))))))
                end)) end.

Definition ide_step_with_bodies_counted (state : audit_ide_machine N D F)
    : exact_counted Call (option (audit_ide_machine N D F)) :=
  match audit_ide_machine_pending state with
  | [] => exact_case 2140 (exact_return 2140 None)
  | id :: rest => exact_case 2141
      (let queued := FinSet.remove nat_encoding id (audit_ide_machine_queued state) in
      exact_bind 2142 (ide_body_internal (IdeMachineQueueRemove id (audit_ide_machine_queued state)
        queued)
        queued) (fun queued =>
      let rule := Map.get nat_encoding id (audit_ide_machine_table state) in
      exact_bind 2143 (ide_body_internal (IdeMachineRuleRead id (audit_ide_machine_table state)
        rule) rule)
        (fun rule => match rule with
      | None => exact_case 2144 (exact_return 2144 (Some (AuditIdeMachine
          (audit_ide_machine_rules state) (audit_ide_machine_table state)
          (audit_ide_machine_incidence state) rest queued (audit_ide_machine_values state)
          (audit_ide_machine_probes_rev state))))
      | Some rule => exact_case 2145
          (exact_bind 2146 (ide_rule_with_bodies_counted (audit_ide_machine_values state) rule) (fun
            derived =>
          exact_bind 2147 (ide_update_with_bodies_counted rule (audit_ide_machine_values state)
            derived)
            (fun update => let '(values,probe) := update in
          exact_bind 2148 (match audit_ide_probe_key probe, audit_ide_probe_changed probe with
            | Some dst,true => exact_case 2148
                (let found := Map.get Key dst (audit_ide_machine_incidence state) in
                exact_bind 2149 (ide_body_internal
                  (IdeMachineIncidenceRead dst (audit_ide_machine_incidence state) found) found)
                  (fun found => ide_enqueue_with_bodies_counted
                    (match found with Some xs => xs | None => [] end) rest queued))
            | _,_ => exact_case 2150 (exact_return 2150 (rest,queued)) end) (fun todo =>
          exact_return 2151 (Some (AuditIdeMachine (audit_ide_machine_rules state)
            (audit_ide_machine_table state) (audit_ide_machine_incidence state)
            (fst todo) (snd todo) values (probe :: audit_ide_machine_probes_rev state))))))) end)))
              end.

Fixpoint ide_loop_with_bodies_counted fuel (state : audit_ide_machine N D F)
    : exact_counted Call (audit_ide_machine N D F) :=
  match audit_ide_machine_pending state with
  | [] => exact_case 2160 (exact_return 2160 state)
  | _ => match fuel with
    | xH => exact_case 2161 (exact_bind 2161 (ide_step_with_bodies_counted state)
        (fun next => exact_return 2161 (match next with Some next => next | None => state end)))
    | xO p => exact_case 2162 (exact_bind 2162 (ide_loop_with_bodies_counted p state)
        (ide_loop_with_bodies_counted p))
    | xI p => exact_case 2163 (exact_bind 2163 (ide_loop_with_bodies_counted p state) (fun middle =>
        exact_bind 2163 (ide_loop_with_bodies_counted p middle) (fun last =>
        exact_bind 2163 (ide_step_with_bodies_counted last)
          (fun next => exact_return 2163 (match next with Some next => next | None => last end)))))
            end end.

Definition ide_machine_body_valid (pair : Call * list audit_external_frame) : Prop :=
  match fst pair with
  | IdeMachineCompose x y out => audit_external_body (ide_compose_adapter adapters) (x,y) out (snd
    pair)
  | IdeMachineJoin x y out => audit_external_body (ide_join_adapter adapters) (x,y) out (snd pair)
  | IdeMachineEqual x y out => audit_external_body (ide_equal_adapter adapters) (x,y) out (snd pair)
  | _ => False end.
Definition ide_machine_body_input_budget (pair : Call * list audit_external_frame) : nat :=
  match fst pair with
  | IdeMachineCompose x y _ => external_input_budget (ide_compose_adapter adapters) (x,y)
  | IdeMachineJoin x y _ => external_input_budget (ide_join_adapter adapters) (x,y)
  | IdeMachineEqual x y _ => external_input_budget (ide_equal_adapter adapters) (x,y)
  | _ => 0 end.

Definition audit_ide_machine_with_bodies_statement : Prop :=
  audit_ide_registry_adapter_laws adapters -> forall fuel state,
  let run := ide_loop_with_bodies_counted fuel state in
  exact_value run = fst (audit_ide_loop_counted EN ED r fuel state) /\
  Forall ide_machine_body_valid (exact_bodies run) /\
  fold_right (fun body rest => audit_external_trace_work (snd body) + rest) 0 (exact_bodies run) <=
    fold_right (fun body rest => ide_machine_body_input_budget body + rest) 0 (exact_bodies run).
End Bodies.

(** * Whole generated IDE source execution with genuine callback bodies

    Card: AUD-IDE-GEN. Base encoder allowances come from their individual certified input
    budgets; internal derived encoders have the fixed library composition duties. Dictionary
    and weight callbacks execute their counted adapters once and retain actual body receipts. *)
Section GeneratedBodies.
Context {N P D A F : Type} (EN : encoding N) (EP : encoding P) (ED : encoding D)
  (L : lattice A) (r : ide_registry A F) (q : ip_problem N P D)
  (weight : ip_edge N P D -> option D -> option D -> F)
  (encoders : audit_ide_graph_encoding_adapters EN EP ED)
  (dictionary : audit_ide_registry_adapters r) (weighted : audit_ide_weight_adapter weight).
Let nb := external_input_budget (ide_node_encoding_adapter encoders).
Let pb := external_input_budget (ide_site_encoding_adapter encoders).
Let db := external_input_budget (ide_fact_encoding_adapter encoders).
Let Call := ide_generated_source_call N P D A F.

Definition ide_generate_arcs_with_bodies_counted : exact_counted Call (list (audit_ide_arc N P D F))
  :=
  exact_flat_map 2200 (fun edge => exact_map 2201 (fun pair =>
    let '(x,y) := pair in
    exact_bind 2202 (exact_external_call weighted (edge,(x,y))
      (fun out => IdeSourceWeight edge x y out)) (fun out =>
    exact_return 2203 (AuditIdeArc (ip_action edge) (ip_source edge,x) (ip_target edge,y) out)))
      (ip_pairs edge)) (ip_edges q).

Definition ide_generated_with_bodies_counted start seed
    : exact_counted Call (ide_registry_summary N D F) :=
  exact_bind 2210 (ide_source_vertices (A:=A) (F:=F) q) (fun vertices =>
  exact_bind 2211 ide_generate_arcs_with_bodies_counted (fun arcs =>
  let '(index,index_events) := audit_ide_generate_index_counted EP arcs in
  exact_bind 2212 (exact_call (IdeSourceGenerator index_events)
    (ide_generator_source_work EP pb index_events) index) (fun index =>
  let '(matches,match_events) := audit_ide_generate_matches_counted EP index arcs in
  exact_bind 2213 (exact_call (IdeSourceGenerator match_events)
    (ide_generator_source_work EP pb match_events) matches) (fun matches =>
  exact_bind 2214 (ide_source_rows r vertices arcs matches (start,seed)) (fun rules =>
  exact_bind 2215 (ide_source_keys (A:=A) (F:=F) q) (fun keys =>
  let '(initial,initial_events) := audit_ide_initial_counted EN ED rules in
  exact_bind 2216 (exact_call (IdeSourceInitial initial_events)
    (ide_initial_source_work EN ED nb db initial_events) initial) (fun initial =>
  let fuel := audit_ide_machine_fuel r keys rules in
  exact_bind 2217 (exact_call (IdeSourceFuel (length rules) (length keys) (audit_ide_bound r) fuel)
    (1024 + audit_ide_fuel_model r keys rules) fuel) (fun fuel =>
  exact_bind 2218 (exact_lift (fun call => IdeSourceMachine [call])
    (ide_loop_with_bodies_counted EN ED r dictionary nb db fuel initial)) (fun final =>
  exact_bind 2219 (exact_rev 2219 (audit_ide_machine_probes_rev final)) (fun probes =>
    exact_return 2220 (IdeRegistrySummary (audit_ide_machine_values final) probes))))))))))).

Definition ide_generated_query_with_bodies_counted summary initial n d
    : exact_counted Call (option A) :=
  exact_bind 2230 (exact_get IdeSourceFact (IpTab.fact_encoding EN ED)
    (ide_fact_body EN ED nb db) (inr (n,d)) (ide_registry_summary_map summary)) (fun found =>
  match found with
  | None => exact_case 2231 (exact_return 2231 None)
  | Some f => exact_case 2232
      (exact_bind 2233 (exact_external_call (ide_eval_adapter dictionary) (f,initial)
        (fun out => IdeSourceEval f initial out)) (fun out => exact_return 2234 (Some out))) end).

Definition ide_generated_external_body_valid (body : Call * list audit_external_frame) : Prop :=
  match fst body with
  | IdeSourceWeight edge x y out => audit_external_body weighted (edge,(x,y)) out (snd body)
  | IdeSourceEval f x out => audit_external_body (ide_eval_adapter dictionary) (f,x) out (snd body)
  | IdeSourceMachine [IdeMachineCompose x y out] =>
      audit_external_body (ide_compose_adapter dictionary) (x,y) out (snd body)
  | IdeSourceMachine [IdeMachineJoin x y out] =>
      audit_external_body (ide_join_adapter dictionary) (x,y) out (snd body)
  | IdeSourceMachine [IdeMachineEqual x y out] =>
      audit_external_body (ide_equal_adapter dictionary) (x,y) out (snd body)
  | _ => False end.
Definition ide_generated_external_body_budget (body : Call * list audit_external_frame) : nat :=
  match fst body with
  | IdeSourceWeight edge x y _ => external_input_budget weighted (edge,(x,y))
  | IdeSourceEval f x _ => external_input_budget (ide_eval_adapter dictionary) (f,x)
  | IdeSourceMachine [IdeMachineCompose x y _] => external_input_budget (ide_compose_adapter
    dictionary) (x,y)
  | IdeSourceMachine [IdeMachineJoin x y _] => external_input_budget (ide_join_adapter dictionary)
    (x,y)
  | IdeSourceMachine [IdeMachineEqual x y _] => external_input_budget (ide_equal_adapter dictionary)
    (x,y)
  | _ => 0 end.
Definition ide_generated_external_allowance bodies :=
  fold_right (fun body rest => ide_generated_external_body_budget body + rest) 0 bodies.

Definition audit_ide_generated_with_bodies_statement : Prop :=
  audit_ide_graph_encoding_laws encoders -> audit_ide_registry_adapter_laws dictionary ->
  audit_external_adapter_laws weighted -> forall start seed,
    ide_registry_laws L r -> ip_problem_wf q -> In start (ip_nodes q) ->
    (match seed with None => True | Some d => In d (ip_facts q) end) ->
    let run := ide_generated_with_bodies_counted start seed in
    exact_value run = ide_registry_solve EN EP ED L r q weight start seed /\
    Forall ide_generated_external_body_valid (exact_bodies run) /\
    exact_units run <= 16 * ide_generated_source_budget EN EP ED r q weight nb pb db start seed +
      ide_generated_external_allowance (exact_bodies run).

Definition audit_ide_generated_query_with_bodies_statement : Prop :=
  audit_ide_graph_encoding_laws encoders -> audit_ide_registry_adapter_laws dictionary ->
  forall summary initial n d,
    let run := ide_generated_query_with_bodies_counted summary initial n d in
    exact_value run = ide_registry_query EN ED r summary initial n d /\
    Forall ide_generated_external_body_valid (exact_bodies run) /\
    exact_units run <= 8192 + 4 * ide_fact_body EN ED nb db (inr (n,d)) +
      1024 * Pos.size_nat (encode (IpTab.fact_encoding EN ED) (inr (n,d))) +
      ide_generated_external_allowance (exact_bodies run).
End GeneratedBodies.
```

```coq
(** * Strict IDE selection and fixed semantic instances

    This canonical candidate fixes executable definitions and future proposition types.
    For example, each source mirror retains the actual operands and returned result.

From Stdlib Require Import Arith Bool List PArith.
From Galois.Analyses Require Export AnalysesAuditIdeBase AnalysesAuditIdeGenerated
  AnalysesAuditIdeLegacy AnalysesAuditSource.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesInterprocedural.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditCost CollectionsAuditElements
  CollectionsAuditEncoding CollectionsAuditMap CollectionsAuditPrimitive CollectionsAuditTrie
  CollectionsAuditUnion CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap.
From Galois.Order Require Import OrderBasic OrderLattice.
Import List.ListNotations.

(** * Strict IDE selection and fixed semantic instances

    This canonical candidate fixes executable definitions and future proposition types.

    Builds on: the explicitly imported canonical dependency modules below. *)

(* Definition source: IdeSelectWhole.v *)
(** * Fixed public IDE producer, strict compatibility and exact selected execution

    Card: AUD-IDE. Construction and returned-query costs are separate. All dictionary and
    registry bodies are genuine supplied adapters; finite library bodies are expanded by the
    legacy and generated models. The generated interface never enumerates A or F. *)

Definition ide_registry_select {N P D A F} (EN : encoding N) (EP : encoding P)
    (ED : encoding D) (EA : encoding A) (old : ide_problem N P D A) (r : ide_registry A F)
    (weight : ip_edge N P D -> option D -> option D -> F) start seed initial :=
  if audit_ide_finite_compatible_check old r weight then
    let summary := ide_registry_solve EN EP ED (ide_lattice old) r (ide_graph old) weight start seed
      in
    AuditIdeFiniteSelection AuditIdeGenerated (ide_registry_query EN ED r summary initial)
  else AuditIdeFiniteSelection AuditIdeFiniteLegacy
    (audit_ide_legacy_query EN EP ED EA old start seed initial).

Section Selection.
Context {N P D A F : Type} (EN : encoding N) (EP : encoding P) (ED : encoding D)
  (EA : encoding A) (old : ide_problem N P D A) (r : ide_registry A F)
  (weight : ip_edge N P D -> option D -> option D -> F).
Context (node_body : N -> nat) (site_body : P -> nat) (fact_body : D -> nat)
  (value_body : A -> nat).
Let Call := ide_generated_source_call N P D A F.

Definition ide_compatibility_value_counted edge x y a : exact_counted Call bool :=
  let transformer := weight edge x y in
  exact_bind 1100 (exact_call (IdeSourceWeight edge x y transformer) 0 transformer) (fun f =>
  let new := audit_ide_eval r f a in
  exact_bind 1101 (exact_call (IdeSourceEval f a new) 0 new) (fun new =>
  let prior := ide_weight old edge x y a in
  exact_bind 1102 (exact_call (IdeSourceOldWeight edge x y a prior) 0 prior) (fun prior =>
  let first := OrderLattice.leb (ide_lattice old) new prior in
  exact_bind 1103 (exact_call (IdeSourceLe new prior first) 0 first) (fun first =>
  let second := OrderLattice.leb (ide_lattice old) prior new in
  exact_bind 1104 (exact_call (IdeSourceLe prior new second) 0 second) (fun second =>
    exact_return 1105 (first && second)))))).

Definition ide_compatibility_counted : exact_counted Call bool :=
  exact_all 1106 (fun edge => exact_all 1107 (fun pair =>
    exact_all 1108 (ide_compatibility_value_counted edge (fst pair) (snd pair))
      (ide_values old)) (ip_pairs edge)) (ip_edges (ide_graph old)).

Definition ide_compatibility_input_budget : nat :=
  4096 * (1 + length (ip_edges (ide_graph old)) + audit_ide_strict_pair_count old +
    audit_ide_strict_pair_count old * length (ide_values old)).

Record ide_source_selection : Type := IdeSourceSelection {
  ide_source_mode : audit_ide_selected_backend;
  ide_source_check : exact_counted Call bool;
  ide_source_generated : option (exact_counted Call (ide_registry_summary N D F));
  ide_source_legacy : option (ide_legacy_whole_run (N:=N) (P:=P) (D:=D) (A:=A));
  ide_source_selected_query : N -> option D -> option A;
  ide_source_selected_query_work : N -> option D -> nat;
  ide_source_build_work : nat
}.

Definition ide_select_source_counted start seed initial : ide_source_selection :=
  let check := ide_compatibility_counted in
  if exact_value check then
    let generated := ide_generated_source_counted EN EP ED r (ide_graph old)
      weight node_body site_body fact_body start seed in
    IdeSourceSelection AuditIdeGenerated check (Some generated) None
      (fun n d => exact_value (ide_generated_query_counted (P:=P) EN ED r node_body fact_body
        (exact_value generated) initial n d))
      (fun n d => exact_units (ide_generated_query_counted (P:=P) EN ED r node_body fact_body
        (exact_value generated) initial n d))
      (256 + exact_units check + exact_units generated)
  else
    let legacy := ide_legacy_whole_counted EN EP ED EA old node_body site_body fact_body
      value_body start seed initial in
    IdeSourceSelection AuditIdeFiniteLegacy check None (Some legacy)
      (fun n d => exact_value (ide_legacy_whole_query EN ED old node_body fact_body legacy n d))
      (fun n d => exact_units (ide_legacy_whole_query EN ED old node_body fact_body legacy n d))
      (256 + exact_units check + ide_legacy_whole_work EN ED EA node_body
        fact_body value_body legacy).

Definition ide_select_input_budget start seed initial : nat :=
  256 + ide_compatibility_input_budget +
  if audit_ide_finite_compatible_check old r weight then
    ide_generated_source_budget EN EP ED r (ide_graph old) weight node_body site_body fact_body
      start seed
  else ide_legacy_whole_input_budget EN EP ED EA old node_body site_body fact_body value_body start
    seed initial.

Definition ide_select_query_budget n d : nat :=
  8192 + ide_legacy_query_input_budget EN ED node_body fact_body n d +
  4 * ide_fact_body EN ED node_body fact_body (inr (n,d)) +
    1024 * Pos.size_nat (encode (IpTab.fact_encoding EN ED) (inr (n,d))).

Definition audit_ide_compatibility_full_source_statement : Prop :=
  exact_value ide_compatibility_counted = audit_ide_finite_compatible_check old r weight /\
  exact_units ide_compatibility_counted <= ide_compatibility_input_budget /\
  length (filter (fun event => match event with
    | AuditCall (IdeSourceLe _ _ _) => true | _ => false end)
      (exact_events ide_compatibility_counted)) =
    2 * audit_ide_strict_pair_count old * length (ide_values old).

Definition audit_ide_select_full_source_statement : Prop := forall start seed initial,
  ide_laws old -> ide_registry_laws (ide_lattice old) r ->
  ide_registry_congruence_laws (ide_lattice old) r ->
  In start (ip_nodes (ide_graph old)) ->
  (match seed with None => True | Some d => In d (ip_facts (ide_graph old)) end) ->
  let run := ide_select_source_counted start seed initial in
  let reference := @ide_registry_select N P D A F EN EP ED EA old r weight start seed initial in
  ide_source_mode run = audit_ide_selected_mode reference /\
  ide_source_build_work run <= ide_select_input_budget start seed initial /\
  (ide_source_mode run = AuditIdeGenerated <->
    audit_ide_finite_compatible_check old r weight = true) /\
  forall n d, ide_source_selected_query run n d = audit_ide_selected_query reference n d /\
    ide_source_selected_query_work run n d <= ide_select_query_budget n d.

End Selection.

(* Definition source: IdeSelectorConsumers.v *)
(** Card: AUD-IDE. Concrete public-client proof targets for both selected branches. *)
Definition audit_ide_selector_client : ide_problem bool unit unit bool :=
  IdeProblem (IpProblem [false] [] [] [IpEdge false false IpInternal [(None,None)]])
    bool_lattice [false;true] (fun _ _ _ value => value).
Definition audit_ide_selector_registry : ide_registry bool bool :=
  {| audit_ide_eval := fun f a => orb a f;
     audit_ide_id := false; audit_ide_compose := orb; audit_ide_join := orb;
     audit_ide_equal := Bool.eqb; audit_ide_rank := fun f => if f then 1 else 0;
     audit_ide_bound := 1 |}.

Definition audit_ide_selector_fast_consumer_statement : Prop :=
  let weight := fun (_ : ip_edge bool unit unit) (_ _ : option unit) => false in
  let run := ide_select_source_counted bool_encoding unit_encoding unit_encoding bool_encoding
    audit_ide_selector_client audit_ide_selector_registry weight
    (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => 1) false None false in
  ide_source_mode run = AuditIdeGenerated /\ ide_source_legacy run = None /\
  exact_value (ide_source_check run) = true /\
  ide_source_selected_query run false None = Some false /\
  ide_source_selected_query run true None = None /\
  0 < ide_source_build_work run /\
  ide_source_build_work run <= ide_select_input_budget bool_encoding unit_encoding unit_encoding
    bool_encoding audit_ide_selector_client audit_ide_selector_registry weight
    (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => 1) false None false.

Definition audit_ide_selector_fallback_consumer_statement : Prop :=
  let weight := fun (_ : ip_edge bool unit unit) (_ _ : option unit) => true in
  let run := ide_select_source_counted bool_encoding unit_encoding unit_encoding bool_encoding
    audit_ide_selector_client audit_ide_selector_registry weight
    (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => 1) false None false in
  ide_source_mode run = AuditIdeFiniteLegacy /\ ide_source_generated run = None /\
  exact_value (ide_source_check run) = false /\
  ide_source_selected_query run false None = Some false /\
  ide_source_selected_query run true None = None /\
  0 < ide_source_build_work run /\
  ide_source_build_work run <= ide_select_input_budget bool_encoding unit_encoding unit_encoding
    bool_encoding audit_ide_selector_client audit_ide_selector_registry weight
    (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => 1) false None false.

Definition audit_ide_nonempty_full_source_statement : Prop :=
  audit_ide_selector_fast_consumer_statement /\ audit_ide_selector_fallback_consumer_statement /\
  audit_ide_fixed_stream_consumer_statement /\ audit_ide_fixed_stream_bottom_statement.

(** * Whole selected execution with callback bodies

    Each compatibility callback runs its genuine counted adapter once. The selected branch
    uses the corresponding whole body model, and retains its actual callback receipts.
    For example, a failed compatibility test returns the finite fallback's own query.
    Builds on: generated and legacy body models. *)
Section SelectionBodies.
Context {N P D A F : Type} (EN : encoding N) (EP : encoding P) (ED : encoding D)
  (EA : encoding A) (old : ide_problem N P D A) (r : ide_registry A F)
  (weight : ip_edge N P D -> option D -> option D -> F)
  (dictionary : audit_ide_registry_adapters r) (weighted : audit_ide_weight_adapter weight)
  (legacy : audit_ide_legacy_adapters EN EP ED EA old).
Let encoders := ide_legacy_graph_encoding legacy.
Let nb := external_input_budget (ide_node_encoding_adapter encoders).
Let pb := external_input_budget (ide_site_encoding_adapter encoders).
Let db := external_input_budget (ide_fact_encoding_adapter encoders).
Let ab := external_input_budget (ide_value_encoding_adapter legacy).
Let Call := ide_generated_source_call N P D A F.

Definition ide_compatibility_value_with_bodies edge x y a : exact_counted Call bool :=
  exact_bind 2300 (exact_external_call weighted (edge,(x,y))
    (fun output => IdeSourceWeight edge x y output)) (fun f =>
  exact_bind 2301 (exact_external_call (ide_eval_adapter dictionary) (f,a)
    (fun output => IdeSourceEval f a output)) (fun new =>
  exact_bind 2302 (exact_external_call (ide_legacy_weight_adapter legacy) (edge,(x,(y,a)))
    (fun output => IdeSourceOldWeight edge x y a output)) (fun prior =>
  exact_bind 2303 (exact_external_call (ide_lattice_order_adapter legacy) (new,prior)
    (fun output => IdeSourceLe new prior output)) (fun first =>
  exact_bind 2304 (exact_external_call (ide_lattice_order_adapter legacy) (prior,new)
    (fun output => IdeSourceLe prior new output)) (fun second =>
    exact_return 2305 (first && second)))))).

Definition ide_compatibility_with_bodies : exact_counted Call bool :=
  exact_all 2306 (fun edge => exact_all 2307 (fun pair =>
    exact_all 2308 (ide_compatibility_value_with_bodies edge (fst pair) (snd pair))
      (ide_values old)) (ip_pairs edge)) (ip_edges (ide_graph old)).

Definition ide_compatibility_body_valid (body : Call * list audit_external_frame) : Prop :=
  match fst body with
  | IdeSourceWeight edge x y output =>
    audit_external_body weighted (edge,(x,y)) output (snd body)
  | IdeSourceEval f input output =>
    audit_external_body (ide_eval_adapter dictionary) (f,input) output (snd body)
  | IdeSourceOldWeight edge x y input output =>
    audit_external_body (ide_legacy_weight_adapter legacy) (edge,(x,(y,input))) output
      (snd body)
  | IdeSourceLe first second output =>
    audit_external_body (ide_lattice_order_adapter legacy) (first,second) output (snd body)
  | _ => False
  end.

Definition ide_compatibility_body_budget (body : Call * list audit_external_frame) : nat :=
  match fst body with
  | IdeSourceWeight edge x y _ => external_input_budget weighted (edge,(x,y))
  | IdeSourceEval f input _ => external_input_budget (ide_eval_adapter dictionary) (f,input)
  | IdeSourceOldWeight edge x y input _ =>
    external_input_budget (ide_legacy_weight_adapter legacy) (edge,(x,(y,input)))
  | IdeSourceLe first second _ =>
    external_input_budget (ide_lattice_order_adapter legacy) (first,second)
  | _ => 0
  end.

Definition ide_select_with_bodies start seed initial : ide_source_selection :=
  let check := ide_compatibility_with_bodies in
  if exact_value check then
    let generated := ide_generated_with_bodies_counted EN EP ED r (ide_graph old)
      weight encoders dictionary weighted start seed in
    IdeSourceSelection AuditIdeGenerated check (Some generated) None
      (fun n d => exact_value (ide_generated_query_with_bodies_counted (P:=P) EN EP ED r
        encoders dictionary (exact_value generated) initial n d))
      (fun n d => exact_units (ide_generated_query_with_bodies_counted (P:=P) EN EP ED r
        encoders dictionary (exact_value generated) initial n d))
      (256 + exact_units check + exact_units generated)
  else
    let finite := ide_legacy_whole_counted_with_bodies EN EP ED EA old legacy
      start seed initial in
    IdeSourceSelection AuditIdeFiniteLegacy check None (Some finite)
      (fun n d => exact_value (ide_legacy_whole_query EN ED old nb db finite n d))
      (fun n d => exact_units (ide_legacy_whole_query EN ED old nb db finite n d))
      (256 + exact_units check + ide_legacy_whole_work EN ED EA nb db ab finite).

Definition ide_select_body_allowance (run : ide_source_selection) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun body rest => ide_compatibility_body_budget body + rest) 0
    (exact_bodies (ide_source_check run)) +
  match ide_source_generated run with
  | Some generated => ide_generated_external_allowance r weight dictionary weighted
      (exact_bodies generated)
  | None => 0
  end +
  match ide_source_legacy run with
  | Some finite => fold_right (fun body rest => ide_legacy_body_budget EN EP ED EA old legacy body +
    rest) 0
      (ide_legacy_actual_bodies finite)
  | None => 0
  end.

(** Selected construction and query retain exact public results and charge every callback body. *)
Definition audit_ide_select_with_bodies_statement : Prop :=
  audit_ide_registry_adapter_laws dictionary -> audit_external_adapter_laws weighted ->
  audit_ide_legacy_adapter_laws legacy -> forall start seed initial,
  ide_laws old -> ide_registry_laws (ide_lattice old) r ->
  ide_registry_congruence_laws (ide_lattice old) r ->
  In start (ip_nodes (ide_graph old)) ->
  (match seed with None => True | Some d => In d (ip_facts (ide_graph old)) end) ->
  let run := ide_select_with_bodies start seed initial in
  let plain := ide_registry_select EN EP ED EA old r weight start seed initial in
  ide_source_mode run = audit_ide_selected_mode plain /\
  Forall ide_compatibility_body_valid (exact_bodies (ide_source_check run)) /\
  ide_source_build_work run <=
    16 * ide_select_input_budget EN EP ED EA old r weight nb pb db ab start seed initial +
    ide_select_body_allowance run /\
  forall n d,
    ide_source_selected_query run n d = audit_ide_selected_query plain n d /\
    ide_source_selected_query_work run n d <=
      16 * ide_select_query_budget EN ED nb db n d +
      match ide_source_generated run with
      | Some generated => ide_generated_external_allowance r weight dictionary weighted
          (exact_bodies (ide_generated_query_with_bodies_counted (P:=P) EN EP ED r encoders
            dictionary (exact_value generated) initial n d))
      | None => 0
      end.
End SelectionBodies.
(** * Closed instances of reusable algorithm predicates

    Generic predicates over an arbitrary solver or generator are specification vocabulary.
    The future claims below use the actual fixed producer, generator and direct query.
    For example, the stream consumer runs the indexed producer on its retained graph.
    Builds on: the public producer and its pure mathematical summary view. *)
Definition audit_ide_fixed_execute {N P D A F} (EN : encoding N) (EP : encoding P)
    (ED : encoding D) (L : lattice A) (r : ide_registry A F) (q : ip_problem N P D)
    weight start seed : audit_ide_summary N D F :=
  audit_ide_public_view (ide_registry_solve EN EP ED L r q weight start seed).

Definition audit_ide_fixed_rule_generator_statement : Prop :=

Definition audit_ide_fixed_generator_occurrences_statement : Prop :=

  audit_ide_stream_consumer_statement (@audit_ide_fixed_execute nat nat unit audit_ide_stream bool).
Definition audit_ide_fixed_stream_bottom_execute_statement : Prop :=

Definition audit_ide_fixed_execute_trace_statement : Prop :=
  forall N P D A F (EN : encoding N) (EP : encoding P) (ED : encoding D)
    (L : lattice A) (r : ide_registry A F) (q : ip_problem N P D) weight,
    audit_ide_execute_trace_statement EN EP ED L r q weight
      (@audit_ide_fixed_execute N P D A F).
```
