```coq
(** * Whole PRE original callback source closure

    This canonical candidate fixes executable definitions and future proposition types.
    For example, each source mirror retains the actual operands and returned result.
    Builds on: the explicitly imported canonical dependency modules below. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith Bool List PArith.
From Galois.Analyses Require Export AnalysesAuditPre AnalysesAuditPreFamily AnalysesAuditPreFinite
  AnalysesAuditPreFrg AnalysesAuditPrePlan AnalysesAuditPreSolve AnalysesAuditSource.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAvailable AnalysesSsaPre AnalysesSsaPreGraph
  AnalysesSsaPreSemantics.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditCost CollectionsAuditElements
  CollectionsAuditEncoding CollectionsAuditFinSet CollectionsAuditMap CollectionsAuditPrimitive
  CollectionsAuditTrie CollectionsAuditUnion CollectionsEncoding CollectionsFinSet CollectionsMap.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphAuditBase GraphAuditDfs GraphAuditDominators
  GraphAuditFrontier GraphAuditLengauerTarjan GraphAuditSemiDominators GraphAuditVirtual GraphCore
  GraphDfs GraphDominance GraphDominators GraphFrontier GraphLengauerTarjan GraphPrepare
  GraphSemiDominators.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsGraph ViewsSemantics ViewsSsa ViewsSsaPoints.
Import List.ListNotations.

(** * Genuine original PRE view callback sources

    Only functions supplied by the original public encodings and expression/graph view
    receive external adapters. Internal phi graphs, reset closures and derived encoders use
    fixed library source instances and the actual callback payloads already retained.
    For example, a translation receipt names its original incoming edge and expression.
    Builds on: exact source combinators and the canonical PRE phase models. *)
Section PreCallbackTypes.
Context {S O B BE N E V K C U : Type}
  (EB : encoding B) (EBE : encoding BE) (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
  (EV : encoding V) (EU : encoding U) (a : pre_expr_ssa S O B BE N E V K C U).
Let bg := block_graph (pre_ssa_points a).
Let pg := live_graph (point_model (pre_ssa_points a)).

Record audit_pre_view_adapters : Type := PreViewAdapters {
  pre_block_encoder : audit_external_adapter B positive (encode EB);
  pre_block_edge_encoder : audit_external_adapter BE positive (encode EBE);
  pre_point_encoder : audit_external_adapter N positive (encode EN);
  pre_edge_encoder : audit_external_adapter E positive (encode EE);
  pre_value_encoder : audit_external_adapter V positive (encode EV);
  pre_expr_encoder : audit_external_adapter U positive (encode EU);
  pre_block_out_source : audit_external_adapter B (list BE) (Graph.out bg);
  pre_block_source_source : audit_external_adapter BE B (Graph.source bg);
  pre_block_target_source : audit_external_adapter BE B (Graph.target bg);
  pre_point_out_source : audit_external_adapter N (list E) (Graph.out pg);
  pre_point_source_source : audit_external_adapter E N (Graph.source pg);
  pre_point_target_source : audit_external_adapter E N (Graph.target pg);
  pre_expression_target_source : audit_external_adapter E N
    (Graph.target (cfg (gkview (pre_genkill (pre_expression a)))));
  pre_operands_source : audit_external_adapter U (list V) (pre_operands a);
  pre_translate_source : audit_external_adapter (BE * U) (option U)
    (fun input => pre_phi_translate a (fst input) (snd input));
  pre_initial_source : audit_external_adapter U bool (pre_initial_available a);
  pre_pure_source : audit_external_adapter U bool (pre_total_pure (pre_expression a));
  pre_recomputed_source : audit_external_adapter E (option U) (pre_recomputed (pre_expression a));
  pre_kill_source : audit_external_adapter (E * U) bool
    (fun input => kill (pre_genkill (pre_expression a)) (fst input) (snd input));
  pre_parameter_source : audit_external_adapter B E (parameter_edge (pre_ssa_points a));
  pre_points_source : audit_external_adapter B (list N) (points_in_block (pre_ssa_points a));
  pre_instructions_source : audit_external_adapter B (list E)
    (instruction_edges (pre_ssa_points a));
  pre_definitions_source : audit_external_adapter E (list V)
    (edge_def (point_model (pre_ssa_points a)));
  pre_exit_source : audit_external_adapter N bool (pre_exit_point a);
  pre_home_source : audit_external_adapter V B (home (pre_ssa_view a));
  pre_block_of_source : audit_external_adapter N B (block_of_point (pre_ssa_points a));
  pre_block_params_source : audit_external_adapter B (list V) (block_params (pre_ssa_points a));
  pre_block_edge_of_source : audit_external_adapter E (option BE)
    (block_edge_of (pre_ssa_points a))
}.

Definition audit_pre_view_adapter_laws (adapters : audit_pre_view_adapters) : Prop :=
  audit_external_adapter_laws (pre_block_encoder adapters) /\
  audit_external_adapter_laws (pre_block_edge_encoder adapters) /\
  audit_external_adapter_laws (pre_point_encoder adapters) /\
  audit_external_adapter_laws (pre_edge_encoder adapters) /\
  audit_external_adapter_laws (pre_value_encoder adapters) /\
  audit_external_adapter_laws (pre_expr_encoder adapters) /\
  audit_external_adapter_laws (pre_block_out_source adapters) /\
  audit_external_adapter_laws (pre_block_source_source adapters) /\
  audit_external_adapter_laws (pre_block_target_source adapters) /\
  audit_external_adapter_laws (pre_point_out_source adapters) /\
  audit_external_adapter_laws (pre_point_source_source adapters) /\
  audit_external_adapter_laws (pre_point_target_source adapters) /\
  audit_external_adapter_laws (pre_expression_target_source adapters) /\
  audit_external_adapter_laws (pre_operands_source adapters) /\
  audit_external_adapter_laws (pre_translate_source adapters) /\
  audit_external_adapter_laws (pre_initial_source adapters) /\
  audit_external_adapter_laws (pre_pure_source adapters) /\
  audit_external_adapter_laws (pre_recomputed_source adapters) /\
  audit_external_adapter_laws (pre_kill_source adapters) /\
  audit_external_adapter_laws (pre_parameter_source adapters) /\
  audit_external_adapter_laws (pre_points_source adapters) /\
  audit_external_adapter_laws (pre_instructions_source adapters) /\
  audit_external_adapter_laws (pre_definitions_source adapters) /\
  audit_external_adapter_laws (pre_exit_source adapters) /\
  audit_external_adapter_laws (pre_home_source adapters) /\
  audit_external_adapter_laws (pre_block_of_source adapters) /\
  audit_external_adapter_laws (pre_block_params_source adapters) /\
  audit_external_adapter_laws (pre_block_edge_of_source adapters).
End PreCallbackTypes.

Definition pre_receipt_work (receipts : list (list audit_external_frame * nat)) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun receipt rest => audit_external_trace_work (fst receipt) + rest) 0 receipts.
Definition pre_receipt_allowance (receipts : list (list audit_external_frame * nat)) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun receipt rest => snd receipt + rest) 0 receipts.
Definition pre_receipt_trace (receipts : list (list audit_external_frame * nat)) :=
  concat (map fst receipts).

Definition pre_fixed_calls_receipt {Call}
    (source : Call -> list audit_external_frame -> nat -> Prop)
    (calls : list Call) trace allowance : Prop :=
  exists receipts,
    Forall2 (fun call receipt => source call (fst receipt) (snd receipt)) calls receipts /\
    trace = pre_receipt_trace receipts /\ allowance = pre_receipt_allowance receipts.

Definition pre_actual_external_receipt {I O plain}
    (adapter : audit_external_adapter I O plain) input output trace allowance : Prop :=
  audit_external_same_call adapter input output trace /\
  allowance = external_input_budget adapter input.

Definition pre_internal_receipt (trace : list audit_external_frame) (allowance : nat) : Prop :=
  trace = [] /\ allowance = 0.

Definition pre_pair_source_receipt {A B} (EA : encoding A) (EB : encoding B)
    (left : A -> positive -> list audit_external_frame -> nat -> Prop)
    (right : B -> positive -> list audit_external_frame -> nat -> Prop)
    (input : A * B) output trace allowance : Prop :=
  exists first second first_trace second_trace first_allowance second_allowance,
    left (fst input) first first_trace first_allowance /\
    right (snd input) second second_trace second_allowance /\
    first = encode EA (fst input) /\ second = encode EB (snd input) /\
    output = fst (audit_pair_encode (fun _ : A => (first,([] : list unit)))
      (fun _ : B => (second,([] : list unit))) input) /\
    trace = first_trace ++ second_trace /\ allowance = first_allowance + second_allowance.

Definition pre_actual_map_receipt {K V}
    (source : K -> positive -> list audit_external_frame -> nat -> Prop)
    (call : exact_map_call K V) trace allowance : Prop :=
  match call with
  | ExactEncode key code => source key code trace allowance
  | _ => pre_internal_receipt trace allowance
  end.

Definition pre_audit_event_receipt {Call}
    (source : Call -> list audit_external_frame -> nat -> Prop)
    (event : audit_event Call) trace allowance : Prop :=
  match event with
  | AuditCall call => source call trace allowance
  | _ => pre_internal_receipt trace allowance
  end.

Definition pre_map_callback_calls {K V Call} (event : audit_map_event K V Call) : list Call :=
  match event with
  | AuditMapGet _ _ _ _ body _ | AuditMapSet _ _ _ _ _ body _ |
      AuditMapRemove _ _ _ _ body _ => body
  end.
Definition pre_set_callback_calls {K Call} (event : audit_set_event K Call) : list Call :=
  match event with
  | AuditSetAdd _ _ _ _ body _ | AuditSetMem _ _ _ _ body _ |
      AuditSetRemove _ _ _ _ body _ => body
  | AuditSetFold _ _ => []
  end.
Definition pre_prepare_callback_calls {V E Call}
    (event : audit_prepare_source_event V E Call) : list Call :=
  match event with
  | PrepareSourceOut _ _ body | PrepareSourceTarget _ _ body => body
  | PrepareSourceMap call => pre_map_callback_calls call
  | _ => []
  end.
Definition pre_dfs_callback_calls {V E Call}
    (event : audit_dfs_nested_event V E (audit_graph_callback_capture V E Call)) : list Call :=
  flat_map (fun captured => match captured with
    | AuditGraphTargetCapture _ _ _ _ _ body | AuditGraphEncodeCapture _ _ _ _ _ body => body
    end) (snd event).

Section PrePhaseBodyReceipts.
Context {S O B BE N E V K C U : Type}
  (EB : encoding B) (EBE : encoding BE) (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
  (EV : encoding V) (EU : encoding U) (a : pre_expr_ssa S O B BE N E V K C U)
  (adapters : audit_pre_view_adapters EB EBE EN EE EV EU a).
Let bs := pre_actual_external_receipt (pre_block_encoder EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters).
Let bes := pre_actual_external_receipt (pre_block_edge_encoder EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters).
Let ns := pre_actual_external_receipt (pre_point_encoder EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters).
Let es := pre_actual_external_receipt (pre_edge_encoder EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters).
Let vs := pre_actual_external_receipt (pre_value_encoder EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters).
Let us := pre_actual_external_receipt (pre_expr_encoder EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters).
Let bu := pre_pair_source_receipt EB EU bs us.
Let ubu := pre_pair_source_receipt EU EB us bs.
Let beu := pre_pair_source_receipt EBE EU bes us.
Let eep := pre_pair_source_receipt EE EE es es.
Let eeu := pre_pair_source_receipt (pair_encoding EE EE) EU eep us.
Let bube := pre_pair_source_receipt (pair_encoding EB EU) EBE bu bes.

Definition pre_frg_version_receipt (input : frg_version B E U) output trace allowance : Prop :=
  output = fst (pre_frg_source_encoding EB EE EU input) /\
  match input with
  | FrUnavailable u | FrInitial u => us u (encode EU u) trace allowance
  | FrFresh e u => pre_pair_source_receipt EE EU es us (e,u)
      (encode (pair_encoding EE EU) (e,u)) trace allowance
  | FrPhi b u => bu (b,u) (encode (pair_encoding EB EU) (b,u)) trace allowance
  end.

Definition pre_family_call_receipt (call : pre_family_call B BE V U) trace allowance : Prop :=
  match call with
  | PreFamilyExpr nested => pre_actual_map_receipt us nested trace allowance
  | PreFamilyEdges nested => pre_actual_map_receipt bes nested trace allowance
  | PreFamilyOut block result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_block_out_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) block result trace allowance
  | PreFamilyOperands u result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_operands_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) u result trace allowance
  | PreFamilyTranslate edge u result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_translate_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) (edge,u) result trace allowance
  | _ => pre_internal_receipt trace allowance
  end.

Definition pre_rename_call_receipt (call : pre_rename_call B BE N E V U) trace allowance : Prop :=
  match call with
  | PrnScope nested => pre_actual_map_receipt us nested trace allowance
  | PrnOccurrence nested => pre_actual_map_receipt es nested trace allowance
  | PrnFresh nested => pre_actual_map_receipt es nested trace allowance
  | PrnLink nested => pre_actual_map_receipt bube nested trace allowance
  | PrnUnsafe nested => pre_actual_map_receipt bu nested trace allowance
  | PrnSeen nested => pre_actual_map_receipt bs nested trace allowance
  | PrnGroupBU nested => pre_actual_map_receipt bs nested trace allowance
  | PrnGroupEU nested => pre_actual_map_receipt es nested trace allowance
  | PrnGroupVU nested => pre_actual_map_receipt vs nested trace allowance
  | PrnSites nested => pre_actual_map_receipt us nested trace allowance
  | PrnPred nested => pre_actual_map_receipt bs nested trace allowance
  | PrnSetU nested => pre_actual_map_receipt us nested trace allowance
  | PrnExit nested => pre_actual_map_receipt ns nested trace allowance
  | PrnArguments nested => pre_actual_map_receipt bs nested trace allowance
  | PrnSetArgument nested => pre_actual_map_receipt beu nested trace allowance
  | PrnChildren nested => pre_actual_map_receipt bs nested trace allowance
  | PrnPhis nested => pre_actual_map_receipt bu nested trace allowance
  | PrnVersions nested => pre_actual_map_receipt pre_frg_version_receipt nested trace allowance
  | PrnInitial u result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_initial_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) u result trace allowance
  | PrnPure u result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_pure_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) u result trace allowance
  | PrnRecomputed edge result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_recomputed_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) edge result trace allowance
  | PrnTranslate edge u result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_translate_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) (edge,u) result trace allowance
  | PrnKilled edge u result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_kill_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) (edge,u) result trace allowance
  | PrnTarget edge result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_point_target_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) edge result trace allowance
  | PrnBlockTarget edge result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_block_target_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) edge result trace allowance
  | PrnBlockSource edge result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_block_source_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) edge result trace allowance
  | PrnParameter block result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_parameter_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) block result trace allowance
  | PrnPoints block result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_points_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) block result trace allowance
  | PrnInstructions block result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_instructions_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) block result trace allowance
  | PrnOperands u result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_operands_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) u result trace allowance
  | PrnDefinitions edge result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_definitions_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) edge result trace allowance
  | PrnOut point result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_point_out_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) point result trace allowance
  | PrnExitPoint point result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_exit_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) point result trace allowance
  | PrnEncodeU input output => us input output trace allowance
  | PrnEncodeE input output => es input output trace allowance
  | _ => pre_internal_receipt trace allowance
  end.

Definition pre_phi_call_receipt (call : pre_phi_call B BE N E V U) trace allowance : Prop :=
  match call with
  | PhiOccurrences nested => pre_actual_map_receipt us nested trace allowance
  | PhiParameters nested => pre_actual_map_receipt vs nested trace allowance
  | PhiBlocks nested => pre_actual_map_receipt bs nested trace allowance
  | PhiPairs nested => pre_actual_map_receipt ubu nested trace allowance
  | PhiFrontier nested => pre_actual_map_receipt bs nested trace allowance
  | PhiPred nested => pre_actual_map_receipt bs nested trace allowance
  | PhiHome value result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_home_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) value result trace allowance
  | PhiBlockOf point result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_block_of_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) point result trace allowance
  | PhiSource edge result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_point_source_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) edge result trace allowance
  | PhiBlockParams block result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_block_params_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) block result trace allowance
  | PhiRename nested => pre_rename_call_receipt nested trace allowance
  | _ => pre_internal_receipt trace allowance
  end.

Definition pre_finalize_call_receipt (call : pre_finalize_call B BE N E U) trace allowance : Prop :=
  match call with
  | PfFlags nested => pre_actual_map_receipt bu nested trace allowance
  | PfScope nested => pre_actual_map_receipt pre_frg_version_receipt nested trace allowance
  | PfReload nested => pre_actual_map_receipt es nested trace allowance
  | PfPhi nested => pre_actual_map_receipt eeu nested trace allowance
  | PfOccurrence nested => pre_actual_map_receipt es nested trace allowance
  | PfDom nested => pre_actual_map_receipt ns nested trace allowance
  | PfExpr nested => pre_actual_map_receipt us nested trace allowance
  | PfNodeRows nested => pre_actual_map_receipt ns nested trace allowance
  | PfArguments nested => pre_actual_map_receipt ns nested trace allowance
  | PfEdges nested => pre_actual_map_receipt ns nested trace allowance
  | PfIdom nested => pre_actual_map_receipt ns nested trace allowance
  | PfOutputs nested => pre_actual_map_receipt ns nested trace allowance
  | PfInitial u result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_initial_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) u result trace allowance
  | PfRecomputed edge result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_recomputed_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) edge result trace allowance
  | PfPure u result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_pure_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) u result trace allowance
  | PfTranslate edge u result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_translate_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) (edge,u) result trace allowance
  | PfKill edge u result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_kill_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) (edge,u) result trace allowance
  | PfParameter block result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_parameter_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) block result trace allowance
  | PfSource edge result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_point_source_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) edge result trace allowance
  | PfTarget edge result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_point_target_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) edge result trace allowance
  | PfExpressionTarget edge result =>
    pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_expression_target_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) edge result trace allowance
  | _ => pre_internal_receipt trace allowance
  end.

Definition pre_rows_call_receipt (call : pre_rows_call B BE N E U) trace allowance : Prop :=
  match call with
  | PrPointIndex nested => pre_actual_map_receipt bes nested trace allowance
  | PrLinks nested => pre_actual_map_receipt bube nested trace allowance
  | PrPhis nested => pre_actual_map_receipt bu nested trace allowance
  | PrOut point result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_point_out_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) point result trace allowance
  | PrBlockEdge edge result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_block_edge_of_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) edge result trace allowance
  | PrFinalize nested => pre_finalize_call_receipt nested trace allowance
  end.

Definition pre_materialize_call_receipt (call : pre_materialize_call E U) trace allowance : Prop :=
  match call with
  | PreMaterializePhi nested => pre_actual_map_receipt eeu nested trace allowance
  | PreMaterializeReload nested => pre_actual_map_receipt es nested trace allowance
  | PreMaterializeRows nested => pre_actual_map_receipt es nested trace allowance
  | PreMaterializeSet nested => pre_actual_map_receipt us nested trace allowance
  | PreMaterializeRecomputed edge result => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_recomputed_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) edge result trace allowance
  end.

(** The internal phi graph expands all nested source callbacks from this same construction. *)
Inductive pre_phi_graph_call_receipt : pre_phi_graph_call B BE N E V U ->
    list audit_external_frame -> nat -> Prop :=
  | PrePhiGraphBody call trace allowance :
    pre_phi_call_receipt call trace allowance ->
    pre_phi_graph_call_receipt (PhiGraphBody call) trace allowance
  | PrePhiGraphOut key result units events trace allowance :
    pre_fixed_calls_receipt (pre_audit_event_receipt pre_phi_call_receipt)
      events trace allowance ->
    pre_phi_graph_call_receipt (PhiGraphOut key result units events) trace allowance
  | PrePhiGraphEncode key code trace allowance :
    ubu key code trace allowance ->
    pre_phi_graph_call_receipt (PhiGraphEncode key code) trace allowance
  | PrePhiGraphTarget edge target :
    pre_phi_graph_call_receipt (PhiGraphTarget edge target) [] 0
  | PrePhiGraphPrepare graph events trace allowance :
    pre_fixed_calls_receipt (fun event => pre_fixed_calls_receipt pre_phi_graph_call_receipt
      (pre_prepare_callback_calls event)) events trace allowance ->
    pre_phi_graph_call_receipt (PhiGraphPrepare graph events) trace allowance
  | PrePhiGraphDfs graph events trace allowance :
    pre_fixed_calls_receipt (fun event => pre_fixed_calls_receipt pre_phi_graph_call_receipt
      (pre_dfs_callback_calls event)) events trace allowance ->
    pre_phi_graph_call_receipt (PhiGraphDfs graph events) trace allowance.

Definition pre_frg_call_receipt (call : pre_frg_call B BE N E V U) trace allowance : Prop :=
  match call with
  | FrgFamily nested => pre_family_call_receipt nested trace allowance
  | FrgPhi nested => pre_phi_graph_call_receipt nested trace allowance
  | FrgRename nested => pre_rename_call_receipt nested trace allowance
  | FrgParents nested => pre_actual_map_receipt bs nested trace allowance
  | FrgFuel _ _ _ => pre_internal_receipt trace allowance
  end.

(** Reset closure callbacks are concrete map/encode/projection bodies from the actual graph. *)
Inductive pre_closure_call_receipt : pre_closure_call (B * U) ->
    list audit_external_frame -> nat -> Prop :=
  | PreClosureRowsReceipt call trace allowance :
    pre_actual_map_receipt bu call trace allowance ->
    pre_closure_call_receipt (PreClosureRows call) trace allowance
  | PreClosureSetReceipt call trace allowance :
    pre_actual_map_receipt bu call trace allowance ->
    pre_closure_call_receipt (PreClosureSet call) trace allowance
  | PreClosureOutReceipt key result units events receipts :
    Forall2 (fun event receipt =>
      pre_closure_event_receipt event (fst receipt) (snd receipt)) events receipts ->
    pre_closure_call_receipt (PreClosureOut key result units events)
      (pre_receipt_trace receipts) (pre_receipt_allowance receipts)
  | PreClosureEncodeReceipt key code trace allowance :
    bu key code trace allowance ->
    pre_closure_call_receipt (PreClosureEncode key code) trace allowance
  | PreClosureTargetReceipt edge target :
    pre_closure_call_receipt (PreClosureTarget edge target) [] 0
  | PreClosurePrepareReceipt graph events trace allowance :
    pre_fixed_calls_receipt (fun event => pre_fixed_calls_receipt pre_closure_call_receipt
      (pre_prepare_callback_calls event)) events trace allowance ->
    pre_closure_call_receipt (PreClosurePrepare graph events) trace allowance
  | PreClosureDfsReceipt graph events trace allowance :
    pre_fixed_calls_receipt (fun event => pre_fixed_calls_receipt pre_closure_call_receipt
      (pre_dfs_callback_calls event)) events trace allowance ->
    pre_closure_call_receipt (PreClosureDfs graph events) trace allowance
with pre_closure_event_receipt : audit_event (pre_closure_call (B * U)) ->
    list audit_external_frame -> nat -> Prop :=
  | PreClosureEventCall call trace allowance :
    pre_closure_call_receipt call trace allowance ->
    pre_closure_event_receipt (AuditCall call) trace allowance
  | PreClosureEventCase site operands :
    pre_closure_event_receipt (AuditCase site operands) [] 0
  | PreClosureEventConstruct site operands :
    pre_closure_event_receipt (AuditConstruct site operands) [] 0
  | PreClosureEventKeyBit bit : pre_closure_event_receipt (AuditKeyBit bit) [] 0
  | PreClosureEventArithmetic site operands :
    pre_closure_event_receipt (AuditArithmetic site operands) [] 0.

Definition pre_solver_call_receipt (call : pre_solver_call B BE E U) trace allowance : Prop :=
  match call with
  | PreSolverClosure nested => pre_closure_call_receipt nested trace allowance
  | PreSolverFlags nested => pre_actual_map_receipt bu nested trace allowance
  | PreSolverKeys nested => pre_actual_map_receipt bu nested trace allowance
  | PreSolverLinks nested => pre_actual_map_receipt bube nested trace allowance
  end.

Definition pre_body_call_receipt (call : pre_place_body_call B BE N E V U) trace allowance
    : Prop :=
  match call with
  | PreBodyFrg nested => pre_frg_call_receipt nested trace allowance
  | PreBodySolve nested => pre_solver_call_receipt nested trace allowance
  | PreBodyFinalize nested => pre_rows_call_receipt nested trace allowance
  | PreBodyMaterialize nested => pre_materialize_call_receipt nested trace allowance
  end.
Definition pre_finite_call_receipt (accept : pre_plan E U -> bool)
    (accept_source : audit_external_adapter (pre_plan E U) bool accept)
    (call : pre_finite_call E U) trace allowance : Prop :=
  match call with
  | PfcRows nested => pre_actual_map_receipt es nested trace allowance
  | PfcExprs nested => pre_actual_map_receipt us nested trace allowance
  | PfcReload nested => pre_actual_map_receipt es nested trace allowance
  | PfcPhi nested => pre_actual_map_receipt eeu nested trace allowance
  | PfcRecomputed edge output => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_recomputed_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) edge output trace allowance
  | PfcAccept plan output =>
    pre_actual_external_receipt accept_source plan output trace allowance
  | PfcNatAdd _ _ _ | PfcNatLe _ _ _ => pre_internal_receipt trace allowance
  end.

(** Finite enumeration, checking and bounded correction retain their own actual callback calls. *)
Definition audit_pre_certificate_body_source_statement : Prop :=
  audit_pre_view_adapter_laws EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters ->
  forall edges exprs chosen candidates accept
    (accept_source : audit_external_adapter (pre_plan E U) bool accept),
  audit_external_adapter_laws accept_source ->
  let eb := external_input_budget (pre_edge_encoder EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) in
  let ub := external_input_budget (pre_expr_encoder EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) in
  let enumeration := pre_enumerate_counted EE EU eb ub edges exprs in
  let minimum := pre_minimum_check_counted EE EU eb ub edges exprs
    (pre_expression a) chosen candidates accept in
  let corrected := pre_choose_best_counted EE EU eb ub edges exprs
    (pre_expression a) accept candidates in
  exists enumeration_receipts minimum_receipts correction_receipts,
    Forall2 (fun event receipt => pre_audit_event_receipt
      (pre_finite_call_receipt accept accept_source) event (fst receipt) (snd receipt))
      (exact_events enumeration) enumeration_receipts /\
    Forall2 (fun event receipt => pre_audit_event_receipt
      (pre_finite_call_receipt accept accept_source) event (fst receipt) (snd receipt))
      (exact_events minimum) minimum_receipts /\
    Forall2 (fun event receipt => pre_audit_event_receipt
      (pre_finite_call_receipt accept accept_source) event (fst receipt) (snd receipt))
      (exact_events corrected) correction_receipts /\
    exact_units enumeration + pre_receipt_work enumeration_receipts <=
      64 * pre_enumerate_input_budget EE EU eb ub edges exprs +
      pre_receipt_allowance enumeration_receipts /\
    exact_units minimum + pre_receipt_work minimum_receipts <=
      64 * pre_minimum_input_budget EE EU eb ub edges exprs (length candidates) +
      pre_receipt_allowance minimum_receipts /\
    exact_units corrected + pre_receipt_work correction_receipts <=
      64 * pre_minimum_input_budget EE EU eb ub edges exprs (length candidates) +
      pre_receipt_allowance correction_receipts.
End PrePhaseBodyReceipts.
(** * Original callback leaves of the fixed graph source models *)
Definition pre_virtual_callback_calls {V E Call}
    (event : audit_virtual_full_call V E Call) : list Call :=
  match event with
  | VirtualFullOut _ _ body | VirtualFullTarget _ _ body |
      VirtualFullSource _ _ body | VirtualFullEncode _ _ body => body
  | VirtualFullEntry (VirtualEntriesSet call) => pre_set_callback_calls call
  | _ => []
  end.
Definition pre_semi_callback_calls {V Call} (event : audit_semi_nested_event V Call)
    : list Call :=
  match event with
  | SemiNestedVertexMap call => pre_map_callback_calls call
  | SemiNestedRankMap call => pre_map_callback_calls call
  | _ => []
  end.
Definition pre_semi_producer_callback_calls {V E Call}
    (event : audit_semi_producer_nested_event V E Call) : list Call :=
  match event with
  | SemiProducerSource _ _ body => body
  | SemiProducerInner nested => pre_semi_callback_calls nested
  | SemiProducerTreeMap call => pre_map_callback_calls call
  | SemiProducerPredMap call => pre_map_callback_calls call
  | _ => []
  end.
Definition pre_lt_callback_calls {V E Call} (event : audit_lt_nested_event V E Call)
    : list Call :=
  match event with
  | LtNestedSemi call => pre_semi_callback_calls call
  | LtNestedProducer call => pre_semi_producer_callback_calls call
  | LtNestedBucket call => pre_map_callback_calls call
  | LtNestedTree call => pre_map_callback_calls call
  | LtNestedSource _ _ body | LtNestedEncode _ _ body => body
  | _ => []
  end.
Definition pre_erase_callback_calls {V Call} (event : audit_erase_nested_event V Call)
    : list Call :=
  match event with
  | EraseNestedSet call => pre_map_callback_calls call
  | _ => []
  end.
Definition pre_dom_body_callback_calls {V Call} (event : audit_dom_source_body V Call)
    : list Call :=
  match event with
  | DomSourceBodyMap call => pre_map_callback_calls call
  | DomSourceBodyEncode _ _ body => body
  | _ => []
  end.
Definition pre_dom_callback_calls {V E Call} (event : audit_dom_source_event V E Call)
    : list Call :=
  match event with
  | DomSourceInitialDfs call => pre_dfs_callback_calls call
  | DomSourceChild call => pre_map_callback_calls call
  | DomSourceParent call => pre_map_callback_calls call
  | DomSourcePrepare call =>
    flat_map pre_dom_body_callback_calls (pre_prepare_callback_calls call)
  | DomSourceDfs call => flat_map pre_dom_body_callback_calls (pre_dfs_callback_calls call)
  | _ => []
  end.
Definition pre_frontier_callback_calls {V E Call} (event : audit_frontier_source_event V E Call)
    : list Call :=
  match event with
  | FrontierSourceDfs call => pre_dfs_callback_calls call
  | FrontierSourceSource _ _ body | FrontierSourceTarget _ _ body => body
  | FrontierSourceParent call => pre_map_callback_calls call
  | FrontierSourceRank call => pre_map_callback_calls call
  | FrontierSourcePred call => pre_map_callback_calls call
  | FrontierSourceRows call => pre_map_callback_calls call
  | FrontierSourceSet call => pre_set_callback_calls call
  | _ => []
  end.

Definition pre_dom_actual_callback_calls {V E Call EV}
    (data : pre_dom_source_data V E Call EV) : list Call :=
  flat_map pre_virtual_callback_calls
    (flat_map pre_prepare_callback_calls (pre_dom_prepare_events data)) ++
  flat_map pre_virtual_callback_calls
    (flat_map pre_dfs_callback_calls (pre_dom_dfs_events data)) ++
  flat_map pre_virtual_callback_calls
    (flat_map pre_semi_producer_callback_calls (pre_dom_semi data)) ++
  flat_map pre_virtual_callback_calls
    (flat_map pre_lt_callback_calls (pre_dom_lt data)) ++
  flat_map pre_erase_callback_calls (pre_dom_erase data) ++
  flat_map pre_dom_callback_calls (audit_dom_source_events (pre_dom_search data)).

Section PreWholeBodySource.
Context {S O B BE N E V K C U : Type}
  (EB : encoding B) (EBE : encoding BE) (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
  (EV : encoding V) (EU : encoding U) (a : pre_expr_ssa S O B BE N E V K C U)
  (adapters : audit_pre_view_adapters EB EBE EN EE EV EU a).
Let bg := block_graph (pre_ssa_points a).
Let pg := live_graph (point_model (pre_ssa_points a)).
Let bb := external_input_budget (pre_block_encoder EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters).
Let beb := external_input_budget (pre_block_edge_encoder EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters).
Let nb := external_input_budget (pre_point_encoder EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters).
Let eb := external_input_budget (pre_edge_encoder EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters).
Let vb := external_input_budget (pre_value_encoder EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters).
Let ub := external_input_budget (pre_expr_encoder EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters).
Let BD := pre_dom_source_data B BE (pre_graph_view_call B BE) EB.
Let ND := pre_dom_source_data N E (pre_graph_view_call N E) EN.

Definition pre_block_view_receipt (call : pre_graph_view_call B BE) trace allowance : Prop :=
  match call with
  | PreViewOut input output => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_block_out_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) input output trace allowance
  | PreViewSource input output => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_block_source_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) input output trace allowance
  | PreViewTarget input output => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_block_target_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) input output trace allowance
  | PreViewEncode input output => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_block_encoder EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) input output trace allowance
  end.
Definition pre_point_view_receipt (call : pre_graph_view_call N E) trace allowance : Prop :=
  match call with
  | PreViewOut input output => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_point_out_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) input output trace allowance
  | PreViewSource input output => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_point_source_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) input output trace allowance
  | PreViewTarget input output => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_point_target_source EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) input output trace allowance
  | PreViewEncode input output => pre_actual_external_receipt
      (pre_point_encoder EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) input output trace allowance
  end.

(** One placement run shares each graph witness and each literal counted phase exactly once. *)
Definition pre_place_graph_body_run (bd : BD) (nd : ND) (result : pre_plan E U)
    (work allowance : nat) : Prop :=
  let '(p,prepare_b) := audit_prepare_source_counted EB bg (pre_view_prepare EB bg) in
  let '(df,frontier_events) := audit_frontier_source_counted (pre_view_frontier EB bg)
    p (pre_dom_result bd) in
  let '(points,prepare_n) := audit_prepare_source_counted EN pg (pre_view_prepare EN pg) in
  let body := pre_place_from_backends_counted EB EBE EN EE EV EU a bb beb nb eb vb ub
    p (pre_dom_result bd) df points (pre_dom_result nd)
    (preorder (audit_dom_source_result (pre_dom_search nd))) in
  pre_dom_fixed_run p (pre_view_virtual EB bg) (pre_view_source bg) bd /\
  pre_dom_fixed_run points (pre_view_virtual EN pg) (pre_view_source pg) nd /\
  exists block_receipts point_receipts body_receipts,
    Forall2 (fun call receipt => pre_block_view_receipt call (fst receipt) (snd receipt))
      (flat_map pre_prepare_callback_calls prepare_b ++ pre_dom_actual_callback_calls bd ++
        flat_map pre_frontier_callback_calls frontier_events) block_receipts /\
    Forall2 (fun call receipt => pre_point_view_receipt call (fst receipt) (snd receipt))
      (flat_map pre_prepare_callback_calls prepare_n ++ pre_dom_actual_callback_calls nd)
      point_receipts /\
    Forall2 (fun call receipt => pre_audit_event_receipt
      (pre_body_call_receipt EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters) call (fst receipt) (snd receipt))
      (exact_events body) body_receipts /\
    result = exact_value body /\
    work = 2048 + audit_prepare_source_work (pre_view_weight bb) prepare_b +
      pre_dom_whole_work (pre_view_weight bb) bd +
      audit_frontier_source_work (pre_view_weight bb) frontier_events +
      audit_prepare_source_work (pre_view_weight nb) prepare_n +
      pre_dom_whole_work (pre_view_weight nb) nd + exact_units body +
      pre_receipt_work block_receipts + pre_receipt_work point_receipts +
      pre_receipt_work body_receipts /\
    allowance = pre_receipt_allowance block_receipts +
      pre_receipt_allowance point_receipts + pre_receipt_allowance body_receipts.

(** Whole source work includes original callbacks under per-function source laws. *)
Definition audit_pre_place_body_source_statement : Prop :=
  audit_pre_view_adapter_laws EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters ->
  pre_expr_ssa_laws EV a -> exists bd nd result work allowance,
    pre_place_graph_body_run bd nd result work allowance /\
    result = ssa_pre_place EB EBE EN EE EV EU a /\
    work <= 64 * pre_place_graph_budget EB EBE EN EE EV EU a bb beb nb eb vb ub bd nd + allowance.
End PreWholeBodySource.

(** Every actual PRE callback body is charged under local original-view source laws. *)
Definition audit_pre_body_source_family_statement : Prop :=
  forall S O B BE N E V K C U (EB : encoding B) (EBE : encoding BE) (EN : encoding N)
    (EE : encoding E) (EV : encoding V) (EU : encoding U)
    (a : pre_expr_ssa S O B BE N E V K C U)
    (adapters : audit_pre_view_adapters EB EBE EN EE EV EU a),
    audit_pre_place_body_source_statement EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters /\
    audit_pre_certificate_body_source_statement EB EBE EN EE EV EU a adapters.

(** The final source obligation combines exact caller models with genuine callback bodies. *)
Definition audit_pre_full_source_statement : Prop :=
  audit_pre_caller_source_statement /\ audit_pre_body_source_family_statement.
```

```rocq
(** * Complete clobber search and materialized output

    One adjacency construction precedes search, and only indexed reads occur during search.
    For example, zero reachable successors still pays every source version's adjacency row.
    Builds on: complete walk indexes, binary search and concrete set enumeration. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryGraph AnalysesMemoryWalk.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditMap.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditElements.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryEncoding.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryInputBudget.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemorySearch.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemorySearchInputBudget.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryDistinct.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemorySharedBudget.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryWalkIndex.
Import List.ListNotations.

Definition audit_clobber_search_event (N E CN CE : Type) : Type :=
  audit_memory_search_event (memory_version N E) (audit_memory_version_event N E CN CE)
    (audit_map_event (memory_version N E) (list (memory_version N E))
      (audit_memory_version_event N E CN CE)).

Record audit_clobbers_source_run (N E T CN CE SE OE TE FE PE BE : Type) : Type :=
  AuditClobbersSourceRun {
    audit_clobbers_source_result : memory_clobber_result N E;
    audit_clobbers_source_index : audit_walk_index_run N E T CN CE SE OE TE FE PE BE;
    audit_clobbers_source_search : list (audit_clobber_search_event N E CN CE);
    audit_clobbers_source_elements : list (audit_set_elements_event (memory_version N E));
    audit_clobbers_source_distinct : list (audit_memory_distinct_event (memory_version N E)
      (audit_memory_version_event N E CN CE));
    audit_clobbers_source_roots : list (memory_version N E)
  }.
Arguments AuditClobbersSourceRun {N E T CN CE SE OE TE FE PE BE} _ _ _ _ _ _.
Arguments audit_clobbers_source_result {N E T CN CE SE OE TE FE PE BE} _.
Arguments audit_clobbers_source_index {N E T CN CE SE OE TE FE PE BE} _.
Arguments audit_clobbers_source_search {N E T CN CE SE OE TE FE PE BE} _.
Arguments audit_clobbers_source_elements {N E T CN CE SE OE TE FE PE BE} _.
Arguments audit_clobbers_source_distinct {N E T CN CE SE OE TE FE PE BE} _.
Arguments audit_clobbers_source_roots {N E T CN CE SE OE TE FE PE BE} _.

Definition audit_memory_clobbers_source_counted {N E T CN CE SE OE TE FE PE BE}
    (EN : encoding N) (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE)
    (out : N -> list E * list OE) (target : E -> N * list TE)
    (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE)
    (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list PE)
    (before : E -> nat -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE)
    (g : Graph.t N E) (mg : memory_graph N E) (scope : memory_scope T)
    (start : memory_version N E) (fuel : positive) :=
  let setup := audit_memory_walk_index_counted EN node_enc edge_enc site_enc out target effects
    operand before g mg scope in
  let enc := audit_memory_version_encode node_enc edge_enc in
  let next := audit_walk_successors node_enc edge_enc (audit_walk_index_value setup) in
  let '(state, search_events) := audit_memory_search_run enc next fuel (memory_search_start
    start) in
  let '(roots, elements_events) := audit_finset_elements (memory_search_roots state) in
  let '(result, distinct_events) := audit_memory_distinct enc (roots ++ memory_search_todo state) in
  AuditClobbersSourceRun
    (MemoryClobberResult result (andb (memory_search_complete state)
      (match memory_search_todo state with [] => true | _ :: _ => false end)))
    setup search_events elements_events distinct_events roots.

Definition audit_memory_clobbers_full_source_work {N E T CN CE SE OE TE FE PE BE}
    (node_work : list CN -> nat) (edge_work : list CE -> nat) (site_work : list SE -> nat)
    (out_work : list OE -> nat) (target_work : list TE -> nat) (effect_work : list FE -> nat)
    (operand_work : list PE -> nat) (before_work : list BE -> nat)
    (run : audit_clobbers_source_run N E T CN CE SE OE TE FE PE BE) : nat :=
  6 + audit_memory_walk_index_source_work node_work edge_work site_work out_work target_work
    effect_work operand_work before_work (audit_clobbers_source_index run) +
  audit_memory_search_source_work (audit_memory_version_work node_work edge_work)
    (audit_map_source_work (audit_memory_version_work node_work edge_work))
    (audit_clobbers_source_search run) +
  audit_set_elements_work (audit_clobbers_source_elements run) +
  length (audit_clobbers_source_roots run) +
  audit_memory_distinct_work (audit_memory_version_work node_work edge_work)
    (audit_clobbers_source_distinct run).

Definition audit_memory_clobbers_whole_input_budget {N E T CN CE SE OE TE FE PE BE}
    (EN : encoding N) (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE)
    (out : N -> list E * list OE) (target : E -> N * list TE)
    (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE)
    (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list PE)
    (before : E -> nat -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE)
    (node_budget out_budget : N -> nat) (edge_budget effect_budget target_budget : E -> nat)
    (site_budget : T -> nat) (operand_budget : N -> option E -> nat)
    (before_budget : E -> nat -> nat) (g : Graph.t N E) (mg : memory_graph N E) scope start fuel :=
  let setup := audit_memory_walk_index_counted EN node_enc edge_enc site_enc out target effects
    operand before g mg scope in
  let enc := audit_memory_version_encode node_enc edge_enc in
  let key_budget := audit_memory_version_input_budget node_enc edge_enc node_budget edge_budget in
  let next := audit_walk_successors node_enc edge_enc (audit_walk_index_value setup) in
  let initial := memory_search_start start in
  let state := fst (audit_memory_search_run enc next fuel initial) in
  let roots := FinSet.elements (memory_search_roots state) in
  6 + audit_memory_walk_index_input_budget EN node_enc edge_enc site_enc out target effects operand
    before node_budget out_budget edge_budget effect_budget target_budget site_budget
    operand_budget before_budget g mg scope +
  audit_search_run_input_budget enc next key_budget
    (audit_search_read_input_budget enc key_budget) fuel initial +
  19 * audit_trie_nodes (memory_search_roots state) +
    audit_trie_output_bits (memory_search_roots state) + 6 + length roots +
  audit_memory_distinct_input_budget enc key_budget (roots ++ memory_search_todo state).

(** Complete clobber erasure fixes setup, search and final duplicate removal to the public body. *)
Definition audit_memory_clobbers_source_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CN CE SE OE TE FE PE BE (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (ET : encoding T)
      (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
      (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE) (out : N -> list E * list OE)
      (target : E -> N * list TE) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE)
      (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list PE)
      (before : E -> nat -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE)
      (g : Graph.t N E) (original : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E)
      scope start fuel,
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall e, fst (edge_enc e) = encode EE e) ->
    (forall t, fst (site_enc t) = encode ET t) ->
    (forall n, fst (out n) = Graph.out g n) ->
    (forall e, fst (target e) = Graph.target g e) ->
    (forall e, fst (effects e) = original e) ->
    (forall n key, fst (operand n key) = memory_operand mg n key) ->
    (forall e i, fst (before e i) = memory_before mg e i) ->
    audit_clobbers_source_result (audit_memory_clobbers_source_counted EN node_enc edge_enc site_enc
      out target effects operand before g mg scope start fuel) =
    memory_clobbers EN EE ET g original mg scope start fuel.

(** All internal key, predecessor, adjacency and materialization work is closed concretely. *)
Definition audit_memory_clobbers_whole_input_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CN CE SE OE TE FE PE BE (EN : encoding N)
      (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
      (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE) (out : N -> list E * list OE)
      (target : E -> N * list TE) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE)
      (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list PE)
      (before : E -> nat -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE)
      node_work edge_work site_work out_work target_work effect_work operand_work before_work
      node_budget edge_budget site_budget out_budget target_budget effect_budget
      operand_budget before_budget (g : Graph.t N E) (mg : memory_graph N E) scope start fuel,
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall n, fst (out n) = Graph.out g n) ->
    (forall e, fst (target e) = Graph.target g e) ->
    (forall n, node_work (snd (node_enc n)) <= node_budget n) ->
    (forall e, edge_work (snd (edge_enc e)) <= edge_budget e) ->
    (forall t, site_work (snd (site_enc t)) <= site_budget t) ->
    (forall n, out_work (snd (out n)) <= out_budget n) ->
    (forall e, target_work (snd (target e)) <= target_budget e) ->
    (forall e, effect_work (snd (effects e)) <= effect_budget e) ->
    (forall n key, operand_work (snd (operand n key)) <= operand_budget n key) ->
    (forall e i, before_work (snd (before e i)) <= before_budget e i) ->
    audit_memory_clobbers_full_source_work node_work edge_work site_work out_work target_work
      effect_work operand_work before_work (audit_memory_clobbers_source_counted EN node_enc
        edge_enc
        site_enc out target effects operand before g mg scope start fuel) <=
    audit_memory_clobbers_whole_input_budget EN node_enc edge_enc site_enc out target effects
      operand
      before node_budget out_budget edge_budget effect_budget target_budget site_budget
      operand_budget before_budget g mg scope start fuel.
```

## AnalysesAuditMemoryDisjoint

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemoryDisjoint.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemoryDisjoint`.

```rocq
(** * Counted footprint disjointness

    This mirror retains every footprint pair and both strict boolean operands.
    For example, a false first pair does not skip later [forallb] operands.
    Builds on: AnalysesMemoryWalk and the footprint API. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith ZArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding.
From Galois.Domains Require Import DomainsFootprint.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryBase AnalysesMemoryWalk.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditCost.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditPrimitive.
Import List.ListNotations.

Inductive audit_disjoint_event (T CE : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditDisjointOuter (remaining : list (footprint T))
  | AuditDisjointInner (item : footprint T) (remaining : list (footprint T))
  | AuditDisjointPair (left right : footprint T) (left_code right_code : positive)
      (left_events right_events : list CE) (eq_events : list audit_positive_eqb_event)
      (same left_before right_before result : bool).

Arguments AuditDisjointOuter {T CE} _.
Arguments AuditDisjointInner {T CE} _ _.
Arguments AuditDisjointPair {T CE} _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _.

(** Both comparisons and both component encoder executions are retained for each pair. *)
Definition audit_disjoint_pair {T CE} (enc : T -> positive * list CE)
    (left right : footprint T) : bool * list (audit_disjoint_event T CE) :=
  let '(lc, le) := enc (fp_site left) in
  let '(rc, re) := enc (fp_site right) in
  let '(same, eq_events) := audit_positive_eqb lc rc in
  let first := Z.leb (fp_hi left) (fp_lo right) in
  let second := Z.leb (fp_hi right) (fp_lo left) in
  let result := orb (orb (negb same) first) second in
  (result, [AuditDisjointPair left right lc rc le re eq_events same first second result]).

(** Every right operand of [andb] is evaluated, even after a false earlier result. *)
Fixpoint audit_disjoint_inner {T CE} (enc : T -> positive * list CE)
    (item : footprint T) (input : list (footprint T))
    : bool * list (audit_disjoint_event T CE) :=
  match input with
  | [] => (true, [AuditDisjointInner item input])
  | x :: rest =>
      let '(head, he) := audit_disjoint_pair enc item x in
      let '(tail, te) := audit_disjoint_inner enc item rest in
      (andb head tail, AuditDisjointInner item input :: he ++ te)
  end.

Fixpoint audit_footprints_disjoint {T CE} (enc : T -> positive * list CE)
    (left right : list (footprint T)) : bool * list (audit_disjoint_event T CE) :=
  match left with
  | [] => (true, [AuditDisjointOuter left])
  | item :: rest =>
      let '(head, he) := audit_disjoint_inner enc item right in
      let '(tail, te) := audit_footprints_disjoint enc rest right in
      (andb head tail, AuditDisjointOuter left :: he ++ te)
  end.

Definition audit_memory_scopes_disjoint {T CE} (enc : T -> positive * list CE)
    (left right : memory_scope T) : bool * list (audit_disjoint_event T CE) :=
  match left, right with
  | MemoryRegions fs, MemoryRegions gs => audit_footprints_disjoint enc fs gs
  | _, _ => (false, [])
  end.

(** * Future erasure and pair-count obligations *)

Definition audit_footprints_disjoint_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall T CE (enc : T -> positive * list CE) (ET : encoding T) left right,
    (forall site, fst (enc site) = encode ET site) ->
    fst (audit_footprints_disjoint enc left right) = footprints_disjoint ET left right.

Definition audit_memory_scopes_disjoint_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall T CE (enc : T -> positive * list CE) (ET : encoding T) left right,
    (forall site, fst (enc site) = encode ET site) ->
    fst (audit_memory_scopes_disjoint enc left right) = memory_scopes_disjoint ET left right.

Fixpoint audit_disjoint_pairs {T CE} (events : list (audit_disjoint_event T CE)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditDisjointPair _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ :: rest => S (audit_disjoint_pairs rest)
  | _ :: rest => audit_disjoint_pairs rest
  end.

Definition audit_disjoint_pairs_count_statement : Prop :=
  forall T CE (enc : T -> positive * list CE) left right,
    audit_disjoint_pairs (snd (audit_footprints_disjoint enc left right)) =
      length left * length right.

(** * Fixed primitive charges and input-derived pair budget *)

(** Comparison charges use the actual positive and signed operands. *)
Definition audit_disjoint_pair_work {T CE} (encoder_work : list CE -> nat)
    (left right : footprint T) (le re : list CE) (eq_events : list audit_positive_eqb_event)
    : nat :=
  4 + encoder_work le + encoder_work re + audit_positive_eqb_source_work eq_events +
    audit_binary_weight (fp_hi left) (fp_lo right) +
    audit_binary_weight (fp_hi right) (fp_lo left).

Fixpoint audit_disjoint_source_work {T CE} (encoder_work : list CE -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_disjoint_event T CE)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditDisjointOuter _ :: rest => 1 + audit_disjoint_source_work encoder_work rest
  | AuditDisjointInner _ _ :: rest => 1 + audit_disjoint_source_work encoder_work rest
  | AuditDisjointPair lf rf _ _ le re eq_events _ _ _ _ :: rest =>
      audit_disjoint_pair_work encoder_work lf rf le re eq_events +
        audit_disjoint_source_work encoder_work rest
  end.

Fixpoint audit_disjoint_inner_budget {T CE} (enc : T -> positive * list CE)
    (encoder_work : list CE -> nat) (item : footprint T) (input : list (footprint T)) : nat :=
  match input with
  | [] => 1
  | x :: rest =>
      1 + audit_disjoint_pair_work encoder_work item x (snd (enc (fp_site item)))
        (snd (enc (fp_site x)))
        (snd (audit_positive_eqb (fst (enc (fp_site item))) (fst (enc (fp_site x))))) +
        audit_disjoint_inner_budget enc encoder_work item rest
  end.

Fixpoint audit_disjoint_budget {T CE} (enc : T -> positive * list CE)
    (encoder_work : list CE -> nat) (left right : list (footprint T)) : nat :=
  match left with
  | [] => 1
  | x :: rest => 1 + audit_disjoint_inner_budget enc encoder_work x right +
      audit_disjoint_budget enc encoder_work rest right
  end.

(** This obligation relates the actual paired trace to its original two input lists. *)
Definition audit_disjoint_source_work_statement : Prop :=
  forall T CE (enc : T -> positive * list CE) encoder_work left right,
    audit_disjoint_source_work encoder_work (snd (audit_footprints_disjoint enc left right)) =
      audit_disjoint_budget enc encoder_work left right.
```

## AnalysesAuditMemoryDistinct

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemoryDistinct.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemoryDistinct`.

```rocq
(** * Counted first-occurrence memory indexing

    This mirror preserves the original order and nested set operations used by memory distinctness.
    For example, repeated edges are probed twice but retained only at their first occurrence.
    Builds on: GraphDominance, AnalysesMemoryFrontier and the audit finite-set observer. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphDominance.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryFrontier.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditFinSet.
Import List.ListNotations.

Inductive audit_memory_distinct_event (A CE : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditMemoryDistinctCase (remaining : list A) (seen : FinSet.t A)
  | AuditMemoryDistinctProbe (key : A) (result : bool) (calls : list (audit_set_event A CE))
  | AuditMemoryDistinctAdd (key : A) (calls : list (audit_set_event A CE))
  | AuditMemoryDistinctKeep (key : A).

Arguments AuditMemoryDistinctCase {A CE} _ _.
Arguments AuditMemoryDistinctProbe {A CE} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditMemoryDistinctAdd {A CE} _ _.
Arguments AuditMemoryDistinctKeep {A CE} _.

(** Each input occurrence performs its actual membership call before the conditional insertion. *)
Fixpoint audit_memory_distinct_from {A CE} (enc : A -> positive * list CE)
    (seen : FinSet.t A) (input : list A) : list A * list (audit_memory_distinct_event A CE) :=
  match input with
  | [] => ([], [AuditMemoryDistinctCase input seen])
  | key :: rest =>
      let '(found, probes) := audit_finset_mem enc key seen in
      if found then
        let '(out, events) := audit_memory_distinct_from enc seen rest in
        (out, [AuditMemoryDistinctCase input seen; AuditMemoryDistinctProbe key found probes] ++
          events)
      else
        let '(next, adds) := audit_finset_add enc key seen in
        let '(out, events) := audit_memory_distinct_from enc next rest in
        (key :: out, [AuditMemoryDistinctCase input seen; AuditMemoryDistinctProbe key found probes;
                      AuditMemoryDistinctAdd key adds; AuditMemoryDistinctKeep key] ++ events)
  end.

Definition audit_memory_distinct {A CE} (enc : A -> positive * list CE) (input : list A)
    : list A * list (audit_memory_distinct_event A CE) :=
  audit_memory_distinct_from enc FinSet.empty input.

(** These claims preserve exact list order, not merely membership. *)
Definition audit_memory_distinct_from_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall A CE (enc : A -> positive * list CE) (EA : encoding A) seen input,
    (forall x, In x input -> fst (enc x) = encode EA x) ->
    fst (audit_memory_distinct_from enc seen input) = virtual_entries_from EA seen input.

Definition audit_memory_distinct_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall A CE (enc : A -> positive * list CE) (EA : encoding A) input,
    (forall x, In x input -> fst (enc x) = encode EA x) ->
    fst (audit_memory_distinct enc input) = memory_distinct EA input.

(** Fixed source charges retain the actual nested probe and conditional add executions. *)
Fixpoint audit_memory_distinct_work {A CE} (enc_work : list CE -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_memory_distinct_event A CE)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditMemoryDistinctCase _ _ :: rest => 1 + audit_memory_distinct_work enc_work rest
  | AuditMemoryDistinctProbe _ _ calls :: rest => audit_finset_source_work enc_work calls +
      audit_memory_distinct_work enc_work rest
  | AuditMemoryDistinctAdd _ calls :: rest => audit_finset_source_work enc_work calls +
      audit_memory_distinct_work enc_work rest
  | AuditMemoryDistinctKeep _ :: rest => 1 + audit_memory_distinct_work enc_work rest
  end.

Fixpoint audit_memory_distinct_budget {A CE} (enc : A -> positive * list CE)
    (enc_work : list CE -> nat) (input : list A) : nat :=
  match input with
  | [] => 1
  | key :: rest => 10 + 2 * enc_work (snd (enc key)) + 21 * Pos.size_nat (fst (enc key)) +
      audit_memory_distinct_budget enc enc_work rest
  end.

Definition audit_memory_distinct_source_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall A CE (enc : A -> positive * list CE) enc_work seen input,
    audit_memory_distinct_work enc_work (snd (audit_memory_distinct_from enc seen input)) <=
      audit_memory_distinct_budget enc enc_work input.
```

## AnalysesAuditMemoryEffects

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemoryEffects.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemoryEffects`.

```rocq
(** * Counted memory effect rows

    This candidate mirrors the existing tail-first effect-table row builder.
    For example, two effects insert the later index first, preserving both unary conversions.
    Builds on: AnalysesMemoryWalk and the shared map and natural-encoding models. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryWalk.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditTrie.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditEncoding.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditMap.
Import List.ListNotations.

Inductive audit_memory_effect_event (T : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditEffectRow (start : nat) (input : list (memory_effect T))
  | AuditEffectSet (events : list (audit_map_event nat (memory_effect T) audit_nat_encoding_event)).

Arguments AuditEffectRow {T} _ _.
Arguments AuditEffectSet {T} _.

(** This function preserves actual indices, tail-built rows and all nested primitive events. *)
Fixpoint audit_memory_effects_from {T} (start : nat) (input : list (memory_effect T))
    : Map.t nat (memory_effect T) * list (audit_memory_effect_event T) :=
  match input with
  | [] => (Map.empty, [AuditEffectRow start input])
  | effect :: rest =>
      let '(tail, tail_events) := audit_memory_effects_from (S start) rest in
      let '(output, set_events) := audit_map_set audit_nat_encode start effect tail in
      (output, AuditEffectRow start input :: tail_events ++ [AuditEffectSet set_events])
  end.

(** Correctness and the outer-frame budget are future source-card proof obligations. *)
Definition audit_memory_effects_from_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall T start (input : list (memory_effect T)),
    fst (audit_memory_effects_from start input) = memory_walk_effects_from start input.

Definition audit_memory_effects_from_count_statement : Prop :=
  forall T start (input : list (memory_effect T)),
    length (snd (audit_memory_effects_from start input)) = 1 + 2 * length input.

(** * Input-derived selected-source budget *)

(** Charges use captured actual encoding and trie operands, not caller-provided prices. *)
Fixpoint audit_memory_effect_map_work {T}
    (events : list (audit_map_event nat (memory_effect T) audit_nat_encoding_event)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditMapSet key value code before _ enc_events _ :: rest =>
      1 + 2 * length enc_events +
      audit_trie_update_source_work code (Some (key, value)) before +
      audit_memory_effect_map_work rest
  | _ :: rest => 1 + audit_memory_effect_map_work rest
  end.

Fixpoint audit_memory_effect_events_work {T} (events : list (audit_memory_effect_event T)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditEffectRow _ _ :: rest => 1 + audit_memory_effect_events_work rest
  | AuditEffectSet calls :: rest => 1 + audit_memory_effect_map_work calls +
      audit_memory_effect_events_work rest
  end.

(** This bound is derived from the source input indices, including their unary sizes. *)
Fixpoint audit_memory_effects_budget {T} (start : nat) (input : list (memory_effect T)) : nat :=
  match input with
  | [] => 1
  | _ :: rest =>
      let bits := Pos.size_nat (encode nat_encoding start) in
      3 + 2 * S start * S bits + 16 * bits + audit_memory_effects_budget (S start) rest
  end.

(** This is an obligation about selected source frames, not native or instrumentation cost. *)
Definition audit_memory_effects_work_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall T start (input : list (memory_effect T)),
    audit_memory_effect_events_work (snd (audit_memory_effects_from start input)) <=
      audit_memory_effects_budget start input.

(** * Existing indexed effect lookup *)

Inductive audit_memory_effect_get_event (E T CE : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditEffectEdgeGet
      (events : list (audit_map_event E (Map.t nat (memory_effect T)) CE))
  | AuditEffectIndexGet
      (events : list (audit_map_event nat (memory_effect T) audit_nat_encoding_event)).

Arguments AuditEffectEdgeGet {E T CE} _.
Arguments AuditEffectIndexGet {E T CE} _.

(** A missing edge skips the numeric lookup; a present row uses the actual unary index. *)
Definition audit_memory_effect_get {E T CE} (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
    (table : Map.t E (Map.t nat (memory_effect T))) (edge : E) (index : nat)
    : option (memory_effect T) * list (audit_memory_effect_get_event E T CE) :=
  let '(row, first) := audit_map_get edge_enc edge table in
  match row with
  | None => (None, [AuditEffectEdgeGet first])
  | Some actual =>
      let '(result, second) := audit_map_get audit_nat_encode index actual in
      (result, [AuditEffectEdgeGet first; AuditEffectIndexGet second])
  end.

Definition audit_memory_effect_get_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall E T CE (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (EE : encoding E) table edge index,
    fst (edge_enc edge) = encode EE edge ->
    fst (@audit_memory_effect_get E T CE edge_enc table edge index) =
      memory_walk_effect_get EE table edge index.

Definition audit_memory_effect_get_count_statement : Prop :=
  forall E T CE (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) table edge index,
    length (snd (@audit_memory_effect_get E T CE edge_enc table edge index)) <= 2.

(** Both row and index lookups charge their actual nested map and encoding traces. *)
Fixpoint audit_memory_effect_get_work {E T CE} (edge_work : list CE -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_memory_effect_get_event E T CE)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditEffectEdgeGet calls :: rest => audit_map_source_work edge_work calls +
      audit_memory_effect_get_work edge_work rest
  | AuditEffectIndexGet calls :: rest => audit_map_source_work audit_nat_events_work calls +
      audit_memory_effect_get_work edge_work rest
  end.
```

## AnalysesAuditMemoryEncoding

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemoryEncoding.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemoryEncoding`.

```rocq
(** * Counted memory keys and scopes

    These adapters compose the actual version, footprint, scope and memo-key encodings.
    For example, a definition version records its edge encoder and unary index conversion.
    Builds on: G4 memory semantics and the shared composite-encoding observers. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith ZArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding.
From Galois.Domains Require Import DomainsFootprint.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryGraph AnalysesMemoryFlow.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditEncoding.
Import List.ListNotations.

(** The scope and key encodings are shared before the memo-state module is defined. *)
Definition scope_code {T} (ET : encoding T) (q : memory_scope T) : positive :=
  match q with
  | MemoryAll => encode (sum_encoding unit_encoding (list_encoding (footprint_encoding ET))) (inl
    tt)
  | MemoryRegions fs =>
      encode (sum_encoding unit_encoding (list_encoding (footprint_encoding ET))) (inr fs)
  end.

Definition memo_key {N E} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) :=
  pair_encoding positive_encoding (memory_version_encoding EN EE).

Inductive audit_memory_version_event (N E CN CE : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditVersionLive
  | AuditVersionPhi (node : N) (code : positive) (events : list CN)
  | AuditVersionDef (edge : E) (index : nat) (code : positive)
      (events : list (audit_pair_event E nat CE audit_nat_encoding_event)).

Arguments AuditVersionLive {N E CN CE}.
Arguments AuditVersionPhi {N E CN CE} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditVersionDef {N E CN CE} _ _ _ _.

(** Definition versions compose the actual edge and unary-index encoder executions. *)
Definition audit_memory_version_encode {N E CN CE}
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
    (input : memory_version N E) : positive * list (audit_memory_version_event N E CN CE) :=
  match input with
  | MemoryLive => (xH, [AuditVersionLive])
  | MemoryPhi n =>
      let '(code, events) := node_enc n in (xO code, [AuditVersionPhi n code events])
  | MemoryDef e i =>
      let '(code, events) := audit_pair_encode edge_enc audit_nat_encode (e, i) in
      (xI code, [AuditVersionDef e i code events])
  end.

Definition audit_memory_version_encode_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E CN CE (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
      (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) input,
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall e, fst (edge_enc e) = encode EE e) ->
    fst (audit_memory_version_encode node_enc edge_enc input) =
      encode (memory_version_encoding EN EE) input.

(** Each footprint uses the exact nested site and signed-endpoint pair encoders. *)
Definition audit_memory_footprint_encode {T CE} (site_enc : T -> positive * list CE)
    (input : footprint T) :=
  audit_pair_encode site_enc (audit_pair_encode audit_z_encode audit_z_encode)
    (fp_site input, (fp_lo input, fp_hi input)).

Definition audit_memory_footprint_encode_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall T CE (ET : encoding T) (site_enc : T -> positive * list CE) input,
    (forall t, fst (site_enc t) = encode ET t) ->
    fst (audit_memory_footprint_encode site_enc input) = encode (footprint_encoding ET) input.

(** Scope coding preserves the selected sum branch and every footprint-list child trace. *)
Definition audit_memory_scope_encode {T CE} (site_enc : T -> positive * list CE)
    (input : memory_scope T) :=
  audit_sum_encode audit_unit_encode (audit_list_encode (audit_memory_footprint_encode site_enc))
    (match input with MemoryAll => inl tt | MemoryRegions fs => inr fs end).

Definition audit_memory_scope_encode_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall T CE (ET : encoding T) (site_enc : T -> positive * list CE) input,
    (forall t, fst (site_enc t) = encode ET t) ->
    fst (audit_memory_scope_encode site_enc input) = scope_code ET input.

(** Memo keys combine the scope code with the same observed version encoding. *)
Definition audit_memory_memo_key_encode {N E CN CE}
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
    (input : positive * memory_version N E) :=
  audit_pair_encode audit_positive_encode (audit_memory_version_encode node_enc edge_enc) input.

Definition audit_memory_memo_key_encode_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E CN CE (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
      (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) input,
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall e, fst (edge_enc e) = encode EE e) ->
    fst (audit_memory_memo_key_encode node_enc edge_enc input) = encode (memo_key EN EE) input.

(** * Deterministic nested event folds *)

Fixpoint audit_memory_version_work {N E CN CE} (node_work : list CN -> nat)
    (edge_work : list CE -> nat) (events : list (audit_memory_version_event N E CN CE)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditVersionLive :: rest => 1 + audit_memory_version_work node_work edge_work rest
  | AuditVersionPhi _ _ child :: rest => 1 + node_work child +
      audit_memory_version_work node_work edge_work rest
  | AuditVersionDef _ _ _ child :: rest =>
      1 + audit_pair_events_work edge_work audit_nat_events_work child +
        audit_memory_version_work node_work edge_work rest
  end.

Definition audit_memory_footprint_event (T CE : Type) : Type :=
  audit_pair_event T (Z * Z) CE
    (audit_pair_event Z Z (audit_basic_encoding_event Z) (audit_basic_encoding_event Z)).

Definition audit_memory_footprint_work {T CE} (site_work : list CE -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_memory_footprint_event T CE)) : nat :=
  audit_pair_events_work site_work
    (audit_pair_events_work audit_basic_encoding_work audit_basic_encoding_work) events.

Definition audit_memory_scope_event (T CE : Type) : Type :=
  audit_sum_event unit (list (footprint T)) (audit_basic_encoding_event unit)
    (audit_list_event (footprint T) (audit_memory_footprint_event T CE)).

Definition audit_memory_scope_work {T CE} (site_work : list CE -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_memory_scope_event T CE)) : nat :=
  audit_sum_events_work audit_basic_encoding_work
    (audit_list_events_work (audit_memory_footprint_work site_work)) events.

Definition audit_memory_memo_key_work {N E CN CE} (node_work : list CN -> nat)
    (edge_work : list CE -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_pair_event positive (memory_version N E)
      (audit_basic_encoding_event positive) (audit_memory_version_event N E CN CE))) : nat :=
  audit_pair_events_work audit_basic_encoding_work (audit_memory_version_work node_work edge_work)
    events.

(** The budget sums the actual footprint children and emitted positive-code sizes. *)
Fixpoint audit_memory_footprint_list_work {T CE} (site_enc : T -> positive * list CE)
    (site_work : list CE -> nat) (input : list (footprint T)) : nat :=
  match input with
  | [] => 0
  | fp :: rest =>
      audit_memory_footprint_work site_work (snd (audit_memory_footprint_encode site_enc fp)) +
        audit_memory_footprint_list_work site_enc site_work rest
  end.

Definition audit_memory_scope_budget {T CE} (site_enc : T -> positive * list CE)
    (site_work : list CE -> nat) (input : memory_scope T) : nat :=
  match input with
  | MemoryAll => 2
  | MemoryRegions fs =>
      5 + 2 * length fs + 10 * audit_encoded_bits (audit_memory_footprint_encode site_enc) fs +
        audit_memory_footprint_list_work site_enc site_work fs
  end.

Definition audit_memory_scope_work_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall T CE (site_enc : T -> positive * list CE) site_work q,
    audit_memory_scope_work site_work (snd (audit_memory_scope_encode site_enc q)) <=
      audit_memory_scope_budget site_enc site_work q.
```

```rocq
  scope_code_injective_statement /\ memo_initial_statement /\

  values. *)

  audit_snapshot_refresh_whole_input_bound_statement /\
  audit_snapshot_query_saved_values_statement /\ audit_snapshot_query_source_erases_statement /\
  audit_snapshot_query_whole_input_bound_statement.

(** Legacy closure includes setup, full query, retain, outer checking and the same produced
  pairs. *)

Definition audit_memory_complete_source_contract_statement : Prop :=
  audit_memory_internal_body_closure_statement /\ audit_memory_memo_source_closure_statement /\
  audit_memory_legacy_source_closure_statement /\ audit_memory_phi_source_closure_statement.

(** Plain snapshot refresh and saved queries preserve completed-entry semantics without ghost
  logs. *)
Definition audit_memory_snapshot_plain_closure_statement : Prop :=

  audit_memory_memo_legacy_whole_input_bound_statement.

(** Final memory closure binds every promised public semantic operation to its concrete body. *)
Definition audit_memory_public_source_contract_statement : Prop :=
  audit_memory_adapted_source_contract_statement /\ audit_memory_memo_legacy_contract_statement /\
  audit_memory_phi_public_semantics_statement /\ audit_memory_phi_public_projection_statement /\
  audit_phi_optional_closure_source_bound_statement /\
```
