## AnalysesAuditMemoryGraphCallbacks

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemoryGraphCallbacks.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemoryGraphCallbacks`.

```rocq
(** * Shared memory graph callback bodies

    These adapters retain every original outgoing, target and node encoder call in full preparation.
    For example, a target's returned node feeds the exact subsequent incoming-index encoder call.
    Builds on: full graph preparation and genuine external callback bodies. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphAuditBase.
Import List.ListNotations.

Inductive audit_snapshot_graph_body (CN OE TE : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditSnapshotNodeBody (events : list CN)
  | AuditSnapshotOutBody (events : list OE)
  | AuditSnapshotTargetBody (events : list TE).
Arguments AuditSnapshotNodeBody {CN OE TE} _.
Arguments AuditSnapshotOutBody {CN OE TE} _.
Arguments AuditSnapshotTargetBody {CN OE TE} _.

Definition audit_snapshot_graph_body_work {CN OE TE} (node_work : list CN -> nat)
    (out_work : list OE -> nat) (target_work : list TE -> nat)
    (body : audit_snapshot_graph_body CN OE TE) : nat :=
  match body with
  | AuditSnapshotNodeBody events => node_work events
  | AuditSnapshotOutBody events => out_work events
  | AuditSnapshotTargetBody events => target_work events
  end.

Definition audit_snapshot_graph_callbacks {N E CN OE TE}
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (out : N -> list E * list OE)
    (target : E -> N * list TE) :
    audit_prepare_callback_model N E (audit_snapshot_graph_body CN OE TE) :=
  @AuditPrepareCallbackModel N E (audit_snapshot_graph_body CN OE TE)
    (fun n => let '(edges, body) := out n in (edges, [AuditSnapshotOutBody body]))
    (fun e => let '(n, body) := target e in (n, [AuditSnapshotTargetBody body]))
    (fun n => let '(code, body) := node_enc n in (code, [AuditSnapshotNodeBody body])).

Fixpoint audit_snapshot_target_input_budget {N E TE} (target : E -> N * list TE)
    (node_budget : N -> nat) (target_budget : E -> nat) (edges : list E) : nat :=
  match edges with
  | [] => 0
  | e :: rest => target_budget e + node_budget (fst (target e)) +
      audit_snapshot_target_input_budget target node_budget target_budget rest
  end.

Fixpoint audit_snapshot_graph_input_budget {N E OE TE}
    (out : N -> list E * list OE) (target : E -> N * list TE)
    (node_budget out_budget : N -> nat) (target_budget : E -> nat) (nodes : list N) : nat :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => 0
  | n :: rest => node_budget n + out_budget n +
      audit_snapshot_target_input_budget target node_budget target_budget (fst (out n)) +
      audit_snapshot_graph_input_budget out target node_budget out_budget target_budget rest
  end.

```

## AnalysesAuditMemoryIndex

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemoryIndex.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemoryIndex`.

```rocq
(** * Counted memory result indexing

    This mirror retains every tail-first index update and actual value callback.
    For example, duplicate keys generate two updates and the earlier occurrence is retained.
    Builds on: AnalysesMemoryFrontier and the shared audit map model. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryFrontier.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditMap.
Import List.ListNotations.

Inductive audit_memory_index_event (K A CE VE : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditMemoryIndexNil
  | AuditMemoryIndexPut (key : K) (value : A) (before after : Map.t K A)
      (value_events : list VE) (set_events : list (audit_map_event K A CE)).

Arguments AuditMemoryIndexNil {K A CE VE}.
Arguments AuditMemoryIndexPut {K A CE VE} _ _ _ _ _ _.

(** The accumulator and value-call traces belong to the same actual recursive execution. *)
Fixpoint audit_memory_result_index {K A CE VE} (enc : K -> positive * list CE)
    (value : K -> A * list VE) (keys : list K)
    : Map.t K A * list (audit_memory_index_event K A CE VE) :=
  match keys with
  | [] => (Map.empty, [AuditMemoryIndexNil])
  | key :: rest =>
      let '(before, tail_events) := audit_memory_result_index enc value rest in
      let '(v, value_events) := value key in
      let '(after, set_events) := audit_map_set enc key v before in
      (after, tail_events ++ [AuditMemoryIndexPut key v before after value_events set_events])
  end.

(** Correctness compares the original fixed index, including duplicate-key order. *)
Definition audit_memory_result_index_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall K A CE VE (enc : K -> positive * list CE) (original_enc : encoding K)
      (value : K -> A * list VE) (original_value : K -> A) keys,
    (forall k, In k keys -> fst (enc k) = encode original_enc k) ->
    (forall k, In k keys -> fst (value k) = original_value k) ->
    fst (audit_memory_result_index enc value keys) = memory_result_index original_enc
      original_value keys.

Definition audit_memory_result_index_count_statement : Prop :=
  forall K A CE VE (enc : K -> positive * list CE) (value : K -> A * list VE) keys,
    length (snd (audit_memory_result_index enc value keys)) = S (length keys).

(** Actual child traces are charged at the same occurrence and intermediate map. *)
Fixpoint audit_memory_index_work {K A CE VE} (encoder_work : list CE -> nat)
    (value_work : list VE -> nat) (events : list (audit_memory_index_event K A CE VE)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditMemoryIndexNil :: rest => 1 + audit_memory_index_work encoder_work value_work rest
  | AuditMemoryIndexPut _ _ _ _ ve se :: rest =>
      1 + value_work ve + audit_map_source_work encoder_work se +
        audit_memory_index_work encoder_work value_work rest
  end.

(** The budget derives from actual keys, component outputs and the original input length. *)
Fixpoint audit_memory_index_budget {K A CE VE} (enc : K -> positive * list CE)
    (value : K -> A * list VE) (encoder_work : list CE -> nat) (value_work : list VE -> nat)
    (keys : list K) : nat :=
  match keys with
  | [] => 1
  | key :: rest =>
      3 + encoder_work (snd (enc key)) + 16 * Pos.size_nat (fst (enc key)) +
      value_work (snd (value key)) + audit_memory_index_budget enc value encoder_work value_work
        rest
  end.

Definition audit_memory_result_index_work_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall K A CE VE (enc : K -> positive * list CE) (value : K -> A * list VE)
      encoder_work value_work keys,
    audit_memory_index_work encoder_work value_work (snd (audit_memory_result_index enc value
      keys)) <=
      audit_memory_index_budget enc value encoder_work value_work keys.
```

## AnalysesAuditMemoryInitial

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemoryInitial.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemoryInitial`.

```rocq
(** * Counted memory preparation

    This candidate connects the actual graph preparation and indexed effect-table phases.
    For example, a graph with no listed nodes still prepares an empty effect table.
    Builds on: G4 memory semantics and the composed memory-table observer. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryGraph.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryState.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryEncoding.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryTable.
Import List.ListNotations.

Record audit_memory_initial_events (N E T CE OE FE PE : Type) : Type := AuditMemoryInitialEvents {
  audit_memory_initial_prepare : list PE;
  audit_memory_initial_table : list (audit_memory_table_event N E T CE OE FE)
}.

Arguments AuditMemoryInitialEvents {N E T CE OE FE PE} _ _.
Arguments audit_memory_initial_prepare {N E T CE OE FE PE} _.
Arguments audit_memory_initial_table {N E T CE OE FE PE} _.

(** The graph and effect-table phases use the exact intermediate values retained in the state. *)
Definition audit_memory_initial {N E T CE OE FE PE} (EN : encoding N)
    (g : Graph.t N E) (original_effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E)
    (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (out : N -> list E * list OE)
    (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE) (graph_prepare : unit -> prepared EN g *
      list PE)
    : memo_state EN g original_effects mg * audit_memory_initial_events N E T CE OE FE PE :=
  let '(prep, pe) := graph_prepare tt in
  let '(table, te) := audit_memory_effect_table edge_enc out effects (Graph.nodes g) in
  (@MemoState N E T EN g original_effects mg prep table Map.empty, AuditMemoryInitialEvents pe te).

(** Graph preparation is a library adapter, whose own source adequacy is proved by AUD-GR. *)
Definition audit_memory_initial_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CE OE FE PE (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (g : Graph.t N E)
      (original : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E)
      (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (out : N -> list E * list OE)
      (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE) (graph_prepare : unit -> prepared EN g *
        list PE),
    (forall e, fst (edge_enc e) = encode EE e) ->
    (forall n, fst (out n) = Graph.out g n) ->
    (forall e, fst (effects e) = original e) ->
    fst (graph_prepare tt) = prepare EN g ->
    fst (audit_memory_initial EN g original mg edge_enc out effects graph_prepare) =
      memo_initial EN EE g original mg.

Definition audit_memory_initial_source_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CE OE FE PE (EN : encoding N) (g : Graph.t N E)
      (original : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E)
      (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (out : N -> list E * list OE)
      (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE) (graph_prepare : unit -> prepared EN g *
        list PE)
      graph_work edge_work out_work effect_work,
    let trace := snd (audit_memory_initial EN g original mg edge_enc out effects graph_prepare) in
    2 + graph_work (audit_memory_initial_prepare trace) +
      audit_memory_table_work edge_work out_work effect_work (audit_memory_initial_table trace) <=
    2 + graph_work (snd (graph_prepare tt)) +
      audit_memory_table_budget edge_enc out effects (Graph.nodes g) edge_work out_work effect_work.
```

## AnalysesAuditMemoryInputBudget

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemoryInputBudget.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemoryInputBudget`.

```rocq
(** * Independent operand budgets for memory observers

    These recurrences inspect the original key, scope, table and callback operands.
    For example, a definition pays its unary index conversion only when its edge row exists.
    Builds on: concrete encoder budgets and memory effect, scope and successor models. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith ZArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap.
From Galois.Domains Require Import DomainsFootprint.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryGraph AnalysesMemoryWalk.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditCost.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditEncoding.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditEncoderBudget.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditMap.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryEncoding.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryDisjoint.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryRawNext.
Import List.ListNotations.

Definition audit_memory_version_input_budget {N E CN CE}
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
    (node_budget : N -> nat) (edge_budget : E -> nat) (v : memory_version N E) : nat :=
  match v with
  | MemoryLive => 1
  | MemoryPhi n => 1 + node_budget n
  | MemoryDef e i => 1 +
      audit_pair_input_budget edge_enc audit_nat_encode edge_budget audit_nat_input_budget (e, i)
  end.

Definition audit_memory_footprint_input_budget {T CE} (site_enc : T -> positive * list CE)
    (site_budget : T -> nat) (fp : footprint T) : nat :=
  audit_pair_input_budget site_enc (audit_pair_encode audit_z_encode audit_z_encode)
    site_budget (audit_pair_input_budget audit_z_encode audit_z_encode
      (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => 1)) (fp_site fp, (fp_lo fp, fp_hi fp)).

Definition audit_memory_scope_input_budget {T CE} (site_enc : T -> positive * list CE)
    (site_budget : T -> nat) (q : memory_scope T) : nat :=
  match q with
  | MemoryAll => 2
  | MemoryRegions fs => 1 + audit_list_input_budget (audit_memory_footprint_encode site_enc)
      (audit_memory_footprint_input_budget site_enc site_budget) fs
  end.

Definition audit_memory_memo_key_input_budget {N E CN CE}
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
    (node_budget : N -> nat) (edge_budget : E -> nat) (key : positive * memory_version N E) : nat :=
  audit_pair_input_budget audit_positive_encode (audit_memory_version_encode node_enc edge_enc)
    (fun _ => 1) (audit_memory_version_input_budget node_enc edge_enc node_budget edge_budget) key.

(** Internal version, footprint, scope and memo-key bodies use only fixed library instances. *)
Definition audit_memory_encoders_input_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CN CE SE (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
      (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE)
      node_work edge_work site_work node_budget edge_budget site_budget,
    (forall n, node_work (snd (node_enc n)) <= node_budget n) ->
    (forall e, edge_work (snd (edge_enc e)) <= edge_budget e) ->
    (forall t, site_work (snd (site_enc t)) <= site_budget t) ->
    (forall v, audit_memory_version_work node_work edge_work
      (snd (audit_memory_version_encode node_enc edge_enc v)) <=
      audit_memory_version_input_budget node_enc edge_enc node_budget edge_budget v) /\
    (forall fp, audit_memory_footprint_work site_work
      (snd (audit_memory_footprint_encode site_enc fp)) <=
      audit_memory_footprint_input_budget site_enc site_budget fp) /\
    (forall q, audit_memory_scope_work site_work (snd (audit_memory_scope_encode site_enc q)) <=
      audit_memory_scope_input_budget site_enc site_budget q) /\
    (forall key, audit_memory_memo_key_work node_work edge_work
      (snd (audit_memory_memo_key_encode node_enc edge_enc key)) <=
      audit_memory_memo_key_input_budget node_enc edge_enc node_budget edge_budget key).

Definition audit_disjoint_pair_input_budget {T CE} (site_enc : T -> positive * list CE)
    (site_budget : T -> nat) (left right : footprint T) : nat :=
  4 + site_budget (fp_site left) + site_budget (fp_site right) +
  2 * Nat.min (Pos.size_nat (fst (site_enc (fp_site left))))
    (Pos.size_nat (fst (site_enc (fp_site right)))) +
  audit_binary_weight (fp_hi left) (fp_lo right) +
  audit_binary_weight (fp_hi right) (fp_lo left).

Fixpoint audit_disjoint_inner_input_budget {T CE} (site_enc : T -> positive * list CE)
    (site_budget : T -> nat) (left : footprint T) (right : list (footprint T)) : nat :=
  match right with
  | [] => 1
  | item :: rest => 1 + audit_disjoint_pair_input_budget site_enc site_budget left item +
      audit_disjoint_inner_input_budget site_enc site_budget left rest
  end.

Fixpoint audit_disjoint_input_budget {T CE} (site_enc : T -> positive * list CE)
    (site_budget : T -> nat) (left right : list (footprint T)) : nat :=
  match left with
  | [] => 1
  | item :: rest => 1 + audit_disjoint_inner_input_budget site_enc site_budget item right +
      audit_disjoint_input_budget site_enc site_budget rest right
  end.

Definition audit_scopes_disjoint_input_budget {T CE} (site_enc : T -> positive * list CE)
    (site_budget : T -> nat) (left right : memory_scope T) : nat :=
  match left, right with
  | MemoryRegions fs, MemoryRegions gs => audit_disjoint_input_budget site_enc site_budget fs gs
  | _, _ => 0
  end.

Definition audit_memory_effect_get_input_budget {E T CE} (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
    (edge_budget : E -> nat) (table : Map.t E (Map.t nat (memory_effect T)))
    (edge : E) (index : nat) : nat :=
  5 + edge_budget edge + 5 * Pos.size_nat (fst (edge_enc edge)) +
  match fst (audit_map_get edge_enc edge table) with
  | None => 0
  | Some _ => 5 + audit_nat_input_budget index +
      5 * Pos.size_nat (fst (audit_nat_encode index))
  end.

Fixpoint audit_operand_calls_input_budget {N E} (operand_budget : N -> option E -> nat)
    (node : N) (keys : list (option E)) : nat :=
  match keys with
  | [] => 0
  | key :: rest => 2 + operand_budget node key +
      audit_operand_calls_input_budget operand_budget node rest
  end.

(** The raw-successor budget uses per-call incoming, operand and before bodies at actual inputs. *)
Definition audit_raw_next_input_budget {N E T CE SE IE OE BE : Type}
    (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE)
    (table : Map.t E (Map.t nat (memory_effect T)))
    (incoming : N -> list E * list IE)
    (before : E -> nat -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE)
    (edge_budget : E -> nat) (site_budget : T -> nat) (incoming_budget : N -> nat)
    (operand_budget : N -> option E -> nat) (before_budget : E -> nat -> nat)
    (q : memory_scope T) (v : memory_version N E) : nat :=
  match v with
  | MemoryLive => 2
  | MemoryPhi n =>
      let edges := fst (incoming n) in
      4 + incoming_budget n + length edges +
      audit_operand_calls_input_budget operand_budget n (None :: map Some edges)
  | MemoryDef e i =>
      8 + audit_memory_effect_get_input_budget edge_enc edge_budget table e i + before_budget e i +
      match fst (audit_memory_effect_get edge_enc table e i), fst (before e i) with
      | Some effect, Some _ =>
          audit_scopes_disjoint_input_budget site_enc site_budget (effect_writes effect) q
      | _, _ => 0
      end
  end.

(** The whole successor bound assumes only the external bodies' own operand budgets. *)
Definition audit_raw_next_whole_input_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CE SE IE OE BE (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
      (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE) table (incoming : N -> list E * list IE)
      (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE)
      (before : E -> nat -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE)
      edge_work site_work incoming_work operand_work before_work
      edge_budget site_budget incoming_budget operand_budget before_budget q v,
    (forall e, edge_work (snd (edge_enc e)) <= edge_budget e) ->
    (forall t, site_work (snd (site_enc t)) <= site_budget t) ->
    (forall n, incoming_work (snd (incoming n)) <= incoming_budget n) ->
    (forall n key, operand_work (snd (operand n key)) <= operand_budget n key) ->
    (forall e i, before_work (snd (before e i)) <= before_budget e i) ->
    audit_raw_next_source_work edge_work site_work incoming_work operand_work before_work
      (snd (audit_memory_raw_next edge_enc site_enc table incoming operand before q v)) <=
      @audit_raw_next_input_budget N E T CE SE IE OE BE edge_enc site_enc table incoming before
        edge_budget site_budget incoming_budget operand_budget before_budget q v.

Example audit_empty_disjoint_input_budget :
  audit_disjoint_input_budget audit_positive_encode (fun _ => 1) [] [] = 1.
Proof.
  reflexivity.
Qed.
```

## AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyBytes

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyBytes.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyBytes`.

```rocq
(** * Historical bytes for the fixed legacy producer

    Byte preservation observes the same allocation identity after the selected definition or entry.
    For example, a retained live-on-entry pair compares its load byte with that entry's byte.
    Builds on: the original byte-view laws and the fixed all-walk checked projection. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore.
From Galois.Domains Require Import DomainsFootprint.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsSemantics ViewsGraph ViewsMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryBase AnalysesMemoryGraph AnalysesMemoryLegacy.
Import List.ListNotations.

(** The producer establishes its own checker acceptance before using the original same-history
  law. *)
Definition audit_legacy_projection_historical_bytes_statement : Prop :=
  forall S O N E T F L (m : semantics S O) (bv : bytes_view S O N E T L)
      (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (EF : encoding F) (ET : encoding T)
      (function : F) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T))
      (reads : N -> list (footprint T)) (mg : memory_graph N E)
      (load_occurrence : N -> option (E * nat)) (fuel : positive),
    bytes_laws m bv ->
    memory_graph_wf (cfg (bgv bv)) effects mg ->
    let ms := project_memory_legacy EN EE EF ET function (cfg (bgv bv)) effects (writes_at bv)
      reads mg load_occurrence fuel in
    (forall s after t edge rest node,
      reachable_state m s -> run_edges m (bgv bv) s [edge] after ->
      run_edges m (bgv bv) after rest t -> point (bgv bv) t = node ->
      def_of_load ms node = Some (MDef function (Graph.source (cfg (bgv bv)) edge)) ->
      forall identity site offset,
        covered (reads node) site offset 1 -> bsite bv after identity = Some site ->
        byte bv t identity offset = byte bv after identity offset) /\
    (forall s edges t node,
      reachable_state m s -> In (point (bgv bv) s) (Graph.entries (cfg (bgv bv))) ->
      run_edges m (bgv bv) s edges t -> point (bgv bv) t = node ->
      def_of_load ms node = Some (MLive function) ->
      forall identity site offset,
        covered (reads node) site offset 1 -> bsite bv s identity = Some site ->
        byte bv t identity offset = byte bv s identity offset).
```

## AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyCfg

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyCfg.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyCfg`.

```rocq
(** * Counted node-adjacency graph used by the legacy checker

    This observer retains every graph-out and target callback, actual node
    distinctness probe and result-index update used by [legacy_cfg]. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryLegacy AnalysesMemoryFrontier.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditMap.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditFinSet.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryDistinct.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryIndex.
Import List.ListNotations.

Inductive audit_legacy_cfg_event (N E CN OE TE : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditLegacyCfgRowCase (remaining : list N)
  | AuditLegacyCfgOutCall (node : N) (edges : list E) (calls : list OE)
  | AuditLegacyCfgTargetCall (edge : E) (target : N) (calls : list TE)
  | AuditLegacyCfgDistinct (events : list (audit_memory_distinct_event N CN))
  | AuditLegacyCfgPairCase (remaining : list N)
  | AuditLegacyCfgPair (node target : N).
Arguments AuditLegacyCfgRowCase {N E CN OE TE} _.
Arguments AuditLegacyCfgOutCall {N E CN OE TE} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditLegacyCfgTargetCall {N E CN OE TE} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditLegacyCfgDistinct {N E CN OE TE} _.
Arguments AuditLegacyCfgPairCase {N E CN OE TE} _.
Arguments AuditLegacyCfgPair {N E CN OE TE} _ _.

Fixpoint audit_legacy_cfg_targets {N E CN OE TE}
    (target : E -> N * list TE) (node : N) (edges : list E)
    : list N * list (audit_legacy_cfg_event N E CN OE TE) :=
  match edges with
  | [] => ([], [])
  | edge :: rest =>
      let '(n, calls) := target edge in
      let '(tail, events) := audit_legacy_cfg_targets target node rest in
      (n :: tail, AuditLegacyCfgTargetCall edge n calls :: events)
  end.

Fixpoint audit_legacy_cfg_pairs {N E CN OE TE} (node : N) (targets : list N)
    : list (N * N) * list (audit_legacy_cfg_event N E CN OE TE) :=
  match targets with
  | [] => ([], [AuditLegacyCfgPairCase targets])
  | target :: rest =>
      let '(tail, events) := audit_legacy_cfg_pairs node rest in
      ((node, target) :: tail, [AuditLegacyCfgPairCase targets; AuditLegacyCfgPair node target] ++
        events)
  end.

Definition audit_legacy_cfg_row {N E CN OE TE} (EN : encoding N)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (out : N -> list E * list OE)
    (target : E -> N * list TE) (node : N)
    : list (N * N) * list (audit_legacy_cfg_event N E CN OE TE) :=
  let '(edges, out_calls) := out node in
  let '(targets, target_events) := audit_legacy_cfg_targets target node edges in
  let '(distinct, distinct_events) := audit_memory_distinct node_enc targets in
  let '(pairs, pair_events) := audit_legacy_cfg_pairs node distinct in
  (pairs, [AuditLegacyCfgRowCase [node]; AuditLegacyCfgOutCall node edges out_calls] ++
    target_events ++ [AuditLegacyCfgDistinct distinct_events] ++ pair_events).

Definition audit_legacy_cfg_rows {N E CN OE TE} (EN : encoding N)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (out : N -> list E * list OE)
    (target : E -> N * list TE) (nodes : list N)
    : Map.t N (list (N * N)) *
      list (audit_memory_index_event N (list (N * N)) CN (audit_legacy_cfg_event N E CN OE TE)) :=
  audit_memory_result_index node_enc (audit_legacy_cfg_row EN node_enc out target) nodes.

Definition audit_legacy_cfg_counted {N E CN OE TE} (EN : encoding N)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (out : N -> list E * list OE)
    (target : E -> N * list TE) (g : Graph.t N E)
    : Graph.t N (N * N) *
      list (audit_memory_index_event N (list (N * N)) CN (audit_legacy_cfg_event N E CN OE TE)) :=
  let '(rows, events) := audit_legacy_cfg_rows EN node_enc out target (Graph.nodes g) in
  ({| Graph.entries := Graph.entries g; Graph.nodes := Graph.nodes g;
      Graph.out := index_edges EN rows; Graph.source := fst; Graph.target := snd |}, events).

Fixpoint audit_legacy_cfg_row_work {N E CN OE TE}
    (node_work : list CN -> nat) (out_work : list OE -> nat) (target_work : list TE -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_legacy_cfg_event N E CN OE TE)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditLegacyCfgRowCase _ :: rest => 2 + audit_legacy_cfg_row_work node_work out_work
    target_work rest
  | AuditLegacyCfgOutCall _ edges calls :: rest => 2 + length edges + out_work calls +
      audit_legacy_cfg_row_work node_work out_work target_work rest
  | AuditLegacyCfgTargetCall _ _ calls :: rest => 2 + target_work calls +
      audit_legacy_cfg_row_work node_work out_work target_work rest
  | AuditLegacyCfgDistinct child :: rest => 2 + audit_memory_distinct_work node_work child +
      audit_legacy_cfg_row_work node_work out_work target_work rest
  | AuditLegacyCfgPairCase _ :: rest => 2 + audit_legacy_cfg_row_work node_work out_work
    target_work rest
  | AuditLegacyCfgPair _ _ :: rest => 2 + audit_legacy_cfg_row_work node_work out_work target_work
    rest
  end.

Definition audit_legacy_cfg_source_work {N E CN OE TE}
    (node_work : list CN -> nat) (out_work : list OE -> nat) (target_work : list TE -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_memory_index_event N (list (N * N)) CN (audit_legacy_cfg_event N E CN OE
      TE))) : nat :=
  audit_memory_index_work node_work (audit_legacy_cfg_row_work node_work out_work target_work)
    events.

Definition audit_legacy_cfg_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E CN OE TE (EN : encoding N) (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (out : N -> list E * list OE) (target : E -> N * list TE) (g : Graph.t N E),
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall n, fst (out n) = Graph.out g n) ->
    (forall e, fst (target e) = Graph.target g e) ->
    fst (audit_legacy_cfg_counted EN node_enc out target g) = legacy_cfg EN g.

Definition audit_legacy_cfg_source_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E CN OE TE (EN : encoding N) (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (out : N -> list E * list OE) (target : E -> N * list TE) (g : Graph.t N E)
    node_work out_work target_work,
    audit_legacy_cfg_source_work node_work out_work target_work
      (snd (audit_legacy_cfg_counted EN node_enc out target g)) <=
    audit_memory_index_budget node_enc (audit_legacy_cfg_row EN node_enc out target)
      node_work (audit_legacy_cfg_row_work node_work out_work target_work) (Graph.nodes g).
```

## AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyChecker

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyChecker.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyChecker`.

```rocq
(** * Actual legacy pair and all-node checker composition

    This file composes owner/scope decisions with the counted full slice for each
    actual candidate. The outer checker stops at the first false result, matching
    [forallb]; its calls retain the exact reached-set and source callback traces. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare.
From Galois.Domains Require Import DomainsFootprint.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryLegacy.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditPrimitive.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditFinSet.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacySliceFull.
Import List.ListNotations.
Open Scope bool_scope.

Inductive audit_legacy_pair_event (F N E T CN CF CT CS CR CW : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditLegacyPairLoadProbe (load : N) (result : bool) (calls : list (audit_set_event N CN))
  | AuditLegacyPairOwnerCompare (owner function : F) (owner_code function_code : positive)
      (owner_body function_body : list CF) (result : bool) (calls : list audit_positive_eqb_event)
  | AuditLegacyPairDefinitionProbe (node : N) (result : bool) (calls : list (audit_set_event N CN))
  | AuditLegacyPairSuccessors (node : N) (result : list N) (calls : list CS)
  | AuditLegacyPairReads (node : N) (result : list (footprint T)) (calls : list CR)
  | AuditLegacyPairSlice (result : bool)
      (events : audit_legacy_slice_full_events N E T CN CT CW).
Arguments AuditLegacyPairLoadProbe {F N E T CN CF CT CS CR CW} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditLegacyPairOwnerCompare {F N E T CN CF CT CS CR CW} _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _.
Arguments AuditLegacyPairDefinitionProbe {F N E T CN CF CT CS CR CW} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditLegacyPairSuccessors {F N E T CN CF CT CS CR CW} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditLegacyPairReads {F N E T CN CF CT CS CR CW} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditLegacyPairSlice {F N E T CN CF CT CS CR CW} _ _.

Definition audit_legacy_pair_check_full {F N E T CN CF CT CS CR CW}
    (EN : encoding N) (EF : encoding F) (ET : encoding T)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (function_enc : F -> positive * list CF)
    (site_enc : T -> positive * list CT)
    (successors : N -> list N * list CS) (reads : N -> list (footprint T) * list CR)
    (writes : N -> list (footprint T) * list CW)
    (g : Graph.t N E) (p : prepared EN g) (reached : FinSet.t N)
    (load : N) (d : mem_node F N) (function : F)
    : bool * list (audit_legacy_pair_event F N E T CN CF CT CS CR CW) :=
  let '(load_ok, load_calls) := audit_finset_mem node_enc load reached in
  let '(owner, def_node) := match d with MDef owner n => (owner, Some n) | MLive owner => (owner,
    None) end in
  let '(owner_code, owner_body) := function_enc owner in
  let '(function_code, function_body) := function_enc function in
  let '(same_owner, owner_calls) := audit_positive_eqb owner_code function_code in
  let owner_event := AuditLegacyPairOwnerCompare owner function owner_code function_code
    owner_body function_body same_owner owner_calls in
  match def_node with
  | Some n =>
      let '(def_ok, def_calls) := audit_finset_mem node_enc n reached in
      let '(read, read_calls) := reads load in
      let '(roots, succ_calls) := successors n in
      let '(answer, slice_events) := audit_legacy_slice_full EN ET node_enc site_enc g p writes
        read roots load in
      (andb load_ok (andb same_owner (andb def_ok answer)),
        [AuditLegacyPairLoadProbe load load_ok load_calls; owner_event;
        AuditLegacyPairDefinitionProbe n def_ok def_calls;
        AuditLegacyPairSuccessors n roots succ_calls; AuditLegacyPairReads load read read_calls;
        AuditLegacyPairSlice answer slice_events])
  | None =>
      let roots := Graph.entries g in
      let '(read, read_calls) := reads load in
      let '(answer, slice_events) := audit_legacy_slice_full EN ET node_enc site_enc g p writes
        read roots load in
      (andb load_ok (andb same_owner answer), [AuditLegacyPairLoadProbe load load_ok load_calls;
        owner_event;
        AuditLegacyPairReads load read read_calls; AuditLegacyPairSlice answer slice_events])
  end.

Inductive audit_legacy_checker_event (F N E T CN CF CT CS CR CW CD : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditLegacyCheckerCase (remaining : list N)
  | AuditLegacyCheckerMissing (node : N) (definition_call : list CD)
  | AuditLegacyCheckerCandidate (node : N) (definition : mem_node F N) (result : bool)
      (definition_call : list CD)
      (events : list (audit_legacy_pair_event F N E T CN CF CT CS CR CW)).
Arguments AuditLegacyCheckerCase {F N E T CN CF CT CS CR CW CD} _.
Arguments AuditLegacyCheckerMissing {F N E T CN CF CT CS CR CW CD} _ _.
Arguments AuditLegacyCheckerCandidate {F N E T CN CF CT CS CR CW CD} _ _ _ _ _.

Fixpoint audit_legacy_check_nodes {F N E T CN CF CT CS CR CW CD}
    (EN : encoding N) (EF : encoding F) (ET : encoding T)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (function_enc : F -> positive * list CF)
    (site_enc : T -> positive * list CT)
    (successors : N -> list N * list CS) (reads : N -> list (footprint T) * list CR)
    (writes : N -> list (footprint T) * list CW)
    (g : Graph.t N E) (p : prepared EN g) (reached : FinSet.t N)
    (definitions : N -> option (mem_node F N) * list CD) (function : F) (nodes : list N)
    : bool * list (audit_legacy_checker_event F N E T CN CF CT CS CR CW CD) :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => (true, [AuditLegacyCheckerCase nodes])
  | n :: rest => let '(definition, definition_call) := definitions n in match definition with
      | None => let '(tail, events) := audit_legacy_check_nodes EN EF ET node_enc function_enc
        site_enc
          successors reads writes g p reached definitions function rest in
          (andb true tail, AuditLegacyCheckerCase nodes :: AuditLegacyCheckerMissing n
            definition_call :: events)
      | Some d =>
          let '(answer, pair_events) := audit_legacy_pair_check_full EN EF ET node_enc function_enc
            site_enc successors reads writes g p reached n d function in
          let '(tail, events) := audit_legacy_check_nodes EN EF ET node_enc function_enc site_enc
            successors reads writes g p reached definitions function rest in
          (andb answer tail,
            AuditLegacyCheckerCase nodes :: AuditLegacyCheckerCandidate n d answer definition_call
              pair_events :: events)
      end
  end.

Definition audit_legacy_pair_check_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall F N E T CN CF CT CS CR CW (EN : encoding N) (EF : encoding F) (ET : encoding T)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (function_enc : F -> positive * list CF)
    (site_enc : T -> positive * list CT) (successors : N -> list N * list CS)
    (reads : N -> list (footprint T) * list CR) (writes : N -> list (footprint T) * list CW)
    (original_reads original_writes : N -> list (footprint T))
    (g : Graph.t N E) (p : prepared EN g) reached n d f,
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall x, fst (function_enc x) = encode EF x) ->
    (forall t, fst (site_enc t) = encode ET t) ->
    (forall n, fst (successors n) = legacy_successors EN g p n) ->
    (forall n, fst (reads n) = original_reads n) ->
    (forall n, fst (writes n) = original_writes n) ->
    fst (audit_legacy_pair_check_full EN EF ET node_enc function_enc site_enc successors reads
      writes
      g p reached n d f) =
      legacy_pair_check EN EF ET f g p reached original_writes original_reads n d.

Fixpoint audit_legacy_pair_primitive_work {F N E T CN CF CT CS CR CW}
    (EN : encoding N) (node_work : list CN -> nat) (function_work : list CF -> nat)
    (site_work : list CT -> nat) (successor_work : list CS -> nat)
    (read_work : list CR -> nat) (write_work : list CW -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_legacy_pair_event F N E T CN CF CT CS CR CW)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditLegacyPairLoadProbe _ _ calls :: rest => audit_finset_source_work node_work calls +
      audit_legacy_pair_primitive_work EN node_work function_work site_work successor_work
        read_work write_work rest
  | AuditLegacyPairOwnerCompare _ _ _ _ left_body right_body _ calls :: rest =>
      function_work left_body + function_work right_body + audit_positive_eqb_source_work calls +
      audit_legacy_pair_primitive_work EN node_work function_work site_work successor_work
        read_work write_work rest
  | AuditLegacyPairDefinitionProbe _ _ calls :: rest => audit_finset_source_work node_work calls +
      audit_legacy_pair_primitive_work EN node_work function_work site_work successor_work
        read_work write_work rest
  | AuditLegacyPairSuccessors _ _ calls :: rest => successor_work calls +
      audit_legacy_pair_primitive_work EN node_work function_work site_work successor_work
        read_work write_work rest
  | AuditLegacyPairReads _ _ calls :: rest => read_work calls +
      audit_legacy_pair_primitive_work EN node_work function_work site_work successor_work
        read_work write_work rest
  | AuditLegacyPairSlice _ child :: rest =>
      audit_legacy_slice_full_source_work EN node_work site_work write_work child +
      audit_legacy_pair_primitive_work EN node_work function_work site_work successor_work
        read_work write_work rest
  end.

Definition audit_legacy_pair_source_work {F N E T CN CF CT CS CR CW}
    (EN : encoding N) (node_work : list CN -> nat) (function_work : list CF -> nat)
    (site_work : list CT -> nat) (successor_work : list CS -> nat)
    (read_work : list CR -> nat) (write_work : list CW -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_legacy_pair_event F N E T CN CF CT CS CR CW)) : nat :=
  2 * length events + audit_legacy_pair_primitive_work EN node_work function_work site_work
    successor_work read_work write_work events.

Fixpoint audit_legacy_checker_source_work {F N E T CN CF CT CS CR CW CD}
    (EN : encoding N) (node_work : list CN -> nat) (function_work : list CF -> nat)
    (site_work : list CT -> nat) (successor_work : list CS -> nat)
    (read_work : list CR -> nat) (write_work : list CW -> nat) (definition_work : list CD -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_legacy_checker_event F N E T CN CF CT CS CR CW CD)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditLegacyCheckerCase _ :: rest => 2 + audit_legacy_checker_source_work EN node_work
    function_work
      site_work successor_work read_work write_work definition_work rest
  | AuditLegacyCheckerMissing _ calls :: rest => 2 + definition_work calls +
    audit_legacy_checker_source_work EN node_work function_work
      site_work successor_work read_work write_work definition_work rest
  | AuditLegacyCheckerCandidate _ _ _ calls child :: rest =>
      2 + audit_legacy_pair_source_work EN node_work function_work site_work successor_work
        read_work write_work child +
      definition_work calls +
      audit_legacy_checker_source_work EN node_work function_work site_work successor_work
        read_work write_work definition_work rest
  end.

Definition audit_legacy_check_nodes_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall F N E T CN CF CT CS CR CW CD (EN : encoding N) (EF : encoding F) (ET : encoding T)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (function_enc : F -> positive * list CF)
    (site_enc : T -> positive * list CT) (successors : N -> list N * list CS)
    (reads : N -> list (footprint T) * list CR) (writes : N -> list (footprint T) * list CW)
    (definitions : N -> option (mem_node F N) * list CD)
    (original_reads original_writes : N -> list (footprint T))
    (original_definitions : N -> option (mem_node F N))
    (g : Graph.t N E) (p : prepared EN g) reached f nodes,
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall x, fst (function_enc x) = encode EF x) ->
    (forall t, fst (site_enc t) = encode ET t) ->
    (forall n, fst (successors n) = legacy_successors EN g p n) ->
    (forall n, fst (reads n) = original_reads n) ->
    (forall n, fst (writes n) = original_writes n) ->
    (forall n, fst (definitions n) = original_definitions n) ->
    fst (audit_legacy_check_nodes EN EF ET node_enc function_enc site_enc successors reads writes
      g p reached definitions f nodes) =
    forallb (fun n => match original_definitions n with
      | None => true
      | Some d => legacy_pair_check EN EF ET f g p reached original_writes original_reads n d
      end) nodes.

(** Counterexamples to short-circuit models: even with a false first operand, the
    selected constructor branch still records its read/successor work and slice. *)
Definition audit_legacy_false_load_graph : Graph.t bool bool :=
  Graph.Make [false; true] [false; true] (fun _ => []) (fun e => e) (fun e => e).

Definition audit_legacy_false_load_pair_fixture :=
  audit_legacy_pair_check_full bool_encoding bool_encoding unit_encoding
    (fun n => (encode bool_encoding n, @nil unit))
    (fun f => (encode bool_encoding f, @nil unit))
    (fun _ => (encode unit_encoding tt, @nil unit))
    (fun n => ([negb n], [tt]))
    (fun _ => ([], [tt])) (fun _ => ([], [tt]))
    audit_legacy_false_load_graph (prepare bool_encoding audit_legacy_false_load_graph)
    FinSet.empty false (MDef true false) true.

Definition audit_legacy_false_load_fixture_retains_body_statement : Prop :=
  let '(result, events) := audit_legacy_false_load_pair_fixture in
  result = false /\
  (exists reads_trace, In (AuditLegacyPairReads false [] reads_trace) events) /\
  (exists slice_result slice_events, In (AuditLegacyPairSlice slice_result slice_events) events).

Definition audit_legacy_false_owner_pair_fixture :=
  audit_legacy_pair_check_full bool_encoding bool_encoding unit_encoding
    (fun n => (encode bool_encoding n, @nil unit))
    (fun f => (encode bool_encoding f, @nil unit))
    (fun _ => (encode unit_encoding tt, @nil unit))
    (fun n => ([negb n], [tt]))
    (fun _ => ([], [tt])) (fun _ => ([], [tt]))
    audit_legacy_false_load_graph (prepare bool_encoding audit_legacy_false_load_graph)
    (FinSet.add bool_encoding false FinSet.empty) false (MDef false true) true.

Definition audit_legacy_false_owner_fixture_retains_body_statement : Prop :=
  let '(result, events) := audit_legacy_false_owner_pair_fixture in
  result = false /\
  (exists left right lc rc lb rb eq_events,
    In (AuditLegacyPairOwnerCompare left right lc rc lb rb false eq_events) events) /\
  (exists node reads_trace, In (AuditLegacyPairReads node [] reads_trace) events) /\
  (exists slice_result slice_events,
    In (AuditLegacyPairSlice slice_result slice_events) events).

(** The outer fixture has two false candidates and exposes both calls, proving the
    all-node traversal continues after a false first pair result. *)
Definition audit_legacy_false_head_two_nodes_fixture :=
  audit_legacy_check_nodes bool_encoding bool_encoding unit_encoding
    (fun n => (encode bool_encoding n, @nil unit))
    (fun f => (encode bool_encoding f, @nil unit))
    (fun _ => (encode unit_encoding tt, @nil unit))
    (fun n => ([negb n], [tt]))
    (fun _ => ([], [tt])) (fun _ => ([], [tt]))
    audit_legacy_false_load_graph (prepare bool_encoding audit_legacy_false_load_graph)
    FinSet.empty (fun _ => (Some (MDef true false), [tt])) true [false; true].

Definition audit_legacy_false_head_two_nodes_fixture_retains_tail_statement : Prop :=
  let '(result, events) := audit_legacy_false_head_two_nodes_fixture in
  result = false /\
  (exists d calls pair_events,
    In (AuditLegacyCheckerCandidate false d false calls pair_events) events /\
    exists d' calls' pair_events',
      In (AuditLegacyCheckerCandidate true d' false calls' pair_events') events).
```

## AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyGuard

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyGuard.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyGuard`.

```rocq
(** * Strict legacy producer guard

    This mirror executes every operand of the existing three-way guard.
    For example, a failing node comparison still probes both membership sets.
    Builds on: shared encoding, positive equality and finite-set observers. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditPrimitive.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditFinSet.
Import List.ListNotations.

Inductive audit_legacy_guard_event (N E CN CE SE : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditGuardSource (edge : E) (node : N) (events : list SE)
  | AuditGuardNodeEncode (node : N) (code : positive) (events : list CN)
  | AuditGuardEqual (left right : positive) (result : bool) (events : list audit_positive_eqb_event)
  | AuditGuardReached (node : N) (result : bool) (events : list (audit_set_event N CN))
  | AuditGuardListed (edge : E) (result : bool) (events : list (audit_set_event E CE)).

Arguments AuditGuardSource {N E CN CE SE} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditGuardNodeEncode {N E CN CE SE} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditGuardEqual {N E CN CE SE} _ _ _ _.
Arguments AuditGuardReached {N E CN CE SE} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditGuardListed {N E CN CE SE} _ _ _.

(** The two source calls and both membership probes are always evaluated. *)
Definition audit_legacy_guard {N E CN CE SE} (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (source : E -> N * list SE)
    (reached : FinSet.t N) (listed : FinSet.t E) (edge : E) (node : N)
    : bool * list (audit_legacy_guard_event N E CN CE SE) :=
  let '(first_source, fs) := source edge in
  let '(first_code, fc) := node_enc first_source in
  let '(node_code, nc) := node_enc node in
  let '(equal, eq) := audit_positive_eqb first_code node_code in
  let '(second_source, ss) := source edge in
  let '(reachable, re) := audit_finset_mem node_enc second_source reached in
  let '(is_listed, li) := audit_finset_mem edge_enc edge listed in
  (andb (andb equal reachable) is_listed,
    [AuditGuardSource edge first_source fs; AuditGuardNodeEncode first_source first_code fc;
     AuditGuardNodeEncode node node_code nc; AuditGuardEqual first_code node_code equal eq;
     AuditGuardSource edge second_source ss; AuditGuardReached second_source reachable re;
     AuditGuardListed edge is_listed li]).

(** Exact boolean erasure requires only the actual encoder and graph-source result agreements. *)
Definition audit_legacy_guard_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E CN CE SE (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (g : Graph.t N E)
      (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
      (source : E -> N * list SE) reached listed edge node,
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall e, fst (edge_enc e) = encode EE e) ->
    (forall e, fst (source e) = Graph.source g e) ->
    fst (audit_legacy_guard node_enc edge_enc source reached listed edge node) =
      andb (andb (Pos.eqb (encode EN (Graph.source g edge)) (encode EN node))
        (FinSet.mem EN (Graph.source g edge) reached)) (FinSet.mem EE edge listed).

Definition audit_legacy_guard_count_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E CN CE SE (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
      (source : E -> N * list SE) reached listed edge node,
    length (snd (audit_legacy_guard node_enc edge_enc source reached listed edge node)) = 7.

(** Each fixed operation charges its captured internal source work and true external child trace. *)
Fixpoint audit_legacy_guard_primitive_work {N E CN CE SE}
    (node_work : list CN -> nat) (edge_work : list CE -> nat) (source_work : list SE -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_legacy_guard_event N E CN CE SE)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditGuardSource _ _ calls :: rest => source_work calls +
      audit_legacy_guard_primitive_work node_work edge_work source_work rest
  | AuditGuardNodeEncode _ _ calls :: rest => node_work calls +
      audit_legacy_guard_primitive_work node_work edge_work source_work rest
  | AuditGuardEqual _ _ _ calls :: rest => audit_positive_eqb_source_work calls +
      audit_legacy_guard_primitive_work node_work edge_work source_work rest
  | AuditGuardReached _ _ calls :: rest => audit_finset_source_work node_work calls +
      audit_legacy_guard_primitive_work node_work edge_work source_work rest
  | AuditGuardListed _ _ calls :: rest => audit_finset_source_work edge_work calls +
      audit_legacy_guard_primitive_work node_work edge_work source_work rest
  end.

Definition audit_legacy_guard_source_work {N E CN CE SE}
    (node_work : list CN -> nat) (edge_work : list CE -> nat) (source_work : list SE -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_legacy_guard_event N E CN CE SE)) : nat :=
  2 * length events + audit_legacy_guard_primitive_work node_work edge_work source_work events.

Definition audit_legacy_guard_source_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E CN CE SE (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
      (source : E -> N * list SE) reached listed edge node node_work edge_work source_work,
    let events := snd (audit_legacy_guard node_enc edge_enc source reached listed edge node) in
    audit_legacy_guard_source_work node_work edge_work source_work events <=
      14 + audit_legacy_guard_primitive_work node_work edge_work source_work events.
```

## AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyInputBudget

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyInputBudget.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyInputBudget`.

```rocq
(** * Independent complete legacy checker budgets

    These recurrences inspect original rows, footprints and actual intermediate reached sets.
    For example, a false owner still pays both DFS slices and the selected branch's callbacks.
    Builds on: full legacy preparation, strict pair checking and source DFS. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith ZArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare GraphDfs GraphAuditBase GraphAuditDfs.
From Galois.Domains Require Import DomainsFootprint.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryLegacy AnalysesMemoryFrontier.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditCost.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditMap.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryInputBudget.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemorySharedBudget.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryIndex.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyCfg.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyOverlap.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacySlice.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacySliceFull.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyChecker.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacySuccessor.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyNoClobber.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryGraphCallbacks.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryWalkIndex.
Import List.ListNotations.

Fixpoint audit_legacy_targets_input_budget {N E TE} (target : E -> N * list TE)
    (target_budget : E -> nat) (edges : list E) : nat :=
  match edges with
  | [] => 0
  | edge :: rest => 2 + target_budget edge +
      audit_legacy_targets_input_budget target target_budget rest
  end.

Definition audit_legacy_cfg_row_input_budget {N E CN OE TE}
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (out : N -> list E * list OE)
    (target : E -> N * list TE) (node_budget out_budget : N -> nat)
    (target_budget : E -> nat) (node : N) : nat :=
  let edges := fst (out node) in
  let targets := map (fun e => fst (target e)) edges in
  8 + length edges + out_budget node +
  audit_legacy_targets_input_budget target target_budget edges +
  audit_memory_distinct_input_budget node_enc node_budget targets + 4 * length targets.

Definition audit_legacy_cfg_input_budget {N E CN OE TE}
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (out : N -> list E * list OE)
    (target : E -> N * list TE) (node_budget out_budget : N -> nat)
    (target_budget : E -> nat) (nodes : list N) : nat :=
  audit_memory_index_input_budget node_enc node_budget
    (audit_legacy_cfg_row_input_budget node_enc out target node_budget out_budget target_budget)
      nodes.

Fixpoint audit_legacy_overlap_row_input_budget {T CT} (site_enc : T -> positive * list CT)
    (site_budget : T -> nat) (left : footprint T) (right : list (footprint T)) : nat :=
  match right with
  | [] => 1
  | item :: rest =>
      8 + site_budget (fp_site left) + site_budget (fp_site item) +
      2 * Nat.min (Pos.size_nat (fst (site_enc (fp_site left))))
        (Pos.size_nat (fst (site_enc (fp_site item)))) +
      audit_binary_weight (fp_lo left) (fp_hi left) +
      audit_binary_weight (fp_lo item) (fp_hi item) +
      audit_binary_weight (fp_lo left) (fp_hi item) +
      audit_binary_weight (fp_lo item) (fp_hi left) +
      audit_legacy_overlap_row_input_budget site_enc site_budget left rest
  end.

Fixpoint audit_legacy_overlap_input_budget {T CT} (site_enc : T -> positive * list CT)
    (site_budget : T -> nat) (left right : list (footprint T)) : nat :=
  match left with
  | [] => 1
  | item :: rest => 1 + audit_legacy_overlap_row_input_budget site_enc site_budget item right +
      audit_legacy_overlap_input_budget site_enc site_budget rest right
  end.

Fixpoint audit_legacy_slice_nodes_input_budget {N T CN CT W}
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (site_enc : T -> positive * list CT)
    (writes : N -> list (footprint T) * list W) (node_budget : N -> nat)
    (site_budget : T -> nat) (writes_budget : N -> nat)
    (read : list (footprint T)) (forward backward : FinSet.t N) (nodes : list N) : nat :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => 0
  | node :: rest => 6 + 2 * audit_walk_predecessor_input_budget node_enc node_budget node +
      (if andb (match fst (audit_map_get node_enc node forward) with Some _ => true | None =>
        false end)
          (match fst (audit_map_get node_enc node backward) with Some _ => true | None => false end)
       then 2 + writes_budget node +
         audit_legacy_overlap_input_budget site_enc site_budget (fst (writes node)) read
       else 0) + audit_legacy_slice_nodes_input_budget node_enc site_enc writes node_budget
         site_budget writes_budget read forward backward rest
  end.

Fixpoint audit_legacy_sum_vertex_budget {N} (node_budget : N -> nat) (nodes : list N) : nat :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => 0
  | node :: rest => node_budget node + audit_legacy_sum_vertex_budget node_budget rest
  end.

(** DFS can discover only roots and actual targets from rows stored in its prepared out map. *)
Definition audit_legacy_dfs_vertices {N E} (g : Graph.t N E) (rows : Map.t N (list E))
    (roots : list N) : list N :=
  roots ++ map fst (Map.elements rows) ++
  map (Graph.target g) (flat_map snd (Map.elements rows)).

Definition audit_legacy_dfs_input_budget {N E} (EN : encoding N) (g : Graph.t N E)
    (p : prepared EN g) (node_budget : N -> nat) (roots : list N) : nat :=
  audit_dfs_source_budget EN g p roots + audit_dfs_full_input_event_bound p roots *
    (1 + audit_legacy_sum_vertex_budget node_budget
      (audit_legacy_dfs_vertices g (out_index p) roots)).

Definition audit_legacy_slice_full_input_budget {N E T CN CT W}
    (EN : encoding N) (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (site_enc : T -> positive * list CT) (g : Graph.t N E) (p : prepared EN g)
    (writes : N -> list (footprint T) * list W) (node_budget : N -> nat)
    (site_budget : T -> nat) (writes_budget : N -> nat) read roots load : nat :=
  let forward := visited (dfs p FinSet.empty roots) in
  let backward := visited (dfs (prepared_reverse p [load]) FinSet.empty [load]) in
  audit_legacy_dfs_input_budget EN g p node_budget roots +
  audit_legacy_dfs_input_budget EN (reverse_graph p [load]) (prepared_reverse p [load])
    node_budget [load] + audit_legacy_slice_nodes_input_budget node_enc site_enc writes node_budget
    site_budget writes_budget read forward backward (Graph.nodes g).

Definition audit_legacy_pair_input_budget {F N E T CN CF CT CS CR CW}
    (EN : encoding N) (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (function_enc : F -> positive * list CF) (site_enc : T -> positive * list CT)
    (successors : N -> list N * list CS) (reads : N -> list (footprint T) * list CR)
    (writes : N -> list (footprint T) * list CW) (node_budget : N -> nat)
    (function_budget : F -> nat) (site_budget : T -> nat)
    (successor_budget read_budget write_budget : N -> nat)
    (g : Graph.t N E) (p : prepared EN g) load (definition : mem_node F N) function : nat :=
  let owner := match definition with MDef owner _ | MLive owner => owner end in
  let roots := match definition with
    | MDef _ node => fst (successors node)
    | MLive _ => Graph.entries g
    end in
  14 + audit_walk_predecessor_input_budget node_enc node_budget load +
  function_budget owner + function_budget function +
  2 * Nat.min (Pos.size_nat (fst (function_enc owner)))
    (Pos.size_nat (fst (function_enc function))) + read_budget load +
  (match definition with
    | MDef _ node => audit_walk_predecessor_input_budget node_enc node_budget node +
        successor_budget node
    | MLive _ => 0
    end) + audit_legacy_slice_full_input_budget EN node_enc site_enc g p writes node_budget
      site_budget write_budget (fst (reads load)) roots load.

Definition audit_legacy_successors_input_budget {N E CN} (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (node_budget : N -> nat) (rows : Map.t N (list E)) (node : N) : nat :=
  2 + audit_walk_predecessor_input_budget node_enc node_budget node +
  4 * length (match fst (audit_map_get node_enc node rows) with
    | Some edges => edges | None => [] end).

Fixpoint audit_legacy_check_nodes_input_budget {F N E T CN CF CT CS CR CW CD}
    (EN : encoding N) (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (function_enc : F -> positive * list CF) (site_enc : T -> positive * list CT)
    (successors : N -> list N * list CS) (reads : N -> list (footprint T) * list CR)
    (writes : N -> list (footprint T) * list CW)
    (definitions : N -> option (mem_node F N) * list CD) (node_budget : N -> nat)
    (function_budget : F -> nat) (site_budget : T -> nat)
    (successor_budget read_budget write_budget definition_budget : N -> nat)
    (g : Graph.t N E) (p : prepared EN g) (function : F) (nodes : list N) : nat :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => 2
  | node :: rest => 4 + definition_budget node +
      (match fst (definitions node) with
      | None => 0
      | Some definition => audit_legacy_pair_input_budget EN node_enc function_enc site_enc
          successors reads writes node_budget function_budget site_budget successor_budget
            read_budget
          write_budget g p node definition function
      end) + audit_legacy_check_nodes_input_budget EN node_enc function_enc site_enc successors
        reads
        writes definitions node_budget function_budget site_budget successor_budget read_budget
        write_budget definition_budget g p function rest
  end.

Definition audit_legacy_no_clobber_input_budget {F N E T CN CF CT OE TE CR CW CD}
    (EN : encoding N) (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (function_enc : F -> positive * list CF) (site_enc : T -> positive * list CT)
    (out : N -> list E * list OE) (target : E -> N * list TE)
    (reads : N -> list (footprint T) * list CR) (writes : N -> list (footprint T) * list CW)
    (definitions : N -> option (mem_node F N) * list CD)
    (node_budget out_budget read_budget write_budget definition_budget : N -> nat)
    (function_budget : F -> nat) (site_budget : T -> nat) (target_budget : E -> nat)
    (g : Graph.t N E) (function : F) : nat :=
  let rows := fst (audit_legacy_cfg_rows EN node_enc out target (Graph.nodes g)) in
  let cfg := Graph.Make (Graph.entries g) (Graph.nodes g) (index_edges EN rows) fst snd in
  let prep := prepare EN cfg in
  let row_read_budget := audit_walk_predecessor_input_budget node_enc node_budget in
  audit_legacy_cfg_input_budget node_enc out target node_budget out_budget target_budget
    (Graph.nodes g) + audit_prepare_source_budget EN cfg +
  audit_graph_prepare_full_event_bound cfg *
    audit_snapshot_graph_input_budget (audit_walk_predecessors node_enc rows)
      (fun edge : N * N => (snd edge, @nil unit)) node_budget row_read_budget (fun _ => 1)
      (Graph.nodes cfg) +
  audit_legacy_dfs_input_budget EN cfg prep node_budget (Graph.entries cfg) +
  audit_legacy_check_nodes_input_budget EN node_enc function_enc site_enc
    (audit_legacy_successors_counted EN node_enc cfg prep) reads writes definitions
    node_budget function_budget site_budget
    (audit_legacy_successors_input_budget node_enc node_budget (out_index prep))
    read_budget write_budget definition_budget cfg prep function (Graph.nodes g).

(** The complete checker bound closes normalized out reads, pair projections and both DFS bodies. *)
Definition audit_legacy_no_clobber_whole_input_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall F N E T CN CF CT OE TE CR CW CD (EN : encoding N) (EF : encoding F) (ET : encoding T)
      (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (function_enc : F -> positive * list CF)
      (site_enc : T -> positive * list CT) (out : N -> list E * list OE)
      (target : E -> N * list TE) (reads : N -> list (footprint T) * list CR)
      (writes : N -> list (footprint T) * list CW)
      (definitions : N -> option (mem_node F N) * list CD)
      node_work function_work site_work out_work target_work read_work write_work definition_work
      node_budget function_budget site_budget out_budget target_budget read_budget write_budget
      definition_budget (g : Graph.t N E) function,
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall n, node_work (snd (node_enc n)) <= node_budget n) ->
    (forall f, function_work (snd (function_enc f)) <= function_budget f) ->
    (forall t, site_work (snd (site_enc t)) <= site_budget t) ->
    (forall n, out_work (snd (out n)) <= out_budget n) ->
    (forall e, target_work (snd (target e)) <= target_budget e) ->
    (forall n, read_work (snd (reads n)) <= read_budget n) ->
    (forall n, write_work (snd (writes n)) <= write_budget n) ->
    (forall n, definition_work (snd (definitions n)) <= definition_budget n) ->
    audit_legacy_no_clobber_source_work EN node_work function_work site_work out_work target_work
      read_work write_work definition_work (snd (audit_legacy_no_clobber_counted EN EF ET node_enc
        function_enc site_enc out target reads writes function g definitions)) <=
    audit_legacy_no_clobber_input_budget EN node_enc function_enc site_enc out target reads writes
      definitions node_budget out_budget read_budget write_budget definition_budget function_budget
      site_budget target_budget g function.

(** All original callback observations are retained in the normalization budget. *)
Definition audit_legacy_cfg_whole_input_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E CN OE TE (EN : encoding N) (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
      (out : N -> list E * list OE) (target : E -> N * list TE)
      node_work out_work target_work node_budget out_budget target_budget (g : Graph.t N E),
    (forall n, node_work (snd (node_enc n)) <= node_budget n) ->
    (forall n, out_work (snd (out n)) <= out_budget n) ->
    (forall e, target_work (snd (target e)) <= target_budget e) ->
    audit_legacy_cfg_source_work node_work out_work target_work
      (snd (audit_legacy_cfg_counted EN node_enc out target g)) <=
    audit_legacy_cfg_input_budget node_enc out target node_budget out_budget target_budget
      (Graph.nodes g).
```

## AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyNoClobber

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyNoClobber.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyNoClobber`.

```rocq
(** * End-to-end counted legacy no-clobber checker

    The original edge graph is normalized, prepared and searched for entry reachability;
    each candidate then runs the exact strict pair check with full forward/reverse slices.
    The returned result is the existing [no_clobber_check] boolean. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare GraphDfs.
From Galois.Domains Require Import DomainsFootprint.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryLegacy.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditMap.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditFinSet.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryIndex.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyCfg.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyChecker.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacySuccessor.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacySliceFull.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryGraphCallbacks.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryWalkIndex.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphAuditBase.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphAuditDfs.
Import List.ListNotations.

(** Normalized graph callbacks close the internal indexed out lookup and pair projection. *)
Definition audit_legacy_prepare_callbacks {N CN} (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (rows : Map.t N (list (N * N))) :=
  audit_snapshot_graph_callbacks node_enc (audit_walk_predecessors node_enc rows)
    (fun edge : N * N => (snd edge, @nil unit)).

Record audit_legacy_no_clobber_events (F N E T CN CF CT OE TE CR CW CD : Type) : Type :=
  AuditLegacyNoClobberEvents {
    audit_legacy_check_cfg_events :
      list (audit_memory_index_event N (list (N * N)) CN (audit_legacy_cfg_event N E CN OE TE));
    audit_legacy_check_prepare_events : list (audit_prepare_source_event N (N * N)
        (audit_snapshot_graph_body CN (audit_map_event N (list (N * N)) CN) unit));
    audit_legacy_check_reached_events : list (audit_dfs_nested_event N (N * N)
        (audit_graph_callback_capture N (N * N) (list CN)));
    audit_legacy_check_nodes_events :
      list (audit_legacy_checker_event F N (N * N) T CN CF CT
        (audit_legacy_successor_event N (N * N) CN) CR CW CD)
  }.
Arguments AuditLegacyNoClobberEvents {F N E T CN CF CT OE TE CR CW CD} _ _ _ _.
Arguments audit_legacy_check_cfg_events {F N E T CN CF CT OE TE CR CW CD} _.
Arguments audit_legacy_check_prepare_events {F N E T CN CF CT OE TE CR CW CD} _.
Arguments audit_legacy_check_reached_events {F N E T CN CF CT OE TE CR CW CD} _.
Arguments audit_legacy_check_nodes_events {F N E T CN CF CT OE TE CR CW CD} _.

Definition audit_legacy_no_clobber_counted {F N E T CN CF CT OE TE CR CW CD}
    (EN : encoding N) (EF : encoding F) (ET : encoding T)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (function_enc : F -> positive * list CF)
    (site_enc : T -> positive * list CT)
    (out : N -> list E * list OE) (target : E -> N * list TE)
    (reads : N -> list (footprint T) * list CR) (writes : N -> list (footprint T) * list CW)
    (function : F) (g : Graph.t N E)
    (definitions : N -> option (mem_node F N) * list CD)
    : bool * audit_legacy_no_clobber_events F N E T CN CF CT OE TE CR CW CD :=
  let '(rows, cfg_events) := audit_legacy_cfg_rows EN node_enc out target (Graph.nodes g) in
  let cfg := Graph.Make (Graph.entries g) (Graph.nodes g) (index_edges EN rows) fst snd in
  let '(p, prepare_events) := audit_prepare_source_counted EN cfg
    (audit_legacy_prepare_callbacks node_enc rows) in
  let '(reached_result, reached_events) := audit_dfs_source_counted p
    (audit_legacy_dfs_callbacks node_enc cfg) FinSet.empty (Graph.entries cfg) in
  let reached := visited reached_result in
  let successors := fun node => audit_legacy_successors_counted EN node_enc cfg p node in
  let '(answer, check_events) := audit_legacy_check_nodes EN EF ET node_enc function_enc site_enc
    successors reads writes cfg p reached definitions function (Graph.nodes g) in
  (answer, AuditLegacyNoClobberEvents cfg_events prepare_events reached_events check_events).

Definition audit_legacy_no_clobber_source_work {F N E T CN CF CT OE TE CR CW CD}
    (EN : encoding N) (node_work : list CN -> nat) (function_work : list CF -> nat)
    (site_work : list CT -> nat) (out_work : list OE -> nat) (target_work : list TE -> nat)
    (read_work : list CR -> nat) (write_work : list CW -> nat) (definition_work : list CD -> nat)
    (events : audit_legacy_no_clobber_events F N E T CN CF CT OE TE CR CW CD) : nat :=
  audit_legacy_cfg_source_work node_work out_work target_work (audit_legacy_check_cfg_events
    events) +
  audit_prepare_source_work
    (audit_snapshot_graph_body_work node_work (audit_map_source_work node_work) (@length unit))
      (audit_legacy_check_prepare_events events) +
  audit_dfs_source_work node_work (audit_legacy_check_reached_events events) +
  audit_legacy_checker_source_work EN node_work function_work site_work
    (audit_legacy_successor_source_work node_work) read_work write_work definition_work
    (audit_legacy_check_nodes_events events).

Definition audit_legacy_no_clobber_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall F N E T CN CF CT OE TE CR CW CD (EN : encoding N) (EF : encoding F) (ET : encoding T)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (function_enc : F -> positive * list CF)
    (site_enc : T -> positive * list CT) (out : N -> list E * list OE)
    (target : E -> N * list TE) (reads : N -> list (footprint T) * list CR)
    (writes : N -> list (footprint T) * list CW) f (g : Graph.t N E)
    (ms : memory_ssa F N) (definitions : N -> option (mem_node F N) * list CD),
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall x, fst (function_enc x) = encode EF x) ->
    (forall t, fst (site_enc t) = encode ET t) ->
    (forall n, fst (out n) = Graph.out g n) ->
    (forall e, fst (target e) = Graph.target g e) ->
    (forall n, fst (definitions n) = def_of_load ms n) ->
    fst (audit_legacy_no_clobber_counted EN EF ET node_enc function_enc site_enc out target reads
      writes f g definitions) =
      no_clobber_check EN EF ET f g (fun n => fst (writes n)) (fun n => fst (reads n)) ms.
```

## AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyOverlap

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyOverlap.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyOverlap`.

```rocq
(** * Legacy half-open footprint overlap

    The legacy checker uses four strict signed comparisons for every pair.
    This observer keeps those operands and the actual site equality execution.
    Builds on: legacy memory certificates and collection primitive observations. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List PArith ZArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding.
From Galois.Domains Require Import DomainsFootprint.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryLegacy.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditCost.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditPrimitive.
Import List.ListNotations.

Inductive audit_legacy_overlap_event (T C : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditLegacyOverlapOuter (remaining : list (footprint T))
  | AuditLegacyOverlapInner (left : footprint T) (remaining : list (footprint T))
  | AuditLegacyOverlapPair (left right : footprint T) (lc rc : positive)
      (le re : list C) (eq : list audit_positive_eqb_event)
      (same nonempty_left nonempty_right left_cross right_cross result : bool).
Arguments AuditLegacyOverlapOuter {T C} _.
Arguments AuditLegacyOverlapInner {T C} _ _.
Arguments AuditLegacyOverlapPair {T C} _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _.

Definition audit_legacy_overlap_pair {T C} (enc : T -> positive * list C)
    (left right : footprint T) : bool * list (audit_legacy_overlap_event T C) :=
  let '(lc, le) := enc (fp_site left) in
  let '(rc, re) := enc (fp_site right) in
  let '(same, eq) := audit_positive_eqb lc rc in
  let nl := Z.ltb (fp_lo left) (fp_hi left) in
  let nr := Z.ltb (fp_lo right) (fp_hi right) in
  let lr := Z.ltb (fp_lo left) (fp_hi right) in
  let rl := Z.ltb (fp_lo right) (fp_hi left) in
  let result := andb (andb (andb (andb same nl) nr) lr) rl in
  (result, [AuditLegacyOverlapPair left right lc rc le re eq same nl nr lr rl result]).

Fixpoint audit_legacy_overlap_inner {T C} (enc : T -> positive * list C)
    (left : footprint T) (right : list (footprint T))
    : bool * list (audit_legacy_overlap_event T C) :=
  match right with
  | [] => (false, [AuditLegacyOverlapInner left right])
  | x :: xs =>
      let '(head, he) := audit_legacy_overlap_pair enc left x in
      let '(tail, te) := audit_legacy_overlap_inner enc left xs in
      (orb head tail, AuditLegacyOverlapInner left right :: he ++ te)
  end.

Fixpoint audit_legacy_overlap_exists {T C} (enc : T -> positive * list C)
    (left right : list (footprint T)) : bool * list (audit_legacy_overlap_event T C) :=
  match left with
  | [] => (false, [AuditLegacyOverlapOuter left])
  | x :: xs =>
      let '(head, he) := audit_legacy_overlap_inner enc x right in
      let '(tail, te) := audit_legacy_overlap_exists enc xs right in
      (orb head tail, AuditLegacyOverlapOuter left :: he ++ te)
  end.
Definition audit_legacy_disjoint {T C} (enc : T -> positive * list C)
    (left right : list (footprint T)) : bool * list (audit_legacy_overlap_event T C) :=
  let '(overlap, events) := audit_legacy_overlap_exists enc left right in (negb overlap, events).

Fixpoint audit_legacy_overlap_pairs {T C} (events : list (audit_legacy_overlap_event T C)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditLegacyOverlapPair _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ :: rest =>
      S (audit_legacy_overlap_pairs rest)
  | _ :: rest => audit_legacy_overlap_pairs rest
  end.

Definition audit_legacy_disjoint_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall T C (enc : T -> positive * list C) (ET : encoding T) left right,
    (forall site, fst (enc site) = encode ET site) ->
    fst (audit_legacy_disjoint enc left right) = legacy_disjoint_b ET left right.
Definition audit_legacy_overlap_pair_count_statement : Prop :=
  forall T C (enc : T -> positive * list C) left right,
    audit_legacy_overlap_pairs (snd (audit_legacy_disjoint enc left right)) =
      length left * length right.

Fixpoint audit_legacy_overlap_source_work {T C} (encoder_work : list C -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_legacy_overlap_event T C)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditLegacyOverlapOuter _ :: rest | AuditLegacyOverlapInner _ _ :: rest =>
      1 + audit_legacy_overlap_source_work encoder_work rest
  | AuditLegacyOverlapPair l r _ _ le re eq _ _ _ _ _ _ :: rest =>
      7 + encoder_work le + encoder_work re + audit_positive_eqb_source_work eq +
      audit_binary_weight (fp_lo l) (fp_hi l) + audit_binary_weight (fp_lo r) (fp_hi r) +
      audit_binary_weight (fp_lo l) (fp_hi r) + audit_binary_weight (fp_lo r) (fp_hi l) +
      audit_legacy_overlap_source_work encoder_work rest
  end.

Fixpoint audit_legacy_overlap_inner_budget {T C} (enc : T -> positive * list C)
    (encoder_work : list C -> nat) (l : footprint T) (rs : list (footprint T)) : nat :=
  match rs with
  | [] => 1
  | r :: rest =>
      8 + encoder_work (snd (enc (fp_site l))) + encoder_work (snd (enc (fp_site r))) +
      2 * Nat.min (Pos.size_nat (fst (enc (fp_site l)))) (Pos.size_nat (fst (enc (fp_site r)))) +
      audit_binary_weight (fp_lo l) (fp_hi l) + audit_binary_weight (fp_lo r) (fp_hi r) +
      audit_binary_weight (fp_lo l) (fp_hi r) + audit_binary_weight (fp_lo r) (fp_hi l) +
      audit_legacy_overlap_inner_budget enc encoder_work l rest
  end.
Fixpoint audit_legacy_overlap_budget {T C} (enc : T -> positive * list C)
    (encoder_work : list C -> nat) (left right : list (footprint T)) : nat :=
  match left with
  | [] => 1
  | l :: rest => 1 + audit_legacy_overlap_inner_budget enc encoder_work l right +
      audit_legacy_overlap_budget enc encoder_work rest right
  end.
Definition audit_legacy_overlap_source_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall T C (enc : T -> positive * list C) encoder_work left right,
    audit_legacy_overlap_source_work encoder_work (snd (audit_legacy_disjoint enc left right)) <=
      audit_legacy_overlap_budget enc encoder_work left right.
```
