## AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyProjectionSource

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyProjectionSource.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyProjectionSource`.

```rocq
(** * Complete legacy producer and checking consumer

    Projection setup is shared by its returned definition closure, which executes full clobbers.
    For example, the outer checker pays the producer's retain slice and then checks the pair again.
    Builds on: full setup, occurrence construction and the independent all-walk checker. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Domains Require Import DomainsFootprint.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryGraph AnalysesMemoryWalk AnalysesMemoryLegacy.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditCallback.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyProposalSource.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacySetupSource.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyChecker.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacySuccessor.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyNoClobber.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyInputBudget.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryClobbersSource.
Import List.ListNotations.

Inductive audit_legacy_projection_event (F N P R : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditLegacyProjectionProposal (body : list P)
  | AuditLegacyProjectionRetainNone
  | AuditLegacyProjectionRetain (candidate : mem_node F N) (accepted : bool) (body : list R).
Arguments AuditLegacyProjectionProposal {F N P R} _.
Arguments AuditLegacyProjectionRetainNone {F N P R}.
Arguments AuditLegacyProjectionRetain {F N P R} _ _ _.

Definition audit_legacy_projection_proposal_event (F N E T CN CE SE XE OE TE FE PE BE LE RE :
  Type) :=
  audit_legacy_source_proposal_event F N E T CN CE XE BE LE RE
    (audit_clobbers_source_run N E T CN CE SE OE TE FE PE BE).

Definition audit_legacy_projection_retain_event (F N T CN CF SE RE WE : Type) :=
  audit_legacy_pair_event F N (N * N) T CN CF SE
    (audit_legacy_successor_event N (N * N) CN) RE WE.

Definition audit_legacy_projection_definition_event
    (F N E T CN CE CF SE XE OE TE FE PE BE LE RE WE : Type) :=
  audit_legacy_projection_event F N
    (audit_legacy_projection_proposal_event F N E T CN CE SE XE OE TE FE PE BE LE RE)
    (audit_legacy_projection_retain_event F N T CN CF SE RE WE).

Section Projection.
  Context {F N E T CN CE CF SE XE OE TE FE PE BE LE RE WE : Type}.
  Context (EN : encoding N) (EF : encoding F) (ET : encoding T).
  Context (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE).
  Context (function_enc : F -> positive * list CF) (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE).
  Context (source : E -> N * list XE) (out : N -> list E * list OE).
  Context (target : E -> N * list TE) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE).
  Context (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list PE).
  Context (before : E -> nat -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE).
  Context (load : N -> option (E * nat) * list LE).
  Context (reads : N -> list (footprint T) * list RE) (writes : N -> list (footprint T) * list WE).
  Context (g : Graph.t N E) (mg : memory_graph N E) (function : F) (fuel : positive).

  Definition audit_legacy_projection_definition_source
      (setup : @audit_legacy_setup_run N E T CN CE OE TE FE EN) (node : N) :=
    let '(proposal, proposal_body) := audit_legacy_occurrence_source EN node_enc edge_enc site_enc
      source out target effects operand before load reads (audit_legacy_setup_listed setup)
      (audit_legacy_setup_reached setup) (audit_legacy_setup_table setup) g mg function fuel node in
    match proposal with
    | None => (None, [AuditLegacyProjectionProposal proposal_body; AuditLegacyProjectionRetainNone])
    | Some candidate =>
        let cfg := audit_legacy_setup_cfg setup in
        let prep := audit_legacy_setup_prepared setup in
        let '(accepted, body) := audit_legacy_pair_check_full EN EF ET node_enc function_enc
          site_enc
          (audit_legacy_successors_counted EN node_enc cfg prep) reads writes cfg prep
          (audit_legacy_setup_reached setup) node candidate function in
        (if accepted then Some candidate else None,
          [AuditLegacyProjectionProposal proposal_body; AuditLegacyProjectionRetain candidate
            accepted body])
    end.

  Definition audit_legacy_projection_source_counted :=
    let setup := audit_legacy_projection_setup EN node_enc edge_enc out target effects g in
    (setup, audit_legacy_projection_definition_source setup).

  Definition audit_legacy_projection_check_source_counted :=
    let '(setup, definitions) := audit_legacy_projection_source_counted in
    let '(accepted, body) := audit_legacy_no_clobber_counted EN EF ET node_enc function_enc site_enc
      out target reads writes function g definitions in
    (accepted, setup, body).
End Projection.

Section Work.
  Context {F N E T CN CE CF SE XE OE TE FE PE BE LE RE WE : Type}.
  Context (EN : encoding N).
  Context (node_work : list CN -> nat) (edge_work : list CE -> nat).
  Context (function_work : list CF -> nat) (site_work : list SE -> nat).
  Context (source_work : list XE -> nat) (out_work : list OE -> nat) (target_work : list TE -> nat).
  Context (effect_work : list FE -> nat) (operand_work : list PE -> nat) (before_work : list BE
    -> nat).
  Context (load_work : list LE -> nat) (read_work : list RE -> nat) (write_work : list WE -> nat).

  Fixpoint audit_legacy_projection_definition_source_work
      (events : list (audit_legacy_projection_definition_event
        F N E T CN CE CF SE XE OE TE FE PE BE LE RE WE)) : nat :=
    match events with
    | [] => 0
    | event :: rest =>
        (2 + match event with
        | AuditLegacyProjectionProposal body => audit_legacy_occurrence_source_work node_work
          edge_work
            source_work before_work load_work read_work
            (audit_memory_clobbers_full_source_work node_work edge_work site_work out_work
              target_work
              effect_work operand_work before_work) body
        | AuditLegacyProjectionRetainNone => 1
        | AuditLegacyProjectionRetain _ _ body => audit_legacy_pair_source_work EN node_work
            function_work site_work (audit_legacy_successor_source_work node_work) read_work
              write_work body
        end) + audit_legacy_projection_definition_source_work rest
    end.

  Definition audit_legacy_projection_check_source_work
      (pipeline : bool * @audit_legacy_setup_run N E T CN CE OE TE FE EN *
        audit_legacy_no_clobber_events F N E T CN CF SE OE TE RE WE
          (audit_legacy_projection_definition_event F N E T CN CE CF SE XE OE TE FE PE BE LE RE
            WE)) : nat :=
    let '(_, setup, body) := pipeline in
    audit_legacy_setup_source_work EN node_work edge_work out_work target_work effect_work setup +

End Work.
```

## AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyProposalSource

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

```rocq
(** * Legacy proposal with complete clobber construction

    Each accepted read occurrence executes the whole original prepared clobber query.
    For example, a table miss skips before, whereas a valid read builds all adjacency rows.
    Builds on: strict legacy guards, full clobbers and the original occurrence proposal. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Domains Require Import DomainsFootprint.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryGraph AnalysesMemoryWalk AnalysesMemoryLegacy.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditMap.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyGuard.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryClobbersSource.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryInputBudget.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryWalkIndex.
Import List.ListNotations.

Inductive audit_legacy_source_proposal_event (F N E T CN CE XE BE LE RE CP : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditLegacySourceLoad (node : N) (result : option (E * nat)) (body : list LE)
  | AuditLegacySourceGuard (body : list (audit_legacy_guard_event N E CN CE XE))
  | AuditLegacySourceEffect (body : list (audit_memory_effect_get_event E T CE))
  | AuditLegacySourceBefore (edge : E) (index : nat)
      (result : option (memory_version N E)) (body : list BE)
  | AuditLegacySourceReadTest (effect : memory_effect T) (result : bool)
  | AuditLegacySourceReads (node : N) (footprints : list (footprint T)) (body : list RE)
  | AuditLegacySourceClobbers (result : memory_clobber_result N E) (body : CP)
  | AuditLegacySourceSource (edge : E) (node : N) (body : list XE)
  | AuditLegacySourceReturn (result : option (mem_node F N)).
Arguments AuditLegacySourceLoad {F N E T CN CE XE BE LE RE CP} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditLegacySourceGuard {F N E T CN CE XE BE LE RE CP} _.
Arguments AuditLegacySourceEffect {F N E T CN CE XE BE LE RE CP} _.
Arguments AuditLegacySourceBefore {F N E T CN CE XE BE LE RE CP} _ _ _ _.
Arguments AuditLegacySourceReadTest {F N E T CN CE XE BE LE RE CP} _ _.
Arguments AuditLegacySourceReads {F N E T CN CE XE BE LE RE CP} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditLegacySourceClobbers {F N E T CN CE XE BE LE RE CP} _ _.
Arguments AuditLegacySourceSource {F N E T CN CE XE BE LE RE CP} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditLegacySourceReturn {F N E T CN CE XE BE LE RE CP} _.

Definition audit_legacy_finish_proposal {F N E T CN CE XE BE LE RE CP}
    (source : E -> N * list XE) (function : F) (clobber : memory_clobber_result N E) :
    option (mem_node F N) * list (audit_legacy_source_proposal_event F N E T CN CE XE BE LE RE
      CP) :=
  match clobber_roots clobber with
  | [MemoryLive] => (Some (MLive function), [AuditLegacySourceReturn (Some (MLive function))])
  | [MemoryDef edge _] =>
      let '(node, body) := source edge in
      let candidate := Some (MDef function node) in
      (candidate, [AuditLegacySourceSource edge node body; AuditLegacySourceReturn candidate])
  | _ => (None, [AuditLegacySourceReturn None])
  end.

Definition audit_legacy_occurrence_source_with {F N E T CN CE XE BE LE RE CP}
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
    (source : E -> N * list XE) (listed : FinSet.t E) (reached : FinSet.t N)
    (table : Map.t E (Map.t nat (memory_effect T)))
    (before : E -> nat -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE)
    (load : N -> option (E * nat) * list LE) (reads : N -> list (footprint T) * list RE)
    (clobbers : memory_scope T -> memory_version N E -> positive -> memory_clobber_result N E * CP)
    (function : F) (fuel : positive) (node : N) :=
  let '(occurrence, load_body) := load node in
  let load_event := AuditLegacySourceLoad node occurrence load_body in
  match occurrence with
  | None => (None, [load_event; AuditLegacySourceReturn None])
  | Some (edge, index) =>
      let '(guard, guard_body) := audit_legacy_guard node_enc edge_enc source reached listed
        edge node in
      let prefix := [load_event; AuditLegacySourceGuard guard_body] in
      if guard then
        let '(effect, effect_body) := audit_memory_effect_get edge_enc table edge index in
        let prefix := prefix ++ [AuditLegacySourceEffect effect_body] in
        match effect with
        | None => (None, prefix ++ [AuditLegacySourceReturn None])
        | Some actual =>
            let '(input, before_body) := before edge index in
            let prefix := prefix ++ [AuditLegacySourceBefore edge index input before_body] in
            match input with
            | None => (None, prefix ++ [AuditLegacySourceReturn None])
            | Some start =>
                let has_read := memory_effect_has_read actual in
                let prefix := prefix ++ [AuditLegacySourceReadTest actual has_read] in
                if has_read then
                  let '(footprints, read_body) := reads node in
                  let '(clobber, clobber_body) := clobbers (MemoryRegions footprints) start fuel in
                  let '(answer, finish_body) := audit_legacy_finish_proposal source function
                    clobber in
                  (answer, prefix ++ [AuditLegacySourceReads node footprints read_body;
                    AuditLegacySourceClobbers clobber clobber_body] ++ finish_body)
                else (None, prefix ++ [AuditLegacySourceReturn None])
            end
        end
      else (None, prefix ++ [AuditLegacySourceReturn None])
  end.

Fixpoint audit_legacy_occurrence_source_work {F N E T CN CE XE BE LE RE CP}
    (node_work : list CN -> nat) (edge_work : list CE -> nat) (source_work : list XE -> nat)
    (before_work : list BE -> nat) (load_work : list LE -> nat) (read_work : list RE -> nat)
    (clobber_work : CP -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_legacy_source_proposal_event F N E T CN CE XE BE LE RE CP)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | event :: rest =>
      (2 + match event with
      | AuditLegacySourceLoad _ _ body => load_work body
      | AuditLegacySourceGuard body => audit_legacy_guard_source_work node_work edge_work
        source_work body
      | AuditLegacySourceEffect body => audit_memory_effect_get_work edge_work body
      | AuditLegacySourceBefore _ _ _ body => before_work body
      | AuditLegacySourceReadTest _ _ => 1
      | AuditLegacySourceReads _ _ body => read_work body
      | AuditLegacySourceClobbers _ body => clobber_work body
      | AuditLegacySourceSource _ _ body => source_work body
      | AuditLegacySourceReturn _ => 1
      end) + audit_legacy_occurrence_source_work node_work edge_work source_work before_work
        load_work read_work clobber_work rest
  end.

Definition audit_legacy_full_clobbers {N E T CN CE SE OE TE FE PE BE}
    (EN : encoding N) (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE)
    (out : N -> list E * list OE) (target : E -> N * list TE)
    (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE)
    (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list PE)
    (before : E -> nat -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE)
    (g : Graph.t N E) (mg : memory_graph N E) scope start fuel :=
  let run := audit_memory_clobbers_source_counted EN node_enc edge_enc site_enc out target effects
    operand before g mg scope start fuel in
  (audit_clobbers_source_result run, run).

Definition audit_legacy_occurrence_source {F N E T CN CE SE XE OE TE FE PE BE LE RE}
    (EN : encoding N) (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE)
    (source : E -> N * list XE) (out : N -> list E * list OE) (target : E -> N * list TE)
    (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE)
    (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list PE)
    (before : E -> nat -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE)
    (load : N -> option (E * nat) * list LE) (reads : N -> list (footprint T) * list RE)
    listed reached table (g : Graph.t N E) (mg : memory_graph N E) (function : F) fuel node :=
  audit_legacy_occurrence_source_with node_enc edge_enc source listed reached table before load
    reads
    (audit_legacy_full_clobbers EN node_enc edge_enc site_enc out target effects operand before
      g mg)
    function fuel node.

(** The fixed full occurrence model erases to the original producer with no opaque next adapter. *)
Definition audit_legacy_occurrence_source_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall F N E T CN CE SE XE OE TE FE PE BE LE RE (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
      (ET : encoding T) (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
      (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE)
      (source : E -> N * list XE) (out : N -> list E * list OE) (target : E -> N * list TE)

      (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list PE)

      (load : N -> option (E * nat) * list LE) (reads : N -> list (footprint T) * list RE)
      listed reached table (g : Graph.t N E) (mg : memory_graph N E) (function : F) fuel node,
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall e, fst (edge_enc e) = encode EE e) ->
    (forall t, fst (site_enc t) = encode ET t) ->
    (forall e, fst (source e) = Graph.source g e) ->
    (forall n, fst (out n) = Graph.out g n) ->
    (forall e, fst (target e) = Graph.target g e) ->
    (forall n key, fst (operand n key) = memory_operand mg n key) ->
    (forall e i, fst (before e i) = memory_before mg e i) ->
    fst (audit_legacy_occurrence_source EN node_enc edge_enc site_enc source out target effects
      operand before load reads listed reached table g mg function fuel node) =
    legacy_occurrence_proposal EN EE ET function g (fun e => fst (effects e)) mg listed reached
      table (fun n => fst (reads n)) (fun n => fst (load n)) fuel node.

Definition audit_legacy_guard_input_budget {N E CN CE XE}
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
    (source : E -> N * list XE) (node_budget : N -> nat) (edge_budget source_budget : E -> nat)
    (edge : E) (node : N) : nat :=
  let origin := fst (source edge) in
  26 + 2 * source_budget edge + 2 * node_budget origin + node_budget node + edge_budget edge +
  2 * Nat.min (Pos.size_nat (fst (node_enc origin))) (Pos.size_nat (fst (node_enc node))) +
  5 * Pos.size_nat (fst (node_enc origin)) + 5 * Pos.size_nat (fst (edge_enc edge)).

Definition audit_legacy_occurrence_with_input_budget {F N E T CN CE XE BE LE RE CP}
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
    (source : E -> N * list XE) (listed : FinSet.t E) (reached : FinSet.t N)
    (table : Map.t E (Map.t nat (memory_effect T)))
    (before : E -> nat -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE)
    (load : N -> option (E * nat) * list LE) (reads : N -> list (footprint T) * list RE)
    (clobbers : memory_scope T -> memory_version N E -> positive -> memory_clobber_result N E * CP)
    (node_budget load_budget read_budget : N -> nat) (edge_budget source_budget : E -> nat)
    (before_budget : E -> nat -> nat)
    (clobber_budget : memory_scope T -> memory_version N E -> positive -> nat)
    (function : F) fuel node : nat :=
  30 + load_budget node +
  match fst (load node) with
  | None => 0
  | Some (edge, index) =>
      audit_legacy_guard_input_budget node_enc edge_enc source node_budget edge_budget source_budget
        edge node +
      if fst (audit_legacy_guard node_enc edge_enc source reached listed edge node) then
        audit_memory_effect_get_input_budget edge_enc edge_budget table edge index +
        match fst (audit_memory_effect_get edge_enc table edge index) with
        | None => 0
        | Some actual => before_budget edge index +
            match fst (before edge index) with
            | None => 0
            | Some start =>
                if memory_effect_has_read actual then
                  let scope := MemoryRegions (fst (reads node)) in
                  let result := fst (clobbers scope start fuel) in
                  read_budget node + clobber_budget scope start fuel +
                  match clobber_roots result with
                  | [MemoryDef source_edge _] => source_budget source_edge
                  | _ => 0
                  end
                else 0
            end
        end
      else 0
  end.

(** Full occurrence work closes its concrete entire clobber body at the same scope and start. *)
Definition audit_legacy_occurrence_whole_input_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall F N E T CN CE SE XE OE TE FE PE BE LE RE (EN : encoding N)
      (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
      (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE) (source : E -> N * list XE)
      (out : N -> list E * list OE) (target : E -> N * list TE)
      (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE)
      (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list PE)
      (before : E -> nat -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE)
      (load : N -> option (E * nat) * list LE) (reads : N -> list (footprint T) * list RE)
      node_work edge_work site_work source_work out_work target_work effect_work operand_work
      before_work load_work read_work node_budget edge_budget site_budget source_budget out_budget
      target_budget effect_budget operand_budget before_budget load_budget read_budget
      listed reached table (g : Graph.t N E) (mg : memory_graph N E) (function : F) fuel node,
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall n, fst (out n) = Graph.out g n) ->
    (forall e, fst (target e) = Graph.target g e) ->
    (forall n, node_work (snd (node_enc n)) <= node_budget n) ->
    (forall e, edge_work (snd (edge_enc e)) <= edge_budget e) ->
    (forall t, site_work (snd (site_enc t)) <= site_budget t) ->
    (forall e, source_work (snd (source e)) <= source_budget e) ->
    (forall n, out_work (snd (out n)) <= out_budget n) ->
    (forall e, target_work (snd (target e)) <= target_budget e) ->
    (forall e, effect_work (snd (effects e)) <= effect_budget e) ->
    (forall n key, operand_work (snd (operand n key)) <= operand_budget n key) ->
    (forall e i, before_work (snd (before e i)) <= before_budget e i) ->
    (forall n, load_work (snd (load n)) <= load_budget n) ->
    (forall n, read_work (snd (reads n)) <= read_budget n) ->
    audit_legacy_occurrence_source_work node_work edge_work source_work before_work load_work
      read_work
      (audit_memory_clobbers_full_source_work node_work edge_work site_work out_work target_work
        effect_work operand_work before_work)
      (snd (audit_legacy_occurrence_source EN node_enc edge_enc site_enc source out target effects
        operand before load reads listed reached table g mg function fuel node)) <=
    audit_legacy_occurrence_with_input_budget node_enc edge_enc source listed reached table before
      load reads (audit_legacy_full_clobbers EN node_enc edge_enc site_enc out target effects
        operand
        before g mg) node_budget load_budget read_budget edge_budget source_budget before_budget
      (audit_memory_clobbers_whole_input_budget EN node_enc edge_enc site_enc out target effects
        operand before node_budget out_budget edge_budget effect_budget target_budget site_budget
        operand_budget before_budget g mg) function fuel node.
```

```rocq
(** * Complete legacy projection preparation

    The normalized graph, its reachability, listed original edges and effects are built once.
    For example, a projection with no queried loads still pays every listed setup phase.
    Builds on: complete normalized graph preparation and original effect-table construction. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare GraphDfs GraphAuditBase GraphAuditDfs.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsMemoryEffects ViewsGraph.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryGraph AnalysesMemoryFrontier
  AnalysesMemoryLegacy AnalysesMemoryWalk.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditMap.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditFinSet.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyCfg.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacySliceFull.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyNoClobber.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyInputBudget.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryIndex.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryTable.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemorySharedBudget.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryWalkIndex.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryGraphCallbacks.
Import List.ListNotations.

Record audit_legacy_setup_run {N E T CN CE OE TE FE} (EN : encoding N) : Type :=
  AuditLegacySetupRun {
    audit_legacy_setup_cfg : Graph.t N (N * N);
    audit_legacy_setup_prepared : prepared EN audit_legacy_setup_cfg;
    audit_legacy_setup_reached : FinSet.t N;
    audit_legacy_setup_listed : FinSet.t E;
    audit_legacy_setup_table : Map.t E (Map.t nat (memory_effect T));
    audit_legacy_setup_cfg_events : list (audit_memory_index_event N (list (N * N)) CN
      (audit_legacy_cfg_event N E CN OE TE));
    audit_legacy_setup_prepare_events : list (audit_prepare_source_event N (N * N)
      (audit_snapshot_graph_body CN (audit_map_event N (list (N * N)) CN) unit));
    audit_legacy_setup_reached_events : list (audit_dfs_nested_event N (N * N)
      (audit_graph_callback_capture N (N * N) (list CN)));
    audit_legacy_setup_edges_events : list (audit_memory_edges_event N E OE);
    audit_legacy_setup_listed_events : list (audit_set_event E CE);
    audit_legacy_setup_table_events : list (audit_memory_table_event N E T CE OE FE)
  }.
Arguments AuditLegacySetupRun {N E T CN CE OE TE FE EN} _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _.
Arguments audit_legacy_setup_cfg {N E T CN CE OE TE FE EN} _.
Arguments audit_legacy_setup_prepared {N E T CN CE OE TE FE EN} _.
Arguments audit_legacy_setup_reached {N E T CN CE OE TE FE EN} _.
Arguments audit_legacy_setup_listed {N E T CN CE OE TE FE EN} _.
Arguments audit_legacy_setup_table {N E T CN CE OE TE FE EN} _.
Arguments audit_legacy_setup_cfg_events {N E T CN CE OE TE FE EN} _.
Arguments audit_legacy_setup_prepare_events {N E T CN CE OE TE FE EN} _.
Arguments audit_legacy_setup_reached_events {N E T CN CE OE TE FE EN} _.
Arguments audit_legacy_setup_edges_events {N E T CN CE OE TE FE EN} _.
Arguments audit_legacy_setup_listed_events {N E T CN CE OE TE FE EN} _.
Arguments audit_legacy_setup_table_events {N E T CN CE OE TE FE EN} _.

Definition audit_legacy_projection_setup {N E T CN CE OE TE FE} (EN : encoding N)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
    (out : N -> list E * list OE) (target : E -> N * list TE)
    (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE) (g : Graph.t N E) :=
  let '(rows, cfg_events) := audit_legacy_cfg_rows EN node_enc out target (Graph.nodes g) in
  let cfg := Graph.Make (Graph.entries g) (Graph.nodes g) (index_edges EN rows) fst snd in
  let '(prep, prepare_events) := audit_prepare_source_counted EN cfg
    (audit_legacy_prepare_callbacks node_enc rows) in
  let '(reached, reached_events) := audit_legacy_reached_counted EN node_enc cfg prep
    (Graph.entries cfg) in
  let '(edges, edge_events) := audit_memory_edges out (Graph.nodes g) in
  let '(listed, listed_events) := audit_finset_of_list edge_enc edges in
  let '(table, table_events) := audit_memory_effect_table edge_enc out effects (Graph.nodes g) in
  AuditLegacySetupRun cfg prep reached listed table cfg_events prepare_events reached_events
    edge_events listed_events table_events.

Definition audit_legacy_setup_source_work {N E T CN CE OE TE FE} (EN : encoding N)
    (node_work : list CN -> nat) (edge_work : list CE -> nat) (out_work : list OE -> nat)
    (target_work : list TE -> nat) (effect_work : list FE -> nat)
    (run : @audit_legacy_setup_run N E T CN CE OE TE FE EN) : nat :=
  6 + audit_legacy_cfg_source_work node_work out_work target_work (audit_legacy_setup_cfg_events
    run) +
  audit_prepare_source_work
    (audit_snapshot_graph_body_work node_work (audit_map_source_work node_work) (@length unit))
    (audit_legacy_setup_prepare_events run) +
  audit_dfs_source_work node_work (audit_legacy_setup_reached_events run) +
  audit_memory_edges_work out_work (audit_legacy_setup_edges_events run) +
  audit_finset_source_work edge_work (audit_legacy_setup_listed_events run) +
  audit_memory_table_work edge_work out_work effect_work (audit_legacy_setup_table_events run).

Fixpoint audit_legacy_listed_input_budget {E CE} (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
    (edge_budget : E -> nat) (edges : list E) : nat :=
  match edges with
  | [] => 1
  | edge :: rest => 3 + edge_budget edge + 16 * Pos.size_nat (fst (edge_enc edge)) +
      audit_legacy_listed_input_budget edge_enc edge_budget rest
  end.

Definition audit_legacy_setup_input_budget {N E T CN CE OE TE FE} (EN : encoding N)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
    (out : N -> list E * list OE) (target : E -> N * list TE)
    (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE)
    (node_budget out_budget : N -> nat) (edge_budget target_budget effect_budget : E -> nat)
    (g : Graph.t N E) : nat :=
  let rows := fst (audit_legacy_cfg_rows EN node_enc out target (Graph.nodes g)) in
  let cfg := Graph.Make (Graph.entries g) (Graph.nodes g) (index_edges EN rows) fst snd in
  let prep := prepare EN cfg in
  let edges := fst (audit_memory_edges out (Graph.nodes g)) in
  6 + audit_legacy_cfg_input_budget node_enc out target node_budget out_budget target_budget
    (Graph.nodes g) + audit_prepare_source_budget EN cfg +
  audit_graph_prepare_full_event_bound cfg *
    audit_snapshot_graph_input_budget (audit_walk_predecessors node_enc rows)
      (fun edge : N * N => (snd edge, @nil unit)) node_budget
      (audit_walk_predecessor_input_budget node_enc node_budget) (fun _ => 1) (Graph.nodes cfg) +
  audit_legacy_dfs_input_budget EN cfg prep node_budget (Graph.entries cfg) +
  audit_memory_edges_input_budget out out_budget (Graph.nodes g) +
  audit_legacy_listed_input_budget edge_enc edge_budget edges +
  audit_memory_table_input_budget edge_enc out effects edge_budget out_budget effect_budget
    (Graph.nodes g).

(** Projection setup produces the actual normalized graph and both original edge indexes. *)
Definition audit_legacy_projection_setup_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CN CE OE TE FE (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
      (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
      (out : N -> list E * list OE) (target : E -> N * list TE)
      (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE) (g : Graph.t N E),
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall e, fst (edge_enc e) = encode EE e) ->
    (forall n, fst (out n) = Graph.out g n) ->
    (forall e, fst (target e) = Graph.target g e) ->
    let run := audit_legacy_projection_setup EN node_enc edge_enc out target effects g in
    audit_legacy_setup_cfg run = legacy_cfg EN g /\
    audit_legacy_setup_reached run = legacy_reached (prepare EN (legacy_cfg EN g))
      (Graph.entries g) /\
    audit_legacy_setup_listed run = FinSet.of_list EE (edges_of g) /\
    audit_legacy_setup_table run = memory_walk_effect_table EE g (fun e => fst (effects e)) /\
    out_index (audit_legacy_setup_prepared run) = out_index (prepare EN (legacy_cfg EN g)) /\
    in_index (audit_legacy_setup_prepared run) = in_index (prepare EN (legacy_cfg EN g)) /\
    fuel (audit_legacy_setup_prepared run) = fuel (prepare EN (legacy_cfg EN g)) /\
    (forall n, succ_edges (audit_legacy_setup_prepared run) n =
      succ_edges (prepare EN (legacy_cfg EN g)) n).

(** All setup costs are input-derived and assume only the actual external bodies' own bounds. *)
Definition audit_legacy_setup_whole_input_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CN CE OE TE FE (EN : encoding N)
      (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
      (out : N -> list E * list OE) (target : E -> N * list TE)
      (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE)
      node_work edge_work out_work target_work effect_work
      node_budget edge_budget out_budget target_budget effect_budget (g : Graph.t N E),
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall n, node_work (snd (node_enc n)) <= node_budget n) ->
    (forall e, edge_work (snd (edge_enc e)) <= edge_budget e) ->
    (forall n, out_work (snd (out n)) <= out_budget n) ->
    (forall e, target_work (snd (target e)) <= target_budget e) ->
    (forall e, effect_work (snd (effects e)) <= effect_budget e) ->
    audit_legacy_setup_source_work EN node_work edge_work out_work target_work effect_work
      (audit_legacy_projection_setup EN node_enc edge_enc out target effects g) <=
    audit_legacy_setup_input_budget EN node_enc edge_enc out target effects node_budget out_budget
      edge_budget target_budget effect_budget g.
```

## AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacySlice

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacySlice.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacySlice`.

```rocq
(** * Legacy slice node traversal

    Both membership lookups occur at every listed node, including a false first lookup.
    Footprint testing occurs exactly when both memberships hold, and forallb visits the tail.
    Builds on: the actual legacy overlap and finite-set source observers. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List PArith Bool.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Domains Require Import DomainsFootprint.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryLegacy.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditFinSet.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyOverlap.
Import List.ListNotations.
Open Scope bool_scope.

Inductive audit_legacy_slice_event (N T CN CT W : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditLegacySliceNode (node : N) (forward backward : bool)
      (first second : list (audit_set_event N CN))
  | AuditLegacySliceWrite (node : N) (writes : list (footprint T)) (calls : list W)
      (disjoint : bool) (checks : list (audit_legacy_overlap_event T CT)).
Arguments AuditLegacySliceNode {N T CN CT W} _ _ _ _ _.
Arguments AuditLegacySliceWrite {N T CN CT W} _ _ _ _ _.

Fixpoint audit_legacy_slice_nodes {N T CN CT W} (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (site_enc : T -> positive * list CT) (writes : N -> list (footprint T) * list W)
    (read : list (footprint T)) (forward backward : FinSet.t N) (nodes : list N)
    : bool * list (audit_legacy_slice_event N T CN CT W) :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => (true, [])
  | n :: rest =>
      let '(f, fe) := audit_finset_mem node_enc n forward in
      let '(b, be) := audit_finset_mem node_enc n backward in
      let '(head, extra) := if andb f b then
          let '(footprints, we) := writes n in
          let '(answer, de) := audit_legacy_disjoint site_enc footprints read in
          (answer, [AuditLegacySliceWrite n footprints we answer de])
        else (true, []) in
      let '(tail, te) := audit_legacy_slice_nodes node_enc site_enc writes read
        forward backward rest in
      (andb head tail, AuditLegacySliceNode n f b fe be :: extra ++ te)
  end.

Definition audit_legacy_slice_nodes_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall N T CN CT W (EN : encoding N) (ET : encoding T)
      (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (site_enc : T -> positive * list CT)
      (writes : N -> list (footprint T) * list W) read forward backward nodes,
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall t, fst (site_enc t) = encode ET t) ->
    fst (audit_legacy_slice_nodes node_enc site_enc writes read forward backward nodes) =
      forallb (fun n => if FinSet.mem EN n forward && FinSet.mem EN n backward
        then legacy_disjoint_b ET (fst (writes n)) read else true) nodes.

Fixpoint audit_legacy_slice_source_work {N T CN CT W} (node_work : list CN -> nat)
    (site_work : list CT -> nat) (writes_work : list W -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_legacy_slice_event N T CN CT W)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditLegacySliceNode _ _ _ fe be :: rest =>
      4 + audit_finset_source_work node_work fe + audit_finset_source_work node_work be +
      audit_legacy_slice_source_work node_work site_work writes_work rest
  | AuditLegacySliceWrite _ _ we _ de :: rest =>
      2 + writes_work we + audit_legacy_overlap_source_work site_work de +
      audit_legacy_slice_source_work node_work site_work writes_work rest
  end.

(** The budget uses each actual input node and the original membership decision. *)
Fixpoint audit_legacy_slice_budget {N T CN CT W} (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (site_enc : T -> positive * list CT) (writes : N -> list (footprint T) * list W)
    (node_work : list CN -> nat) (site_work : list CT -> nat) (writes_work : list W -> nat)
    (read : list (footprint T)) (forward backward : FinSet.t N) (nodes : list N) : nat :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => 0
  | n :: rest =>
      let '(f, fe) := audit_finset_mem node_enc n forward in
      let '(b, be) := audit_finset_mem node_enc n backward in
      4 + audit_finset_source_work node_work fe + audit_finset_source_work node_work be +
      (if andb f b then
        2 + writes_work (snd (writes n)) +
          audit_legacy_overlap_budget site_enc site_work (fst (writes n)) read
       else 0) +
      audit_legacy_slice_budget node_enc site_enc writes node_work site_work writes_work
        read forward backward rest
  end.
Definition audit_legacy_slice_nodes_source_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall N T CN CT W (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (site_enc : T -> positive * list CT)
      (writes : N -> list (footprint T) * list W) node_work site_work writes_work
      read forward backward nodes,
    audit_legacy_slice_source_work node_work site_work writes_work
      (snd (audit_legacy_slice_nodes node_enc site_enc writes read forward backward nodes)) <=
      audit_legacy_slice_budget node_enc site_enc writes node_work site_work writes_work
        read forward backward nodes.
```

```rocq
(** * Full counted legacy forward/reverse slice

    This adapter executes the two actual DFS walks used by [legacy_slice], then
    feeds their returned visited sets into every actual graph-node membership and
    footprint-overlap check. Reverse preparation is the library's exact index swap. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare GraphDfs.
From Galois.Domains Require Import DomainsFootprint.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryLegacy.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditFinSet.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditPrimitive.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacySlice.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryLegacyOverlap.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphAuditBase.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphAuditDfs.
Import List.ListNotations.

Definition audit_legacy_dfs_callbacks {N E CN} (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (g : Graph.t N E) : audit_dfs_callback_model N E (list CN) :=
  @AuditDfsCallbackModel N E (list CN)
    (fun edge => (Graph.target g edge, []))
    (fun n => let '(code, trace) := node_enc n in (code, [trace])).

Definition audit_legacy_reached_counted {N E CN} (EN : encoding N)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (g : Graph.t N E) (p : prepared EN g) (roots : list N)
    : FinSet.t N * list (audit_dfs_nested_event N E (audit_graph_callback_capture N E (list CN))) :=
  let '(result, events) := audit_dfs_source_counted p (audit_legacy_dfs_callbacks node_enc g)
    FinSet.empty roots in
  (visited result, events).

Record audit_legacy_slice_full_events (N E T CN CT W : Type) : Type :=
  AuditLegacySliceFullEvents {
    audit_legacy_slice_forward_dfs : list (audit_dfs_nested_event N E
      (audit_graph_callback_capture N E (list CN)));
    audit_legacy_slice_reverse_dfs : list (audit_dfs_nested_event N E
      (audit_graph_callback_capture N E (list CN)));
    audit_legacy_slice_node_checks : list (audit_legacy_slice_event N T CN CT W)
  }.
Arguments AuditLegacySliceFullEvents {N E T CN CT W} _ _ _.
Arguments audit_legacy_slice_forward_dfs {N E T CN CT W} _.
Arguments audit_legacy_slice_reverse_dfs {N E T CN CT W} _.
Arguments audit_legacy_slice_node_checks {N E T CN CT W} _.

Definition audit_legacy_slice_full {N E T CN CT W} (EN : encoding N) (ET : encoding T)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (site_enc : T -> positive * list CT)
    (g : Graph.t N E) (p : prepared EN g)
    (writes : N -> list (footprint T) * list W) (read : list (footprint T))
    (roots : list N) (load : N)
    : bool * audit_legacy_slice_full_events N E T CN CT W :=
  let '(forward, forward_events) := audit_legacy_reached_counted EN node_enc g p roots in
  let reverse_graph := reverse_graph p [load] in
  let reverse_prep := prepared_reverse p [load] in
  let '(backward, backward_events) := audit_legacy_reached_counted EN node_enc reverse_graph
    reverse_prep [load] in
  let '(answer, node_events) := audit_legacy_slice_nodes node_enc site_enc writes read
    forward backward (Graph.nodes g) in
  (answer, AuditLegacySliceFullEvents forward_events backward_events node_events).

Definition audit_legacy_slice_full_source_work {N E T CN CT W} (EN : encoding N)
    (node_work : list CN -> nat) (site_work : list CT -> nat) (writes_work : list W -> nat)
    (events : audit_legacy_slice_full_events N E T CN CT W) : nat :=
  audit_dfs_source_work node_work (audit_legacy_slice_forward_dfs events) +
  audit_dfs_source_work node_work (audit_legacy_slice_reverse_dfs events) +
  audit_legacy_slice_source_work node_work site_work writes_work (audit_legacy_slice_node_checks
    events).

Definition audit_legacy_slice_full_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CN CT W (EN : encoding N) (ET : encoding T)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (site_enc : T -> positive * list CT)
    (g : Graph.t N E) (p : prepared EN g)
    (writes : N -> list (footprint T) * list W) (read : list (footprint T)) roots load,
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall t, fst (site_enc t) = encode ET t) ->
    fst (audit_legacy_slice_full EN ET node_enc site_enc g p writes read roots load) =
      legacy_slice EN ET g p (fun n => fst (writes n)) read roots load.

Definition audit_legacy_slice_full_trace_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CN CT W (EN : encoding N) (ET : encoding T)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (site_enc : T -> positive * list CT)
    (g : Graph.t N E) (p : prepared EN g)
    (writes : N -> list (footprint T) * list W) read roots load node_work site_work writes_work,
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    let events := snd (audit_legacy_slice_full EN ET node_enc site_enc g p writes read roots load)
      in
    audit_legacy_slice_full_source_work EN node_work site_work writes_work events <=
      audit_dfs_source_budget EN g p roots + audit_dfs_source_body_work node_work
        (audit_legacy_slice_forward_dfs events) +
      audit_dfs_source_budget EN (reverse_graph p [load]) (prepared_reverse p [load]) [load] +
      audit_dfs_source_body_work node_work (audit_legacy_slice_reverse_dfs events) +
      audit_legacy_slice_budget node_enc site_enc writes node_work site_work writes_work
        read (visited (dfs p FinSet.empty roots))
        (visited (dfs (prepared_reverse p [load]) FinSet.empty [load])) (Graph.nodes g).
```

```rocq
(** * Counted legacy successor enumeration

    The definition-side roots are every indexed outgoing edge target in stored order.
    This observer retains the actual map lookup and maps each parallel edge separately. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryLegacy.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditMap.
Import List.ListNotations.

Inductive audit_legacy_successor_event (N E CN : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditLegacySuccessorLookup (calls : list (audit_map_event N (list E) CN))
  | AuditLegacySuccessorMapCase (remaining : list E)
  | AuditLegacySuccessorTarget (edge : E) (target : N).
Arguments AuditLegacySuccessorLookup {N E CN} _.
Arguments AuditLegacySuccessorMapCase {N E CN} _.
Arguments AuditLegacySuccessorTarget {N E CN} _ _.

Fixpoint audit_legacy_successor_map {N E CN} (g : Graph.t N E) (edges : list E)
    : list N * list (audit_legacy_successor_event N E CN) :=
  match edges with
  | [] => ([], [])
  | edge :: rest =>
      let target := Graph.target g edge in
      let '(tail, events) := audit_legacy_successor_map g rest in
      (target :: tail, [AuditLegacySuccessorMapCase edges; AuditLegacySuccessorTarget edge target]
        ++ events)
  end.

Definition audit_legacy_successors_counted {N E CN} (EN : encoding N)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (g : Graph.t N E) (p : prepared EN g) (node : N)
    : list N * list (audit_legacy_successor_event N E CN) :=
  let '(found, calls) := audit_map_get node_enc node (out_index p) in
  let edges := match found with Some xs => xs | None => [] end in
  let '(result, events) := audit_legacy_successor_map g edges in
  (result, AuditLegacySuccessorLookup calls :: events).

Fixpoint audit_legacy_successor_source_work {N E CN} (node_work : list CN -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_legacy_successor_event N E CN)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditLegacySuccessorLookup calls :: rest => 2 + audit_map_source_work node_work calls +
      audit_legacy_successor_source_work node_work rest
  | AuditLegacySuccessorMapCase _ :: rest => 2 + audit_legacy_successor_source_work node_work rest
  | AuditLegacySuccessorTarget _ _ :: rest => 2 + audit_legacy_successor_source_work node_work rest
  end.

Definition audit_legacy_successors_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E CN (EN : encoding N) (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (g : Graph.t N E) (p : prepared EN g) node,
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    fst (audit_legacy_successors_counted EN node_enc g p node) = legacy_successors EN g p node.
```

## AnalysesAuditMemoryMemo

`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemoryMemo.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemoryMemo`.

```rocq
(** * Source-shaped memoized memory walk

    These rules retain actual probes, cut branches, child runs, unions and persistent writes.
    For example, a completed hit returns its saved roots without expanding successors.
    Builds on: G4 memory semantics and shared collection observers. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List NArith PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryGraph AnalysesMemoryFlow AnalysesMemoryWalk.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryState.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryEncoding.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditMap.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditFinSet.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditElements.
Import List.ListNotations.

Inductive audit_memo_event (N E CV CK NE : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditMemoActive (v : memory_version N E) (result : bool)
      (calls : list (audit_set_event (memory_version N E) CV))
  | AuditMemoLookup (v : memory_version N E) (result : option (memo_entry N E))
      (calls : list (audit_map_event (positive * memory_version N E) (memo_entry N E) CK))
  | AuditMemoExpand (v : memory_version N E) (successors : list (memory_version N E))
      (calls : list NE)
  | AuditMemoAddActive (v : memory_version N E)
      (calls : list (audit_set_event (memory_version N E) CV))
  | AuditMemoStore (v : memory_version N E) (roots : list (memory_version N E))
      (calls : list (audit_map_event (positive * memory_version N E) (memo_entry N E) CK))
  | AuditMemoUnion (left right output : list (memory_version N E))
      (build : list (audit_set_event (memory_version N E) CV))
      (enumerate : list (audit_set_elements_event (memory_version N E))).

Arguments AuditMemoActive {N E CV CK NE} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditMemoLookup {N E CV CK NE} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditMemoExpand {N E CV CK NE} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditMemoAddActive {N E CV CK NE} _ _.
Arguments AuditMemoStore {N E CV CK NE} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditMemoUnion {N E CV CK NE} _ _ _ _ _.

(** The union executes the actual set construction and enumeration on the same intermediate set. *)
Definition audit_memo_union {N E CV} (enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
    (left right : list (memory_version N E))
    : list (memory_version N E) *
      (list (audit_set_event (memory_version N E) CV) *
       list (audit_set_elements_event (memory_version N E))) :=
  let '(set, build) := audit_finset_of_list enc (left ++ right) in
  let '(out, enumerate) := audit_finset_elements set in
  (out, (build, enumerate)).

(** Count every actual outgoing occurrence, including duplicate successors. *)
Fixpoint audit_memo_successor_occurrences {N E CV CK NE}
    (events : list (audit_memo_event N E CV CK NE)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditMemoExpand _ successors _ :: rest =>
      length successors + audit_memo_successor_occurrences rest
  | _ :: rest => audit_memo_successor_occurrences rest
  end.

(** Nested costs use the very captured maps, sets, encoder traces and successor traces. *)
Fixpoint audit_memo_primitive_work {N E CV CK NE} (version_work : list CV -> nat)
    (key_work : list CK -> nat) (next_work : list NE -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_memo_event N E CV CK NE)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditMemoActive _ _ calls :: rest => audit_finset_source_work version_work calls +
      audit_memo_primitive_work version_work key_work next_work rest
  | AuditMemoLookup _ _ calls :: rest => audit_map_source_work key_work calls +
      audit_memo_primitive_work version_work key_work next_work rest
  | AuditMemoExpand _ _ calls :: rest => next_work calls +
      audit_memo_primitive_work version_work key_work next_work rest
  | AuditMemoAddActive _ calls :: rest => audit_finset_source_work version_work calls +
      audit_memo_primitive_work version_work key_work next_work rest
  | AuditMemoStore _ _ calls :: rest => audit_map_source_work key_work calls +
      audit_memo_primitive_work version_work key_work next_work rest
  | AuditMemoUnion lroots _ _ build enumeration :: rest =>
      length lroots + audit_finset_source_work version_work build +
      audit_set_elements_work enumeration + audit_memo_primitive_work version_work key_work
        next_work rest
  end.

(** The model charges a fixed positive control cost per branch and the captured body costs. *)
Definition audit_memo_source_work {N E CV CK NE} (version_work : list CV -> nat)
    (key_work : list CK -> nat) (next_work : list NE -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_memo_event N E CV CK NE)) : nat :=
  2 * length events + audit_memo_primitive_work version_work key_work next_work events.

Section MemoRules.
  Context {N E CV CK NE : Type}.
  Let V := memory_version N E.
  Let M := Map.t (positive * V) (memo_entry N E).
  Variable version_enc : V -> positive * list CV.
  Variable key_enc : (positive * V) -> positive * list CK.
  Variable scope : positive.
  Variable next : V -> list V * list NE.

  (** Each clause fixes branch priority, actual map/set calls and their returned traces. *)
  Inductive audit_memo_tree : FinSet.t V -> M -> V -> BinNums.N -> memory_clobber_result N E ->
      M -> BinNums.N -> list (audit_memo_event N E CV CK NE) -> Prop :=
    | AuditMemoTreeActive : forall active memo v fuel ae,
        audit_finset_mem version_enc v active = (true, ae) ->
        audit_memo_tree active memo v fuel (MemoryClobberResult [v] false) memo fuel
          [AuditMemoActive v true ae]
    | AuditMemoTreeDone : forall active memo v fuel ae le roots,
        audit_finset_mem version_enc v active = (false, ae) ->
        audit_map_get key_enc (scope, v) memo = (Some (MemoDone roots), le) ->
        audit_memo_tree active memo v fuel (MemoryClobberResult roots true) memo fuel
          [AuditMemoActive v false ae; AuditMemoLookup v (Some (MemoDone roots)) le]
    | AuditMemoTreeBusy : forall active memo v fuel ae le,
        audit_finset_mem version_enc v active = (false, ae) ->
        audit_map_get key_enc (scope, v) memo = (Some MemoBusy, le) ->
        audit_memo_tree active memo v fuel (MemoryClobberResult [v] false) memo fuel
          [AuditMemoActive v false ae; AuditMemoLookup v (Some MemoBusy) le]
    | AuditMemoTreeFuel : forall active memo v ae le,
        audit_finset_mem version_enc v active = (false, ae) ->
        audit_map_get key_enc (scope, v) memo = (None, le) ->
        audit_memo_tree active memo v 0%N (MemoryClobberResult [v] false) memo 0%N
          [AuditMemoActive v false ae; AuditMemoLookup v None le]
    | AuditMemoTreeTerminal : forall active memo v fuel ae le ne final se,
        audit_finset_mem version_enc v active = (false, ae) ->
        audit_map_get key_enc (scope, v) memo = (None, le) -> next v = ([], ne) ->
        audit_map_set key_enc (scope, v) (MemoDone [v]) memo = (final, se) ->
        audit_memo_tree active memo v (N.succ fuel) (MemoryClobberResult [v] true) final fuel
          [AuditMemoActive v false ae; AuditMemoLookup v None le; AuditMemoExpand v [] ne;
           AuditMemoStore v [v] se]
    | AuditMemoTreeBranchComplete :
        forall active memo v fuel ae le ne first rest active' add_events result memo' remaining
          children_events final se,
        audit_finset_mem version_enc v active = (false, ae) ->
        audit_map_get key_enc (scope, v) memo = (None, le) -> next v = (first :: rest, ne) ->
        audit_finset_add version_enc v active = (active', add_events) ->
        audit_memo_children active' memo (first :: rest) fuel result memo' remaining
          children_events ->
        clobber_complete result = true ->
        audit_map_set key_enc (scope, v) (MemoDone (clobber_roots result)) memo' = (final, se) ->
        audit_memo_tree active memo v (N.succ fuel) result final remaining
          ([AuditMemoActive v false ae; AuditMemoLookup v None le;
            AuditMemoExpand v (first :: rest) ne; AuditMemoAddActive v add_events] ++
            children_events ++ [AuditMemoStore v (clobber_roots result) se])
    | AuditMemoTreeBranchIncomplete :
        forall active memo v fuel ae le ne first rest active' add_events result final remaining
          children_events,
        audit_finset_mem version_enc v active = (false, ae) ->
        audit_map_get key_enc (scope, v) memo = (None, le) -> next v = (first :: rest, ne) ->
        audit_finset_add version_enc v active = (active', add_events) ->
        audit_memo_children active' memo (first :: rest) fuel result final remaining
          children_events ->
        clobber_complete result = false ->
        audit_memo_tree active memo v (N.succ fuel) result final remaining
          ([AuditMemoActive v false ae; AuditMemoLookup v None le;
            AuditMemoExpand v (first :: rest) ne; AuditMemoAddActive v add_events] ++
              children_events)
  with audit_memo_children : FinSet.t V -> M -> list V -> BinNums.N -> memory_clobber_result N E ->
      M -> BinNums.N -> list (audit_memo_event N E CV CK NE) -> Prop :=
    | AuditMemoChildrenNil : forall active memo fuel,
        audit_memo_children active memo [] fuel (MemoryClobberResult [] true) memo fuel []
    | AuditMemoChildrenCons : forall active memo v vs fuel one memo' fuel' first rest memo'' fuel''
        tail roots build enumeration,
        audit_memo_tree active memo v fuel one memo' fuel' first ->
        audit_memo_children active memo' vs fuel' rest memo'' fuel'' tail ->
        audit_memo_union version_enc (clobber_roots one) (clobber_roots rest) =
          (roots, (build, enumeration)) ->
        audit_memo_children active memo (v :: vs) fuel
          (MemoryClobberResult roots (andb (clobber_complete one) (clobber_complete rest)))
          memo'' fuel'' (first ++ tail ++
            [AuditMemoUnion (clobber_roots one) (clobber_roots rest) roots build enumeration]).

  (** Totality and determinacy are future claims; no source implementation is assumed here. *)
  Definition audit_memo_tree_total_at : Prop :=
    forall active memo v fuel, exists result final remaining events,
      audit_memo_tree active memo v fuel result final remaining events.

  Definition audit_memo_tree_deterministic_at : Prop :=
    forall active memo v fuel result1 final1 remaining1 events1 result2 final2 remaining2 events2,
      audit_memo_tree active memo v fuel result1 final1 remaining1 events1 ->
      audit_memo_tree active memo v fuel result2 final2 remaining2 events2 ->
      result1 = result2 /\ final1 = final2 /\ remaining1 = remaining2 /\ events1 = events2.

  (** The budget counts source fuel, actual edge occurrences and the same captured primitive
    calls. *)
  Definition audit_memo_tree_source_bound_at : Prop :=
    forall active memo v fuel result final remaining events version_work key_work next_work,
      audit_memo_tree active memo v fuel result final remaining events ->
      audit_memo_source_work version_work key_work next_work events <=
        8 + 8 * BinNat.N.to_nat fuel + 6 * audit_memo_successor_occurrences events +
        audit_memo_primitive_work version_work key_work next_work events.
End MemoRules.

(** This closed obligation quantifies every encoder, callback and original input. *)
Definition audit_memo_tree_total_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E CV CK NE version_enc key_enc scope next,
    @audit_memo_tree_total_at N E CV CK NE version_enc key_enc scope next.

(** This closed obligation quantifies every encoder, callback and original input. *)
Definition audit_memo_tree_deterministic_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E CV CK NE version_enc key_enc scope next,
    @audit_memo_tree_deterministic_at N E CV CK NE version_enc key_enc scope next.

(** This closed obligation quantifies every encoder, callback and original input. *)
Definition audit_memo_tree_source_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E CV CK NE version_enc key_enc scope next,
    @audit_memo_tree_source_bound_at N E CV CK NE version_enc key_enc scope next.


(** * Public query connection *)

Definition audit_memo_query_type : Type :=
  forall N E T (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (ET : encoding T)
      (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E),
    memo_state EN g effects mg -> memory_scope T -> memory_version N E -> positive ->
    memory_clobber_result N E * memo_state EN g effects mg.

(** A future implementation must return the same tree result and exact persistent final cache. *)
Definition audit_memo_query_execution_contract (query : audit_memo_query_type) : Prop :=
  forall N E T CV CK NE (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (ET : encoding T)
      (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E)
      (state : memo_state EN g effects mg) q start fuel
      (version_enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
      (key_enc : (positive * memory_version N E) -> positive * list CK)
      (next : memory_version N E -> list (memory_version N E) * list NE),
    (forall v, fst (version_enc v) = encode (memory_version_encoding EN EE) v) ->
    (forall k, fst (key_enc k) = encode (memo_key EN EE) k) ->
    (forall v, fst (next v) =
      memory_walk_raw_next EE ET (@memo_effect_index N E T EN g effects mg state)
        (pred_edges (@memo_adjacency N E T EN g effects mg state)) mg q v) ->
    let '(result, final) := query N E T EN EE ET g effects mg state q start fuel in
    exists remaining events,
      audit_memo_tree version_enc key_enc (scope_code ET q) next FinSet.empty
        (@memo_entries N E T EN g effects mg state) start (BinNums.Npos fuel) result
        (@memo_entries N E T EN g effects mg final) remaining events /\
      @memo_adjacency N E T EN g effects mg final = @memo_adjacency N E T EN g effects mg state /\
      @memo_effect_index N E T EN g effects mg final =
        @memo_effect_index N E T EN g effects mg state.
```

```rocq
(** * Adapted family source bounds

    These obligations bind every genuine foreign callback to its actual input, result and body.
    For example, internally prepared predecessor lookups never receive a foreign source-price law.
    Builds on: the family's complete source model and the shared actual-call adapter. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith NArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare GraphAuditBase.
From Galois.Domains Require Import DomainsFootprint.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryGraph AnalysesMemoryWalk.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditCallback.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryState.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryEncoding.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditMap.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryInputBudget.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryRawNext.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryWalkIndex.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryMemo.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoWhole.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoExecute.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoExecuteBound.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoSnapshot.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryTable.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemorySharedBudget.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryGraphCallbacks.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoPublicSource.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoSnapshotSource.
Import List.ListNotations.

(** Actual foreign source laws cover the same returned bodies charged by this fixed call. *)
Definition audit_memory_memo_public_whole_input_bound_adapted_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CN CE SE OE BE (EN : encoding N)
      (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
      (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE) (g : Graph.t N E)
      (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E)
      (state : memo_state EN g effects mg)
      (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE)
```

```rocq
(** * Composed memo-walk source cost

From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryRawNext.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryMemo.
Import List.ListNotations.

(** This query-run proposition fixes the exact composed model, not an arbitrary priced callback. *)
Definition audit_memory_memo_composed_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CN CE SE IE OE BE
      (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
      (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE) (table : Map.t E (Map.t nat (memory_effect T)))
      (incoming : N -> list E * list IE)
      (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE)
      (before : E -> nat -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE)

      events (node_work : list CN -> nat) (edge_work : list CE -> nat)
      (site_work : list SE -> nat) (incoming_work : list IE -> nat)
      (operand_work : list OE -> nat) (before_work : list BE -> nat),

    let next := audit_memory_raw_next edge_enc site_enc table incoming operand before q in

    let key_work := audit_memory_memo_key_work node_work edge_work in

      before_work in

      events ->
```

```rocq
(** * Fixed binary-credit memo producer

    This producer threads a binary credit and the exact persistent memo through every child.
    For example, a completed hit preserves its credit while a missing entry consumes one credit.
    Builds on: memo branch rules and the well-founded order on binary credit. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List NArith PArith PeanoNat Wf_nat Lia.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryGraph AnalysesMemoryFlow AnalysesMemoryWalk.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryState.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryEncoding.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditMap.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditFinSet.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryMemo.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoPlain.
Import List.ListNotations.

Inductive audit_memo_control_event : Type :=
  | AuditMemoEnterCase
  | AuditMemoChildrenCase
  | AuditMemoCreditCase (input : N)
  | AuditMemoPredPositiveCase (input : positive)
  | AuditMemoPredDoubleCase (input : positive).

Fixpoint audit_memo_pred_double (input : positive)
    : positive * list audit_memo_control_event :=
  match input with
  | xH => (xH, [AuditMemoPredDoubleCase input])
  | xI p => (xI (xO p), [AuditMemoPredDoubleCase input])
  | xO p =>
      let '(result, events) := audit_memo_pred_double p in
      (xI result, AuditMemoPredDoubleCase input :: events)
  end.

Definition audit_memo_pred (input : N) : N * list audit_memo_control_event :=
  match input with
  | N0 => (N0, [AuditMemoCreditCase input])
  | Npos xH => (N0, [AuditMemoCreditCase input; AuditMemoPredPositiveCase xH])
  | Npos (xI p) =>
      (Npos (xO p), [AuditMemoCreditCase input; AuditMemoPredPositiveCase (xI p)])
  | Npos (xO p) =>
      let '(result, events) := audit_memo_pred_double p in
      (Npos result, [AuditMemoCreditCase input; AuditMemoPredPositiveCase (xO p)] ++ events)
  end.

(** The binary predecessor preserves the exact result and charges every borrow constructor. *)
Definition audit_memo_pred_correct_statement : Prop :=
  forall input, fst (audit_memo_pred input) = N.pred input /\
    2 * length (snd (audit_memo_pred input)) <=
      4 + 2 * match input with N0 => 0 | Npos p => Pos.size_nat p end.

Record audit_memo_execution (N E CV CK NE : Type) : Type := AuditMemoExecution {
  audit_memo_value : memory_clobber_result N E;
  audit_memo_cache : Map.t (positive * memory_version N E) (memo_entry N E);
  audit_memo_credit : BinNums.N;
  audit_memo_body_events : list (audit_memo_event N E CV CK NE);
  audit_memo_control_events : list audit_memo_control_event
}.

Arguments AuditMemoExecution {N E CV CK NE} _ _ _ _ _.
Arguments audit_memo_value {N E CV CK NE} _.
Arguments audit_memo_cache {N E CV CK NE} _.
Arguments audit_memo_credit {N E CV CK NE} _.
Arguments audit_memo_body_events {N E CV CK NE} _.
Arguments audit_memo_control_events {N E CV CK NE} _.

Section Execute.
  Context {N E CV CK NE : Type}.
  Let V := memory_version N E.
  Let M := Map.t (positive * V) (memo_entry N E).
  Let R := audit_memo_execution N E CV CK NE.
  Variable version_enc : V -> positive * list CV.
  Variable key_enc : (positive * V) -> positive * list CK.
  Variable scope : positive.
  Variable next : V -> list V * list NE.

  Definition audit_memo_credit_bounded (fuel : BinNums.N) (run : R) : Prop :=
    (N.to_nat (audit_memo_credit run) <= N.to_nat fuel)%nat.

  (** The list recursion is structural; the recursive version oracle accepts only smaller credit. *)
  Fixpoint audit_memo_execute_children (bound : BinNums.N)
      (recur : forall credit, (N.to_nat credit < N.to_nat bound)%nat ->
        FinSet.t V -> M -> V -> {run : R | audit_memo_credit_bounded credit run})
      (active : FinSet.t V) (memo : M) (versions : list V) (credit : BinNums.N)
      (Hcredit : (N.to_nat credit < N.to_nat bound)%nat)
      {struct versions} : {run : R | audit_memo_credit_bounded credit run}.
  Proof.
    destruct versions as [| v rest].
    - exists (AuditMemoExecution (MemoryClobberResult [] true) memo credit []
        [AuditMemoChildrenCase]).
      apply Nat.le_refl.
    - destruct (recur credit Hcredit active memo v) as [one Hone].
      assert (Hsmaller : (N.to_nat (audit_memo_credit one) < N.to_nat bound)%nat).
      { unfold audit_memo_credit_bounded in Hone. lia. }
      destruct (audit_memo_execute_children bound recur active (audit_memo_cache one) rest
        (audit_memo_credit one) Hsmaller) as [tail Htail].
      destruct (audit_memo_union version_enc (clobber_roots (audit_memo_value one))
        (clobber_roots (audit_memo_value tail))) as [roots [build enumeration]].
      exists (AuditMemoExecution
        (MemoryClobberResult roots (andb (clobber_complete (audit_memo_value one))
          (clobber_complete (audit_memo_value tail))))
        (audit_memo_cache tail) (audit_memo_credit tail)
        (audit_memo_body_events one ++ audit_memo_body_events tail ++
          [AuditMemoUnion (clobber_roots (audit_memo_value one))
            (clobber_roots (audit_memo_value tail)) roots build enumeration])
        (AuditMemoChildrenCase :: audit_memo_control_events one ++ audit_memo_control_events tail)).
      unfold audit_memo_credit_bounded in *. cbn. lia.
  Defined.

  (** Only the proof-erased termination measure uses unary conversion; runtime credit remains
    binary. *)
  Definition audit_memo_execute_body (fuel : BinNums.N)
      (recur : forall credit, (N.to_nat credit < N.to_nat fuel)%nat ->
        FinSet.t V -> M -> V -> {run : R | audit_memo_credit_bounded credit run})
      (active : FinSet.t V) (memo : M) (v : V) :
      {run : R | audit_memo_credit_bounded fuel run}.
  Proof.
    destruct (audit_finset_mem version_enc v active) as [is_active ae].
    destruct is_active.
    - exists (AuditMemoExecution (MemoryClobberResult [v] false) memo fuel
        [AuditMemoActive v true ae] [AuditMemoEnterCase]).
      apply Nat.le_refl.
    - destruct (audit_map_get key_enc (scope, v) memo) as [entry le].
      destruct entry as [[| roots] |].
      + exists (AuditMemoExecution (MemoryClobberResult [v] false) memo fuel
          [AuditMemoActive v false ae; AuditMemoLookup v (Some MemoBusy) le]
          [AuditMemoEnterCase]).
        apply Nat.le_refl.
      + exists (AuditMemoExecution (MemoryClobberResult roots true) memo fuel
          [AuditMemoActive v false ae; AuditMemoLookup v (Some (MemoDone roots)) le]
          [AuditMemoEnterCase]).
        apply Nat.le_refl.
      + destruct fuel as [| positive_fuel].
        * exists (AuditMemoExecution (MemoryClobberResult [v] false) memo 0%N
            [AuditMemoActive v false ae; AuditMemoLookup v None le]
            [AuditMemoEnterCase; AuditMemoCreditCase 0%N]).
          apply Nat.le_refl.
        * pose (credit := N.pred (Npos positive_fuel)).
          assert (Hcredit : (N.to_nat credit < N.to_nat (Npos positive_fuel))%nat).
          { unfold credit. rewrite N2Nat.inj_pred.
            cbn. pose proof (Pos2Nat.is_pos positive_fuel) as Hpositive. lia. }
          destruct (next v) as [successors ne].
          destruct successors as [| first rest].
          -- destruct (audit_map_set key_enc (scope, v) (MemoDone [v]) memo) as [final se].
             exists (AuditMemoExecution (MemoryClobberResult [v] true) final credit
               [AuditMemoActive v false ae; AuditMemoLookup v None le;
                AuditMemoExpand v [] ne; AuditMemoStore v [v] se]
               (AuditMemoEnterCase :: snd (audit_memo_pred (Npos positive_fuel)))).
             unfold audit_memo_credit_bounded. cbn. lia.
          -- destruct (audit_finset_add version_enc v active) as [active' adds].
             destruct (audit_memo_execute_children (Npos positive_fuel) recur active' memo
               (first :: rest) credit Hcredit) as [children Hchildren].
             pose (prefix := [AuditMemoActive v false ae; AuditMemoLookup v None le;
               AuditMemoExpand v (first :: rest) ne; AuditMemoAddActive v adds]).
             pose (controls := AuditMemoEnterCase :: snd (audit_memo_pred (Npos positive_fuel)) ++
               audit_memo_control_events children).
             destruct (clobber_complete (audit_memo_value children)).
             ++ destruct (audit_map_set key_enc (scope, v)
                  (MemoDone (clobber_roots (audit_memo_value children)))
                  (audit_memo_cache children)) as [final se].
                exists (AuditMemoExecution (audit_memo_value children) final
                  (audit_memo_credit children)
                  (prefix ++ audit_memo_body_events children ++
                    [AuditMemoStore v (clobber_roots (audit_memo_value children)) se]) controls).
                unfold audit_memo_credit_bounded in *. cbn. lia.
             ++ exists (AuditMemoExecution (audit_memo_value children) (audit_memo_cache children)
                  (audit_memo_credit children) (prefix ++ audit_memo_body_events children)
                    controls).
                unfold audit_memo_credit_bounded in *. cbn. lia.
  Defined.

  Definition audit_memo_execute (fuel : BinNums.N) (active : FinSet.t V) (memo : M) (v : V) : R :=
    proj1_sig (Fix (well_founded_ltof BinNums.N N.to_nat)
      (fun credit => forall active memo v,
        {run : R | audit_memo_credit_bounded credit run})
      audit_memo_execute_body fuel active memo v).

  (** The fixed producer yields the same body execution and explicitly retains binary control. *)
  Definition audit_memo_execute_tree_at : Prop :=
    forall fuel active memo v,
      let run := audit_memo_execute fuel active memo v in
      audit_memo_tree version_enc key_enc scope next active memo v fuel
        (audit_memo_value run) (audit_memo_cache run) (audit_memo_credit run)
        (audit_memo_body_events run).
End Execute.

(** This closed obligation quantifies every encoder, callback and original input. *)
Definition audit_memo_execute_tree_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E CV CK NE version_enc key_enc scope next,
    @audit_memo_execute_tree_at N E CV CK NE version_enc key_enc scope next.


(** This fixed public query uses the saved adjacency and effect table and updates only its memo. *)
Definition audit_memory_memo_query {N E T}
    (EN : CollectionsEncoding.encoding N) (EE : CollectionsEncoding.encoding E)
    (ET : CollectionsEncoding.encoding T) (g : GraphCore.Graph.t N E)
    (effects : E -> list (ViewsMemoryEffects.memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E)
    (state : memo_state EN g effects mg) (q : ViewsMemoryEffects.memory_scope T)
    (start : memory_version N E) (fuel : positive) :
    memory_clobber_result N E * memo_state EN g effects mg :=
  let next := memory_walk_raw_next EE ET (@memo_effect_index N E T EN g effects mg state)
    (pred_edges (@memo_adjacency N E T EN g effects mg state)) mg q in
  let run := audit_memo_compute (memory_version_encoding EN EE) (memo_key EN EE)
    (scope_code ET q) next (Npos fuel) FinSet.empty
    (@memo_entries N E T EN g effects mg state) start in

    @MemoState N E T EN g effects mg (@memo_adjacency N E T EN g effects mg state)
```
