```rocq
(** * Fixed memo producer source bounds and public erasure

    These contracts include binary predecessor work and the fixed query's returned cache.
    For example, zero-credit cutoff pays its probes and credit case but never calls successors.
    Builds on: the fixed memo producer, its input recurrence and concrete memory adapters. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List NArith PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryGraph AnalysesMemoryFlow AnalysesMemoryWalk.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryState.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryEncoding.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryRawNext.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryInputBudget.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryMemo.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoWhole.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoExecute.
Import List.ListNotations.

Definition audit_memo_credit_width (fuel : BinNums.N) : nat :=
  match fuel with N0 => 0 | Npos p => Pos.size_nat p end.

Definition audit_memo_execution_source_work {N E CV CK NE}
    (version_work : list CV -> nat) (key_work : list CK -> nat) (next_work : list NE -> nat)
    (run : audit_memo_execution N E CV CK NE) : nat :=
  audit_memo_source_work version_work key_work next_work (audit_memo_body_events run) +
    2 * length (audit_memo_control_events run).

(** Model erasure compares actual codes and successors, retaining exact results and memo state. *)
Definition audit_memo_execute_projection_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E CV CK NE CV' CK' NE'
      (version_enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
      (key_enc : positive * memory_version N E -> positive * list CK)
      (next : memory_version N E -> list (memory_version N E) * list NE)
      (version_enc' : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV')
      (key_enc' : positive * memory_version N E -> positive * list CK')
      (next' : memory_version N E -> list (memory_version N E) * list NE')
      scope fuel active memo start,
    (forall v, fst (version_enc v) = fst (version_enc' v)) ->
    (forall key, fst (key_enc key) = fst (key_enc' key)) ->
    (forall v, fst (next v) = fst (next' v)) ->
    let run := audit_memo_execute version_enc key_enc scope next fuel active memo start in
    let run' := audit_memo_execute version_enc' key_enc' scope next' fuel active memo start in
    audit_memo_value run = audit_memo_value run' /\
    audit_memo_cache run = audit_memo_cache run' /\
    audit_memo_credit run = audit_memo_credit run'.

(** The independent recurrence pays every source body and all binary control at input width. *)
Definition audit_memo_execute_whole_input_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E CV CK NE (version_enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
      (key_enc : positive * memory_version N E -> positive * list CK)
      (next : memory_version N E -> list (memory_version N E) * list NE)
      scope version_work key_work next_work version_budget key_budget next_budget
      fuel active memo start,
    (forall v, version_work (snd (version_enc v)) <= version_budget v) ->
    (forall key, key_work (snd (key_enc key)) <= key_budget key) ->
    (forall v, next_work (snd (next v)) <= next_budget v) ->
    let run := audit_memo_execute version_enc key_enc scope next fuel active memo start in
    exists budget,
      audit_memo_input_budget_run version_enc key_enc scope next
        version_budget key_budget next_budget active memo start fuel
        (audit_memo_value run) (audit_memo_cache run) (audit_memo_credit run) budget /\
      audit_memo_execution_source_work version_work key_work next_work run <=
        16 * S (audit_memo_credit_width fuel) * budget.

(** The counted query executes actual memory callbacks from the same saved prepared state. *)
Definition audit_memory_memo_query_counted {N E T CN CE SE IE OE BE}
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
    (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE) (EN : encoding N) (g : Graph.t N E)
    (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E)
    (state : memo_state EN g effects mg)
    (incoming : N -> list E * list IE)
    (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE)
    (before : E -> nat -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE)
    (q : memory_scope T) (start : memory_version N E) (fuel : positive) :=
  let scope := audit_memory_scope_encode site_enc q in
  let next := audit_memory_raw_next edge_enc site_enc
    (@memo_effect_index N E T EN g effects mg state) incoming operand before q in
  (scope, audit_memo_execute (audit_memory_version_encode node_enc edge_enc)
    (audit_memory_memo_key_encode node_enc edge_enc) (fst scope) next
    (Npos fuel) FinSet.empty (@memo_entries N E T EN g effects mg state) start).

(** The erased result and full cache agree with the fixed public query, including failed cutoffs. *)
Definition audit_memory_memo_query_counted_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CN CE SE IE OE BE (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (ET : encoding T)
      (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
      (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE) (g : Graph.t N E)
      (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E)
      (state : memo_state EN g effects mg) (incoming : N -> list E * list IE)
      (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE)
      (before : E -> nat -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE) q start fuel,
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall e, fst (edge_enc e) = encode EE e) ->
    (forall t, fst (site_enc t) = encode ET t) ->
    (forall n, fst (incoming n) = pred_edges (@memo_adjacency N E T EN g effects mg state) n) ->
    (forall n key, fst (operand n key) = memory_operand mg n key) ->
    (forall e i, fst (before e i) = memory_before mg e i) ->
    let run := snd (audit_memory_memo_query_counted node_enc edge_enc site_enc EN g effects mg state
      incoming operand before q start fuel) in
    let original := audit_memory_memo_query EN EE ET g effects mg state q start fuel in
    audit_memo_value run = fst original /\
    audit_memo_cache run = @memo_entries N E T EN g effects mg (snd original).

(** Whole query work has only per-input external callback premises and the independent recurrence.
  *)
Definition audit_memory_memo_query_whole_input_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CN CE SE IE OE BE (EN : encoding N)
      (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
      (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE) (g : Graph.t N E)
      (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E)
      (state : memo_state EN g effects mg) (incoming : N -> list E * list IE)
      (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE)
      (before : E -> nat -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE)
      node_work edge_work site_work incoming_work operand_work before_work
      node_budget edge_budget site_budget incoming_budget operand_budget before_budget q start fuel,
    (forall n, node_work (snd (node_enc n)) <= node_budget n) ->
    (forall e, edge_work (snd (edge_enc e)) <= edge_budget e) ->
    (forall t, site_work (snd (site_enc t)) <= site_budget t) ->
    (forall n, incoming_work (snd (incoming n)) <= incoming_budget n) ->
    (forall n key, operand_work (snd (operand n key)) <= operand_budget n key) ->
    (forall e i, before_work (snd (before e i)) <= before_budget e i) ->
    let '(scope, run) := audit_memory_memo_query_counted node_enc edge_enc site_enc EN
      g effects mg state incoming operand before q start fuel in
    let version_enc := audit_memory_version_encode node_enc edge_enc in
    let key_enc := audit_memory_memo_key_encode node_enc edge_enc in
    let next := audit_memory_raw_next edge_enc site_enc
      (@memo_effect_index N E T EN g effects mg state) incoming operand before q in
    exists budget,
      audit_memo_input_budget_run version_enc key_enc (fst scope) next
        (audit_memory_version_input_budget node_enc edge_enc node_budget edge_budget)
        (audit_memory_memo_key_input_budget node_enc edge_enc node_budget edge_budget)
        (@audit_raw_next_input_budget N E T CE SE IE OE BE edge_enc site_enc
          (@memo_effect_index N E T EN g effects mg state) incoming before
          edge_budget site_budget incoming_budget operand_budget before_budget q)
        FinSet.empty (@memo_entries N E T EN g effects mg state) start (Npos fuel)
        (audit_memo_value run) (audit_memo_cache run) (audit_memo_credit run) budget /\
      audit_memory_scope_work site_work (snd scope) +
        audit_memo_execution_source_work (audit_memory_version_work node_work edge_work)
          (audit_memory_memo_key_work node_work edge_work)
          (audit_raw_next_source_work edge_work site_work incoming_work operand_work before_work)
          run <= audit_memory_scope_input_budget site_enc site_budget q +
            16 * S (Pos.size_nat fuel) * budget.

(** The counted mathematical mirror erases to the separate untraced computation at all endpoints. *)
Definition audit_memo_execute_plain_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E CV CK NE (version_encoding : encoding (memory_version N E))
      (key_encoding : encoding (positive * memory_version N E))
      (version_enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
      (key_enc : positive * memory_version N E -> positive * list CK)
      (next : memory_version N E -> list (memory_version N E) * list NE)
      scope fuel active memo start,
    (forall v, fst (version_enc v) = encode version_encoding v) ->
    (forall key, fst (key_enc key) = encode key_encoding key) ->
    let counted := audit_memo_execute version_enc key_enc scope next fuel active memo start in
    let plain := AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoPlain.audit_memo_compute version_encoding key_encoding scope
      (fun v => fst (next v)) fuel active memo start in
    audit_memo_value counted = AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoPlain.audit_plain_memo_value plain /\
    audit_memo_cache counted = AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoPlain.audit_plain_memo_cache plain /\
    audit_memo_credit counted = AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoPlain.audit_plain_memo_credit plain.

(** The model connection is an obligation for the one fixed public query, not arbitrary functions.
  *)
Definition audit_memory_memo_query_execution_contract_statement : Prop :=
  audit_memo_query_execution_contract (@audit_memory_memo_query).
```

## AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoLegacyPlain

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoLegacyPlain.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoLegacyPlain`.

```rocq
(** * Plain memo-threaded legacy projection

    This producer evaluates each listed load once, threads its memo and indexes retained pairs.
    For example, a later load at the same scope and version reuses a completed earlier memo query.
    Builds on: the plain memo query and the original independent all-walk retain decision. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List Bool PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsMemoryEffects ViewsGraph.
From Galois.Domains Require Import DomainsFootprint.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryGraph AnalysesMemoryWalk AnalysesMemoryLegacy.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryState.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryEncoding.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoExecute.
Import List.ListNotations.
Open Scope bool_scope.

Definition audit_memo_legacy_request {N E T} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (g : Graph.t N E) (mg : memory_graph N E) (reached : FinSet.t N) (listed : FinSet.t E)
    (table : Map.t E (Map.t nat (memory_effect T)))
    (reads : N -> list (footprint T)) (loads : N -> option (E * nat)) (node : N) :=
  match loads node with
  | None => None
  | Some (edge, index) =>
      if Pos.eqb (encode EN (Graph.source g edge)) (encode EN node) &&
        FinSet.mem EN (Graph.source g edge) reached && FinSet.mem EE edge listed then
        match memory_walk_effect_get EE table edge index, memory_before mg edge index with
        | Some effect, Some start =>
            if memory_effect_has_read effect then Some (MemoryRegions (reads node), start) else None
        | _, _ => None
        end
      else None
  end.

Definition audit_memo_legacy_one {F N E T} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (EF : encoding F) (ET : encoding T) (function : F) (g : Graph.t N E)
    (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E)
    (state : memo_state EN g effects mg) (cfg : Graph.t N (N * N)) (prep : prepared EN cfg)
    (reached : FinSet.t N) (listed : FinSet.t E)
    (writes reads : N -> list (footprint T)) (loads : N -> option (E * nat)) fuel node :=
  match audit_memo_legacy_request EN EE g mg reached listed
    (@memo_effect_index N E T EN g effects mg state) reads loads node with
  | None => (None, state)
  | Some (scope, start) =>
      let '(result, next) := audit_memory_memo_query EN EE ET g effects mg state scope start fuel in
      (legacy_retain EN EF ET function cfg prep reached writes reads node
        (legacy_clobber_proposal function g result), next)
  end.

Fixpoint audit_memo_legacy_nodes {F N E T} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (EF : encoding F) (ET : encoding T) (function : F) (g : Graph.t N E)
    (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E)
    (cfg : Graph.t N (N * N)) (prep : prepared EN cfg)
    (reached : FinSet.t N) (listed : FinSet.t E)
    (writes reads : N -> list (footprint T)) (loads : N -> option (E * nat)) (fuel : positive)
    (nodes : list N) (state : memo_state EN g effects mg)
    (pairs : Map.t N (option (mem_node F N))) :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => (pairs, state)
  | node :: rest =>
      let '(candidate, next) := audit_memo_legacy_one EN EE EF ET function g effects mg state cfg
        prep reached listed writes reads loads fuel node in
      audit_memo_legacy_nodes EN EE EF ET function g effects mg cfg prep reached listed writes reads
        loads fuel rest next (Map.set EN node candidate pairs)
  end.

Definition audit_memory_memo_legacy_project {F N E T} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (EF : encoding F) (ET : encoding T) (function : F) (g : Graph.t N E)
    (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (writes reads : N -> list (footprint T))
    (mg : memory_graph N E) (state : memo_state EN g effects mg)
    (loads : N -> option (E * nat)) (fuel : positive) :
    memory_ssa F N * memo_state EN g effects mg :=
  let cfg := legacy_cfg EN g in
  let prep := prepare EN cfg in
  let reached := legacy_reached prep (Graph.entries cfg) in
  let listed := FinSet.of_list EE (edges_of g) in
  let '(pairs, next) := audit_memo_legacy_nodes EN EE EF ET function g effects mg cfg prep reached
    listed writes reads loads fuel (Graph.nodes g) state Map.empty in
  (MemorySSA (fun node => match Map.get EN node pairs with Some result => result | None => None
    end),
    next).

(** The concrete memo-threaded producer establishes the promised checked-pair and byte
  properties. *)
Definition audit_memory_memo_legacy_semantics_statement : Prop :=
  memo_legacy_checked_statement (@audit_memory_memo_legacy_project) /\
  memo_legacy_bytes_statement (@audit_memory_memo_legacy_project).
```

```rocq
Record audit_memo_legacy_receipt (N E T CN CE SE OE BE : Type) : Type := AuditMemoLegacyReceipt {
  audit_memo_legacy_scope_body : list (audit_memory_scope_event T SE);
  audit_memo_legacy_execution : audit_memo_execution N E (audit_memory_version_event N E CN CE)
    (audit_pair_event positive (memory_version N E) (audit_basic_encoding_event positive)
      (audit_memory_version_event N E CN CE))

Arguments AuditMemoLegacyReceipt {N E T CN CE SE OE BE} _ _.

Definition audit_memo_legacy_proposal_event (F N E T CN CE SE XE OE BE LE RE : Type) :=
  audit_legacy_source_proposal_event F N E T CN CE XE BE LE RE
    (audit_memo_legacy_receipt N E T CN CE SE OE BE).

Definition audit_memo_legacy_one_event (F N E T CN CE CF SE XE OE BE LE RE WE : Type) :=
  audit_legacy_projection_event F N
    (audit_memo_legacy_proposal_event F N E T CN CE SE XE OE BE LE RE)

Definition audit_memo_legacy_receipt_work {N E T CN CE SE OE BE}
    (node_work : list CN -> nat) (edge_work : list CE -> nat) (site_work : list SE -> nat)
    (operand_work : list OE -> nat) (before_work : list BE -> nat)
    (receipt : audit_memo_legacy_receipt N E T CN CE SE OE BE) : nat :=
  4 + audit_memory_scope_work site_work (audit_memo_legacy_scope_body receipt) +
  audit_memo_execution_source_work (audit_memory_version_work node_work edge_work)
    (audit_memory_memo_key_work node_work edge_work)
    (audit_raw_next_source_work edge_work site_work (audit_map_source_work node_work)
      operand_work before_work) (audit_memo_legacy_execution receipt).

Definition audit_memo_legacy_setup_counted {N E T CN CE OE TE}
    (EN : encoding N) (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
    (out : N -> list E * list OE) (target : E -> N * list TE) (g : Graph.t N E)
    (table : Map.t E (Map.t nat (memory_effect T))) :=
  let '(rows, cfg_events) := audit_legacy_cfg_rows EN node_enc out target (Graph.nodes g) in
  let cfg := Graph.Make (Graph.entries g) (Graph.nodes g) (index_edges EN rows) fst snd in
  let '(prep, prepare_events) := audit_prepare_source_counted EN cfg
    (audit_legacy_prepare_callbacks node_enc rows) in
  let '(reached, reached_events) := audit_legacy_reached_counted EN node_enc cfg prep
    (Graph.entries cfg) in
  let '(edges, edge_events) := audit_memory_edges out (Graph.nodes g) in
  let '(listed, listed_events) := audit_finset_of_list edge_enc edges in
  @AuditLegacySetupRun N E T CN CE OE TE unit EN cfg prep reached listed table cfg_events
    prepare_events reached_events edge_events listed_events [].

Section One.
  Context {F N E T CN CE CF SE XE OE BE LE RE WE : Type}.
  Context (EN : encoding N) (EF : encoding F) (ET : encoding T).
  Context (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE).
  Context (function_enc : F -> positive * list CF) (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE).
  Context (source : E -> N * list XE).
  Context (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE).
  Context (before : E -> nat -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE).
  Context (load : N -> option (E * nat) * list LE).
  Context (reads : N -> list (footprint T) * list RE) (writes : N -> list (footprint T) * list WE).
  Context (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E).

  Definition audit_memo_legacy_clobber_counted (state : memo_state EN g effects mg) scope start
    fuel :=
    let '(encoded_scope, run) := audit_memory_memo_public_source_counted node_enc edge_enc
      site_enc EN
      g effects mg state operand before scope start fuel in
    (audit_memo_value run, AuditMemoLegacyReceipt (snd encoded_scope) run).

  Fixpoint audit_memo_legacy_receipt_after (state : memo_state EN g effects mg)
      (events : list (audit_memo_legacy_proposal_event F N E T CN CE SE XE OE BE LE RE)) :=
    match events with
    | [] => state
    | AuditLegacySourceClobbers _ receipt :: _ =>
        @MemoState N E T EN g effects mg (@memo_adjacency N E T EN g effects mg state)
          (@memo_effect_index N E T EN g effects mg state)
          (audit_memo_cache (audit_memo_legacy_execution receipt))
    | _ :: rest => audit_memo_legacy_receipt_after state rest
    end.

  Definition audit_memo_legacy_one_counted {OO TE}
      (setup : @audit_legacy_setup_run N E T CN CE OO TE unit EN)
      (state : memo_state EN g effects mg) function fuel node :=
    let '(proposal, proposal_body) := audit_legacy_occurrence_source_with node_enc edge_enc source
      (audit_legacy_setup_listed setup) (audit_legacy_setup_reached setup)
      (@memo_effect_index N E T EN g effects mg state) before load reads
      (audit_memo_legacy_clobber_counted state) function fuel node in
    let next := audit_memo_legacy_receipt_after state proposal_body in
    match proposal with
    | None => (None, next, [AuditLegacyProjectionProposal proposal_body;
      AuditLegacyProjectionRetainNone])
    | Some candidate =>
        let cfg := audit_legacy_setup_cfg setup in
        let prep := audit_legacy_setup_prepared setup in
        let '(accepted, body) := audit_legacy_pair_check_full EN EF ET node_enc function_enc
          site_enc
          (audit_legacy_successors_counted EN node_enc cfg prep) reads writes cfg prep
          (audit_legacy_setup_reached setup) node candidate function in
        (if accepted then Some candidate else None, next,
          [AuditLegacyProjectionProposal proposal_body; AuditLegacyProjectionRetain candidate
            accepted body])
    end.
End One.

Inductive audit_memo_legacy_nodes_event (F N MS P CN : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditMemoLegacyNodesCase (remaining : list N)
  | AuditMemoLegacyNodesOne (node : N) (before after : MS)
      (candidate : option (mem_node F N)) (body : list P)
  | AuditMemoLegacyNodesStore
      (body : list (audit_map_event N (option (mem_node F N)) CN)).
Arguments AuditMemoLegacyNodesCase {F N MS P CN} _.
Arguments AuditMemoLegacyNodesOne {F N MS P CN} _ _ _ _ _.
Arguments AuditMemoLegacyNodesStore {F N MS P CN} _.

Section Nodes.
  Context {F N E T CN CE CF SE XE OO TE OE BE LE RE WE : Type}.
  Context (EN : encoding N) (EF : encoding F) (ET : encoding T).
  Context (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE).
  Context (function_enc : F -> positive * list CF) (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE).
  Context (source : E -> N * list XE) (out : N -> list E * list OO) (target : E -> N * list TE).
  Context (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE).
  Context (before : E -> nat -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE).
  Context (load : N -> option (E * nat) * list LE).
  Context (reads : N -> list (footprint T) * list RE) (writes : N -> list (footprint T) * list WE).
  Context (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E).
  Context (function : F) (fuel : positive).

  Fixpoint audit_memo_legacy_nodes_counted
      (setup : @audit_legacy_setup_run N E T CN CE OO TE unit EN) (nodes : list N)
      (state : memo_state EN g effects mg) (pairs : Map.t N (option (mem_node F N))) :=
    match nodes with
    | [] => (pairs, state, [AuditMemoLegacyNodesCase nodes])
    | node :: rest =>
        let '(candidate, next, body) := audit_memo_legacy_one_counted EN EF ET node_enc edge_enc
          function_enc site_enc source operand before load reads writes g effects mg setup state
          function fuel node in
        let '(updated, store_body) := audit_map_set node_enc node candidate pairs in
        let '(final_pairs, final_state, tail) := audit_memo_legacy_nodes_counted setup rest next
          updated in
        (final_pairs, final_state, [AuditMemoLegacyNodesCase nodes;
          AuditMemoLegacyNodesOne node state next candidate body; AuditMemoLegacyNodesStore
            store_body] ++ tail)
    end.

  Definition audit_memory_memo_legacy_project_counted (state : memo_state EN g effects mg) :=
    let setup := audit_memo_legacy_setup_counted EN node_enc edge_enc out target g
      (@memo_effect_index N E T EN g effects mg state) in
    (setup, audit_memo_legacy_nodes_counted setup (Graph.nodes g) state Map.empty).
End Nodes.

Section SourceWork.
  Context {F N E T CN CE CF SE XE OE BE LE RE WE : Type}.
  Context (EN : encoding N).
  Context (node_work : list CN -> nat) (edge_work : list CE -> nat).
  Context (function_work : list CF -> nat) (site_work : list SE -> nat).
  Context (source_work : list XE -> nat) (operand_work : list OE -> nat).
  Context (before_work : list BE -> nat) (load_work : list LE -> nat).
  Context (read_work : list RE -> nat) (write_work : list WE -> nat).

  Fixpoint audit_memo_legacy_one_source_work
      (events : list (audit_memo_legacy_one_event F N E T CN CE CF SE XE OE BE LE RE WE)) : nat :=
    match events with
    | [] => 0
    | event :: rest =>
        (2 + match event with
        | AuditLegacyProjectionProposal body =>
            audit_legacy_occurrence_source_work node_work edge_work source_work before_work
              load_work
              read_work (audit_memo_legacy_receipt_work node_work edge_work site_work operand_work
                before_work) body
        | AuditLegacyProjectionRetainNone => 1
        | AuditLegacyProjectionRetain _ _ body => audit_legacy_pair_source_work EN node_work
          function_work
            site_work (audit_legacy_successor_source_work node_work) read_work write_work body
        end) + audit_memo_legacy_one_source_work rest
    end.

  Fixpoint audit_memo_legacy_nodes_source_work {MS}
      (events : list (audit_memo_legacy_nodes_event F N MS
        (audit_memo_legacy_one_event F N E T CN CE CF SE XE OE BE LE RE WE) CN)) : nat :=
    match events with
    | [] => 0
    | AuditMemoLegacyNodesCase _ :: rest => 2 + audit_memo_legacy_nodes_source_work rest
    | AuditMemoLegacyNodesOne _ _ _ _ body :: rest =>
        2 + audit_memo_legacy_one_source_work body + audit_memo_legacy_nodes_source_work rest
    | AuditMemoLegacyNodesStore body :: rest =>
        2 + audit_map_source_work node_work body + audit_memo_legacy_nodes_source_work rest
    end.
End SourceWork.

Section InputBudget.
  Context {F N E T CN CE CF SE XE OO TE OE BE LE RE WE : Type}.
  Context (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (EF : encoding F) (ET : encoding T).
  Context (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE).
  Context (function_enc : F -> positive * list CF) (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE).
  Context (source : E -> N * list XE) (out : N -> list E * list OO) (target : E -> N * list TE).
  Context (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE).
  Context (before : E -> nat -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE).
  Context (load : N -> option (E * nat) * list LE).
  Context (reads : N -> list (footprint T) * list RE) (writes : N -> list (footprint T) * list WE).
  Context (node_budget out_budget load_budget read_budget write_budget : N -> nat).
  Context (edge_budget source_budget target_budget : E -> nat).
  Context (function_budget : F -> nat) (site_budget : T -> nat).
  Context (operand_budget : N -> option E -> nat) (before_budget : E -> nat -> nat).
  Context (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E).
  Context (function : F) (fuel : positive).
  Let State := memo_state EN g effects mg.
  Let Pairs := Map.t N (option (mem_node F N)).
  Let Setup := @audit_legacy_setup_run N E T CN CE OO TE unit EN.

  (** Query receipts use the existing independent binary-credit recurrence on identical
    endpoints. *)
  Definition audit_memo_legacy_query_input_budget (state : State) scope start
      (result : memory_clobber_result N E) (next : State) (cost : nat) : Prop :=
    let incoming := audit_walk_predecessors node_enc
      (in_index (@memo_adjacency N E T EN g effects mg state)) in
    let version_enc := audit_memory_version_encode node_enc edge_enc in
    let key_enc := audit_memory_memo_key_encode node_enc edge_enc in
    let next_versions := audit_memory_raw_next edge_enc site_enc
      (@memo_effect_index N E T EN g effects mg state) incoming operand before scope in
    exists final remaining query_cost,
      audit_memo_input_budget_run version_enc key_enc
        (fst (audit_memory_scope_encode site_enc scope)) next_versions
        (audit_memory_version_input_budget node_enc edge_enc node_budget edge_budget)
        (audit_memory_memo_key_input_budget node_enc edge_enc node_budget edge_budget)
        (@audit_raw_next_input_budget N E T CE SE (audit_map_event N (list E) CN) OE BE
          edge_enc site_enc (@memo_effect_index N E T EN g effects mg state) incoming before
          edge_budget site_budget (audit_walk_predecessor_input_budget node_enc node_budget)
          operand_budget before_budget scope)
        FinSet.empty (@memo_entries N E T EN g effects mg state) start (Npos fuel)
        result final remaining query_cost /\
      next = @MemoState N E T EN g effects mg (@memo_adjacency N E T EN g effects mg state)
        (@memo_effect_index N E T EN g effects mg state) final /\
      cost = 4 + audit_memory_scope_input_budget site_enc site_budget scope +
        16 * S (Pos.size_nat fuel) * query_cost.

  Definition audit_memo_legacy_prefix_input_budget (setup : Setup) (state : State) node : nat :=
    audit_legacy_occurrence_with_input_budget node_enc edge_enc source
      (audit_legacy_setup_listed setup) (audit_legacy_setup_reached setup)
      (@memo_effect_index N E T EN g effects mg state) before load reads
      (fun _ _ _ => (MemoryClobberResult [] false, tt)) node_budget load_budget read_budget
      edge_budget source_budget before_budget (fun _ _ _ => 0) function fuel node.

  Definition audit_memo_legacy_finish_input_budget (setup : Setup) node
      (result : memory_clobber_result N E) : nat :=
    (match clobber_roots result with [MemoryDef edge _] => source_budget edge | _ => 0 end) +
    match legacy_clobber_proposal function g result with
    | None => 0
    | Some candidate =>
        let cfg := audit_legacy_setup_cfg setup in
        let prep := audit_legacy_setup_prepared setup in
        audit_legacy_pair_input_budget EN node_enc function_enc site_enc
          (audit_legacy_successors_counted EN node_enc cfg prep) reads writes node_budget
            function_budget
          site_budget (audit_legacy_successors_input_budget node_enc node_budget (out_index prep))
          read_budget write_budget cfg prep node candidate function
    end.

  (** The branch recurrence is independent of the observer and retains the actual memo endpoints. *)
  Inductive audit_memo_legacy_one_input_budget (setup : Setup) :
      State -> N -> option (mem_node F N) -> State -> nat -> Prop :=
    | AuditMemoLegacyBudgetNoQuery : forall state node,
        audit_memo_legacy_request EN EE g mg (audit_legacy_setup_reached setup)
          (audit_legacy_setup_listed setup) (@memo_effect_index N E T EN g effects mg state)
          (fun n => fst (reads n)) (fun n => fst (load n)) node = None ->
        audit_memo_legacy_one_input_budget setup state node None state
          (5 + audit_memo_legacy_prefix_input_budget setup state node)
    | AuditMemoLegacyBudgetQuery : forall state node scope start result next query_cost,
        audit_memo_legacy_request EN EE g mg (audit_legacy_setup_reached setup)
          (audit_legacy_setup_listed setup) (@memo_effect_index N E T EN g effects mg state)
          (fun n => fst (reads n)) (fun n => fst (load n)) node = Some (scope, start) ->
        audit_memo_legacy_query_input_budget state scope start result next query_cost ->
        audit_memo_legacy_one_input_budget setup state node
          (legacy_retain EN EF ET function (audit_legacy_setup_cfg setup)
            (audit_legacy_setup_prepared setup) (audit_legacy_setup_reached setup)
            (fun n => fst (writes n)) (fun n => fst (reads n)) node
            (legacy_clobber_proposal function g result)) next
          (5 + audit_memo_legacy_prefix_input_budget setup state node + query_cost +
            audit_memo_legacy_finish_input_budget setup node result).

  (** The list recurrence sums each occurrence once while threading its memo and materialized
    index. *)
  Inductive audit_memo_legacy_nodes_input_budget (setup : Setup) :
      list N -> State -> Pairs -> Pairs -> State -> nat -> Prop :=
    | AuditMemoLegacyBudgetNil : forall state pairs,
        audit_memo_legacy_nodes_input_budget setup [] state pairs pairs state 2
    | AuditMemoLegacyBudgetCons : forall node rest state pairs candidate next final final_state
      one tail,
        audit_memo_legacy_one_input_budget setup state node candidate next one ->
        audit_memo_legacy_nodes_input_budget setup rest next (Map.set EN node candidate pairs)
          final final_state tail ->
        audit_memo_legacy_nodes_input_budget setup (node :: rest) state pairs final final_state
          (6 + one + 2 + node_budget node + 16 * Pos.size_nat (fst (node_enc node)) + tail).
End InputBudget.

Definition audit_memo_legacy_lookup_counted {F N CN} (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (pairs : Map.t N (option (mem_node F N))) (node : N) :=
  let '(found, body) := audit_map_get node_enc node pairs in
  (match found with Some candidate => candidate | None => None end, body).

(** Returned load queries use one concrete indexed read at the queried node. *)
Definition audit_memo_legacy_lookup_source_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall F N CN (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) node_work node_budget node_source
      (pairs : Map.t N (option (mem_node F N))) node,
    audit_external_callback_adapter node_enc node_work node_source node_budget ->
    4 + audit_map_source_work node_work (snd (audit_memo_legacy_lookup_counted node_enc pairs
      node)) <=
      9 + node_budget node + 5 * Pos.size_nat (fst (node_enc node)).

Section Complete.
  Context {F N E T CN CE CF SE XE OO TE OE BE LE RE WE : Type}.
  Context (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (EF : encoding F) (ET : encoding T).
  Context (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE).
  Context (function_enc : F -> positive * list CF) (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE).
  Context (source : E -> N * list XE) (out : N -> list E * list OO) (target : E -> N * list TE).
  Context (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE).
  Context (before : E -> nat -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE).
  Context (load : N -> option (E * nat) * list LE).
  Context (reads : N -> list (footprint T) * list RE) (writes : N -> list (footprint T) * list WE).
  Context (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E).
  Context (function : F) (fuel : positive) (state : memo_state EN g effects mg).

  Definition audit_memory_memo_legacy_check_counted :=
    let '(setup, (pairs, next, node_body)) := audit_memory_memo_legacy_project_counted EN EF ET
      node_enc edge_enc function_enc site_enc source out target operand before load reads writes
      g effects mg function fuel state in
    let '(accepted, check_body) := audit_legacy_no_clobber_counted EN EF ET node_enc
      function_enc site_enc
      out target reads writes function g (audit_memo_legacy_lookup_counted node_enc pairs) in
    (accepted, setup, pairs, next, node_body, check_body).

  (** The same counted run produces the exact public memo state and every materialized load
    answer. *)
  Definition audit_memory_memo_legacy_source_erases_at : Prop :=
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall e, fst (edge_enc e) = encode EE e) ->
    (forall f, fst (function_enc f) = encode EF f) ->
    (forall t, fst (site_enc t) = encode ET t) ->
    (forall e, fst (source e) = Graph.source g e) ->
    (forall n, fst (out n) = Graph.out g n) ->
    (forall e, fst (target e) = Graph.target g e) ->
    (forall n key, fst (operand n key) = memory_operand mg n key) ->
    (forall e i, fst (before e i) = memory_before mg e i) ->
    let '(_, (pairs, next, _)) := audit_memory_memo_legacy_project_counted EN EF ET node_enc
      edge_enc
      function_enc site_enc source out target operand before load reads writes g effects mg
      function fuel state in
    let original := audit_memory_memo_legacy_project EN EE EF ET function g effects
      (fun n => fst (writes n)) (fun n => fst (reads n)) mg state (fun n => fst (load n)) fuel in
    next = snd original /\
    (forall node, fst (audit_memo_legacy_lookup_counted node_enc pairs node) =
      def_of_load (fst original) node) /\
    let '(accepted, _, _, _, _, _) := audit_memory_memo_legacy_check_counted in
    accepted = no_clobber_check EN EF ET function g (fun n => fst (writes n))
      (fun n => fst (reads n)) (fst original).

  Context (node_work : list CN -> nat) (edge_work : list CE -> nat).
  Context (function_work : list CF -> nat) (site_work : list SE -> nat).
  Context (source_work : list XE -> nat) (out_work : list OO -> nat) (target_work : list TE -> nat).
  Context (operand_work : list OE -> nat) (before_work : list BE -> nat).
  Context (load_work : list LE -> nat) (read_work : list RE -> nat) (write_work : list WE -> nat).
  Context (node_budget out_budget load_budget read_budget write_budget : N -> nat).
  Context (edge_budget source_budget target_budget : E -> nat).
  Context (function_budget : F -> nat) (site_budget : T -> nat).
  Context (operand_budget : N -> option E -> nat) (before_budget : E -> nat -> nat).

  Definition audit_memory_memo_legacy_source_work : nat :=
    let '(setup, (_, _, node_body)) := audit_memory_memo_legacy_project_counted EN EF ET node_enc
      edge_enc function_enc site_enc source out target operand before load reads writes g effects mg
      function fuel state in
    4 + audit_legacy_setup_source_work EN node_work edge_work out_work target_work (fun _ => 0)
      setup +
    audit_memo_legacy_nodes_source_work EN node_work edge_work function_work site_work source_work
      operand_work before_work load_work read_work write_work node_body.

  Definition audit_memory_memo_legacy_check_source_work : nat :=
    let '(_, _, _, _, _, check_body) := audit_memory_memo_legacy_check_counted in
    audit_memory_memo_legacy_source_work +
    audit_legacy_no_clobber_source_work EN node_work function_work site_work out_work target_work
      read_work write_work (fun body => 4 + audit_map_source_work node_work body) check_body.

  (** The producer recurrence is witnessed by its actual output map and returned memo state. *)
  Definition audit_memory_memo_legacy_whole_input_bound_at : Prop :=
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall e, fst (edge_enc e) = encode EE e) ->
    (forall f, fst (function_enc f) = encode EF f) ->
    (forall t, fst (site_enc t) = encode ET t) ->
    (forall e, fst (source e) = Graph.source g e) ->
    (forall n, fst (out n) = Graph.out g n) ->
    (forall e, fst (target e) = Graph.target g e) ->
    (forall n key, fst (operand n key) = memory_operand mg n key) ->
    (forall e i, fst (before e i) = memory_before mg e i) ->
    forall node_source edge_source function_source site_source source_source out_source
      target_source
        operand_source before_source load_source reads_source writes_source,
      audit_external_callback_adapter node_enc node_work node_source node_budget ->
      audit_external_callback_adapter edge_enc edge_work edge_source edge_budget ->
      audit_external_callback_adapter function_enc function_work function_source function_budget ->
      audit_external_callback_adapter site_enc site_work site_source site_budget ->
      audit_external_callback_adapter source source_work source_source source_budget ->
      audit_external_callback_adapter out out_work out_source out_budget ->
      audit_external_callback_adapter target target_work target_source target_budget ->
      audit_external_callback_adapter (fun args => operand (fst args) (snd args)) operand_work
        operand_source (fun args => operand_budget (fst args) (snd args)) ->
      audit_external_callback_adapter (fun args => before (fst args) (snd args)) before_work
        before_source (fun args => before_budget (fst args) (snd args)) ->
      audit_external_callback_adapter load load_work load_source load_budget ->
      audit_external_callback_adapter reads read_work reads_source read_budget ->
      audit_external_callback_adapter writes write_work writes_source write_budget ->
      let '(setup, (pairs, next, _)) := audit_memory_memo_legacy_project_counted EN EF ET
        node_enc edge_enc
        function_enc site_enc source out target operand before load reads writes g effects mg
        function fuel state in
      exists budget,
        audit_memo_legacy_nodes_input_budget EN EE EF ET node_enc edge_enc function_enc site_enc
          source
          operand before load reads writes node_budget load_budget read_budget write_budget
            edge_budget
          source_budget function_budget site_budget operand_budget before_budget g effects mg
            function fuel
          setup (Graph.nodes g) state Map.empty pairs next budget /\
        audit_memory_memo_legacy_source_work <=
          4 + audit_legacy_setup_input_budget EN node_enc edge_enc out target
            (fun e => (effects e, @nil unit)) node_budget out_budget edge_budget target_budget
            (fun _ => 0) g + budget /\
        audit_memory_memo_legacy_check_source_work <=
          4 + audit_legacy_setup_input_budget EN node_enc edge_enc out target
            (fun e => (effects e, @nil unit)) node_budget out_budget edge_budget target_budget
            (fun _ => 0) g + budget +
          audit_legacy_no_clobber_input_budget EN node_enc function_enc site_enc out target
            reads writes
            (audit_memo_legacy_lookup_counted node_enc pairs) node_budget out_budget read_budget
              write_budget
```

## AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoPlain

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoPlain.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoPlain`.

```rocq
(** * Untraced binary-credit memo computation

    This fixed computational body contains no source-event fields or log construction.
    For example, a completed cache hit returns its roots, original cache and unchanged credit.
    Builds on: memory versions, persistent maps and sets, and binary-credit well-founded
      recursion. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List NArith PArith PeanoNat Wf_nat Lia.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryGraph AnalysesMemoryFlow AnalysesMemoryWalk.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryState.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryEncoding.
Import List.ListNotations.

Record audit_plain_memo_result (N E : Type) : Type := AuditPlainMemoResult {
  audit_plain_memo_value : memory_clobber_result N E;
  audit_plain_memo_cache : Map.t (positive * memory_version N E) (memo_entry N E);
  audit_plain_memo_credit : BinNums.N
}.
Arguments AuditPlainMemoResult {N E} _ _ _.
Arguments audit_plain_memo_value {N E} _.
Arguments audit_plain_memo_cache {N E} _.
Arguments audit_plain_memo_credit {N E} _.

Section PlainMemo.
  Context {N E : Type}.
  Let V := memory_version N E.
  Let M := Map.t (positive * V) (memo_entry N E).
  Let R := audit_plain_memo_result N E.
  Variable version_encoding : encoding V.
  Variable key_encoding : encoding (positive * V).
  Variable scope : positive.
  Variable next : V -> list V.

  Definition audit_plain_memo_bounded (fuel : BinNums.N) (run : R) : Prop :=
    (N.to_nat (audit_plain_memo_credit run) <= N.to_nat fuel)%nat.

  Fixpoint audit_plain_memo_children (bound : BinNums.N)
      (recur : forall credit, (N.to_nat credit < N.to_nat bound)%nat ->
        FinSet.t V -> M -> V -> {run : R | audit_plain_memo_bounded credit run})
      (active : FinSet.t V) (memo : M) (versions : list V) (credit : BinNums.N)
      (Hcredit : (N.to_nat credit < N.to_nat bound)%nat)
      {struct versions} : {run : R | audit_plain_memo_bounded credit run}.
  Proof.
    destruct versions as [| v rest].
    - exists (AuditPlainMemoResult (MemoryClobberResult [] true) memo credit).
      apply Nat.le_refl.
    - destruct (recur credit Hcredit active memo v) as [one Hone].
      assert (Hsmaller : (N.to_nat (audit_plain_memo_credit one) < N.to_nat bound)%nat).
      { unfold audit_plain_memo_bounded in Hone. lia. }
      destruct (audit_plain_memo_children bound recur active (audit_plain_memo_cache one) rest
        (audit_plain_memo_credit one) Hsmaller) as [tail Htail].
      let roots := constr:(FinSet.elements (FinSet.of_list version_encoding
        (clobber_roots (audit_plain_memo_value one) ++ clobber_roots (audit_plain_memo_value
          tail)))) in
      exists (AuditPlainMemoResult
        (MemoryClobberResult roots (andb (clobber_complete (audit_plain_memo_value one))
          (clobber_complete (audit_plain_memo_value tail))))
        (audit_plain_memo_cache tail) (audit_plain_memo_credit tail)).
      unfold audit_plain_memo_bounded in *. cbn. lia.
  Defined.

  (** The only runtime credit operation is binary predecessor; unary conversions occur in Prop. *)
  Definition audit_plain_memo_body (fuel : BinNums.N)
      (recur : forall credit, (N.to_nat credit < N.to_nat fuel)%nat ->
        FinSet.t V -> M -> V -> {run : R | audit_plain_memo_bounded credit run})
      (active : FinSet.t V) (memo : M) (v : V) :
      {run : R | audit_plain_memo_bounded fuel run}.
  Proof.
    destruct (FinSet.mem version_encoding v active).
    - exists (AuditPlainMemoResult (MemoryClobberResult [v] false) memo fuel).
      apply Nat.le_refl.
    - destruct (Map.get key_encoding (scope, v) memo) as [[| roots] |].
      + exists (AuditPlainMemoResult (MemoryClobberResult [v] false) memo fuel).
        apply Nat.le_refl.
      + exists (AuditPlainMemoResult (MemoryClobberResult roots true) memo fuel).
        apply Nat.le_refl.
      + destruct fuel as [| positive_fuel].
        * exists (AuditPlainMemoResult (MemoryClobberResult [v] false) memo 0%N).
          apply Nat.le_refl.
        * pose (credit := N.pred (Npos positive_fuel)).
          assert (Hcredit : (N.to_nat credit < N.to_nat (Npos positive_fuel))%nat).
          { unfold credit. rewrite N2Nat.inj_pred.
            cbn. pose proof (Pos2Nat.is_pos positive_fuel) as Hpositive. lia. }
          destruct (next v) as [| first rest].
          -- exists (AuditPlainMemoResult (MemoryClobberResult [v] true)
               (Map.set key_encoding (scope, v) (MemoDone [v]) memo) credit).
             unfold audit_plain_memo_bounded. cbn. lia.
          -- destruct (audit_plain_memo_children (Npos positive_fuel) recur
               (FinSet.add version_encoding v active) memo (first :: rest) credit Hcredit)
               as [children Hchildren].
             exists (AuditPlainMemoResult (audit_plain_memo_value children)
               (if clobber_complete (audit_plain_memo_value children) then
                  Map.set key_encoding (scope, v) (MemoDone (clobber_roots
                    (audit_plain_memo_value children))) (audit_plain_memo_cache children)
                else audit_plain_memo_cache children) (audit_plain_memo_credit children)).
             unfold audit_plain_memo_bounded in *. cbn. lia.
  Defined.

  Definition audit_memo_compute (fuel : BinNums.N) (active : FinSet.t V) (memo : M) (v : V) : R :=
    proj1_sig (Fix (well_founded_ltof BinNums.N N.to_nat)
      (fun credit => forall active memo v,
        {run : R | audit_plain_memo_bounded credit run}) audit_plain_memo_body fuel active memo v).
End PlainMemo.

Example audit_plain_memo_terminal_fixture :
  let version_encoding := memory_version_encoding positive_encoding positive_encoding in
  let key_encoding := pair_encoding positive_encoding version_encoding in
  let run := audit_memo_compute version_encoding key_encoding 1%positive
    (fun _ => []) 1%N FinSet.empty Map.empty MemoryLive in
  audit_plain_memo_value run = MemoryClobberResult [MemoryLive] true /\
    audit_plain_memo_credit run = 0%N.
Proof.
  vm_compute.
  split; reflexivity.
Qed.
```

```rocq
(** * Fixed public memo query with concrete predecessor reads

    The public source mirror reads predecessors from the saved state's actual incoming trie.
    For example, snapshot queries continue to execute the stored graph after an epoch reuse hit.
    Builds on: plain public memo queries, binary-credit source execution and stored snapshots. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith NArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet.

Definition audit_memory_memo_public_source_counted {N E T CN CE SE OE BE}
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
    (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE) (EN : encoding N) (g : Graph.t N E)
    (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E)
    (state : memo_state EN g effects mg)
    (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE)
    (before : E -> nat -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE) scope start fuel :=
  audit_memory_memo_query_counted node_enc edge_enc site_enc EN g effects mg state
    (audit_walk_predecessors node_enc (in_index (@memo_adjacency N E T EN g effects mg state)))
    operand before scope start fuel.

Definition audit_memory_memo_public_source_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CN CE SE OE BE (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (ET : encoding T)
      (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
      (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE) (g : Graph.t N E)
      (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E)
      (state : memo_state EN g effects mg)
      (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE)
      (before : E -> nat -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE) scope start fuel,
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall e, fst (edge_enc e) = encode EE e) ->
    (forall t, fst (site_enc t) = encode ET t) ->

    (forall e i, fst (before e i) = memory_before mg e i) ->

      effects mg
      state operand before scope start fuel) in
    let original := audit_memory_memo_query EN EE ET g effects mg state scope start fuel in
    audit_memo_value run = fst original /\
    audit_memo_cache run = @memo_entries N E T EN g effects mg (snd original).

(** The whole input recurrence closes every internal encoder and concrete saved predecessor read. *)
Definition audit_memory_memo_public_whole_input_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CN CE SE OE BE (EN : encoding N)
      (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
      (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE) (g : Graph.t N E)
      (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E)
      (state : memo_state EN g effects mg)
      (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE)
      (before : E -> nat -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE)
      node_work edge_work site_work operand_work before_work
      node_budget edge_budget site_budget operand_budget before_budget scope start fuel,
    (forall n, node_work (snd (node_enc n)) <= node_budget n) ->
    (forall e, edge_work (snd (edge_enc e)) <= edge_budget e) ->
    (forall t, site_work (snd (site_enc t)) <= site_budget t) ->
    (forall n key, operand_work (snd (operand n key)) <= operand_budget n key) ->
    (forall e i, before_work (snd (before e i)) <= before_budget e i) ->
    let incoming := audit_walk_predecessors node_enc
      (in_index (@memo_adjacency N E T EN g effects mg state)) in
    let '(encoded_scope, run) := audit_memory_memo_public_source_counted node_enc edge_enc
      site_enc EN
      g effects mg state operand before scope start fuel in
    let version_enc := audit_memory_version_encode node_enc edge_enc in
    let key_enc := audit_memory_memo_key_encode node_enc edge_enc in
    let next := audit_memory_raw_next edge_enc site_enc
      (@memo_effect_index N E T EN g effects mg state) incoming operand before scope in
    exists budget,
      audit_memo_input_budget_run version_enc key_enc (fst encoded_scope) next
        (audit_memory_version_input_budget node_enc edge_enc node_budget edge_budget)
        (audit_memory_memo_key_input_budget node_enc edge_enc node_budget edge_budget)
        (@audit_raw_next_input_budget N E T CE SE (audit_map_event N (list E) CN) OE BE
          edge_enc site_enc (@memo_effect_index N E T EN g effects mg state) incoming before
          edge_budget site_budget (audit_walk_predecessor_input_budget node_enc node_budget)
          operand_budget before_budget scope)
        FinSet.empty (@memo_entries N E T EN g effects mg state) start (Npos fuel)
        (audit_memo_value run) (audit_memo_cache run) (audit_memo_credit run) budget /\
      4 + audit_memory_scope_work site_work (snd encoded_scope) +
        audit_memo_execution_source_work (audit_memory_version_work node_work edge_work)

          (audit_raw_next_source_work edge_work site_work (audit_map_source_work node_work)
            operand_work before_work) run <=
      4 + audit_memory_scope_input_budget site_enc site_budget scope +
        16 * S (Pos.size_nat fuel) * budget.

Definition audit_snapshot_query_source_counted {N E T Epoch CN CE SE OE BE}
    (EN : encoding N) (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)

Definition audit_snapshot_query_source_erases_statement : Prop :=
```

## AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoSnapshot

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoSnapshot.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoSnapshot`.

```rocq
(** * Snapshot-valued memo state and exact epoch refresh

    The prepared graph and effect index are dependent values inside one stored snapshot.
    A matching epoch returns the complete cache unchanged. A miss prepares and indexes
    the new snapshot and starts with an empty memo table. This avoids transporting a
    dependent cache across merely pointwise observation equality. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryGraph AnalysesMemoryWalk.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditCost.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryState.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryEncoding.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryMemo.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryTable.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphAuditBase.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphAuditDfs.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditPrimitive.
Import List.ListNotations.

Record audit_snapshot_memo_cache (N E T Epoch : Type) (EN : encoding N) : Type :=
  AuditSnapshotMemoCache {
    audit_cache_snapshot : memo_snapshot N E T Epoch;
    audit_cache_prepared : prepared EN (snapshot_graph audit_cache_snapshot);
    audit_cache_effect_index : Map.t E (Map.t nat (memory_effect T));
    audit_cache_entries : Map.t (positive * memory_version N E) (memo_entry N E)
  }.
Arguments AuditSnapshotMemoCache {N E T Epoch EN}.
Arguments audit_cache_snapshot {N E T Epoch EN} _.
Arguments audit_cache_prepared {N E T Epoch EN} _.
Arguments audit_cache_effect_index {N E T Epoch EN} _.
Arguments audit_cache_entries {N E T Epoch EN} _.

Inductive audit_snapshot_refresh_event (N E T Epoch CE CN OE FE : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditSnapshotEpochCompare (old current : Epoch) (old_code current_code : positive)
      (old_body current_body : list CE) (result : bool) (calls : list audit_positive_eqb_event)
  | AuditSnapshotRefreshHit
  | AuditSnapshotRefreshMiss (prepare_events : list (audit_prepare_nested_event N E (list CN)))
      (table_events : list (audit_memory_table_event N E T CE OE FE)).
Arguments AuditSnapshotEpochCompare {N E T Epoch CE CN OE FE} _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _.
Arguments AuditSnapshotRefreshHit {N E T Epoch CE CN OE FE}.
Arguments AuditSnapshotRefreshMiss {N E T Epoch CE CN OE FE} _ _.

Definition audit_snapshot_prepare_callbacks {N E CN}
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (g : Graph.t N E) :
    audit_prepare_callback_model N E (list CN) :=
  @AuditPrepareCallbackModel N E (list CN)
    (fun n => (Graph.out g n, [])) (fun e => (Graph.target g e, []))
    (fun n => let '(code, trace) := node_enc n in (code, [trace])).

Definition audit_snapshot_out_adapter {N E OE} (g : Graph.t N E)
    : N -> list E * list OE := fun n => (Graph.out g n, []).

Definition audit_snapshot_effect_adapter {E T FE}
    (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE :=
  fun e => (effects e, []).

Definition audit_snapshot_refresh {N E T Epoch CE CN OE FE}
    (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (epoch_enc : Epoch -> positive * list CE)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
    (out : N -> list E * list OE) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE)
    (old : audit_snapshot_memo_cache N E T Epoch EN)
    (current : memo_snapshot N E T Epoch)
    : audit_snapshot_memo_cache N E T Epoch EN *
      list (audit_snapshot_refresh_event N E T Epoch CE CN OE FE) :=
  let old_snapshot := audit_cache_snapshot old in
  let '(old_code, old_trace) := epoch_enc (snapshot_epoch old_snapshot) in
  let '(current_code, current_trace) := epoch_enc (snapshot_epoch current) in
  let '(same, compare_events) := audit_positive_eqb old_code current_code in
  if same then
    (old, [AuditSnapshotEpochCompare (snapshot_epoch old_snapshot) (snapshot_epoch current)
      old_code current_code old_trace current_trace same compare_events; AuditSnapshotRefreshHit])
  else
    let '(prepared_index, prepare_events) := audit_graph_prepare_nested_counted EN
      (snapshot_graph current) (audit_snapshot_prepare_callbacks node_enc (snapshot_graph
        current)) in
    let '(table, table_events) := audit_memory_effect_table edge_enc out effects
      (Graph.nodes (snapshot_graph current)) in
    (AuditSnapshotMemoCache current prepared_index table Map.empty,
      [AuditSnapshotEpochCompare (snapshot_epoch old_snapshot) (snapshot_epoch current)
        old_code current_code old_trace current_trace same compare_events;
       AuditSnapshotRefreshMiss prepare_events table_events]).

Definition audit_snapshot_refresh_match_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E (T Epoch CE CN OE FE : Type) (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (epoch_enc : Epoch -> positive * list CE) (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (out : N -> list E * list OE)
    (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE)
    (old : audit_snapshot_memo_cache N E T Epoch EN) (current : memo_snapshot N E T Epoch),
    let '(result, events) := audit_snapshot_refresh EN EE epoch_enc node_enc edge_enc out effects
      old current in
    Pos.eqb (fst (epoch_enc (snapshot_epoch (audit_cache_snapshot old))))
      (fst (epoch_enc (snapshot_epoch current))) = true ->
    result = old /\ audit_cache_snapshot result = audit_cache_snapshot old /\
    audit_cache_effect_index result = audit_cache_effect_index old /\
    audit_cache_entries result = audit_cache_entries old /\
    length events = 2.

Definition audit_snapshot_refresh_match_execution_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E (T Epoch CE CN OE FE : Type) (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (epoch_enc : Epoch -> positive * list CE) (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (out : N -> list E * list OE)
    (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE)
    (old : audit_snapshot_memo_cache N E T Epoch EN) (current : memo_snapshot N E T Epoch),
    let '(result, events) := audit_snapshot_refresh EN EE epoch_enc node_enc edge_enc out effects
      old current in
    let old_snapshot := audit_cache_snapshot old in
    let '(old_code, old_body) := epoch_enc (snapshot_epoch old_snapshot) in
    let '(current_code, current_body) := epoch_enc (snapshot_epoch current) in
    let '(same, compare_events) := audit_positive_eqb old_code current_code in
    same = true ->
    result = old /\ events =
      [AuditSnapshotEpochCompare (snapshot_epoch old_snapshot) (snapshot_epoch current)
        old_code current_code old_body current_body same compare_events; AuditSnapshotRefreshHit].

Definition audit_snapshot_refresh_miss_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E (T Epoch CE CN OE FE : Type) (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (epoch_enc : Epoch -> positive * list CE) (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (out : N -> list E * list OE)
    (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE)
    (old : audit_snapshot_memo_cache N E T Epoch EN) (current : memo_snapshot N E T Epoch),
    let '(result, events) := audit_snapshot_refresh EN EE epoch_enc node_enc edge_enc out effects
      old current in
    Pos.eqb (fst (epoch_enc (snapshot_epoch (audit_cache_snapshot old))))
      (fst (epoch_enc (snapshot_epoch current))) = false ->
    (forall e, fst (edge_enc e) = encode EE e) ->
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall n, fst (out n) = Graph.out (snapshot_graph current) n) ->
    (forall e, fst (effects e) = snapshot_effects current e) ->
    audit_cache_snapshot result = current /\ audit_cache_entries result = Map.empty /\
    audit_cache_effect_index result = memory_walk_effect_table EE (snapshot_graph current)
      (snapshot_effects current) /\ length events = 2.

Definition audit_snapshot_refresh_miss_execution_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E (T Epoch CE CN OE FE : Type) (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (epoch_enc : Epoch -> positive * list CE) (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (out : N -> list E * list OE)
    (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE)
    (old : audit_snapshot_memo_cache N E T Epoch EN) (current : memo_snapshot N E T Epoch),
    let '(result, events) := audit_snapshot_refresh EN EE epoch_enc node_enc edge_enc out effects
      old current in
    let old_snapshot := audit_cache_snapshot old in
    let '(old_code, old_body) := epoch_enc (snapshot_epoch old_snapshot) in
    let '(current_code, current_body) := epoch_enc (snapshot_epoch current) in
    let '(same, compare_events) := audit_positive_eqb old_code current_code in
    same = false ->
    events =
      [AuditSnapshotEpochCompare (snapshot_epoch old_snapshot) (snapshot_epoch current)
        old_code current_code old_body current_body same compare_events;
       AuditSnapshotRefreshMiss
         (snd (audit_graph_prepare_nested_counted EN (snapshot_graph current)
           (audit_snapshot_prepare_callbacks node_enc (snapshot_graph current))))
         (snd (audit_memory_effect_table edge_enc out effects (Graph.nodes (snapshot_graph
           current))))].

(** This validity proposition concerns the saved snapshot's own dependent values.
    Cross-snapshot reuse requires an explicit epoch identity law and domain law. *)
Definition audit_snapshot_cache_valid {N E T Epoch} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (cache : audit_snapshot_memo_cache N E T Epoch EN) : Prop :=
  audit_cache_prepared cache = prepare EN (snapshot_graph (audit_cache_snapshot cache)) /\
  audit_cache_effect_index cache = memory_walk_effect_table EE
    (snapshot_graph (audit_cache_snapshot cache)) (snapshot_effects (audit_cache_snapshot cache)) /\
  Map.wf (memo_key EN EE) (audit_cache_entries cache) /\
  (forall k, Map.get (memo_key EN EE) k (audit_cache_entries cache) <> Some MemoBusy).

Definition audit_snapshot_refresh_observation_context_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T Epoch (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (ET : encoding T)
    (EEpoch : encoding Epoch)
    (domain : memo_snapshot N E T Epoch -> Prop)
    (epoch_identity : forall (old current : memo_snapshot N E T Epoch),
      Pos.eqb (encode EEpoch (snapshot_epoch old)) (encode EEpoch (snapshot_epoch current)) = true
        ->
      snapshot_epoch old = snapshot_epoch current)
    (laws : memo_epoch_laws domain) (old current : memo_snapshot N E T Epoch),
    domain old -> domain current ->
    Pos.eqb (encode EEpoch (snapshot_epoch old)) (encode EEpoch (snapshot_epoch current)) = true ->
    snapshot_epoch old = snapshot_epoch current /\
    graph_observations_equal (snapshot_graph old) (snapshot_graph current) /\
    (forall e, snapshot_effects old e = snapshot_effects current e) /\
    memory_observations_equal (snapshot_memory old) (snapshot_memory current).

Definition audit_snapshot_refresh_epoch_compare_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall Epoch CE (EEpoch : encoding Epoch) (epoch_enc : Epoch -> positive * list CE) old current,
    (forall epoch, fst (epoch_enc epoch) = encode EEpoch epoch) ->
    Pos.eqb (fst (epoch_enc old)) (fst (epoch_enc current)) =
      epoch_matches EEpoch old current.

Fixpoint audit_snapshot_refresh_source_work {N E T Epoch CE CN OE FE}
    (epoch_work : list CE -> nat) (node_work : list CN -> nat)
    (edge_work : list CE -> nat) (out_work : list OE -> nat) (effect_work : list FE -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_snapshot_refresh_event N E T Epoch CE CN OE FE)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditSnapshotEpochCompare _ _ _ _ old_body current_body _ eq_events :: rest =>
      2 + epoch_work old_body + epoch_work current_body + audit_positive_eqb_source_work eq_events +
        audit_snapshot_refresh_source_work epoch_work node_work edge_work out_work effect_work rest
  | AuditSnapshotRefreshHit :: rest => 2 +
      audit_snapshot_refresh_source_work epoch_work node_work edge_work out_work effect_work rest
  | AuditSnapshotRefreshMiss prepare_events table_events :: rest =>
      audit_graph_prepare_nested_total_work node_work prepare_events +
      audit_memory_table_work edge_work out_work effect_work table_events +
      audit_snapshot_refresh_source_work epoch_work node_work edge_work out_work effect_work rest
  end.
```

## AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoSnapshotSource

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoSnapshotSource.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoSnapshotSource`.

```rocq
(** * Snapshot refresh with complete graph callbacks

    Refresh captures outgoing, target and encoder bodies in the actual full prepare execution.
    For example, a matching epoch preserves the saved graph, effect table and completed memo.
    Builds on: snapshot-valued caches, full graph preparation and the fixed memo query. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsAuditCost.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare GraphAuditBase.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryGraph AnalysesMemoryWalk.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryState.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryEncoding.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditPrimitive.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoSnapshot.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryTable.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemorySharedBudget.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoExecute.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryGraphCallbacks.
Import List.ListNotations.

Inductive audit_snapshot_refresh_source_event (N E T Epoch CE CN OE FE TE : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditSnapshotSourceEpoch (old current : Epoch) (old_body current_body : list CE)
      (comparison : list audit_positive_eqb_event)
  | AuditSnapshotSourceHit
  | AuditSnapshotSourceMiss
      (preparation : list (audit_prepare_source_event N E (audit_snapshot_graph_body CN OE TE)))
      (table : list (audit_memory_table_event N E T CE OE FE)).
Arguments AuditSnapshotSourceEpoch {N E T Epoch CE CN OE FE TE} _ _ _ _ _.
Arguments AuditSnapshotSourceHit {N E T Epoch CE CN OE FE TE}.
Arguments AuditSnapshotSourceMiss {N E T Epoch CE CN OE FE TE} _ _.

Definition audit_snapshot_refresh_source {N E T Epoch CE CN OE FE TE}
    (EN : encoding N) (epoch_enc : Epoch -> positive * list CE)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
    (out : N -> list E * list OE) (target : E -> N * list TE)
    (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE)
    (old : audit_snapshot_memo_cache N E T Epoch EN) (current : memo_snapshot N E T Epoch) :
    audit_snapshot_memo_cache N E T Epoch EN *
      list (audit_snapshot_refresh_source_event N E T Epoch CE CN OE FE TE) :=
  let old_epoch := snapshot_epoch (audit_cache_snapshot old) in
  let current_epoch := snapshot_epoch current in
  let '(old_code, old_body) := epoch_enc old_epoch in
  let '(current_code, current_body) := epoch_enc current_epoch in
  let '(same, comparison) := audit_positive_eqb old_code current_code in
  let prefix := AuditSnapshotSourceEpoch old_epoch current_epoch old_body current_body comparison in
  if same then (old, [prefix; AuditSnapshotSourceHit])
  else
    let '(prepared, preparation) := audit_prepare_source_counted EN (snapshot_graph current)
      (audit_snapshot_graph_callbacks node_enc out target) in
    let '(table, rows) := audit_memory_effect_table edge_enc out effects
      (Graph.nodes (snapshot_graph current)) in
    (AuditSnapshotMemoCache current prepared table Map.empty,
      [prefix; AuditSnapshotSourceMiss preparation rows]).

Fixpoint audit_snapshot_refresh_full_source_work {N E T Epoch CE CN OE FE TE}
    (epoch_work : list CE -> nat) (node_work : list CN -> nat) (edge_work : list CE -> nat)
    (out_work : list OE -> nat) (effect_work : list FE -> nat) (target_work : list TE -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_snapshot_refresh_source_event N E T Epoch CE CN OE FE TE)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditSnapshotSourceEpoch _ _ old_body current_body comparison :: rest =>
      2 + epoch_work old_body + epoch_work current_body +
      audit_positive_eqb_source_work comparison +
      audit_snapshot_refresh_full_source_work epoch_work node_work edge_work out_work
        effect_work target_work rest
  | AuditSnapshotSourceHit :: rest => 2 +
      audit_snapshot_refresh_full_source_work epoch_work node_work edge_work out_work
        effect_work target_work rest
  | AuditSnapshotSourceMiss preparation table :: rest =>
      6 + audit_prepare_source_work (audit_snapshot_graph_body_work node_work out_work target_work)
        preparation + audit_memory_table_work edge_work out_work effect_work table +
      audit_snapshot_refresh_full_source_work epoch_work node_work edge_work out_work
        effect_work target_work rest
  end.

Definition audit_snapshot_refresh_input_budget {N E T Epoch CE CN OE FE TE}
    (EN : encoding N) (epoch_enc : Epoch -> positive * list CE)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
    (out : N -> list E * list OE) (target : E -> N * list TE)
    (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE)
    (epoch_budget : Epoch -> nat) (node_budget out_budget : N -> nat)
    (edge_budget effect_budget target_budget : E -> nat)
    (old : audit_snapshot_memo_cache N E T Epoch EN) (current : memo_snapshot N E T Epoch) : nat :=
  let old_epoch := snapshot_epoch (audit_cache_snapshot old) in
  let current_epoch := snapshot_epoch current in
  let old_code := fst (epoch_enc old_epoch) in
  let current_code := fst (epoch_enc current_epoch) in
  4 + epoch_budget old_epoch + epoch_budget current_epoch +
  2 * Nat.min (Pos.size_nat old_code) (Pos.size_nat current_code) +
  if Pos.eqb old_code current_code then 0 else
    let g := snapshot_graph current in
    6 + audit_prepare_source_budget EN g +
      audit_graph_prepare_full_event_bound g *
        audit_snapshot_graph_input_budget out target node_budget out_budget target_budget
          (Graph.nodes g) +
      audit_memory_table_input_budget edge_enc out effects edge_budget out_budget effect_budget
        (Graph.nodes g).

(** A hit preserves the complete saved snapshot and all dependent cache values exactly. *)
Definition audit_snapshot_refresh_source_hit_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T Epoch CE CN OE FE TE (EN : encoding N)
      (epoch_enc : Epoch -> positive * list CE) (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
      (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (out : N -> list E * list OE)
      (target : E -> N * list TE) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE)
      old current,
    Pos.eqb (fst (epoch_enc (snapshot_epoch (audit_cache_snapshot old))))
      (fst (epoch_enc (snapshot_epoch current))) = true ->
    fst (audit_snapshot_refresh_source EN epoch_enc node_enc edge_enc out target effects old
      current) =
      old.

(** A miss constructs both saved indexes from the exact current snapshot callback observations. *)
Definition audit_snapshot_refresh_source_miss_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T Epoch CE CN OE FE TE (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
      (epoch_enc : Epoch -> positive * list CE) (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
      (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (out : N -> list E * list OE)
      (target : E -> N * list TE) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE)
      old current,
    Pos.eqb (fst (epoch_enc (snapshot_epoch (audit_cache_snapshot old))))
      (fst (epoch_enc (snapshot_epoch current))) = false ->
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall e, fst (edge_enc e) = encode EE e) ->
    (forall n, fst (out n) = Graph.out (snapshot_graph current) n) ->
    (forall e, fst (target e) = Graph.target (snapshot_graph current) e) ->
    (forall e, fst (effects e) = snapshot_effects current e) ->
    let result := fst (audit_snapshot_refresh_source EN epoch_enc node_enc edge_enc out target
      effects
      old current) in
    result = AuditSnapshotMemoCache current (prepare EN (snapshot_graph current))
      (memory_walk_effect_table EE (snapshot_graph current) (snapshot_effects current)) Map.empty.

(** The complete refresh bound includes every graph callback and concrete table setup body. *)
Definition audit_snapshot_refresh_whole_input_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T Epoch CE CN OE FE TE (EN : encoding N)
      (epoch_enc : Epoch -> positive * list CE) (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
      (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (out : N -> list E * list OE)
      (target : E -> N * list TE) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE)
      epoch_work node_work edge_work out_work effect_work target_work
      epoch_budget node_budget edge_budget out_budget effect_budget target_budget old current,
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall n, fst (out n) = Graph.out (snapshot_graph current) n) ->
    (forall e, fst (target e) = Graph.target (snapshot_graph current) e) ->
    (forall epoch, epoch_work (snd (epoch_enc epoch)) <= epoch_budget epoch) ->
    (forall n, node_work (snd (node_enc n)) <= node_budget n) ->
    (forall e, edge_work (snd (edge_enc e)) <= edge_budget e) ->
    (forall n, out_work (snd (out n)) <= out_budget n) ->
    (forall e, effect_work (snd (effects e)) <= effect_budget e) ->
    (forall e, target_work (snd (target e)) <= target_budget e) ->
    audit_snapshot_refresh_full_source_work epoch_work node_work edge_work out_work effect_work
      target_work (snd (audit_snapshot_refresh_source EN epoch_enc node_enc edge_enc out target
        effects old current)) <=
    audit_snapshot_refresh_input_budget EN epoch_enc node_enc edge_enc out target effects
      epoch_budget node_budget out_budget edge_budget effect_budget target_budget old current.

(** Query executes the stored snapshot values, including after cross-snapshot epoch reuse. *)
Definition audit_snapshot_query {N E T Epoch} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (ET : encoding T)
    (cache : audit_snapshot_memo_cache N E T Epoch EN) (q : memory_scope T)
    (start : memory_version N E) (fuel : positive) :
    memory_clobber_result N E * audit_snapshot_memo_cache N E T Epoch EN :=
  let saved := audit_cache_snapshot cache in
  let state := @MemoState N E T EN (snapshot_graph saved) (snapshot_effects saved)
    (snapshot_memory saved) (audit_cache_prepared cache) (audit_cache_effect_index cache)
    (audit_cache_entries cache) in
  let '(result, final) := audit_memory_memo_query EN EE ET (snapshot_graph saved)
    (snapshot_effects saved) (snapshot_memory saved) state q start fuel in
  (result, AuditSnapshotMemoCache saved (audit_cache_prepared cache) (audit_cache_effect_index
    cache)
    (@memo_entries N E T EN (snapshot_graph saved) (snapshot_effects saved) (snapshot_memory saved)
      final)).

(** Queries preserve the exact saved snapshot and both prepared indexes while threading entries. *)
Definition audit_snapshot_query_saved_values_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T Epoch (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (ET : encoding T) cache q start fuel,
    let final := snd (@audit_snapshot_query N E T Epoch EN EE ET cache q start fuel) in
    audit_cache_snapshot final = audit_cache_snapshot cache /\
    (forall n, pred_edges (audit_cache_prepared final) n =
      pred_edges (audit_cache_prepared cache) n) /\
    audit_cache_effect_index final = audit_cache_effect_index cache.
```
