## AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoWhole

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoWhole.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoWhole`.

```rocq
(** * Whole memo-walk operand recurrence

    This independent recurrence computes a budget from actual states and intermediate roots.
    For example, a completed memo hit pays its two probes and performs no successor expansion.
    Builds on: memo execution rules, concrete memory input budgets and collection dimensions. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List NArith PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryGraph AnalysesMemoryWalk.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryState.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryEncoding.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditFinSet.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditMap.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditElements.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditEncoding.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditEncoderBudget.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryRawNext.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryInputBudget.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryMemo.
Import List.ListNotations.

Fixpoint audit_memo_build_input_budget {N E CV}
    (enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
    (budget : memory_version N E -> nat) (roots : list (memory_version N E)) : nat :=
  match roots with
  | [] => 1
  | root :: rest => 3 + budget root + 16 * Pos.size_nat (fst (enc root)) +
      audit_memo_build_input_budget enc budget rest
  end.

Definition audit_memo_union_input_budget {N E CV}
    (enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
    (budget : memory_version N E -> nat) (left right : list (memory_version N E)) : nat :=
  let input := left ++ right in
  let set := fst (audit_finset_of_list enc input) in
  2 + length left + audit_memo_build_input_budget enc budget input +
    19 * audit_trie_nodes set + audit_trie_output_bits set + 6.

Section MemoBudget.
  Context {N E CV CK NE : Type}.
  Let V := memory_version N E.
  Let M := Map.t (positive * V) (memo_entry N E).
  Variable version_enc : V -> positive * list CV.
  Variable key_enc : (positive * V) -> positive * list CK.
  Variable scope : positive.
  Variable next : V -> list V * list NE.
  Variable version_budget : V -> nat.
  Variable key_budget : (positive * V) -> nat.
  Variable next_budget : V -> nat.

  Definition audit_memo_active_input_budget (v : V) : nat :=
    8 + version_budget v + 5 * Pos.size_nat (fst (version_enc v)).

  Definition audit_memo_lookup_input_budget (v : V) : nat :=
    7 + key_budget (scope, v) + 5 * Pos.size_nat (fst (key_enc (scope, v))).

  Definition audit_memo_store_input_budget (v : V) : nat :=
    4 + key_budget (scope, v) + 16 * Pos.size_nat (fst (key_enc (scope, v))).

  Definition audit_memo_add_active_input_budget (v : V) : nat :=
    4 + version_budget v + 16 * Pos.size_nat (fst (version_enc v)).

  Definition audit_memo_probe_input_budget (v : V) : nat :=
    audit_memo_active_input_budget v + audit_memo_lookup_input_budget v.

  (** These clauses contain input and intermediate values but no execution event or work fold. *)
  Inductive audit_memo_input_budget_run : FinSet.t V -> M -> V -> BinNums.N ->
      memory_clobber_result N E -> M -> BinNums.N -> nat -> Prop :=
    | AuditMemoBudgetActive : forall active memo v fuel,
        fst (audit_finset_mem version_enc v active) = true ->
        audit_memo_input_budget_run active memo v fuel
          (MemoryClobberResult [v] false) memo fuel (audit_memo_active_input_budget v)
    | AuditMemoBudgetDone : forall active memo v fuel roots,
        fst (audit_finset_mem version_enc v active) = false ->
        fst (audit_map_get key_enc (scope, v) memo) = Some (MemoDone roots) ->
        audit_memo_input_budget_run active memo v fuel
          (MemoryClobberResult roots true) memo fuel (audit_memo_probe_input_budget v)
    | AuditMemoBudgetBusy : forall active memo v fuel,
        fst (audit_finset_mem version_enc v active) = false ->
        fst (audit_map_get key_enc (scope, v) memo) = Some MemoBusy ->
        audit_memo_input_budget_run active memo v fuel
          (MemoryClobberResult [v] false) memo fuel (audit_memo_probe_input_budget v)
    | AuditMemoBudgetFuel : forall active memo v,
        fst (audit_finset_mem version_enc v active) = false ->
        fst (audit_map_get key_enc (scope, v) memo) = None ->
        audit_memo_input_budget_run active memo v 0%N
          (MemoryClobberResult [v] false) memo 0%N (audit_memo_probe_input_budget v)
    | AuditMemoBudgetTerminal : forall active memo v fuel,
        fst (audit_finset_mem version_enc v active) = false ->
        fst (audit_map_get key_enc (scope, v) memo) = None -> fst (next v) = [] ->
        audit_memo_input_budget_run active memo v (N.succ fuel)
          (MemoryClobberResult [v] true)
          (fst (audit_map_set key_enc (scope, v) (MemoDone [v]) memo)) fuel
          (audit_memo_probe_input_budget v + 2 + next_budget v + audit_memo_store_input_budget v)
    | AuditMemoBudgetBranch : forall active memo v fuel first rest result final remaining cost,
        fst (audit_finset_mem version_enc v active) = false ->
        fst (audit_map_get key_enc (scope, v) memo) = None -> fst (next v) = first :: rest ->
        audit_memo_children_input_budget_run
          (fst (audit_finset_add version_enc v active)) memo (first :: rest) fuel
          result final remaining cost ->
        audit_memo_input_budget_run active memo v (N.succ fuel) result
          (if clobber_complete result then
            fst (audit_map_set key_enc (scope, v) (MemoDone (clobber_roots result)) final)
           else final) remaining
          (audit_memo_probe_input_budget v + 2 + next_budget v +
           audit_memo_add_active_input_budget v + cost +
           if clobber_complete result then audit_memo_store_input_budget v else 0)
  with audit_memo_children_input_budget_run : FinSet.t V -> M -> list V -> BinNums.N ->
      memory_clobber_result N E -> M -> BinNums.N -> nat -> Prop :=
    | AuditMemoBudgetChildrenNil : forall active memo fuel,
        audit_memo_children_input_budget_run active memo [] fuel
          (MemoryClobberResult [] true) memo fuel 0
    | AuditMemoBudgetChildrenCons : forall active memo v vs fuel one memo' fuel'
        tail memo'' fuel'' first_cost tail_cost,
        audit_memo_input_budget_run active memo v fuel one memo' fuel' first_cost ->
        audit_memo_children_input_budget_run active memo' vs fuel' tail memo'' fuel'' tail_cost ->
        audit_memo_children_input_budget_run active memo (v :: vs) fuel
          (MemoryClobberResult
            (fst (audit_memo_union version_enc (clobber_roots one) (clobber_roots tail)))
            (andb (clobber_complete one) (clobber_complete tail))) memo'' fuel''
          (first_cost + tail_cost + audit_memo_union_input_budget version_enc version_budget
            (clobber_roots one) (clobber_roots tail)).

  (** The output bound has an independently constructed recurrence witness on identical endpoints.
    *)
  Definition audit_memo_whole_input_bound_at : Prop :=
    forall version_work key_work next_work,
      (forall v, version_work (snd (version_enc v)) <= version_budget v) ->
      (forall key, key_work (snd (key_enc key)) <= key_budget key) ->
      (forall v, next_work (snd (next v)) <= next_budget v) ->
      forall active memo v fuel result final remaining events,
      audit_memo_tree version_enc key_enc scope next active memo v fuel result final remaining
        events ->
      exists budget,
        audit_memo_input_budget_run active memo v fuel result final remaining budget /\
        audit_memo_source_work version_work key_work next_work events <= budget.

  (** A fixed input and intermediate result cannot select an arbitrary larger budget. *)
  Definition audit_memo_input_budget_deterministic_at : Prop :=
    forall active memo v fuel result final remaining first second,
      audit_memo_input_budget_run active memo v fuel result final remaining first ->
      audit_memo_input_budget_run active memo v fuel result final remaining second -> first =
        second.
End MemoBudget.

(** This closed obligation quantifies every encoder, callback and original input. *)
Definition audit_memo_whole_input_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E CV CK NE version_enc key_enc scope next version_budget key_budget next_budget,
    @audit_memo_whole_input_bound_at N E CV CK NE version_enc key_enc scope next version_budget
      key_budget next_budget.

(** This closed obligation quantifies every encoder, callback and original input. *)
Definition audit_memo_input_budget_deterministic_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E CV CK NE version_enc key_enc scope next version_budget key_budget next_budget,
    @audit_memo_input_budget_deterministic_at N E CV CK NE version_enc key_enc scope next
      version_budget key_budget next_budget.


(** The composed bound discharges all internal bodies using their concrete source models. *)
Definition audit_memory_memo_whole_input_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CN CE SE IE OE BE (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
      (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE) table
      (incoming : N -> list E * list IE)
      (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE)
      (before : E -> nat -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE)
      node_work edge_work site_work incoming_work operand_work before_work
      node_budget edge_budget site_budget incoming_budget operand_budget before_budget
      q active memo v fuel result final remaining events,
    (forall n, node_work (snd (node_enc n)) <= node_budget n) ->
    (forall e, edge_work (snd (edge_enc e)) <= edge_budget e) ->
    (forall t, site_work (snd (site_enc t)) <= site_budget t) ->
    (forall n, incoming_work (snd (incoming n)) <= incoming_budget n) ->
    (forall n key, operand_work (snd (operand n key)) <= operand_budget n key) ->
    (forall e i, before_work (snd (before e i)) <= before_budget e i) ->
    let scope := audit_memory_scope_encode site_enc q in
    let version_enc := audit_memory_version_encode node_enc edge_enc in
    let key_enc := audit_memory_memo_key_encode node_enc edge_enc in
    let next := audit_memory_raw_next edge_enc site_enc table incoming operand before q in
    let version_budget :=
      audit_memory_version_input_budget node_enc edge_enc node_budget edge_budget in
    let key_budget :=
      audit_memory_memo_key_input_budget node_enc edge_enc node_budget edge_budget in
    let next_budget := @audit_raw_next_input_budget N E T CE SE IE OE BE
      edge_enc site_enc table incoming before edge_budget site_budget
      incoming_budget operand_budget before_budget q in
    audit_memo_tree version_enc key_enc (fst scope) next active memo v fuel
      result final remaining events ->
    exists budget,
      audit_memo_input_budget_run version_enc key_enc (fst scope) next
        version_budget key_budget next_budget active memo v fuel result final remaining budget /\
      audit_memory_scope_work site_work (snd scope) +
        audit_memo_source_work (audit_memory_version_work node_work edge_work)
          (audit_memory_memo_key_work node_work edge_work)
          (audit_raw_next_source_work edge_work site_work incoming_work operand_work before_work)
          events <= audit_memory_scope_input_budget site_enc site_budget q + budget.

Example audit_memo_union_budget_nonempty :
  audit_memo_union_input_budget
    (@audit_memory_version_encode positive positive
      (audit_basic_encoding_event positive) (audit_basic_encoding_event positive)
      audit_positive_encode audit_positive_encode)
    (fun _ => 1) [MemoryLive] [] > 0.
Proof.
  vm_compute.
  repeat constructor.
Qed.
```

```rocq
(** * Adapted family source bounds

    These obligations bind every genuine foreign callback to its actual input, result and body.
    For example, internally prepared predecessor lookups never receive a foreign source-price law.
    Builds on: the family's complete source model and the shared actual-call adapter. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith NArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare GraphAuditBase.
From Galois.Domains Require Import DomainsFootprint.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryGraph AnalysesMemoryWalk.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditCallback.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiState.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditMap.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryEncoding.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryInputBudget.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiProducer.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiInputBudget.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiConsumer.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiSetup.
Import List.ListNotations.

(** Actual foreign source laws cover the same returned bodies charged by this fixed call. *)
Definition audit_memory_phi_prune_whole_input_bound_adapted_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CN CE OE TE PE (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
      (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
      (out : N -> list E * list OE) (target : E -> N * list TE)
      (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list PE)
      node_work edge_work out_work target_work operand_work
      node_budget edge_budget out_budget target_budget operand_budget
      (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E)
        node_enc_source edge_enc_source out_source target_source operand_source,
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall n, fst (out n) = Graph.out g n) ->
    (forall e, fst (target e) = Graph.target g e) ->
    audit_external_callback_adapter node_enc node_work node_enc_source node_budget ->
    audit_external_callback_adapter edge_enc edge_work edge_enc_source edge_budget ->
    audit_external_callback_adapter out out_work out_source out_budget ->
    audit_external_callback_adapter target target_work target_source target_budget ->
    audit_external_callback_adapter
      (fun args => operand (fst args) (snd args)) operand_work operand_source
      (fun args => operand_budget (fst args) (snd args)) ->
    let '(base, preparation, run) := audit_memory_phi_prune_counted EN EE node_enc edge_enc
      out target operand g effects mg in
    audit_prepare_source_work (audit_phi_input_graph_body_work node_work out_work target_work)
      preparation +
    audit_phi_producer_work node_work edge_work (audit_map_source_work node_work) operand_work
      (audit_memory_version_work node_work edge_work) EN run <=
    audit_prepare_source_budget EN g + audit_graph_prepare_full_event_bound g *
      audit_phi_input_graph_envelope out target node_budget out_budget target_budget
        (Graph.nodes g) +
    audit_phi_producer_input_budget EN EE node_enc edge_enc
      (audit_phi_predecessors_counted EN node_enc g base) operand node_budget edge_budget
      (audit_phi_get_input_budget node_enc node_budget) operand_budget g effects mg.

(** Optional returned fields use fixed version encoding and the actual foreign callback
  result/body. *)
Definition audit_phi_optional_closure_source_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall I N E CN CE B (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
      (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
      (base : I -> option (memory_version N E) * list B)
      node_work edge_work base_work node_budget edge_budget base_budget
      node_source edge_source base_source representatives input,
    audit_external_callback_adapter node_enc node_work node_source node_budget ->
    audit_external_callback_adapter edge_enc edge_work edge_source edge_budget ->
    audit_external_callback_adapter base base_work base_source base_budget ->
    base_source input (fst (base input)) (snd (base input)) (base_work (snd (base input))) /\
    audit_phi_closure_source_work (audit_memory_version_work node_work edge_work) base_work
      (snd (audit_phi_output_optional_call (audit_memory_version_encode node_enc edge_enc)
        base representatives input)) <=
    audit_phi_closure_input_budget (audit_memory_version_encode node_enc edge_enc) base
      (audit_memory_version_input_budget node_enc edge_enc node_budget edge_budget) base_budget
        input.

(** Total fields retain the original total result; the optional observer wrapper is
  library-owned. *)
Definition audit_phi_total_closure_source_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall I N E CN CE B (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
      (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (base : I -> memory_version N E * list B)
      node_work edge_work base_work node_budget edge_budget base_budget
      node_source edge_source base_source representatives input,
    audit_external_callback_adapter node_enc node_work node_source node_budget ->
    audit_external_callback_adapter edge_enc edge_work edge_source edge_budget ->
    audit_external_callback_adapter base base_work base_source base_budget ->
    base_source input (fst (base input)) (snd (base input)) (base_work (snd (base input))) /\
    audit_phi_closure_source_work (audit_memory_version_work node_work edge_work) base_work
      (snd (audit_phi_output_total_call (audit_memory_version_encode node_enc edge_enc)
        base representatives input)) <=
    audit_phi_closure_input_budget (audit_memory_version_encode node_enc edge_enc)
      (fun argument => let '(version, body) := base argument in (Some version, body))
      (audit_memory_version_input_budget node_enc edge_enc node_budget edge_budget) base_budget
        input.
```

## AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiConsumer

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiConsumer.v`.

```rocq
(** * Actual pruned output queries and semantic consumers

    Returned fields map their original callback results through representatives.
    Operand queries first check the retained-phi index.
    For example, a missing before-occurrence returns None without a representative lookup.
    Builds on: full phi production and the unchanged history and byte contracts. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryGraph AnalysesMemoryFlow.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiState.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditMap.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditEncoding.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryEncoding.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiProducer.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiInputBudget.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiPlain.
Import List.ListNotations.

Inductive audit_phi_closure_event (I N E CV CE : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditPhiClosureCall (input : I) (result : option (memory_version N E)) (body : list CE)
  | AuditPhiClosureRead (input : memory_version N E) (result : option (memory_version N E))
      (body : list (audit_map_event (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E) CV)).
Arguments AuditPhiClosureCall {I N E CV CE} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditPhiClosureRead {I N E CV CE} _ _ _.

Definition audit_phi_output_optional_call {I N E CV CE}
    (version_enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
    (base : I -> option (memory_version N E) * list CE)
    (reps : Map.t (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E)) (input : I) :
    option (memory_version N E) * list (audit_phi_closure_event I N E CV CE) :=
  let '(found, body) := base input in
  match found with
  | None => (None, [AuditPhiClosureCall input found body])
  | Some v =>
      let '(representative, calls) := audit_map_get version_enc v reps in
      (Some (match representative with Some r => r | None => v end),
        [AuditPhiClosureCall input found body; AuditPhiClosureRead v representative calls])
  end.

Definition audit_phi_output_total_call {I N E CV CE}
    (version_enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
    (base : I -> memory_version N E * list CE)
    (reps : Map.t (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E)) (input : I) :=
  audit_phi_output_optional_call version_enc
    (fun arg => let '(v, body) := base arg in (Some v, body)) reps input.

Fixpoint audit_phi_closure_source_work {I N E CV CE} (version_work : list CV -> nat)
    (base_work : list CE -> nat) (events : list (audit_phi_closure_event I N E CV CE)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditPhiClosureCall _ _ body :: rest => 4 + base_work body +
      audit_phi_closure_source_work version_work base_work rest
  | AuditPhiClosureRead _ _ body :: rest => 4 + audit_map_source_work version_work body +
      audit_phi_closure_source_work version_work base_work rest
  end.

Definition audit_phi_closure_input_budget {I N E CV CE}
    (version_enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
    (base : I -> option (memory_version N E) * list CE)
    (version_budget : memory_version N E -> nat) (base_budget : I -> nat) (input : I) : nat :=
  4 + base_budget input +
  match fst (base input) with
  | None => 0
  | Some v => 4 + audit_phi_get_input_budget version_enc version_budget v
  end.

(** Each returned closure pays its concrete representative lookup only when it is invoked. *)
Definition audit_phi_closure_whole_input_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall I N E CV CE (version_enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
      (base : I -> option (memory_version N E) * list CE)
      version_work base_work version_budget base_budget reps input,
    (forall v, version_work (snd (version_enc v)) <= version_budget v) ->
    (forall arg, base_work (snd (base arg)) <= base_budget arg) ->
    audit_phi_closure_source_work version_work base_work
      (snd (audit_phi_output_optional_call version_enc base reps input)) <=
      audit_phi_closure_input_budget version_enc base version_budget base_budget input.

(** Generic optional erasure fixes exact fallback behavior, including None before any map lookup. *)
Definition audit_phi_output_optional_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall I N E CV CE (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
      (version_enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
      (base : I -> option (memory_version N E) * list CE) original reps input,
    (forall v, fst (version_enc v) = encode (memory_version_encoding EN EE) v) ->
    fst (base input) = original input ->
    fst (audit_phi_output_optional_call version_enc base reps input) =
      option_map (audit_phi_producer_rep EN EE reps) (original input).

(** The four returned fields instantiate the same counted closure at their actual argument types. *)
Definition audit_phi_output_fields_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E CN CE BE OE CV (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
      (version_enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
      (in_body : N -> memory_version N E * list CN)
      (out_body : E -> memory_version N E * list CE)
      (before_body : (E * nat) -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE)
      (operand_body : (N * option E) -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE) old reps,
    (forall v, fst (version_enc v) = encode (memory_version_encoding EN EE) v) ->
    (forall n, fst (in_body n) = memory_in old n) ->
    (forall e, fst (out_body e) = memory_out old e) ->
    (forall e i, fst (before_body (e, i)) = memory_before old e i) ->
    (forall n key, fst (operand_body (n, key)) = memory_operand old n key) ->
    let output := audit_phi_producer_output EN EE old reps in
    (forall n, fst (audit_phi_output_total_call version_enc in_body reps n) =
      Some (memory_in output n)) /\
    (forall e, fst (audit_phi_output_total_call version_enc out_body reps e) =
      Some (memory_out output e)) /\
    (forall e i, fst (audit_phi_output_optional_call version_enc before_body reps (e, i)) =
      memory_before output e i) /\
    (forall n key,
      (if FinSet.mem EN n (FinSet.of_list EN (memory_phis output))
       then fst (audit_phi_output_optional_call version_enc operand_body reps (n, key))
       else None) = memory_operand output n key).

(** This fixed pruning computation supplies the actual result used by semantic consumers. *)
Definition audit_memory_phi_prune N E T (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E) :
    phi_result N E :=
  audit_phi_compute N E T EN EE g effects mg.

(** Existing history, terminal, cycle and legacy-byte guarantees bind this fixed produced value. *)
Definition audit_memory_phi_prune_semantics_statement : Prop :=
  phi_projection_statement audit_memory_phi_prune /\
  phi_terminal_elimination_statement audit_memory_phi_prune /\
  phi_self_only_retained_statement audit_memory_phi_prune /\
  phi_cycle_retained_statement audit_memory_phi_prune /\
  phi_legacy_checked_statement audit_memory_phi_prune /\
  phi_legacy_byte_statement audit_memory_phi_prune.

(** The counted producer's output and representative map erase to the fixed pruning computation. *)
Definition audit_memory_phi_producer_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CN CE PE OE (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
      (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
      (pred : N -> list E * list PE)
      (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE)
      (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E),
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall e, fst (edge_enc e) = encode EE e) ->
    (forall n, fst (pred n) = pred_edges (prepare EN g) n) ->
    (forall n key, fst (operand n key) = memory_operand mg n key) ->
    let run := audit_phi_produce EN EE node_enc edge_enc pred operand
      (audit_memory_version_encode node_enc edge_enc) g effects mg in
    let original := audit_memory_phi_prune N E T EN EE g effects mg in
    audit_phi_run_output EN run = phi_graph original /\
    audit_phi_run_representatives EN run = phi_representatives original.

Example audit_phi_closure_none_skips_representative :
  let enc := fun _ : memory_version positive positive => (1%positive, [tt]) in
  let base := fun _ : unit => (@None (memory_version positive positive), [tt; tt]) in
  let run := audit_phi_output_optional_call enc base Map.empty tt in
  fst run = None /\ length (snd run) = 1.
Proof.
  vm_compute.
  split; reflexivity.
Qed.
```

```rocq
(** * Whole memory-phi operand budgets

    These recurrences follow actual rows, dependency components and persistent representatives.
    For example, a false operand comparison still pays every remaining strict operand comparison.
    Builds on: full graph source models and the concrete memory-phi producer phases. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith PeanoNat.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare GraphScc GraphAuditBase GraphAuditDfs
  GraphAuditScc.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryGraph AnalysesMemoryFlow.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiState.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditMap.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditFinSet.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditEncoding.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditEncoderBudget.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryEncoding.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryInputBudget.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemorySharedBudget.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiRows.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiResolve.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiProducer.
Import List.ListNotations.

Definition audit_phi_get_input_budget {K CE} (enc : K -> positive * list CE)
    (budget : K -> nat) (key : K) : nat := 5 + budget key + 5 * Pos.size_nat (fst (enc key)).

Definition audit_phi_set_input_budget {K CE} (enc : K -> positive * list CE)
    (budget : K -> nat) (key : K) : nat := 2 + budget key + 16 * Pos.size_nat (fst (enc key)).

Fixpoint audit_phi_operand_input_budget {N E} (budget : N -> option E -> nat)
    (node : N) (keys : list (option E)) : nat :=
  match keys with
  | [] => 0
  | key :: rest => 2 + budget node key + audit_phi_operand_input_budget budget node rest
  end.

Fixpoint audit_phi_rows_input_budget {N E CN CE PE}
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
    (pred : N -> list E * list PE) (node_budget : N -> nat) (edge_budget : E -> nat)
    (pred_budget : N -> nat) (operand_budget : N -> option E -> nat) (nodes : list N) : nat :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => 1
  | n :: rest =>
      let edges := fst (pred n) in
      let keys := None :: map Some edges in
      let distinct := fst (audit_phi_distinct_from (audit_option_encode edge_enc) FinSet.empty
        keys) in
      2 + length edges + pred_budget n +
      2 + audit_memory_distinct_input_budget (audit_option_encode edge_enc)
        (audit_option_input_budget edge_budget) keys +
      audit_phi_operand_input_budget operand_budget n distinct +
      2 + audit_phi_set_input_budget node_enc node_budget n +
      audit_phi_rows_input_budget node_enc edge_enc pred node_budget edge_budget
        pred_budget operand_budget rest
  end.

Definition audit_phi_dependency_row_input_budget {N E CN}
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (node_budget : N -> nat)
    (inputs : Map.t N (list (option E * memory_version N E))) (node : N) : nat :=
  let row := match fst (audit_map_get node_enc node inputs) with Some xs => xs | None => [] end in
  audit_phi_get_input_budget node_enc node_budget node + 2 + 4 * length row.

Fixpoint audit_phi_self_edges_input_budget {N E CN}
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (node_budget : N -> nat)
    (dep : Graph.t N (phi_dependency_edge N E)) (node : N)
    (edges : list (phi_dependency_edge N E)) : nat :=
  match edges with
  | [] => 2
  | edge :: rest =>
      let target := Graph.target dep edge in
      10 + node_budget target + node_budget node +
      2 * Nat.min (Pos.size_nat (fst (node_enc target))) (Pos.size_nat (fst (node_enc node))) +
      audit_phi_self_edges_input_budget node_enc node_budget dep node rest
  end.

Fixpoint audit_phi_mark_input_budget {N CN} (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (node_budget : N -> nat) (nodes : list N) : nat :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => 0
  | node :: rest => 2 + audit_phi_set_input_budget node_enc node_budget node +
      audit_phi_mark_input_budget node_enc node_budget rest
  end.

Definition audit_phi_component_input_budget {N E CN} (EN : encoding N)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (node_budget : N -> nat)
    (dep : Graph.t N (phi_dependency_edge N E)) (prepared : prepared EN dep)
    (component : list N) : nat :=
  match component with
  | [] => 2
  | [node] =>
      let edges := match fst (audit_map_get node_enc node (out_index prepared)) with
        Some xs => xs | None => [] end in
      4 + audit_phi_get_input_budget node_enc node_budget node +
      audit_phi_self_edges_input_budget node_enc node_budget dep node edges
  | _ :: _ :: _ => 2
  end.

Fixpoint audit_phi_cycles_input_budget {N E CN} (EN : encoding N)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (node_budget : N -> nat)
    (dep : Graph.t N (phi_dependency_edge N E)) (prepared : prepared EN dep)
    (components : list (list N)) : nat :=
  match components with
  | [] => 0
  | component :: rest =>
      audit_phi_component_input_budget EN node_enc node_budget dep prepared component +
      (if fst (audit_phi_component_cyclic_counted EN node_enc dep prepared component)
       then audit_phi_mark_input_budget node_enc node_budget component else 0) +
      audit_phi_cycles_input_budget EN node_enc node_budget dep prepared rest
  end.

Definition audit_phi_rep_input_budget {N E CV}
    (enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
    (budget : memory_version N E -> nat) (v : memory_version N E) : nat :=
  2 + audit_phi_get_input_budget enc budget v.

Definition audit_phi_compare_input_budget {N E CV}
    (enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
    (budget : memory_version N E -> nat) (left right : memory_version N E) : nat :=
  6 + budget left + budget right +
    2 * Nat.min (Pos.size_nat (fst (enc left))) (Pos.size_nat (fst (enc right))).

Fixpoint audit_phi_all_same_input_budget {N E CV}
    (enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV) (budget : memory_version N E -> nat)
    (reps : Map.t (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E))
    (candidate : memory_version N E) (row : list (option E * memory_version N E)) : nat :=
  match row with
  | [] => 2
  | (_, v) :: rest =>
      let representative := fst (@audit_phi_rep N E unit CV enc reps v) in
      2 + audit_phi_rep_input_budget enc budget v +
      audit_phi_compare_input_budget enc budget candidate representative +
      audit_phi_all_same_input_budget enc budget reps candidate rest
  end.

Definition audit_phi_resolve_step_input_budget {N E CN CV} (EN : encoding N)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (version_enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
    (node_budget : N -> nat) (version_budget : memory_version N E -> nat)
    (index : phi_dependency_index (E := E) EN)
    (reps : Map.t (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E)) (node : N) : nat :=
  8 + node_budget node + 5 * Pos.size_nat (fst (node_enc node)) +
  if fst (audit_finset_mem node_enc node (phi_index_cycles index)) then 0 else
    2 + audit_phi_get_input_budget node_enc node_budget node +
    match fst (audit_map_get node_enc node (phi_index_inputs index)) with
    | None | Some [] => 0
    | Some ((_, v) :: rest) =>
        let candidate := fst (@audit_phi_rep N E CN CV version_enc reps v) in
        let self := fst (@audit_phi_compare N E CN CV version_enc candidate (MemoryPhi node)) in
        let all_same := fst (@audit_phi_all_same N E CN CV version_enc reps candidate rest) in
        audit_phi_rep_input_budget version_enc version_budget v +
        audit_phi_compare_input_budget version_enc version_budget candidate (MemoryPhi node) +
        audit_phi_all_same_input_budget version_enc version_budget reps candidate rest +
        if andb (negb self) all_same then
          2 + audit_phi_set_input_budget version_enc version_budget (MemoryPhi node)
        else 0
    end.

Fixpoint audit_phi_resolve_pass_input_budget {N E CN CV} (EN : encoding N)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (version_enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
    (node_budget : N -> nat) (version_budget : memory_version N E -> nat)
    (index : phi_dependency_index (E := E) EN) (nodes : list N)
    (reps : Map.t (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E)) : nat :=

  | [] => 0
  | node :: rest =>
      let next := fst (audit_phi_resolve_step EN node_enc version_enc index reps node) in
      audit_phi_resolve_step_input_budget EN node_enc version_enc node_budget version_budget
        index reps node +
      audit_phi_resolve_pass_input_budget EN node_enc version_enc node_budget version_budget
        index rest next
  end.

Fixpoint audit_phi_output_keep_input_budget {N E CV}
    (version_enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
    (version_budget : memory_version N E -> nat)
    (reps : Map.t (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E)) (nodes : list N) : nat :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => 2
  | n :: rest =>
      let v := MemoryPhi n in
      let representative := match fst (audit_map_get version_enc v reps) with
        Some r => r | None => v end in
      8 + audit_phi_get_input_budget version_enc version_budget v +
      version_budget v + version_budget representative +
      2 * Nat.min (Pos.size_nat (fst (version_enc v)))
        (Pos.size_nat (fst (version_enc representative))) +
      audit_phi_output_keep_input_budget version_enc version_budget reps rest
  end.

Fixpoint audit_phi_filter_nodes_input_budget {N CN} (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (node_budget : N -> nat) (nodes : list N) : nat :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => 2
  | node :: rest => 8 + node_budget node + 5 * Pos.size_nat (fst (node_enc node)) +
      audit_phi_filter_nodes_input_budget node_enc node_budget rest
  end.

Fixpoint audit_phi_filter_versions_input_budget {N E CN}
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (node_budget : N -> nat)
    (versions : list (memory_version N E)) : nat :=

  | [] => 2
  | version :: rest =>
      2 + (match version with
      | MemoryPhi node => 8 + node_budget node + 5 * Pos.size_nat (fst (node_enc node))
      | _ => 0
      end) + audit_phi_filter_versions_input_budget node_enc node_budget rest
  end.

Definition audit_phi_output_input_budget {N E CN CV} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (version_enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
    (node_budget : N -> nat) (version_budget : memory_version N E -> nat)
    (old : memory_graph N E) (reps : Map.t (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E)) : nat :=
  let kept := fst (audit_phi_output_keep_phis EN EE node_enc version_enc reps (memory_phis old)) in
  audit_phi_output_keep_input_budget version_enc version_budget reps (memory_phis old) +
  2 + audit_memory_distinct_input_budget node_enc node_budget kept +
  audit_phi_filter_nodes_input_budget node_enc node_budget (memory_phis old) +
  audit_phi_filter_versions_input_budget node_enc node_budget (memory_versions old).

Fixpoint audit_phi_graph_targets_input_budget {N E}
    (node_budget : N -> nat) (edges : list (phi_dependency_edge N E)) : nat :=
  match edges with
  | [] => 0
  | edge :: rest => node_budget (dependency_target edge) +
      audit_phi_graph_targets_input_budget node_budget rest
  end.

Fixpoint audit_phi_graph_callback_envelope {N E CN}
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (node_budget : N -> nat)
    (dep : Graph.t N (phi_dependency_edge N E)) (nodes : list N) : nat :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => 0
  | n :: rest => node_budget n + audit_phi_get_input_budget node_enc node_budget n +
      audit_phi_graph_targets_input_budget node_budget (Graph.out dep n) +
      audit_phi_graph_callback_envelope node_enc node_budget dep rest
  end.

Definition audit_phi_producer_input_budget {N E T CN CE PE OE}
    (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (pred : N -> list E * list PE)
    (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE)
    (node_budget : N -> nat) (edge_budget : E -> nat)
    (pred_budget : N -> nat) (operand_budget : N -> option E -> nat)
    (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E) : nat :=
  let version_enc := audit_memory_version_encode node_enc edge_enc in
  let version_budget := audit_memory_version_input_budget node_enc edge_enc node_budget
    edge_budget in
  let inputs := fst (audit_phi_input_rows node_enc edge_enc pred operand (memory_phis mg)) in
  let '(dep, rows, _) := audit_phi_dependency_graph_counted EN node_enc mg inputs in
  let cb := audit_phi_prepare_callbacks node_enc rows dep in
  let prep := fst (audit_prepare_source_counted EN dep cb) in
  let components := fst (audit_scc_source_counted prep (audit_phi_scc_callbacks node_enc dep)
    (Graph.nodes dep)) in
  let cycles := fst (audit_phi_cycle_flags_counted EN node_enc dep prep components) in
  let index := PhiDependencyIndex inputs dep prep components cycles in
  let order := concat (GraphScc.components components) in
  let reps := fst (audit_phi_resolve_all EN node_enc version_enc index order Map.empty) in
  let envelope := audit_phi_graph_callback_envelope node_enc node_budget dep (Graph.nodes dep) in
  audit_phi_rows_input_budget node_enc edge_enc pred node_budget edge_budget pred_budget
    operand_budget
    (memory_phis mg) +
  audit_memory_index_input_budget node_enc node_budget
    (audit_phi_dependency_row_input_budget node_enc node_budget inputs) (memory_phis mg) +
  19 + length order + length (GraphScc.components components) +
  fold_right (fun component total => length component + total) 0 (GraphScc.components components) +
  audit_prepare_source_budget EN dep + audit_graph_prepare_full_event_bound dep * envelope +
  audit_scc_source_budget EN dep prep (Graph.nodes dep) +
    2 * audit_tarjan_input_event_bound prep (Graph.nodes dep) * envelope +
  audit_phi_cycles_input_budget EN node_enc node_budget dep prep (GraphScc.components components) +
  audit_phi_resolve_pass_input_budget EN node_enc version_enc node_budget version_budget
    index order Map.empty +
  audit_phi_output_input_budget EN EE node_enc version_enc node_budget version_budget mg reps.

(** The complete producer bound composes concrete library bodies and only external call budgets. *)
Definition audit_phi_producer_whole_input_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CN CE PE OE (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
      (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
      (pred : N -> list E * list PE)
      (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE)
      node_work edge_work pred_work operand_work node_budget edge_budget pred_budget operand_budget
      (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E),
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall n, node_work (snd (node_enc n)) <= node_budget n) ->
    (forall e, edge_work (snd (edge_enc e)) <= edge_budget e) ->
    (forall n, pred_work (snd (pred n)) <= pred_budget n) ->
    (forall n key, operand_work (snd (operand n key)) <= operand_budget n key) ->
    audit_phi_producer_work node_work edge_work pred_work operand_work
      (audit_memory_version_work node_work edge_work) EN
      (audit_phi_produce EN EE node_enc edge_enc pred operand
        (audit_memory_version_encode node_enc edge_enc) g effects mg) <=
    audit_phi_producer_input_budget EN EE node_enc edge_enc pred operand
      node_budget edge_budget pred_budget operand_budget g effects mg.
```

## AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiPlain

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiPlain.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiPlain`.

```rocq
(** * Untraced memory-phi pruning computation

    This body prepares dependencies, resolves acyclic equal inputs and returns plain graph fields.
    For example, all output representative reads occur in returned closures when they are called.
    Builds on: the unchanged phi dependency preparation and original collection operations. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphScc.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryGraph AnalysesMemoryFlow.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiState.
Import List.ListNotations.

Definition audit_phi_compute_rep {N E} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (reps : Map.t (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E)) (v : memory_version N E) :=
  match Map.get (memory_version_encoding EN EE) v reps with
  | None => v
  | Some representative => representative
  end.

Definition audit_phi_compute_step {N E} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (index : phi_dependency_index (E := E) EN)
    (reps : Map.t (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E)) (node : N) :=
  if FinSet.mem EN node (phi_index_cycles index) then reps else
  match Map.get EN node (phi_index_inputs index) with
  | None | Some [] => reps
  | Some ((_, v) :: rest) =>
      let rep := audit_phi_compute_rep EN EE reps in
      let candidate := rep v in
      let code := encode (memory_version_encoding EN EE) in
      let self := Pos.eqb (code candidate) (code (MemoryPhi node)) in
      let all_same := forallb (fun kv => Pos.eqb (code candidate) (code (rep (snd kv)))) rest in
      if andb (negb self) all_same then
        Map.set (memory_version_encoding EN EE) (MemoryPhi node) candidate reps
      else reps
  end.

Definition audit_phi_compute_output {N E} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (old : memory_graph N E) (reps : Map.t (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E)) :=
  let rep := audit_phi_compute_rep EN EE reps in
  let kept := filter (fun n =>
    Pos.eqb (encode (memory_version_encoding EN EE) (MemoryPhi n))
      (encode (memory_version_encoding EN EE) (rep (MemoryPhi n)))) (memory_phis old) in
  let kept_set := FinSet.of_list EN kept in
  MemoryGraph
    (filter (fun n => FinSet.mem EN n kept_set) (memory_phis old))
    (filter (fun v => match v with
      | MemoryPhi n => FinSet.mem EN n kept_set
      | _ => true
      end) (memory_versions old))
    (fun n => rep (memory_in old n))
    (fun e i => option_map rep (memory_before old e i))
    (fun e => rep (memory_out old e))
    (fun n key => if FinSet.mem EN n kept_set
      then option_map rep (memory_operand old n key) else None).

Definition audit_phi_compute N E T (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E) :
    phi_result N E :=
  let index := phi_prepare_dependencies EN EE g effects mg in
  let order := concat (components (phi_index_scc index)) in
  let reps := fold_left (audit_phi_compute_step EN EE index) order Map.empty in
  @PhiResult N E (audit_phi_compute_output EN EE mg reps) reps.

Example audit_phi_plain_kept_live_fixture :
  let old : memory_graph positive positive :=
    MemoryGraph [] [MemoryLive] (fun _ => MemoryLive) (fun _ _ => None)
      (fun _ => MemoryLive) (fun _ _ => None) in
  memory_versions (audit_phi_compute_output positive_encoding positive_encoding old Map.empty) =
    [MemoryLive].
Proof.
  reflexivity.
Qed.
```

## AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiPrepare

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiPrepare.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiPrepare`.

```rocq
(** * Memory phi dependency preparation phases

    This candidate preserves the actual intermediate inputs, graph, SCC and flags.
    For example, SCC receives the graph prepared from the same captured input rows.
    Builds on: AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiState and the graph preparation and SCC APIs. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare GraphScc.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryGraph.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiState.
Import List.ListNotations.

(** * Dependency preparation sequence *)

Inductive audit_phi_prepare_event {N E T} (EN : encoding N) : Type :=
  | AuditPhiInputs (graph : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T))
      (memory : memory_graph N E) (rows : Map.t N (list (option E * memory_version N E)))
  | AuditPhiGraph (rows : Map.t N (list (option E * memory_version N E)))
      (dep : Graph.t N (phi_dependency_edge N E))
  | AuditPhiPrepared (dep : Graph.t N (phi_dependency_edge N E)) (index : prepared EN dep)
  | AuditPhiScc (result : scc_result N)
  | AuditPhiCycles (result : FinSet.t N).

Arguments AuditPhiInputs {N E T EN} _ _ _ _.
Arguments AuditPhiGraph {N E T EN} _ _.
Arguments AuditPhiPrepared {N E T EN} _ _.
Arguments AuditPhiScc {N E T EN} _.
Arguments AuditPhiCycles {N E T EN} _.

(** The five source phases retain the exact common intermediate values and returned index. *)
Definition audit_phi_prepare_dependencies {N E T} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E)
    : phi_dependency_index (E := E) EN * list (audit_phi_prepare_event (T := T) EN) :=
  let inputs := phi_input_rows EN EE g effects mg in
  let dep := phi_dependency_graph_from_inputs EN mg inputs in
  let prep := prepare EN dep in
  let components := scc prep in
  let cycles := phi_cycle_flags EN dep prep components in
  (PhiDependencyIndex inputs dep prep components cycles,
    [AuditPhiInputs g effects mg inputs; AuditPhiGraph inputs dep; AuditPhiPrepared dep prep;
     AuditPhiScc components; AuditPhiCycles cycles]).

(** These proposition types are not proofs of the producer or of phase source-cost adequacy. *)
Definition audit_phi_prepare_dependencies_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (g : Graph.t N E) effects mg,
    fst (@audit_phi_prepare_dependencies N E T EN EE g effects mg) =
      phi_prepare_dependencies EN EE g effects mg.

Definition audit_phi_prepare_phase_count_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (g : Graph.t N E) effects mg,
    length (snd (@audit_phi_prepare_dependencies N E T EN EE g effects mg)) = 5.
```
