## AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiProducer

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiProducer.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiProducer`.

```rocq
(** * End-to-end counted phi producer candidate

    This file joins actual prepared inputs, dependency SCCs, ordered representative
    updates, and the returned memory graph in one source-shaped execution. The
    result retains every intermediate trace rather than pricing an opaque producer.
    Builds on: AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiState and the counted row, preparation and resolution models.
      *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare GraphScc.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphDfs GraphAuditBase GraphAuditDfs GraphAuditScc.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryGraph AnalysesMemoryFlow.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiState.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiRows.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiPrepare.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiResolve.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditMap.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditFinSet.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditEncoding.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditPrimitive.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryIndex.
Import List.ListNotations.

Definition audit_phi_producer_rep {N E} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (reps : Map.t (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E))
    (v : memory_version N E) : memory_version N E :=
  match Map.get (memory_version_encoding EN EE) v reps with
  | Some representative => representative
  | None => v
  end.

Inductive audit_phi_graph_callback_event (N E CN : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditPhiGraphEncodeBody (events : list CN)
  | AuditPhiGraphOutBody
      (events : list (audit_map_event N (list (phi_dependency_edge N E)) CN)).
Arguments AuditPhiGraphEncodeBody {N E CN} _.
Arguments AuditPhiGraphOutBody {N E CN} _.

Definition audit_phi_graph_callback_work {N E CN} (node_work : list CN -> nat)
    (event : audit_phi_graph_callback_event N E CN) : nat :=
  match event with
  | AuditPhiGraphEncodeBody calls => node_work calls
  | AuditPhiGraphOutBody calls => audit_map_source_work node_work calls
  end.

Definition audit_phi_prepare_callbacks {N E CN} (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (rows : Map.t N (list (phi_dependency_edge N E)))
    (dep : Graph.t N (phi_dependency_edge N E)) :
    audit_prepare_callback_model N (phi_dependency_edge N E) (audit_phi_graph_callback_event N E
      CN) :=
  @AuditPrepareCallbackModel N (phi_dependency_edge N E) (audit_phi_graph_callback_event N E CN)
    (fun n => let '(found, calls) := audit_map_get node_enc n rows in
      (match found with Some edges => edges | None => [] end, [AuditPhiGraphOutBody calls]))
    (fun edge => (Graph.target dep edge, []))
    (fun n => let '(code, events) := node_enc n in (code, [AuditPhiGraphEncodeBody events])).

Definition audit_phi_scc_callbacks {N E CN} (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (dep : Graph.t N (phi_dependency_edge N E)) :
    audit_dfs_callback_model N (phi_dependency_edge N E) (audit_phi_graph_callback_event N E CN) :=
  @AuditDfsCallbackModel N (phi_dependency_edge N E) (audit_phi_graph_callback_event N E CN)
    (fun edge => (Graph.target dep edge, []))
    (fun n => let '(code, events) := node_enc n in (code, [AuditPhiGraphEncodeBody events])).

(** The output constructor records actual mapped fields and the stable kept-phi
    filter. Non-phi versions retain their source order and identity. *)
Definition audit_phi_producer_output {N E} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (old : memory_graph N E) (reps : Map.t (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E))
    : memory_graph N E :=
  let rep := audit_phi_producer_rep EN EE reps in
  let kept := filter (fun n =>
    Pos.eqb (encode (memory_version_encoding EN EE) (MemoryPhi n)) (encode
      (memory_version_encoding EN EE) (rep (MemoryPhi n))))
    (memory_phis old) in
  let kept_set := FinSet.of_list EN kept in
  MemoryGraph
    (filter (fun n => FinSet.mem EN n kept_set) (memory_phis old))
    (filter (fun v => match v with
      | MemoryPhi n => FinSet.mem EN n kept_set
      | _ => true
      end) (memory_versions old))
    (fun n => rep (memory_in old n))
    (fun e i => option_map rep (memory_before old e i))
    (fun e => rep (memory_out old e))
    (fun n key => if FinSet.mem EN n kept_set
      then option_map rep (memory_operand old n key) else None).

Inductive audit_phi_output_event (N E CN CV : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditPhiOutputPhiCase (remaining : list N)
  | AuditPhiOutputRepRead (node : N) (found : option (memory_version N E))
      (calls : list (audit_map_event (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E) CV))
  | AuditPhiOutputRepEncode (version : memory_version N E) (code : positive) (body : list CV)
  | AuditPhiOutputRepCompare (node : N) (result : bool) (calls : list audit_positive_eqb_event)
  | AuditPhiOutputSetBuild (calls : list (audit_set_event N CN))
  | AuditPhiOutputPhiProbe (node : N) (result : bool) (calls : list (audit_set_event N CN))
  | AuditPhiOutputVersionCase (remaining : list (memory_version N E))
  | AuditPhiOutputVersionProbe (version : memory_version N E) (result : bool)
      (calls : list (audit_set_event N CN)).
Arguments AuditPhiOutputPhiCase {N E CN CV} _.
Arguments AuditPhiOutputRepRead {N E CN CV} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditPhiOutputRepEncode {N E CN CV} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditPhiOutputRepCompare {N E CN CV} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditPhiOutputSetBuild {N E CN CV} _.
Arguments AuditPhiOutputPhiProbe {N E CN CV} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditPhiOutputVersionCase {N E CN CV} _.
Arguments AuditPhiOutputVersionProbe {N E CN CV} _ _ _.

Fixpoint audit_phi_output_keep_phis {N E CN CV} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (version_enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
    (reps : Map.t (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E)) (nodes : list N)
    : list N * list (audit_phi_output_event N E CN CV) :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => ([], [AuditPhiOutputPhiCase nodes])
  | n :: rest =>
      let '(found, read_events) := audit_map_get version_enc (MemoryPhi n) reps in
      let representative := match found with Some v => v | None => MemoryPhi n end in
      let '(left_code, left_body) := version_enc (MemoryPhi n) in
      let '(right_code, right_body) := version_enc representative in
      let '(same, eq_events) := audit_positive_eqb left_code right_code in
      let '(kept, tail_events) := audit_phi_output_keep_phis EN EE node_enc version_enc reps rest in
      (if same then n :: kept else kept,
        [AuditPhiOutputPhiCase nodes; AuditPhiOutputRepRead n found read_events;
         AuditPhiOutputRepEncode (MemoryPhi n) left_code left_body;
         AuditPhiOutputRepEncode representative right_code right_body;
         AuditPhiOutputRepCompare n same eq_events] ++ tail_events)
  end.

Fixpoint audit_phi_output_filter_nodes {N E CN CV} (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (kept : FinSet.t N) (nodes : list N) : list N * list (audit_phi_output_event N E CN CV) :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => ([], [AuditPhiOutputPhiCase nodes])
  | n :: rest =>
      let '(found, calls) := audit_finset_mem node_enc n kept in
      let '(tail, tail_events) := audit_phi_output_filter_nodes node_enc kept rest in
      (if found then n :: tail else tail,
        AuditPhiOutputPhiProbe n found calls :: tail_events)
  end.

Fixpoint audit_phi_output_filter_versions {N E CN CV}
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (version_enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
    (kept : FinSet.t N) (versions : list (memory_version N E))
    : list (memory_version N E) * list (audit_phi_output_event N E CN CV) :=
  match versions with
  | [] => ([], [AuditPhiOutputVersionCase versions])
  | v :: rest =>
      let '(keep, events) := match v with
        | MemoryLive | MemoryDef _ _ => (true, [])
        | MemoryPhi n => let '(found, calls) := audit_finset_mem node_enc n kept in
            (found, [AuditPhiOutputVersionProbe v found calls])
      end in
      let '(tail, tail_events) := audit_phi_output_filter_versions node_enc version_enc kept rest in
      (if keep then v :: tail else tail,
        AuditPhiOutputVersionCase versions :: events ++ tail_events)
  end.

(** The output is assembled from the same representatives and the actual filter
    probes captured here. Function-valued fields remain closures and cost only
    when consumers call them. *)
Definition audit_phi_producer_output_counted {N E CN CV}
    (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (version_enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
    (old : memory_graph N E) (reps : Map.t (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E))
    : memory_graph N E * list (audit_phi_output_event N E CN CV) :=
  let '(kept, reps_events) := audit_phi_output_keep_phis EN EE node_enc version_enc reps
    (memory_phis old) in
  let '(kept_set, set_events) := audit_finset_of_list node_enc kept in
  let '(phis, phi_events) := audit_phi_output_filter_nodes node_enc kept_set (memory_phis old) in
  let '(versions, version_events) := audit_phi_output_filter_versions node_enc version_enc kept_set
    (memory_versions old) in
  let rep := audit_phi_producer_rep EN EE reps in
  (MemoryGraph phis versions (fun n => rep (memory_in old n))
    (fun e i => option_map rep (memory_before old e i))
    (fun e => rep (memory_out old e))
    (fun n key => if FinSet.mem EN n kept_set
      then option_map rep (memory_operand old n key) else None),
   reps_events ++ [AuditPhiOutputSetBuild set_events] ++ phi_events ++ version_events).

Fixpoint audit_phi_output_source_work {N E CN CV}
    (node_work : list CN -> nat) (version_work : list CV -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_phi_output_event N E CN CV)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditPhiOutputPhiCase _ :: rest => 2 + audit_phi_output_source_work node_work version_work rest
  | AuditPhiOutputRepRead _ _ calls :: rest => 2 + audit_map_source_work version_work calls +
      audit_phi_output_source_work node_work version_work rest
  | AuditPhiOutputRepEncode _ _ body :: rest => 1 + version_work body +
      audit_phi_output_source_work node_work version_work rest
  | AuditPhiOutputRepCompare _ _ calls :: rest => 2 + audit_positive_eqb_source_work calls +
      audit_phi_output_source_work node_work version_work rest
  | AuditPhiOutputSetBuild calls :: rest => 2 + audit_finset_source_work node_work calls +
      audit_phi_output_source_work node_work version_work rest
  | AuditPhiOutputPhiProbe _ _ calls :: rest => 2 + audit_finset_source_work node_work calls +
      audit_phi_output_source_work node_work version_work rest
  | AuditPhiOutputVersionCase _ :: rest => 2 + audit_phi_output_source_work node_work version_work
    rest
  | AuditPhiOutputVersionProbe _ _ calls :: rest => 2 + audit_finset_source_work node_work calls +
      audit_phi_output_source_work node_work version_work rest
  end.

Inductive audit_phi_dependency_row_event (N E CN : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditPhiDependencyRowGet (node : N)
      (found : option (list (option E * memory_version N E)))
      (calls : list (audit_map_event N (list (option E * memory_version N E)) CN))
  | AuditPhiDependencyRowCase (remaining : list (option E * memory_version N E))
  | AuditPhiDependencyEdgeKeep (node : N) (key : option E) (target : N).
Arguments AuditPhiDependencyRowGet {N E CN} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditPhiDependencyRowCase {N E CN} _.
Arguments AuditPhiDependencyEdgeKeep {N E CN} _ _ _.

Fixpoint audit_phi_dependency_row_entries {N E CN} (node : N)
    (row : list (option E * memory_version N E))
    : list (phi_dependency_edge N E) * list (audit_phi_dependency_row_event N E CN) :=
  match row with
  | [] => ([], [AuditPhiDependencyRowCase row])
  | (key, value) :: rest =>
      let '(tail, events) := audit_phi_dependency_row_entries node rest in
      match value with
      | MemoryPhi target =>
          (PhiDependencyEdgeData node key target :: tail,
            [AuditPhiDependencyRowCase row; AuditPhiDependencyEdgeKeep node key target] ++ events)
      | MemoryLive | MemoryDef _ _ =>
          (tail, AuditPhiDependencyRowCase row :: events)
      end
  end.

Definition audit_phi_dependency_row {N E CN}
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (inputs : Map.t N (list (option E * memory_version N E))) (node : N)
    : list (phi_dependency_edge N E) * list (audit_phi_dependency_row_event N E CN) :=
  let '(found, calls) := audit_map_get node_enc node inputs in
  let row := match found with Some xs => xs | None => [] end in
  let '(edges, events) := audit_phi_dependency_row_entries node row in
  (edges, AuditPhiDependencyRowGet node found calls :: events).

Definition audit_phi_dependency_rows_counted {N E CN}
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (mg : memory_graph N E)
    (inputs : Map.t N (list (option E * memory_version N E))) :=
  audit_memory_result_index node_enc (audit_phi_dependency_row node_enc inputs)
    (memory_phis mg).

Definition audit_phi_dependency_graph_counted {N E CN}
    (EN : encoding N) (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (mg : memory_graph N E)
    (inputs : Map.t N (list (option E * memory_version N E)))
    : Graph.t N (phi_dependency_edge N E) * Map.t N (list (phi_dependency_edge N E)) *
      list (audit_memory_index_event N (list (phi_dependency_edge N E)) CN
        (audit_phi_dependency_row_event N E CN)) :=
  let '(rows, events) := audit_phi_dependency_rows_counted node_enc mg inputs in
  ({| Graph.entries := memory_phis mg; Graph.nodes := memory_phis mg;
      Graph.out := index_edges EN rows; Graph.source := dependency_source;
      Graph.target := dependency_target |}, rows, events).

Fixpoint audit_phi_dependency_row_work {N E CN}
    (node_work : list CN -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_phi_dependency_row_event N E CN)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditPhiDependencyRowGet _ _ calls :: rest => audit_map_source_work node_work calls +
      audit_phi_dependency_row_work node_work rest
  | AuditPhiDependencyRowCase _ :: rest => 2 + audit_phi_dependency_row_work node_work rest
  | AuditPhiDependencyEdgeKeep _ _ _ :: rest => 2 + audit_phi_dependency_row_work node_work rest
  end.

Definition audit_phi_dependency_rows_work {N E CN}
    (node_work : list CN -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_memory_index_event N (list (phi_dependency_edge N E)) CN
      (audit_phi_dependency_row_event N E CN))) : nat :=
  audit_memory_index_work node_work (audit_phi_dependency_row_work node_work) events.

Inductive audit_phi_cycle_event (N E CN : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditPhiCycleComponent (component : list N) (cyclic : bool)
  | AuditPhiCycleSuccessors (node : N) (edges : option (list (phi_dependency_edge N E)))
      (calls : list (audit_map_event N (list (phi_dependency_edge N E)) CN))
  | AuditPhiCycleEdgeCase (remaining : list (phi_dependency_edge N E))
  | AuditPhiCycleTarget (edge : phi_dependency_edge N E) (target : N)
  | AuditPhiCycleEncode (node : N) (code : positive) (body : list CN)
  | AuditPhiCycleCompare (node : N) (target : N) (result : bool)
      (calls : list audit_positive_eqb_event)
  | AuditPhiCycleMark (node : N) (calls : list (audit_set_event N CN)).
Arguments AuditPhiCycleComponent {N E CN} _ _.
Arguments AuditPhiCycleSuccessors {N E CN} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditPhiCycleEdgeCase {N E CN} _.
Arguments AuditPhiCycleTarget {N E CN} _ _.
Arguments AuditPhiCycleEncode {N E CN} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditPhiCycleCompare {N E CN} _ _ _ _.
Arguments AuditPhiCycleMark {N E CN} _ _.

Fixpoint audit_phi_cycle_self_edges {N E CN} (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (dep : Graph.t N (phi_dependency_edge N E)) (node : N)
    (edges : list (phi_dependency_edge N E)) : bool * list (audit_phi_cycle_event N E CN) :=
  match edges with
  | [] => (false, [AuditPhiCycleEdgeCase edges])
  | edge :: rest =>
      let target := Graph.target dep edge in
      let '(target_code, target_body) := node_enc target in
      let '(node_code, node_body) := node_enc node in
      let '(same, compare_events) := audit_positive_eqb target_code node_code in
      let '(later, tail_events) := audit_phi_cycle_self_edges node_enc dep node rest in
      (orb same later,
        [AuditPhiCycleEdgeCase edges; AuditPhiCycleTarget edge target;
          AuditPhiCycleEncode target target_code target_body;
          AuditPhiCycleEncode node node_code node_body;
          AuditPhiCycleCompare node target same compare_events] ++ tail_events)
  end.

Definition audit_phi_component_cyclic_counted {N E CN} (EN : encoding N)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (dep : Graph.t N (phi_dependency_edge N E))
    (prepared_dep : prepared EN dep) (component : list N)
    : bool * list (audit_phi_cycle_event N E CN) :=
  match component with
  | [] => (false, [AuditPhiCycleComponent component false])
  | [node] =>
      let '(found, calls) := audit_map_get node_enc node (out_index prepared_dep) in
      let edges := match found with Some xs => xs | None => [] end in
      let '(cyclic, cycle_events) := audit_phi_cycle_self_edges node_enc dep node edges in
      (cyclic, [AuditPhiCycleComponent component cyclic;
        AuditPhiCycleSuccessors node found calls] ++ cycle_events)
  | _ :: _ :: _ => (true, [AuditPhiCycleComponent component true])
  end.

Fixpoint audit_phi_cycle_mark_nodes {N E CN} (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (nodes : list N) (marked : FinSet.t N)
    : FinSet.t N * list (audit_phi_cycle_event N E CN) :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => (marked, [])
  | node :: rest =>
      let '(next, calls) := audit_finset_add node_enc node marked in
      let '(final, tail) := audit_phi_cycle_mark_nodes node_enc rest next in
      (final, AuditPhiCycleMark node calls :: tail)
  end.

Fixpoint audit_phi_cycle_flags_from {N E CN} (EN : encoding N)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (dep : Graph.t N (phi_dependency_edge N E))
    (prepared_dep : prepared EN dep) (components : list (list N)) (marked : FinSet.t N)
    : FinSet.t N * list (audit_phi_cycle_event N E CN) :=
  match components with
  | [] => (marked, [])
  | component :: rest =>
      let '(cyclic, cycle_events) := audit_phi_component_cyclic_counted EN node_enc dep
        prepared_dep component in
      let '(next, mark_events) := if cyclic then audit_phi_cycle_mark_nodes node_enc component
        marked
        else (marked, []) in
      let '(final, tail) := audit_phi_cycle_flags_from EN node_enc dep prepared_dep rest next in
      (final, cycle_events ++ mark_events ++ tail)
  end.

Definition audit_phi_cycle_flags_counted {N E CN} (EN : encoding N)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (dep : Graph.t N (phi_dependency_edge N E))
    (prepared_dep : prepared EN dep) (result : scc_result N)
    : FinSet.t N * list (audit_phi_cycle_event N E CN) :=
  audit_phi_cycle_flags_from EN node_enc dep prepared_dep (components result) FinSet.empty.

Fixpoint audit_phi_cycle_source_work {N E CN} (node_work : list CN -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_phi_cycle_event N E CN)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditPhiCycleComponent _ _ :: rest => 2 + audit_phi_cycle_source_work node_work rest
  | AuditPhiCycleSuccessors _ _ calls :: rest => 2 + audit_map_source_work node_work calls +
    audit_phi_cycle_source_work node_work rest
  | AuditPhiCycleEdgeCase _ :: rest => 2 + audit_phi_cycle_source_work node_work rest
  | AuditPhiCycleTarget _ _ :: rest => 2 + audit_phi_cycle_source_work node_work rest
  | AuditPhiCycleEncode _ _ body :: rest => 2 + node_work body + audit_phi_cycle_source_work
    node_work rest
  | AuditPhiCycleCompare _ _ _ calls :: rest => 2 + audit_positive_eqb_source_work calls +
    audit_phi_cycle_source_work node_work rest
  | AuditPhiCycleMark _ calls :: rest => 2 + audit_finset_source_work node_work calls +
    audit_phi_cycle_source_work node_work rest
  end.

Definition audit_phi_cycle_flags_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E CN (EN : encoding N) (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (dep : Graph.t N (phi_dependency_edge N E)) (prepared_dep : prepared EN dep) result,
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    fst (audit_phi_cycle_flags_counted EN node_enc dep prepared_dep result) =
      phi_cycle_flags EN dep prepared_dep result.

Definition audit_phi_output_counted_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E CN CV (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (version_enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
    (old : memory_graph N E) reps,
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall v, fst (version_enc v) = encode (memory_version_encoding EN EE) v) ->
    fst (audit_phi_producer_output_counted EN EE node_enc version_enc old reps) =
      audit_phi_producer_output EN EE old reps.

Record audit_phi_producer_run {N E T CN CE PE OE CV}
    (EN : encoding N) : Type := AuditPhiProducerRun {
  audit_phi_run_index : phi_dependency_index (E := E) EN;
  audit_phi_run_order : list N;
  audit_phi_run_representatives : Map.t (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E);
  audit_phi_run_output : memory_graph N E;
  audit_phi_run_output_events : list (audit_phi_output_event N E CN CV);
  audit_phi_run_rows : list (audit_phi_row_event N E CN CE PE OE);
  audit_phi_run_dependency_rows : list
    (audit_memory_index_event N (list (phi_dependency_edge N E)) CN
      (audit_phi_dependency_row_event N E CN));
  audit_phi_run_preparation : list (@audit_phi_prepare_event N E T EN);
  audit_phi_run_graph_preparation :
    list (audit_prepare_source_event N (phi_dependency_edge N E)
      (audit_phi_graph_callback_event N E CN));
  audit_phi_run_scc_events :
    list (audit_tarjan_nested_event N (phi_dependency_edge N E)
      (audit_graph_callback_capture N (phi_dependency_edge N E)
        (audit_phi_graph_callback_event N E CN)));
  audit_phi_run_cycle_events : list (audit_phi_cycle_event N E CN);
  audit_phi_run_resolution : list (audit_phi_resolve_event N E CN CV)
}.
Arguments AuditPhiProducerRun {N E T CN CE PE OE CV EN}.

(** Source call adapters are inputs, and their captured traces remain attached to
    the run. SCC nodes are resolved in the exact concatenated component order. *)
Definition audit_phi_produce {N E T CN CE PE OE CV}
    (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
    (pred : N -> list E * list PE)
    (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE)
    (version_enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
    (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E)
    : audit_phi_producer_run EN :=
  let '(inputs, row_events) := audit_phi_input_rows node_enc edge_enc pred operand
    (memory_phis mg) in
  let '(dep, dependency_rows, dependency_events) := audit_phi_dependency_graph_counted EN node_enc
    mg inputs in
  let '(prep, graph_prep_events) := audit_prepare_source_counted EN dep
    (audit_phi_prepare_callbacks node_enc dependency_rows dep) in
  let '(component_result, scc_events) := audit_scc_source_counted prep
    (audit_phi_scc_callbacks node_enc dep) (Graph.nodes dep) in
  let '(cycles, cycle_events) := audit_phi_cycle_flags_counted EN node_enc dep prep
    component_result in
  let index := PhiDependencyIndex inputs dep prep component_result cycles in
  let order := concat (components component_result) in
  let '(representatives, resolution_events) :=
    audit_phi_resolve_all EN node_enc version_enc index order Map.empty in
  let preparation_events :=
    [AuditPhiInputs g effects mg inputs; AuditPhiGraph inputs dep;
     AuditPhiPrepared dep prep; AuditPhiScc component_result; AuditPhiCycles cycles] in
  let '(output, output_events) := audit_phi_producer_output_counted EN EE node_enc version_enc
    mg representatives in
  AuditPhiProducerRun index order representatives output output_events row_events
    dependency_events preparation_events graph_prep_events scc_events cycle_events
      resolution_events.

Definition audit_phi_producer_resolution_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CN CE PE OE CV (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
    (pred : N -> list E * list PE)
    (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE)
    (version_enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
    (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E),
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall v, fst (version_enc v) = encode (memory_version_encoding EN EE) v) ->
    let run := audit_phi_produce EN EE node_enc edge_enc pred operand version_enc g effects mg in
    phi_resolve_trace EN EE (audit_phi_run_index EN run) (audit_phi_run_order EN run) Map.empty
      (audit_phi_run_representatives EN run).

Definition audit_phi_producer_index_source_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CN CE PE OE CV (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
    (pred : N -> list E * list PE)
    (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE)
    (version_enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
    (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E),
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall e, fst (edge_enc e) = encode EE e) ->
    (forall n, fst (pred n) = pred_edges (prepare EN g) n) ->
    (forall n key, fst (operand n key) = memory_operand mg n key) ->
    (forall v, fst (version_enc v) = encode (memory_version_encoding EN EE) v) ->
    let run := audit_phi_produce EN EE node_enc edge_enc pred operand version_enc g effects mg in
    phi_index_graph (audit_phi_run_index EN run) = phi_dependency_graph_from_inputs EN mg
      (phi_input_rows EN EE g effects mg) /\
    phi_index_prepared (audit_phi_run_index EN run) =
      prepare EN (phi_index_graph (audit_phi_run_index EN run)) /\
    phi_index_scc (audit_phi_run_index EN run) =
      scc (phi_index_prepared (audit_phi_run_index EN run)) /\
    phi_index_cycles (audit_phi_run_index EN run) =
      phi_cycle_flags EN (phi_index_graph (audit_phi_run_index EN run))
        (phi_index_prepared (audit_phi_run_index EN run))
        (phi_index_scc (audit_phi_run_index EN run)).

Definition audit_phi_producer_output_shape_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) old reps,
    let output := audit_phi_producer_output EN EE old reps in
    let rep := audit_phi_producer_rep EN EE reps in
    let kept := filter (fun n =>
      Pos.eqb (encode (memory_version_encoding EN EE) (MemoryPhi n))
        (encode (memory_version_encoding EN EE) (rep (MemoryPhi n)))) (memory_phis old) in
    memory_phis output = filter (fun n => FinSet.mem EN n (FinSet.of_list EN kept))
      (memory_phis old) /\
    memory_versions output = filter (fun v => match v with
      | MemoryPhi n => FinSet.mem EN n (FinSet.of_list EN (memory_phis output))
      | _ => true
      end) (memory_versions old) /\
    (forall n, memory_in output n = rep (memory_in old n)) /\
    (forall e, memory_out output e = rep (memory_out old e)) /\
    (forall e i, memory_before output e i = option_map rep (memory_before old e i)) /\
    (forall n key, memory_operand output n key =
      if FinSet.mem EN n (FinSet.of_list EN (memory_phis output))
      then option_map rep (memory_operand old n key) else None).

(** Input-derived outer blocks charge every node row and every actual resolution
    row; internal calls retain their captured child traces in the family costs. *)
Definition audit_phi_producer_work {N E T CN CE PE OE CV}
    (node_work : list CN -> nat) (edge_work : list CE -> nat)
    (pred_work : list PE -> nat) (operand_work : list OE -> nat)
    (version_work : list CV -> nat)
    (EN : encoding N) (run : @audit_phi_producer_run N E T CN CE PE OE CV EN) : nat :=
  audit_phi_rows_source_work node_work edge_work pred_work operand_work
    (audit_phi_run_rows EN run) +
  audit_phi_dependency_rows_work node_work (audit_phi_run_dependency_rows EN run) +
  5 + 5 + 6 + (* dependency graph, dependency index, returned memory graph records *)
  3 + length (audit_phi_run_order EN run) +
    length (components (phi_index_scc (audit_phi_run_index EN run))) +
    fold_right (fun component total => length component + total) 0
      (components (phi_index_scc (audit_phi_run_index EN run))) +
  audit_prepare_source_work (audit_phi_graph_callback_work node_work)
    (audit_phi_run_graph_preparation EN run) +
  audit_scc_source_work (audit_phi_graph_callback_work node_work)
    (audit_phi_run_scc_events EN run) +
  audit_phi_cycle_source_work node_work (audit_phi_run_cycle_events EN run) +
  audit_phi_resolve_source_work node_work version_work (audit_phi_run_resolution EN run) +
  audit_phi_output_source_work node_work version_work (audit_phi_run_output_events EN run).

Definition audit_phi_producer_phase_counts_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CN CE PE OE CV (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
    (pred : N -> list E * list PE)
    (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE)
    (version_enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
    (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E),
    length (audit_phi_run_preparation EN
      (audit_phi_produce EN EE node_enc edge_enc pred operand version_enc g effects mg)) = 5.

Example audit_phi_singleton_cycle_scans_later_edge :
  let edges := [PhiDependencyEdgeData 1%positive (@None positive) 1%positive;
    PhiDependencyEdgeData 1%positive None 2%positive] in
  let dep := {| Graph.entries := [1%positive]; Graph.nodes := [1%positive];
    Graph.out := fun _ => edges; Graph.source := dependency_source;
    Graph.target := dependency_target |} in
  let run := audit_phi_cycle_self_edges audit_positive_encode dep 1%positive edges in
  fst run = true /\ length (snd run) = 11.
Proof.
  vm_compute.
  split; reflexivity.
Qed.
```

```rocq
(** * Fixed public phi pruning and proof-carrying result packaging

    The public package contains the same plain computed graph and representative map.
    For example, the graph-only result projects that same representative-bearing result.
    Builds on: the fixed plain phi producer and the original history, shape and byte predicates. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryGraph.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiState.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiConsumer.

(** The library proves well-formedness of its fixed result before constructing the public
  package. *)
Definition audit_memory_phi_prune_wf_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (g : Graph.t N E)
      (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E),
    memory_graph_wf g effects mg ->
    memory_graph_wf g effects (phi_graph (audit_memory_phi_prune N E T EN EE g effects mg)).

(** This helper accepts the library's own proved theorem; its proof argument is erased. *)
Definition audit_memory_phi_prune_pack (correct : audit_memory_phi_prune_wf_statement)
    : memory_prune_with_map_type :=
  fun N E T EN EE g effects mg wf =>
    exist _ (audit_memory_phi_prune N E T EN EE g effects mg)
      (correct N E T EN EE g effects mg wf).

Definition audit_memory_phi_graph_pack (correct : audit_memory_phi_prune_wf_statement)
    : memory_prune_type := memory_prune_from_map (audit_memory_phi_prune_pack correct).

(** Every promised public semantic predicate is fixed to that same computed producer and map. *)
Definition audit_memory_phi_public_semantics_statement : Prop :=
  audit_memory_phi_prune_wf_statement /\
  forall correct,
    let operation := audit_memory_phi_prune_pack correct in
    memory_phi_projection_statement operation /\
    memory_phi_terminal_removed_statement operation /\
    memory_phi_cycles_retained_statement operation /\
    memory_pruned_builders_projection_statement operation /\
    memory_prune_legacy_checked_statement operation /\
    memory_prune_legacy_bytes_statement operation /\
    memory_phi_removed_has_operand_statement operation /\
    memory_phi_resolved_removed_statement operation /\
    memory_phi_output_shape_statement operation /\
    memory_phi_map_domain_statement operation /\
    phi_resolution_statement operation /\
    memory_prune_wf_contract (audit_memory_phi_graph_pack correct) /\
    memory_prune_map_projection_contract (audit_memory_phi_graph_pack correct) operation.

(** Packaging carries only the exact already-costed plain graph and representative table. *)
Definition audit_memory_phi_public_projection_statement : Prop :=
  forall correct N E T (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (g : Graph.t N E)
      (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E) wf,
    proj1_sig (audit_memory_phi_prune_pack correct N E T EN EE g effects mg wf) =
      audit_memory_phi_prune N E T EN EE g effects mg /\
    proj1_sig (audit_memory_phi_graph_pack correct N E T EN EE g effects mg wf) =
      phi_graph (audit_memory_phi_prune N E T EN EE g effects mg).
```

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiResolve`.

```rocq
(** * Counted phi representative resolution

    This candidate fixes each indexed lookup, representative check and strict comparison.
    For example, a cyclic phi leaves the representative map unchanged.
    Builds on: AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiState and the shared collection observers. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryGraph AnalysesMemoryFlow.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiState.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditTrie.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditPrimitive.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditMap.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditFinSet.
Import List.ListNotations.

Inductive audit_phi_resolve_event (N E CN CV : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditPhiCycleProbe (node : N) (result : bool) (events : list (audit_set_event N CN))
  | AuditPhiInputsProbe (node : N) (result : option (list (option E * memory_version N E)))
      (events : list (audit_map_event N (list (option E * memory_version N E)) CN))
  | AuditPhiRepresentative (input output : memory_version N E)
      (events : list (audit_map_event (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E) CV))
  | AuditPhiVersionEncode (input : memory_version N E) (code : positive) (events : list CV)
  | AuditPhiCompare (left right : positive) (result : bool) (events : list audit_positive_eqb_event)
  | AuditPhiForall (remaining : list (option E * memory_version N E))
  | AuditPhiWrite (events : list (audit_map_event (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E) CV)).

Arguments AuditPhiCycleProbe {N E CN CV} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditPhiInputsProbe {N E CN CV} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditPhiRepresentative {N E CN CV} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditPhiVersionEncode {N E CN CV} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditPhiCompare {N E CN CV} _ _ _ _.
Arguments AuditPhiForall {N E CN CV} _.
Arguments AuditPhiWrite {N E CN CV} _.

(** Lookup retains the actual stored representative or the original fallback. *)
Definition audit_phi_rep {N E CN CV}
    (enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
    (reps : Map.t (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E)) (input : memory_version N E)
    : memory_version N E * list (audit_phi_resolve_event N E CN CV) :=
  let '(found, events) := audit_map_get enc input reps in
  let output := match found with Some v => v | None => input end in
  (output, [AuditPhiRepresentative input output events]).

(** This executes both actual encoders and the fixed positive-equality observer. *)
Definition audit_phi_compare {N E CN CV}
    (enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV) (left right : memory_version N E)
    : bool * list (audit_phi_resolve_event N E CN CV) :=
  let '(lc, le) := enc left in
  let '(rc, re) := enc right in
  let '(result, eq) := audit_positive_eqb lc rc in
  (result, [AuditPhiVersionEncode left lc le; AuditPhiVersionEncode right rc re;
            AuditPhiCompare lc rc result eq]).

(** Every remaining operand is evaluated, including after a false previous comparison. *)
Fixpoint audit_phi_all_same {N E CN CV}
    (enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
    (reps : Map.t (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E))
    (candidate : memory_version N E) (input : list (option E * memory_version N E))
    : bool * list (audit_phi_resolve_event N E CN CV) :=
  match input with
  | [] => (true, [AuditPhiForall input])
  | (_, v) :: rest =>
      let '(rep, re) := @audit_phi_rep N E CN CV enc reps v in
      let '(equal, ee) := audit_phi_compare enc candidate rep in
      let '(tail, te) := audit_phi_all_same enc reps candidate rest in
      (andb equal tail, AuditPhiForall input :: re ++ ee ++ te)
  end.

(** One candidate resolution step fixes the source call order and persistent map result. *)
Definition audit_phi_resolve_step {N E CN CV} (EN : encoding N)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (version_enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
    (index : phi_dependency_index (E := E) EN)
    (reps : Map.t (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E)) (n : N)
    : Map.t (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E) * list (audit_phi_resolve_event N E CN CV) :=
  let '(cyclic, ce) := audit_finset_mem node_enc n (phi_index_cycles index) in
  if cyclic then (reps, [AuditPhiCycleProbe n cyclic ce]) else
    let '(row, ie) := audit_map_get node_enc n (phi_index_inputs index) in
    match row with
    | None | Some [] => (reps, [AuditPhiCycleProbe n cyclic ce; AuditPhiInputsProbe n row ie])
    | Some ((_, v) :: rest) =>
        let '(candidate, re) := @audit_phi_rep N E CN CV version_enc reps v in
        let '(self, se) := audit_phi_compare version_enc candidate (MemoryPhi n) in
        let '(all_same, ae) := audit_phi_all_same version_enc reps candidate rest in
        if andb (negb self) all_same then
          let '(out, we) := audit_map_set version_enc (MemoryPhi n) candidate reps in
          (out, [AuditPhiCycleProbe n cyclic ce; AuditPhiInputsProbe n row ie] ++ re ++ se ++ ae ++
            [AuditPhiWrite we])
        else (reps, [AuditPhiCycleProbe n cyclic ce; AuditPhiInputsProbe n row ie] ++ re ++ se ++
          ae)
    end.

(** * Future semantic and strict traversal obligations *)

Definition audit_phi_resolve_step_refines_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E CN CV (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (index : phi_dependency_index (E := E) EN)
      (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (version_enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
      reps n,
    (forall x, fst (node_enc x) = encode EN x) ->
    (forall x, fst (version_enc x) = encode (memory_version_encoding EN EE) x) ->
    phi_resolve_step EN EE index reps n (fst (audit_phi_resolve_step EN node_enc version_enc index
      reps n)).

(** Fixed outer-frame work plus the exact captured primitive and encoder child traces. *)
Fixpoint audit_phi_resolve_primitive_work {N E CN CV}
    (node_work : list CN -> nat) (version_work : list CV -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_phi_resolve_event N E CN CV)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditPhiCycleProbe _ _ calls :: rest => audit_finset_source_work node_work calls +
      audit_phi_resolve_primitive_work node_work version_work rest
  | AuditPhiInputsProbe _ _ calls :: rest => audit_map_source_work node_work calls +
      audit_phi_resolve_primitive_work node_work version_work rest
  | AuditPhiRepresentative _ _ calls :: rest => audit_map_source_work version_work calls +
      audit_phi_resolve_primitive_work node_work version_work rest
  | AuditPhiVersionEncode _ _ calls :: rest => version_work calls +
      audit_phi_resolve_primitive_work node_work version_work rest
  | AuditPhiCompare _ _ _ calls :: rest => audit_positive_eqb_source_work calls +
      audit_phi_resolve_primitive_work node_work version_work rest
  | AuditPhiForall _ :: rest => audit_phi_resolve_primitive_work node_work version_work rest
  | AuditPhiWrite calls :: rest => audit_map_source_work version_work calls +
      audit_phi_resolve_primitive_work node_work version_work rest
  end.

Definition audit_phi_resolve_source_work {N E CN CV}
    (node_work : list CN -> nat) (version_work : list CV -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_phi_resolve_event N E CN CV)) : nat :=
  2 * length events + audit_phi_resolve_primitive_work node_work version_work events.

(** The bound uses the actual stored row, including every duplicate predecessor occurrence. *)
Definition audit_phi_resolve_source_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E CN CV (EN : encoding N) (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
      (version_enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
      (index : phi_dependency_index (E := E) EN) reps n node_work version_work,
    let events := snd (audit_phi_resolve_step EN node_enc version_enc index reps n) in
    let row := fst (audit_map_get node_enc n (phi_index_inputs index)) in
    audit_phi_resolve_source_work node_work version_work events <=
      16 + 10 * length (match row with None => [] | Some actual => actual end) +
      audit_phi_resolve_primitive_work node_work version_work events.

(** * Complete ordered resolution pass *)

(** Each next step sees the exact persistent map returned by the previous step. *)
Fixpoint audit_phi_resolve_all {N E CN CV} (EN : encoding N)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (version_enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
    (index : phi_dependency_index (E := E) EN) (nodes : list N)
    (reps : Map.t (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E))
    : Map.t (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E) * list (audit_phi_resolve_event N E CN CV) :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => (reps, [])
  | n :: rest =>
      let '(next, first) := audit_phi_resolve_step EN node_enc version_enc index reps n in
      let '(final, tail) := audit_phi_resolve_all EN node_enc version_enc index rest next in
      (final, first ++ tail)
  end.

Definition audit_phi_resolve_all_refines_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E CN CV (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (index : phi_dependency_index (E := E) EN)
      (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (version_enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
      nodes reps,
    (forall x, fst (node_enc x) = encode EN x) ->
    (forall x, fst (version_enc x) = encode (memory_version_encoding EN EE) x) ->
    phi_resolve_trace EN EE index nodes reps
      (fst (audit_phi_resolve_all EN node_enc version_enc index nodes reps)).

(** The budget charges actual rows and child traces at each changing representative map. *)
Fixpoint audit_phi_resolve_all_budget {N E CN CV} (EN : encoding N)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (version_enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
    (index : phi_dependency_index (E := E) EN) (nodes : list N)
    (reps : Map.t (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E))
    (node_work : list CN -> nat) (version_work : list CV -> nat) : nat :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => 0
  | n :: rest =>
      let '(next, events) := audit_phi_resolve_step EN node_enc version_enc index reps n in
      let row := fst (audit_map_get node_enc n (phi_index_inputs index)) in
      16 + 10 * length (match row with None => [] | Some actual => actual end) +
        audit_phi_resolve_primitive_work node_work version_work events +
        audit_phi_resolve_all_budget EN node_enc version_enc index rest next node_work version_work
  end.

Definition audit_phi_resolve_all_source_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E CN CV (EN : encoding N) (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
      (version_enc : memory_version N E -> positive * list CV)
      (index : phi_dependency_index (E := E) EN) nodes reps node_work version_work,
    audit_phi_resolve_source_work node_work version_work
      (snd (audit_phi_resolve_all EN node_enc version_enc index nodes reps)) <=
    audit_phi_resolve_all_budget EN node_enc version_enc index nodes reps node_work version_work.
```

## AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiRows

`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiRows.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiRows`.

```rocq
(** * Counted phi input rows

    This mirror preserves predecessor occurrences, first-occurrence keys and operand callbacks.
    For example, duplicate predecessor keys are probed twice but retained at their first position.
    Builds on: G4 phi inputs and shared collection and encoding observers. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare GraphDominance.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryGraph.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiState.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditEncoding.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditMap.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditFinSet.
Import List.ListNotations.

Inductive audit_phi_distinct_event (K CE : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditPhiDistinctCase (remaining : list K) (seen : FinSet.t K)
  | AuditPhiDistinctProbe (key : K) (found : bool) (calls : list (audit_set_event K CE))
  | AuditPhiDistinctAdd (key : K) (calls : list (audit_set_event K CE))
  | AuditPhiDistinctKeep (key : K).

Arguments AuditPhiDistinctCase {K CE} _ _.
Arguments AuditPhiDistinctProbe {K CE} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditPhiDistinctAdd {K CE} _ _.
Arguments AuditPhiDistinctKeep {K CE} _.

(** This is the exact first-occurrence traversal used by [memory_distinct]. *)
Fixpoint audit_phi_distinct_from {K CE} (enc : K -> positive * list CE)
    (seen : FinSet.t K) (input : list K) : list K * list (audit_phi_distinct_event K CE) :=
  match input with
  | [] => ([], [AuditPhiDistinctCase input seen])
  | key :: rest =>
      let '(found, probes) := audit_finset_mem enc key seen in
      if found then
        let '(out, events) := audit_phi_distinct_from enc seen rest in
        (out, [AuditPhiDistinctCase input seen; AuditPhiDistinctProbe key found probes] ++ events)
      else
        let '(next, adds) := audit_finset_add enc key seen in
        let '(out, events) := audit_phi_distinct_from enc next rest in
        (key :: out, [AuditPhiDistinctCase input seen; AuditPhiDistinctProbe key found probes;
                      AuditPhiDistinctAdd key adds; AuditPhiDistinctKeep key] ++ events)
  end.

Inductive audit_phi_row_event (N E CN CE PE OE : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditPhiPred (node : N) (edges : list E) (events : list PE)
  | AuditPhiDistinctKeys (events : list (audit_phi_distinct_event (option E) (audit_option_event E
    CE)))
  | AuditPhiRowOperand (node : N) (key : option E) (result : option (memory_version N E))
      (events : list OE)
  | AuditPhiRowStore (events : list (audit_map_event N (list (option E * memory_version N E)) CN)).

Arguments AuditPhiPred {N E CN CE PE OE} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditPhiDistinctKeys {N E CN CE PE OE} _.
Arguments AuditPhiRowOperand {N E CN CE PE OE} _ _ _ _.
Arguments AuditPhiRowStore {N E CN CE PE OE} _.

(** Each distinct key retains the actual optional operand result and its child trace. *)
Fixpoint audit_phi_row_operands {N E CN CE PE OE}
    (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE) (n : N)
    (keys : list (option E))
    : list (option E * memory_version N E) * list (audit_phi_row_event N E CN CE PE OE) :=
  match keys with
  | [] => ([], [])
  | key :: rest =>
      let '(result, calls) := operand n key in
      let '(tail, events) := @audit_phi_row_operands N E CN CE PE OE operand n rest in
      (match result with Some v => (key, v) :: tail | None => tail end,
        AuditPhiRowOperand n key result calls :: events)
  end.

Definition audit_phi_input_row {N E CN CE PE OE}
    (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (pred : N -> list E * list PE)
    (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE) (n : N)
    : list (option E * memory_version N E) * list (audit_phi_row_event N E CN CE PE OE) :=
  let '(edges, pe) := pred n in
  let '(keys, de) := audit_phi_distinct_from (audit_option_encode edge_enc) FinSet.empty
    (None :: map Some edges) in
  let '(row, oe) := @audit_phi_row_operands N E CN CE PE OE operand n keys in
  (row, [AuditPhiPred n edges pe; AuditPhiDistinctKeys de] ++ oe).

(** The result index uses the same tail-first order as [memory_result_index]. *)
Fixpoint audit_phi_input_rows {N E CN CE PE OE}
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
    (pred : N -> list E * list PE)
    (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE) (nodes : list N)
    : Map.t N (list (option E * memory_version N E)) * list (audit_phi_row_event N E CN CE PE OE) :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => (Map.empty, [])
  | n :: rest =>
      let '(tail, te) := audit_phi_input_rows node_enc edge_enc pred operand rest in
      let '(row, re) := @audit_phi_input_row N E CN CE PE OE edge_enc pred operand n in
      let '(out, se) := audit_map_set node_enc n row tail in
      (out, te ++ re ++ [AuditPhiRowStore se])
  end.

(** * Future exact-result and occurrence bounds *)

Definition audit_phi_distinct_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall K CE (enc : K -> positive * list CE) (EK : encoding K) seen input,
    (forall key, In key input -> fst (enc key) = encode EK key) ->
    fst (audit_phi_distinct_from enc seen input) = virtual_entries_from EK seen input.

Definition audit_phi_input_rows_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CN CE PE OE (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (g : Graph.t N E)
      (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E)
      (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
      (pred : N -> list E * list PE)
      (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE),
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall e, fst (edge_enc e) = encode EE e) ->
    (forall n, fst (pred n) = pred_edges (prepare EN g) n) ->
    (forall n key, fst (operand n key) = memory_operand mg n key) ->
    fst (audit_phi_input_rows node_enc edge_enc pred operand (memory_phis mg)) =
      phi_input_rows EN EE g effects mg.

Fixpoint audit_phi_rows_budget {N E PE} (pred : N -> list E * list PE) (nodes : list N) : nat :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => 0
  | n :: rest => 4 + length (fst (pred n)) + audit_phi_rows_budget pred rest
  end.

Definition audit_phi_input_rows_count_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E CN CE PE OE (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
      (pred : N -> list E * list PE)
      (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE) nodes,
    length (snd (audit_phi_input_rows node_enc edge_enc pred operand nodes)) <=
      audit_phi_rows_budget pred nodes.

(** * Nested collection and callback source charges *)

Fixpoint audit_phi_distinct_work {K CE} (enc_work : list CE -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_phi_distinct_event K CE)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditPhiDistinctCase _ _ :: rest => 1 + audit_phi_distinct_work enc_work rest
  | AuditPhiDistinctProbe _ _ calls :: rest => audit_finset_source_work enc_work calls +
      audit_phi_distinct_work enc_work rest
  | AuditPhiDistinctAdd _ calls :: rest => audit_finset_source_work enc_work calls +
      audit_phi_distinct_work enc_work rest
  | AuditPhiDistinctKeep _ :: rest => 1 + audit_phi_distinct_work enc_work rest
  end.

Fixpoint audit_phi_rows_primitive_work {N E CN CE PE OE} (node_work : list CN -> nat)
    (edge_work : list CE -> nat) (pred_work : list PE -> nat) (operand_work : list OE -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_phi_row_event N E CN CE PE OE)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditPhiPred _ edges calls :: rest => length edges + pred_work calls +
      audit_phi_rows_primitive_work node_work edge_work pred_work operand_work rest
  | AuditPhiDistinctKeys calls :: rest =>
      audit_phi_distinct_work (audit_option_events_work edge_work) calls +
      audit_phi_rows_primitive_work node_work edge_work pred_work operand_work rest
  | AuditPhiRowOperand _ _ _ calls :: rest => operand_work calls +
      audit_phi_rows_primitive_work node_work edge_work pred_work operand_work rest
  | AuditPhiRowStore calls :: rest => audit_map_source_work node_work calls +
      audit_phi_rows_primitive_work node_work edge_work pred_work operand_work rest
  end.

Definition audit_phi_rows_source_work {N E CN CE PE OE} (node_work : list CN -> nat)
    (edge_work : list CE -> nat) (pred_work : list PE -> nat) (operand_work : list OE -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_phi_row_event N E CN CE PE OE)) : nat :=
  1 + 2 * length events + audit_phi_rows_primitive_work node_work edge_work pred_work operand_work
    events.

Definition audit_phi_input_rows_source_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E CN CE PE OE (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
      (pred : N -> list E * list PE)
      (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE) nodes
      node_work edge_work pred_work operand_work,
    let events := snd (audit_phi_input_rows node_enc edge_enc pred operand nodes) in
    audit_phi_rows_source_work node_work edge_work pred_work operand_work events <=
      1 + 2 * audit_phi_rows_budget pred nodes +
      audit_phi_rows_primitive_work node_work edge_work pred_work operand_work events.
```

```rocq
(** * Input preparation and concrete phi predecessor reads

    The complete counted prune prepares the input graph once before any phi input row query.
    For example, each predecessor callback performs one read in that same prepared incoming map.
    Builds on: full graph preparation, concrete map reads and the full phi producer. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare GraphAuditBase.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryGraph.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditMap.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditEncoding.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryEncoding.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiProducer.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiInputBudget.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiConsumer.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiState.
Import List.ListNotations.

Inductive audit_phi_input_graph_body (CN OE TE : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditPhiInputNodeBody (events : list CN)
  | AuditPhiInputOutBody (events : list OE)
  | AuditPhiInputTargetBody (events : list TE).
Arguments AuditPhiInputNodeBody {CN OE TE} _.
Arguments AuditPhiInputOutBody {CN OE TE} _.
Arguments AuditPhiInputTargetBody {CN OE TE} _.

Definition audit_phi_input_graph_body_work {CN OE TE} (node_work : list CN -> nat)
    (out_work : list OE -> nat) (target_work : list TE -> nat)
    (body : audit_phi_input_graph_body CN OE TE) : nat :=
  match body with
  | AuditPhiInputNodeBody events => node_work events
  | AuditPhiInputOutBody events => out_work events
  | AuditPhiInputTargetBody events => target_work events
  end.

Definition audit_phi_input_graph_callbacks {N E CN OE TE}
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (out : N -> list E * list OE)
    (target : E -> N * list TE) :
    audit_prepare_callback_model N E (audit_phi_input_graph_body CN OE TE) :=
  @AuditPrepareCallbackModel N E (audit_phi_input_graph_body CN OE TE)
    (fun n => let '(edges, body) := out n in (edges, [AuditPhiInputOutBody body]))
    (fun e => let '(n, body) := target e in (n, [AuditPhiInputTargetBody body]))
    (fun n => let '(code, body) := node_enc n in (code, [AuditPhiInputNodeBody body])).

Definition audit_phi_predecessors_counted {N E CN} (EN : encoding N)
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (g : Graph.t N E) (base : prepared EN g) (node : N) :=
  let '(found, events) := audit_map_get node_enc node (in_index base) in
  (match found with Some edges => edges | None => [] end, events).

Definition audit_memory_phi_prune_counted {N E T CN CE OE TE PE}
    (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (out : N -> list E * list OE)
    (target : E -> N * list TE)
    (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list PE)
    (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E) :=
  let '(base, preparation) := audit_prepare_source_counted EN g
    (audit_phi_input_graph_callbacks node_enc out target) in
  let run := audit_phi_produce EN EE node_enc edge_enc
    (audit_phi_predecessors_counted EN node_enc g base) operand
    (audit_memory_version_encode node_enc edge_enc) g effects mg in
  (base, preparation, run).

Fixpoint audit_phi_input_targets_envelope {N E TE} (target : E -> N * list TE)
    (node_budget : N -> nat) (target_budget : E -> nat) (edges : list E) : nat :=
  match edges with
  | [] => 0
  | e :: rest => target_budget e + node_budget (fst (target e)) +
      audit_phi_input_targets_envelope target node_budget target_budget rest
  end.

Fixpoint audit_phi_input_graph_envelope {N E OE TE}
    (out : N -> list E * list OE) (target : E -> N * list TE)
    (node_budget out_budget : N -> nat) (target_budget : E -> nat) (nodes : list N) : nat :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => 0
  | n :: rest => node_budget n + out_budget n +
      audit_phi_input_targets_envelope target node_budget target_budget (fst (out n)) +
      audit_phi_input_graph_envelope out target node_budget out_budget target_budget rest
  end.

(** The exact complete source includes original-graph setup and concrete internal predecessor
  reads. *)
Definition audit_memory_phi_prune_whole_input_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CN CE OE TE PE (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
      (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
      (out : N -> list E * list OE) (target : E -> N * list TE)
      (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list PE)
      node_work edge_work out_work target_work operand_work
      node_budget edge_budget out_budget target_budget operand_budget
      (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E),
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall n, fst (out n) = Graph.out g n) ->
    (forall e, fst (target e) = Graph.target g e) ->
    (forall n, node_work (snd (node_enc n)) <= node_budget n) ->
    (forall e, edge_work (snd (edge_enc e)) <= edge_budget e) ->
    (forall n, out_work (snd (out n)) <= out_budget n) ->
    (forall e, target_work (snd (target e)) <= target_budget e) ->
    (forall n key, operand_work (snd (operand n key)) <= operand_budget n key) ->
    let '(base, preparation, run) := audit_memory_phi_prune_counted EN EE node_enc edge_enc
      out target operand g effects mg in
    audit_prepare_source_work (audit_phi_input_graph_body_work node_work out_work target_work)
      preparation +
    audit_phi_producer_work node_work edge_work (audit_map_source_work node_work) operand_work
      (audit_memory_version_work node_work edge_work) EN run <=
    audit_prepare_source_budget EN g + audit_graph_prepare_full_event_bound g *
      audit_phi_input_graph_envelope out target node_budget out_budget target_budget (Graph.nodes
        g) +
    audit_phi_producer_input_budget EN EE node_enc edge_enc
      (audit_phi_predecessors_counted EN node_enc g base) operand node_budget edge_budget
      (audit_phi_get_input_budget node_enc node_budget) operand_budget g effects mg.

(** The same complete run produces the exact fixed pruning graph and representative table. *)
Definition audit_memory_phi_prune_counted_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CN CE OE TE PE (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
      (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
      (out : N -> list E * list OE) (target : E -> N * list TE)
      (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list PE)
      (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E),
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall e, fst (edge_enc e) = encode EE e) ->
    (forall n, fst (out n) = Graph.out g n) ->
    (forall e, fst (target e) = Graph.target g e) ->
    (forall n key, fst (operand n key) = memory_operand mg n key) ->
    let '(base, _, run) := audit_memory_phi_prune_counted EN EE node_enc edge_enc out target operand
      g effects mg in
    base = prepare EN g /\
    let original := audit_memory_phi_prune N E T EN EE g effects mg in
    audit_phi_run_output EN run = phi_graph original /\
    audit_phi_run_representatives EN run = phi_representatives original.
```

## AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiState

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiState.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemoryPhiState`.

```rocq
(** * G4 memory phi semantics

    This declaration-only pilot isolates G4 semantic contracts.
    For example, it keeps the historical observation in its original statement.
    Builds on: Galois.Analyses. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List Bool NArith PArith ZArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare GraphScc.
From Galois.Domains Require Import DomainsFootprint.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsSemantics ViewsGraph ViewsMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryBase AnalysesMemoryGraph AnalysesMemoryFlow
  AnalysesMemoryLegacy AnalysesMemoryFrontier AnalysesMemorySealed.
Import List.ListNotations.


(** Declarations from the PhiProbe candidate. *)
Record phi_result (N E : Type) : Type := PhiResult {
  phi_graph : memory_graph N E;
  phi_representatives : Map.t (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E)
}.

Arguments phi_graph {N E}.
Arguments phi_representatives {N E}.

Definition phi_rep {N E} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (r : phi_result N E) (v : memory_version N E) : memory_version N E :=
  match Map.get (memory_version_encoding EN EE) v (phi_representatives r) with
  | Some representative => representative
  | None => v
  end.

Definition phi_history_projection {N E T} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (old : memory_graph N E)
    (r : phi_result N E) : Prop :=
  let new := phi_graph r in
  let rep := phi_rep EN EE r in
  memory_graph_wf g effects new /\
  Map.wf (memory_version_encoding EN EE) (phi_representatives r) /\
  (forall n, In n (memory_phis new) -> In n (memory_phis old)) /\
  (forall v, memory_valid_version g effects old v -> memory_valid_version g effects new (rep v)) /\
  rep MemoryLive = MemoryLive /\
  (forall e i, rep (MemoryDef e i) = MemoryDef e i) /\
  (forall n, In n (memory_phis new) -> rep (MemoryPhi n) = MemoryPhi n) /\
  (forall v, rep (rep v) = rep v) /\
  (forall n, memory_in new n = rep (memory_in old n)) /\
  (forall e, memory_out new e = rep (memory_out old e)) /\
  (forall e i, memory_before new e i = option_map rep (memory_before old e i)) /\
  (forall n key, In n (memory_phis new) ->
    memory_operand new n key = option_map rep (memory_operand old n key)) /\
  (forall n, In n (memory_phis old) -> ~ In n (memory_phis new) ->
    rep (MemoryPhi n) <> MemoryPhi n /\
    forall key input, memory_operand old n key = Some input -> rep input = rep (MemoryPhi n)) /\
  (forall root es n v origin, memory_provenance g effects old root es n v origin ->
    memory_provenance g effects new root es n (rep v) origin) /\
  forall es e i input origin, memory_occurrence_history g effects old es e i input origin ->
    memory_occurrence_history g effects new es e i (rep input) origin.

Inductive phi_dependency_path {N E} (mg : memory_graph N E) : N -> N -> Prop :=
  | PhiDependencyEdge : forall n key next,
      memory_operand mg n key = Some (MemoryPhi next) -> phi_dependency_path mg n next
  | PhiDependencyExtend : forall n key middle last,
      memory_operand mg n key = Some (MemoryPhi middle) ->
      phi_dependency_path mg middle last -> phi_dependency_path mg n last.

Section Candidate.
  Variable prune : forall N E T, encoding N -> encoding E -> Graph.t N E ->
    (E -> list (memory_effect T)) -> memory_graph N E -> phi_result N E.

  Definition phi_projection_statement : Prop :=
    forall N E T (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (g : Graph.t N E)
      (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) old,
      memory_graph_wf g effects old -> phi_history_projection EN EE g effects old
        (prune N E T EN EE g effects old).

  Definition phi_terminal_elimination_statement : Prop :=
    forall N E T (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (g : Graph.t N E)
      (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) old,
      memory_graph_wf g effects old ->
      forall n v, In n (memory_phis old) ->
        (v = MemoryLive \/ exists e i, v = MemoryDef e i) ->
        (exists key, memory_operand old n key = Some v) ->
        (forall key input, memory_operand old n key = Some input -> input = v) ->
        ~ In n (memory_phis (phi_graph (prune N E T EN EE g effects old))).

  Definition phi_self_only_retained_statement : Prop :=
    forall N E T (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (g : Graph.t N E)
      (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) old,
      memory_graph_wf g effects old ->
      forall n, In n (memory_phis old) ->
        (exists key, memory_operand old n key = Some (MemoryPhi n)) ->
        (forall key input, memory_operand old n key = Some input -> input = MemoryPhi n) ->
        In n (memory_phis (phi_graph (prune N E T EN EE g effects old))).

  Definition phi_cycle_retained_statement : Prop :=
    forall N E T (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (g : Graph.t N E)

(** Declarations from the PhiDependencyProbe candidate. *)
Record phi_dependency_edge (N E : Type) : Type := PhiDependencyEdgeData {
  dependency_source : N;
  dependency_key : option E;
  dependency_target : N
}.
Arguments PhiDependencyEdgeData {N E}.
Arguments dependency_source {N E}.
Arguments dependency_key {N E}.
Arguments dependency_target {N E}.

Definition phi_input_rows {N E T} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (g : Graph.t N E)
    (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E) :
    Map.t N (list (option E * memory_version N E)) :=
  let base := prepare EN g in
  memory_result_index EN (fun n =>
    let raw_keys := None :: map Some (pred_edges base n) in
    let keys := memory_distinct (option_encoding EE) raw_keys in
    flat_map (fun key => match memory_operand mg n key with
      | Some input => [(key,input)] | None => []
      end) keys) (memory_phis mg).

Definition phi_dependency_rows_from_inputs {N E} (EN : encoding N) (mg : memory_graph N E)
    (inputs : Map.t N (list (option E * memory_version N E))) :
    Map.t N (list (phi_dependency_edge N E)) :=
  memory_result_index EN (fun n => flat_map (fun kv => match snd kv with
    | MemoryPhi target => [PhiDependencyEdgeData n (fst kv) target]
    | _ => [] end) (index_edges EN inputs n)) (memory_phis mg).

Definition phi_dependency_graph_from_inputs {N E} (EN : encoding N) (mg : memory_graph N E)
    (inputs : Map.t N (list (option E * memory_version N E))) : Graph.t N (phi_dependency_edge N
      E) :=
  let rows := phi_dependency_rows_from_inputs EN mg inputs in
  {| Graph.entries := memory_phis mg;
     Graph.nodes := memory_phis mg;
     Graph.out := index_edges EN rows;
     Graph.source := dependency_source;
     Graph.target := dependency_target |}.

Definition phi_dependency_graph {N E T} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (g : Graph.t N E)
    (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E) : Graph.t N
      (phi_dependency_edge N E) :=
  phi_dependency_graph_from_inputs EN mg (phi_input_rows EN EE g effects mg).

Definition phi_dependency_ready_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (g : Graph.t N E)
    (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) mg,
    memory_graph_wf g effects mg ->
    let dep := phi_dependency_graph EN EE g effects mg in ready EN dep (prepare EN dep).

Definition phi_dependency_paths_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (g : Graph.t N E)
    (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) mg,
    memory_graph_wf g effects mg -> forall n m,
    In n (memory_phis mg) ->
    (phi_dependency_path mg n m <->
      exists edges, edges <> [] /\ path (phi_dependency_graph EN EE g effects mg) n edges m).

Definition phi_component_cyclic {N E} (EN : encoding N) (dep : Graph.t N (phi_dependency_edge N E))
    (p : prepared EN dep) (component : list N) : bool :=
  match component with
  | [] => false
  | [n] => existsb (fun edge => Pos.eqb (encode EN (Graph.target dep edge)) (encode EN n))
    (succ_edges p n)
  | _ :: _ :: _ => true
  end.

Definition phi_cycle_flags {N E} (EN : encoding N) (dep : Graph.t N (phi_dependency_edge N E))
    (p : prepared EN dep) (r : scc_result N) : FinSet.t N :=
  fold_left (fun marked component =>
    if phi_component_cyclic EN dep p component then
      fold_left (fun flags n => FinSet.add EN n flags) component marked
    else marked) (components r) FinSet.empty.

Record phi_dependency_index {N E} (EN : encoding N) : Type := PhiDependencyIndex {
  phi_index_inputs : Map.t N (list (option E * memory_version N E));
  phi_index_graph : Graph.t N (phi_dependency_edge N E);
  phi_index_prepared : prepared EN phi_index_graph;
  phi_index_scc : scc_result N;
  phi_index_cycles : FinSet.t N
}.
Arguments PhiDependencyIndex {N E EN}.
Arguments phi_index_inputs {N E EN}.
Arguments phi_index_graph {N E EN}.
Arguments phi_index_prepared {N E EN}.
Arguments phi_index_scc {N E EN}.
Arguments phi_index_cycles {N E EN}.

Definition phi_prepare_dependencies {N E T} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E) :
    phi_dependency_index (E := E) EN :=
  let inputs := phi_input_rows EN EE g effects mg in
  let dep := phi_dependency_graph_from_inputs EN mg inputs in
  let prep := prepare EN dep in
  let components := scc prep in
  PhiDependencyIndex inputs dep prep components (phi_cycle_flags EN dep prep components).

Definition phi_cycle_flags_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (g : Graph.t N E)
    (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) mg,
    memory_graph_wf g effects mg -> forall n, In n (memory_phis mg) ->
    (FinSet.mem EN n (phi_index_cycles (phi_prepare_dependencies EN EE g effects mg)) = true <->
      phi_dependency_path mg n n).

(** Declarations from the PhiResolveProbe candidate. *)
Definition phi_rep_from_map {N E} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (representatives : Map.t (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E)) (v : memory_version N E) :
    memory_version N E :=
  match Map.get (memory_version_encoding EN EE) v representatives with
  | Some r => r
  | None => v
  end.

Definition phi_same_rep {N E} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (representatives : Map.t (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E))
    (candidate : memory_version N E) (entry : option E * memory_version N E) : bool :=
  Pos.eqb (encode (memory_version_encoding EN EE) candidate)
    (encode (memory_version_encoding EN EE) (phi_rep_from_map EN EE representatives (snd entry))).

Inductive phi_resolve_step {N E} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (index : phi_dependency_index (E := E) EN) :
    Map.t (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E) -> N ->
    Map.t (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E) -> Prop :=
  | PhiResolveCyclic : forall representatives n,
      FinSet.mem EN n (phi_index_cycles index) = true ->
      phi_resolve_step EN EE index representatives n representatives
  | PhiResolveEmpty : forall representatives n,
      FinSet.mem EN n (phi_index_cycles index) = false ->
      index_edges EN (phi_index_inputs index) n = [] ->
      phi_resolve_step EN EE index representatives n representatives
  | PhiResolveEqual : forall representatives n key input rest candidate,
      FinSet.mem EN n (phi_index_cycles index) = false ->
      index_edges EN (phi_index_inputs index) n = (key,input) :: rest ->
      candidate = phi_rep_from_map EN EE representatives input ->
      Pos.eqb (encode (memory_version_encoding EN EE) candidate)
        (encode (memory_version_encoding EN EE) (MemoryPhi n)) = false ->
      forallb (phi_same_rep EN EE representatives candidate) rest = true ->
      phi_resolve_step EN EE index representatives n
        (Map.set (memory_version_encoding EN EE) (MemoryPhi n) candidate representatives)
  | PhiResolveKeep : forall representatives n key input rest candidate,
      FinSet.mem EN n (phi_index_cycles index) = false ->
      index_edges EN (phi_index_inputs index) n = (key,input) :: rest ->
      candidate = phi_rep_from_map EN EE representatives input ->
      (Pos.eqb (encode (memory_version_encoding EN EE) candidate)
         (encode (memory_version_encoding EN EE) (MemoryPhi n)) = true \/
       forallb (phi_same_rep EN EE representatives candidate) rest = false) ->
      phi_resolve_step EN EE index representatives n representatives.

Inductive phi_resolve_trace {N E} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (index : phi_dependency_index (E := E) EN) : list N ->
    Map.t (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E) ->
    Map.t (memory_version N E) (memory_version N E) -> Prop :=
  | PhiResolveTraceNil : forall representatives,
      phi_resolve_trace EN EE index [] representatives representatives
  | PhiResolveTraceCons : forall n rest before after final,
      phi_resolve_step EN EE index before n after ->
      phi_resolve_trace EN EE index rest after final ->
      phi_resolve_trace EN EE index (n :: rest) before final.

Definition phi_resolution_statement (prune : memory_prune_with_map_type) : Prop :=
  forall N E T (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (g : Graph.t N E)
    (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) mg (wf : memory_graph_wf g effects mg),
    let index := phi_prepare_dependencies EN EE g effects mg in
    let result := proj1_sig (prune N E T EN EE g effects mg wf) in
    phi_resolve_trace EN EE index (concat (components (phi_index_scc index))) Map.empty
      (phi_representatives result).

Definition phi_resolve_step_total_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (index : phi_dependency_index (E := E) EN)
    before n, exists after, phi_resolve_step EN EE index before n after.
Definition phi_resolve_step_deterministic_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (index : phi_dependency_index (E := E) EN)
    before n a b, phi_resolve_step EN EE index before n a -> phi_resolve_step EN EE index before n
      b -> a = b.
```
