```rocq
Import List.ListNotations.

Inductive audit_raw_next_event (N E T CE SE IE OE BE : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditRawBranch (version : memory_version N E)
  | AuditRawIncoming (node : N) (edges : list E) (events : list IE)
  | AuditRawOperand (node : N) (key : option E) (result : option (memory_version N E))
      (events : list OE)
  | AuditRawEffectGet (events : list (audit_memory_effect_get_event E T CE))
  | AuditRawBefore (edge : E) (index : nat) (result : option (memory_version N E))
      (events : list BE)
  | AuditRawDisjoint (left right : memory_scope T) (result : bool)
      (events : list (audit_disjoint_event T SE)).

Arguments AuditRawBranch {N E T CE SE IE OE BE} _.
Arguments AuditRawIncoming {N E T CE SE IE OE BE} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditRawOperand {N E T CE SE IE OE BE} _ _ _ _.
Arguments AuditRawEffectGet {N E T CE SE IE OE BE} _.
Arguments AuditRawBefore {N E T CE SE IE OE BE} _ _ _ _.
Arguments AuditRawDisjoint {N E T CE SE IE OE BE} _ _ _ _.

(** Every key occurrence calls the actual operand function and preserves its nested trace. *)
Fixpoint audit_memory_operands {N E T CE SE IE OE BE}
    (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE)
    (node : N) (keys : list (option E))
    : list (memory_version N E) * list (audit_raw_next_event N E T CE SE IE OE BE) :=
  match keys with
  | [] => ([], [])
  | key :: rest =>
      let '(entry, oe) := operand node key in
      let '(tail, events) := @audit_memory_operands N E T CE SE IE OE BE operand node rest in
      (match entry with Some v => v :: tail | None => tail end,
        AuditRawOperand node key entry oe :: events)
  end.

(** Both strict boolean operands and their nested calls are retained at definitions. *)
Definition audit_memory_raw_next {N E T CE SE IE OE BE}
    (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE)
    (table : Map.t E (Map.t nat (memory_effect T)))
    (incoming : N -> list E * list IE)
    (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE)
    (before : E -> nat -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE)
    (q : memory_scope T) (v : memory_version N E)
    : list (memory_version N E) * list (audit_raw_next_event N E T CE SE IE OE BE) :=
  match v with
  | MemoryLive => ([], [AuditRawBranch v])
  | MemoryPhi n =>
      let '(edges, ie) := incoming n in
      let '(out, oe) := @audit_memory_operands N E T CE SE IE OE BE operand n
        (None :: map Some edges) in
      (out, [AuditRawBranch v; AuditRawIncoming n edges ie] ++ oe)
  | MemoryDef e i =>
      let '(effect, ee) := audit_memory_effect_get edge_enc table e i in
      match effect with
      | None => ([], [AuditRawBranch v; AuditRawEffectGet ee])
      | Some a =>
        let '(previous, be) := before e i in
        match previous with
        | Some p =>
          let writes := effect_writes a in
          let '(disjoint, de) := audit_memory_scopes_disjoint site_enc writes q in
          let result := if andb (effect_is_def a) disjoint then [p] else [] in
          (result, [AuditRawBranch v; AuditRawEffectGet ee; AuditRawBefore e i previous be;
                    AuditRawDisjoint writes q disjoint de])
        | None => ([], [AuditRawBranch v; AuditRawEffectGet ee; AuditRawBefore e i previous be])
        end
      end
  end.

(** * Future exact-result and occurrence-count obligations *)

Definition audit_memory_raw_next_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CE SE IE OE BE (EE : encoding E) (ET : encoding T)
      (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE)
      table (incoming : N -> list E * list IE)
      (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE)
      (before : E -> nat -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE) mg q v,
    (forall e, fst (edge_enc e) = encode EE e) ->
    (forall t, fst (site_enc t) = encode ET t) ->
    (forall n key, fst (operand n key) = memory_operand mg n key) ->
    (forall e i, fst (before e i) = memory_before mg e i) ->
    fst (audit_memory_raw_next edge_enc site_enc table incoming operand before q v) =
      memory_walk_raw_next EE ET table (fun n => fst (incoming n)) mg q v.

Definition audit_memory_operands_count_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CE SE IE OE BE
      (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE) node keys,
    length (snd (@audit_memory_operands N E T CE SE IE OE BE operand node keys)) = length keys.

(** * Actual child work and occurrence-sensitive bound *)

Fixpoint audit_raw_next_primitive_work {N E T CE SE IE OE BE}
    (edge_work : list CE -> nat) (site_work : list SE -> nat)
    (incoming_work : list IE -> nat) (operand_work : list OE -> nat)
    (before_work : list BE -> nat) (events : list (audit_raw_next_event N E T CE SE IE OE BE))
    : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditRawIncoming _ edges calls :: rest => length edges + incoming_work calls +
      audit_raw_next_primitive_work edge_work site_work incoming_work operand_work before_work rest
  | AuditRawOperand _ _ _ calls :: rest => operand_work calls +
      audit_raw_next_primitive_work edge_work site_work incoming_work operand_work before_work rest
  | AuditRawEffectGet calls :: rest => audit_memory_effect_get_work edge_work calls +
      audit_raw_next_primitive_work edge_work site_work incoming_work operand_work before_work rest
  | AuditRawBefore _ _ _ calls :: rest => before_work calls +
      audit_raw_next_primitive_work edge_work site_work incoming_work operand_work before_work rest
  | AuditRawDisjoint _ _ _ calls :: rest => audit_disjoint_source_work site_work calls +
      audit_raw_next_primitive_work edge_work site_work incoming_work operand_work before_work rest
  | _ :: rest =>
      audit_raw_next_primitive_work edge_work site_work incoming_work operand_work before_work rest
  end.

Definition audit_raw_next_source_work {N E T CE SE IE OE BE}
    (edge_work : list CE -> nat) (site_work : list SE -> nat)
    (incoming_work : list IE -> nat) (operand_work : list OE -> nat) (before_work : list BE -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_raw_next_event N E T CE SE IE OE BE)) : nat :=
  2 * length events +
    audit_raw_next_primitive_work edge_work site_work incoming_work operand_work before_work events.

(** The bound retains all actual parallel-edge occurrences and every captured child body. *)
Definition audit_raw_next_source_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CE SE IE OE BE (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
      (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE) table (incoming : N -> list E * list IE)
      (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list OE)
      (before : E -> nat -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE) q v
      edge_work site_work incoming_work operand_work before_work,
    let events := snd (audit_memory_raw_next edge_enc site_enc table incoming operand before q v) in
    audit_raw_next_source_work edge_work site_work incoming_work operand_work before_work events <=
      8 + 2 * (match v with MemoryPhi n => length (fst (incoming n)) | _ => 0 end) +
      audit_raw_next_primitive_work edge_work site_work incoming_work operand_work before_work
        events.

(** The first missing effect suppresses the later memory-before callback in the source match. *)
Example audit_raw_next_first_missing_skips_before :
  let edge_enc := fun e : positive => (e, @nil unit) in
  let site_enc := fun t : positive => (t, @nil unit) in
  let incoming := fun _ : positive => (@nil positive, @nil unit) in
  let operand := fun (_ : positive) (_ : option positive) =>
    (@None (memory_version positive positive), @nil unit) in
  let before := fun (_ : positive) (_ : nat) =>
    (Some (@MemoryLive positive positive), [tt]) in
  let events := snd (audit_memory_raw_next edge_enc site_enc Map.empty incoming operand before
    MemoryAll (MemoryDef 1%positive 0)) in
  length events = 2 /\
  (forall e i result body, ~ In (AuditRawBefore e i result body) events).
Proof.
  vm_compute.
  split.
  - reflexivity.
  - intros e i result body [Hbranch | [Heffect | Hempty]].
    + discriminate Hbranch.
    + discriminate Heffect.
    + exact Hempty.
Qed.
```

## AnalysesAuditMemorySearch

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemorySearch.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemorySearch`.

```rocq
(** * Counted memory search

    This mirror follows each binary-fuel search step and preserves its actual primitive calls.
    For example, a previously seen version records a cut and never invokes its successor callback.
    Builds on: AnalysesMemoryWalk and the audit map and finite-set models. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryWalk.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditMap.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditFinSet.
Import List.ListNotations.

(** * Source-shaped search trace *)

Inductive audit_memory_search_event (V E NE : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditSearchFuel (fuel : positive) (state : memory_search_state V)
  | AuditSearchStep (state : memory_search_state V)
  | AuditSearchRead (events : list (audit_map_event V nat E))
  | AuditSearchWrite (events : list (audit_map_event V nat E))
  | AuditSearchRoot (events : list (audit_set_event V E))
  | AuditSearchNext (version : V) (result : list V) (events : list NE).

Arguments AuditSearchFuel {V E NE} _ _.
Arguments AuditSearchStep {V E NE} _.
Arguments AuditSearchRead {V E NE} _.
Arguments AuditSearchWrite {V E NE} _.
Arguments AuditSearchRoot {V E NE} _.
Arguments AuditSearchNext {V E NE} _ _ _.

(** All primitive events contain the exact pre-state, encoded operand and returned value. *)
Definition audit_memory_search_step {V E NE}
    (enc : V -> positive * list E) (next : V -> list V * list NE) (st : memory_search_state V)
    : memory_search_state V * list (audit_memory_search_event V E NE) :=
  match memory_search_todo st with
  | [] => (st, [AuditSearchStep st])
  | v :: rest =>
      let '(seen, reads) := audit_map_get enc v (memory_search_seen st) in
      match seen with
      | Some _ =>
          let '(roots, root_events) := audit_finset_add enc v (memory_search_roots st) in
          (MemorySearchState rest (memory_search_seen st) (memory_search_clock st) roots false,
            [AuditSearchStep st; AuditSearchRead reads; AuditSearchRoot root_events])
      | None =>
          let '(updated, writes) := audit_map_set enc v (memory_search_clock st)
            (memory_search_seen st) in
          let '(successors, successor_events) := next v in
          match successors with
          | [] =>
              let '(roots, root_events) := audit_finset_add enc v (memory_search_roots st) in
              (MemorySearchState rest updated (S (memory_search_clock st)) roots
                (memory_search_complete st),
                [AuditSearchStep st; AuditSearchRead reads; AuditSearchWrite writes;
                 AuditSearchNext v successors successor_events; AuditSearchRoot root_events])
          | w :: ws =>
              (MemorySearchState ((w :: ws) ++ rest) updated (S (memory_search_clock st))
                (memory_search_roots st) (memory_search_complete st),
                [AuditSearchStep st; AuditSearchRead reads; AuditSearchWrite writes;
                 AuditSearchNext v successors successor_events])
          end
      end
  end.

(** Binary recursion records early empty states and the exact intermediate state of both halves. *)
Fixpoint audit_memory_search_run {V E NE} (enc : V -> positive * list E)
    (next : V -> list V * list NE) (fuel : positive) (st : memory_search_state V)
    : memory_search_state V * list (audit_memory_search_event V E NE) :=
  match memory_search_todo st with
  | [] => (st, [AuditSearchFuel fuel st])
  | _ =>
      match fuel with
      | xH =>
          let '(out, events) := audit_memory_search_step enc next st in
          (out, AuditSearchFuel fuel st :: events)
      | xO half =>
          let '(middle, first) := audit_memory_search_run enc next half st in
          let '(out, second) := audit_memory_search_run enc next half middle in
          (out, AuditSearchFuel fuel st :: first ++ second)
      | xI half =>
          let '(middle, first) := audit_memory_search_run enc next half st in
          let '(after, second) := audit_memory_search_run enc next half middle in
          let '(out, final) := audit_memory_search_step enc next after in
          (out, AuditSearchFuel fuel st :: first ++ second ++ final)
      end
  end.

(** * Future correctness and input bounds *)

Fixpoint audit_memory_search_steps {V E NE}
    (events : list (audit_memory_search_event V E NE)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditSearchStep _ :: rest => S (audit_memory_search_steps rest)
  | _ :: rest => audit_memory_search_steps rest
  end.

Definition audit_memory_search_run_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall V E NE (original : encoding V) (enc : V -> positive * list E)
      (next : V -> list V * list NE) fuel st,
    (forall v, fst (enc v) = encode original v) ->
    fst (audit_memory_search_run enc next fuel st) =
      memory_search_run original (fun v => fst (next v)) fuel st.

Definition audit_memory_search_step_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall V E NE (enc : V -> positive * list E) (next : V -> list V * list NE) fuel st,
    audit_memory_search_steps (snd (audit_memory_search_run enc next fuel st)) <= Pos.to_nat fuel.

(** * Fixed search charges and nested actual primitive work *)

Fixpoint audit_memory_search_primitive_work {V E NE} (encoder_work : list E -> nat)
    (next_work : list NE -> nat) (events : list (audit_memory_search_event V E NE)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditSearchRead calls :: rest => audit_map_source_work encoder_work calls +
      audit_memory_search_primitive_work encoder_work next_work rest
  | AuditSearchWrite calls :: rest => audit_map_source_work encoder_work calls +
      audit_memory_search_primitive_work encoder_work next_work rest
  | AuditSearchRoot calls :: rest => audit_finset_source_work encoder_work calls +
      audit_memory_search_primitive_work encoder_work next_work rest
  | AuditSearchNext _ successors calls :: rest => length successors + next_work calls +
      audit_memory_search_primitive_work encoder_work next_work rest
  | _ :: rest => audit_memory_search_primitive_work encoder_work next_work rest
  end.

Fixpoint audit_memory_search_source_work {V E NE} (encoder_work : list E -> nat)
    (next_work : list NE -> nat) (events : list (audit_memory_search_event V E NE)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditSearchFuel _ _ :: rest => 2 + audit_memory_search_source_work encoder_work next_work rest
  | AuditSearchStep _ :: rest => 2 + audit_memory_search_source_work encoder_work next_work rest
  | AuditSearchRead calls :: rest => audit_map_source_work encoder_work calls +
      audit_memory_search_source_work encoder_work next_work rest
  | AuditSearchWrite calls :: rest => audit_map_source_work encoder_work calls +
      audit_memory_search_source_work encoder_work next_work rest
  | AuditSearchRoot calls :: rest => audit_finset_source_work encoder_work calls +
      audit_memory_search_source_work encoder_work next_work rest
  | AuditSearchNext _ successors calls :: rest => 2 + length successors + next_work calls +
      audit_memory_search_source_work encoder_work next_work rest
  end.

(** This bound separates actual nested calls and append lengths from binary-fuel control. *)
Definition audit_memory_search_source_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall V E NE (enc : V -> positive * list E) (next : V -> list V * list NE)
      encoder_work next_work fuel st,
    let events := snd (audit_memory_search_run enc next fuel st) in
    audit_memory_search_source_work encoder_work next_work events <=
      8 * Pos.to_nat fuel + audit_memory_search_primitive_work encoder_work next_work events.
```

```rocq
(** * Adapted family source bounds

    These obligations bind every genuine foreign callback to its actual input, result and body.
    For example, internally prepared predecessor lookups never receive a foreign source-price law.
    Builds on: the family's complete source model and the shared actual-call adapter. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith NArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare GraphAuditBase.
From Galois.Domains Require Import DomainsFootprint.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryGraph AnalysesMemoryWalk.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditCallback.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditMap.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditElements.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryEncoding.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryInputBudget.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryRawNext.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryWalkIndex.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryTable.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemorySharedBudget.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryClobbersSource.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemorySearch.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemorySearchInputBudget.
Import List.ListNotations.

(** Actual foreign source laws cover the same returned bodies charged by this fixed call. *)
Definition audit_memory_clobbers_whole_input_bound_adapted_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CN CE SE OE TE FE PE BE (EN : encoding N)
      (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
      (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE) (out : N -> list E * list OE)
      (target : E -> N * list TE) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE)
      (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list PE)
      (before : E -> nat -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE)
      node_work edge_work site_work out_work target_work effect_work operand_work before_work
      node_budget edge_budget site_budget out_budget target_budget effect_budget
      operand_budget before_budget (g : Graph.t N E) (mg : memory_graph N E) scope start fuel
        node_enc_source edge_enc_source site_enc_source out_source target_source effects_source
        operand_source before_source,
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall n, fst (out n) = Graph.out g n) ->
    (forall e, fst (target e) = Graph.target g e) ->
    audit_external_callback_adapter node_enc node_work node_enc_source node_budget ->
    audit_external_callback_adapter edge_enc edge_work edge_enc_source edge_budget ->
    audit_external_callback_adapter site_enc site_work site_enc_source site_budget ->
    audit_external_callback_adapter out out_work out_source out_budget ->
    audit_external_callback_adapter target target_work target_source target_budget ->
    audit_external_callback_adapter effects effect_work effects_source effect_budget ->
    audit_external_callback_adapter
      (fun args => operand (fst args) (snd args)) operand_work operand_source
      (fun args => operand_budget (fst args) (snd args)) ->
    audit_external_callback_adapter
      (fun args => before (fst args) (snd args)) before_work before_source

    audit_memory_clobbers_full_source_work node_work edge_work site_work out_work target_work
```

## AnalysesAuditMemorySearchInputBudget

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemorySearchInputBudget.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemorySearchInputBudget`.

```rocq
(** * Independent binary-search input recurrence

    These budgets follow binary fuel halves and their actual intermediate search states.
    For example, a seen version pays a root insertion and performs no successor callback.
    Builds on: the fixed memory search source model and concrete key input budgets. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryWalk.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditMap.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditFinSet.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemorySearch.
Import List.ListNotations.

Definition audit_search_read_input_budget {V CE} (enc : V -> positive * list CE)
    (budget : V -> nat) (v : V) : nat := 5 + budget v + 5 * Pos.size_nat (fst (enc v)).

Definition audit_search_write_input_budget {V CE} (enc : V -> positive * list CE)
    (budget : V -> nat) (v : V) : nat := 2 + budget v + 16 * Pos.size_nat (fst (enc v)).

Definition audit_search_step_input_budget {V CE NE} (enc : V -> positive * list CE)
    (next : V -> list V * list NE) (key_budget next_budget : V -> nat)
    (state : memory_search_state V) : nat :=
  match memory_search_todo state with
  | [] => 2
  | v :: _ =>
      2 + audit_search_read_input_budget enc key_budget v +
      match fst (audit_map_get enc v (memory_search_seen state)) with
      | Some _ => audit_search_write_input_budget enc key_budget v
      | None =>
          let successors := fst (next v) in
          audit_search_write_input_budget enc key_budget v + 2 + length successors + next_budget v +
          match successors with
          | [] => audit_search_write_input_budget enc key_budget v
          | _ :: _ => 0
          end
      end
  end.

Fixpoint audit_search_run_input_budget {V CE NE} (enc : V -> positive * list CE)
    (next : V -> list V * list NE) (key_budget next_budget : V -> nat)
    (fuel : positive) (state : memory_search_state V) : nat :=
  match memory_search_todo state with
  | [] => 2
  | _ :: _ =>
      match fuel with
      | xH => 2 + audit_search_step_input_budget enc next key_budget next_budget state
      | xO half =>
          let middle := fst (audit_memory_search_run enc next half state) in
          2 + audit_search_run_input_budget enc next key_budget next_budget half state +
            audit_search_run_input_budget enc next key_budget next_budget half middle
      | xI half =>
          let middle := fst (audit_memory_search_run enc next half state) in
          let after := fst (audit_memory_search_run enc next half middle) in
          2 + audit_search_run_input_budget enc next key_budget next_budget half state +
            audit_search_run_input_budget enc next key_budget next_budget half middle +
            audit_search_step_input_budget enc next key_budget next_budget after
      end
  end.

(** The whole search bound requires only each actual encoder and successor call's input budget. *)
Definition audit_search_whole_input_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall V CE NE (enc : V -> positive * list CE) (next : V -> list V * list NE)
      work next_work key_budget next_budget fuel state,
    (forall v, work (snd (enc v)) <= key_budget v) ->
    (forall v, next_work (snd (next v)) <= next_budget v) ->
    audit_memory_search_source_work work next_work (snd (audit_memory_search_run enc next fuel
      state)) <=
      audit_search_run_input_budget enc next key_budget next_budget fuel state.

Example audit_search_empty_input_budget :
  audit_search_run_input_budget (fun p : positive => (p, @nil unit))
    (fun _ => ([], @nil unit)) (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => 1) 8%positive
    (MemorySearchState [] CollectionsMap.Map.empty 0 CollectionsFinSet.FinSet.empty true) = 2.
Proof.
  reflexivity.
Qed.
```

## AnalysesAuditMemorySharedBudget

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemorySharedBudget.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemorySharedBudget`.

```rocq
(** * Whole budgets for shared memory preparation

    These recurrences use original nodes, outgoing occurrences and indexed effect operands.
    For example, a duplicate edge pays another probe but constructs its effect row only once.
    Builds on: memory edge, distinctness, effect-row and result-index bodies. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryDistinct.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryIndex.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryTable.
Import List.ListNotations.

Fixpoint audit_memory_edges_input_budget {N E OE} (out : N -> list E * list OE)
    (budget : N -> nat) (nodes : list N) : nat :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => 1
  | node :: rest => 2 + length (fst (out node)) + budget node +
      audit_memory_edges_input_budget out budget rest
  end.

Fixpoint audit_memory_distinct_input_budget {K CE} (enc : K -> positive * list CE)
    (budget : K -> nat) (keys : list K) : nat :=
  match keys with
  | [] => 1
  | key :: rest => 10 + 2 * budget key + 21 * Pos.size_nat (fst (enc key)) +
      audit_memory_distinct_input_budget enc budget rest
  end.

Fixpoint audit_memory_index_input_budget {K CE} (enc : K -> positive * list CE)
    (key_budget value_budget : K -> nat) (keys : list K) : nat :=
  match keys with
  | [] => 1
  | key :: rest => 3 + key_budget key + 16 * Pos.size_nat (fst (enc key)) + value_budget key +
      audit_memory_index_input_budget enc key_budget value_budget rest
  end.

Definition audit_memory_row_input_budget {E T FE}
    (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE) (budget : E -> nat) (edge : E) : nat :=
  2 + budget edge + audit_memory_effects_budget 0 (fst (effects edge)).

Definition audit_memory_table_input_budget {N E T CE OE FE}
    (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (out : N -> list E * list OE)
    (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE)
    (edge_budget : E -> nat) (out_budget : N -> nat) (effect_budget : E -> nat)
    (nodes : list N) : nat :=
  let edges := fst (audit_memory_edges out nodes) in
  let unique := fst (audit_memory_distinct edge_enc edges) in
  3 + audit_memory_edges_input_budget out out_budget nodes +
    audit_memory_distinct_input_budget edge_enc edge_budget edges +
    audit_memory_index_input_budget edge_enc edge_budget
      (audit_memory_row_input_budget effects effect_budget) unique.

(** The table bound has only genuine external encoder, outgoing and effects call premises. *)
Definition audit_memory_table_whole_input_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CE OE FE (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (out : N -> list E * list OE)
      (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE)
      edge_work out_work effect_work edge_budget out_budget effect_budget nodes,
    (forall e, edge_work (snd (edge_enc e)) <= edge_budget e) ->
    (forall n, out_work (snd (out n)) <= out_budget n) ->
    (forall e, effect_work (snd (effects e)) <= effect_budget e) ->
    audit_memory_table_work edge_work out_work effect_work
      (snd (audit_memory_effect_table edge_enc out effects nodes)) <=
      audit_memory_table_input_budget edge_enc out effects edge_budget out_budget effect_budget
        nodes.

Example audit_shared_duplicate_distinct_budget :
  audit_memory_distinct_input_budget (fun p : positive => (p, @nil unit))
    (fun _ => 1) [1%positive; 1%positive] = 67.
Proof.
  reflexivity.
Qed.
```

## AnalysesAuditMemorySnapshotPublic

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemorySnapshotPublic.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemorySnapshotPublic`.

```rocq
(** * Plain snapshot refresh and full saved-cache validity

    Public refresh stores complete snapshot values and executes no counted observer or ghost trace.
    For example, an epoch hit returns the exact old cache and a miss prepares the new snapshot.
    Builds on: saved snapshots, the plain memo query and full source refresh models. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryGraph AnalysesMemoryWalk.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryState.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryEncoding.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoSnapshot.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoSnapshotSource.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryMemoPublicSource.
Import List.ListNotations.

Definition audit_snapshot_refresh_compute {N E T Epoch} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (EEpoch : encoding Epoch) (old : audit_snapshot_memo_cache N E T Epoch EN)
    (current : memo_snapshot N E T Epoch) : audit_snapshot_memo_cache N E T Epoch EN :=
  if epoch_matches EEpoch (snapshot_epoch (audit_cache_snapshot old)) (snapshot_epoch current)
  then old
  else AuditSnapshotMemoCache current (prepare EN (snapshot_graph current))
    (memory_walk_effect_table EE (snapshot_graph current) (snapshot_effects current)) Map.empty.

Definition audit_snapshot_saved_state {N E T Epoch} (EN : encoding N)
    (cache : audit_snapshot_memo_cache N E T Epoch EN) :=
  let saved := audit_cache_snapshot cache in
  @MemoState N E T EN (snapshot_graph saved) (snapshot_effects saved) (snapshot_memory saved)
    (audit_cache_prepared cache) (audit_cache_effect_index cache) (audit_cache_entries cache).

(** Full validity includes every completed entry's roots, traces and exact terminal semantics. *)
Definition audit_snapshot_semantic_valid {N E T Epoch} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (ET : encoding T) (cache : audit_snapshot_memo_cache N E T Epoch EN) : Prop :=
  let saved := audit_cache_snapshot cache in
  memo_valid EN EE ET (snapshot_graph saved) (snapshot_effects saved) (snapshot_memory saved)
    (audit_snapshot_saved_state EN cache).

(** Complete source refresh erases exactly to the plain computational public refresh. *)
Definition audit_snapshot_refresh_plain_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T Epoch CE CN OE FE TE (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (EEpoch : encoding Epoch)
      (epoch_enc : Epoch -> positive * list CE) (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
      (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (out : N -> list E * list OE)
      (target : E -> N * list TE) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE) old current,
    (forall epoch, fst (epoch_enc epoch) = encode EEpoch epoch) ->
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall e, fst (edge_enc e) = encode EE e) ->
    (forall n, fst (out n) = Graph.out (snapshot_graph current) n) ->
    (forall e, fst (target e) = Graph.target (snapshot_graph current) e) ->
    (forall e, fst (effects e) = snapshot_effects current e) ->
    fst (audit_snapshot_refresh_source EN epoch_enc node_enc edge_enc out target effects old
      current) =
      audit_snapshot_refresh_compute EN EE EEpoch old current.

(** Refresh preserves full validity for its saved snapshot on both exact hit and rebuilt miss. *)
Definition audit_snapshot_refresh_semantic_valid_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T Epoch (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (ET : encoding T)
      (EEpoch : encoding Epoch) (old : audit_snapshot_memo_cache N E T Epoch EN) current,
    audit_snapshot_semantic_valid EN EE ET old ->
    audit_snapshot_semantic_valid EN EE ET
      (audit_snapshot_refresh_compute EN EE EEpoch old current).

(** Saved query execution preserves completed-entry semantics and both saved index values. *)
Definition audit_snapshot_query_semantic_valid_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T Epoch (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (ET : encoding T)
      (cache : audit_snapshot_memo_cache N E T Epoch EN) scope start fuel,
    let saved := audit_cache_snapshot cache in
    audit_snapshot_semantic_valid EN EE ET cache ->
    memory_graph_wf (snapshot_graph saved) (snapshot_effects saved) (snapshot_memory saved) ->
    memory_valid_version (snapshot_graph saved) (snapshot_effects saved) (snapshot_memory saved)
      start ->
    let next := snd (audit_snapshot_query EN EE ET cache scope start fuel) in
    audit_snapshot_semantic_valid EN EE ET next /\
    audit_cache_snapshot next = audit_cache_snapshot cache /\
    audit_cache_prepared next = audit_cache_prepared cache /\
    audit_cache_effect_index next = audit_cache_effect_index cache.

(** Coverage retains the exact saved graph, memory graph and same backward path witness. *)
Definition audit_snapshot_query_coverage_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T Epoch (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (ET : encoding T)
      (cache : audit_snapshot_memo_cache N E T Epoch EN) scope start fuel,
    let saved := audit_cache_snapshot cache in
    let graph := snapshot_graph saved in
    let effects := snapshot_effects saved in
    let memory := snapshot_memory saved in
    audit_snapshot_semantic_valid EN EE ET cache -> memory_graph_wf graph effects memory ->
    memory_valid_version graph effects memory start ->
    forall trace last, memory_walk_trace ET effects memory scope start trace ->
      memory_trace_last trace = Some last ->
      (memory_walk_terminal ET effects memory scope last \/ ~ NoDup trace) ->
      exists hit, In hit trace /\
        In hit (clobber_roots (fst (audit_snapshot_query EN EE ET cache scope start fuel))).

(** Completed results have exactly the saved graph's reachable terminal roots. *)
Definition audit_snapshot_query_complete_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T Epoch (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (ET : encoding T)
      (cache : audit_snapshot_memo_cache N E T Epoch EN) scope start fuel,
    let saved := audit_cache_snapshot cache in
    let graph := snapshot_graph saved in
    let effects := snapshot_effects saved in
    let memory := snapshot_memory saved in
    audit_snapshot_semantic_valid EN EE ET cache -> memory_graph_wf graph effects memory ->
    memory_valid_version graph effects memory start ->
    let result := fst (audit_snapshot_query EN EE ET cache scope start fuel) in
    clobber_complete result = true ->
    forall version, In version (clobber_roots result) <->
      memory_walk_terminal ET effects memory scope version /\
      exists trace, memory_walk_trace ET effects memory scope start trace /\
        memory_trace_last trace = Some version.

(** Epoch reuse is interpreted against current observations only under the stated snapshot
  domain law. *)
Definition audit_snapshot_query_current_coverage_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T Epoch (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (ET : encoding T)
      (EEpoch : encoding Epoch) (domain : memo_snapshot N E T Epoch -> Prop)
      (cache : audit_snapshot_memo_cache N E T Epoch EN) current scope start fuel,
    memo_epoch_laws domain -> domain (audit_cache_snapshot cache) -> domain current ->
    epoch_matches EEpoch (snapshot_epoch (audit_cache_snapshot cache)) (snapshot_epoch current)
      = true ->
    audit_snapshot_semantic_valid EN EE ET cache ->
    memory_graph_wf (snapshot_graph current) (snapshot_effects current) (snapshot_memory current) ->
    memory_valid_version (snapshot_graph current) (snapshot_effects current) (snapshot_memory
      current)
      start ->
    forall trace last,
      memory_walk_trace ET (snapshot_effects current) (snapshot_memory current) scope start trace ->
      memory_trace_last trace = Some last ->
      (memory_walk_terminal ET (snapshot_effects current) (snapshot_memory current) scope last \/
        ~ NoDup trace) ->
      exists hit, In hit trace /\
        In hit (clobber_roots (fst (audit_snapshot_query EN EE ET cache scope start fuel))).

(** Completed reused roots denote exactly the current snapshot's terminals under the same domain
  law. *)
Definition audit_snapshot_query_current_complete_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T Epoch (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (ET : encoding T)
      (EEpoch : encoding Epoch) (domain : memo_snapshot N E T Epoch -> Prop)
      (cache : audit_snapshot_memo_cache N E T Epoch EN) current scope start fuel,
    memo_epoch_laws domain -> domain (audit_cache_snapshot cache) -> domain current ->
    epoch_matches EEpoch (snapshot_epoch (audit_cache_snapshot cache)) (snapshot_epoch current)
      = true ->
    audit_snapshot_semantic_valid EN EE ET cache ->
    memory_graph_wf (snapshot_graph current) (snapshot_effects current) (snapshot_memory current) ->
    memory_valid_version (snapshot_graph current) (snapshot_effects current) (snapshot_memory
      current)
      start ->
    let result := fst (audit_snapshot_query EN EE ET cache scope start fuel) in
    clobber_complete result = true ->
    forall version, In version (clobber_roots result) <->
      memory_walk_terminal ET (snapshot_effects current) (snapshot_memory current) scope version /\
      exists trace,
        memory_walk_trace ET (snapshot_effects current) (snapshot_memory current) scope start
          trace /\
        memory_trace_last trace = Some version.
```

## AnalysesAuditMemoryState

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemoryState.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemoryState`.

```rocq
(** * G4 memory walk semantics

    This declaration-only pilot isolates G4 semantic contracts.
    For example, it keeps the historical observation in its original statement.
    Builds on: Galois.Analyses. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List Bool NArith PArith ZArith Permutation.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsTrie CollectionsMap
  CollectionsFinSet CollectionsDenseSet CollectionsUnionFind.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare GraphDfs GraphScc.
From Galois.Domains Require Import DomainsFootprint.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsSemantics ViewsGraph ViewsMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryBase AnalysesMemoryGraph AnalysesMemoryFlow
  AnalysesMemoryWalk AnalysesMemoryLegacy AnalysesMemoryFrontier AnalysesMemorySealed.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryEncoding.
Import List.ListNotations.



(** Declarations from the MemoProbe candidate. *)

Definition scope_code_injective_statement : Prop := forall T (ET : encoding T) a b,
  scope_code ET a = scope_code ET b -> a = b.

Inductive memo_entry (N E : Type) : Type :=
  | MemoBusy
  | MemoDone (roots : list (memory_version N E)).

Arguments MemoBusy {N E}.
Arguments MemoDone {N E}.

Record memo_state {N E T} (EN : encoding N) (g : Graph.t N E)
    (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E) : Type := MemoState {
  memo_adjacency : prepared EN g;
  memo_effect_index : Map.t E (Map.t nat (memory_effect T));
  memo_entries : Map.t (positive * memory_version N E) (memo_entry N E)
}.


Definition memo_valid {N E T} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (ET : encoding T)
    (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E)
    (s : memo_state EN g effects mg) : Prop :=
  @memo_adjacency N E T EN g effects mg s = prepare EN g /\
  @memo_effect_index N E T EN g effects mg s = memory_walk_effect_table EE g effects /\
  Map.wf (memo_key EN EE) (@memo_entries N E T EN g effects mg s) /\
  (forall k, Map.get (memo_key EN EE) k (@memo_entries N E T EN g effects mg s) <> Some MemoBusy) /\
  forall q start roots,
    Map.get (memo_key EN EE) (scope_code ET q, start) (@memo_entries N E T EN g effects mg s) =
      Some (MemoDone roots) ->
    NoDup roots /\ memory_valid_version g effects mg start /\
    (forall trace, memory_walk_trace ET effects mg q start trace -> NoDup trace) /\
    forall v, In v roots <-> memory_walk_terminal ET effects mg q v /\
      exists trace, memory_walk_trace ET effects mg q start trace /\ memory_trace_last trace =
        Some v.

Definition memo_initial {N E T} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E) :
    memo_state EN g effects mg :=
  @MemoState N E T EN g effects mg (prepare EN g) (memory_walk_effect_table EE g effects) Map.empty.

Section Query.
  Variable query : forall {N E T} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (ET : encoding T)
    (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E),
    memo_state EN g effects mg -> memory_scope T -> memory_version N E -> positive ->
    memory_clobber_result N E * memo_state EN g effects mg.

  Definition memo_initial_statement : Prop := forall N E T (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (ET : encoding T) (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) mg,
    memo_valid EN EE ET g effects mg (memo_initial EN EE g effects mg).

  Definition memo_preserved_statement : Prop := forall N E T (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (ET : encoding T) (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) mg s q start fuel,
    memo_valid EN EE ET g effects mg s ->
    memory_graph_wf g effects mg -> memory_valid_version g effects mg start ->
    memo_valid EN EE ET g effects mg (snd (query EN EE ET g effects mg s q start fuel)).

  Definition memo_coverage_statement : Prop := forall N E T (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (ET : encoding T) (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) mg s q start fuel,
    memo_valid EN EE ET g effects mg s -> memory_graph_wf g effects mg ->
    memory_valid_version g effects mg start ->
    forall trace last, memory_walk_trace ET effects mg q start trace ->
      memory_trace_last trace = Some last ->
      (memory_walk_terminal ET effects mg q last \/ ~ NoDup trace) ->
      exists hit, In hit trace /\
        In hit (clobber_roots (fst (query EN EE ET g effects mg s q start fuel))).

  Definition memo_complete_statement : Prop := forall N E T (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (ET : encoding T) (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) mg s q start fuel,
    memo_valid EN EE ET g effects mg s -> memory_graph_wf g effects mg ->
    memory_valid_version g effects mg start ->
    clobber_complete (fst (query EN EE ET g effects mg s q start fuel)) = true ->
    forall v, In v (clobber_roots (fst (query EN EE ET g effects mg s q start fuel))) <->
      memory_walk_terminal ET effects mg q v /\
      exists trace, memory_walk_trace ET effects mg q start trace /\ memory_trace_last trace =
        Some v.

  Definition memo_execution_statement : Prop := forall N E T (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (ET : encoding T) (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) mg s q fuel,
    memo_valid EN EE ET g effects mg s -> memory_graph_wf g effects mg ->
    forall root es e i a, In root (Graph.entries g) -> path g root es (Graph.source g e) ->
      memory_occurrence g effects e i a -> exists input origin trace hit,
      memory_provenance g effects mg root es (Graph.source g e)
        (memory_in mg (Graph.source g e)) (memory_last_path effects es) /\
      memory_occurrence_history g effects mg es e i input origin /\
      memory_walk_trace ET effects mg q input trace /\
      memory_trace_last trace = Some
        (memory_last_clobbers ET q e 0 (firstn i (effects e))
          (memory_path_last_clobber ET q effects es)) /\
      In hit trace /\ In hit (clobber_roots (fst (query EN EE ET g effects mg s q input fuel))).

  Definition memo_hit_statement : Prop := forall N E T (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (ET : encoding T) (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) mg s q start
    fuel roots,
    memo_valid EN EE ET g effects mg s ->
    Map.get (memo_key EN EE) (scope_code ET q, start) (@memo_entries N E T EN g effects mg s) =
      Some (MemoDone roots) ->
    query EN EE ET g effects mg s q start fuel = (MemoryClobberResult roots true, s).

  Definition memo_store_complete_statement : Prop :=
    forall N E T (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (ET : encoding T)
      (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) mg s q start fuel,
      memo_valid EN EE ET g effects mg s -> memory_graph_wf g effects mg ->
      memory_valid_version g effects mg start ->
      let '(result, next) := query EN EE ET g effects mg s q start fuel in
      clobber_complete result = true ->
      Map.get (memo_key EN EE) (scope_code ET q, start)
        (@memo_entries N E T EN g effects mg next) = Some (MemoDone (clobber_roots result)).

  Definition memo_second_query_statement : Prop :=
    forall N E T (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (ET : encoding T)
      (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) mg s q start first_fuel second_fuel,
      memo_valid EN EE ET g effects mg s -> memory_graph_wf g effects mg ->
      memory_valid_version g effects mg start ->
      let '(first, next) := query EN EE ET g effects mg s q start first_fuel in
      clobber_complete first = true ->
      query EN EE ET g effects mg next q start second_fuel = (first, next).
End Query.

Definition busy_cut {N E} (v : memory_version N E) : memory_clobber_result N E :=
  MemoryClobberResult [v] false.

Definition busy_cut_coverage_statement : Prop := forall N E (v : memory_version N E) trace,
  In v trace -> clobber_complete (busy_cut v) = false /\
  exists hit, In hit trace /\ In hit (clobber_roots (busy_cut v)).

Definition busy_cut_trace_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T (ET : encoding T) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T))
    (mg : memory_graph N E) q v trace,
    memory_walk_trace ET effects mg q v trace ->
    clobber_complete (busy_cut v) = false /\
    exists hit, In hit trace /\ In hit (clobber_roots (busy_cut v)).

Definition graph_observations_equal {N E} (g h : Graph.t N E) : Prop :=
  Graph.entries g = Graph.entries h /\ Graph.nodes g = Graph.nodes h /\
  (forall n, Graph.out g n = Graph.out h n) /\
  (forall e, Graph.source g e = Graph.source h e /\ Graph.target g e = Graph.target h e).

Definition memory_observations_equal {N E} (a b : memory_graph N E) : Prop :=
  memory_phis a = memory_phis b /\ memory_versions a = memory_versions b /\
  (forall n, memory_in a n = memory_in b n) /\
  (forall e i, memory_before a e i = memory_before b e i) /\
  (forall e, memory_out a e = memory_out b e) /\
  (forall n key, memory_operand a n key = memory_operand b n key).

Record memo_snapshot (N E T Epoch : Type) : Type := MemoSnapshot {
  snapshot_epoch : Epoch;
  snapshot_graph : Graph.t N E;
  snapshot_effects : E -> list (memory_effect T);
  snapshot_memory : memory_graph N E
}.

Arguments snapshot_epoch {N E T Epoch}.
Arguments snapshot_graph {N E T Epoch}.
Arguments snapshot_effects {N E T Epoch}.
Arguments snapshot_memory {N E T Epoch}.

Record memo_epoch_laws {N E T Epoch} (domain : memo_snapshot N E T Epoch -> Prop) : Prop := {
  epoch_equal_observations : forall old current,
    domain old -> domain current -> snapshot_epoch old = snapshot_epoch current ->
    graph_observations_equal (snapshot_graph old) (snapshot_graph current) /\
    (forall e, snapshot_effects old e = snapshot_effects current e) /\
    memory_observations_equal (snapshot_memory old) (snapshot_memory current)
}.

Definition epoch_matches {Epoch} (E : encoding Epoch) (old current : Epoch) : bool :=
  Pos.eqb (encode E old) (encode E current).

Section Refresh.
  Variable refresh : forall {N E T Epoch} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (EEpoch : encoding Epoch) (old current : memo_snapshot N E T Epoch),
    memo_state EN (snapshot_graph old) (snapshot_effects old) (snapshot_memory old) ->
    memo_state EN (snapshot_graph current) (snapshot_effects current) (snapshot_memory current).

  Definition refresh_valid_statement : Prop :=
    forall N E T Epoch (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (ET : encoding T)
      (EEpoch : encoding Epoch) (domain : memo_snapshot N E T Epoch -> Prop),
      memo_epoch_laws domain -> forall old current,
      domain old -> domain current -> forall s,
      memo_valid EN EE ET (snapshot_graph old) (snapshot_effects old) (snapshot_memory old) s ->
      memo_valid EN EE ET (snapshot_graph current) (snapshot_effects current)
        (snapshot_memory current) (refresh EN EE EEpoch old current s).

  Definition refresh_mismatch_statement : Prop :=
    forall N E T Epoch (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (EEpoch : encoding Epoch)
      (old current : memo_snapshot N E T Epoch) s,
      epoch_matches EEpoch (snapshot_epoch old) (snapshot_epoch current) = false ->
      @memo_entries N E T EN (snapshot_graph current) (snapshot_effects current)
        (snapshot_memory current) (refresh EN EE EEpoch old current s) = Map.empty.

  Definition refresh_match_statement : Prop :=
    forall N E T Epoch (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (EEpoch : encoding Epoch)
      (old current : memo_snapshot N E T Epoch) s,
      epoch_matches EEpoch (snapshot_epoch old) (snapshot_epoch current) = true ->
      @memo_entries N E T EN (snapshot_graph current) (snapshot_effects current)
        (snapshot_memory current) (refresh EN EE EEpoch old current s) =
      @memo_entries N E T EN (snapshot_graph old) (snapshot_effects old) (snapshot_memory old) s.
End Refresh.

Section LegacyConsumer.
  Variable project : forall {F N E T} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (EF : encoding F)
    (ET : encoding T) (f : F) (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T))
    (writes reads : N -> list (footprint T)) (mg : memory_graph N E),
    memo_state EN g effects mg -> (N -> option (E * nat)) -> positive ->
    memory_ssa F N * memo_state EN g effects mg.

  Definition memo_legacy_checked_statement : Prop :=
    forall F N E T (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (EF : encoding F) (ET : encoding T)
      (f : F) (g : Graph.t N E) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T))
      (writes reads : N -> list (footprint T)) mg s loads fuel,
      memo_valid EN EE ET g effects mg s -> memory_graph_wf g effects mg ->
      let '(ms, next) := project EN EE EF ET f g effects writes reads mg s loads fuel in
      no_clobber_check EN EF ET f g writes reads ms = true /\
      memo_valid EN EE ET g effects mg next.

  Definition memo_legacy_bytes_statement : Prop :=
    forall S O N E T F L (m : semantics S O) (bv : bytes_view S O N E T L)
      (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (EF : encoding F) (ET : encoding T) (f : F)
      (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (reads : N -> list (footprint T)) mg s loads fuel,
      bytes_laws m bv ->
      memo_valid EN EE ET (cfg (bgv bv)) effects mg s ->
      memory_graph_wf (cfg (bgv bv)) effects mg ->
      let ms := fst (project EN EE EF ET f (cfg (bgv bv)) effects (writes_at bv) reads
        mg s loads fuel) in
      (forall before after first e es n,
        reachable_state m before -> run_edges m (bgv bv) before [e] first ->
        run_edges m (bgv bv) first es after -> point (bgv bv) after = n ->
        def_of_load ms n = Some (MDef f (Graph.source (cfg (bgv bv)) e)) ->
        forall l site offset, covered (reads n) site offset 1 -> bsite bv first l = Some site ->
          byte bv after l offset = byte bv first l offset) /\
      (forall before es after n, reachable_state m before ->
        In (point (bgv bv) before) (Graph.entries (cfg (bgv bv))) ->
        run_edges m (bgv bv) before es after -> point (bgv bv) after = n ->
        def_of_load ms n = Some (MLive f) ->
        forall l site offset, covered (reads n) site offset 1 -> bsite bv before l = Some site ->
          byte bv after l offset = byte bv before l offset).
End LegacyConsumer.
```

## AnalysesAuditMemoryTable

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemoryTable.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemoryTable`.

```rocq
(** * Counted memory effect-table construction

    This mirror connects graph edge collection, stable deduplication and each indexed effect row.
    For example, a repeated edge is collected twice and its effect row is built once.
    Builds on: memory distinctness, effect rows and result-index observers. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsGraph ViewsMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryWalk.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryDistinct.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryIndex.
Import List.ListNotations.

Inductive audit_memory_edges_event (N E OE : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditMemoryEdgesCase (remaining : list N)
  | AuditMemoryEdgesOut (node : N) (edges : list E) (events : list OE).

Arguments AuditMemoryEdgesCase {N E OE} _.
Arguments AuditMemoryEdgesOut {N E OE} _ _ _.

(** Preserve each actual graph callback and the source [flat_map] concatenation order. *)
Fixpoint audit_memory_edges {N E OE} (out : N -> list E * list OE) (nodes : list N)
    : list E * list (audit_memory_edges_event N E OE) :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => ([], [AuditMemoryEdgesCase nodes])
  | n :: rest =>
      let '(edges, oe) := out n in
      let '(tail, te) := audit_memory_edges out rest in
      (edges ++ tail, [AuditMemoryEdgesCase nodes; AuditMemoryEdgesOut n edges oe] ++ te)
  end.

Inductive audit_memory_row_event (E T FE : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditMemoryEffectsCallback (edge : E) (effects : list (memory_effect T)) (events : list FE)
  | AuditMemoryRowBuild (events : list (audit_memory_effect_event T)).

Arguments AuditMemoryEffectsCallback {E T FE} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditMemoryRowBuild {E T FE} _.

(** The row callback composes the actual client effect list and tail-first numeric index builder. *)
Definition audit_memory_effect_row {E T FE} (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE)
    (edge : E) : Map.t nat (memory_effect T) * list (audit_memory_row_event E T FE) :=
  let '(items, fe) := effects edge in
  let '(row, re) := audit_memory_effects_from 0 items in
  (row, [AuditMemoryEffectsCallback edge items fe; AuditMemoryRowBuild re]).

Inductive audit_memory_table_event (N E T CE OE FE : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditMemoryTableEdges (events : list (audit_memory_edges_event N E OE))
  | AuditMemoryTableDistinct (events : list (audit_memory_distinct_event E CE))
  | AuditMemoryTableIndex
      (events : list (audit_memory_index_event E (Map.t nat (memory_effect T)) CE
        (audit_memory_row_event E T FE))).

Arguments AuditMemoryTableEdges {N E T CE OE FE} _.
Arguments AuditMemoryTableDistinct {N E T CE OE FE} _.
Arguments AuditMemoryTableIndex {N E T CE OE FE} _.

(** The same actual edge list and deduplicated output flow into the final tail-first index. *)
Definition audit_memory_effect_table {N E T CE OE FE}
    (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (out : N -> list E * list OE)
    (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE) (nodes : list N)
    : Map.t E (Map.t nat (memory_effect T)) * list (audit_memory_table_event N E T CE OE FE) :=
  let '(edges, oe) := audit_memory_edges out nodes in
  let '(unique, de) := audit_memory_distinct edge_enc edges in
  let '(table, ie) := audit_memory_result_index edge_enc (audit_memory_effect_row effects) unique in
  (table, [AuditMemoryTableEdges oe; AuditMemoryTableDistinct de; AuditMemoryTableIndex ie]).

(** Exact erasure includes the original graph callback, order and duplicate behavior. *)
Definition audit_memory_effect_table_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CE OE FE (EE : encoding E) (g : Graph.t N E)
      (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (out : N -> list E * list OE)
      (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE) (original : E -> list (memory_effect T)),
    (forall e, fst (edge_enc e) = encode EE e) ->
    (forall n, fst (out n) = Graph.out g n) ->
    (forall e, fst (effects e) = original e) ->
    fst (audit_memory_effect_table edge_enc out effects (Graph.nodes g)) =
      memory_walk_effect_table EE g original.

(** * Original-input phase budgets *)

Fixpoint audit_memory_edges_work {N E OE} (out_work : list OE -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_memory_edges_event N E OE)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditMemoryEdgesCase _ :: rest => 1 + audit_memory_edges_work out_work rest
  | AuditMemoryEdgesOut _ edges child :: rest =>
      1 + length edges + out_work child + audit_memory_edges_work out_work rest
  end.

Fixpoint audit_memory_edges_budget {N E OE} (out : N -> list E * list OE)
    (out_work : list OE -> nat) (nodes : list N) : nat :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => 1
  | node :: rest => 2 + length (fst (out node)) + out_work (snd (out node)) +
      audit_memory_edges_budget out out_work rest
  end.

Fixpoint audit_memory_row_work {E T FE} (effect_work : list FE -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_memory_row_event E T FE)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditMemoryEffectsCallback _ _ child :: rest => 1 + effect_work child +
      audit_memory_row_work effect_work rest
  | AuditMemoryRowBuild child :: rest => 1 + audit_memory_effect_events_work child +
      audit_memory_row_work effect_work rest
  end.

Fixpoint audit_memory_table_work {N E T CE OE FE} (edge_work : list CE -> nat)
    (out_work : list OE -> nat) (effect_work : list FE -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_memory_table_event N E T CE OE FE)) : nat :=
  match events with
  | [] => 0
  | AuditMemoryTableEdges child :: rest => 1 + audit_memory_edges_work out_work child +
      audit_memory_table_work edge_work out_work effect_work rest
  | AuditMemoryTableDistinct child :: rest => 1 + audit_memory_distinct_work edge_work child +
      audit_memory_table_work edge_work out_work effect_work rest
  | AuditMemoryTableIndex child :: rest =>
      1 + audit_memory_index_work edge_work (audit_memory_row_work effect_work) child +
      audit_memory_table_work edge_work out_work effect_work rest
  end.

Definition audit_memory_table_budget {N E T CE OE FE}
    (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (out : N -> list E * list OE)
    (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE) (nodes : list N)
    (edge_work : list CE -> nat) (out_work : list OE -> nat) (effect_work : list FE -> nat) : nat :=
  let edges := fst (audit_memory_edges out nodes) in
  let unique := fst (audit_memory_distinct edge_enc edges) in
  3 + audit_memory_edges_budget out out_work nodes + audit_memory_distinct_budget edge_enc
    edge_work edges +
    audit_memory_index_budget edge_enc (audit_memory_effect_row effects) edge_work
      (audit_memory_row_work effect_work) unique.

Definition audit_memory_effect_table_source_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CE OE FE (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (out : N -> list E * list OE)
      (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE) nodes edge_work out_work effect_work,
    audit_memory_table_work edge_work out_work effect_work
      (snd (audit_memory_effect_table edge_enc out effects nodes)) <=
    audit_memory_table_budget edge_enc out effects nodes edge_work out_work effect_work.
```

## AnalysesAuditMemoryWalkIndex

Card: AUD-MEM-MODELS

Source destination:
`theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditMemoryWalkIndex.v`.

Public module:
`Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditMemoryWalkIndex`.

```rocq
(** * Complete prepared clobber adjacency

    This model builds every version row before the binary search begins.
    For example, an unvisited phi still pays its complete operand materialization.
    Builds on: full graph preparation, concrete memory encoders and indexed search. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare GraphAuditBase.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsMemoryEffects.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesMemoryGraph AnalysesMemoryWalk.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditMap.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditElements.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryEncoding.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryInputBudget.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryRawNext.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryIndex.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryTable.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemorySharedBudget.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryGraphCallbacks.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemorySearch.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemorySearchInputBudget.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditMemoryDistinct.
Import List.ListNotations.

Definition audit_walk_predecessors {N E CN} (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (incoming : Map.t N (list E)) (node : N) :=
  let '(found, calls) := audit_map_get node_enc node incoming in
  (match found with Some edges => edges | None => [] end, calls).

Definition audit_walk_successors {N E CN CE}
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
    (index : Map.t (memory_version N E) (list (memory_version N E)))
    (version : memory_version N E) :=
  let '(found, calls) := audit_map_get (audit_memory_version_encode node_enc edge_enc)
    version index in
  (match found with Some versions => versions | None => [] end, calls).

Definition audit_walk_raw_event (N E T CN CE SE PE BE : Type) : Type :=
  audit_raw_next_event N E T CE SE (audit_map_event N (list E) CN) PE BE.

Definition audit_walk_index_event (N E T CN CE SE PE BE : Type) : Type :=
  audit_memory_index_event (memory_version N E) (list (memory_version N E))
    (audit_memory_version_event N E CN CE) (audit_walk_raw_event N E T CN CE SE PE BE).

Record audit_walk_index_run (N E T CN CE SE OE TE FE PE BE : Type) : Type :=
  AuditWalkIndexRun {
    audit_walk_index_value : Map.t (memory_version N E) (list (memory_version N E));
    audit_walk_index_table : list (audit_memory_table_event N E T CE OE FE);
    audit_walk_index_prepare :
      list (audit_prepare_source_event N E (audit_snapshot_graph_body CN OE TE));
    audit_walk_index_rows : list (audit_walk_index_event N E T CN CE SE PE BE)
  }.
Arguments AuditWalkIndexRun {N E T CN CE SE OE TE FE PE BE} _ _ _ _.
Arguments audit_walk_index_value {N E T CN CE SE OE TE FE PE BE} _.
Arguments audit_walk_index_table {N E T CN CE SE OE TE FE PE BE} _.
Arguments audit_walk_index_prepare {N E T CN CE SE OE TE FE PE BE} _.
Arguments audit_walk_index_rows {N E T CN CE SE OE TE FE PE BE} _.

Definition audit_memory_walk_index_counted {N E T CN CE SE OE TE FE PE BE}
    (EN : encoding N) (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE)
    (out : N -> list E * list OE) (target : E -> N * list TE)
    (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE)
    (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list PE)
    (before : E -> nat -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE)
    (g : Graph.t N E) (mg : memory_graph N E) (scope : memory_scope T) :=
  let '(table, table_events) := audit_memory_effect_table edge_enc out effects (Graph.nodes g) in
  let '(base, prepare_events) := audit_prepare_source_counted EN g
    (audit_snapshot_graph_callbacks node_enc out target) in
  let '(index, index_events) := audit_memory_result_index
    (audit_memory_version_encode node_enc edge_enc)
    (audit_memory_raw_next edge_enc site_enc table
      (audit_walk_predecessors node_enc (in_index base)) operand before scope)
    (memory_versions mg) in
  AuditWalkIndexRun index table_events prepare_events index_events.

Definition audit_memory_walk_index_source_work {N E T CN CE SE OE TE FE PE BE}
    (node_work : list CN -> nat) (edge_work : list CE -> nat) (site_work : list SE -> nat)
    (out_work : list OE -> nat) (target_work : list TE -> nat) (effect_work : list FE -> nat)
    (operand_work : list PE -> nat) (before_work : list BE -> nat)
    (run : audit_walk_index_run N E T CN CE SE OE TE FE PE BE) : nat :=
  4 + audit_memory_table_work edge_work out_work effect_work (audit_walk_index_table run) +
  audit_prepare_source_work (audit_snapshot_graph_body_work node_work out_work target_work)
    (audit_walk_index_prepare run) +
  audit_memory_index_work (audit_memory_version_work node_work edge_work)
    (audit_raw_next_source_work edge_work site_work (audit_map_source_work node_work)
      operand_work before_work) (audit_walk_index_rows run).

Definition audit_walk_predecessor_input_budget {N CN}
    (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (node_budget : N -> nat) (node : N) : nat :=
  5 + node_budget node + 5 * Pos.size_nat (fst (node_enc node)).

Definition audit_memory_walk_index_input_budget {N E T CN CE SE OE TE FE PE BE}
    (EN : encoding N) (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN)
    (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE) (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE)
    (out : N -> list E * list OE) (target : E -> N * list TE)
    (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE)
    (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list PE)
    (before : E -> nat -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE)
    (node_budget out_budget : N -> nat) (edge_budget effect_budget target_budget : E -> nat)
    (site_budget : T -> nat) (operand_budget : N -> option E -> nat)
    (before_budget : E -> nat -> nat) (g : Graph.t N E) (mg : memory_graph N E) scope : nat :=
  let table := fst (audit_memory_effect_table edge_enc out effects (Graph.nodes g)) in
  let base := fst (audit_prepare_source_counted EN g
    (audit_snapshot_graph_callbacks node_enc out target)) in
  4 + audit_memory_table_input_budget edge_enc out effects edge_budget out_budget effect_budget
    (Graph.nodes g) + audit_prepare_source_budget EN g +
  audit_graph_prepare_full_event_bound g *
    audit_snapshot_graph_input_budget out target node_budget out_budget target_budget
      (Graph.nodes g) +
  audit_memory_index_input_budget (audit_memory_version_encode node_enc edge_enc)
    (audit_memory_version_input_budget node_enc edge_enc node_budget edge_budget)
    (@audit_raw_next_input_budget N E T CE SE (audit_map_event N (list E) CN) PE BE
      edge_enc site_enc table
      (audit_walk_predecessors node_enc (in_index base)) before edge_budget site_budget
      (audit_walk_predecessor_input_budget node_enc node_budget) operand_budget before_budget scope)
    (memory_versions mg).

(** Full adjacency erasure includes original graph setup and every listed memory version. *)
Definition audit_memory_walk_index_erases_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CN CE SE OE TE FE PE BE (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (ET : encoding T)
      (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
      (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE) (out : N -> list E * list OE)
      (target : E -> N * list TE) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE)
      (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list PE)
      (before : E -> nat -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE)
      (g : Graph.t N E) (original : E -> list (memory_effect T)) (mg : memory_graph N E) scope,
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall e, fst (edge_enc e) = encode EE e) ->
    (forall t, fst (site_enc t) = encode ET t) ->
    (forall n, fst (out n) = Graph.out g n) ->
    (forall e, fst (target e) = Graph.target g e) ->
    (forall e, fst (effects e) = original e) ->
    (forall n key, fst (operand n key) = memory_operand mg n key) ->
    (forall e i, fst (before e i) = memory_before mg e i) ->
    audit_walk_index_value (audit_memory_walk_index_counted EN node_enc edge_enc site_enc out
      target effects operand before g mg scope) = memory_walk_index EN EE ET g original mg scope.

(** The whole adjacency bound has premises only for genuine external callback bodies. *)
Definition audit_memory_walk_index_whole_input_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E T CN CE SE OE TE FE PE BE (EN : encoding N)
      (node_enc : N -> positive * list CN) (edge_enc : E -> positive * list CE)
      (site_enc : T -> positive * list SE) (out : N -> list E * list OE)
      (target : E -> N * list TE) (effects : E -> list (memory_effect T) * list FE)
      (operand : N -> option E -> option (memory_version N E) * list PE)
      (before : E -> nat -> option (memory_version N E) * list BE)
      node_work edge_work site_work out_work target_work effect_work operand_work before_work
      node_budget edge_budget site_budget out_budget target_budget effect_budget
      operand_budget before_budget (g : Graph.t N E) (mg : memory_graph N E) scope,
    (forall n, fst (node_enc n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall n, fst (out n) = Graph.out g n) ->
    (forall e, fst (target e) = Graph.target g e) ->
    (forall n, node_work (snd (node_enc n)) <= node_budget n) ->
    (forall e, edge_work (snd (edge_enc e)) <= edge_budget e) ->
    (forall t, site_work (snd (site_enc t)) <= site_budget t) ->
    (forall n, out_work (snd (out n)) <= out_budget n) ->
    (forall e, target_work (snd (target e)) <= target_budget e) ->
    (forall e, effect_work (snd (effects e)) <= effect_budget e) ->
    (forall n key, operand_work (snd (operand n key)) <= operand_budget n key) ->
    (forall e i, before_work (snd (before e i)) <= before_budget e i) ->
    audit_memory_walk_index_source_work node_work edge_work site_work out_work target_work
      effect_work operand_work before_work (audit_memory_walk_index_counted EN node_enc edge_enc
        site_enc out target effects operand before g mg scope) <=
    audit_memory_walk_index_input_budget EN node_enc edge_enc site_enc out target effects operand
      before node_budget out_budget edge_budget effect_budget target_budget site_budget
      operand_budget before_budget g mg scope.
```
