## Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditSsaOneShot

Card: AUD-SQ-MODELS

Source destination: `theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditSsaOneShot.v`.

```rocq
(** * One-shot liveness source callbacks

    The surviving graph filters each outgoing edge using the original definition callback.
    For example, a defining edge is omitted while every definition occurrence is scanned.
    Builds on: graph source models and SSA one-shot liveness. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsFinSet CollectionsAuditCompare
  CollectionsAuditPrimitive.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare GraphDfs GraphAuditBase GraphAuditDfs.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsGraph ViewsSsaPoints.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesLiveness AnalysesAuditSsaQueryBase.
Import List.ListNotations.

(** Only supplied graph, point-use and encoding operations carry external bodies. *)
Record audit_live_one_callbacks (N E V B : Type) : Type := AuditLiveOneCallbacks {
  live_one_node_encode : N -> positive * list B;
  live_one_value_encode : V -> positive * list B;
  live_one_out : N -> list E * list B;
  live_one_target : E -> N * list B;
  live_one_def : E -> list V * list B;
  live_one_exit : N -> list V * list B;
  live_one_use : E -> list V * list B
}.
Arguments live_one_node_encode {N E V B} _ _.
Arguments live_one_value_encode {N E V B} _ _.
Arguments live_one_out {N E V B} _ _.
Arguments live_one_target {N E V B} _ _.
Arguments live_one_def {N E V B} _ _.
Arguments live_one_exit {N E V B} _ _.
Arguments live_one_use {N E V B} _ _.

(** Events retain exact original callback inputs, outputs and body receipts. *)
Inductive audit_live_one_event (N E V B : Type) : Type :=
  | LiveOneCase : nat -> audit_live_one_event N E V B
  | LiveOneNode : N -> positive -> list B -> audit_live_one_event N E V B
  | LiveOneValue : V -> positive -> list B -> audit_live_one_event N E V B
  | LiveOneOut : N -> list E -> list B -> audit_live_one_event N E V B
  | LiveOneTarget : E -> N -> list B -> audit_live_one_event N E V B
  | LiveOneDef : E -> list V -> list B -> audit_live_one_event N E V B
  | LiveOneExit : N -> list V -> list B -> audit_live_one_event N E V B
  | LiveOneUse : E -> list V -> list B -> audit_live_one_event N E V B
  | LiveOneEqual : list audit_positive_eqb_event -> audit_live_one_event N E V B.
Arguments LiveOneCase {N E V B} _.
Arguments LiveOneNode {N E V B} _ _ _.
Arguments LiveOneValue {N E V B} _ _ _.
Arguments LiveOneOut {N E V B} _ _ _.
Arguments LiveOneTarget {N E V B} _ _ _.
Arguments LiveOneDef {N E V B} _ _ _.
Arguments LiveOneExit {N E V B} _ _ _.
Arguments LiveOneUse {N E V B} _ _ _.
Arguments LiveOneEqual {N E V B} _.

(** Rocq's strict disjunction scans every occurrence even after a match. *)
Fixpoint audit_live_one_has {N E V B} (cb : audit_live_one_callbacks N E V B)
    (x : V) (xs : list V) : bool * list (audit_live_one_event N E V B) :=
  match xs with
  | [] => (false, [LiveOneCase 0])
  | y :: rest =>
    let '(a, ac) := live_one_value_encode cb x in
    let '(b, bc) := live_one_value_encode cb y in
    let '(same, equal) := audit_positive_eqb a b in
    let '(later, events) := audit_live_one_has cb x rest in
    (same || later, LiveOneValue x a ac :: LiveOneValue y b bc :: LiveOneEqual equal :: events)
  end.

(** Filtering evaluates every defining-edge predicate and preserves edge order. *)
Fixpoint audit_live_one_filter {N E V B} (cb : audit_live_one_callbacks N E V B)
    (x : V) (edges : list E) : list E * list (audit_live_one_event N E V B) :=
  match edges with
  | [] => ([], [LiveOneCase 1])
  | e :: rest =>
    let '(defs, body) := live_one_def cb e in
    let '(defined, calls) := audit_live_one_has cb x defs in
    let '(later, events) := audit_live_one_filter cb x rest in
    (if defined then later else e :: later, LiveOneDef e defs body :: calls ++ events)
  end.

Definition audit_live_one_surviving_out {N E V B} (cb : audit_live_one_callbacks N E V B)
    (x : V) (n : N) : list E * list (audit_live_one_event N E V B) :=
  let '(edges, body) := live_one_out cb n in
  let '(kept, calls) := audit_live_one_filter cb x edges in
  (kept, LiveOneOut n edges body :: calls).

Fixpoint audit_live_one_edge_uses {N E V B} (cb : audit_live_one_callbacks N E V B)
    (x : V) (edges : list E) : bool * list (audit_live_one_event N E V B) :=
  match edges with
  | [] => (false, [LiveOneCase 2])
  | e :: rest =>
    let '(uses, body) := live_one_use cb e in
    let '(here, calls) := audit_live_one_has cb x uses in
    let '(later, events) := audit_live_one_edge_uses cb x rest in
    (here || later, LiveOneUse e uses body :: calls ++ events)
  end.

Definition audit_live_one_use_at {N E V B} (cb : audit_live_one_callbacks N E V B)
    (x : V) (n : N) : bool * list (audit_live_one_event N E V B) :=
  let '(uses, body) := live_one_exit cb n in
  let '(here, calls) := audit_live_one_has cb x uses in
  let '(edges, out_body) := live_one_out cb n in
  let '(later, events) := audit_live_one_edge_uses cb x edges in
  (here || later, LiveOneExit n uses body :: calls ++ LiveOneOut n edges out_body :: events).

Fixpoint audit_live_one_search_uses {N E V B} (cb : audit_live_one_callbacks N E V B)
    (x : V) (nodes : list N) : bool * list (audit_live_one_event N E V B) :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => (false, [LiveOneCase 3])
  | n :: rest => let '(here, calls) := audit_live_one_use_at cb x n in
    let '(later, events) := audit_live_one_search_uses cb x rest in
    (here || later, calls ++ events)
  end.

(** Wrappers preserve the genuine node and edge callback bodies. *)
Definition audit_live_one_node {N E V B} (cb : audit_live_one_callbacks N E V B) (n : N)
    : positive * list (audit_live_one_event N E V B) :=
  let '(code, body) := live_one_node_encode cb n in (code, [LiveOneNode n code body]).
Definition audit_live_one_target {N E V B} (cb : audit_live_one_callbacks N E V B) (e : E)
    : N * list (audit_live_one_event N E V B) :=
  let '(n, body) := live_one_target cb e in (n, [LiveOneTarget e n body]).

(** The source model prepares and searches the same filtered graph once. *)
Definition audit_live_one_counted {N E V B} (EN : encoding N) (EV : encoding V)
    (p : point_uses N E V) (cb : audit_live_one_callbacks N E V B) (n : N) (x : V) :=
  let g := audit_live_surviving_graph EV p x in
  let prep_cb := AuditPrepareCallbackModel N E (audit_live_one_event N E V B)
    (audit_live_one_surviving_out cb x) (audit_live_one_target cb) (audit_live_one_node cb) in
  let dfs_cb := AuditDfsCallbackModel N E (audit_live_one_event N E V B)
    (audit_live_one_target cb) (audit_live_one_node cb) in
  let '(prepared, prep_events) := audit_prepare_source_counted EN g prep_cb in
  let '(search, dfs_events) := audit_dfs_source_counted prepared dfs_cb FinSet.empty [n] in
  let '(answer, use_events) := audit_live_one_search_uses cb x (preorder search) in
  (answer, (prep_events, dfs_events, use_events)).

(** Every internal equality frame and actual supplied body is charged. *)
Definition audit_live_one_event_work {N E V B} (weight : B -> nat)
    (event : audit_live_one_event N E V B) : nat :=
  let body := fun xs => fold_right (fun item total => weight item + total) 0 xs in
  64 + match event with
  | LiveOneNode _ _ xs | LiveOneValue _ _ xs | LiveOneOut _ _ xs | LiveOneTarget _ _ xs |
    LiveOneDef _ _ xs | LiveOneExit _ _ xs | LiveOneUse _ _ xs => body xs
  | LiveOneEqual calls => audit_positive_eqb_source_work calls
  | LiveOneCase _ => 0
  end.

(** Each external allowance refers to the input of the actual captured invocation. *)
Definition audit_live_one_event_budget {N E V B} (node_budget out_budget exit_budget : N -> nat)
    (value_budget : V -> nat) (target_budget def_budget use_budget : E -> nat)
    (event : audit_live_one_event N E V B) : nat :=
  match event with
  | LiveOneNode n _ _ => node_budget n
  | LiveOneValue v _ _ => value_budget v
  | LiveOneOut n _ _ => out_budget n
  | LiveOneTarget e _ _ => target_budget e
  | LiveOneDef e _ _ => def_budget e
  | LiveOneExit n _ _ => exit_budget n
  | LiveOneUse e _ _ => use_budget e
  | _ => 0
  end.

(** The input support includes listed vertices and the endpoints DFS may visit. *)
Definition audit_live_one_input_scale {N E V} (EN : encoding N) (EV : encoding V)
    (p : point_uses N E V) (n : N) (x : V) : nat :=
  let g := live_graph p in
  let edges := flat_map (Graph.out g) (Graph.nodes g) in
  let nodes := n :: Graph.nodes g ++ Graph.entries g ++ map (Graph.target g) edges in
  let use_edges := flat_map (Graph.out g) nodes in
  let values := x :: flat_map (exit_use p) nodes ++ flat_map (edge_def p) edges ++
    flat_map (edge_use p) use_edges in
  let nw := fold_right (fun node total => Pos.size_nat (encode EN node) + total) 0 nodes in
  let vw := fold_right (fun value total => Pos.size_nat (encode EV value) + total) 0 values in
  let filtered := audit_live_surviving_graph EV p x in
  S (length nodes + length edges + length use_edges + length values + nw + vw +
    audit_prepare_source_budget EN filtered +
    audit_dfs_source_budget EN filtered (prepare EN filtered) [n]).

(** The one-shot allowance is determined by the original point-use input. *)
Definition audit_live_one_input_budget {N E V} (EN : encoding N) (EV : encoding V)
    (p : point_uses N E V) (n : N) (x : V) : nat :=
  1048576 * Nat.pow (audit_live_one_input_scale EN EV p n x) 64.

(** Erasure fixes each callback to the matching point-use or graph operation. *)
Definition audit_live_one_callbacks_erase {N E V B} (EN : encoding N) (EV : encoding V)
    (p : point_uses N E V) (cb : audit_live_one_callbacks N E V B) : Prop :=
  (forall n, fst (live_one_node_encode cb n) = encode EN n) /\
  (forall v, fst (live_one_value_encode cb v) = encode EV v) /\
  (forall n, fst (live_one_out cb n) = Graph.out (live_graph p) n) /\
  (forall e, fst (live_one_target cb e) = Graph.target (live_graph p) e) /\
  (forall e, fst (live_one_def cb e) = edge_def p e) /\
  (forall n, fst (live_one_exit cb n) = exit_use p n) /\
  (forall e, fst (live_one_use cb e) = edge_use p e).

(** The source run bounds preparation, DFS and the complete strict use scan. *)
Definition audit_live_one_source_adapted_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E V B (EN : encoding N) (EV : encoding V) (p : point_uses N E V)
    (cb : audit_live_one_callbacks N E V B) n x (weight : B -> nat)
    node_source value_source out_source target_source def_source exit_source use_source
    node_budget value_budget out_budget target_budget def_budget exit_budget use_budget,
    audit_live_one_callbacks_erase EN EV p cb ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (live_one_node_encode cb) weight node_source node_budget
  ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (live_one_value_encode cb) weight value_source
  value_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (live_one_out cb) weight out_source out_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (live_one_target cb) weight target_source target_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (live_one_def cb) weight def_source def_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (live_one_exit cb) weight exit_source exit_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (live_one_use cb) weight use_source use_budget ->
    let '(answer, (prep_events, dfs_events, use_events)) := audit_live_one_counted EN EV p cb n x in
    let event_work := audit_live_one_event_work weight in
    let event_budget := audit_live_one_event_budget node_budget out_budget exit_budget value_budget
      target_budget def_budget use_budget in
    let work := audit_prepare_source_work event_work prep_events +
      audit_dfs_source_work event_work dfs_events + 256 * Nat.pow (S (length use_events)) 3 +
      fold_right (fun event total => event_work event + total) 0 use_events in
    let external := audit_prepare_source_body_work event_budget prep_events +
      audit_dfs_source_body_work event_budget dfs_events +
      fold_right (fun event total => event_budget event + total) 0 use_events in
    answer = audit_live_one_shot EN EV p n x /\ work <= audit_live_one_input_budget EN EV p n x +
  external.
```

```rocq
(** * Sparse liveness materialization source

    The source follows seed insertion and binary-fuel backward propagation.
    For example, an already present node/value pair is not scheduled again.
    Builds on: collection source models, graph preparation and point-use views. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool PArith NArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet
  CollectionsAuditMap CollectionsAuditFinSet CollectionsAuditEncoding CollectionsAuditNAdd.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare GraphAuditBase.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsGraph ViewsSsaPoints.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesLiveness AnalysesSsaLiveQuery AnalysesSsaLiveSets.
Import List.ListNotations.

Record audit_live_sparse_callbacks (N E V B : Type) : Type := AuditLiveSparseCallbacks {
  sl_node_encode : N -> positive * list B;
  sl_edge_encode : E -> positive * list B;
  sl_value_encode : V -> positive * list B;
  sl_out : N -> list E * list B;
  sl_target : E -> N * list B;
  sl_source : E -> N * list B;
  sl_def : E -> list V * list B;
  sl_exit : N -> list V * list B;
  sl_use : E -> list V * list B
}.
Arguments sl_node_encode {N E V B} _ _.
Arguments sl_edge_encode {N E V B} _ _.
Arguments sl_value_encode {N E V B} _ _.
Arguments sl_out {N E V B} _ _.
Arguments sl_target {N E V B} _ _.
Arguments sl_source {N E V B} _ _.
Arguments sl_def {N E V B} _ _.
Arguments sl_exit {N E V B} _ _.
Arguments sl_use {N E V B} _ _.

Inductive audit_live_sparse_event (N E V B : Type) : Type :=
  | SlCase : nat -> audit_live_sparse_event N E V B
  | SlList : nat -> audit_live_sparse_event N E V B
  | SlOut : N -> list E -> list B -> audit_live_sparse_event N E V B
  | SlSource : E -> N -> list B -> audit_live_sparse_event N E V B
  | SlDef : E -> list V -> list B -> audit_live_sparse_event N E V B
  | SlExit : N -> list V -> list B -> audit_live_sparse_event N E V B
  | SlUse : E -> list V -> list B -> audit_live_sparse_event N E V B
  | SlPred : audit_map_event N (list E) B -> audit_live_sparse_event N E V B
  | SlRows : audit_map_event N (FinSet.t V) B -> audit_live_sparse_event N E V B
  | SlDefs : audit_map_event E (FinSet.t V) B -> audit_live_sparse_event N E V B
  | SlSet : audit_set_event V B -> audit_live_sparse_event N E V B
  | SlEncodeNat : audit_nat_encoding_event -> audit_live_sparse_event N E V B
  | SlMultiply : positive -> positive -> audit_live_sparse_event N E V B
  | SlAdd : audit_idf_nadd_event -> audit_live_sparse_event N E V B.
Arguments SlCase {N E V B} _.
Arguments SlList {N E V B} _.
Arguments SlOut {N E V B} _ _ _.
Arguments SlSource {N E V B} _ _ _.
Arguments SlDef {N E V B} _ _ _.
Arguments SlExit {N E V B} _ _ _.
Arguments SlUse {N E V B} _ _ _.
Arguments SlPred {N E V B} _.
Arguments SlRows {N E V B} _.
Arguments SlDefs {N E V B} _.
Arguments SlSet {N E V B} _.
Arguments SlEncodeNat {N E V B} _.
Arguments SlMultiply {N E V B} _ _.
Arguments SlAdd {N E V B} _.

(** Binary multiplication records each recursive bit and the actual addition body. *)
Fixpoint audit_live_sparse_mul {N E V B} (a b : positive)
    : positive * list (audit_live_sparse_event N E V B) :=
  match a with
  | xH => (b, [SlMultiply a b])
  | xO rest => let '(result, calls) := audit_live_sparse_mul rest b in
    (xO result, SlMultiply a b :: calls)
  | xI rest => let '(result, calls) := audit_live_sparse_mul rest b in
    let '(sum, adds) := audit_idf_positive_add false b (xO result) in
    (sum, SlMultiply a b :: calls ++ map SlAdd adds)
  end.

(** The binary fuel product preserves its value and has an operand-width frame bound. *)
Definition audit_live_sparse_mul_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E V B a b,
    let '(result, events) := audit_live_sparse_mul (N := N) (E := E) (V := V) (B := B) a b in
    result = Pos.mul a b /\
    length events <= 16 * Nat.pow (S (Pos.size_nat a + Pos.size_nat b)) 3.

Fixpoint audit_live_sparse_edges {N E V B} (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E V B)
    (nodes : list N) : list E * list (audit_live_sparse_event N E V B) :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => ([], [SlCase 0])
  | n :: rest => let '(edges, body) := sl_out cb n in
    let '(later, calls) := audit_live_sparse_edges cb rest in
    (edges ++ later, SlOut n edges body :: calls ++ [SlList (length edges)])
  end.

Fixpoint audit_live_sparse_uses {N E V B} (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E V B)
    (edges : list E) : list V * list (audit_live_sparse_event N E V B) :=
  match edges with
  | [] => ([], [SlCase 1])
  | e :: rest => let '(values, body) := sl_use cb e in
    let '(later, calls) := audit_live_sparse_uses cb rest in
    (values ++ later, SlUse e values body :: calls ++ [SlList (length values)])
  end.

Fixpoint audit_live_sparse_seeds {N E V B} (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E V B)
    (nodes : list N) : list (N * V) * list (audit_live_sparse_event N E V B) :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => ([], [SlCase 2])
  | n :: rest =>
    let '(exit_values, exit_body) := sl_exit cb n in
    let '(edges, out_body) := sl_out cb n in
    let '(edge_values, use_calls) := audit_live_sparse_uses cb edges in
    let values := exit_values ++ edge_values in
    let '(later, calls) := audit_live_sparse_seeds cb rest in
    (map (fun v => (n, v)) values ++ later,
      SlExit n exit_values exit_body :: SlOut n edges out_body :: use_calls ++
      [SlList (length exit_values); SlList (length values)] ++ calls ++ [SlList (length values)])
  end.

Fixpoint audit_live_sparse_defs {N E V B} (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E V B)
    (edges : list E) : Map.t E (FinSet.t V) * list (audit_live_sparse_event N E V B) :=
  match edges with
  | [] => (Map.empty, [SlCase 3])
  | e :: rest => let '(later, calls) := audit_live_sparse_defs cb rest in
    let '(values, body) := sl_def cb e in
    let '(set, set_calls) := audit_finset_of_list (sl_value_encode cb) values in
    let '(result, writes) := audit_map_set (sl_edge_encode cb) e set later in
    (result, calls ++ SlDef e values body :: map SlSet set_calls ++ map SlDefs writes)
  end.

Definition audit_live_sparse_state N V := (Map.t N (FinSet.t V) * list (N * V))%type.

(** A miss repeats the source lookup before inserting and scheduling the pair. *)
Definition audit_live_sparse_add {N E V B} (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E V B)
    (state : audit_live_sparse_state N V) (q : N * V)
    : audit_live_sparse_state N V * list (audit_live_sparse_event N E V B) :=
  let '(n, x) := q in
  let '(found, reads) := audit_map_get (sl_node_encode cb) n (fst state) in
  let set := match found with Some s => s | None => FinSet.empty end in
  let '(present, tests) := audit_finset_mem (sl_value_encode cb) x set in
  if present then (state, map SlRows reads ++ map SlSet tests ++ [SlCase 4])
  else let '(found2, reads2) := audit_map_get (sl_node_encode cb) n (fst state) in
    let set2 := match found2 with Some s => s | None => FinSet.empty end in
    let '(updated, adds) := audit_finset_add (sl_value_encode cb) x set2 in
    let '(rows, writes) := audit_map_set (sl_node_encode cb) n updated (fst state) in
    ((rows, q :: snd state), map SlRows reads ++ map SlSet tests ++ map SlRows reads2 ++
      map SlSet adds ++ map SlRows writes).

Fixpoint audit_live_sparse_adds {N E V B} (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E V B)
    (qs : list (N * V)) (state : audit_live_sparse_state N V)
    : audit_live_sparse_state N V * list (audit_live_sparse_event N E V B) :=
  match qs with
  | [] => (state, [SlCase 5])
  | q :: rest => let '(next, here) := audit_live_sparse_add cb state q in
    let '(result, calls) := audit_live_sparse_adds cb rest next in (result, here ++ calls)
  end.

(** The filter tests every predecessor before the source-map phase starts. *)
Fixpoint audit_live_sparse_filter_edges {N E V B} (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E V B)
    (defs : Map.t E (FinSet.t V)) (x : V) (edges : list E)
    : list E * list (audit_live_sparse_event N E V B) :=
  match edges with
  | [] => ([], [SlCase 6])
  | e :: rest => let '(found, reads) := audit_map_get (sl_edge_encode cb) e defs in
    let set := match found with Some s => s | None => FinSet.empty end in
    let '(killed, tests) := audit_finset_mem (sl_value_encode cb) x set in
    let '(later, calls) := audit_live_sparse_filter_edges cb defs x rest in
    if killed then (later, map SlDefs reads ++ map SlSet tests ++ calls)
    else (e :: later, map SlDefs reads ++ map SlSet tests ++ calls)
  end.

(** The source-map phase visits the filtered edges in their original order. *)
Fixpoint audit_live_sparse_back_sources {N E V B} (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E V B)
    (x : V) (edges : list E) : list (N * V) * list (audit_live_sparse_event N E V B) :=
  match edges with
  | [] => ([], [SlCase 11])
  | e :: rest =>
    let '(src, body) := sl_source cb e in
    let '(later, calls) := audit_live_sparse_back_sources cb x rest in
    ((src, x) :: later, SlSource e src body :: calls)
  end.

Definition audit_live_sparse_step {N E V B} {EN : encoding N} {g : Graph.t N E}
    (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E V B) (p : prepared EN g) (defs : Map.t E (FinSet.t V))
    (state : audit_live_sparse_state N V) : audit_live_sparse_state N V * list
  (audit_live_sparse_event N E V B) :=
  match snd state with
  | [] => (state, [SlCase 7])
  | (n, x) :: rest =>
    let '(found, reads) := audit_map_get (sl_node_encode cb) n (in_index p) in
    let edges := match found with Some es => es | None => [] end in
    let '(kept, filter_calls) := audit_live_sparse_filter_edges cb defs x edges in
    let '(next, back_calls) := audit_live_sparse_back_sources cb x kept in
    let '(result, calls) := audit_live_sparse_adds cb next (fst state, rest) in
    (result, map SlPred reads ++ filter_calls ++ back_calls ++ calls)
  end.

Fixpoint audit_live_sparse_run {N E V B} {EN : encoding N} {g : Graph.t N E}
    (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E V B) (p : prepared EN g) (defs : Map.t E (FinSet.t V))
    (fuel : positive) (state : audit_live_sparse_state N V)
    : audit_live_sparse_state N V * list (audit_live_sparse_event N E V B) :=
  match snd state with
  | [] => (state, [SlCase 8])
  | _ :: _ => match fuel with
    | xH => audit_live_sparse_step cb p defs state
    | xO k => let '(middle, first) := audit_live_sparse_run cb p defs k state in
      let '(result, second) := audit_live_sparse_run cb p defs k middle in
      (result, SlCase 9 :: first ++ second)
    | xI k => let '(middle, first) := audit_live_sparse_run cb p defs k state in
      let '(before, second) := audit_live_sparse_run cb p defs k middle in
      let '(result, last) := audit_live_sparse_step cb p defs before in
      (result, SlCase 10 :: first ++ second ++ last)
    end
  end.

(** Materialization binds one preparation, two input traversals and one worklist run. *)
Definition audit_live_sparse_counted {N E V B} (EN : encoding N) (p : point_uses N E V)
    (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E V B) :=
  let g := live_graph p in
  let prep_cb := AuditPrepareCallbackModel N E B (sl_out cb) (sl_target cb) (sl_node_encode cb) in
  let '(prepared, prep_events) := audit_prepare_source_counted EN g prep_cb in
  let '(edges, edge_calls) := audit_live_sparse_edges cb (Graph.nodes g) in
  let '(defs, def_calls) := audit_live_sparse_defs cb edges in
  let '(seeds, seed_calls) := audit_live_sparse_seeds cb (Graph.nodes g) in
  let '(initial, initial_calls) := audit_live_sparse_adds cb seeds (Map.empty, []) in
  let '(a, ac) := audit_nat_encode (length (Graph.nodes g)) in
  let '(b, bc) := audit_nat_encode (length seeds) in
  let '(fuel, mul_calls) := audit_live_sparse_mul a b in
  let '(result, run_calls) := audit_live_sparse_run cb prepared defs fuel initial in
  (fst result, (prep_events, edge_calls ++ def_calls ++ seed_calls ++ initial_calls ++
    map SlEncodeNat ac ++ map SlEncodeNat bc ++ mul_calls ++ run_calls)).

(** Event work includes trie paths, arithmetic frames and actual callback bodies. *)
Definition audit_live_sparse_event_work {N E V B} (weight : B -> nat)
    (event : audit_live_sparse_event N E V B) : nat :=
  let body := fun xs => fold_right (fun item total => weight item + total) 0 xs in
  64 + match event with
  | SlOut _ _ xs | SlSource _ _ xs | SlDef _ _ xs | SlExit _ _ xs | SlUse _ _ xs => body xs
  | SlPred call => audit_map_source_work body [call]
  | SlRows call => audit_map_source_work body [call]
  | SlDefs call => audit_map_source_work body [call]
  | SlSet call => audit_finset_source_work body [call]
  | SlList length => length
  | _ => 0
  end.

Definition audit_live_sparse_work {N E V B} (weight : B -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_live_sparse_event N E V B)) : nat :=
  256 * Nat.pow (S (length events)) 3 +
  fold_right (fun event total => audit_live_sparse_event_work weight event + total) 0 events.

(** Actual operands select the corresponding supplied callback allowance. *)
Definition audit_live_sparse_event_budget {N E V B} (node_budget out_budget exit_budget : N -> nat)
    (edge_budget source_budget def_budget use_budget : E -> nat) (value_budget : V -> nat)
    (event : audit_live_sparse_event N E V B) : nat :=
  match event with
  | SlOut n _ _ => out_budget n
  | SlExit n _ _ => exit_budget n
  | SlSource e _ _ => source_budget e
  | SlDef e _ _ => def_budget e
  | SlUse e _ _ => use_budget e
  | SlPred (AuditMapGet n _ _ _ _ _) | SlPred (AuditMapSet n _ _ _ _ _ _) |
    SlPred (AuditMapRemove n _ _ _ _ _) | SlRows (AuditMapGet n _ _ _ _ _) |
    SlRows (AuditMapSet n _ _ _ _ _ _) | SlRows (AuditMapRemove n _ _ _ _ _) => node_budget n
  | SlDefs (AuditMapGet e _ _ _ _ _) | SlDefs (AuditMapSet e _ _ _ _ _ _) |
    SlDefs (AuditMapRemove e _ _ _ _ _) => edge_budget e
  | SlSet (AuditSetMem x _ _ _ _ _) | SlSet (AuditSetAdd x _ _ _ _ _) |
    SlSet (AuditSetRemove x _ _ _ _ _) => value_budget x
  | _ => 0
  end.

(** Original nodes, edge occurrences and values bound all reachable worklist operands. *)
Definition audit_live_sparse_input_scale {N E V} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (EV : encoding V) (p : point_uses N E V) : nat :=
  let g := live_graph p in
  let edges := edges_of g in
  let nodes := Graph.nodes g ++ Graph.entries g ++ map (Graph.source g) edges ++ map (Graph.target
  g) edges in
  let values := flat_map (exit_use p) (Graph.nodes g) ++ flat_map (edge_use p) edges ++
    flat_map (edge_def p) edges in
  let nw := fold_right (fun x total => Pos.size_nat (encode EN x) + total) 0 nodes in
  let ew := fold_right (fun x total => Pos.size_nat (encode EE x) + total) 0 edges in
  let vw := fold_right (fun x total => Pos.size_nat (encode EV x) + total) 0 values in
  S (length nodes + length edges + length values + nw + ew + vw + audit_prepare_source_budget EN g).

Definition audit_live_sparse_input_budget {N E V} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (EV : encoding V) (p : point_uses N E V) : nat :=
  1048576 * Nat.pow (audit_live_sparse_input_scale EN EE EV p) 64.

(** Every supplied callback erases to its actual graph or point-use operation. *)
Definition audit_live_sparse_callbacks_erase {N E V B} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (EV : encoding V) (p : point_uses N E V) (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E V B) : Prop :=
  (forall n, fst (sl_node_encode cb n) = encode EN n) /\
  (forall e, fst (sl_edge_encode cb e) = encode EE e) /\
  (forall x, fst (sl_value_encode cb x) = encode EV x) /\
  (forall n, fst (sl_out cb n) = Graph.out (live_graph p) n) /\
  (forall e, fst (sl_target cb e) = Graph.target (live_graph p) e) /\
  (forall e, fst (sl_source cb e) = Graph.source (live_graph p) e) /\
  (forall e, fst (sl_def cb e) = edge_def p e) /\
  (forall n, fst (sl_exit cb n) = exit_use p n) /\
  (forall e, fst (sl_use cb e) = edge_use p e).

(** Materialization binds the actual preparation and run to the original-input budget. *)
Definition audit_live_sparse_source_adapted_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E V B (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (EV : encoding V) (p : point_uses N E V)
    (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E V B) (weight : B -> nat)
    node_source edge_source value_source out_source target_source source_source def_source
  exit_source use_source
    node_budget edge_budget value_budget out_budget target_budget source_budget def_budget
  exit_budget use_budget,
    audit_live_sparse_callbacks_erase EN EE EV p cb ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (sl_node_encode cb) weight node_source node_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (sl_edge_encode cb) weight edge_source edge_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (sl_value_encode cb) weight value_source value_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (sl_out cb) weight out_source out_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (sl_target cb) weight target_source target_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (sl_source cb) weight source_source source_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (sl_def cb) weight def_source def_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (sl_exit cb) weight exit_source exit_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (sl_use cb) weight use_source use_budget ->
    let '(result, (prep_events, events)) := audit_live_sparse_counted EN p cb in
    let external := audit_prepare_source_body_work weight prep_events in
    let adapted := fold_right (fun event total => audit_live_sparse_event_budget node_budget
  out_budget
      exit_budget edge_budget source_budget def_budget use_budget value_budget event + total) 0
  events in
    result = sparse_live_materialize EN EE EV p /\
    audit_prepare_source_work weight prep_events + audit_live_sparse_work weight events <=
      audit_live_sparse_input_budget EN EE EV p + external + adapted /\
    audit_prepare_source_work weight prep_events + audit_live_sparse_work weight events <=
      audit_live_sparse_input_budget EN EE EV p +
      fold_right (fun event total => audit_prepare_source_event_budget node_budget out_budget
  target_budget event + total)
        0 prep_events + adapted.

(** An online lookup reads the actual materialized row and tests the requested value. *)
Definition audit_live_sparse_probe {N E V B} (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E V B)
    (rows : Map.t N (FinSet.t V)) (n : N) (x : V)
    : bool * list (audit_live_sparse_event N E V B) :=
  let '(found, reads) := audit_map_get (sl_node_encode cb) n rows in
  let set := match found with Some s => s | None => FinSet.empty end in
  let '(answer, tests) := audit_finset_mem (sl_value_encode cb) x set in
  (answer, map SlRows reads ++ map SlSet tests).

(** Lookup has an operand-width bound and retains both actual encoder calls. *)
Definition audit_live_sparse_probe_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E V B (EN : encoding N) (EV : encoding V) (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E V B)
    rows n x (weight : B -> nat) node_source value_source node_budget value_budget,
    (forall v, fst (sl_node_encode cb v) = encode EN v) ->
    (forall v, fst (sl_value_encode cb v) = encode EV v) ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (sl_node_encode cb) weight node_source node_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (sl_value_encode cb) weight value_source value_budget ->
    let '(answer, events) := audit_live_sparse_probe cb rows n x in
    answer = sparse_live_at EN EV rows n x /\
    audit_live_sparse_work weight events <=
      4096 * Nat.pow (S (Pos.size_nat (encode EN n) + Pos.size_nat (encode EV x))) 4 +
      fold_right (fun event total => audit_live_sparse_event_budget node_budget (fun _ => 0) (fun _
  => 0)
        (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) value_budget event + total) 0 events.
```

```rocq
(** * Liveness fact extraction source

    Fact extraction visits original graph occurrences and encodes every tuple argument.
    For example, repeated edge occurrences yield repeated use and successor facts.
    Builds on: liveness views and the sparse source callback dictionary. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphAuditBase.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsGraph.
From Galois.Rules Require Import RulesSyntax.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesLiveness AnalysesRules AnalysesAuditSsaSparse.
Import List.ListNotations.

Inductive audit_live_fact_event (N E V B : Type) : Type :=
  | LiveFactCase : nat -> audit_live_fact_event N E V B
  | LiveFactList : nat -> audit_live_fact_event N E V B
  | LiveFactOut : N -> list E -> list B -> audit_live_fact_event N E V B
  | LiveFactTarget : E -> N -> list B -> audit_live_fact_event N E V B
  | LiveFactUse : E -> list V -> list B -> audit_live_fact_event N E V B
  | LiveFactDef : E -> list V -> list B -> audit_live_fact_event N E V B
  | LiveFactExit : N -> list V -> list B -> audit_live_fact_event N E V B
  | LiveFactNode : N -> positive -> list B -> audit_live_fact_event N E V B
  | LiveFactEdge : E -> positive -> list B -> audit_live_fact_event N E V B
  | LiveFactValue : V -> positive -> list B -> audit_live_fact_event N E V B.
Arguments LiveFactCase {N E V B} _.
Arguments LiveFactList {N E V B} _.
Arguments LiveFactOut {N E V B} _ _ _.
Arguments LiveFactTarget {N E V B} _ _ _.
Arguments LiveFactUse {N E V B} _ _ _.
Arguments LiveFactDef {N E V B} _ _ _.
Arguments LiveFactExit {N E V B} _ _ _.
Arguments LiveFactNode {N E V B} _ _ _.
Arguments LiveFactEdge {N E V B} _ _ _.
Arguments LiveFactValue {N E V B} _ _ _.

Fixpoint audit_live_fact_edges {N E V B} (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E V B) (nodes : list N)
    : list E * list (audit_live_fact_event N E V B) :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => ([], [LiveFactCase 0])
  | n :: rest => let '(edges, body) := sl_out cb n in
    let '(later, events) := audit_live_fact_edges cb rest in
    (edges ++ later, LiveFactOut n edges body :: events ++ [LiveFactList (length edges)])
  end.

Fixpoint audit_live_fact_edge_values {N E V B} (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E V B)
    (tag : pred) (e : E) (values : list V)
    : list (ground_atom pred) * list (audit_live_fact_event N E V B) :=
  match values with
  | [] => ([], [LiveFactCase 1])
  | x :: rest =>
    let '(ec, eb) := sl_edge_encode cb e in let '(xc, xb) := sl_value_encode cb x in
    let '(later, events) := audit_live_fact_edge_values cb tag e rest in
    ((tag, [ec; xc]) :: later, LiveFactEdge e ec eb :: LiveFactValue x xc xb :: events)
  end.

Fixpoint audit_live_fact_rows {N E V B} (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E V B) (edges : list E)
    : list (ground_atom pred) * list (audit_live_fact_event N E V B) :=
  match edges with
  | [] => ([], [LiveFactCase 2])
  | e :: rest =>
    let '(uses, ub) := sl_use cb e in
    let '(use_rows, ue) := audit_live_fact_edge_values cb PUse e uses in
    let '(defs, db) := sl_def cb e in
    let '(def_rows, de) := audit_live_fact_edge_values cb PDef e defs in
    let '(later, events) := audit_live_fact_rows cb rest in
    (use_rows ++ def_rows ++ later, LiveFactUse e uses ub :: ue ++ LiveFactDef e defs db :: de ++
      [LiveFactList (length use_rows)] ++ events ++ [LiveFactList (length use_rows + length
  def_rows)])
  end.

Fixpoint audit_live_fact_succ_edges {N E V B} (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E V B)
    (n : N) (edges : list E) : list (ground_atom pred) * list (audit_live_fact_event N E V B) :=
  match edges with
  | [] => ([], [LiveFactCase 3])
  | e :: rest =>
    let '(target, tb) := sl_target cb e in
    let '(nc, nb) := sl_node_encode cb n in let '(ec, eb) := sl_edge_encode cb e in
    let '(tc, tcb) := sl_node_encode cb target in
    let '(later, events) := audit_live_fact_succ_edges cb n rest in
    ((PSucc, [nc; ec; tc]) :: later,
      LiveFactTarget e target tb :: LiveFactNode n nc nb :: LiveFactEdge e ec eb ::
      LiveFactNode target tc tcb :: events)
  end.

Fixpoint audit_live_fact_succ_nodes {N E V B} (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E V B) (nodes :
  list N)
    : list (ground_atom pred) * list (audit_live_fact_event N E V B) :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => ([], [LiveFactCase 4])
  | n :: rest => let '(edges, body) := sl_out cb n in
    let '(here, calls) := audit_live_fact_succ_edges cb n edges in
    let '(later, events) := audit_live_fact_succ_nodes cb rest in
    (here ++ later, LiveFactOut n edges body :: calls ++ events ++ [LiveFactList (length here)])
  end.

Fixpoint audit_live_fact_exit_values {N E V B} (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E V B)
    (n : N) (values : list V) : list (ground_atom pred) * list (audit_live_fact_event N E V B) :=
  match values with
  | [] => ([], [LiveFactCase 5])
  | x :: rest => let '(nc, nb) := sl_node_encode cb n in let '(xc, xb) := sl_value_encode cb x in
    let '(later, calls) := audit_live_fact_exit_values cb n rest in
    ((PExitUse, [nc; xc]) :: later, LiveFactNode n nc nb :: LiveFactValue x xc xb :: calls)
  end.

Fixpoint audit_live_fact_exit_nodes {N E V B} (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E V B) (nodes :
  list N)
    : list (ground_atom pred) * list (audit_live_fact_event N E V B) :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => ([], [LiveFactCase 6])
  | n :: rest => let '(values, body) := sl_exit cb n in
    let '(here, calls) := audit_live_fact_exit_values cb n values in
    let '(later, events) := audit_live_fact_exit_nodes cb rest in
    (here ++ later, LiveFactExit n values body :: calls ++ events ++ [LiveFactList (length here)])
  end.

Definition audit_live_facts_counted {N E V B} (g : Graph.t N E) (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N
  E V B)
    : list (ground_atom pred) * list (audit_live_fact_event N E V B) :=
  let '(edges, edge_events) := audit_live_fact_edges cb (Graph.nodes g) in
  let '(operands, operand_events) := audit_live_fact_rows cb edges in
  let '(successors, succ_events) := audit_live_fact_succ_nodes cb (Graph.nodes g) in
  let '(exits, exit_events) := audit_live_fact_exit_nodes cb (Graph.nodes g) in
  (operands ++ successors ++ exits, edge_events ++ operand_events ++ succ_events ++ exit_events ++
    [LiveFactList (length successors); LiveFactList (length operands)]).

(** Source work charges all tuple frames and actual supplied callback bodies. *)
Definition audit_live_fact_event_work {N E V B} (weight : B -> nat)
    (event : audit_live_fact_event N E V B) : nat :=
  let body := fun xs => fold_right (fun item total => weight item + total) 0 xs in
  64 + match event with
  | LiveFactOut _ _ xs | LiveFactTarget _ _ xs | LiveFactUse _ _ xs |
    LiveFactDef _ _ xs | LiveFactExit _ _ xs | LiveFactNode _ _ xs |
    LiveFactEdge _ _ xs | LiveFactValue _ _ xs => body xs
  | LiveFactList size => size
  | LiveFactCase _ => 0
  end.

Definition audit_live_facts_work {N E V B} (weight : B -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_live_fact_event N E V B)) : nat :=
  256 * Nat.pow (S (length events)) 3 +
  fold_right (fun event total => audit_live_fact_event_work weight event + total) 0 events.

(** Each captured input selects its supplied callback's allowance. *)
Definition audit_live_fact_event_budget {N E V B} (node_budget out_budget exit_budget : N -> nat)
    (edge_budget target_budget use_budget def_budget : E -> nat) (value_budget : V -> nat)
    (event : audit_live_fact_event N E V B) : nat :=
  match event with
  | LiveFactOut n _ _ => out_budget n
  | LiveFactExit n _ _ => exit_budget n
  | LiveFactTarget e _ _ => target_budget e
  | LiveFactUse e _ _ => use_budget e
  | LiveFactDef e _ _ => def_budget e
  | LiveFactNode n _ _ => node_budget n
  | LiveFactEdge e _ _ => edge_budget e
  | LiveFactValue x _ _ => value_budget x
  | _ => 0
  end.

(** Fact extraction agrees exactly and is bounded by original graph and occurrence inputs. *)
Definition audit_live_facts_adapted_statement : Prop :=
  forall S O N E V C B (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (EV : encoding V)
    (vv : var_view S O N E V C) (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E V B) (weight : B -> nat)
    node_source edge_source value_source out_source target_source use_source def_source exit_source
    node_budget edge_budget value_budget out_budget target_budget use_budget def_budget exit_budget,
    audit_live_sparse_callbacks_erase EN EE EV (var_point_uses vv) cb ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (sl_node_encode cb) weight node_source node_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (sl_edge_encode cb) weight edge_source edge_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (sl_value_encode cb) weight value_source value_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (sl_out cb) weight out_source out_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (sl_target cb) weight target_source target_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (sl_use cb) weight use_source use_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (sl_def cb) weight def_source def_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (sl_exit cb) weight exit_source exit_budget ->
    let '(facts, events) := audit_live_facts_counted (cfg (gview vv)) cb in
    facts = extract_live_facts EN EE EV vv /\
    audit_live_facts_work weight events <=
      65536 * Nat.pow (audit_live_sparse_input_scale EN EE EV (var_point_uses vv)) 16 +
      fold_right (fun event total => audit_live_fact_event_budget node_budget out_budget exit_budget
        edge_budget target_budget use_budget def_budget value_budget event + total) 0 events.
```

```rocq
(** * General liveness tabulation source

From Stdlib Require Import List Bool PArith.

From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphAuditBase.

Inductive audit_live_tab_event (N E V B : Type) : Type :=
  | LiveTabCase : nat -> audit_live_tab_event N E V B

  | LiveTabSparse : audit_live_sparse_event N E V B -> audit_live_tab_event N E V B

  | LiveTabElements : audit_set_elements_event V -> audit_live_tab_event N E V B
  | LiveTabRows : audit_map_event N (FinSet.t V) B -> audit_live_tab_event N E V B
  | LiveTabDb : audit_map_event pred (FinSet.t tuple) unit -> audit_live_tab_event N E V B
  | LiveTabTuple : audit_set_event tuple (audit_list_event positive (audit_basic_encoding_event
  positive)) ->
      audit_live_tab_event N E V B
  | LiveTabNode : N -> positive -> list B -> audit_live_tab_event N E V B
  | LiveTabValue : V -> positive -> list B -> audit_live_tab_event N E V B.

Arguments LiveTabList {N E V B} _.
Arguments LiveTabSparse {N E V B} _.
Arguments LiveTabSet {N E V B} _.
Arguments LiveTabElements {N E V B} _.
Arguments LiveTabRows {N E V B} _.
Arguments LiveTabDb {N E V B} _.
Arguments LiveTabTuple {N E V B} _.
Arguments LiveTabNode {N E V B} _ _ _.
Arguments LiveTabValue {N E V B} _ _ _.

Fixpoint audit_live_tab_edge_values {N E V B} (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E V B)
    (edges : list E) : list V * list (audit_live_tab_event N E V B) :=
  match edges with
  | [] => ([], [LiveTabCase 0])
  | e :: rest => let '(uses, ub) := sl_use cb e in let '(defs, db) := sl_def cb e in
    let '(later, events) := audit_live_tab_edge_values cb rest in
    (uses ++ defs ++ later,
      LiveTabSparse (SlUse e uses ub) :: LiveTabSparse (SlDef e defs db) ::
      LiveTabList (length uses) :: events ++ [LiveTabList (length uses + length defs)])
  end.

Fixpoint audit_live_tab_exits {N E V B} (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E V B)
    (nodes : list N) : list V * list (audit_live_tab_event N E V B) :=

  | [] => ([], [LiveTabCase 1])

    let '(later, events) := audit_live_tab_exits cb rest in

(** Universe enumeration is repeated where the source uses it twice. *)
Definition audit_live_tab_universe {N E V B} (g : Graph.t N E) (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E
  V B)

(** Database membership uses the actual tuple encoder, predicate lookup and set lookup. *)
Definition audit_live_tab_db_holds {N E V B} (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E V B)
    (db : database pred) (n : N) (x : V) : bool * list (audit_live_tab_event N E V B) :=

  tuple_calls).

Fixpoint audit_live_tab_filter_db {N E V B} (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E V B)

    let '(later, events) := audit_live_tab_filter_db cb db n rest in

Fixpoint audit_live_tab_filter_set {N E V B} (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E V B)

  match values with

    let '(later, events) := audit_live_tab_filter_set cb set rest in
    (if keep then x :: later else later, map LiveTabSet calls ++ events)

(** The clamp uses the first universe and the database filter uses the second. *)
Definition audit_live_tab_node {N E V B} (g : Graph.t N E) (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E V
  B)

  let '(universe, first) := audit_live_tab_universe g cb in
  let '(universe2, second) := audit_live_tab_universe g cb in
  let '(selected, selected_calls) := audit_live_tab_filter_db cb db n universe2 in
  let '(selected_set, set_calls) := audit_finset_of_list (sl_value_encode cb) selected in
  let '(clamped, clamp_calls) := audit_live_tab_filter_set cb selected_set universe in
  let '(result, result_calls) := audit_finset_of_list (sl_value_encode cb) clamped in

  LiveTabSet result_calls).

Fixpoint audit_live_tab_nodes {N E V B} (g : Graph.t N E) (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E V B)
    (db : database pred) (nodes : list N) : Map.t N (FinSet.t V) * list (audit_live_tab_event N E V
  B) :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => (Map.empty, [LiveTabCase 4])
  | n :: rest => let '(later, calls) := audit_live_tab_nodes g cb db rest in
    let '(set, node_calls) := audit_live_tab_node g cb db n in
    let '(result, writes) := audit_map_set (sl_node_encode cb) n set later in

  end.

Definition audit_live_tab_probe {N E V B} (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E V B)
    (rows : Map.t N (FinSet.t V)) (n : N) (x : V) : bool * list (audit_live_tab_event N E V B) :=
  let '(found, reads) := audit_map_get (sl_node_encode cb) n rows in
  let set := match found with Some s => s | None => FinSet.empty end in
  let '(answer, tests) := audit_finset_mem (sl_value_encode cb) x set in
  (answer, map LiveTabRows reads ++ map LiveTabSet tests).

(** Event work expands tuple encoding and collection operations at their actual operands. *)
Definition audit_live_tab_event_work {N E V B} (weight : B -> nat)
    (event : audit_live_tab_event N E V B) : nat :=
  let body := fun xs => fold_right (fun item total => weight item + total) 0 xs in

  | LiveTabTuple call => audit_finset_source_work (audit_list_events_work audit_basic_encoding_work)
  [call]
  | LiveTabNode _ _ xs | LiveTabValue _ _ xs => body xs
  end.

Definition audit_live_tab_work {N E V B} (weight : B -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_live_tab_event N E V B)) : nat :=
  256 * Nat.pow (S (length events)) 3 +
  fold_right (fun event total => audit_live_tab_event_work weight event + total) 0 events.

(** Callback allowances follow each original input retained in the same trace. *)
Definition audit_live_tab_event_budget {N E V B} (node_budget out_budget exit_budget : N -> nat)
    (edge_budget source_budget def_budget use_budget : E -> nat) (value_budget : V -> nat)
    (event : audit_live_tab_event N E V B) : nat :=
  match event with
  | LiveTabSparse call => audit_live_sparse_event_budget node_budget out_budget exit_budget
  edge_budget

  | LiveTabSet (AuditSetMem x _ _ _ _ _) | LiveTabSet (AuditSetAdd x _ _ _ _ _) |
    LiveTabSet (AuditSetRemove x _ _ _ _ _) => value_budget x
  | LiveTabRows (AuditMapGet n _ _ _ _ _) | LiveTabRows (AuditMapSet n _ _ _ _ _ _) |

  | LiveTabValue x _ _ => value_budget x
  | _ => 0
  end.

(** Database dimensions use the actual stored relation tries, not a returned-work total. *)
Definition audit_live_tab_input_scale {S O N E V C} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)

Definition audit_live_tab_adapted_statement : Prop :=
```

```rocq
(** * General liveness portfolio source

    The general fallback composes fact extraction, the actual naive rules run and tabulation.
    For example, a rejected rules program returns false without constructing answer rows.
    Builds on: liveness fact and tabulation sources and the naive rules materializer. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphAuditBase.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsGraph.
From Galois.Rules Require Import RulesSyntax RulesSolve RulesAuditMaterializeDeltaTotal
  RulesAuditMaterializeReceipts RulesAuditMaterializeNaiveDimensions
  RulesAuditMaterializeNaiveTotal.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesLiveness AnalysesRules AnalysesSsaLiveQuery
  AnalysesAuditSsaSparse AnalysesAuditSsaFacts AnalysesAuditSsaTabulate.
Import List.ListNotations.

(** Predicate encoding is the actual fixed liveness-program constructor match. *)
Definition audit_live_predicate_code (p : pred) : positive :=
  match p with
  | PUse => 1%positive | PDef => 2%positive | PSucc => 3%positive
  | PNec => 4%positive | PDep => 5%positive | PExitUse => 6%positive
  | PLive => 7%positive | PNeeded => 8%positive | PReaches => 9%positive
  end.

(** Predicate arity is the actual fixed liveness-program constructor match. *)
Definition audit_live_predicate_arity (p : pred) : nat :=
  match p with
  | PUse | PDef | PNec | PExitUse | PLive | PNeeded => 2
  | PSucc | PDep | PReaches => 3
  end.

(** Internal predicate calls retain their constructor and the executed match frame. *)
Definition audit_live_predicate_source : mat_predicate_callback_source liveness_program (bool *
  pred) :=
  @MatPredicateCallbackSource pred liveness_program (bool * pred)
    (fun p code body => code = audit_live_predicate_code p /\ body = [(false, p)])
    (fun p value body => value = audit_live_predicate_arity p /\ body = [(true, p)])
    (fun _ => 1).

(** Fixed predicate matches satisfy the materializer's source and constant-frame laws. *)
Definition audit_live_predicate_source_statement : Prop :=
  mat_predicate_callback_receipts_statement liveness_program (bool * pred)

  mat_predicate_callback_input_bounds_statement liveness_program (bool * pred)
  audit_live_predicate_source
    (fun _ => 2) (fun _ => 2).

    (vv : var_view S O N E V C) (cb : audit_live_sparse_callbacks N E V B)
    n x (weight : B -> nat)
    node_source edge_source value_source out_source target_source use_source def_source exit_source
    node_budget edge_budget value_budget out_budget target_budget use_budget def_budget exit_budget,
    audit_live_sparse_callbacks_erase EN EE EV (var_point_uses vv) cb ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (sl_node_encode cb) weight node_source node_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (sl_edge_encode cb) weight edge_source edge_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (sl_value_encode cb) weight value_source value_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (sl_out cb) weight out_source out_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (sl_target cb) weight target_source target_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (sl_use cb) weight use_source use_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (sl_def cb) weight def_source def_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (sl_exit cb) weight exit_source exit_budget ->
    let g := cfg (gview vv) in
    let '(facts, fact_events) := audit_live_facts_counted g cb in
    let fact_external := fold_right (fun event total => audit_live_fact_event_budget node_budget
  out_budget
      exit_budget edge_budget target_budget use_budget def_budget value_budget event + total) 0
```

```rocq
(** * Complete SEG builder source contracts

    For example, the returned sparse graph retains the final arc map of the same builder run.
    Builds on: graph and collection source models and expression SEG operations. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool PArith NArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet
  CollectionsTrie
  CollectionsAuditCost CollectionsAuditTrie CollectionsAuditMap CollectionsAuditFinSet
  CollectionsAuditElements

From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare GraphAuditBase GraphAuditDfs.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsGraph.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesLiveness AnalysesAvailable AnalysesSeg.
Import List.ListNotations.

(** Events retain every actual client callback input, result and body. *)
Inductive audit_seg_transfer_source_event (E U B : Type) : Type :=
  | SegTransferCase : nat -> audit_seg_transfer_source_event E U B
  | SegTransferGen : E -> list U -> list B -> audit_seg_transfer_source_event E U B
  | SegTransferKill : E -> U -> bool -> list B -> audit_seg_transfer_source_event E U B
  | SegTransferEncode : U -> positive -> list B -> audit_seg_transfer_source_event E U B
  | SegTransferEqual : positive -> positive -> bool -> list audit_positive_eqb_event ->
  audit_seg_transfer_source_event E U B.
Arguments SegTransferCase {E U B} _.
Arguments SegTransferGen {E U B} _ _ _.
Arguments SegTransferKill {E U B} _ _ _ _.
Arguments SegTransferEncode {E U B} _ _ _.
Arguments SegTransferEqual {E U B} _ _ _ _.

(** The strict mention scan visits every expression occurrence. *)
Fixpoint audit_seg_transfer_source_mentions {E U B} (enc : U -> positive * list B) (u : U) (values :
  list U)
    : bool * list (audit_seg_transfer_source_event E U B) :=
  match values with
  | [] => (false, [SegTransferCase 0])
  | v :: rest =>
      let '(a, ea) := enc u in let '(b, eb) := enc v in
      let '(equal, calls) := audit_positive_eqb a b in
      let '(later, events) := audit_seg_transfer_source_mentions enc u rest in
      (equal || later, SegTransferCase 1 :: SegTransferEncode u a ea :: SegTransferEncode v b eb ::
        SegTransferEqual a b equal calls :: events)
  end.

(** Generation and kill both execute for every event or transfer invocation. *)
Definition audit_seg_transfer_source_operands {E U B} (enc : U -> positive * list B)
    (gen_call : E -> list U * list B) (kill_call : E * U -> bool * list B) (u : U) (e : E)
    : (bool * bool) * list (audit_seg_transfer_source_event E U B) :=
  let '(generated, gen_body) := gen_call e in
  let '(found, mentions) := audit_seg_transfer_source_mentions (E := E) enc u generated in
  let '(killed, kill_body) := kill_call (e, u) in
  ((found, killed), SegTransferGen e generated gen_body :: mentions ++ [SegTransferKill e u killed
  kill_body]).

(** Event detection returns the strict disjunction of the captured operands. *)
Definition audit_seg_event_source_counted {E U B} (enc : U -> positive * list B)
    (gen_call : E -> list U * list B) (kill_call : E * U -> bool * list B) (u : U) (e : E)
    : bool * list (audit_seg_transfer_source_event E U B) :=
  let '((found, killed), events) := audit_seg_transfer_source_operands enc gen_call kill_call u e in
  (found || killed, events ++ [SegTransferCase 2]).

(** Transfer uses the same operands and the supplied incoming Boolean. *)
Definition audit_seg_transfer_source_counted {E U B} (enc : U -> positive * list B)
    (gen_call : E -> list U * list B) (kill_call : E * U -> bool * list B) (u : U) (e : E) (b :
  bool)
    : bool * list (audit_seg_transfer_source_event E U B) :=
  let '((found, killed), events) := audit_seg_transfer_source_operands enc gen_call kill_call u e in
  (found || (b && negb killed), events ++ [SegTransferCase 3]).

(** Work includes actual equality source frames and supplied callback bodies. *)
Definition audit_seg_transfer_source_event_work {E U B} (weight : B -> nat)
    (event : audit_seg_transfer_source_event E U B) : nat :=
  64 + match event with
  | SegTransferGen _ _ body | SegTransferKill _ _ _ body | SegTransferEncode _ _ body =>
      fold_right (fun x n => weight x + n) 0 body
  | SegTransferEqual _ _ _ calls => audit_positive_eqb_source_work calls
  | SegTransferCase _ => 0
  end.

(** External work is the sum of actual generated, kill and encoder bodies. *)
Definition audit_seg_transfer_source_event_external {E U B} (weight : B -> nat)
    (event : audit_seg_transfer_source_event E U B) : nat :=
  match event with
  | SegTransferGen _ _ body | SegTransferKill _ _ _ body | SegTransferEncode _ _ body =>
      fold_right (fun x n => weight x + n) 0 body
  | _ => 0
  end.

(** Work charges all source events and occurrence-list construction. *)
Definition audit_seg_transfer_source_work {E U B} (weight : B -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_seg_transfer_source_event E U B)) : nat :=
  256 * S (length events) * S (length events) +
    fold_right (fun event n => audit_seg_transfer_source_event_work weight event + n) 0 events.

(** Callback cost is taken from the same recorded run. *)
Definition audit_seg_transfer_source_external {E U B} (weight : B -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_seg_transfer_source_event E U B)) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun event n => audit_seg_transfer_source_event_external weight event + n) 0 events.

(** The input bound uses actual generation output and encoded expression widths. *)
Definition audit_seg_transfer_source_budget {E U} (EU : encoding U) (gen_value : E -> list U) (u :
  U) (e : E) : nat :=
  let values := u :: gen_value e in
  let width := fold_right Nat.max 0 (map (fun v => Pos.size_nat (encode EU v)) values) in
  4096 * Nat.pow (S (length values + width)) 4.

(** Event and transfer have exact results and input-derived same-run source bounds. *)
Definition audit_seg_transfer_source_statement : Prop :=
  forall S O N E U C B (EU : encoding U) (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) u e b
    (enc : U -> positive * list B) (gen_call : E -> list U * list B) (kill_call : E * U -> bool *
  list B)

    (forall edge expression, fst (kill_call (edge, expression)) = kill gk edge expression) ->
    let '(event_result, event_calls) := audit_seg_event_source_counted enc gen_call kill_call u e in
    let '(transfer_result, transfer_calls) := audit_seg_transfer_source_counted enc gen_call

    event_result = seg_event EU gk u e /\ transfer_result = seg_bit_transfer EU gk u e b /\

  gk) u e +
      audit_seg_transfer_source_external weight event_calls /\
    audit_seg_transfer_source_work weight transfer_calls <= audit_seg_transfer_source_budget EU (gen
  gk) u e +
      audit_seg_transfer_source_external weight transfer_calls.

(** Each source event charges a genuine callback at its actual input. *)
Definition audit_seg_transfer_source_event_budget {E U B} (encode_budget : U -> nat) (gen_budget : E
  -> nat)
    (kill_budget : E * U -> nat) (event : audit_seg_transfer_source_event E U B) : nat :=
  match event with
  | SegTransferGen e _ _ => gen_budget e
  | SegTransferKill e u _ _ => kill_budget (e, u)
  | SegTransferEncode u _ _ => encode_budget u
  | _ => 0
  end.

(** Adapted bounds apply the client source and budget laws at the recorded invocations. *)
Definition audit_seg_transfer_source_adapted_statement : Prop :=
  forall S O N E U C B (EU : encoding U) (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) u e b

  kill_budget event + n) 0 event_calls /\

  gk) u e +

  kill_budget event + n) 0 transfer_calls.

(** The component contract includes strict event, transfer and equality source obligations. *)
Definition audit_seg_transfer_source_contract_statement : Prop :=
  audit_seg_transfer_source_statement /\ audit_seg_transfer_source_adapted_statement /\
  audit_positive_eqb_erases_statement /\ audit_positive_eqb_source_bound_statement.

(** All supplied graph, encoder and expression callbacks retain actual source bodies. *)
Record audit_seg_build_callbacks (N E U B : Type) : Type := SegBuildCallbacks {
  seg_build_node_encode : N -> positive * list B;
  seg_build_edge_encode : E -> positive * list B;
  seg_build_expr_encode : U -> positive * list B;
  seg_build_out : N -> list E * list B;
  seg_build_target : E -> N * list B;
  seg_build_source : E -> N * list B;
  seg_build_gen : E -> list U * list B;
  seg_build_kill : E * U -> bool * list B

Arguments seg_build_node_encode {N E U B} _ _.
Arguments seg_build_edge_encode {N E U B} _ _.
Arguments seg_build_expr_encode {N E U B} _ _.
Arguments seg_build_out {N E U B} _ _.
Arguments seg_build_target {N E U B} _ _.
Arguments seg_build_source {N E U B} _ _.
Arguments seg_build_gen {N E U B} _ _.
Arguments seg_build_kill {N E U B} _ _.

(** Events retain actual operands, intermediate maps and callback bodies. *)
Inductive audit_seg_build_event (N E U B : Type) : Type :=
  | SegBuildCase : nat -> audit_seg_build_event N E U B
  | SegBuildPrepare : audit_prepare_source_event N E B -> audit_seg_build_event N E U B
  | SegBuildOut : N -> list E -> list B -> audit_seg_build_event N E U B
  | SegBuildTarget : E -> N -> list B -> audit_seg_build_event N E U B
  | SegBuildSource : E -> N -> list B -> audit_seg_build_event N E U B
  | SegBuildTransfer : audit_seg_transfer_source_event E U B -> audit_seg_build_event N E U B
  | SegBuildSet : audit_set_event N B -> audit_seg_build_event N E U B
  | SegBuildAdj : audit_map_event N (list E) B -> audit_seg_build_event N E U B
  | SegBuildNodeMap : audit_map_event N E B -> audit_seg_build_event N E U B
  | SegBuildArcMap : audit_map_event E (seg_arc N E) B -> audit_seg_build_event N E U B

Arguments SegBuildCase {N E U B} _.
Arguments SegBuildPrepare {N E U B} _.
Arguments SegBuildOut {N E U B} _ _ _.
Arguments SegBuildTarget {N E U B} _ _ _.
Arguments SegBuildSource {N E U B} _ _ _.
Arguments SegBuildTransfer {N E U B} _.
Arguments SegBuildSet {N E U B} _.
Arguments SegBuildAdj {N E U B} _.
Arguments SegBuildNodeMap {N E U B} _.
Arguments SegBuildArcMap {N E U B} _.
Arguments SegBuildOutput {N E U B} _.

(** Edge enumeration invokes the original outgoing callback at each listed node. *)
Fixpoint audit_seg_build_edges {N E U B} (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B) (nodes : list N)
    : list E * list (audit_seg_build_event N E U B) :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => ([], [SegBuildCase 0])
  | n :: rest => let '(edges, body) := seg_build_out cb n in
      let '(later, events) := audit_seg_build_edges cb rest in
      (edges ++ later, SegBuildCase 1 :: SegBuildOut n edges body :: events ++ [SegBuildOutput
  (length edges)])
  end.

(** Event endpoints use the exact transfer-predicate source and conditional endpoint calls. *)
Fixpoint audit_seg_build_points {N E U B} (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B) (u : U) (edges :
  list E)
    : FinSet.t N * list (audit_seg_build_event N E U B) :=
  match edges with
  | [] => (FinSet.empty, [SegBuildCase 2])
  | e :: rest =>
      let '(middle, later) := audit_seg_build_points cb u rest in
      let '(event, calls) := audit_seg_event_source_counted (seg_build_expr_encode cb)
        (seg_build_gen cb) (seg_build_kill cb) u e in
      if event then
        let '(src, sb) := seg_build_source cb e in let '(dst, db) := seg_build_target cb e in
        let '(after_dst, dst_calls) := audit_finset_add (seg_build_node_encode cb) dst middle in
        let '(result, src_calls) := audit_finset_add (seg_build_node_encode cb) src after_dst in
        (result, SegBuildCase 3 :: later ++ map SegBuildTransfer calls ++
          [SegBuildSource e src sb; SegBuildTarget e dst db] ++ map SegBuildSet dst_calls ++ map
  SegBuildSet src_calls)
      else (middle, SegBuildCase 4 :: later ++ map SegBuildTransfer calls)
  end.

(** Both boundary membership tests execute; predecessor lookup follows a singleton successor. *)
Fixpoint audit_seg_build_candidates {N E U B} {EN : encoding N} {g : Graph.t N E}
    (p : prepared EN g) (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B) (points entries : FinSet.t N)
  (nodes : list N)
    : Map.t N E * list (audit_seg_build_event N E U B) :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => (Map.empty, [SegBuildCase 5])
  | n :: rest =>
      let '(middle, later) := audit_seg_build_candidates p cb points entries rest in
      let '(point, pcalls) := audit_finset_mem (seg_build_node_encode cb) n points in
      let '(entry, ecalls) := audit_finset_mem (seg_build_node_encode cb) n entries in
      if point || entry then (middle, SegBuildCase 6 :: later ++ map SegBuildSet pcalls ++ map
  SegBuildSet ecalls)
      else
        let '(out, out_calls) := audit_map_get (seg_build_node_encode cb) n (out_index p) in
        let successors := match out with Some es => es | None => [] end in
        match successors with
        | [edge] =>
            let '(incoming, in_calls) := audit_map_get (seg_build_node_encode cb) n (in_index p) in
            let predecessors := match incoming with Some es => es | None => [] end in
            match predecessors with
            | [_] => let '(result, writes) := audit_map_set (seg_build_node_encode cb) n edge middle
  in
                (result, SegBuildCase 7 :: later ++ map SegBuildSet pcalls ++ map SegBuildSet ecalls
  ++
                  map SegBuildAdj out_calls ++ map SegBuildAdj in_calls ++ map SegBuildNodeMap
  writes)
            | _ => (middle, SegBuildCase 8 :: later ++ map SegBuildSet pcalls ++ map SegBuildSet
  ecalls ++
                  map SegBuildAdj out_calls ++ map SegBuildAdj in_calls)
            end
        | _ => (middle, SegBuildCase 9 :: later ++ map SegBuildSet pcalls ++ map SegBuildSet ecalls
  ++
              map SegBuildAdj out_calls)
        end
  end.

(** The incoming index retains one target call and map write per edge occurrence. *)
Fixpoint audit_seg_build_incoming {N E U B} (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B) (edges : list
  E)
    : Map.t N E * list (audit_seg_build_event N E U B) :=
  match edges with
  | [] => (Map.empty, [SegBuildCase 10])
  | e :: rest =>
      let '(middle, later) := audit_seg_build_incoming cb rest in
      let '(dst, body) := seg_build_target cb e in
      let '(result, writes) := audit_map_set (seg_build_node_encode cb) dst e middle in
      (result, SegBuildCase 11 :: later ++ [SegBuildTarget e dst body] ++ map SegBuildNodeMap
  writes)
  end.

(** Initial arcs evaluate all four source transfer applications for each edge. *)
Fixpoint audit_seg_build_arcs {N E U B} (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B) (u : U) (edges :
  list E)
    : Map.t E (seg_arc N E) * list (audit_seg_build_event N E U B) :=

  | [] => (Map.empty, [SegBuildCase 12])
  | e :: rest =>
      let '(middle, later) := audit_seg_build_arcs cb u rest in
      let '(dst, body) := seg_build_target cb e in
      let '(ff, ef) := audit_seg_transfer_source_counted (seg_build_expr_encode cb) (seg_build_gen
  cb) (seg_build_kill cb) u e false in
      let '(ft, et) := audit_seg_transfer_source_counted (seg_build_expr_encode cb) (seg_build_gen
  cb) (seg_build_kill cb) u e true in
      let '(bf, ebf) := audit_seg_transfer_source_counted (seg_build_expr_encode cb) (seg_build_gen
  cb) (seg_build_kill cb) u e false in
      let '(bt, ebt) := audit_seg_transfer_source_counted (seg_build_expr_encode cb) (seg_build_gen
  cb) (seg_build_kill cb) u e true in
      let arc := SegArc dst (SegLeaf e) (ff, ft) (bf, bt) in
      let '(result, writes) := audit_map_set (seg_build_edge_encode cb) e arc middle in
      (result, SegBuildCase 13 :: later ++ [SegBuildTarget e dst body] ++ map SegBuildTransfer ef ++
        map SegBuildTransfer et ++ map SegBuildTransfer ebf ++ map SegBuildTransfer ebt ++ map
  SegBuildArcMap writes)
  end.

(** The actual initial work contains separately constructed alive, incoming and arc maps. *)
Definition audit_seg_build_initial {N E U B} (g : Graph.t N E) (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U
  B)
    (u : U) (edges : list E) : seg_work N E * list (audit_seg_build_event N E U B) :=
  let '(alive, alive_calls) := audit_finset_of_list (seg_build_node_encode cb) (Graph.nodes g) in
  let '(incoming, incoming_calls) := audit_seg_build_incoming cb edges in
```
