```rocq
        Forall (fx_dep_prepare_source index_source) (fx_rpo_prepare_events schedule) /\
        Forall (fx_dep_dfs_source index_source) (fx_rpo_dfs_events schedule) /\
        Forall (fx_dep_positions_source index_source) (fx_rpo_position_events schedule) /\

    u n cuts in

        let system_external := fold_right (fun event total =>

        let query_external := fold_right (fun event total =>
          audit_seg_reconstruct_event_budget node_budget edge_budget target_budget source_budget
    gen_budget

        answer = audit_seg_query_expected EN EE EU gk direction u n /\

          fx_declared_body_work (fx_body_weight budget) engine_bodies +

(** This conjunction records future obligations; no universal proof is claimed here. *)
Definition audit_seg_query_contract_statement : Prop :=

  audit_seg_solver_contract_statement /\ audit_seg_query_adapted_statement.
```

```rocq
    One sparse builder and one solver result serve a list of node probes.

(** Each probe reuses the same cut set, graph work state and solver assignment. *)
Fixpoint audit_seg_sparse_batch_probes {N E U B} (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B)
    (work : seg_work N E) (idx : seg_index N E) (solution : Map.t N bool)
    (direction : audit_seg_direction) (u : U) (cuts : FinSet.t N) (nodes : list N)
    : list bool * list (list (audit_seg_reconstruct_event N E U B)) :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => ([], [])
  | n :: rest => let '(answer, calls) := audit_seg_reconstruct_probe cb work idx solution direction
  u n cuts in
    let '(answers, traces) := audit_seg_sparse_batch_probes cb work idx solution direction u cuts
  rest in
    (answer :: answers, calls :: traces)
  end.

(** Setup is bounded by the captured graph's node count and actual encoded widths. *)
Definition audit_seg_sparse_setup_budget {N E} (EN : encoding N) (idx : seg_index N E) : nat :=
  let nodes := Graph.nodes (seg_graph idx) in
  let width := fold_right (fun n total => Pos.size_nat (encode EN n) + total) 0 nodes in
  65536 * Nat.pow (S (length nodes + width)) 8.

  audit_seg_sparse_setup_budget EN idx + Nat.succ (length nodes) +

  nodes.

    (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B)

  kill_source

  kill_budget,
    audit_seg_full_callbacks_erase EN EE EU gk cb ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_node_encode cb) weight node_source node_budget
  ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_edge_encode cb) weight edge_source edge_budget
  ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_expr_encode cb) weight expr_source expr_budget
  ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_out cb) weight out_source out_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_target cb) weight target_source target_budget
  ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_source cb) weight source_source source_budget
  ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_gen cb) weight gen_source gen_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_kill cb) weight kill_source kill_budget ->
    let '(present, universe_events) := audit_seg_universe_counted (cfg (gkview gk)) cb u in
    let universe_external := fold_right (fun event total =>
      audit_seg_universe_event_budget out_budget gen_budget expr_budget event + total) 0
  universe_events in
    audit_seg_universe_work weight universe_events <= audit_seg_universe_input_budget EU gk u +
  universe_external /\
    if present then
      let receipt := audit_seg_full_source_counted EN EE (cfg (gkview gk)) cb u in
      let idx := audit_seg_full_result receipt in
      let p := audit_seg_full_index receipt in let work := audit_seg_full_work_state receipt in
      let system := audit_seg_fx_system EE EU gk u idx direction in
      let static := audit_seg_fx_static EE EU gk u idx direction in
      let index_cb := audit_seg_fx_index_model direction (seg_build_node_encode cb)
  (seg_build_edge_encode cb)
        (seg_build_target cb) (seg_build_source cb) work in
      let index_source := audit_seg_fx_index_source direction (seg_build_node_encode cb)
  (seg_build_edge_encode cb)
        (seg_build_target cb) (seg_build_source cb) work in
      let index_budget := audit_seg_fx_index_budget EN EE weight node_budget edge_budget
  target_budget source_budget in
      let schedule := fx_rpo_scheduler_counted EN system static index_cb in
      let source := audit_seg_fx_declared_source EN EE EU gk u p direction (seg_build_node_encode
  cb)
        (seg_build_edge_encode cb) (seg_build_target cb) (seg_build_source cb) work idx schedule in
      let budget := audit_seg_fx_declared_budget EN EE weight node_budget edge_budget target_budget
  source_budget
        (System.constraints system) in
      let '(constraints, system_events) := audit_seg_system_constraints p (seg_build_node_encode cb)
  work idx direction in
      exists result index_events init_events engine_events init_bodies engine_bodies,
        constraints = System.constraints system /\

          (rpo_scheduler EN system static) Joining system index_cb result index_events init_events
  engine_events /\

        fx_declared_trace_source source engine_events engine_bodies /\
        fx_dep_body_source index_source (fx_rpo_build_events schedule) /\
        Forall (fx_dep_prepare_source index_source) (fx_rpo_prepare_events schedule) /\
        Forall (fx_dep_dfs_source index_source) (fx_rpo_dfs_events schedule) /\
        Forall (fx_dep_positions_source index_source) (fx_rpo_position_events schedule) /\
        Forall (fx_dep_retreat_source index_source) (fx_rpo_retreat_events schedule) /\
        let '(cuts, setup_events) := audit_seg_reconstruct_setup cb idx in
        let '(answers, traces) := audit_seg_sparse_batch_probes cb work idx result direction u cuts
  nodes in
        let builder_external := fold_right (fun event total =>
          audit_seg_full_event_budget node_budget out_budget edge_budget target_budget source_budget
            gen_budget expr_budget kill_budget event + total) 0 (audit_seg_full_events receipt) in
        let system_external := fold_right (fun event total => audit_seg_system_event_budget
  node_budget event + total)
          0 system_events in

  node_budget
          edge_budget target_budget source_budget gen_budget expr_budget kill_budget event + total)
  0
          (setup_events ++ concat traces) in

  length nodes /\
        audit_seg_full_source_work weight (audit_seg_full_events receipt) + audit_seg_system_work
```

```rocq
(** Each constructor binds the actual step output and that same step's source bodies. *)
Inductive audit_dense_annotated_engine {X C A B} (EX : encoding X) (EC : encoding C)
    (L : lattice A) (sch : scheduler X) (mode : strategy) (system : System.t X C A)
    (ix : sys_index X C) (source : fx_declared_callback_source X C A B) :

      list (list (list B)) -> Prop :=
  | DenseAnnotatedStop : forall state result events bodies,
      fx_model_step EX EC L sch mode system ix state = (Done result, events) ->
      fx_declared_trace_source source events bodies ->
      audit_dense_annotated_engine EX EC L sch mode system ix source state result events bodies

      fx_model_step EX EC L sch mode system ix state = (Pending next, events) ->
      fx_declared_trace_source source events bodies ->
      audit_dense_annotated_engine EX EC L sch mode system ix source next result later
    later_bodies ->
      audit_dense_annotated_engine EX EC L sch mode system ix source state result

(** Index and initial queue receipts feed the same annotated engine and final assignment. *)
Inductive audit_dense_annotated_total {X C A BI BW} (EX : encoding X) (EC : encoding C)
    (L : lattice A) (sch : scheduler X) (mode : strategy) (system : System.t X C A)
    (cb : fx_index_external_model X C BI) (index_source : fx_index_external_source X C BI)

    Prop :=
  | DenseAnnotatedTotal : forall ix index_events queue init_events result engine_events
      init_bodies engine_bodies,

      fx_index_external_trace_adequacy index_source index_events ->
      fx_model_enqueue EC sch system (System.constraints system) PQueue.empty = (queue,
    init_events) ->
      fx_declared_trace_source source init_events init_bodies ->
      audit_dense_annotated_engine EX EC L sch mode system ix source
        (Engine.State Map.empty queue Map.empty) result engine_events engine_bodies ->
      audit_dense_annotated_total EX EC L sch mode system cb index_source source
        result index_events init_events engine_events init_bodies engine_bodies.

(** The annotated witness projects to the original total-engine execution and source traces. *)
Definition audit_dense_annotated_total_erasure_statement : Prop :=
  forall (X C A BI BW : Type) (EX : encoding X) (EC : encoding C) (L : lattice A)
    (sch : scheduler X) (mode : strategy) (system : System.t X C A)
    (cb : fx_index_external_model X C BI) (index_source : fx_index_external_source X C BI)
    (source : fx_declared_callback_source X C A BW) result index_events init_events engine_events
    init_bodies engine_bodies,
    audit_dense_annotated_total EX EC L sch mode system cb index_source source
      result index_events init_events engine_events init_bodies engine_bodies ->
    fx_total_callbacks_run EX EC L sch mode system cb result index_events init_events
    engine_events /\
    fx_declared_trace_source source init_events init_bodies /\
      fx_declared_trace_source source engine_events engine_bodies.
```

```rocq
(** * Dense SEG callback input budgets

From Stdlib Require Import List PArith Arith.

    CollectionsAuditElements.
From Galois.Order Require Import OrderLattice.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphAuditBase.
From Galois.Fixpoint Require Import FixpointSystem FixpointWorklist FixpointSchedule

From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsGraph.

    AnalysesAuditSegBuilder
  AnalysesAuditSegDenseUniverse AnalysesAuditSegDenseTransfer AnalysesAuditSegDenseSystem
  AnalysesAuditSegDenseCallbacks.
Import List.ListNotations.

(** Each field prices one genuine external client callback at its own input. *)
Record audit_dense_client_budget (N E U : Type) : Type := AuditDenseClientBudget {
  dense_node_budget : N -> nat;
  dense_edge_budget : E -> nat;
  dense_expr_budget : U -> nat;
  dense_out_budget : N -> nat;
  dense_target_budget : E -> nat;
  dense_source_budget : E -> nat;
  dense_gen_budget : E -> nat;
  dense_kill_budget : E * U -> nat
}.
Arguments dense_node_budget {N E U} _ _.
Arguments dense_edge_budget {N E U} _ _.
Arguments dense_expr_budget {N E U} _ _.
Arguments dense_out_budget {N E U} _ _.
Arguments dense_target_budget {N E U} _ _.
Arguments dense_source_budget {N E U} _ _.
Arguments dense_gen_budget {N E U} _ _.
Arguments dense_kill_budget {N E U} _ _.

(** The external universe bound counts actual listed out, gen and expression-encoding calls. *)
Definition audit_dense_universe_external_budget {S O N E U C} (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C)
    (costs : audit_dense_client_budget N E U) : nat :=
  let g := cfg (gkview gk) in let edges := edges_of g in
  fold_right (fun n total => dense_out_budget costs n + total) 0 (Graph.nodes g) +
  fold_right (fun e total => dense_gen_budget costs e + total) 0 edges +
  fold_right (fun u total => dense_expr_budget costs u + total) 0 (flat_map (gen gk) edges).

(** A transfer pays every actual kill, generation and finite-set encoding call. *)
Definition audit_dense_transfer_external_budget {S O N E U C} (EU : encoding U)
    (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) (costs : audit_dense_client_budget N E U)
    (edge : E) (input : FinSet.t U) : nat :=
  let items := FinSet.elements input in
  let generated := gen gk edge in
  let universe := expr_universe EU gk in
  audit_dense_universe_external_budget gk costs + dense_gen_budget costs edge +
    fold_right (fun u n => dense_kill_budget costs (edge, u) + n) 0 items +
    fold_right (fun u n => dense_expr_budget costs u + n) 0 (items ++ generated) +
    2 * fold_right (fun u n => dense_expr_budget costs u + n) 0 universe.

(** Seed construction includes its own fresh universe and selected set rebuild. *)
Definition audit_dense_seed_budget {S O N E U C} (EU : encoding U)
    (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) (costs : audit_dense_client_budget N E U)
    (direction : audit_seg_direction) (node : N) : nat :=
  let universe := expr_universe EU gk in
  512 + audit_dense_universe_budget EU gk + audit_dense_universe_external_budget gk costs +
    audit_dense_clamp_budget EU universe FinSet.empty +
    2 * fold_right (fun u n => dense_expr_budget costs u + n) 0 universe +
    match direction with AuditAvailable => 0 | AuditBusy => dense_out_budget costs node end.

(** A finite maximum ranges over actual flow occurrences and the actual input set. *)
Definition audit_dense_continuation_budget {S O N E U C} (EU : encoding U)
    (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) (costs : audit_dense_client_budget N E U)
    (direction : audit_seg_direction) (input : avail_set EU gk) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun constraint n => match constraint with
    | Seed _ => n
    | Flow e => Nat.max n (512 + audit_dense_transfer_budget EU gk e (proj1_sig input) +
        audit_dense_transfer_external_budget EU gk costs e (proj1_sig input))
    end) 256 (System.constraints (audit_dense_fx_system EU gk direction)).

(** Every solver callback has a concrete per-input bound, including finite-set operations. *)
Definition audit_dense_declared_budget {S O N E U C B} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (EU : encoding U) (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) (costs : audit_dense_client_budget N E U)
    (weight : B -> nat) (direction : audit_seg_direction) :

  let endpoint := fun e => 512 + dense_target_budget costs e + dense_source_budget costs e in

      512 + dense_edge_budget costs e + 16 * Pos.size_nat (encode EE e) end)
    (fun c => match c with Seed _ => 256 | Flow e => endpoint e end)
    node node
    (fun c => match c with Seed n => audit_dense_seed_budget EU gk costs direction n
      | Flow e => endpoint e end)

    (fun a b => 256 + 32 * audit_trie_nodes (proj1_sig b))
    (fun a b => 256 + 64 * (audit_trie_nodes (proj1_sig a) + audit_trie_nodes (proj1_sig b)))
    (fun a b => 256 + 64 * (audit_trie_nodes (proj1_sig a) + audit_trie_nodes (proj1_sig b))).

(** Actual client adapters instantiate the generated index, scheduler and every solver callback. *)
Definition audit_dense_callback_instantiation_statement : Prop :=
  forall (S O N E U C B : Type) (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (EU : encoding U)
    (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B)
    (direction : audit_seg_direction) (weight : B -> nat) (costs : audit_dense_client_budget N E U)

    kill_source,
    audit_seg_full_callbacks_erase EN EE EU gk cb ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_node_encode cb) weight node_source

    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_edge_encode cb) weight edge_source
      (dense_edge_budget costs) ->

    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_source cb) weight source_source

    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_gen cb) weight gen_source
    (dense_gen_budget costs) ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_kill cb) weight kill_source
    (dense_kill_budget costs) ->
    let sys := audit_dense_fx_system EU gk direction in
    let static := audit_dense_fx_static EU gk direction in
    let model := audit_dense_index_model cb direction in
    let index_budget := audit_dense_fx_index_budget EN EE weight (dense_node_budget costs)
      (dense_edge_budget costs) (dense_target_budget costs) (dense_source_budget costs) in
```

```rocq
(** * Dense SEG solver callbacks

    The generated solver uses actual graph endpoints, finite must operations and transfers.
    For example, a backward seed inspects its actual outgoing list before choosing its value.
    Builds on: AnalysesAuditSegDenseSystem and the captured RPO schedule. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool PArith Arith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet
  CollectionsAuditMap CollectionsAuditFinSet CollectionsAuditInter.
From Galois.Order Require Import OrderLattice OrderPowerset.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore.
From Galois.Fixpoint Require Import FixpointQuery FixpointSystem FixpointWorklist FixpointSchedule

    AnalysesAuditSegBuilder
  AnalysesAuditSegDenseUniverse AnalysesAuditSegDenseSets AnalysesAuditSegDenseTransfer
  AnalysesAuditSegDenseSystem.
Import List.ListNotations.

(** A seed captures the selected empty clamp or full-universe construction. *)
Definition audit_dense_seed {N E U B} (g : Graph.t N E) (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B)
    (direction : audit_seg_direction) (n : N) :
    FinSet.t U * list (audit_dense_fx_event N E U B) :=
  let '(boundary, before) := match direction with
    | AuditAvailable => (true, [])
    | AuditBusy => let '(out, body) := seg_build_out cb n in
        (match out with [] => true | _ => false end, [DenseFxOut n out body])
    end in
  let '(universe, universe_events) := audit_dense_universe g cb in
  if boundary then
    let '(result, clamp_events) := audit_dense_clamp cb universe FinSet.empty in
    (result, before ++ [DenseFxUniverse universe_events; DenseFxTransfer clamp_events])
  else
    let '(result, set_events) := audit_finset_of_list (seg_build_expr_encode cb) universe in
    (result, before ++ [DenseFxUniverse universe_events;
      DenseFxTransfer [DenseTransferSet set_events]]).

(** RHS source is a relational same-invocation derivation, including its actual returned query. *)
Definition audit_dense_rhs_source {S O N E U C B} (EU : encoding U)
    (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B)
    (direction : audit_seg_direction) (c : dense_constraint N E)
    (out : Query.t N (avail_set EU gk)) (body : list (audit_dense_fx_event N E U B)) : Prop :=
  let g := cfg (gkview gk) in
  let system := audit_dense_fx_system EU gk direction in
  match c with
  | Seed n => exists value raw events,
      out = Query.Ret value /\ out = System.rhs system c /\
      audit_dense_seed g cb direction n = (raw, events) /\ proj1_sig value = raw /\ body = events
  | Flow e => exists n endpoint,
      (match direction with
       | AuditAvailable => seg_build_source cb e = (n, endpoint) /\ body = [DenseFxSource e n
    endpoint]
       | AuditBusy => seg_build_target cb e = (n, endpoint) /\ body = [DenseFxTarget e n endpoint]
       end) /\
      out = Query.Ask n (fun input => Query.Ret (avail_transfer EU gk e input))
  end.

(** A flow continuation captures its transfer on the actual finite-set input. *)
Definition audit_dense_continuation_source {S O N E U C B} (EU : encoding U)
    (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B)
    (direction : audit_seg_direction) (k : avail_set EU gk -> Query.t N (avail_set EU gk))
    (input : avail_set EU gk) (out : Query.t N (avail_set EU gk))
    (body : list (audit_dense_fx_event N E U B)) : Prop :=
  exists edge raw events,
    In (Flow edge) (System.constraints (audit_dense_fx_system EU gk direction)) /\
    k = (fun value => Query.Ret (avail_transfer EU gk edge value)) /\
    audit_dense_transfer (cfg (gkview gk)) cb edge (proj1_sig input) = (raw, events) /\
    raw = proj1_sig (avail_transfer EU gk edge input) /\
    out = Query.Ret (avail_transfer EU gk edge input) /\ body = [DenseFxTransfer events].

(** RPO priority reads the actual captured position map. *)
Definition audit_dense_priority {N E U B} (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B)
    (positions : Map.t N positive) (n : N) : positive * list (audit_dense_fx_event N E U B) :=
  let '(found, events) := audit_map_get (seg_build_node_encode cb) n positions in
  (match found with Some p => p | None => 1%positive end, map DenseFxNodeMap events).

(** RPO widening membership reads the actual captured head set. *)
Definition audit_dense_widening {N E U B} (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B)
    (heads : FinSet.t N) (n : N) : bool * list (audit_dense_fx_event N E U B) :=
  let '(found, events) := audit_finset_mem (seg_build_node_encode cb) n heads in
  (found, map DenseFxNodeSet events).

(** Every declared callback is tied to a concrete source-shaped invocation. *)
Definition audit_dense_declared_source {S O N E U C B} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (EU : encoding U) (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B)
    (direction : audit_seg_direction)
    (schedule : fx_rpo_result N (dense_constraint N E) (audit_dense_fx_event N E U B)) :
    fx_declared_callback_source N (dense_constraint N E) (avail_set EU gk)
      (audit_dense_fx_event N E U B) :=
  let lattice := avail_lattice EU gk in
  FxDeclaredCallbackSource _ _ _ _
    (fun n result body => audit_dense_node_encode cb n = (result, body))
    (fun c result body => audit_dense_constraint_encode cb c = (result, body))
    (fun c result body => audit_dense_target cb direction c = (result, body))
    (fun n result body => audit_dense_priority cb (fx_rpo_positions schedule) n = (result, body))
    (fun n result body => audit_dense_widening cb (fx_rpo_heads schedule) n = (result, body))
    (audit_dense_rhs_source EU gk cb direction)
    (audit_dense_continuation_source EU gk cb direction)
    (fun a b result body => let '(out, events) := audit_dense_subset (proj1_sig b) (proj1_sig a) in
      result = out /\ body = [DenseFxSubset events])
    (fun a b result body => let '(raw, events) := audit_dense_inter (proj1_sig a) (proj1_sig b) in
      result = join lattice a b /\ proj1_sig result = raw /\ body = [DenseFxInter events])
    (fun a b result body => let '(raw, events) := audit_dense_inter (proj1_sig a) (proj1_sig b) in
      result = widen lattice a b /\ proj1_sig result = raw /\ body = [DenseFxInter events]).
```

## Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditSegDenseClient

Card: AUD-SQ-MODELS

Source destination: `theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditSegDenseClient.v`.

```rocq
(** * Dense SEG client callback laws

    Client source relations describe actual per-input calls and bodies.
    For example, an edge-generation body is tied to that exact edge and returned list.
    Builds on: the graph callback adapter and dense client budget. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List PArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsAuditMap
    CollectionsAuditFinSet.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphAuditBase.
From Galois.Fixpoint Require Import FixpointAuditIndex.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsGraph.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAvailable AnalysesAuditSegBuilder
    AnalysesAuditSegUniverse
  AnalysesAuditSegDenseTransfer AnalysesAuditSegDenseSystem AnalysesAuditSegDenseBudget.
Import List.ListNotations.
(** Sources describe real client callback bodies at their exact inputs and results. *)
Record audit_dense_client_source (N E U B : Type) : Type := AuditDenseClientSource {
  dense_node_source : N -> positive -> list B -> nat -> Prop;
  dense_edge_source : E -> positive -> list B -> nat -> Prop;
  dense_expr_source : U -> positive -> list B -> nat -> Prop;
  dense_out_source : N -> list E -> list B -> nat -> Prop;
  dense_target_source : E -> N -> list B -> nat -> Prop;
  dense_source_source : E -> N -> list B -> nat -> Prop;
  dense_gen_source : E -> list U -> list B -> nat -> Prop;
  dense_kill_source : E * U -> bool -> list B -> nat -> Prop
}.
Arguments dense_node_source {N E U B} _ _ _ _ _.
Arguments dense_edge_source {N E U B} _ _ _ _ _.
Arguments dense_expr_source {N E U B} _ _ _ _ _.
Arguments dense_out_source {N E U B} _ _ _ _ _.
Arguments dense_target_source {N E U B} _ _ _ _ _.
Arguments dense_source_source {N E U B} _ _ _ _ _.
Arguments dense_gen_source {N E U B} _ _ _ _ _.
Arguments dense_kill_source {N E U B} _ _ _ _ _.

(** Laws are per actual client invocation and do not assume any whole-solver cost. *)
Definition audit_dense_client_laws {S O N E U C B} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (EU : encoding U) (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B)
    (weight : B -> nat) (costs : audit_dense_client_budget N E U)
    (source : audit_dense_client_source N E U B) : Prop :=
  audit_seg_full_callbacks_erase EN EE EU gk cb /\
  audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_node_encode cb) weight (dense_node_source source)
    (dense_node_budget costs) /\
  audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_edge_encode cb) weight (dense_edge_source source)
    (dense_edge_budget costs) /\
  audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_expr_encode cb) weight (dense_expr_source source)
    (dense_expr_budget costs) /\
  audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_out cb) weight (dense_out_source source)
    (dense_out_budget costs) /\
  audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_target cb) weight (dense_target_source source)
    (dense_target_budget costs) /\
  audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_source cb) weight (dense_source_source source)
    (dense_source_budget costs) /\
  audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_gen cb) weight (dense_gen_source source)
    (dense_gen_budget costs) /\
  audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_kill cb) weight (dense_kill_source source)
    (dense_kill_budget costs).


(** The exact event body determines the work argument passed to a client source relation. *)
Definition audit_dense_client_body_work {B} (weight : B -> nat) (body : list B) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun item n => weight item + n) 0 body.

(** Every expression-set event preserves the actual key, code and client encoder body. *)
Definition audit_dense_expr_set_source {N E U B} (weight : B -> nat)
    (source : audit_dense_client_source N E U B) (event : audit_set_event U B) : Prop :=
  match event with
  | AuditSetAdd u code _ _ body _ | AuditSetMem u code _ _ body _ |
    AuditSetRemove u code _ _ body _ =>
      dense_expr_source source u code body (audit_dense_client_body_work weight body)
  | AuditSetFold _ _ => True
  end.

(** Every universe event links its actual callback body to the client source. *)
Definition audit_dense_universe_client_source {N E U B} (weight : B -> nat)
    (source : audit_dense_client_source N E U B) (event : audit_seg_universe_event N E U B) :
    Prop :=
  match event with
  | SegUniverseOut n out body => dense_out_source source n out body
    (audit_dense_client_body_work weight body)
  | SegUniverseGen e out body => dense_gen_source source e out body
    (audit_dense_client_body_work weight body)
  | SegUniverseSet call => audit_dense_expr_set_source weight source call
  | _ => True
  end.

(** Every transfer event retains the original generation, kill and expression encoder source. *)
Definition audit_dense_transfer_client_source {N E U B} (weight : B -> nat)
    (source : audit_dense_client_source N E U B) (event : audit_dense_transfer_event N E U B) :
    Prop :=
  match event with
  | DenseTransferUniverse events => Forall (audit_dense_universe_client_source weight source) events
  | DenseTransferSet events => Forall (audit_dense_expr_set_source weight source) events
  | DenseTransferGen e out body => dense_gen_source source e out body
    (audit_dense_client_body_work weight body)
  | DenseTransferKill e u out body =>
      dense_kill_source source (e, u) out body (audit_dense_client_body_work weight body)
  | _ => True
  end.

(** Nested scheduler and finite-set source events expose their actual client bodies. *)
Definition audit_dense_fx_client_source {N E U B} (weight : B -> nat)
    (source : audit_dense_client_source N E U B) (event : audit_dense_fx_event N E U B) : Prop :=
  match event with
  | DenseFxNodeEncode n out body => dense_node_source source n out body
    (audit_dense_client_body_work weight body)
  | DenseFxEdgeEncode e out body => dense_edge_source source e out body
    (audit_dense_client_body_work weight body)
  | DenseFxOut n out body => dense_out_source source n out body (audit_dense_client_body_work
    weight body)
  | DenseFxTarget e out body => dense_target_source source e out body
    (audit_dense_client_body_work weight body)
  | DenseFxSource e out body => dense_source_source source e out body
    (audit_dense_client_body_work weight body)
  | DenseFxUniverse events => Forall (audit_dense_universe_client_source weight source) events
  | DenseFxTransfer events => Forall (audit_dense_transfer_client_source weight source) events
  | DenseFxNodeMap e => match e with
      | AuditMapGet n code _ _ body _ | AuditMapSet n _ code _ _ body _ |
        AuditMapRemove n code _ _ body _ =>
          dense_node_source source n code body (audit_dense_client_body_work weight body)
      end
  | DenseFxNodeSet e => match e with
      | AuditSetAdd n code _ _ body _ | AuditSetMem n code _ _ body _ |
        AuditSetRemove n code _ _ body _ =>
          dense_node_source source n code body (audit_dense_client_body_work weight body)
      | AuditSetFold _ _ => True
      end
  | _ => True
  end.

(** The body of each set operation retains every generated dense callback source event. *)
Definition audit_dense_index_set_client_source {N E U B} (weight : B -> nat)
    (source : audit_dense_client_source N E U B) (event : audit_set_event N
    (audit_dense_fx_event N E U B)) : Prop :=
  match event with
  | AuditSetAdd _ _ _ _ body _ | AuditSetMem _ _ _ _ body _ |
    AuditSetRemove _ _ _ _ body _ => Forall (audit_dense_fx_client_source weight source) body
  | AuditSetFold _ _ => True
  end.

(** Index receipts expose client bodies nested inside each actual dictionary call. *)
Definition audit_dense_index_client_source {N E U B} (weight : B -> nat)
    (source : audit_dense_client_source N E U B)
    (event : fx_index_nested_event N (dense_constraint N E) (audit_dense_fx_event N E U B)) :
    Prop :=
  match event with
  | FxiTarget _ _ body | FxiSides _ _ body | FxiDeps _ _ body |
    FxiRead _ _ _ _ body _ | FxiWrite _ _ _ _ _ body _ =>
      Forall (audit_dense_fx_client_source weight source) body
  | FxiDistinctBuild _ _ events => Forall (audit_dense_index_set_client_source weight source) events
  | _ => True
  end.
```

## Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditSegDenseInit

Card: AUD-SQ-MODELS

Source destination: `theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditSegDenseInit.v`.

```rocq
(** * Dense must-lattice initialization

    Constructing the finite must lattice creates its bottom from the whole expression universe.
    For example, an empty universe produces an empty bottom without any key insertion.
    Builds on: AnalysesAuditSegDenseUniverse and the shared finite-set source model. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List PArith Arith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsFinSet CollectionsAuditFinSet.
From Galois.Order Require Import OrderLattice.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphAuditBase.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsGraph.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAvailable AnalysesAuditSegBuilder
    AnalysesAuditSegUniverse
  AnalysesAuditSegDenseUniverse AnalysesAuditSegDenseTransfer AnalysesAuditSegDenseSystem
  AnalysesAuditSegDenseBudget.
Import List.ListNotations.

(** The one initial value captures both its universe and actual set insertions. *)
Definition audit_dense_initial {N E U B} (g : Graph.t N E) (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E
    U B) :
    FinSet.t U * list (audit_dense_fx_event N E U B) :=
  let '(universe, universe_events) := audit_dense_universe g cb in
  let '(out, set_events) := audit_finset_of_list (seg_build_expr_encode cb) universe in
  (out, [DenseFxUniverse universe_events; DenseFxTransfer [DenseTransferSet set_events]]).

(** The initial work is determined by the captured universe and insertion events. *)
Definition audit_dense_initial_work {N E U B} (weight : B -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_dense_fx_event N E U B)) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun e n => audit_dense_fx_event_work weight e + n) 0 events.

(** The input budget uses the real universe, including duplicate-free key widths. *)
Definition audit_dense_initial_budget {S O N E U C} (EU : encoding U)
    (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) (costs : audit_dense_client_budget N E U) : nat :=
  let universe := expr_universe EU gk in
  audit_dense_universe_budget EU gk + audit_dense_universe_external_budget gk costs + 512 +
    fold_right (fun u n => 16 + 16 * Pos.size_nat (encode EU u) + dense_expr_budget costs u + n)
      0 universe.

(** The counted initial set is exactly the existing finite must-lattice bottom. *)
Definition audit_dense_initial_source_statement : Prop :=
  forall (S O N E U C B : Type) (EU : encoding U) (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C)
    (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B) (weight : B -> nat) (costs :
    audit_dense_client_budget N E U)
    out_source gen_source expr_source,
    (forall n, fst (seg_build_out cb n) = Graph.out (cfg (gkview gk)) n) ->
    (forall e, fst (seg_build_gen cb e) = gen gk e) ->
    (forall u, fst (seg_build_expr_encode cb u) = encode EU u) ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_out cb) weight out_source
    (dense_out_budget costs) ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_gen cb) weight gen_source
    (dense_gen_budget costs) ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_expr_encode cb) weight expr_source
      (dense_expr_budget costs) ->
    let '(out, events) := audit_dense_initial (cfg (gkview gk)) cb in
    out = proj1_sig (bot (avail_lattice EU gk)) /\
      audit_dense_initial_work weight events <= audit_dense_initial_budget EU gk costs.
```

## Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditSegDensePortfolio

Card: AUD-SQ-MODELS

Source destination: `theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditSegDensePortfolio.v`.

```rocq
(** * Dense and sparse SEG portfolio source

    The portfolio selects one dense or expression-specific sparse producer and reuses its result.
    For example, a fixed expression can be probed at several nodes with one sparse build.
    Builds on: the dense and sparse same-solve batch source contracts. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List PArith Arith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphPrepare.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsGraph.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAvailable AnalysesAuditSsaQueryBase
    AnalysesAuditSegBuilder
  AnalysesAuditSegUniverse AnalysesAuditSegBatch AnalysesAuditSegDenseBudget
    AnalysesAuditSegDenseBatch.
Import List.ListNotations.

(** One selected dense solve or one expression-specific sparse build receives the node batch. *)
Definition audit_seg_portfolio_input_budget {S O N E U C B} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (EU : encoding U) (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B)
    (direction : audit_seg_direction) (choice : audit_seg_choice) (u : U) (nodes : list N)
    (weight : B -> nat) (costs : audit_dense_client_budget N E U) : nat :=
  match choice with
  | AuditDense => audit_dense_batch_budget EN EE EU gk cb direction weight costs
      (map (fun n => (n, u)) nodes)
  | AuditSparse => audit_seg_universe_input_budget EU gk u +
      if FinSet.mem EU u (FinSet.of_list EU (expr_universe EU gk)) then
        audit_seg_sparse_batch_input_budget EN EE EU gk direction u nodes weight
          (dense_node_budget costs) (dense_edge_budget costs) (dense_target_budget costs)
          (dense_source_budget costs)
      else 0
  end.

(** Both choices agree at the original listed graph nodes under the published readiness premise. *)
Definition audit_dense_portfolio_answers_statement : Prop :=
  forall (S O N E U C : Type) (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (EU : encoding U)
    (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) (direction : audit_seg_direction) (u : U) (nodes : list N),
    ready EN (cfg (gkview gk)) (prepare EN (cfg (gkview gk))) ->
    (forall n, In n nodes -> In n (Graph.nodes (cfg (gkview gk)))) ->
    map (audit_seg_select EN EE EU gk direction AuditDense u) nodes =
      map (audit_seg_select EN EE EU gk direction AuditSparse u) nodes.

(** The selection budget records the actual absent-expression branch without a sparse build. *)
Definition audit_dense_portfolio_budget_statement : Prop :=
  forall (S O N E U C B : Type) (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (EU : encoding U)
    (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B)
    (direction : audit_seg_direction) (u : U) (nodes : list N) (weight : B -> nat)
    (costs : audit_dense_client_budget N E U),
    audit_seg_portfolio_input_budget EN EE EU gk cb direction AuditDense u nodes weight costs =
      audit_dense_batch_budget EN EE EU gk cb direction weight costs (map (fun n => (n, u))
    nodes) /\
    audit_seg_portfolio_input_budget EN EE EU gk cb direction AuditSparse u nodes weight costs =
      audit_seg_universe_input_budget EU gk u +
      (if FinSet.mem EU u (FinSet.of_list EU (expr_universe EU gk)) then
        audit_seg_sparse_batch_input_budget EN EE EU gk direction u nodes weight
          (dense_node_budget costs) (dense_edge_budget costs) (dense_target_budget costs)
          (dense_source_budget costs)
      else 0).

(** Selecting a branch exposes that branch’s complete same-run source contract. *)
Definition audit_dense_portfolio_selected_source_statement : Prop :=
  forall choice, match choice with
  | AuditDense => audit_dense_batch_source_statement
  | AuditSparse => audit_seg_sparse_batch_adapted_statement
  end.

(** The portfolio requires both actual branch source contracts and their exact-result boundary. *)
Definition audit_dense_portfolio_contract_statement : Prop :=
  audit_dense_portfolio_selected_source_statement /\
    audit_dense_portfolio_answers_statement /\ audit_dense_portfolio_budget_statement.
```

## Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditSegDenseQuery

Card: AUD-SQ-MODELS

Source destination: `theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditSegDenseQuery.v`.

```rocq
(** * Dense SEG result probes

    A retained finite-set assignment answers node-expression queries without another solve.
    For example, a missing assignment uses the finite must-lattice bottom before membership.
    Builds on: AnalysesAuditSegDenseSystem and the shared map and set models. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List PArith Arith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet
  CollectionsAuditMap CollectionsAuditFinSet.
From Galois.Order Require Import OrderLattice OrderPowerset.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphAuditBase.
From Galois.Fixpoint Require Import FixpointSystem FixpointWorklist.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesLiveness AnalysesAvailable AnalysesAuditSegBuilder.
Import List.ListNotations.

Inductive audit_dense_probe_event (N U A B : Type) : Type :=
  | DenseProbeMap (event : audit_map_event N A B)
  | DenseProbeSet (event : audit_set_event U B)
  | DenseProbeCase.
Arguments DenseProbeMap {N U A B} _.
Arguments DenseProbeSet {N U A B} _.
Arguments DenseProbeCase {N U A B}.

(** A probe captures the node lookup and the actual finite-set membership. *)
Definition audit_dense_probe {N E U B} (EU : encoding U) (universe : list U)
    (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B) (bottom : finite_set EU universe)
    (values : assignment N (finite_set EU universe)) (n : N) (u : U) :
    bool * list (audit_dense_probe_event N U (finite_set EU universe) B) :=
  let '(found, read_events) := audit_map_get (seg_build_node_encode cb) n values in
  let fact := match found with Some value => value | None => bottom end in
  let '(result, mem_events) := audit_finset_mem (seg_build_expr_encode cb) u (proj1_sig fact) in
  (result, map DenseProbeMap read_events ++ map DenseProbeSet mem_events ++ [DenseProbeCase]).

(** The event fold charges the actual node and expression encoder bodies. *)
Definition audit_dense_probe_work {N U A B} (weight : B -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_dense_probe_event N U A B)) : nat :=
  let body := fun xs => fold_right (fun x n => weight x + n) 0 xs in
  fold_right (fun event n => n + 32 + match event with
    | DenseProbeMap e => audit_map_source_work body [e]
    | DenseProbeSet e => audit_finset_source_work body [e]
    | DenseProbeCase => 0
    end) 0 events.

(** Each query frame is bounded by the original node and expression code widths. *)
Definition audit_dense_probe_budget {N U} (EN : encoding N) (EU : encoding U) (n : N) (u : U) :
    nat :=
  256 + 5 * Pos.size_nat (encode EN n) + 5 * Pos.size_nat (encode EU u).

(** Actual encoder budgets are charged only to the corresponding captured call. *)
Definition audit_dense_probe_event_budget {N U A B} (node_budget : N -> nat) (expr_budget : U
    -> nat)
    (event : audit_dense_probe_event N U A B) : nat :=
  match event with
  | DenseProbeMap (AuditMapGet n _ _ _ _ _) | DenseProbeMap (AuditMapSet n _ _ _ _ _ _) |
    DenseProbeMap (AuditMapRemove n _ _ _ _ _) => node_budget n
  | DenseProbeSet (AuditSetAdd u _ _ _ _ _) | DenseProbeSet (AuditSetMem u _ _ _ _ _) |
    DenseProbeSet (AuditSetRemove u _ _ _ _ _) => expr_budget u
  | _ => 0
  end.

(** The captured probe has the source result and a bound using its actual input codes. *)
Definition audit_dense_probe_source_statement : Prop :=
  forall (N E U B : Type) (EN : encoding N) (EU : encoding U) (universe : list U)
    (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B) (weight : B -> nat) (bottom : finite_set EU universe)
    (values : assignment N (finite_set EU universe)) (n : N) (u : U)
    node_source expr_source node_budget expr_budget,
    (forall x, fst (seg_build_node_encode cb x) = encode EN x) ->
    (forall x, fst (seg_build_expr_encode cb x) = encode EU x) ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_node_encode cb) weight node_source
    node_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_expr_encode cb) weight expr_source
    expr_budget ->
    let '(out, events) := audit_dense_probe EU universe cb bottom values n u in
    out = fmem EU u (match Map.get EN n values with Some value => value | None => bottom end) /\
      audit_dense_probe_work weight events <= audit_dense_probe_budget EN EU n u +
        fold_right (fun event k => audit_dense_probe_event_budget node_budget expr_budget event + k)
          0 events.

(** A batch preserves query order and uses the same captured assignment at every probe. *)
Fixpoint audit_dense_probe_batch {N E U B} (EU : encoding U) (universe : list U)
    (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B) (bottom : finite_set EU universe)
    (values : assignment N (finite_set EU universe)) (queries : list (N * U)) :
    list bool * list (audit_dense_probe_event N U (finite_set EU universe) B) :=
  match queries with
  | [] => ([], [DenseProbeCase])
  | (n, u) :: rest =>
      let '(answer, events) := audit_dense_probe EU universe cb bottom values n u in
      let '(later, tail) := audit_dense_probe_batch EU universe cb bottom values rest in
      (answer :: later, DenseProbeCase :: events ++ tail)
  end.

(** The batch source budget sums original per-query operands, not solver reruns. *)
Definition audit_dense_probe_batch_budget {N U} (EN : encoding N) (EU : encoding U)
    (queries : list (N * U)) : nat :=
  32 * S (length queries) +
    fold_right (fun q n => audit_dense_probe_budget EN EU (fst q) (snd q) + n) 0 queries.

(** Batch outputs and callback work preserve all queries and their order. *)
Definition audit_dense_probe_batch_source_statement : Prop :=
  forall (N E U B : Type) (EN : encoding N) (EU : encoding U) (universe : list U)
    (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B) (weight : B -> nat) (bottom : finite_set EU universe)
    (values : assignment N (finite_set EU universe)) (queries : list (N * U))
    node_source expr_source node_budget expr_budget,
    (forall x, fst (seg_build_node_encode cb x) = encode EN x) ->
    (forall x, fst (seg_build_expr_encode cb x) = encode EU x) ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_node_encode cb) weight node_source
    node_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_expr_encode cb) weight expr_source
    expr_budget ->
    let '(out, events) := audit_dense_probe_batch EU universe cb bottom values queries in
    out = map (fun q => fmem EU (snd q)
      (match Map.get EN (fst q) values with Some value => value | None => bottom end)) queries /\
      audit_dense_probe_work weight events <= audit_dense_probe_batch_budget EN EU queries +
        fold_right (fun event k => audit_dense_probe_event_budget node_budget expr_budget event + k)
          0 events.
```

## Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditSegDenseSets

Card: AUD-SQ-MODELS

Source destination: `theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditSegDenseSets.v`.

```rocq
(** * Dense must-set source primitives

    The models retain the actual trie traversal for subset, intersection and union.
    For example, a missing value stops a subset traversal before its later branches.
    Builds on: CollectionsAuditInter and CollectionsAuditUnion. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool Arith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsTrie CollectionsFinSet
  CollectionsAuditElements CollectionsAuditInter CollectionsAuditUnion.
Import List.ListNotations.

Inductive audit_dense_subset_event (U : Type) : Type :=
  | DenseSubsetNode (node : Trie.ne (U * unit)) (other : FinSet.t U)
  | DenseSubsetValue (other : option (U * unit)).
Arguments DenseSubsetNode {U} _ _.
Arguments DenseSubsetValue {U} _.

(** Membership at the matching structural position needs no key encoding. *)
Definition audit_dense_subset_value {U} (other : option (U * unit)) :
    bool * list (audit_dense_subset_event U) :=
  (match other with Some _ => true | None => false end, [DenseSubsetValue other]).

(** This follows the source's seven trie shapes and selective later branches. *)
Fixpoint audit_dense_subset_ne {U} (node : Trie.ne (U * unit)) (other : FinSet.t U) :
    bool * list (audit_dense_subset_event U) :=
  let here := [DenseSubsetNode node other] in
  match node with
  | Trie.N001 r =>
      let '(out, events) := audit_dense_subset_ne r (Trie.right other) in (out, here ++ events)
  | Trie.N010 _ =>
      let '(out, events) := audit_dense_subset_value (Trie.value other) in (out, here ++ events)
  | Trie.N011 _ r =>
      let '(present, events) := audit_dense_subset_value (Trie.value other) in
      if present then
        let '(out, later) := audit_dense_subset_ne r (Trie.right other) in
        (out, here ++ events ++ later)
      else (false, here ++ events)
  | Trie.N100 l =>
      let '(out, events) := audit_dense_subset_ne l (Trie.left other) in (out, here ++ events)
  | Trie.N101 l r =>
      let '(present, events) := audit_dense_subset_ne l (Trie.left other) in
      if present then
        let '(out, later) := audit_dense_subset_ne r (Trie.right other) in
        (out, here ++ events ++ later)
      else (false, here ++ events)
  | Trie.N110 l _ =>
      let '(present, events) := audit_dense_subset_ne l (Trie.left other) in
      if present then
        let '(out, later) := audit_dense_subset_value (Trie.value other) in
        (out, here ++ events ++ later)
      else (false, here ++ events)
  | Trie.N111 l _ r =>
      let '(present, events) := audit_dense_subset_ne l (Trie.left other) in
      if present then
        let '(middle, middle_events) := audit_dense_subset_value (Trie.value other) in
        if middle then
          let '(out, later) := audit_dense_subset_ne r (Trie.right other) in
          (out, here ++ events ++ middle_events ++ later)
        else (false, here ++ events ++ middle_events)
      else (false, here ++ events)
  end.

(** The empty source set succeeds without visiting an operand node. *)
Definition audit_dense_subset {U} (left right : FinSet.t U) :
    bool * list (audit_dense_subset_event U) :=
  match left with
  | Trie.Empty => (true, [])
  | Trie.Nodes node => audit_dense_subset_ne node right
  end.

(** Every visited subset frame pays a fixed source-block charge. *)
Definition audit_dense_subset_work {U} (events : list (audit_dense_subset_event U)) : nat :=
  1 + 16 * length events.

(** Input nodes bound the source subset traversal independently of its output trace. *)
Definition audit_dense_subset_budget {U} (left : FinSet.t U) : nat :=
  1 + 32 * audit_trie_nodes left.

(** The captured subset result is the actual finite-set inclusion result. *)
Definition audit_dense_subset_statement : Prop :=
  forall (U : Type) (EU : encoding U) (left right : FinSet.t U),
    let '(out, events) := audit_dense_subset left right in
    out = FinSet.subset EU left right /\
      audit_dense_subset_work events <= audit_dense_subset_budget left.

(** Intersection and union retain the actual one-sided trie traversals. *)
Definition audit_dense_inter {U} (left right : FinSet.t U) := audit_finset_inter left right.
Definition audit_dense_union {U} (left right : FinSet.t U) := audit_finset_union left right.

(** The two lattice merge operations erase to the library's exact sets and input-node bounds. *)
Definition audit_dense_merge_statement : Prop :=
  forall (U : Type) (EU : encoding U) (left right : FinSet.t U),
    let '(intersection, inter_events) := audit_dense_inter left right in
    let '(union, union_events) := audit_dense_union left right in
    intersection = FinSet.inter EU left right /\ union = FinSet.union EU left right /\
      audit_finset_inter_source_work inter_events <= 64 * (1 + audit_trie_nodes left +
        audit_trie_nodes right) /\
      audit_finset_union_source_work union_events <= 64 * (1 + audit_trie_nodes left).
```

```rocq
Definition audit_dense_solution {S O N E U C} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (EU : encoding U)

  | AuditBusy => audit_dense_busy EN EE EU gk
  end.

(** The solver bound uses original inputs, finite height and the actual generated index. *)

    (EU : encoding U) (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B)

    static index_budget +
    fx_declared_run_input_budget EN (dense_constraint_encoding EN EE) lattice
      (rpo_scheduler EN sys static) Joining sys static ix fuel.

  forall (S O N E U C B : Type) (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (EU : encoding U)
    (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B)

    kill_source,

    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_edge_encode cb) weight edge_source
      (dense_edge_budget costs) ->

    (dense_out_budget costs) ->

      (dense_target_budget costs) ->

      (dense_source_budget costs) ->

    (dense_gen_budget costs) ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_kill cb) weight kill_source
    (dense_kill_budget costs) ->
    let sys := audit_dense_fx_system EU gk direction in
    let static := audit_dense_fx_static EU gk direction in
    let lattice := avail_lattice EU gk in
    let height := base_height (finite_must_height EU (expr_universe EU gk)
    (audit_universe_nodup EU gk)) in
    let index_cb := audit_dense_index_model cb direction in
    let index_source := audit_dense_index_source cb direction in
    let index_budget := audit_dense_fx_index_budget (U := U) EN EE weight (dense_node_budget costs)

        fx_declared_body_work (fx_body_weight budget) engine_bodies <=

        fold_right (fun e n => audit_seg_universe_event_budget (dense_out_budget costs)
```

```rocq
(** * Dense SEG system and index callbacks

Import List.ListNotations.

(** The selected system is exactly the existing forward or backward dense system. *)
Definition audit_dense_fx_system {S O N E U C} (EU : encoding U) (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C)
    (direction : audit_seg_direction) : System.t N (dense_constraint N E) (avail_set EU gk) :=
  match direction with
  | AuditAvailable => available_system EU gk
  | AuditBusy => busy_system EU gk
  end.

(** The selected static dictionary is the source system's actual dictionary. *)
Definition audit_dense_fx_static {S O N E U C} (EU : encoding U) (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C)
    (direction : audit_seg_direction) : System.static (audit_dense_fx_system EU gk direction) :=
  match direction with
  | AuditAvailable => forward_static _ _ _
  | AuditBusy => backward_static _ _ _
  end.

Inductive audit_dense_fx_event (N E U B : Type) : Type :=
  | DenseFxNodeEncode (node : N) (code : positive) (body : list B)
  | DenseFxEdgeEncode (edge : E) (code : positive) (body : list B)
  | DenseFxOut (node : N) (edges : list E) (body : list B)
  | DenseFxTarget (edge : E) (node : N) (body : list B)
  | DenseFxSource (edge : E) (node : N) (body : list B)
  | DenseFxUniverse (events : list (audit_seg_universe_event N E U B))
  | DenseFxTransfer (events : list (audit_dense_transfer_event N E U B))
  | DenseFxSubset (events : list (audit_dense_subset_event U))
  | DenseFxInter (events : list (audit_inter_event U))
  | DenseFxNodeMap (event : audit_map_event N positive B)
  | DenseFxNodeSet (event : audit_set_event N B)
  | DenseFxCase (site : nat).
Arguments DenseFxNodeEncode {N E U B} _ _ _.
Arguments DenseFxEdgeEncode {N E U B} _ _ _.
Arguments DenseFxOut {N E U B} _ _ _.
Arguments DenseFxTarget {N E U B} _ _ _.
Arguments DenseFxSource {N E U B} _ _ _.
Arguments DenseFxUniverse {N E U B} _.
Arguments DenseFxTransfer {N E U B} _.
Arguments DenseFxSubset {N E U B} _.
Arguments DenseFxInter {N E U B} _.
Arguments DenseFxNodeMap {N E U B} _.
Arguments DenseFxNodeSet {N E U B} _.
Arguments DenseFxCase {N E U B} _.

(** Seed and flow codes invoke their actual node and edge encoders, respectively. *)
Definition audit_dense_constraint_encode {N E U B} (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B)
    (c : dense_constraint N E) : positive * list (audit_dense_fx_event N E U B) :=
  match c with
  | Seed n => let '(code, body) := seg_build_node_encode cb n in
      (xO code, [DenseFxNodeEncode n code body])
  | Flow e => let '(code, body) := seg_build_edge_encode cb e in
      (xI code, [DenseFxEdgeEncode e code body])
  end.

(** The source node encoding carries its actual client body. *)
Definition audit_dense_node_encode {N E U B} (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B) (n : N) :
    positive * list (audit_dense_fx_event N E U B) :=
  let '(code, body) := seg_build_node_encode cb n in (code, [DenseFxNodeEncode n code body]).

(** Direction selects the actual endpoint invoked by a flow target. *)
Definition audit_dense_target {N E U B} (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B)
    (direction : audit_seg_direction) (c : dense_constraint N E) :
    N * list (audit_dense_fx_event N E U B) :=
  match c with
  | Seed n => (n, [DenseFxCase 0])
  | Flow e => match direction with
      | AuditAvailable => let '(n, body) := seg_build_target cb e in (n, [DenseFxTarget e n body])
      | AuditBusy => let '(n, body) := seg_build_source cb e in (n, [DenseFxSource e n body])
      end
  end.

(** Flow dependencies invoke the opposite graph endpoint; seed dependencies are empty. *)
Definition audit_dense_deps {N E U B} (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B)
    (direction : audit_seg_direction) (c : dense_constraint N E) :
    list N * list (audit_dense_fx_event N E U B) :=
  match c with
  | Seed _ => ([], [DenseFxCase 1])
  | Flow e => match direction with
      | AuditAvailable => let '(n, body) := seg_build_source cb e in ([n], [DenseFxSource e n body])
      | AuditBusy => let '(n, body) := seg_build_target cb e in ([n], [DenseFxTarget e n body])
      end
  end.

(** The index source model uses the actual dense target and dependency bodies. *)
Definition audit_dense_index_model {N E U B} (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B)
    (direction : audit_seg_direction) :
    fx_index_external_model N (dense_constraint N E) (audit_dense_fx_event N E U B) :=
  FxIndexExternalModel _ _ _ (audit_dense_node_encode cb) (audit_dense_target cb direction)
    (fun _ => ([], [DenseFxCase 2])) (audit_dense_deps cb direction).

(** Each index callback relation identifies its same-call captured concrete body. *)
Definition audit_dense_index_source {N E U B} (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B)
    (direction : audit_seg_direction) :
    fx_index_external_source N (dense_constraint N E) (audit_dense_fx_event N E U B) :=
  FxIndexExternalSource _ _ _
    (fun n out body => audit_dense_node_encode cb n = (out, body))
    (fun c out body => audit_dense_target cb direction c = (out, body))
    (fun _ out body => out = [] /\ body = [DenseFxCase 2])
    (fun c out body => audit_dense_deps cb direction c = (out, body)).

(** System constraints enumerate outgoing edges once and retain actual source callbacks. *)
Definition audit_dense_constraints {N E U B} (g : Graph.t N E)
    (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B) (direction : audit_seg_direction) :
    list (dense_constraint N E) * list (audit_seg_universe_event N E U B) :=
  let seeds := match direction with AuditAvailable => Graph.entries g | AuditBusy =>
    Graph.nodes g end in
  let seed_rows := map Seed seeds in
  let '(edges, events) := audit_seg_universe_edges cb (Graph.nodes g) in
  let flow_rows := map Flow edges in
  (seed_rows ++ flow_rows,
    SegUniverseAppend (length seeds) :: events ++
      [SegUniverseAppend (length edges); SegUniverseAppend (length seeds)]).

(** The constraint budget includes entries even when they are absent from the node list. *)
Definition audit_dense_constraints_budget {N E} (g : Graph.t N E) : nat :=
  65536 * Nat.pow (S (length (Graph.nodes g) + length (Graph.entries g) +
    length (edges_of g))) 8.

(** The generated constraint list preserves original entries, nodes and edge occurrences. *)
Definition audit_dense_constraints_source_statement : Prop :=
  forall (S O N E U C B : Type) (EU : encoding U) (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C)
    (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B) (weight : B -> nat) direction out_source out_budget,
    (forall n, fst (seg_build_out cb n) = Graph.out (cfg (gkview gk)) n) ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_out cb) weight out_source out_budget ->
    let g := cfg (gkview gk) in
    let '(out, events) := audit_dense_constraints g cb direction in
    out = System.constraints (audit_dense_fx_system EU gk direction) /\
      audit_seg_universe_work weight events <= audit_dense_constraints_budget g +
        fold_right (fun e n => audit_seg_universe_event_budget out_budget (fun _ => 0)
          (fun _ => 0) e + n) 0 events.

(** Source work includes nested transfer, finite-set, scheduler and actual client bodies. *)
Definition audit_dense_fx_event_work {N E U B} (weight : B -> nat)
    (event : audit_dense_fx_event N E U B) : nat :=
  let body := fun xs => fold_right (fun x n => weight x + n) 0 xs in
  64 + match event with
  | DenseFxNodeEncode _ _ xs | DenseFxEdgeEncode _ _ xs | DenseFxOut _ _ xs |
    DenseFxTarget _ _ xs | DenseFxSource _ _ xs => body xs
  | DenseFxUniverse events => audit_seg_universe_work weight events
  | DenseFxTransfer events => audit_dense_transfer_work weight events
  | DenseFxSubset events => audit_dense_subset_work events
  | DenseFxInter events => audit_finset_inter_source_work events
  | DenseFxNodeMap e => audit_map_source_work body [e]
  | DenseFxNodeSet e => audit_finset_source_work body [e]
  | DenseFxCase _ => 0
  end.

(** The generated index uses per-node and per-edge bounds on its concrete callbacks. *)
Definition audit_dense_fx_index_budget {N E U B} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (weight : B -> nat) (node_budget : N -> nat)
    (edge_budget target_budget source_budget : E -> nat) :
    fx_index_external_budget N (dense_constraint N E) (audit_dense_fx_event N E U B) :=
  FxIndexExternalBudget _ _ _ (audit_dense_fx_event_work weight)
    (fun n => 256 + node_budget n + 16 * Pos.size_nat (encode EN n))
    (fun c => match c with Seed _ => 256 | Flow e =>
      256 + target_budget e + source_budget e end)
    (fun _ => 256)
    (fun c => match c with Seed _ => 256 | Flow e => 256 + target_budget e + source_budget e end).

(** The generated index dictionary erases and is bounded by actual endpoint client bodies. *)
Definition audit_dense_fx_index_statement : Prop :=
  forall (S O N E U C B : Type) (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (EU : encoding U)
    (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B)
    (direction : audit_seg_direction) (weight : B -> nat)
    node_source edge_source target_source source_source node_budget edge_budget target_budget
    source_budget,
    (forall n, fst (seg_build_node_encode cb n) = encode EN n) ->
    (forall e, fst (seg_build_edge_encode cb e) = encode EE e) ->
    (forall e, fst (seg_build_target cb e) = Graph.target (cfg (gkview gk)) e) ->
    (forall e, fst (seg_build_source cb e) = Graph.source (cfg (gkview gk)) e) ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_node_encode cb) weight node_source
    node_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_edge_encode cb) weight edge_source
    edge_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_target cb) weight target_source
    target_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_source cb) weight source_source
    source_budget ->
    let sys := audit_dense_fx_system EU gk direction in
    let static := audit_dense_fx_static EU gk direction in
    let model := audit_dense_index_model cb direction in
    let budget := audit_dense_fx_index_budget EN EE weight node_budget edge_budget
      target_budget source_budget in
    fx_index_external_erases EN sys static model /\ fx_index_external_bounded model budget /\
      fx_dep_source_laws model (audit_dense_index_source cb direction).
```

## Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditSegDenseTransfer

```rocq
(** * Dense expression transfer and clamp

    Each transfer captures the current facts, kill and generation calls and fresh universe build.
    For example, a killed expression is removed before generation is unioned and clamped.
    Builds on: AnalysesAuditSegDenseUniverse and the collection set models. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool PArith Arith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsFinSet CollectionsAuditFinSet
  CollectionsAuditElements CollectionsAuditUnion.
From Galois.Order Require Import OrderPowerset.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphAuditBase.

Inductive audit_dense_transfer_event (N E U B : Type) : Type :=
  | DenseTransferUniverse (events : list (audit_seg_universe_event N E U B))
  | DenseTransferElements (events : list (audit_elements_event (U * unit)))
  | DenseTransferSet (events : list (audit_set_event U B))
  | DenseTransferUnion (events : list (audit_union_event U))

  | DenseTransferKill (edge : E) (item : U) (out : bool) (body : list B)
  | DenseTransferCase (site : nat).
Arguments DenseTransferUniverse {N E U B} _.
Arguments DenseTransferElements {N E U B} _.
Arguments DenseTransferSet {N E U B} _.
Arguments DenseTransferUnion {N E U B} _.
Arguments DenseTransferGen {N E U B} _ _ _.
Arguments DenseTransferKill {N E U B} _ _ _ _.
Arguments DenseTransferCase {N E U B} _.

(** Filter retains every actual kill callback, including duplicates and later elements. *)
Fixpoint audit_dense_survivors {N E U B} (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B)
    (edge : E) (items : list U) : list U * list (audit_dense_transfer_event N E U B) :=
  match items with
  | [] => ([], [DenseTransferCase 0])
  | u :: rest =>
      let '(killed, body) := seg_build_kill cb (edge, u) in
      let '(later, events) := audit_dense_survivors cb edge rest in
      (if killed then later else u :: later, DenseTransferKill edge u killed body :: events)
  end.

(** Clamp's membership filter evaluates the entire supplied universe. *)
Fixpoint audit_dense_clamp_filter {N E U B} (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B)
    (set : FinSet.t U) (universe : list U) : list U * list (audit_dense_transfer_event N E U B) :=
  match universe with
  | [] => ([], [DenseTransferCase 1])
  | u :: rest =>
      let '(present, calls) := audit_finset_mem (seg_build_expr_encode cb) u set in
      let '(later, events) := audit_dense_clamp_filter cb set rest in
      (if present then u :: later else later, DenseTransferSet calls :: events)
  end.

(** Clamp rebuilds a finite set using the same filtered sequence. *)
Definition audit_dense_clamp {N E U B} (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B)
    (universe : list U) (set : FinSet.t U) :
    FinSet.t U * list (audit_dense_transfer_event N E U B) :=
  let '(selected, filter_events) := audit_dense_clamp_filter cb set universe in
  let '(out, set_events) := audit_finset_of_list (seg_build_expr_encode cb) selected in
  (out, filter_events ++ [DenseTransferSet set_events]).

(** One transfer uses its actual input set and captures a fresh expression-universe build. *)
Definition audit_dense_transfer {N E U B} (g : Graph.t N E)
    (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B) (edge : E) (input : FinSet.t U) :
    FinSet.t U * list (audit_dense_transfer_event N E U B) :=
  let '(universe, universe_events) := audit_dense_universe g cb in
  let '(rows, elements) := audit_map_elements input in
  let '(survivors, kills) := audit_dense_survivors cb edge (map fst rows) in
  let '(kept, kept_events) := audit_finset_of_list (seg_build_expr_encode cb) survivors in
  let '(generated, gen_body) := seg_build_gen cb edge in
  let '(gen_set, gen_events) := audit_finset_of_list (seg_build_expr_encode cb) generated in
  let '(merged, union_events) := audit_finset_union kept gen_set in
  let '(out, clamp_events) := audit_dense_clamp cb universe merged in
  (out, [DenseTransferUniverse universe_events; DenseTransferElements elements;
    DenseTransferCase (length rows)] ++ kills ++
    [DenseTransferSet kept_events; DenseTransferGen edge generated gen_body;
     DenseTransferSet gen_events; DenseTransferUnion union_events] ++ clamp_events).

(** Each retained frame and genuine client callback contributes its actual body work. *)
Definition audit_dense_transfer_event_work {N E U B} (weight : B -> nat)
    (event : audit_dense_transfer_event N E U B) : nat :=
  let body := fun xs => fold_right (fun x n => weight x + n) 0 xs in
  64 + match event with
  | DenseTransferUniverse events => audit_seg_universe_work weight events
  | DenseTransferElements events => fold_right (fun e n => audit_elements_frame_work e + n) 0 events
  | DenseTransferSet events => audit_finset_source_work body events
  | DenseTransferUnion events => audit_finset_union_source_work events
  | DenseTransferGen _ _ events | DenseTransferKill _ _ _ events => body events
  | DenseTransferCase site => site
  end.

(** Work is folded over the same transfer's captured event list. *)
Definition audit_dense_transfer_work {N E U B} (weight : B -> nat)
    (events : list (audit_dense_transfer_event N E U B)) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun event n => audit_dense_transfer_event_work weight event + n) 0 events.

(** Source bounds inspect original graph, edge, input-set nodes and actual generated key widths. *)
Definition audit_dense_transfer_budget {S O N E U C} (EU : encoding U)
    (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) (edge : E) (input : FinSet.t U) : nat :=
  let universe := expr_universe EU gk in
  let keys := FinSet.elements input ++ gen gk edge ++ universe in
  let bits := fold_right (fun u n => Pos.size_nat (encode EU u) + n) 0 keys in
  65536 * Nat.pow (Nat.succ (audit_trie_nodes input + length keys + bits)) 8 +
    audit_dense_universe_budget EU gk.

(** External callback budgets follow each actual occurrence and selected set operation. *)
Definition audit_dense_transfer_event_budget {N E U B} (out_budget : N -> nat)
    (gen_budget : E -> nat) (expr_budget : U -> nat) (kill_budget : E * U -> nat)
    (event : audit_dense_transfer_event N E U B) : nat :=
  match event with
  | DenseTransferUniverse events => fold_right (fun e n =>
      audit_seg_universe_event_budget out_budget gen_budget expr_budget e + n) 0 events
  | DenseTransferSet events => fold_right (fun e n => n + match e with
      | AuditSetAdd u _ _ _ _ _ | AuditSetMem u _ _ _ _ _ |
        AuditSetRemove u _ _ _ _ _ => expr_budget u
      | AuditSetFold _ _ => 0
      end) 0 events
  | DenseTransferGen e _ _ => gen_budget e
  | DenseTransferKill e u _ _ => kill_budget (e, u)
  | _ => 0
  end.

(** A transfer witness erases to the actual clamped set and includes all callback body costs. *)
Definition audit_dense_transfer_source_statement : Prop :=
  forall (S O N E U C B : Type) (EU : encoding U) (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C)
    (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B) (weight : B -> nat) (edge : E)
    (input : avail_set EU gk) out_source gen_source expr_source kill_source
    out_budget gen_budget expr_budget kill_budget,
    (forall n, fst (seg_build_out cb n) = Graph.out (cfg (gkview gk)) n) ->
    (forall e, fst (seg_build_gen cb e) = gen gk e) ->
    (forall e u, fst (seg_build_kill cb (e, u)) = kill gk e u) ->
    (forall u, fst (seg_build_expr_encode cb u) = encode EU u) ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_out cb) weight out_source out_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_gen cb) weight gen_source gen_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_expr_encode cb) weight expr_source
    expr_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_kill cb) weight kill_source kill_budget ->
    let '(out, events) := audit_dense_transfer (cfg (gkview gk)) cb edge (proj1_sig input) in
    out = proj1_sig (avail_transfer EU gk edge input) /\
      audit_dense_transfer_work weight events <= audit_dense_transfer_budget EU gk edge
    (proj1_sig input) +
        fold_right (fun event n => audit_dense_transfer_event_budget out_budget gen_budget
    expr_budget
          kill_budget event + n) 0 events.

(** Clamp charges each original universe occurrence and the input trie shape. *)
Definition audit_dense_clamp_budget {U} (EU : encoding U) (universe : list U)
    (set : FinSet.t U) : nat :=
  let bits := fold_right (fun u n => Pos.size_nat (encode EU u) + n) 0 universe in
  4096 * Nat.pow (S (audit_trie_nodes set + length universe + bits)) 4.

(** Clamp supplies the exact finite-set payload and its same-run source allowance. *)
Definition audit_dense_clamp_source_statement : Prop :=
  forall (N E U B : Type) (EU : encoding U) (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B)
    (weight : B -> nat) (universe : list U) (set : FinSet.t U) expr_source expr_budget,
    (forall u, fst (seg_build_expr_encode cb u) = encode EU u) ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_expr_encode cb) weight expr_source
    expr_budget ->
    let '(out, events) := audit_dense_clamp cb universe set in
    out = proj1_sig (finite_clamp EU universe set) /\
      audit_dense_transfer_work weight events <= audit_dense_clamp_budget EU universe set +
        fold_right (fun event n => audit_dense_transfer_event_budget (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0)
          expr_budget (fun _ => 0) event + n) 0 events.
```

```rocq
(** * Dense expression-universe source

    This model captures edge enumeration, generation, set construction and set enumeration.
    For example, duplicate generated expressions retain separate insertion receipts.
    Builds on: AnalysesAuditSegUniverse and the shared collection source models. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List PArith Arith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsFinSet CollectionsAuditFinSet
  CollectionsAuditElements.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphAuditBase.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsGraph.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAvailable AnalysesAuditSegBuilder
    AnalysesAuditSegUniverse.
Import List.ListNotations.

(** The returned list and events are from one actual universe construction. *)
Definition audit_dense_universe {N E U B} (g : Graph.t N E)
    (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B) : list U * list (audit_seg_universe_event N E U B) :=
  let '(edges, edge_events) := audit_seg_universe_edges cb (Graph.nodes g) in
  let '(values, gen_events) := audit_seg_universe_gen cb edges in
  let '(set, set_events) := audit_finset_of_list (seg_build_expr_encode cb) values in
  let '(rows, element_events) := audit_map_elements set in
  (map fst rows, edge_events ++ gen_events ++ map SegUniverseSet set_events ++
    map SegUniverseElements element_events ++ [SegUniverseAppend (length rows)]).

(** The original-input budget covers traversal and encoded output widths. *)
Definition audit_dense_universe_budget {S O N E U C} (EU : encoding U)
    (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) : nat :=
  let g := cfg (gkview gk) in
  let edges := edges_of g in
  let values := flat_map (gen gk) edges in
  let width := fold_right (fun x total => Pos.size_nat (encode EU x) + total) 0 values in
  65536 * Nat.pow (Nat.succ (length (Graph.nodes g) + length edges + length values + width)) 8.

(** A captured universe has the source result and an input-derived bound plus actual callbacks. *)
Definition audit_dense_universe_source_statement : Prop :=
  forall (S O N E U C B : Type) (EU : encoding U) (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C)
    (cb : audit_seg_build_callbacks N E U B) (weight : B -> nat)
    out_source gen_source expr_source out_budget gen_budget expr_budget,
    (forall n, fst (seg_build_out cb n) = Graph.out (cfg (gkview gk)) n) ->
    (forall e, fst (seg_build_gen cb e) = gen gk e) ->
    (forall x, fst (seg_build_expr_encode cb x) = encode EU x) ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_out cb) weight out_source out_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_gen cb) weight gen_source gen_budget ->
    audit_graph_external_callback_adapter (seg_build_expr_encode cb) weight expr_source
    expr_budget ->
    let '(out, events) := audit_dense_universe (cfg (gkview gk)) cb in
    out = expr_universe EU gk /\
      audit_seg_universe_work weight events <= audit_dense_universe_budget EU gk +
        fold_right (fun event n => audit_seg_universe_event_budget out_budget gen_budget
          expr_budget event + n) 0 events.
```

```rocq
Inductive audit_sq_values_call (N E V : Type) : Type :=

Fixpoint audit_sq_flat_uses {N E V} (p : point_uses N E V) (edges : list E)
    : list V * list (audit_sq_values_call N E V) :=
  match edges with

Definition audit_sq_point_uses {N E V} (p : point_uses N E V) (n : N)

Fixpoint audit_sq_add_uses {N E V} (EN : encoding N) (EV : encoding V) (n : N)

Fixpoint audit_sq_defs_counted {N E V A} (EV : encoding V) (home : V -> option N)

Definition audit_sq_values_counted {B BE N E V} (EN : encoding N) (EV : encoding V)

Fixpoint audit_sq_r_edges_counted {N E} (EN : encoding N) (g : Graph.t N E)
```
