```rocq
  | [] => (initial, [AuditSqReducedCase 0])
  | edge :: rest => let '(middle, later) := audit_sq_r_edges_counted EN g r index rest initial in
      let '(back, here) := audit_sq_back_counted EN g r edge in
      if back then (middle, AuditSqReducedCase 1 :: later ++ here ++ [AuditSqReducedCase 2])
      else let target := Graph.target g edge in let found := Map.get EN target index in
        let reachable := match found with Some s => s | None => FinSet.empty end in
        let result := FinSet.union EN reachable middle in
        (result, AuditSqReducedCase 1 :: later ++ here ++ [AuditSqReducedCase 3;
          AuditSqReducedTarget edge target; AuditSqReducedGet target index found;
          AuditSqReducedUnion reachable middle result])
  end.

Fixpoint audit_sq_r_rows_counted {N E} {EN : encoding N} {g : Graph.t N E}
    (p : prepared EN g) (r : dfs_result N E) (order : list N)
    : Map.t N (FinSet.t N) * list (audit_sq_reduced_call N E) :=
  match order with
  | [] => (Map.empty, [AuditSqReducedCase 4])
  | n :: rest => let '(middle, later) := audit_sq_r_rows_counted p r rest in
      let initial := FinSet.add EN n FinSet.empty in
      let found := Map.get EN n (out_index p) in let edges := match found with Some es => es | None
  => [] end in
      let '(row, here) := audit_sq_r_edges_counted EN g r middle edges initial in
      (Map.set EN n row middle, AuditSqReducedCase 5 :: later ++
        [AuditSqReducedAdd n FinSet.empty; AuditSqReducedOut n (out_index p) found] ++ here ++
        [AuditSqReducedSet n row middle])
  end.

Definition audit_sq_reduced_event_work {N E} (EN : encoding N) (event : audit_sq_reduced_call N E) :
  nat :=
  64 + match event with
  | AuditSqReducedDom item => audit_frontier_dom_event_work EN item
  | AuditSqReducedOut n _ _ | AuditSqReducedGet n _ _ =>
      audit_encoding_weight (audit_key_bits_weight (encode EN n)) + audit_get_weight (encode EN n)
  | AuditSqReducedAdd n _ | AuditSqReducedSet n _ _ =>
      audit_encoding_weight (audit_key_bits_weight (encode EN n)) + audit_set_weight (encode EN n)
  | AuditSqReducedUnion lhs rhs _ => let size := audit_erase_nodes lhs + audit_erase_nodes rhs in
      64 * S size * S size
  | _ => 0 end.

Definition audit_sq_reduced_work {N E} (EN : encoding N) (events : list (audit_sq_reduced_call N E))
  : nat :=
  512 * S (length events) * S (length events) +
    fold_right (fun event total => audit_sq_reduced_event_work EN event + total) 0 events.

Definition audit_sq_reduced_input_edges {N E} {EN : encoding N} {g : Graph.t N E}
    (p : prepared EN g) (order : list N) : list E := flat_map (succ_edges p) order.

Definition audit_sq_reduced_width {N E} (EN : encoding N) (g : Graph.t N E)
    (p : prepared EN g) (r : dfs_result N E) (order : list N) : nat :=
  let edges := audit_sq_reduced_input_edges p order in
  let vertices := order ++ map (Graph.target g) edges ++ map (Graph.source g) edges ++
    map fst (Map.elements (pre_num r)) ++ map fst (Map.elements (post_num r)) in
  let numbers := map snd (Map.elements (pre_num r)) ++ map snd (Map.elements (post_num r)) in
  Nat.max (fold_right Nat.max 0 (map (fun v => audit_key_bits_weight (encode EN v)) vertices))
    (fold_right Nat.max 0 (map audit_key_bits_weight numbers)).

Definition audit_sq_reduced_event_bound {N E} {EN : encoding N} {g : Graph.t N E}
    (p : prepared EN g) (order : list N) : nat :=
  32 * S (length order + length (audit_sq_reduced_input_edges p order)).

Definition audit_sq_reduced_budget {N E} (EN : encoding N) (g : Graph.t N E)
    (p : prepared EN g) (r : dfs_result N E) (order : list N) : nat :=
  let count := audit_sq_reduced_event_bound p order in let width := audit_sq_reduced_width EN g p r
  order in
  4096 * Nat.pow (S count) 4 * Nat.pow (S width) 2.

Definition audit_sq_reduced_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E (EN : encoding N) (g : Graph.t N E) (p : prepared EN g) (r : dfs_result N E) order,
    let '(result, events) := audit_sq_r_rows_counted p r order in
    result = AnalysesSsaLiveQuery.live_r_build EN (Graph.target g) (succ_edges p)
      (fun e => ancestor_b EN r (Graph.target g e) (Graph.source g e)) order /\
    length events <= audit_sq_reduced_event_bound p order /\
    audit_sq_reduced_work EN events <= audit_sq_reduced_budget EN g p r order.

Inductive audit_sq_t_call (N E : Type) : Type :=
| AuditSqTCase (site : nat)
| AuditSqTReduced (event : audit_sq_reduced_call N E)
| AuditSqTGet (v : N) (m : Map.t N (FinSet.t N)) (result : option (FinSet.t N))
| AuditSqTOut (v : N) (m : Map.t N (list E)) (result : option (list E))
| AuditSqTElements (set : FinSet.t N) (result : list N)
| AuditSqTTarget (e : E) (v : N)
| AuditSqTMember (v : N) (set : FinSet.t N) (result : bool)
| AuditSqTAdd (v : N) (set : FinSet.t N)
| AuditSqTSet (v : N) (row : list (N * N)) (m : Map.t N (list (N * N)))
| AuditSqTOutput (size : nat).
Arguments AuditSqTCase {N E} _.
Arguments AuditSqTReduced {N E} _.
Arguments AuditSqTGet {N E} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditSqTOut {N E} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditSqTElements {N E} _ _.
Arguments AuditSqTTarget {N E} _ _.
Arguments AuditSqTMember {N E} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditSqTAdd {N E} _ _.
Arguments AuditSqTSet {N E} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditSqTOutput {N E} _.

Fixpoint audit_sq_t_filter {N E} (EN : encoding N) (g : Graph.t N E) (r : dfs_result N E)
    (reduced : FinSet.t N) (edges : list E) : list E * list (audit_sq_t_call N E) :=
  match edges with
  | [] => ([], [AuditSqTCase 0])
  | e :: rest => let '(back, back_events) := audit_sq_back_counted EN g r e in
      let target := Graph.target g e in let member := FinSet.mem EN target reduced in
      let keep := back && negb member in let '(later, events) := audit_sq_t_filter EN g r reduced
  rest in
      (if keep then e :: later else later, AuditSqTCase 1 :: map AuditSqTReduced back_events ++
        [AuditSqTTarget e target; AuditSqTMember target reduced member; AuditSqTCase (if keep then 2
  else 3)] ++ events)
  end.

Fixpoint audit_sq_t_targets {N E} (g : Graph.t N E) (edges : list E) : list N * list
  (audit_sq_t_call N E) :=
  match edges with
  | [] => ([], [AuditSqTCase 4])
  | e :: rest => let target := Graph.target g e in let '(later, events) := audit_sq_t_targets g rest
  in
      (target :: later, AuditSqTCase 5 :: AuditSqTTarget e target :: events)
  end.

Fixpoint audit_sq_t_vertices {N E} {EN : encoding N} {g : Graph.t N E}
    (p : prepared EN g) (r : dfs_result N E) (reduced : FinSet.t N) (vertices : list N)
    : list N * list (audit_sq_t_call N E) :=
  match vertices with
  | [] => ([], [AuditSqTCase 6])
  | v :: rest => let found := Map.get EN v (out_index p) in
      let edges := match found with Some xs => xs | None => [] end in
      let '(filtered, filter_events) := audit_sq_t_filter EN g r reduced edges in
      let '(targets, target_events) := audit_sq_t_targets g filtered in
      let '(later, events) := audit_sq_t_vertices p r reduced rest in
      (targets ++ later, AuditSqTCase 7 :: AuditSqTOut v (out_index p) found ::
        filter_events ++ target_events ++ events ++ [AuditSqTOutput (length targets)])
  end.

Fixpoint audit_sq_t_set_counted {N E} (EN : encoding N) (vertices : list N) (set : FinSet.t N)
    : FinSet.t N * list (audit_sq_t_call N E) :=
  match vertices with
  | [] => (set, [AuditSqTCase 8])
  | v :: rest => let next := FinSet.add EN v set in
      let '(result, events) := audit_sq_t_set_counted EN rest next in
      (result, AuditSqTCase 9 :: AuditSqTAdd v set :: events)
  end.

Definition audit_sq_t_edges_counted {N E} {EN : encoding N} {g : Graph.t N E}
    (p : prepared EN g) (r : dfs_result N E) (rm : Map.t N (FinSet.t N)) (n : N)
    : FinSet.t N * list (audit_sq_t_call N E) :=
  let found := Map.get EN n rm in let reduced := match found with Some s => s | None => FinSet.empty
  end in
  let vertices := FinSet.elements reduced in
  let '(targets, target_events) := audit_sq_t_vertices p r reduced vertices in
  let '(result, set_events) := audit_sq_t_set_counted EN targets FinSet.empty in
  (result, [AuditSqTGet n rm found; AuditSqTElements reduced vertices] ++ target_events ++
  set_events).

Fixpoint audit_sq_t_rows_counted {N E} {EN : encoding N} {g : Graph.t N E}
    (p : prepared EN g) (r : dfs_result N E) (rm : Map.t N (FinSet.t N)) (nodes : list N)
    : Map.t N (list (N * N)) * list (audit_sq_t_call N E) :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => (Map.empty, [AuditSqTCase 10])
  | n :: rest => let '(middle, later) := audit_sq_t_rows_counted p r rm rest in
      let '(edges, edge_events) := audit_sq_t_edges_counted p r rm n in
      let vertices := FinSet.elements edges in let row := map (fun v => (n, v)) vertices in
      (Map.set EN n row middle, AuditSqTCase 11 :: later ++ edge_events ++
        [AuditSqTElements edges vertices; AuditSqTOutput (length vertices); AuditSqTSet n row
  middle])
  end.

Definition audit_sq_t_graph_with_rows {N E} {EN : encoding N} {g : Graph.t N E}
    (p : prepared EN g) (r : dfs_result N E) (rm : Map.t N (FinSet.t N)) (nodes : list N)
    : Graph.t N (N * N) * (Map.t N (list (N * N)) * list (audit_sq_t_call N E)) :=
  let '(rows, events) := audit_sq_t_rows_counted p r rm nodes in
  (Graph.Make [] nodes (fun n => match Map.get EN n rows with Some es => es | None => [] end) fst
  snd, (rows, events)).

Definition audit_sq_t_graph_counted {N E} {EN : encoding N} {g : Graph.t N E}
    (p : prepared EN g) (r : dfs_result N E) (rm : Map.t N (FinSet.t N)) (nodes : list N)
    : Graph.t N (N * N) * list (audit_sq_t_call N E) :=
  let '(graph, (_, events)) := audit_sq_t_graph_with_rows p r rm nodes in (graph, events).

Definition audit_sq_t_event_work {N E} (EN : encoding N) (event : audit_sq_t_call N E) : nat :=
  64 + match event with
  | AuditSqTReduced item => audit_sq_reduced_event_work EN item
  | AuditSqTGet v _ _ | AuditSqTOut v _ _ | AuditSqTMember v _ _ =>
      audit_encoding_weight (audit_key_bits_weight (encode EN v)) + audit_get_weight (encode EN v)
  | AuditSqTAdd v _ | AuditSqTSet v _ _ =>
      audit_encoding_weight (audit_key_bits_weight (encode EN v)) + audit_set_weight (encode EN v)
  | AuditSqTElements set _ => 64 * Nat.pow (S (audit_erase_nodes set)) 3
  | AuditSqTOutput size => S size
  | _ => 0 end.

Definition audit_sq_t_work {N E} (EN : encoding N) (events : list (audit_sq_t_call N E)) : nat :=
  512 * S (length events) * S (length events) +
    fold_right (fun event n => audit_sq_t_event_work EN event + n) 0 events.

Definition audit_sq_t_input_vertices {N} (rm : Map.t N (FinSet.t N)) (nodes : list N) : list N :=
  nodes ++ flat_map (fun row => FinSet.elements (snd row)) (Map.elements rm).

Definition audit_sq_t_input_scale {N E} {EN : encoding N} {g : Graph.t N E}
    (p : prepared EN g) (rm : Map.t N (FinSet.t N)) (nodes : list N) : nat :=
  let vertices := audit_sq_t_input_vertices rm nodes in
  1 + length vertices + audit_erase_nodes rm +
    fold_right (fun row n => audit_erase_nodes (snd row) + n) 0 (Map.elements rm) +
    length (audit_sq_reduced_input_edges p vertices).

Definition audit_sq_t_event_bound {N E} {EN : encoding N} {g : Graph.t N E}
    (p : prepared EN g) (rm : Map.t N (FinSet.t N)) (nodes : list N) : nat :=
  1024 * Nat.pow (S (audit_sq_t_input_scale p rm nodes)) 5.

Definition audit_sq_t_budget {N E} (EN : encoding N) (g : Graph.t N E)
    (p : prepared EN g) (r : dfs_result N E) (rm : Map.t N (FinSet.t N)) (nodes : list N) : nat :=
  let count := audit_sq_t_event_bound p rm nodes in
  let width := audit_sq_reduced_width EN g p r (audit_sq_t_input_vertices rm nodes) in
  4096 * Nat.pow (S count) 4 * Nat.pow (S width) 2.

Definition audit_sq_t_graph_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E (EN : encoding N) (g : Graph.t N E) (p : prepared EN g) (r : dfs_result N E) rm nodes,
    let '(result, events) := audit_sq_t_graph_counted p r rm nodes in
    result = AnalysesSsaLiveQuery.live_t_graph EN g (succ_edges p)
      (fun e => ancestor_b EN r (Graph.target g e) (Graph.source g e)) rm nodes /\
    length events <= audit_sq_t_event_bound p rm nodes /\ audit_sq_t_work EN events <=
  audit_sq_t_budget EN g p r rm nodes.




Inductive audit_sq_tbody (N : Type) : Type :=
| AuditSqTBodyOut (n : N) (rows : Map.t N (list (N * N))) (result : option (list (N * N)))
| AuditSqTBodyTarget (edge : N * N)
| AuditSqTBodyEncode (n : N) (code : positive).
Arguments AuditSqTBodyOut {N} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditSqTBodyTarget {N} _.
Arguments AuditSqTBodyEncode {N} _ _.

Definition audit_sq_tbody_out {N} (EN : encoding N) (rows : Map.t N (list (N * N))) (n : N)
    : list (N * N) * list (audit_sq_tbody N) :=
  let found := Map.get EN n rows in
  (match found with Some es => es | None => [] end, [AuditSqTBodyOut n rows found]).

Definition audit_sq_tbody_target {N} (edge : N * N) : N * list (audit_sq_tbody N) :=
  (snd edge, [AuditSqTBodyTarget edge]).

Definition audit_sq_tbody_encode {N} (EN : encoding N) (n : N) : positive * list (audit_sq_tbody N)
  :=
  let code := encode EN n in (code, [AuditSqTBodyEncode n code]).

Definition audit_sq_t_prepare_callbacks {N} (EN : encoding N) (rows : Map.t N (list (N * N)))
    : audit_prepare_callback_model N (N * N) (audit_sq_tbody N) :=
  AuditPrepareCallbackModel _ _ _ (audit_sq_tbody_out EN rows) audit_sq_tbody_target
  (audit_sq_tbody_encode EN).

Definition audit_sq_t_dfs_callbacks {N} (EN : encoding N) : audit_dfs_callback_model N (N * N)
  (audit_sq_tbody N) :=
  AuditDfsCallbackModel _ _ _ audit_sq_tbody_target (audit_sq_tbody_encode EN).

Inductive audit_sq_tclosure_call (N : Type) : Type :=
| AuditSqTCClosureCase (site : nat)
| AuditSqTCClosureDfs (event : audit_dfs_nested_event N (N * N) (audit_sq_tbody N))
| AuditSqTCClosureAdd (n : N) (s : FinSet.t N)
| AuditSqTCClosureSet (n : N) (s : FinSet.t N) (m : Map.t N (FinSet.t N)).
Arguments AuditSqTCClosureCase {N} _.
Arguments AuditSqTCClosureDfs {N} _.
Arguments AuditSqTCClosureAdd {N} _ _.
Arguments AuditSqTCClosureSet {N} _ _ _.

Fixpoint audit_sq_tclosure_set {N} (EN : encoding N) (nodes : list N) (s : FinSet.t N)
    : FinSet.t N * list (audit_sq_tclosure_call N) :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => (s, [AuditSqTCClosureCase 0])
  | n :: rest => let next := FinSet.add EN n s in let '(result, events) := audit_sq_tclosure_set EN
  rest next in
      (result, AuditSqTCClosureCase 1 :: AuditSqTCClosureAdd n s :: events)
  end.

Fixpoint audit_sq_tclosure_rows {N} {EN : encoding N} {tg : Graph.t N (N * N)}
    (tp : prepared EN tg) (nodes : list N) : Map.t N (FinSet.t N) * list (audit_sq_tclosure_call N)
  :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => (Map.empty, [AuditSqTCClosureCase 2])
  | n :: rest => let '(middle, later) := audit_sq_tclosure_rows tp rest in
      let '(search, dfs_events) := audit_dfs_nested_counted tp (audit_sq_t_dfs_callbacks EN)
  FinSet.empty [n] in
      let '(row, set_events) := audit_sq_tclosure_set EN (preorder search) FinSet.empty in
      (Map.set EN n row middle, AuditSqTCClosureCase 3 :: later ++ map AuditSqTCClosureDfs
  dfs_events ++
        set_events ++ [AuditSqTCClosureSet n row middle])
  end.

Definition audit_sq_tbody_work {N} (EN : encoding N) (event : audit_sq_tbody N) : nat :=
  64 + match event with
  | AuditSqTBodyOut n _ _ => audit_encoding_weight (audit_key_bits_weight (encode EN n)) +
  audit_get_weight (encode EN n)
  | AuditSqTBodyEncode _ code => audit_encoding_weight (audit_key_bits_weight code)
  | AuditSqTBodyTarget _ => 0 end.

Definition audit_sq_tclosure_event_work {N} (EN : encoding N) (event : audit_sq_tclosure_call N) :
  nat :=
  64 + match event with
  | AuditSqTCClosureDfs (outer, body) => audit_dfs_full_model_event EN outer +
      fold_right (fun item n => audit_sq_tbody_work EN item + n) 0 body
  | AuditSqTCClosureAdd n _ | AuditSqTCClosureSet n _ _ =>
      audit_encoding_weight (audit_key_bits_weight (encode EN n)) + audit_set_weight (encode EN n)
  | AuditSqTCClosureCase _ => 0 end.

Definition audit_sq_tclosure_work {N} (EN : encoding N) (events : list (audit_sq_tclosure_call N)) :
  nat :=
  512 * S (length events) * S (length events) +
    fold_right (fun event n => audit_sq_tclosure_event_work EN event + n) 0 events.

Definition audit_sq_tclosure_event_bound {N} {EN : encoding N} {tg : Graph.t N (N * N)}
    (tp : prepared EN tg) (nodes : list N) : nat :=
  64 * S (length nodes) * S (Pos.to_nat (fuel tp)).

Definition audit_sq_tclosure_budget {N} (EN : encoding N) (tg : Graph.t N (N * N))
    (tp : prepared EN tg) (nodes : list N) : nat :=
  let count := audit_sq_tclosure_event_bound tp nodes in
  let width := Nat.max (audit_dfs_full_input_width EN tg tp nodes)
    (audit_key_bits_weight (Pos.of_succ_nat (S count))) in
  2048 * S count * S count + count * (512 + 24 * width).

Definition audit_sq_tclosure_statement : Prop :=
  forall N (EN : encoding N) (tg : Graph.t N (N * N)) (tp : prepared EN tg) nodes,
    (forall edge, Graph.target tg edge = snd edge) ->
    let '(result, events) := audit_sq_tclosure_rows tp nodes in
    result = AnalysesSsaLiveQuery.live_tabulate EN
      (fun n => FinSet.of_list EN (preorder (dfs tp FinSet.empty [n]))) nodes /\
    length events <= audit_sq_tclosure_event_bound tp nodes /\
    audit_sq_tclosure_work EN events <= audit_sq_tclosure_budget EN tg tp nodes.


Record audit_sq_graph_trace (N E : Type) : Type := AuditSqGraphTrace {
  audit_sq_graph_prepare_events : list (audit_graph_full_call N E);
  audit_sq_graph_initial_dfs_events : list (audit_dfs_full_call N E);
  audit_sq_graph_reduced_events : list (audit_sq_reduced_call N E);
  audit_sq_graph_t_events : list (audit_sq_t_call N E);
  audit_sq_graph_t_prepare_events : list (audit_prepare_nested_event N (N * N) (audit_sq_tbody N));
  audit_sq_graph_dom_events : audit_dom_backend_trace N E;
  audit_sq_graph_closure_events : list (audit_sq_tclosure_call N)
}.
Arguments AuditSqGraphTrace {N E} _ _ _ _ _ _ _.

Definition audit_sq_graph_run {N E} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (g : Graph.t N E)
    (result : ssa_query_graph N E) (trace : audit_sq_graph_trace N E) : Prop :=
  let '(p, prepare_events) := audit_graph_prepare_full_counted EN g in
  let '(search, dfs_events) := audit_dfs_full_counted p FinSet.empty (Graph.entries g) in
  let '(rm, reduced_events) := audit_sq_r_rows_counted p search (rpo search) in
  let '(tg, (rows, t_events)) := audit_sq_t_graph_with_rows p search rm (preorder search) in
  let '(tp, t_prepare_events) := audit_graph_prepare_nested_counted EN tg
  (audit_sq_t_prepare_callbacks EN rows) in
  exists tree dom_events,
    audit_dom_tree_with_run p SimpleLT tree dom_events /\
    let '(closure, closure_events) := audit_sq_tclosure_rows tp (preorder search) in
    result = SsaQueryGraph g search tree rm closure /\
    trace = AuditSqGraphTrace prepare_events dfs_events reduced_events t_events t_prepare_events
  dom_events closure_events.

Definition audit_sq_graph_erasure_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (g : Graph.t N E),
    exists result trace, audit_sq_graph_run EN EE g result trace /\ result = prepare_ssa_query_graph
  EN EE g.


Inductive audit_sq_dom_call (N : Type) : Type :=
| AuditSqDomGet (n : N) (m : Map.t N positive) (r : option positive)
| AuditSqDomLe (a b : positive) (r : bool).
Arguments AuditSqDomGet {N} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditSqDomLe {N} _ _ _.

Definition audit_sq_dom_counted {N} (EN : encoding N) (tree : dom_tree N) (d t : N)
    : bool * list (audit_sq_dom_call N) :=
  let a := Map.get EN d (tin tree) in
  match a with
  | None => (false, [AuditSqDomGet d (tin tree) a])
  | Some av => let b := Map.get EN t (tin tree) in
    match b with
    | None => (false, [AuditSqDomGet d (tin tree) a; AuditSqDomGet t (tin tree) b])
    | Some bv => let c := Map.get EN d (tout tree) in
      match c with
      | None => (false, [AuditSqDomGet d (tin tree) a; AuditSqDomGet t (tin tree) b;
          AuditSqDomGet d (tout tree) c])
      | Some cv => let e := Map.get EN t (tout tree) in
        match e with
        | None => (false, [AuditSqDomGet d (tin tree) a; AuditSqDomGet t (tin tree) b;
            AuditSqDomGet d (tout tree) c; AuditSqDomGet t (tout tree) e])
        | Some ev => let first := Pos.leb av bv in let second := Pos.leb ev cv in
          (first && second, [AuditSqDomGet d (tin tree) a; AuditSqDomGet t (tin tree) b;
            AuditSqDomGet d (tout tree) c; AuditSqDomGet t (tout tree) e;
            AuditSqDomLe av bv first; AuditSqDomLe ev cv second])
        end
      end
    end
  end.

Inductive audit_sq_query_call (N V : Type) : Type :=
| AuditSqDefinition (x : V) (m : Map.t V N) (r : option N)
| AuditSqUses (x : V) (m : Map.t V (FinSet.t N)) (r : FinSet.t N)
| AuditSqClosure (n : N) (m : Map.t N (FinSet.t N)) (r : FinSet.t N)
| AuditSqCompare (d t : N) (same : bool)
| AuditSqDominates (d t : N) (tree : dom_tree N) (result : bool) (calls : list (audit_sq_dom_call
  N))
| AuditSqReduced (t : N) (m : Map.t N (FinSet.t N)) (r : FinSet.t N)
| AuditSqMember (u : N) (set : FinSet.t N) (result : bool).
Arguments AuditSqDefinition {N V} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditSqUses {N V} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditSqClosure {N V} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditSqCompare {N V} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditSqDominates {N V} _ _ _ _ _.
Arguments AuditSqReduced {N V} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditSqMember {N V} _ _ _.

Fixpoint audit_sq_members_counted {N V} (EN : encoding N) (set : FinSet.t N)
    (uses : list N) : bool * list (audit_sq_query_call N V) :=
  match uses with
  | [] => (false, [])
  | u :: rest =>
      let found := FinSet.mem EN u set in
      let '(later, events) := audit_sq_members_counted EN set rest in
      (found || later, AuditSqMember u set found :: events)
  end.

Fixpoint audit_sq_rows_counted {N E V} (EN : encoding N) (idx : ssa_query_graph N E)
    (d : N) (uses rows : list N) : bool * list (audit_sq_query_call N V) :=
  match rows with
  | [] => (false, [])
  | t :: rest =>
      let same := Pos.eqb (encode EN d) (encode EN t) in
      let '(dom, dom_events) := audit_sq_dom_counted EN (query_dom idx) d t in
      let reduced := live_index_get EN t (query_reduced idx) in
      let '(member, members) := audit_sq_members_counted EN reduced uses in
      let here := negb same && dom && member in
      let '(later, events) := audit_sq_rows_counted EN idx d uses rest in
      (here || later, AuditSqCompare d t same :: AuditSqDominates d t (query_dom idx) dom dom_events
  ::
        AuditSqReduced t (query_reduced idx) reduced :: members ++ events)
  end.

Definition audit_sq_query_counted {N E V} (EN : encoding N) (EV : encoding V)
    (idx : ssa_query_graph N E) (values : ssa_query_values N V) (n : N) (x : V)
    : bool * list (audit_sq_query_call N V) :=
  let definition := Map.get EV x (query_def values) in
  match definition with
  | None => (false, [AuditSqDefinition x (query_def values) definition])
  | Some d =>
      let us := live_index_get EV x (query_uses values) in
      let uses := FinSet.elements us in
      let rows := live_index_get EN n (query_back_closure idx) in
      let '(result, events) := audit_sq_rows_counted EN idx d uses (FinSet.elements rows) in
      (result, AuditSqDefinition x (query_def values) definition ::
        AuditSqUses x (query_uses values) us :: AuditSqClosure n (query_back_closure idx) rows ::
  events)
  end.

Definition audit_sq_dom_event_work {N} (EN : encoding N) (event : audit_sq_dom_call N) : nat :=
  64 + match event with
  | AuditSqDomGet n _ _ => audit_get_weight (encode EN n) + audit_encoding_weight
  (audit_key_bits_weight (encode EN n))
  | AuditSqDomLe a b _ => audit_binary_weight (Z.pos a) (Z.pos b)
  end.

Definition audit_sq_query_event_work {N V} (EN : encoding N) (EV : encoding V)
    (event : audit_sq_query_call N V) : nat :=
  let node_read n := audit_get_weight (encode EN n) + audit_encoding_weight (audit_key_bits_weight
  (encode EN n)) in
  let value_read x := audit_get_weight (encode EV x) + audit_encoding_weight (audit_key_bits_weight
  (encode EV x)) in
  64 + match event with
  | AuditSqDefinition x _ _ | AuditSqUses x _ _ => value_read x
  | AuditSqClosure n _ _ | AuditSqReduced n _ _ | AuditSqMember n _ _ => node_read n
  | AuditSqCompare d t _ => audit_encoding_weight (audit_key_bits_weight (encode EN d)) +
      audit_encoding_weight (audit_key_bits_weight (encode EN t)) +
      audit_binary_weight (Z.pos (encode EN d)) (Z.pos (encode EN t))
  | AuditSqDominates _ _ _ _ calls => fold_right (fun e total => audit_sq_dom_event_work EN e +
  total) 0 calls
  end.

Definition audit_sq_query_model_work {N V} (EN : encoding N) (EV : encoding V)
    (events : list (audit_sq_query_call N V)) : nat :=
  64 * S (length events) * S (length events) +
    fold_right (fun e total => audit_sq_query_event_work EN EV e + total) 0 events.

Definition audit_sq_query_event_bound {N E V} (EN : encoding N) (EV : encoding V)
    (idx : ssa_query_graph N E) (values : ssa_query_values N V) (n : N) (x : V) : nat :=
  let uses := FinSet.elements (live_index_get EV x (query_uses values)) in
  let rows := FinSet.elements (live_index_get EN n (query_back_closure idx)) in
  3 + length rows * (3 + length uses).

Definition audit_sq_query_input_width {N E V} (EN : encoding N) (EV : encoding V)
    (idx : ssa_query_graph N E) (values : ssa_query_values N V) (n : N) (x : V) : nat :=
  let nodes := n :: FinSet.elements (live_index_get EV x (query_uses values)) ++
    FinSet.elements (live_index_get EN n (query_back_closure idx)) ++
    match Map.get EV x (query_def values) with Some d => [d] | None => [] end in
  Nat.max (audit_key_bits_weight (encode EV x))
    (Nat.max (fold_right Nat.max 0 (map (fun node => audit_key_bits_weight (encode EN node)) nodes))
      (fold_right Nat.max 0 (map (fun binding => audit_key_bits_weight (snd binding))
        (Map.elements (tin (query_dom idx)) ++ Map.elements (tout (query_dom idx)))))).

Definition audit_sq_query_input_budget {N E V} (EN : encoding N) (EV : encoding V)
    (idx : ssa_query_graph N E) (values : ssa_query_values N V) (n : N) (x : V) : nat :=
  let events := audit_sq_query_event_bound EN EV idx values n x in
  let width := audit_sq_query_input_width EN EV idx values n x in
  64 * S events * S events + events * (8 * (70 + 6 * width)).

Definition audit_sq_dom_counted_statement : Prop :=
  forall N (EN : encoding N) tree d t,
    let '(result, events) := audit_sq_dom_counted EN tree d t in
    result = dominates_b EN tree d t /\ length events <= 6.


Definition audit_sq_query_counted_statement : Prop :=
  forall N E V (EN : encoding N) (EV : encoding V) (idx : ssa_query_graph N E)
      (values : ssa_query_values N V) n x,
    let '(result, events) := audit_sq_query_counted EN EV idx values n x in
    result = ssa_live_query EN EV idx values n x /\
    length events <= audit_sq_query_event_bound EN EV idx values n x /\
    audit_sq_query_model_work EN EV events <= audit_sq_query_input_budget EN EV idx values n x.
```

```rocq
(** * Original SEG reconstruction component contract

    The helper retains the original directional reconstruction theorem type.
    For example, an absent interior returns false without invoking the cut callback.
    Builds on: SEG definitions and graph and collection audit vocabularies. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool PArith ZArith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet
  CollectionsAuditCost.
From Galois.Graph Require Import GraphCore GraphAuditBase GraphAuditDfs GraphAuditVirtual
  GraphAuditFrontier.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditSsaQueryBase AnalysesLiveness AnalysesAvailable
  AnalysesSeg.
Import List.ListNotations.


Inductive audit_seg_strict_event (E U : Type) : Type :=
  | AuditSegGen (edge : E) (generated : list U)
  | AuditSegKill (edge : E) (expression : U) (killed : bool)
  | AuditSegEncode (expression : U) (code : positive)
  | AuditSegEqual (left right : positive) (answer : bool).
Arguments AuditSegGen {E U} _ _.
Arguments AuditSegKill {E U} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditSegEncode {E U} _ _.
Arguments AuditSegEqual {E U} _ _ _.

Fixpoint audit_seg_strict_mentions {E U} (EU : encoding U) (u : U) (xs : list U)
    : bool * list (audit_seg_strict_event E U) :=
  match xs with
  | [] => (false, [])
  | x :: rest =>
      let left := encode EU u in
      let right := encode EU x in
      let equal := Pos.eqb left right in
      let '(later_result, later) := audit_seg_strict_mentions EU u rest in
      (equal || later_result,
       AuditSegEncode u left :: AuditSegEncode x right :: AuditSegEqual left right equal :: later)
  end.

Definition audit_seg_strict_transfer {S O N E U C} (EU : encoding U)
    (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) (u : U) (e : E) (b : bool)
    : bool * list (audit_seg_strict_event E U) :=
  let generated := gen gk e in
  let '(found, events) := audit_seg_strict_mentions EU u generated in
  let killed := kill gk e u in
  (found || (b && negb killed), AuditSegGen e generated :: events ++ [AuditSegKill e u killed]).

Inductive audit_seg_mentions_execution {E U} (EU : encoding U) (u : U)
    : list U -> bool -> list (audit_seg_strict_event E U) -> Prop :=
  | AuditSegMentionsNil : audit_seg_mentions_execution EU u [] false []
  | AuditSegMentionsCons x rest later_result later :
      audit_seg_mentions_execution EU u rest later_result later ->
      audit_seg_mentions_execution EU u (x :: rest)
        (Pos.eqb (encode EU u) (encode EU x) || later_result)
        (AuditSegEncode u (encode EU u) :: AuditSegEncode x (encode EU x) ::
         AuditSegEqual (encode EU u) (encode EU x)
           (Pos.eqb (encode EU u) (encode EU x)) :: later).

Inductive audit_seg_transfer_execution {S O N E U C} (EU : encoding U)
    (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) (u : U) (e : E) (b : bool)
    : bool -> list (audit_seg_strict_event E U) -> Prop :=
  | AuditSegTransferRun found events :
      audit_seg_mentions_execution EU u (gen gk e) found events ->
      audit_seg_transfer_execution EU gk u e b
        (found || (b && negb (kill gk e u)))
        (AuditSegGen e (gen gk e) :: events ++ [AuditSegKill e u (kill gk e u)]).

Definition audit_seg_transfer_execution_exists_statement : Prop :=
  forall S O N E U C (EU : encoding U) (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) u e b,
    exists result events, audit_seg_transfer_execution EU gk u e b result events /\
      result = seg_bit_transfer EU gk u e b.

Definition audit_seg_strict_transfer_statement : Prop :=
  forall S O N E U C (EU : encoding U) (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) u e b,
    let '(result, events) := audit_seg_strict_transfer EU gk u e b in
    audit_seg_transfer_execution EU gk u e b result events /\
    result = seg_bit_transfer EU gk u e b /\
    length events = 2 + 3 * length (gen gk e).

Definition audit_seg_model_event {E U} (event : audit_seg_strict_event E U) : nat :=
  match event with
  | AuditSegGen _ _ | AuditSegKill _ _ _ => 1
  | AuditSegEncode _ code => audit_encoding_weight (audit_key_bits_weight code)
  | AuditSegEqual left_code right_code _ => audit_binary_weight (Z.pos left_code) (Z.pos right_code)
  end.

Definition audit_seg_model_work {E U} (events : list (audit_seg_strict_event E U)) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun event n => audit_seg_model_event event + n) 0 events.

Definition audit_seg_model_expected {S O N E U C} (EU : encoding U)
    (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) (u : U) (e : E) : nat :=
  2 + fold_right (fun x total =>
    audit_encoding_weight (audit_key_bits_weight (encode EU u)) +
    audit_encoding_weight (audit_key_bits_weight (encode EU x)) +
    audit_binary_weight (Z.pos (encode EU u)) (Z.pos (encode EU x)) + total)
    0 (gen gk e).

Definition audit_seg_model_statement : Prop :=
  forall S O N E U C (EU : encoding U) (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) u e b result events,
    audit_seg_transfer_execution EU gk u e b result events ->
    audit_seg_model_work events = audit_seg_model_expected EU gk u e.




Inductive audit_seg_reconstruct_call (N E U : Type) : Type :=
| AuditSegReconCase (site : nat)
| AuditSegReconAdd (n : N) (s : FinSet.t N)
| AuditSegReconMem (n : N) (s : FinSet.t N) (result : bool)
| AuditSegReconInterior (n : N) (m : Map.t N (E * nat)) (result : option (E * nat))
| AuditSegReconPath (e : E) (m : Map.t E (list E)) (result : option (list E))
| AuditSegReconSource (e : E) (n : N)
| AuditSegReconTarget (e : E) (n : N)
| AuditSegReconCut (n : N) (result : bool)
| AuditSegReconTransfer (event : audit_seg_strict_event E U).
Arguments AuditSegReconCase {N E U} _.
Arguments AuditSegReconAdd {N E U} _ _.
Arguments AuditSegReconMem {N E U} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditSegReconInterior {N E U} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditSegReconPath {N E U} _ _ _.
Arguments AuditSegReconSource {N E U} _ _.
Arguments AuditSegReconTarget {N E U} _ _.
Arguments AuditSegReconCut {N E U} _ _.
Arguments AuditSegReconTransfer {N E U} _.

Fixpoint audit_seg_recon_setup {N E U} (EN : encoding N) (nodes : list N) (cuts : FinSet.t N)
    : FinSet.t N * list (audit_seg_reconstruct_call N E U) :=
  match nodes with
  | [] => (cuts, [AuditSegReconCase 0])
  | n :: rest => let next := FinSet.add EN n cuts in let '(result, events) := audit_seg_recon_setup
  EN rest next in
      (result, AuditSegReconCase 1 :: AuditSegReconAdd n cuts :: events)
  end.

Fixpoint audit_seg_firstn {N E U} (k : nat) (xs : list E)
    : list E * list (audit_seg_reconstruct_call N E U) :=
  match k, xs with
  | O, _ => ([], [AuditSegReconCase 2])
  | S _, [] => ([], [AuditSegReconCase 3])
  | S n, e :: rest => let '(later, events) := audit_seg_firstn n rest in
      (e :: later, AuditSegReconCase 4 :: events)
  end.

Fixpoint audit_seg_skipn {N E U} (k : nat) (xs : list E)
    : list E * list (audit_seg_reconstruct_call N E U) :=
  match k, xs with
  | O, _ => (xs, [AuditSegReconCase 5])
  | S _, [] => ([], [AuditSegReconCase 6])
  | S n, _ :: rest => let '(later, events) := audit_seg_skipn n rest in
      (later, AuditSegReconCase 7 :: events)
  end.

Fixpoint audit_seg_forward_fold {S O N E U C} (EU : encoding U) (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C)
    (u : U) (edges : list E) (initial : bool) : bool * list (audit_seg_reconstruct_call N E U) :=
  match edges with
  | [] => (initial, [AuditSegReconCase 8])
  | e :: rest => let '(next, here) := audit_seg_strict_transfer EU gk u e initial in
      let '(result, later) := audit_seg_forward_fold EU gk u rest next in
      (result, AuditSegReconCase 9 :: map AuditSegReconTransfer here ++ later)
  end.

Fixpoint audit_seg_backward_fold {S O N E U C} (EU : encoding U) (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C)
    (u : U) (edges : list E) (initial : bool) : bool * list (audit_seg_reconstruct_call N E U) :=
  match edges with
  | [] => (initial, [AuditSegReconCase 10])
  | e :: rest => let '(middle, later) := audit_seg_backward_fold EU gk u rest initial in
      let '(result, here) := audit_seg_strict_transfer EU gk u e middle in
      (result, AuditSegReconCase 11 :: later ++ map AuditSegReconTransfer here)
  end.

Definition audit_seg_recon_probe {S O N E U C} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (EU : encoding U)
    (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) (u : U) (idx : seg_index N E)
    (cut : N -> bool) (cuts : FinSet.t N) (forward : bool) (n : N)
    : bool * list (audit_seg_reconstruct_call N E U) :=
  let is_cut := FinSet.mem EN n cuts in
  if is_cut then let answer := cut n in
    (answer, [AuditSegReconMem n cuts is_cut; AuditSegReconCase 12; AuditSegReconCut n answer])
  else let interior := Map.get EN n (seg_interiors idx) in
    match interior with
    | None => (false, [AuditSegReconMem n cuts is_cut; AuditSegReconCase 13;
        AuditSegReconInterior n (seg_interiors idx) interior; AuditSegReconCase 14])
    | Some (a, k) => if forward then
        let found := Map.get EE a (seg_paths idx) in let path := match found with Some es => es |
  None => [] end in
        let '(prefix, slice_events) := audit_seg_firstn (Nat.succ k) path in
        let source := Graph.source (seg_graph idx) a in let start := cut source in
        let '(answer, transfer_events) := audit_seg_forward_fold EU gk u prefix start in
        (answer, [AuditSegReconMem n cuts is_cut; AuditSegReconCase 13;
          AuditSegReconInterior n (seg_interiors idx) interior; AuditSegReconCase 15;
          AuditSegReconPath a (seg_paths idx) found] ++ slice_events ++
          [AuditSegReconSource a source; AuditSegReconCut source start] ++ transfer_events)
      else let target := Graph.target (seg_graph idx) a in let start := cut target in
        let found := Map.get EE a (seg_paths idx) in let path := match found with Some es => es |
  None => [] end in
        let '(suffix, slice_events) := audit_seg_skipn (Nat.succ k) path in
        let '(answer, transfer_events) := audit_seg_backward_fold EU gk u suffix start in
        (answer, [AuditSegReconMem n cuts is_cut; AuditSegReconCase 13;
          AuditSegReconInterior n (seg_interiors idx) interior; AuditSegReconCase 16;
          AuditSegReconTarget a target; AuditSegReconCut target start; AuditSegReconPath a
  (seg_paths idx) found] ++
          slice_events ++ transfer_events)
    end.

Definition audit_seg_recon_counted {S O N E U C} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (EU : encoding
  U)
    (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) (u : U) (idx : seg_index N E) (cut : N -> bool) (forward : bool)
  (n : N)
    : bool * list (audit_seg_reconstruct_call N E U) :=
  let '(cuts, setup) := audit_seg_recon_setup EN (Graph.nodes (seg_graph idx)) FinSet.empty in
  let '(result, events) := audit_seg_recon_probe EN EE EU gk u idx cut cuts forward n in (result,
  setup ++ events).

Definition audit_seg_recon_event_work {N E U} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (event : audit_seg_reconstruct_call N E U) : nat :=
  64 + match event with
  | AuditSegReconAdd n _ => audit_encoding_weight (audit_key_bits_weight (encode EN n)) +
  audit_set_weight (encode EN n)
  | AuditSegReconMem n _ _ | AuditSegReconInterior n _ _ =>
      audit_encoding_weight (audit_key_bits_weight (encode EN n)) + audit_get_weight (encode EN n)
  | AuditSegReconPath e _ _ => audit_encoding_weight (audit_key_bits_weight (encode EE e)) +
  audit_get_weight (encode EE e)
  | AuditSegReconTransfer inner => audit_seg_model_event inner
  | _ => 0 end.

Definition audit_seg_recon_work {N E U} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (events : list (audit_seg_reconstruct_call N E U)) : nat :=
  256 * S (length events) * S (length events) +
    fold_right (fun event n => audit_seg_recon_event_work EN EE event + n) 0 events.

Definition audit_seg_recon_path {N E} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (idx : seg_index N E) (n :
  N) : list E :=
  match Map.get EN n (seg_interiors idx) with Some (a, _) => seg_path EE idx a | None => [] end.

Definition audit_seg_recon_event_bound {S O N E U C} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E)
    (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) (idx : seg_index N E) (n : N) : nat :=
  let path := audit_seg_recon_path EN EE idx n in
  32 + 4 * length (Graph.nodes (seg_graph idx)) +
    fold_right (fun e total => 16 + 3 * length (gen gk e) + total) 0 path.

Definition audit_seg_recon_width {S O N E U C} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (EU : encoding U)
    (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) (u : U) (idx : seg_index N E) (n : N) : nat :=
  let path := audit_seg_recon_path EN EE idx n in
  let node_width := fold_right Nat.max (audit_key_bits_weight (encode EN n))
    (map (fun v => audit_key_bits_weight (encode EN v)) (Graph.nodes (seg_graph idx))) in
  let edge_width := fold_right Nat.max 0 (map (fun e => audit_key_bits_weight (encode EE e)) path)
  in
  let expression_width := fold_right Nat.max (audit_key_bits_weight (encode EU u))
    (map (fun v => audit_key_bits_weight (encode EU v)) (flat_map (gen gk) path)) in
  let interior_width := match Map.get EN n (seg_interiors idx) with
    | Some (a, _) => audit_key_bits_weight (encode EE a) | None => 0 end in
  Nat.max node_width (Nat.max edge_width (Nat.max expression_width interior_width)).

Definition audit_seg_recon_budget {S O N E U C} (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (EU : encoding
  U)
    (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) (u : U) (idx : seg_index N E) (n : N) : nat :=
  let count := audit_seg_recon_event_bound EN EE gk idx n in let width := audit_seg_recon_width EN
  EE EU gk u idx n in
  512 * Nat.succ count * Nat.succ count + count * (128 + 6 * width).

Definition audit_seg_recon_statement : Prop :=
  forall S O N E U C (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (EU : encoding U)
      (gk : genkill_view S O N E U C) u idx cut forward n,
    let '(result, events) := audit_seg_recon_counted EN EE EU gk u idx cut forward n in
    result = (if forward then seg_reconstruct_available EN EE idx (seg_bit_transfer EU gk u) cut n
      else seg_reconstruct_busy EN EE idx (seg_bit_transfer EU gk u) cut n) /\
    length events <= audit_seg_recon_event_bound EN EE gk idx n /\
    audit_seg_recon_work EN EE events <= audit_seg_recon_budget EN EE EU gk u idx n.
```

## Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditScevCost

Card: AUD-SM-COUNT-BASE

Source destination: `theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditScevCost.v`.

```rocq
(** * Shared scalar source charges

    These fixed arithmetic weights and input dimensions have no floor-loop dependency.
    For example, scalar fallback can use word-view weights without importing modular counting.
    Builds on: BitsWord and the shared Collections audit vocabulary. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List NArith PArith ZArith Bool.
From Galois.Bits Require Import BitsWord.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditCost.
Import List.ListNotations.

Definition floor_source_frame_weight (event : audit_event unit) : nat :=
  match event with
  | AuditArithmetic site [a] =>
    if Nat.eqb site 0 || Nat.eqb site 1
    then audit_binary_weight (Z.of_N a) 0%Z else 1%nat
  | AuditArithmetic site [a; b] =>
    if Nat.eqb site 3 then audit_multiply_weight (Z.of_N a) (Z.of_N b)
    else if Nat.eqb site 4 || Nat.eqb site 5 then audit_divide_weight (Z.of_N a) (Z.of_N b)
    else audit_binary_weight (Z.of_N a) (Z.of_N b)
  | _ => 1%nat
  end.

Definition floor_sum_frame_weight (event : audit_event unit) : nat :=
  match event with
  | AuditArithmetic site [m] =>
    if Nat.eqb site 7 then audit_unary_conversion_weight (audit_z_bits (Z.of_N m))
    else floor_source_frame_weight event
  | _ => floor_source_frame_weight event
  end.

Definition count_frame_weight (e : audit_event unit) : nat :=
  match e with
  | AuditArithmetic 41 [w] | AuditArithmetic 43 [w] => S (N.to_nat w)
  | AuditArithmetic 42 [a; b] => audit_divide_weight (count_zdecode a) (count_zdecode b)
  | AuditArithmetic 44 [a; b] => audit_binary_weight (count_zdecode a) (count_zdecode b)
  | AuditArithmetic 45 [w; a] =>
    (S (N.to_nat w) + audit_divide_weight (count_zdecode a) (2 ^ Z.of_N w))%nat
  | AuditArithmetic 46 [a] => audit_unary_conversion_weight (audit_z_bits (count_zdecode a))
  | _ => floor_sum_frame_weight e
  end.

Definition count_input_size (w : width) (a step bound : Z) (limit : N) : nat :=
  (1 + Pos.to_nat w + audit_z_bits a + audit_z_bits step + audit_z_bits bound +
    audit_z_bits (Z.of_N limit))%nat.
```

## Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditScevFast

Card: AUD-SA

Source destination: `theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditScevFast.v`.

```rocq
(** * No-wrap concrete statement check

    This scratch file elaborates the exact no-wrap guard and client statements.
    For example, an unsigned unit-step input has a selected candidate.
    Builds on: AnalysesScev and BitsWord. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List NArith PArith ZArith Bool.
From Galois.Bits Require Import BitsWord.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesScev.
Import List.ListNotations.

(** * Candidate guard and proposition types *)

Inductive nw_event : Type :=
  | NwModulus (w : width)
  | NwCompare (a b : Z)
  | NwAdd (a b : Z)
  | NwSub (a b : Z)
  | NwNeg (a : Z)
  | NwMul (a b : Z)
  | NwDiv (a b : Z)
  | NwRem (a b : Z)
  | NwToN (a : Z).

Definition nw_guard (w : width) (sg : signedness) (cmp : cmp_kind)
    (a step bound : Z) : option N * list nw_event :=
  let m := modulus w in
  let h := (m / 2)%Z in
  let lo := match sg with Unsigned => 0%Z | Signed => (-h)%Z end in
  let hi := match sg with Unsigned => (m - 1)%Z | Signed => (h - 1)%Z end in
  let prefix := [NwModulus w; NwDiv m 2; NwNeg h; NwSub m 1; NwSub h 1;
    NwCompare lo a; NwCompare a hi; NwCompare lo bound; NwCompare bound hi] in
  if (lo <=? a)%Z && (a <=? hi)%Z && (lo <=? bound)%Z && (bound <=? hi)%Z then
    let holds := match cmp with
      | CmpLt => (a <? bound)%Z
      | CmpLe => (a <=? bound)%Z
      | CmpNe => negb (a =? bound)%Z
      end in
    let initial := prefix ++ [NwCompare a bound] in
    if negb holds then (Some 0%N, initial) else
      let delta := (bound - a)%Z in
      let delta_events := initial ++ [NwSub bound a; NwCompare step 0] in
      let '(candidate, arithmetic) := match cmp with
        | CmpLt =>
          if (0 <? step)%Z then
            let sum := (delta + step)%Z in
            let n := (sum - 1)%Z in
            (Some (n / step)%Z, [NwAdd delta step; NwSub sum 1;
              NwDiv n step])
          else (None, [])
        | CmpLe =>
          if (0 <? step)%Z then
            let q := (delta / step)%Z in
            (Some (q + 1)%Z, [NwDiv delta step; NwAdd q 1])
          else (None, [])
        | CmpNe =>
          if (step =? 0)%Z then (None, []) else
            let r := (delta mod step)%Z in
            if (r =? 0)%Z then
              (Some (delta / step)%Z,
                [NwRem delta step; NwCompare r 0; NwDiv delta step])
            else (None, [NwRem delta step; NwCompare r 0])
        end in
      match candidate with
      | None => (None, delta_events ++ arithmetic)
      | Some k =>
        let product := (step * k)%Z in
        let endpoint := (a + product)%Z in
        let events := delta_events ++ arithmetic ++
          [NwCompare 0 k; NwMul step k; NwAdd a product;
            NwCompare lo endpoint; NwCompare endpoint hi; NwToN k] in
        if (0 <=? k)%Z && (lo <=? endpoint)%Z && (endpoint <=? hi)%Z
        then (Some (Z.to_N k), events) else (None, events)
      end
  else (None, prefix).

Definition nw_fast (w : width) (sg : signedness) (cmp : cmp_kind)
    (a step bound : Z) : option N :=
  match fst (nw_guard w sg cmp a step bound) with
  | Some k => Some k
  | None => affine_first_failure w sg cmp a step bound
  end.

Definition scev_nowrap_fast := nw_fast.

Definition nw_trip {V : Type} (inv : V -> Z) (w : width) (sg : signedness)
    (cmp : cmp_kind) (ch : chrec V) (bound : iexpr V) : option N :=
  match ch with
  | CRec base (CInv step) =>
    nw_fast w sg cmp (eval_chrec inv base O) (eval_iexpr inv step)
      (eval_iexpr inv bound)
  | _ => None
  end.

Definition scev_nowrap_probe_sound_type : Prop := forall w sg cmp a step bound k,
```

## Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditScevFastSource

```rocq
(** * Complete scalar guard and exhaustive fallback equations

    These executable equations retain actual operands for no-wrap and legacy search.
    For example, both strict range tests execute before their Boolean conjunction.
    Builds on: ScevCost and AnalysesScev. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List NArith PArith ZArith Bool.
From Galois.Bits Require Import BitsWord.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesScev.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditCost.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditScevCost.
Import List.ListNotations.

(** Actual comparisons include both operands and never short circuit their evaluation. *)
Definition scalar_compare (a b : Z) : audit_event unit := scalar_z 60 a b.

(** The word observation includes its actual wrap and selected signed branch. *)
Definition scalar_view (w : width) (sg : signedness) (z : Z)
    : Z * audit_trace unit :=
  let r := wrap w z in
  let prefix := [AuditArithmetic 45 [N.pos w; count_zencode z]] in
  match sg with
  | Unsigned => (r, prefix ++ [AuditCase 61 [0%N]])
  | Signed =>
    let m := modulus w in
    let h := (m / 2)%Z in
    let test := (r <? h)%Z in
    let tests := prefix ++ [AuditCase 61 [1%N]; AuditArithmetic 41 [N.pos w];
      scalar_z 42 m 2; scalar_compare r h; AuditCase 62 [if test then 1%N else 0%N]] in
    if test then (r, tests) else
      ((r - m)%Z, tests ++ [AuditArithmetic 41 [N.pos w]; scalar_z 63 r m])
  end.

(** Each predicate executes the affine arithmetic and both complete word observations. *)
Definition scalar_predicate w sg cmp a step bound (k : N) : bool * audit_trace unit :=
  let kz := Z.of_N k in
  let product := (step * kz)%Z in
  let value := (a + product)%Z in
  let '(lhs, first) := scalar_view w sg value in
  let '(rhs, second) := scalar_view w sg bound in
  let out := match cmp with
    | CmpLt => (lhs <? rhs)%Z
    | CmpLe => (lhs <=? rhs)%Z
    | CmpNe => negb (lhs =? rhs)%Z
    end in
  (out, [AuditArithmetic 64 [k]; scalar_z 65 step kz; scalar_z 44 a product] ++
    first ++ second ++ [AuditCase 66 [match cmp with CmpLt => 0%N
      | CmpLe => 1%N | CmpNe => 2%N end]; scalar_compare lhs rhs] ++
    match cmp with CmpNe => [AuditCase 67 [if out then 0%N else 1%N]] | _ => [] end).

(** One leaf retains its actual predicate, branch and optional output construction. *)
Definition scalar_one w sg cmp a step bound (start : N)
    : option N * audit_trace unit :=
  let '(test, body) := scalar_predicate w sg cmp a step bound start in
  (if test then None else Some start,
    AuditCase 68 [start] :: body ++ [AuditCase 69 [if test then 1%N else 0%N];
      AuditConstruct 70 [if test then 0%N else 1%N; start]]).

(** Binary search follows the first failure and records both executed boundary children. *)
Fixpoint scalar_search (fuel : positive) w sg cmp a step bound (start : N)
    : option N * audit_trace unit :=
  let prefix := [AuditCase 71 [N.pos fuel]] in
  match fuel with
  | xH => let '(out, body) := scalar_one w sg cmp a step bound start in (out, prefix ++ body)
  | xO rest | xI rest =>
    let '(out1, first) := scalar_search rest w sg cmp a step bound start in
    match out1 with
    | Some k => (Some k, prefix ++ first ++ [AuditCase 72 [1%N]; AuditConstruct 70 [1%N; k]])
    | None =>
      let next := (start + N.pos rest)%N in
      let '(out2, second) := scalar_search rest w sg cmp a step bound next in
      let middle := prefix ++ first ++ [AuditCase 72 [0%N];
        AuditArithmetic 2 [start; N.pos rest]] ++ second in
      match fuel, out2 with
      | xI _, None =>
        let last := (next + N.pos rest)%N in
        let '(out, body) := scalar_one w sg cmp a step bound last in
        (out, middle ++ [AuditCase 73 [0%N]; AuditArithmetic 2 [next; N.pos rest]] ++ body)
      | _, _ => (out2, middle ++ [AuditCase 73 [match out2 with None => 0%N
          | Some _ => 1%N end]])
      end
    end
  end.

(** The legacy fallback includes its setup, zero-step branch and full selected search. *)
Definition scalar_fallback w sg cmp a step bound : option N * audit_trace unit :=
  let wrapped := wrap w step in
  let zero := (wrapped =? 0)%Z in
  let '(out, body) := if zero then scalar_one w sg cmp a step bound 0%N
    else scalar_search (word_period w) w sg cmp a step bound 0%N in
  (out, [AuditArithmetic 45 [N.pos w; count_zencode step]; scalar_compare wrapped 0;
    AuditCase 74 [if zero then 1%N else 0%N]] ++
    (if zero then [] else [AuditArithmetic 43 [N.pos w]]) ++ body).

(** The arithmetic guard has complete source order and branch-dependent operations. *)
Definition scalar_guard (w : width) (sg : signedness) (cmp : cmp_kind)
    (a step bound : Z) : option N * audit_trace unit :=
  let m := modulus w in
  let h := (m / 2)%Z in
  let lo := match sg with Unsigned => 0%Z | Signed => (-h)%Z end in
  let hi := match sg with Unsigned => (m - 1)%Z | Signed => (h - 1)%Z end in
  let low_events := match sg with Unsigned => [AuditCase 75 [0%N]]
    | Signed => [AuditCase 75 [1%N]; scalar_z 63 0 h] end in
  let high_events := match sg with Unsigned => [AuditCase 76 [0%N]; scalar_z 63 m 1]
    | Signed => [AuditCase 76 [1%N]; scalar_z 63 h 1] end in
  let range := (lo <=? a)%Z && (a <=? hi)%Z && (lo <=? bound)%Z && (bound <=? hi)%Z in
  let prefix := [AuditArithmetic 41 [N.pos w]; scalar_z 42 m 2] ++ low_events ++
    high_events ++ [scalar_compare lo a; scalar_compare a hi; AuditCase 77 [];
      scalar_compare lo bound; AuditCase 77 []; scalar_compare bound hi; AuditCase 77 [];
      AuditCase 78 [if range then 1%N else 0%N]] in
  if range then
    let holds := match cmp with CmpLt => (a <? bound)%Z | CmpLe => (a <=? bound)%Z
      | CmpNe => negb (a =? bound)%Z end in
    let first := prefix ++ [AuditCase 79 []; scalar_compare a bound] ++
      (match cmp with CmpNe => [AuditCase 67 []] | _ => [] end) ++
      [AuditCase 67 []; AuditCase 80 [if holds then 0%N else 1%N]] in
    if negb holds then (Some 0%N, first ++ [AuditConstruct 70 [1%N; 0%N]]) else
    let delta := (bound - a)%Z in
    let '(candidate, arithmetic) := match cmp with
      | CmpLt =>
        if (0 <? step)%Z then
          let sum := (delta + step)%Z in
          let n := (sum - 1)%Z in
          (Some (n / step)%Z, [scalar_compare 0 step; AuditCase 81 [1%N];
            scalar_z 44 delta step; scalar_z 63 sum 1; scalar_z 42 n step])
        else (None, [scalar_compare 0 step; AuditCase 81 [0%N]])
      | CmpLe =>
        if (0 <? step)%Z then
          let q := (delta / step)%Z in
          (Some (q + 1)%Z, [scalar_compare 0 step; AuditCase 81 [1%N];
            scalar_z 42 delta step; scalar_z 44 q 1])
        else (None, [scalar_compare 0 step; AuditCase 81 [0%N]])
      | CmpNe =>
        if (step =? 0)%Z then (None, [scalar_compare step 0; AuditCase 81 [1%N]]) else
        let r := (delta mod step)%Z in
        if (r =? 0)%Z then (Some (delta / step)%Z,
          [scalar_compare step 0; AuditCase 81 [0%N]; scalar_z 82 delta step;
           scalar_compare r 0; AuditCase 83 [1%N]; scalar_z 42 delta step])
        else (None, [scalar_compare step 0; AuditCase 81 [0%N]; scalar_z 82 delta step;
          scalar_compare r 0; AuditCase 83 [0%N]])
      end in
    let before := first ++ [scalar_z 63 bound a; AuditCase 79 []] ++ arithmetic in
    match candidate with
    | None => (None, before ++ [AuditCase 84 [0%N]; AuditConstruct 70 [0%N]])
    | Some k =>
      let product := (step * k)%Z in
      let endpoint := (a + product)%Z in
      let accepted := (0 <=? k)%Z && (lo <=? endpoint)%Z && (endpoint <=? hi)%Z in
      let events := before ++ [AuditCase 84 [1%N]; scalar_z 65 step k;
        scalar_z 44 a product; scalar_compare 0 k; scalar_compare lo endpoint;
        AuditCase 77 []; scalar_compare endpoint hi; AuditCase 77 [];
        AuditCase 85 [if accepted then 1%N else 0%N]] in
      if accepted then (Some (Z.to_N k), events ++ [AuditArithmetic 46 [count_zencode k];
        AuditConstruct 70 [1%N; Z.to_N k]]) else (None, events ++ [AuditConstruct 70 [0%N]])
    end
  else (None, prefix ++ [AuditConstruct 70 [0%N]]).

(** A failed guard executes the exact legacy fallback in this same source execution. *)
Definition scev_nowrap_source w sg cmp a step bound : option N * audit_trace unit :=
  let '(candidate, guard) := scalar_guard w sg cmp a step bound in
  match candidate with
  | Some k => (Some k, guard ++ [AuditCase 86 [1%N]; AuditConstruct 70 [1%N; k]])
  | None => let '(out, fallback) := scalar_fallback w sg cmp a step bound in
    (out, guard ++ AuditCase 86 [0%N] :: fallback)
  end.

(** This is the lean production guard: metadata logging remains in the legacy public guard. *)
Definition nw_guard_lean (w : width) (sg : signedness) (cmp : cmp_kind)
    (a step bound : Z) : option N :=
  let m := modulus w in
  let h := (m / 2)%Z in
  let lo := match sg with Unsigned => 0%Z | Signed => (-h)%Z end in
  let hi := match sg with Unsigned => (m - 1)%Z | Signed => (h - 1)%Z end in
  if (lo <=? a)%Z && (a <=? hi)%Z && (lo <=? bound)%Z && (bound <=? hi)%Z then
    let holds := match cmp with CmpLt => (a <? bound)%Z | CmpLe => (a <=? bound)%Z
      | CmpNe => negb (a =? bound)%Z end in
    if negb holds then Some 0%N else
      let delta := (bound - a)%Z in
      let candidate := match cmp with
        | CmpLt => if (0 <? step)%Z then Some ((delta + step - 1) / step)%Z else None
        | CmpLe => if (0 <? step)%Z then Some (delta / step + 1)%Z else None
        | CmpNe => if (step =? 0)%Z then None else
          if (delta mod step =? 0)%Z then Some (delta / step)%Z else None
        end in
      match candidate with
      | None => None
      | Some k =>
        let endpoint := (a + step * k)%Z in
        if (0 <=? k)%Z && (lo <=? endpoint)%Z && (endpoint <=? hi)%Z
        then Some (Z.to_N k) else None
      end
  else None.

(** The selected production path uses the lean guard and retains the exact legacy fallback. *)
Definition scev_nowrap_fast_lean w sg cmp a step bound : option N :=
  match nw_guard_lean w sg cmp a step bound with
  | Some k => Some k
  | None => affine_first_failure w sg cmp a step bound
  end.

(** The fixed source model instruments this lean production body rather than legacy logging. *)
Definition scalar_guard_lean_erases_type : Prop := forall w sg cmp a step bound,
  fst (scalar_guard w sg cmp a step bound) = nw_guard_lean w sg cmp a step bound.

(** Lean source correspondence names its exact selected uninstrumented implementation. *)
Definition scev_nowrap_source_lean_erases_type : Prop := forall w sg cmp a step bound,
  fst (scev_nowrap_source w sg cmp a step bound) = scev_nowrap_fast_lean w sg cmp a step bound.

(** Fixed arithmetic weights use the actual signed operands and positive control charges. *)
Definition scalar_frame_weight (event : audit_event unit) : nat :=
  match event with
  | AuditArithmetic 60 [a; b] | AuditArithmetic 63 [a; b] =>
    audit_binary_weight (count_zdecode a) (count_zdecode b)
  | AuditArithmetic 65 [a; b] => audit_multiply_weight (count_zdecode a) (count_zdecode b)
  | AuditArithmetic 82 [a; b] => audit_divide_weight (count_zdecode a) (count_zdecode b)
  | AuditArithmetic 64 [a] => audit_unary_conversion_weight (audit_z_bits (Z.of_N a))
  | _ => count_frame_weight event
  end.

(** Sum the fixed costs of this exact scalar source execution. *)
Definition scalar_source_work (events : audit_trace unit) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun event total => (scalar_frame_weight event + total)%nat) 0%nat events.

(** Predicate correctness connects the literal operations to the old continuation Boolean. *)
Definition scalar_predicate_erases_type : Prop := forall w sg cmp a step bound k,
  fst (scalar_predicate w sg cmp a step bound k) = affine_test w sg cmp a step bound k.

(** Fallback correctness preserves the full old first-failure option. *)
Definition scalar_fallback_erases_type : Prop := forall w sg cmp a step bound,
  fst (scalar_fallback w sg cmp a step bound) = affine_first_failure w sg cmp a step bound.

(** The whole fast operation preserves the complete legacy result. *)
Definition scev_nowrap_source_erases_type : Prop := forall w sg cmp a step bound,
  fst (scev_nowrap_source w sg cmp a step bound) = affine_first_failure w sg cmp a step bound.

(** Each actual binary search has at most its length predicates and twice that many nodes. *)
Definition scalar_search_counts_type : Prop := forall fuel w sg cmp a step bound start,
  let '(_, events) := scalar_search fuel w sg cmp a step bound start in

(** The whole fast-path source cost includes its guard and all executed fallback predicates. *)
Definition scev_nowrap_source_bound_type : Prop := forall w sg cmp a step bound,
```

```rocq
(** * Fixed modular threshold-count model

    This scratch file models the two floor sums used by a threshold query.
    For example, both sums execute even when their eventual difference is zero.
    Builds on: FloorSumCandidate. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List NArith Bool.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditScevModCountPlain.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditCost.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditScevFloorTick.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditScevFloorIter.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditScevFloorSum.
Import List.ListNotations.
Local Open Scope N_scope.

(** * Fixed threshold-query frames *)

(** Record the actual offset addition and saturating subtraction. *)
Definition floor_ge_prefix (offset modulus added threshold : N) : audit_trace unit :=
  [AuditArithmetic 2 [offset; modulus]; AuditArithmetic 8 [added; threshold]].

(** Record both pattern matches that project the selected floor-sum result. *)
Definition floor_ge_projection (sum steps : N) (done : bool) : audit_trace unit :=
  [AuditCase 30 [sum]; AuditCase 31 [steps; floor_bool done]].

(** Record the final natural subtraction at its actual arguments. *)
Definition floor_ge_suffix (left right : N) : audit_trace unit :=
  [AuditArithmetic 8 [left; right]].

(** * Fixed threshold-query source relation *)

(** Both calls retain the same input parameters and their actual subruns. *)
Inductive floor_ge_run :
    N -> N -> N -> N -> N -> N -> audit_trace unit -> nat -> nat -> Prop :=
  | FloorGeRun : forall n modulus multiplier offset threshold
      left left_steps left_done right right_steps right_done
      first second overhead1 overhead2 budget1 budget2,
      floor_sum_run n modulus multiplier (offset + modulus - threshold)
        (left, left_steps, left_done) first overhead1 budget1 ->
      floor_sum_run n modulus multiplier offset
        (right, right_steps, right_done) second overhead2 budget2 ->
      let prefix := floor_ge_prefix offset modulus (offset + modulus) threshold in
      let middle1 := floor_ge_projection left left_steps left_done in
      let middle2 := floor_ge_projection right right_steps right_done in
      let suffix := floor_ge_suffix left right in
      floor_ge_run n modulus multiplier offset threshold (left - right)
        (prefix ++ first ++ middle1 ++ second ++ middle2 ++ suffix)
        (overhead1 + overhead2 + 48 + 2 * (length first + length second))%nat
        (floor_sum_weight prefix + budget1 + floor_sum_weight middle1 +
          budget2 + floor_sum_weight middle2 + floor_sum_weight suffix)%nat.

(** * Counted threshold query *)

(** Retain actual setup operands and both floor-sum results from this execution. *)
Definition audit_floor_ge_traced (n modulus multiplier offset threshold : N)
    : N * audit_trace unit :=
  let added := offset + modulus in
  let shifted := added - threshold in
  let '((left_sum, left_steps, left_done), first) :=
    audit_floor_sum_traced n modulus multiplier shifted in
  let '((right_sum, right_steps, right_done), second) :=
    audit_floor_sum_traced n modulus multiplier offset in
  let result := left_sum - right_sum in
  (result, floor_ge_prefix offset modulus added threshold ++ first ++
    floor_ge_projection left_sum left_steps left_done ++ second ++
    floor_ge_projection right_sum right_steps right_done ++ floor_ge_suffix left_sum right_sum).

(** * Prospective source and accounting obligations *)

(** The actual counted query has one fixed source derivation and exact result. *)
Definition audit_floor_ge_source_correct_type : Prop := forall n modulus multiplier offset
  threshold,
  let '(out, events) := audit_floor_ge_traced n modulus multiplier offset threshold in
  exists overhead budget, floor_ge_run n modulus multiplier offset threshold out events overhead
    budget /\
    out = audit_count_ge audit_floor_sum_fast n modulus multiplier offset threshold.

(** Every threshold query has a source-shaped derivation. *)
Definition audit_floor_ge_source_total_type : Prop := forall n modulus multiplier offset threshold,
  exists out events overhead budget,
    floor_ge_run n modulus multiplier offset threshold out events overhead budget /\
    out = audit_count_ge audit_floor_sum_fast n modulus multiplier offset threshold.

(** Exactly two real floor-wrapper branch sites occur in each query. *)
Definition audit_floor_ge_calls_exact_type : Prop := forall n modulus multiplier offset threshold,
  let '(_, events) := audit_floor_ge_traced n modulus multiplier offset threshold in
  audit_case_count 20 events = 2%nat.

(** Fixed source work is bounded by the two budgets of the same source derivation. *)
Definition audit_floor_ge_weight_bound_type : Prop :=
  forall n modulus multiplier offset threshold out events overhead budget,
    floor_ge_run n modulus multiplier offset threshold out events overhead budget ->
```

```rocq
(** * Fixed strict floor iterator model

    This scratch file models the binary iterator with the actual tick states.
    For example, fuel two runs the tick twice even when the first tick is done.
    Builds on: FloorStrictCandidate. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List NArith PArith Bool.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditScevModCountPlain.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditCost.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditScevFloorTick.
Import List.ListNotations.

(** * Binary iterator source relation *)

(** The fixed per-tick source budget depends on that tick's actual input fields. *)
Definition floor_tick_source_budget (st : audit_floor_state) : nat :=
  let size := floor_input_size st in
  (27 * (1 + (20 * size) * (20 * size)))%nat.

(** Each branch carries its actual intermediate states, traces and fixed budgets. *)
Inductive floor_iter_run :
    positive -> audit_floor_state -> audit_floor_state -> audit_trace unit -> nat -> nat -> Prop :=
  | FloorIterOne : forall st out tick,
      floor_shared_run st out tick ->
      floor_iter_run 1%positive st out (AuditCase 12 [1%N] :: tick)
        (floor_instrumentation_work st + 5)%nat (1 + floor_tick_source_budget st)%nat
  | FloorIterEven : forall fuel st mid out first second overhead1 overhead2 budget1 budget2,
      floor_iter_run fuel st mid first overhead1 budget1 ->
      floor_iter_run fuel mid out second overhead2 budget2 ->
      floor_iter_run (xO fuel) st out (AuditCase 11 [N.pos fuel] :: (first ++ second))
        (overhead1 + overhead2 + 6 + 2 * length first + 1)%nat (1 + budget1 + budget2)%nat
  | FloorIterOdd : forall fuel st mid1 mid2 out first second tick overhead1 overhead2 budget1
    budget2,
      floor_iter_run fuel st mid1 first overhead1 budget1 ->
      floor_iter_run fuel mid1 mid2 second overhead2 budget2 ->
      floor_shared_run mid2 out tick ->
      floor_iter_run (xI fuel) st out (AuditCase 10 [N.pos fuel] :: (first ++ second ++ tick))
        (overhead1 + overhead2 + floor_instrumentation_work mid2 + 7 +
          2 * length first + 1 + 2 * length second + 1)%nat
        (1 + budget1 + budget2 + floor_tick_source_budget mid2)%nat.

(** * Counted binary iterator *)

(** Execute the actual tick once per binary-iterator call and retain its trace. *)
Fixpoint audit_floor_iter_counted (fuel : positive) (st : audit_floor_state)
    : audit_floor_state * audit_trace unit :=
  match fuel with
  | xH =>
    let '(out, tick) := audit_floor_tick_counted st in
    (out, AuditCase 12 [1%N] :: tick)
  | xO rest =>
    let '(mid, first) := audit_floor_iter_counted rest st in
    let '(out, second) := audit_floor_iter_counted rest mid in
    (out, AuditCase 11 [N.pos rest] :: (first ++ second))
  | xI rest =>
    let '(mid1, first) := audit_floor_iter_counted rest st in
    let '(mid2, second) := audit_floor_iter_counted rest mid1 in
    let '(out, tick) := audit_floor_tick_counted mid2 in
    (out, AuditCase 10 [N.pos rest] :: (first ++ second ++ tick))
  end.

(** * Prospective iterator obligations *)

(** The counted result and trace correspond to the same source iterator run. *)
Definition audit_floor_iter_source_correct_type : Prop := forall fuel st,
  let '(out, events) := audit_floor_iter_counted fuel st in
  exists overhead budget, floor_iter_run fuel st out events overhead budget /\
    out = Pos.iter audit_floor_step st fuel.

(** Every binary iterator input has a source-shaped run. *)
Definition audit_floor_iter_source_total_type : Prop := forall fuel st,
```

```rocq
(** * Fixed floor-sum wrapper model

    This scratch file models the floor-sum wrapper around its binary iterator.
    For example, a zero modulus returns zero without entering the iterator.
    Builds on: FloorIterCandidate. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List NArith ZArith Bool.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditScevCost.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditScevModCountPlain.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditCost.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditScevFloorTick.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditScevFloorIter.
Import List.ListNotations.
Local Open Scope N_scope.

(** * Fixed wrapper frames *)

(** Record the source's zero-modulus test and zero result construction. *)
Definition floor_sum_zero_events (m : N) : audit_trace unit :=
  [AuditArithmetic 6 [m; 0]; AuditCase 20 [1];
   AuditConstruct 2 [0; 0]; AuditConstruct 3 [0]].

(** Record setup and the actual iterator fuel without recomputing inputs. *)
Definition floor_sum_prefix (n m a b size twice fuel : N) : audit_trace unit :=
  [AuditArithmetic 6 [m; 0]; AuditCase 20 [0]; AuditArithmetic 7 [m];
   AuditArithmetic 3 [2; size]; AuditArithmetic 2 [twice; 1];
   AuditConstruct 1 [n; m; a; b; 0; 0; 0]; AuditCase 21 [fuel]].

(** Record the actual final projections and output tuple construction. *)
Definition floor_sum_suffix (acc updates : N) (done : bool) : audit_trace unit :=
  [AuditCase 122 [acc]; AuditCase 123 [updates]; AuditCase 124 [floor_bool done];
   AuditConstruct 2 [acc; updates]; AuditConstruct 3 [floor_bool done]].

(** A size call is charged by its actual input bits; other frames retain tick weights. *)


(** Sum fixed wrapper and nested source-frame weights. *)
Definition floor_sum_weight (events : audit_trace unit) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun event total => (floor_sum_frame_weight event + total)%nat) 0%nat events.

(** * Fixed source relation *)

(** The source either handles zero or follows the actual binary iterator run. *)
Inductive floor_sum_run :
    N -> N -> N -> N -> (N * N * bool) -> audit_trace unit -> nat -> nat -> Prop :=
  | FloorSumZero : forall n a b,
      floor_sum_run n 0 a b (0, 0, false) (floor_sum_zero_events 0) 15%nat
        (floor_sum_weight (floor_sum_zero_events 0))
  | FloorSumFuelZero : forall n m a b,
      m <> 0 -> (2 * N.size m + 1 = 0)%N ->
      let prefix := floor_sum_prefix n m a b (N.size m) (2 * N.size m) 0 in
      let suffix := floor_sum_suffix 0 0 false in
      floor_sum_run n m a b (0, 0, false) (prefix ++ suffix)
        64%nat (floor_sum_weight prefix + floor_sum_weight suffix)%nat
  | FloorSumPositive : forall n m a b fuel out inner overhead budget,
      m <> 0 -> (2 * N.size m + 1 = N.pos fuel)%N ->
      floor_iter_run fuel (AuditFloorState n m a b 0 false 0) out inner overhead budget ->
      let prefix := floor_sum_prefix n m a b (N.size m) (2 * N.size m) (N.pos fuel) in
      let suffix := floor_sum_suffix (audit_floor_acc out) (audit_floor_updates out)
        (audit_floor_done out) in
      floor_sum_run n m a b (audit_floor_acc out, audit_floor_updates out, audit_floor_done out)
        (prefix ++ inner ++ suffix) (overhead + 66 + 2 * length inner)%nat
        (floor_sum_weight prefix + budget + floor_sum_weight suffix)%nat.

(** * Counted wrapper *)

(** Reuse each setup value, iterator output and trace from this execution. *)
Definition audit_floor_sum_traced (n m a b : N) : (N * N * bool) * audit_trace unit :=
  let zero := m =? 0 in
  if zero then ((0, 0, false), floor_sum_zero_events m) else
  let size := N.size m in
  let twice := 2 * size in
  let fuel := twice + 1 in
  let initial := AuditFloorState n m a b 0 false 0 in
  let prefix := floor_sum_prefix n m a b size twice fuel in
  match fuel with
  | N0 => ((0, 0, false), prefix ++ floor_sum_suffix 0 0 false)
  | Npos p =>
    let '(out, inner) := audit_floor_iter_counted p initial in
    let acc := audit_floor_acc out in
    let updates := audit_floor_updates out in
    let done := audit_floor_done out in
    ((acc, updates, done), prefix ++ inner ++ floor_sum_suffix acc updates done)
  end.

(** * Prospective whole-wrapper obligations *)

(** Counted output and trace belong to the same fixed source derivation. *)
Definition audit_floor_sum_source_correct_type : Prop := forall n m a b,
  let '(out, events) := audit_floor_sum_traced n m a b in
  exists overhead budget, floor_sum_run n m a b out events overhead budget /\
    out = audit_floor_sum_counted n m a b.

(** Every wrapper input has a finite source derivation. *)
Definition audit_floor_sum_source_total_type : Prop := forall n m a b,
  exists out events overhead budget, floor_sum_run n m a b out events overhead budget /\
    out = audit_floor_sum_counted n m a b.

(** A positive modulus always has nonzero binary fuel. *)
Definition audit_floor_sum_fuel_positive_type : Prop := forall m,
  (0 < m)%N -> (0 < 2 * N.size m + 1)%N.

(** The completed wrapper counts all fixed-fuel tick invocations. *)
Definition audit_floor_sum_tick_count_type : Prop := forall n m a b,
  (0 < m)%N ->
  let '(_, events) := audit_floor_sum_traced n m a b in
  audit_case_count 100 events = N.to_nat (2 * N.size m + 1).

(** Every source derivation's fixed weight is bounded by its own tick budgets. *)
Definition audit_floor_sum_weight_bound_type : Prop := forall n m a b out events overhead budget,
  floor_sum_run n m a b out events overhead budget ->
  (floor_sum_weight events <= budget)%nat.
```
