```rocq
(** * Fixed strict floor-tick model

    This scratch file fixes a source-shaped event vocabulary for one floor tick.
    For example, an already-completed tick records its projection and branch.
    Builds on: ModCountCandidate. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List NArith ZArith Bool.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditScevCost.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditScevModCountPlain.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditCost.
Import List.ListNotations.
Local Open Scope N_scope.

(** * Source-level floor-tick events *)

(** Events retain the source site, the actual operands and the result state. *)
Inductive floor_strict_event : Type :=
  | FloorProjection (site : nat) (value : N)
  | FloorBranch (site : nat) (value : bool)
  | FloorPred (a : N)
  | FloorSucc (a : N)
  | FloorAdd (a b : N)
  | FloorMul (a b : N)
  | FloorDiv (a b : N)
  | FloorMod (a b : N)
  | FloorCompare (a b : N)
  | FloorConstruct (out : audit_floor_state).

(** Encode a Boolean projection in its source event. *)
Definition floor_bool (b : bool) : N := if b then 1 else 0.

(** List the fixed source operations before the final branch of an active tick. *)
Definition floor_active_prefix (st : audit_floor_state) : list floor_strict_event :=
  let n := audit_floor_n st in
  let m := audit_floor_m st in
  let a := audit_floor_a st in
  let b := audit_floor_b st in
  let acc := audit_floor_acc st in
  let ar := a mod m in
  let br := b mod m in
  let pred := N.pred n in
  let prod := n * pred in
  let triangle := prod / 2 in
  let aq := a / m in
  let first := triangle * aq in
  let acc1 := acc + first in
  let bq := b / m in
  let second := n * bq in
  let scaled := ar * n in
  let y := scaled + br in
  [FloorProjection 0 (floor_bool (audit_floor_done st)); FloorBranch 0 false;
   FloorProjection 1 n; FloorProjection 2 m; FloorProjection 3 a; FloorProjection 4 b;
   FloorMod a m; FloorMod b m; FloorProjection 5 acc; FloorPred n;
   FloorMul n pred; FloorDiv prod 2; FloorDiv a m; FloorMul triangle aq;
   FloorAdd acc first; FloorDiv b m; FloorMul n bq; FloorAdd acc1 second;
   FloorMul ar n; FloorAdd scaled br; FloorCompare y m; FloorBranch 1 (y <? m)].

(** Describe the actual output of a finished active tick. *)
Definition floor_finish_output (st : audit_floor_state) : audit_floor_state :=
  let n := audit_floor_n st in
  let m := audit_floor_m st in
  let a := audit_floor_a st in
  let b := audit_floor_b st in
  let acc := audit_floor_acc st + (n * N.pred n / 2) * (a / m) + n * (b / m) in
  AuditFloorState n m (a mod m) (b mod m) acc true (N.succ (audit_floor_updates st)).

(** Describe the actual output of a continuing active tick. *)
Definition floor_continue_output (st : audit_floor_state) : audit_floor_state :=
  let n := audit_floor_n st in
  let m := audit_floor_m st in
  let a := audit_floor_a st in
  let b := audit_floor_b st in
  let ar := a mod m in
  let br := b mod m in
  let acc := audit_floor_acc st + (n * N.pred n / 2) * (a / m) + n * (b / m) in
  let y := ar * n + br in
  AuditFloorState (y / m) ar m (y mod m) acc false (N.succ (audit_floor_updates st)).

(** The source relation has exactly the done, finished and continuing cases. *)
Inductive floor_strict_run :
    audit_floor_state -> audit_floor_state -> list floor_strict_event -> Prop :=
  | FloorRunDone : forall st,
      audit_floor_done st = true ->
      floor_strict_run st st [FloorProjection 0 1; FloorBranch 0 true]
  | FloorRunFinish : forall st,
      audit_floor_done st = false ->
      let y := audit_floor_a st mod audit_floor_m st * audit_floor_n st +
        audit_floor_b st mod audit_floor_m st in
      (y <? audit_floor_m st) = true ->
      floor_strict_run st (floor_finish_output st)
        (floor_active_prefix st ++
          [FloorProjection 6 (audit_floor_updates st); FloorSucc (audit_floor_updates st);
           FloorConstruct (floor_finish_output st)])
  | FloorRunContinue : forall st,
      audit_floor_done st = false ->
      let y := audit_floor_a st mod audit_floor_m st * audit_floor_n st +
        audit_floor_b st mod audit_floor_m st in
      (y <? audit_floor_m st) = false ->
      floor_strict_run st (floor_continue_output st)
        (floor_active_prefix st ++
          [FloorDiv y (audit_floor_m st); FloorMod y (audit_floor_m st);
           FloorProjection 6 (audit_floor_updates st); FloorSucc (audit_floor_updates st);
           FloorConstruct (floor_continue_output st)]).

(** * Prospective implementation and laws *)

(** The fixed literal observer follows exactly the source relation's selected branch. *)
Definition floor_tick_counted (st : audit_floor_state)
    : audit_floor_state * list floor_strict_event :=
  if audit_floor_done st then (st, [FloorProjection 0 1; FloorBranch 0 true]) else
  let y := (audit_floor_a st mod audit_floor_m st * audit_floor_n st +
    audit_floor_b st mod audit_floor_m st)%N in
  if (y <? audit_floor_m st)%N then
    (floor_finish_output st, floor_active_prefix st ++
      [FloorProjection 6 (audit_floor_updates st); FloorSucc (audit_floor_updates st);
       FloorConstruct (floor_finish_output st)])
  else
    (floor_continue_output st, floor_active_prefix st ++
      [FloorDiv y (audit_floor_m st); FloorMod y (audit_floor_m st);
       FloorProjection 6 (audit_floor_updates st); FloorSucc (audit_floor_updates st);
       FloorConstruct (floor_continue_output st)]).

  (** The counted output and trace belong to the fixed source-shaped branch. *)
  Definition floor_tick_correspondence_type : Prop := forall st,
    let '(out, events) := floor_tick_counted st in
    floor_strict_run st out events /\ out = audit_floor_step st.

  (** Every source tick admits an exact result and trace. *)
  Definition floor_tick_total_type : Prop := forall st,
    exists out events, floor_strict_run st out events /\ out = audit_floor_step st.

  (** The fixed direct-operation trace has a nonzero finite bound. *)
  Definition floor_tick_count_type : Prop := forall st,
    let '(_, events) := floor_tick_counted st in
    (2 <= length events <= 27)%nat.

(** * Shared-vocabulary source frames *)

(** Map a literal floor event to its fixed common source-frame site. *)
Definition floor_shared_event (e : floor_strict_event) : audit_event unit :=
  match e with
  | FloorProjection site value => AuditCase (100 + site)%nat [value]
  | FloorBranch site value => AuditCase site [floor_bool value]
  | FloorPred a => AuditArithmetic 0 [a]
  | FloorSucc a => AuditArithmetic 1 [a]
  | FloorAdd a b => AuditArithmetic 2 [a; b]
  | FloorMul a b => AuditArithmetic 3 [a; b]
  | FloorDiv a b => AuditArithmetic 4 [a; b]
  | FloorMod a b => AuditArithmetic 5 [a; b]
  | FloorCompare a b => AuditArithmetic 6 [a; b]
  | FloorConstruct out =>
    AuditConstruct 0 [audit_floor_n out; audit_floor_m out; audit_floor_a out;
      audit_floor_b out; audit_floor_acc out; floor_bool (audit_floor_done out);
      audit_floor_updates out]
  end.

(** A shared trace represents the very same fixed floor-source branch. *)
Definition floor_shared_run (st out : audit_floor_state) (events : audit_trace unit) : Prop :=
  exists frames, floor_strict_run st out frames /\ events = List.map floor_shared_event frames.

(** Price a fixed source frame by its actual operands in the shared abstract model. *)


(** Sum the fixed source-frame weights without a caller-selected valuation. *)
Definition floor_source_weight (events : audit_trace unit) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun event total => (floor_source_frame_weight event + total)%nat) 0%nat events.

(** Input size includes every natural field, including the update counter. *)
Definition floor_input_size (st : audit_floor_state) : nat :=
  (1 + audit_z_bits (Z.of_N (audit_floor_n st)) + audit_z_bits (Z.of_N (audit_floor_m st)) +
   audit_z_bits (Z.of_N (audit_floor_a st)) + audit_z_bits (Z.of_N (audit_floor_b st)) +
   audit_z_bits (Z.of_N (audit_floor_acc st)) +
   audit_z_bits (Z.of_N (audit_floor_updates st)))%nat.

(** Compute one tick while retaining the very operands used by that execution. *)
Definition audit_floor_tick_counted (st : audit_floor_state)
    : audit_floor_state * audit_trace unit :=
  let done := audit_floor_done st in
  if done then (st, [AuditCase 100 [1]; AuditCase 0 [1]]) else
  let n := audit_floor_n st in
  let m := audit_floor_m st in
  let a := audit_floor_a st in
  let b := audit_floor_b st in
  let ar := a mod m in
  let br := b mod m in
  let acc0 := audit_floor_acc st in
  let pred := N.pred n in
  let prod := n * pred in
  let triangle := prod / 2 in
  let aq := a / m in
  let first := triangle * aq in
  let acc1 := acc0 + first in
  let bq := b / m in
  let second := n * bq in
  let acc := acc1 + second in
  let scaled := ar * n in
  let y := scaled + br in
  let finished := y <? m in
  let prefix :=
    [AuditCase 100 [0]; AuditCase 0 [0]; AuditCase 101 [n]; AuditCase 102 [m];
     AuditCase 103 [a]; AuditCase 104 [b]; AuditArithmetic 5 [a; m];
     AuditArithmetic 5 [b; m]; AuditCase 105 [acc0]; AuditArithmetic 0 [n];
     AuditArithmetic 3 [n; pred]; AuditArithmetic 4 [prod; 2]; AuditArithmetic 4 [a; m];
     AuditArithmetic 3 [triangle; aq]; AuditArithmetic 2 [acc0; first];
     AuditArithmetic 4 [b; m]; AuditArithmetic 3 [n; bq]; AuditArithmetic 2 [acc1; second];
     AuditArithmetic 3 [ar; n]; AuditArithmetic 2 [scaled; br]; AuditArithmetic 6 [y; m];
     AuditCase 1 [floor_bool finished]] in
  if finished then
    let old_updates := audit_floor_updates st in
    let updates := N.succ old_updates in
    let out := AuditFloorState n m ar br acc true updates in
    (out, prefix ++ [AuditCase 106 [old_updates]; AuditArithmetic 1 [old_updates];
      AuditConstruct 0 [n; m; ar; br; acc; 1; updates]])
  else
    let quotient := y / m in
    let remainder := y mod m in
    let old_updates := audit_floor_updates st in
    let updates := N.succ old_updates in
    let out := AuditFloorState quotient ar m remainder acc false updates in
    (out, prefix ++ [AuditArithmetic 4 [y; m]; AuditArithmetic 5 [y; m];
      AuditCase 106 [old_updates]; AuditArithmetic 1 [old_updates];
      AuditConstruct 0 [quotient; ar; m; remainder; acc; 0; updates]]).

(** Count list cells in the actual recorded frame payloads. *)
Definition floor_payload_cells (events : audit_trace unit) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun event total =>
    match event with
    | AuditCase _ operands | AuditConstruct _ operands | AuditArithmetic _ operands =>
      (length operands + total)%nat
    | _ => total
    end) 0%nat events.

(** Charge trace frame constructors, list cells, append visits and the returned pair. *)
Definition floor_instrumentation_work (st : audit_floor_state) : nat :=
  let '(_, events) := audit_floor_tick_counted st in
  let copied := if audit_floor_done st then 0%nat else 22%nat in
  let inspections := if audit_floor_done st then 0%nat else 24%nat in
  (1 + audit_work events + audit_work events + copied + floor_payload_cells events +
    inspections)%nat.

Section FutureSharedTick.

  (** The counted output and events are those of one fixed source branch. *)
  Definition audit_floor_tick_source_correct_type : Prop := forall st,
    let '(out, events) := audit_floor_tick_counted st in
    floor_shared_run st out events /\ out = audit_floor_step st.

  (** Every actual tick has one source-shaped result and trace. *)
  Definition audit_floor_tick_source_total_type : Prop := forall st,
    exists out events, floor_shared_run st out events /\ out = audit_floor_step st.

  (** Direct source frames include the done and branch even after completion. *)
  Definition audit_floor_tick_source_count_type : Prop := forall st,
    let '(_, events) := audit_floor_tick_counted st in
    (2 <= audit_work events <= 27)%nat.

  (** The branch-specific frame count includes the completed terminal check. *)
  Definition audit_floor_tick_source_counts_exact_type : Prop := forall st,
    let '(_, events) := audit_floor_tick_counted st in
    if audit_floor_done st then audit_work events = 2%nat else
    let y := (audit_floor_a st mod audit_floor_m st * audit_floor_n st +
      audit_floor_b st mod audit_floor_m st)%N in
    audit_work events = if (y <? audit_floor_m st)%N then 25%nat else 27%nat.

  (** Event and trace construction have a fixed finite abstract bound. *)
  Definition audit_floor_tick_instrumentation_bound_type : Prop := forall st,
    (floor_instrumentation_work st <= 200)%nat.

  (** Instrumentation work follows the exact done, finished and continuing cases. *)
  Definition audit_floor_tick_instrumentation_exact_type : Prop := forall st,
    if audit_floor_done st then floor_instrumentation_work st = 7%nat else
    let y := (audit_floor_a st mod audit_floor_m st * audit_floor_n st +
      audit_floor_b st mod audit_floor_m st)%N in
    floor_instrumentation_work st = if (y <? audit_floor_m st)%N then 141%nat else 149%nat.

  (** Direct primitive weights are bounded by the actual input field sizes. *)
  Definition audit_floor_tick_source_weight_type : Prop := forall st,
    let '(_, events) := audit_floor_tick_counted st in
    let size := floor_input_size st in
    (floor_source_weight events <= 27 * (1 + (20 * size) * (20 * size)))%nat.
End FutureSharedTick.

(** * Concrete branch observations *)
```

```rocq
(** * Modular first-hit statement check

    This scratch file elaborates the proposed first-hit semantic propositions.
    For example, a zero prefix count characterizes no failure in one period.
    Builds on: ModCountCandidate and AnalysesScev. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List NArith PArith ZArith.
From Galois.Bits Require Import BitsWord.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesScev.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditScevModCountPlain.

From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditScevModSource.

(** * Future first-hit operation and proposition types *)

(** The retained diagnostic observer has the fixed probe's actual event list. *)
Definition mod_probe_trace w sg cmp a step bound := hit_probe_source w sg cmp a step bound.

Definition scev_mod_first_hit_agrees_type : Prop := forall w sg cmp a step bound,
  scev_mod_first_hit w sg cmp a step bound =
    affine_first_failure w sg cmp a step bound.

Definition audit_mod_period_positive_type : Prop := forall w step,
  (0 < audit_mod_period w step)%N.

Definition audit_mod_period_size_type : Prop := forall w step,
  (N.size (audit_mod_period w step) <= 1 + N.pos w)%N.

Definition scev_mod_no_exit_type : Prop := forall w sg cmp a step bound,
  scev_mod_first_hit w sg cmp a step bound = None <->
    scev_mod_count w sg cmp a step bound (audit_mod_period w step) = 0%N.

Definition scev_mod_first_hit_count_type : Prop := forall w sg cmp a step bound k,
  scev_mod_first_hit w sg cmp a step bound = Some k ->
  scev_mod_count w sg cmp a step bound k = 0%N /\
  scev_mod_count w sg cmp a step bound (N.succ k) = 1%N.

Definition scev_mod_trip {V : Type} (inv : V -> Z) (w : width) (sg : signedness)
    (cmp : cmp_kind) (ch : chrec V) (bound : iexpr V) : option N :=
  match ch with
  | CRec base (CInv step) =>
    scev_mod_first_hit w sg cmp (eval_chrec inv base O) (eval_iexpr inv step)
      (eval_iexpr inv bound)
  | _ => None
  end.

Definition scev_mod_trip_agrees_type : Prop := forall V (inv : V -> Z) w sg cmp ch bound,
  scev_mod_trip inv w sg cmp ch bound = trip_count inv w sg cmp ch bound.

Definition scev_mod_even_no_exit_type : Prop := forall w, (2 <= Pos.to_nat w)%nat ->
  scev_mod_first_hit w Unsigned CmpLt 0 2 (modulus w - 1) = None.

Definition audit_mod_even_no_fallback_type : Prop := forall w, (2 <= Pos.to_nat w)%nat ->
  fst (mod_probe_trace w Unsigned CmpLt 0 2 (modulus w - 1)) = Some None.

Definition audit_mod_one_bit_fallback_type : Prop := forall sg cmp a step bound,
  fst (mod_probe_trace 1%positive sg cmp a step bound) = None.
```

```rocq
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditScevCost.
```

```rocq
(** * Modular counting statement check

    This scratch file elaborates the proposed modular counting definitions.
    For example, a zero modulus produces a zero sum.
    Builds on: AnalysesScev and BitsWord. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List NArith PArith ZArith.
From Galois.Bits Require Import BitsWord.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesScev.

(** * Counting definitions and proposition types *)

Definition audit_floor_sum_reference (n modulus multiplier offset : N) : N :=
  snd (N.iter n (fun state =>
    let '(index, total) := state in
    (N.succ index, (total + (multiplier * index + offset) / modulus)%N))
    (0%N, 0%N)).

Record audit_floor_state : Type := AuditFloorState {
  audit_floor_n : N;
  audit_floor_m : N;
  audit_floor_a : N;
  audit_floor_b : N;
  audit_floor_acc : N;
  audit_floor_done : bool;
  audit_floor_updates : N
}.

Definition audit_floor_step (st : audit_floor_state) : audit_floor_state :=
  if audit_floor_done st then st else
  let n := audit_floor_n st in
  let m := audit_floor_m st in
  let a := audit_floor_a st in
  let b := audit_floor_b st in
  let ar := (a mod m)%N in
  let br := (b mod m)%N in
  let acc := (audit_floor_acc st + (n * N.pred n / 2) * (a / m) + n * (b / m))%N in
  let y := (ar * n + br)%N in
  if (y <? m)%N then AuditFloorState n m ar br acc true (N.succ (audit_floor_updates st))
  else AuditFloorState (y / m)%N ar m (y mod m)%N acc false (N.succ (audit_floor_updates st)).

Definition audit_floor_sum_counted (n m a b : N) : N * N * bool :=
  if (m =? 0)%N then (0%N, 0%N, false)
  else
    let final := N.iter (2 * N.size m + 1)%N audit_floor_step
      (AuditFloorState n m a b 0%N false 0%N) in
    (audit_floor_acc final, audit_floor_updates final, audit_floor_done final).

Definition audit_floor_state_bits (st : audit_floor_state) : N :=
  (N.size (audit_floor_n st) + N.size (audit_floor_m st) +
   N.size (audit_floor_a st) + N.size (audit_floor_b st) +
   N.size (audit_floor_acc st))%N.

Definition audit_floor_sum_fast (n m a b : N) : N :=
  let '(sum, _, _) := audit_floor_sum_counted n m a b in sum.

Definition audit_count_ge (floor_sum : N -> N -> N -> N -> N)
    (n modulus multiplier offset threshold : N) : N :=
  (floor_sum n modulus multiplier (offset + modulus - threshold) -
    floor_sum n modulus multiplier offset)%N.

Definition scev_mod_count (w : width) (sg : signedness) (cmp : cmp_kind)
    (a step bound : Z) (n : N) : N :=
  let word_mod := N.pos (word_period w) in
  let shift := match sg with Unsigned => 0%Z | Signed => (modulus w / 2)%Z end in
  let start := Z.to_N (wrap w (a + shift)) in
  let target := Z.to_N (wrap w (bound + shift)) in
  let delta := Z.to_N (wrap w step) in
  let ge k := audit_count_ge audit_floor_sum_fast n word_mod delta start k in
  match cmp with
  | CmpLt => ge target
  | CmpLe => ge (N.succ target)
  | CmpNe => (ge target - ge (N.succ target))%N
  end.

Definition audit_failed_indices (w : width) (sg : signedness) (cmp : cmp_kind)
    (a step bound : Z) (limit : N) (indices : list N) : Prop :=
  NoDup indices /\
  forall k, In k indices <->
    (k < limit)%N /\ affine_test w sg cmp a step bound k = false.

Definition scev_mod_count_exact_type : Prop := forall w sg cmp a step bound limit,
  exists indices, audit_failed_indices w sg cmp a step bound limit indices /\
    scev_mod_count w sg cmp a step bound limit = N.of_nat (length indices).

Definition audit_floor_sum_fast_correct_type : Prop := forall n m a b, (0 < m)%N ->
  audit_floor_sum_fast n m a b = audit_floor_sum_reference n m a b.

Definition audit_floor_sum_terminates_type : Prop := forall n m a b, (0 < m)%N ->
  let '(_, steps, done) := audit_floor_sum_counted n m a b in
  done = true /\ (steps <= 2 * N.size m + 1)%N.

Definition audit_floor_live_bits_type : Prop := forall n m a b k, (0 < m)%N ->
  (audit_floor_state_bits
    (N.iter k audit_floor_step (AuditFloorState n m a b 0%N false 0%N)) <=
    10 * (N.size n + N.size m + N.size a + N.size b + 1))%N.

(** A zero modulus takes the explicitly specified zero-result branch. *)
Definition audit_floor_sum_zero_type : Prop := forall n a b,
  audit_floor_sum_fast n 0 a b = 0%N.
```

```rocq
(** * Concrete modular first failure

    Prefix counts guide a binary first-failure search without constructing a source trace.
    For example, the one-bit format selects the legacy exhaustive fallback.
    Builds on: ModCountCandidate and AnalysesScev. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List NArith PArith ZArith Bool.
From Galois.Bits Require Import BitsWord.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesScev.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditScevModCountPlain.

Definition audit_mod_period (w : width) (step : Z) : N :=
  let m := N.pos (word_period w) in
  N.div m (N.gcd m (Z.to_N (wrap w step))).

Definition mod_hit_tick w sg cmp a step bound (state : N * N) : N * N :=
  let '(lo, hi) := state in
  if (lo <? hi)%N then
    let mid := ((lo + hi) / 2)%N in
    let next := N.succ mid in
    if (0 <? scev_mod_count w sg cmp a step bound next)%N then (lo, mid)
    else (next, hi)
  else state.

(** The probe's outer option records support independently of the no-exit result. *)
Definition mod_probe w sg cmp a step bound : option (option N) :=
  if Pos.leb 2 w then
    let period := audit_mod_period w step in
    if (period =? 0)%N then None
    else if (scev_mod_count w sg cmp a step bound period =? 0)%N then Some None
    else
      let state := N.iter (N.size period) (mod_hit_tick w sg cmp a step bound)
        (0%N, N.pred period) in
      let '(k, _) := state in
      let no_prior := (scev_mod_count w sg cmp a step bound k =? 0)%N in
      let failed := negb (affine_test w sg cmp a step bound k) in
      if no_prior && failed then Some (Some k) else None
  else None.

(** The public first-failure operation uses the fixed modular probe and exact old fallback. *)
Definition scev_mod_first_hit w sg cmp a step bound : option N :=
  match mod_probe w sg cmp a step bound with
  | Some out => out
  | None => affine_first_failure w sg cmp a step bound
  end.
```

```rocq
Definition recognize_check {S O N E V K C} (EN : encoding N) (EV : encoding V)
    (inventory : list V) (lv : loop_view S O N E V K C) (so : scev_ops K C) (x : V)
    : option (chrec V) := recognise EN EV inventory lv so x.

(** Successful recognition is sound for reachable header arrivals. *)
Definition recognize_sound_type : Prop :=
  forall (S O N E V K C : Type) (m : semantics S O)
    (EN : encoding N) (EE : encoding E) (EV : encoding V) (inventory : list V)
    (lv : loop_view S O N E V K C) (so : scev_ops K C) (x : V) (ch : chrec V),
    loop_view_laws m EN EV inventory so lv ->
    scev_ops_laws so (op_eval (lssa lv)) ->
    scev_extra_recognize EN EV inventory lv so x = Some ch ->
    forall s0 es s c, initial m s0 -> run_edges m (base (lssa lv)) s0 es s ->
      point (base (lssa lv)) s = lheader lv -> val (lssa lv) s x = Some c ->
      to_Z so c = wrap (width_of so)
        (eval_chrec (inv_env lv so s) ch (stay_arrivals EE lv es)).

(** Shared checking and compilation retain their existing cache laws. *)
Definition recognize_cache_type : Prop :=
  (forall (N V K C : Type) (EV : encoding V) (body : N -> bool)
    (ix : scev_static_index N V K) (so : scev_ops K C) rank (e : scev_expr V),
    scev_check_shared_expr_laws EV body ix so rank e) /\
  (forall (V : Type) (EV : encoding V) (lookup : V -> option (chrec V))
    (e : scev_expr V), scev_compile_shared_expr_laws EV lookup e).

(** Exact retained public semantic spellings. *)
Definition scev_extra_recognize_sound_type := recognize_sound_type.
Definition scev_extra_cache_valid_type := recognize_cache_type.
```

## Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditScevRecognizeCheck

```rocq
(** * Shared recognizer checking source model

    This file fixes every rank/cache validation and local binding-gate body at its actual operands.
    For example, both rank observations execute for every support key after an earlier mismatch.
    Builds on: RecognizeClosure and the frozen Collections source models. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List NArith PArith ZArith Bool Arith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsSsa.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesScev.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditCost.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditScevRecognizeTrace.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditMapFold.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditUnion.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditEncoding.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditTrie.
Import List.ListNotations.

Section CheckerSource.
Context {S O Node E V K C : Type} (EN : encoding Node) (EV : encoding V)
  (lv : loop_view S O Node E V K C) (so : scev_ops K C).

Inductive sr_check_call : Type :=
  | SrCheckClosure (call : @sr_closure_call V)
  | SrCheckEncodeNode (input : Node) (output : positive)
  | SrCheckBody (input : Node) (output : bool)
  | SrCheckAdd (input : K) (output : bool)
  | SrCheckMul (input : K) (output : bool)
  | SrCheckConstant (input : K) (output : option Z)
  | SrCheckSupport (input : FinSet.t V)
  | SrCheckNatural (input : nat).

Definition check_measure : Type := nat * list sr_check_call.
Definition check_run (A : Type) : Type := A * check_measure.

Definition check_return {A} (value : A) : check_run A := (value, (100%nat, [])).

Definition check_bind {A B} (first : check_run A) (next : A -> check_run B) : check_run B :=
  let '(a, (w1, c1)) := first in
  let '(b, (w2, c2)) := next a in (b, ((w1 + w2)%nat, c1 ++ c2)).

Notation "x <- first ;; next" := (check_bind first (fun x => next))
  (at level 100, first at next level, right associativity).

Definition check_lift {A} (run : A * (nat * list (@sr_closure_call V))) : check_run A :=
  let '(out, (work, calls)) := run in (out, (work, map SrCheckClosure calls)).

Definition check_get {A} (x : V) (input : Map.t V A) : check_run (option A) :=
  check_lift (sr_get EV x input).

Definition check_code_get {A} (x : positive) (input : Map.t positive A)
    : check_run (option A) := check_lift (@sr_code_get V A x input).

Definition check_code_set {A} (x : positive) (value : A) (input : Map.t positive A)
    : check_run (Map.t positive A) := check_lift (@sr_code_set V A x value input).

Definition check_body (node : Node) : check_run bool :=
  let out := lbody lv node in (out, (101%nat, [SrCheckBody node out])).

Definition check_flag (multiply : bool) (op : K) : check_run bool :=
  let out := if multiply then mul_op so op else add_op so op in
  (out, (101%nat, [if multiply then SrCheckMul op out else SrCheckAdd op out])).

Definition check_key (x y : V) : check_run bool :=
  let first := encode EV x in
  let second := encode EV y in
  (Pos.eqb first second,
    ((102 + audit_binary_weight (Z.pos first) (Z.pos second))%nat,
      [SrCheckClosure (SrClosureEncode x first); SrCheckClosure (SrClosureEncode y second)])).

Definition check_node_key (x y : Node) : check_run bool :=
  let first := encode EN x in
  let second := encode EN y in
  (Pos.eqb first second,
    ((102 + audit_binary_weight (Z.pos first) (Z.pos second))%nat,
      [SrCheckEncodeNode x first; SrCheckEncodeNode y second])).

Definition check_union (a b : FinSet.t V) : check_run (FinSet.t V) :=
  let events := snd (audit_finset_union a b) in
  (FinSet.union EV a b,
    (audit_finset_union_source_work events, [SrCheckSupport a; SrCheckSupport b])).

Definition check_add (x : V) (input : FinSet.t V) : check_run (FinSet.t V) :=
  check_lift (sr_set EV x tt input).

Definition check_mem {A} (x : V) (input : Map.t V A) : check_run bool :=
  found <- check_get x input ;;
  check_return (match found with Some _ => true | None => false end).

(** A binary gate evaluates body, flag and both ordered key comparisons strictly. *)
Definition check_binary (ix : scev_static_index Node V K) (multiply : bool)
    (x lhs rhs : V) : check_run bool :=
  found <- check_get x (ssi_values ix) ;;
  match found with
  | Some (node, Op op [a; b]) =>
    inside <- check_body node ;;
    flag <- check_flag multiply op ;;
    first <- check_key a lhs ;;
    second <- check_key b rhs ;; check_return (inside && flag && first && second)
  | _ => check_return false
  end.

Definition check_constant (ix : scev_static_index Node V K) (x : V) (z : Z) : check_run bool :=
  found <- check_get x (ssi_values ix) ;;
  match found with
  | Some (node, Op op []) =>
    inside <- check_body node ;;
    let out := const_op so op in
    let '(exact, equality_work) := match out with
      | None => (false, 100%nat)
      | Some value => ((value =? z)%Z, (100 + audit_binary_weight value z)%nat)

    (inside && exact, ((101 + equality_work)%nat, [SrCheckConstant op out]))
  | _ => check_return false
  end.

Definition check_phi_before (ix : scev_static_index Node V K) (rank : nat) (x : V)
    : check_run bool :=
  found <- check_get x (sri_ranks (ssi_phi ix)) ;;
  match found with
  | None => check_return false
  | Some position =>
    (Nat.ltb position rank,
      ((100 + Nat.min position rank)%nat, [SrCheckNatural position; SrCheckNatural rank]))
  end.

Definition check_context_entry (ix : scev_static_index Node V K) (rank old : nat)
    (acc : bool) (x : V) (_ : unit) : bool * list check_measure :=
  let '(current, (w1, c1)) := check_phi_before ix rank x in
  let '(previous, (w2, c2)) := check_phi_before ix old x in
  (acc && Bool.eqb current previous, [((100 + w1 + w2)%nat, c1 ++ c2)]).

Definition check_context (ix : scev_static_index Node V K) (rank old : nat) (support : FinSet.t V)
    : check_run bool :=
  let '(out, events) := audit_map_fold (check_context_entry ix rank old) support true in
  let child_work := fun children : list check_measure =>
    fold_right (fun child total => (fst child + total)%nat) 0%nat children in
  let calls := flat_map (fun event =>
    match event with AuditMapFoldCall _ _ _ _ _ children => flat_map snd children | _ => [] end)
      events in
  (out, (audit_map_fold_source_work child_work events, SrCheckSupport support :: calls)).

Definition check_store (code : positive) rank (result : scev_expr_check_result V)
    (memo : scev_shared_check_memo V) : check_run (scev_shared_check_memo V) :=
  entries <- check_code_set code (rank, result) (scc_entries memo) ;;
  check_return (ScevCache entries (scc_hits memo) (code :: scc_misses memo)).

(** The exact shared checker composes its cached and uncached source bodies on one memo history. *)
Fixpoint sr_check_expr_source (ix : scev_static_index Node V K) (rank : nat)
    (e : scev_prepared_expr V) (memo : scev_shared_check_memo V)
    : check_run (scev_expr_check_result V * scev_shared_check_memo V) :=
  let code := scev_prepared_code e in
  let finish result memo' := stored <- check_store code rank result memo' ;;
    check_return (result, stored) in
  let failed := (false, @FinSet.empty V) in
  let compute := fun _ : unit =>
    match e with
    | POutside _ _ x =>
      found <- check_get x (ssi_values ix) ;;
      match found with
      | Some (node, _) => inside <- check_body node ;; finish (negb inside, FinSet.empty) memo
      | None => finish failed memo
      end
    | PPhi _ _ x =>
      present <- check_mem x (ssi_values ix) ;;
      earlier <- check_phi_before ix rank x ;;
      support <- check_add x FinSet.empty ;; finish (present && earlier, support) memo
    | PAdd _ _ x a b | PMul _ _ x a b =>
      let multiply := match e with PMul _ _ _ _ _ => true | _ => false end in
      valid <- check_binary ix multiply x (scev_prepared_root a) (scev_prepared_root b) ;;
      if valid then
        first <- sr_check_expr_source ix rank a memo ;;
        let '(ra, ma) := first in
        if fst ra then
          second <- sr_check_expr_source ix rank b ma ;;
          let '(rb, mb) := second in
          support <- check_union (snd ra) (snd rb) ;; finish (fst rb, support) mb
        else finish failed ma
      else finish failed memo
    | PConst _ _ x z => valid <- check_constant ix x z ;; finish (valid, FinSet.empty) memo
    end in

  match found with
  | None => compute tt
  | Some (old, result) =>

    if valid then check_return
      (result, ScevCache (scc_entries memo) (code :: scc_hits memo) (scc_misses memo))
    else compute tt
  end.

(** Update-gate arguments are selected from the actual prepared root and feedback orientation. *)
Definition check_update_gate (ix : scev_static_index Node V K)
    (b : scev_binding V) (other : option (scev_prepared_expr V)) : check_run bool :=
  match sb_kind b, other with
  | SDoubleUpdate, None =>
    valid <- check_binary ix false (sb_update_value b) (sb_phi b) (sb_phi b) ;;
    check_return (sb_phi_first b && valid)
  | SAddUpdate, Some e | SMulUpdate, Some e =>
    let root := scev_prepared_root e in
    equal <- check_key root (sb_phi b) ;;
    let multiply := match sb_kind b with SAddUpdate => false | _ => true end in
    valid <- check_binary ix multiply (sb_update_value b)
      (if sb_phi_first b then sb_phi b else root)
      (if sb_phi_first b then root else sb_phi b) ;;
    check_return (negb equal && valid)
  | _, _ => check_return false
  end.

(** A positional read executes its actual unary index encoder only when reached. *)
Definition check_argument_get (index : nat) (input : Map.t nat V) : check_run (option V) :=

    ((100 + audit_nat_events_work encoded + audit_trie_get_source_work code input)%nat,
      [SrCheckNatural index])).

Definition check_binding_gate (ix : scev_static_index Node V K)
    (b : scev_binding V) (other : option (scev_prepared_expr V)) : check_run bool :=
  phi <- check_get (sb_phi b) (ssi_values ix) ;;
  match phi with
  | Some (phi_home, Param header index) =>
    base <- check_get (sb_base b) (ssi_values ix) ;;
    match base with
    | Some (base_home, _) =>
      update <- check_get (sb_update_value b) (ssi_values ix) ;;
      match update with
      | Some (update_home, _) =>
        first <- check_node_key phi_home (lheader lv) ;;
        second <- check_node_key header (lheader lv) ;;
        base_inside <- check_body base_home ;;
        update_inside <- check_body update_home ;;
        if first && second && negb base_inside && update_inside then
          entry <- check_argument_get index (ssi_entry ix) ;;
          match entry with
          | Some base_value =>
            back <- check_argument_get index (ssi_back ix) ;;
            match back with
            | Some update_value =>
              base_ok <- check_key base_value (sb_base b) ;;
              update_ok <- check_key update_value (sb_update_value b) ;;
              if base_ok && update_ok then check_update_gate ix b other else check_return false
            | None => check_return false
            end
          | None => check_return false
          end
        else check_return false
      | None => check_return false
      end
    | None => check_return false
    end
  | _ => check_return false
  end.

Definition sr_check_binding_source (ix : scev_static_index Node V K) rank
    (b : scev_prepared_binding EV) (memo : scev_shared_check_memo V)
    : check_run (option (FinSet.t V * scev_shared_check_memo V)) :=
  valid <- check_binding_gate ix (spb_source b) (spb_other b) ;;
  if valid then
    match sb_kind (spb_source b), spb_other b with
    | SDoubleUpdate, None => check_return (Some (FinSet.empty, memo))
    | SAddUpdate, Some e | SMulUpdate, Some e =>
      checked <- sr_check_expr_source ix rank e memo ;;
      let '(result, memo') := checked in
      check_return (if fst result then Some (snd result, memo') else None)
    | _, _ => check_return None
    end
  else check_return None.

Fixpoint sr_check_bindings_source (ix : scev_static_index Node V K) rank
    (bs : list (scev_prepared_binding EV)) checked (memo : scev_shared_check_memo V)
    : check_run (option (list (V * FinSet.t V) * scev_shared_check_memo V)) :=

  | [] => check_return (Some (checked, memo))
  | b :: rest =>
    result <- sr_check_binding_source ix rank b memo ;;
    match result with
    | None => check_return None
    | Some (deps, memo') => sr_check_bindings_source ix (Nat.succ rank) rest
      ((sb_phi (spb_source b), deps) :: checked) memo'
    end
  end.

Fixpoint sr_check_dependencies_source (rows : list (V * FinSet.t V)) (needed : FinSet.t V)
    : check_run bool :=
  match rows with
  | [] => check_return true
  | (x, deps) :: rest =>
    present <- check_mem x needed ;;
    if present then expanded <- check_union needed deps ;;
      sr_check_dependencies_source rest expanded
    else check_return false
  end.

Definition sr_check_plan_source (ix : scev_static_index Node V K)
    (bs : list (scev_prepared_binding EV)) (target : V)
    : check_run (bool * scev_shared_check_memo V) :=
  present <- check_mem target (ssi_values ix) ;;
  if present && sri_distinct (ssi_phi ix) then
    match sri_final (ssi_phi ix) with
    | None => check_return (false, scev_cache_empty)
    | Some last =>
      final <- check_key last target ;;
      if final then
        result <- sr_check_bindings_source ix 0 bs [] scev_cache_empty ;;
        match result with
        | None => check_return (false, scev_cache_empty)
        | Some (checked, memo) =>
          needed <- check_add target FinSet.empty ;;
          accepted <- sr_check_dependencies_source checked needed ;;
          check_return (accepted, memo)
        end
      else check_return (false, scev_cache_empty)
    end
  else check_return (false, scev_cache_empty).

(** Shared checking erases to the existing context-validated checker on all malformed inputs. *)
Definition sr_check_plan_source_erases_type : Prop := forall ix bs target,
  fst (sr_check_plan_source ix bs target) = scev_check_shared_plan EN EV lv so ix bs target.

End CheckerSource.
```

## Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditScevRecognizePlain

Card: AUD-SR-CLOSURE

Source destination: `theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditScevRecognizePlain.v`.

```rocq
(** * Concrete recognition with a lean captured-map compiler

    Recognition retains the prepared producer and checker, and uses explicit Boolean equality.
    For example, a compiler cache entry is reused only when every referenced phi still agrees.
    Builds on: AnalysesScev and RecognizeClosure. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List NArith PArith ZArith Bool.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesScev.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditScevRecognizeTrace.
Import List.ListNotations.

Section PlainCompiler.
Context {V : Type} (EV : encoding V).

Fixpoint scev_iexpr_equal_lean (a b : iexpr V) : bool :=
  match a, b with
  | IVar x, IVar y => Pos.eqb (encode EV x) (encode EV y)
  | IConst x, IConst y | IWordConst x, IWordConst y => (x =? y)%Z
  | IAdd a1 a2, IAdd b1 b2 | IMul a1 a2, IMul b1 b2 =>
    scev_iexpr_equal_lean a1 b1 && scev_iexpr_equal_lean a2 b2
  | _, _ => false
  end.

Fixpoint scev_chrec_equal_lean (a b : chrec V) : bool :=
  match a, b with
  | CInv x, CInv y => scev_iexpr_equal_lean x y
  | CRec a1 a2, CRec b1 b2 | CGeo a1 a2, CGeo b1 b2 |
    CSum a1 a2, CSum b1 b2 | CProduct a1 a2, CProduct b1 b2 =>
    scev_chrec_equal_lean a1 b1 && scev_chrec_equal_lean a2 b2
  | _, _ => false
  end.

(** The separately named lean comparator has the legacy Boolean value, with a distinct body. *)
Definition scev_lookup_equal_lean (a b : option (chrec V)) : bool :=
  match a, b with
  | None, None => true
  | Some x, Some y => scev_chrec_equal_lean x y
  | _, _ => false
  end.

Definition scev_captured_context_lean (env snapshot : Map.t V (chrec V))
    (support : FinSet.t V) : bool :=
  Map.fold (fun acc x _ =>
    acc && scev_lookup_equal_lean (Map.get EV x env) (Map.get EV x snapshot)) support true.

Definition scev_captured_store_lean (code : positive) (env : Map.t V (chrec V))
    (c : chrec V) (memo : @sr_compiler_memo V) : @sr_compiler_memo V :=
  SrCompilerMemo (Map.set positive_encoding code (env, c) (src_entries memo))
    (src_hits memo) (code :: src_misses memo).

Fixpoint scev_captured_compile_lean (env : Map.t V (chrec V)) (e : scev_prepared_expr V)
    (memo : @sr_compiler_memo V) : option (chrec V * @sr_compiler_memo V) :=
  let code := scev_prepared_code e in
  let finish c memo' := Some (c, scev_captured_store_lean code env c memo') in
  let compute := fun _ : unit =>
    match e with
    | POutside _ _ x => finish (CInv (IVar x)) memo
    | PPhi _ _ x =>
      match Map.get EV x env with
      | Some c => finish c memo
      | None => None
      end
    | PAdd _ _ _ a b | PMul _ _ _ a b =>
      match scev_captured_compile_lean env a memo with
      | None => None
      | Some (ca, ma) =>
        match scev_captured_compile_lean env b ma with
        | None => None
        | Some (cb, mb) =>
          finish (match e with PAdd _ _ _ _ _ => chrec_add ca cb
            | _ => chrec_mul ca cb end) mb
        end
      end
    | PConst _ _ _ z => finish (CInv (IWordConst z)) memo
    end in
  match Map.get positive_encoding code (src_entries memo) with
  | None => compute tt
  | Some (snapshot, c) =>
    if scev_captured_context_lean env snapshot (scev_prepared_phis e) then
      Some (c, SrCompilerMemo (src_entries memo) (code :: src_hits memo) (src_misses memo))
    else compute tt
  end.

Fixpoint scev_captured_bindings_lean (bs : list (scev_prepared_binding EV))
    (env : Map.t V (chrec V)) (memo : @sr_compiler_memo V)
    : option (Map.t V (chrec V) * @sr_compiler_memo V) :=
  match bs with
  | [] => Some (env, memo)
  | b :: rest =>
    let source := spb_source b in
    let base := CInv (IVar (sb_base source)) in
    let compiled := match sb_kind source with
      | SDoubleUpdate => Some (CGeo base (CInv (IConst 2)), memo)
      | SAddUpdate | SMulUpdate =>
        match spb_other b with
        | None => None
        | Some e =>
          match scev_captured_compile_lean env e memo with
          | None => None
          | Some (c, memo') => Some
            ((match sb_kind source with SAddUpdate => CRec base c | _ => CGeo base c end), memo')
          end
        end
      end in
    match compiled with
    | None => None
    | Some (c, memo') =>
      scev_captured_bindings_lean rest (Map.set EV (sb_phi source) c env) memo'
    end
  end.

Definition scev_captured_plan_lean (bs : list (scev_prepared_binding EV)) (x : V)
    : option (chrec V) :=
  match scev_captured_bindings_lean bs Map.empty sr_compiler_empty with
  | None => None
  | Some (env, _) => Map.get EV x env
  end.

(** This closed value claim does not claim source identity with the proof-producing decider. *)
Definition scev_lookup_equal_lean_agrees_statement : Prop := forall a b,
  scev_lookup_equal_lean a b = scev_lookup_eqb EV a b.

(** The compiler source instruments the fixed lean compiler with the same retained memo. *)
Definition scev_captured_compile_lean_erases_statement : Prop := forall env e memo,
  fst (sr_compile_expr_source EV env e memo) = scev_captured_compile_lean env e memo.

End PlainCompiler.

(** The public lean recognizer prepares once, checks once and compiles the retained graph. *)
Definition scev_extra_recognize {S O Node E V K C} (EN : encoding Node) (EV : encoding V)
    (inventory : list V) (lv : loop_view S O Node E V K C) (so : scev_ops K C) (x : V)
    : option (chrec V) :=
  let source_ix := scev_prepare_index EV inventory lv (ScevPlan [] x) in
  let next := fun st => scev_producer_advance EN EV lv so source_ix
    (sps_work st) (sps_active st) (sps_done st) (sps_bindings st)
    (sps_hits st) (sps_prepared st) in
  match scev_producer_iterate (Pos.of_succ_nat (length inventory)) next
    (ScevProducerState [SVisit x] FinSet.empty Map.empty [] [] []) with
  | None => None
  | Some st =>
    match sps_work st with
    | _ :: _ => None
    | [] =>
      let bs := rev (sps_bindings st) in
      let ranks := scev_rank_index_from EV 0 (map spb_source bs) in
      let ix := ScevStaticIndex (ssi_values source_ix) (ssi_entry source_ix)
        (ssi_back source_ix) ranks in
      let '(accepted, _) := scev_check_shared_plan EN EV lv so ix bs x in
      if accepted then scev_captured_plan_lean EV bs x else None
    end
  end.

(** Exact legacy result agreement includes malformed inputs and cache rejection. *)
Definition scev_extra_recognize_agrees_statement : Prop := forall S O Node E V K C
    (EN : encoding Node) (EV : encoding V) inventory (lv : loop_view S O Node E V K C) so x,
  scev_extra_recognize EN EV inventory lv so x = recognise EN EV inventory lv so x.
```

```rocq
(** * Complete recognizer preparation and producer source equations

    This file composes inventory setup, full encoded keys, producer states and both shared
      consumers.
    For example, a completed child is reused through its stored prepared node without tree
      ingestion.
    Builds on: RecognizeClosure, RecognizeCheckWhole and the Collections models. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List NArith PArith ZArith Bool Arith.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsMap CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Views Require Import ViewsSsa.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesScev AnalysesNumbering.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditScevRecognizePlain.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditCost.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditScevRecognizeTrace.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditScevRecognizeCheck.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditEncoding.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditTrie.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditUnion.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditElements.
Import List.ListNotations.

Section RecognizerSource.
Context {S O Node E V K C : Type} (EN : encoding Node) (EV : encoding V)
  (lv : loop_view S O Node E V K C) (so : scev_ops K C).

Inductive sr_producer_call : Type :=
  | SrProducerCheck (call : @sr_check_call Node V K)
  | SrProducerHome (input : V) (output : Node)
  | SrProducerDefinition (input : V) (output : definition Node V K)
  | SrProducerArguments (input : E) (output : list V)
  | SrProducerCode (input : list positive) (output : positive)
  | SrProducerSupport (input : FinSet.t V)
  | SrProducerAdvance (input : list (scev_work V))
  | SrProducerCommand (input : scev_work V).

Definition producer_run (A : Type) : Type := A * (nat * list sr_producer_call).

Definition producer_return {A} (value : A) : producer_run A := (value, (100%nat, [])).

Definition producer_mark {A} (call : sr_producer_call) (run : producer_run A) : producer_run A :=
  let '(out, (work, calls)) := run in (out, (work, call :: calls)).

Definition producer_bind {A B} (first : producer_run A) (next : A -> producer_run B)
    : producer_run B :=
  let '(a, (w1, c1)) := first in
  let '(b, (w2, c2)) := next a in (b, ((w1 + w2)%nat, c1 ++ c2)).

Notation "x <- first ;; next" := (producer_bind first (fun x => next))
  (at level 100, first at next level, right associativity).

Definition producer_lift {A} (run : A * (nat * list (@sr_check_call Node V K)))
    : producer_run A :=
  let '(out, (work, calls)) := run in (out, (work, map SrProducerCheck calls)).

Definition producer_get {A} (x : V) (input : Map.t V A) : producer_run (option A) :=
  producer_lift (check_get EV x input).

Definition producer_set {A} (x : V) (value : A) (input : Map.t V A) : producer_run (Map.t V A) :=
  let '(out, (work, calls)) := sr_set EV x value input in
  (out, (work, map (fun call => SrProducerCheck (SrCheckClosure call)) calls)).

Definition producer_mem {A} (x : V) (input : Map.t V A) : producer_run bool :=
  found <- producer_get x input ;;
  producer_return (match found with Some _ => true | None => false end).

Definition producer_remove (x : V) (input : FinSet.t V) : producer_run (FinSet.t V) :=
  let code := encode EV x in
  (FinSet.remove EV x input,
    ((104 + audit_trie_update_source_work code None input)%nat,
      [SrProducerCheck (SrCheckClosure (SrClosureEncode x code))])).

Definition producer_add (x : V) (input : FinSet.t V) : producer_run (FinSet.t V) :=
  producer_set x tt input.

Definition producer_argument_get (index : nat) (input : Map.t nat V) : producer_run (option V) :=
  let '(code, encoded) := audit_nat_encode index in
  (Map.get nat_encoding index input,
    ((104 + audit_nat_events_work encoded + audit_trie_get_source_work code input)%nat, [])).

Definition producer_code (codes : list positive) : producer_run positive :=
  let '(out, events) := audit_list_encode audit_positive_encode codes in
  (out, (audit_list_events_work audit_basic_encoding_work events, [SrProducerCode codes out])).

Definition producer_encode (x : V) : producer_run positive :=
  let code := encode EV x in
  (code, (101%nat, [SrProducerCheck (SrCheckClosure (SrClosureEncode x code))])).

Definition producer_prepare_binary (multiply : bool) (x : V)
    (a b : scev_prepared_expr V) : producer_run (scev_prepared_expr V) :=
  code_x <- producer_encode x ;;
  code <- producer_code [if multiply then 4%positive else 3%positive;
    code_x; scev_prepared_code a; scev_prepared_code b] ;;
  let events := snd (audit_finset_union (scev_prepared_phis a) (scev_prepared_phis b)) in
  let phis := FinSet.union EV (scev_prepared_phis a) (scev_prepared_phis b) in
  (if multiply then PMul code phis x a b else PAdd code phis x a b,
    ((100 + audit_finset_union_source_work events)%nat,
      [SrProducerSupport (scev_prepared_phis a); SrProducerSupport (scev_prepared_phis b)])).

(** External ingestion traverses every tree occurrence and encodes every complete key. *)
Fixpoint producer_prepare_expr (e : scev_expr V) : producer_run (scev_prepared_expr V) :=
  match e with
  | SOutside x =>
    cx <- producer_encode x ;;
    code <- producer_code [1%positive; cx] ;; producer_return (POutside code FinSet.empty x)
  | SPhi x =>
    cx <- producer_encode x ;;
    code <- producer_code [2%positive; cx] ;;
    phis <- producer_add x FinSet.empty ;; producer_return (PPhi code phis x)
  | SAdd x a b =>
    first <- producer_prepare_expr a ;;
    second <- producer_prepare_expr b ;; producer_prepare_binary false x first second
  | SMul x a b =>
    first <- producer_prepare_expr a ;;
    second <- producer_prepare_expr b ;; producer_prepare_binary true x first second
  | SConst x z =>
    cx <- producer_encode x ;;
    let '(cz, z_events) := audit_z_encode z in
    code <- producer_code [5%positive; cx; cz] ;;
    (PConst code FinSet.empty x z, ((100 + audit_basic_encoding_work z_events)%nat, []))
  end.

Definition producer_complete_leaf (e : scev_expr V) : producer_run (scev_completed EV) :=
  let '(_, (work, calls)) := producer_prepare_expr e in
  (scev_complete_leaf EV e, ((100 + work)%nat, calls)).

Definition producer_complete_binary (multiply : bool) (x : V) (a b : scev_completed EV)
    : producer_run (scev_completed EV) :=
  let '(_, (work, calls)) := producer_prepare_binary multiply x (sc_prepared a) (sc_prepared b) in
  (scev_complete_binary EV multiply x a b, ((100 + work)%nat, calls)).

Definition producer_finish (rest : list (scev_work V)) (st : scev_producer_state EV)
    (x : V) (e : scev_expr V) : producer_run (scev_producer_state EV) :=
  value <- producer_complete_leaf e ;;
  done <- producer_set x value (sps_done st) ;;
  producer_return (ScevProducerState rest (sps_active st) done (sps_bindings st)
    (sps_hits st) (x :: sps_prepared st)).

(** Phi expansion evaluates all strict header/body/key tests and only selected operation branches.
  *)
Definition producer_expand_phi (ix : scev_static_index Node V K) (rest : list (scev_work V))
    (st : scev_producer_state EV) (x : V) (header : Node) (index : nat)
    : producer_run (option (scev_producer_state EV)) :=
  header_ok <- producer_lift (check_node_key EN header (lheader lv)) ;;
  if header_ok then
    entry <- producer_argument_get index (ssi_entry ix) ;;
    match entry with
    | Some base => back <- producer_argument_get index (ssi_back ix) ;; match back with
    | Some update =>
      base_value <- producer_get base (ssi_values ix) ;;
      match base_value with
      | Some (base_home, _) => update_value <- producer_get update (ssi_values ix) ;;
        match update_value with
        | Some (update_home, Op op [arg_left; arg_right]) =>
        base_inside <- producer_lift (check_body lv base_home) ;;
        update_inside <- producer_lift (check_body lv update_home) ;;
        if negb base_inside && update_inside then
          lhs <- producer_lift (check_key EV arg_left x) ;;
          rhs <- producer_lift (check_key EV arg_right x) ;;
          addition <- producer_lift (check_flag so false op) ;;
          if addition && lhs && rhs then
            value <- producer_complete_leaf (SPhi x) ;;
            done <- producer_set x value (sps_done st) ;;
            producer_return (Some (ScevProducerState rest (sps_active st) done
              (scev_complete_double EV x base update :: sps_bindings st)
              (sps_hits st) (x :: sps_prepared st)))
          else if lhs || rhs then
            let other := if lhs then arg_right else arg_left in
            is_add <- producer_lift (check_flag so false op) ;;
            kind <- (if is_add then producer_return (Some SAddUpdate) else
              is_mul <- producer_lift (check_flag so true op) ;;
              producer_return (if is_mul then Some SMulUpdate else None)) ;;
            match kind with
            | None => producer_return None
            | Some update_kind =>
              active <- producer_add x (sps_active st) ;;
              producer_return (Some (ScevProducerState
                (SVisit other :: SFinishPhi x base update other update_kind lhs :: rest)
                active (sps_done st) (sps_bindings st) (sps_hits st) (sps_prepared st)))
            end
          else producer_return None
        else producer_return None
        | _ => producer_return None end
      | _ => producer_return None end
    | _ => producer_return None end
    | _ => producer_return None end
  else producer_return None.

Definition producer_expand_value (ix : scev_static_index Node V K) (rest : list (scev_work V))
    (st : scev_producer_state EV) (x : V) : producer_run (option (scev_producer_state EV)) :=
  found <- producer_get x (ssi_values ix) ;;
  match found with
  | None => producer_return None
  | Some (node, definition) =>
    inside <- producer_lift (check_body lv node) ;;
    if inside then
      match definition with
      | Param header index => producer_expand_phi ix rest st x header index
      | Op op [] =>
        let out := const_op so op in
        let '(result, (work, calls)) := match out with
          | None => producer_return None
          | Some z => next <- producer_finish rest st x (SConst x z) ;;
            producer_return (Some next)
          end in
        (result, ((101 + work)%nat, SrProducerCheck (SrCheckConstant op out) :: calls))
      | Op op [a; b] =>
        is_add <- producer_lift (check_flag so false op) ;;
        command <- (if is_add then producer_return (Some (SFinishAdd x a b)) else
          is_mul <- producer_lift (check_flag so true op) ;;
          producer_return (if is_mul then Some (SFinishMul x a b) else None)) ;;
        match command with
        | None => producer_return None
        | Some next =>
          active <- producer_add x (sps_active st) ;;
          producer_return (Some (ScevProducerState (SVisit a :: SVisit b :: next :: rest)
            active (sps_done st) (sps_bindings st) (sps_hits st) (sps_prepared st)))
        end
      | _ => producer_return None
      end
    else next <- producer_finish rest st x (SOutside x) ;; producer_return (Some next)
  end.

(** Every administrative command is charged at its actual worklist and persistent-map state. *)
Fixpoint producer_advance (ix : scev_static_index Node V K) (work : list (scev_work V))
    (active : FinSet.t V) (done : Map.t V (scev_completed EV))
    (bindings : list (scev_prepared_binding EV)) (hits prepared : list V)
    : producer_run (option (scev_producer_state EV)) :=
  match work with
  | [] => producer_return (Some (ScevProducerState [] active done bindings hits prepared))
  | command :: rest =>
    let st := ScevProducerState work active done bindings hits prepared in
    producer_mark (SrProducerCommand command) (
    match command with
    | SVisit x =>
      completed <- producer_mem x done ;;
      if completed then producer_advance ix rest active done bindings (x :: hits) prepared else
      cyclic <- producer_mem x active ;;
      if cyclic then producer_return None else producer_expand_value ix rest st x
    | SFinishAdd x a b | SFinishMul x a b =>
      first <- producer_get a done ;;
      match first with
      | Some lhs => second <- producer_get b done ;; match second with
      | Some rhs =>
        let multiply := match command with SFinishMul _ _ _ => true | _ => false end in
        new_active <- producer_remove x active ;;
        value <- producer_complete_binary multiply x lhs rhs ;;
        new_done <- producer_set x value done ;;
        producer_advance ix rest new_active new_done bindings hits (x :: prepared)
      | _ => producer_return None end
      | _ => producer_return None end
    | SFinishPhi x base update other kind first_phi =>
      found <- producer_get other done ;;
      match found with
      | None => producer_return None
      | Some e =>
        new_active <- producer_remove x active ;;
        value <- producer_complete_leaf (SPhi x) ;;
        new_done <- producer_set x value done ;;
        producer_advance ix rest new_active new_done
          (scev_complete_binding EV x base update kind first_phi e :: bindings) hits (x :: prepared)
      end
    end)
  end.

(** Binary fuel retains every actual terminal check and never prices an unexecuted producer step. *)
Fixpoint producer_iterate (ix : scev_static_index Node V K) (fuel : positive)
    (st : scev_producer_state EV) : producer_run (option (scev_producer_state EV)) :=
  let next state := producer_mark (SrProducerAdvance (sps_work state))
    (producer_advance ix (sps_work state) (sps_active state) (sps_done state)
      (sps_bindings state) (sps_hits state) (sps_prepared state)) in
  match sps_work st with
  | [] => producer_return (Some st)
  | _ =>
    match fuel with
    | xH => next st
    | xO p =>
      first <- producer_iterate ix p st ;;
      match first with None => producer_return None | Some mid => producer_iterate ix p mid end
    | xI p =>
      first <- producer_iterate ix p st ;;
      match first with
      | None => producer_return None
      | Some mid =>
        second <- producer_iterate ix p mid ;;
        match second with None => producer_return None | Some later => next later end
      end
    end
  end.

(** The instrumented producer has exactly the existing native state result. *)
Definition producer_advance_erases_type : Prop := forall ix work active done bs hits prepared,
  fst (producer_advance ix work active done bs hits prepared) =
    scev_producer_advance EN EV lv so ix work active done bs hits prepared.

(** Prepared ingestion preserves the exact complete structural key and support at every node. *)
Definition producer_prepare_expr_erases_type : Prop := forall e,
  fst (producer_prepare_expr e) = scev_prepare_expr EV e.

(** Inventory preparation retains both real client callbacks before the persistent update. *)
Fixpoint producer_inventory (inventory : list V)
    : producer_run (Map.t V (Node * definition Node V K)) :=
  match inventory with
  | [] => producer_return Map.empty
  | x :: rest =>
    let node := home (lssa lv) x in
    let source := def (lssa lv) x in
    let '(tail, (tail_work, tail_calls)) := producer_inventory rest in
    let '(out, (set_work, set_calls)) := producer_set x (node, source) tail in
    (out, ((102 + tail_work + set_work)%nat,
      SrProducerHome x node :: SrProducerDefinition x source :: tail_calls ++ set_calls))
  end.

Fixpoint producer_arguments (index : nat) (values : list V) : producer_run (Map.t nat V) :=
  match values with
  | [] => producer_return Map.empty
  | value :: rest =>
    let '(code, encoded) := audit_nat_encode index in
    let '(tail, (tail_work, calls)) := producer_arguments (Nat.succ index) rest in
    (Map.set nat_encoding index value tail,
      ((200 + audit_nat_events_work encoded + tail_work +
        audit_trie_update_source_work code (Some (index, value)) tail)%nat, calls))
  end.

Fixpoint producer_ranks (rank : nat) (bs : list (scev_binding V))
    : producer_run (scev_rank_index V) :=
  match bs with
  | [] => producer_return (ScevRankIndex Map.empty true None)
  | b :: rest =>
    tail <- producer_ranks (Nat.succ rank) rest ;;
    ranks <- producer_set (sb_phi b) rank (sri_ranks tail) ;;
    duplicate <- producer_mem (sb_phi b) (sri_ranks tail) ;;
    producer_return (ScevRankIndex ranks (negb duplicate && sri_distinct tail)
      (match sri_final tail with Some x => Some x | None => Some (sb_phi b) end))
  end.

Definition producer_prepare_index (inventory : list V) (plan : scev_plan V)
    : producer_run (scev_static_index Node V K) :=
  values <- producer_inventory inventory ;;
  let entry_values := edge_args (lssa lv) (lentry lv) in
  let '(entry, (entry_work, entry_calls)) := producer_arguments 0 entry_values in
  let back_values := edge_args (lssa lv) (lback lv) in
  let '(back, (back_work, back_calls)) := producer_arguments 0 back_values in
  let '(ranks, (rank_work, rank_calls)) := producer_ranks 0 (sp_bindings plan) in
  (ScevStaticIndex values entry back ranks,
    ((102 + entry_work + back_work + rank_work)%nat,
      SrProducerArguments (lentry lv) entry_values :: entry_calls ++
      SrProducerArguments (lback lv) back_values :: back_calls ++ rank_calls)).

Fixpoint producer_compile_bindings (bs : list (scev_prepared_binding EV))
    (env : Map.t V (chrec V)) (memo : @sr_compiler_memo V)
    : producer_run (option (Map.t V (chrec V) * @sr_compiler_memo V)) :=
  match bs with
  | [] => producer_return (Some (env, memo))
  | b :: rest =>
    let source := spb_source b in
    let base := CInv (IVar (sb_base source)) in
    let result :=
      match sb_kind source with
      | SDoubleUpdate => producer_return (Some (CGeo base (CInv (IConst 2)), memo))
      | SAddUpdate | SMulUpdate =>
        match spb_other b with
        | None => producer_return None
        | Some e =>
          let '(compiled, (work, calls)) := sr_compile_expr_source EV env e memo in
          let out := match compiled with
            | None => None
            | Some (c, memo') => Some
              ((match sb_kind source with SAddUpdate => CRec base c | _ => CGeo base c end), memo')
            end in
          (out, ((100 + work)%nat,
            map (fun call => SrProducerCheck (SrCheckClosure call)) calls))
        end
      end in
    compiled <- result ;;
    match compiled with
    | None => producer_return None
    | Some (c, memo') =>
      updated <- producer_set (sb_phi source) c env ;;
      producer_compile_bindings rest updated memo'
    end
  end.

Definition producer_compile_plan (bs : list (scev_prepared_binding EV)) (target : V)
    : producer_run (option (chrec V)) :=
  result <- producer_compile_bindings bs Map.empty sr_compiler_empty ;;
  match result with
  | None => producer_return None
  | Some (env, _) => producer_get target env
  end.

(** The complete source composes initial setup, actual binary producer, checking and compilation. *)
Definition scev_extra_recognize_source (inventory : list V) (x : V)
    : producer_run (option (chrec V)) :=
  source_ix <- producer_prepare_index inventory (ScevPlan [] x) ;;
  let fuel := Pos.of_succ_nat (length inventory) in
  let fuel_work := audit_nat_events_work (snd (audit_nat_encode (length inventory))) in
  let initial := ScevProducerState [SVisit x] FinSet.empty Map.empty [] [] [] in
  let '(run, (run_work, run_calls)) := producer_iterate source_ix fuel initial in
  let '(out, (later_work, later_calls)) :=
    match run with
    | None => producer_return None
    | Some st =>
      match sps_work st with
      | _ :: _ => producer_return None
      | [] =>
        let bs := rev (sps_bindings st) in
        let source_bindings := map spb_source bs in
        ranks <- producer_ranks 0 source_bindings ;;
 let ix := ScevStaticIndex (ssi_values source_ix) (ssi_entry source_ix) (ssi_back source_ix)
   ranks in
        let '(checked, (check_work, check_calls)) := sr_check_plan_source EN EV lv so ix bs x in
        let '(accepted, _) := checked in
        let '(result, (compile_work, compile_calls)) :=
          if accepted then producer_compile_plan bs x else producer_return None in
        (result, ((200 + 4 * length bs + check_work + compile_work)%nat,
          map SrProducerCheck check_calls ++ compile_calls))
      end
    end in
  (out, ((200 + length inventory + fuel_work + run_work + later_work)%nat,
    run_calls ++ later_calls)).

(** The full source result preserves the old recognizer, including every rejected shape. *)
Definition scev_extra_recognize_source_erases_type : Prop := forall inventory x,
  fst (scev_extra_recognize_source inventory x) = scev_extra_recognize EN EV inventory lv so x.

Fixpoint sr_iexpr_width (e : iexpr V) : nat :=
  match e with
  | IVar x => Pos.size_nat (encode EV x)
  | IConst z | IWordConst z => audit_z_bits z
  | IAdd a b | IMul a b => (1 + sr_iexpr_width a + sr_iexpr_width b)%nat
  end.

Fixpoint sr_chrec_width (c : chrec V) : nat :=
  match c with
  | CInv e => Nat.succ (sr_iexpr_width e)
  | CRec a b | CGeo a b | CSum a b | CProduct a b =>
    Nat.succ (sr_chrec_width a + sr_chrec_width b)
  end.

Definition sr_support_width (support : FinSet.t V) : nat := audit_trie_nodes support.

Definition sr_closure_width (call : @sr_closure_call V) : nat :=
  match call with
  | SrClosureEncode _ code | SrClosureCode code => Pos.size_nat code
  | SrClosureTrees a b => (sr_chrec_width a + sr_chrec_width b)%nat
  | SrClosureSupport support => sr_support_width support
  end.

Definition sr_check_width (call : @sr_check_call Node V K) : nat :=
  match call with
  | SrCheckClosure child => sr_closure_width child
  | SrCheckEncodeNode _ code => Pos.size_nat code
  | SrCheckSupport support => sr_support_width support
  | SrCheckNatural n => Nat.succ n
  | SrCheckConstant _ (Some z) => audit_z_bits z
  | _ => 1%nat
  end.

(** This maximum measures actual source operands and generated keys, independently of returned
  work. *)
Definition sr_actual_operand_width (calls : list sr_producer_call) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun call total => Nat.max total
    (match call with
    | SrProducerCheck child => sr_check_width child
    | SrProducerDefinition _ (Param _ index) => Nat.succ index
    | SrProducerDefinition _ (Op _ args) => Nat.succ (length args)
    | SrProducerArguments _ args => Nat.succ (length args)
    | SrProducerCode input output =>
      (Pos.size_nat output + fold_right (fun p n => (Pos.size_nat p + n)%nat) 0%nat input)%nat
    | SrProducerSupport support => sr_support_width support
    | _ => 1%nat
    end)) 1%nat calls.

(** The whole source budget uses input loop count and actual same-execution operand widths. *)
Definition scev_extra_recognize_source_bound_type : Prop := forall inventory x,
  let '(_, (work, calls)) := scev_extra_recognize_source inventory x in
  let size := Nat.succ (sr_actual_operand_width calls) in
  (work <= 1000000000 * Nat.pow (Nat.succ (length inventory)) 3 * Nat.pow size 8)%nat.

(** Binary loop calls and visited commands are different dimensions of the same source execution. *)
Definition producer_source_counts_type : Prop := forall ix fuel st,
  let '(_, (_, calls)) := producer_iterate ix fuel st in
  let advances := length (filter (fun call =>
    match call with SrProducerAdvance _ => true | _ => false end) calls) in
  let visits := length (filter (fun call =>
    match call with SrProducerCommand _ => true | _ => false end) calls) in
  (advances <= Pos.to_nat fuel /\ visits <= length (sps_work st) + 4 * advances)%nat.

(** The fixed concrete source equations have a finite realization on every input. *)
Definition scev_extra_recognize_source_total_type : Prop := forall inventory x,
  exists out work calls, scev_extra_recognize_source inventory x = (out, (work, calls)).

(** Realizations of the fixed source equations retain the same output, work and typed calls. *)
Definition scev_extra_recognize_source_unique_type : Prop := forall inventory x
    out1 work1 calls1 out2 work2 calls2,
  scev_extra_recognize_source inventory x = (out1, (work1, calls1)) ->
  scev_extra_recognize_source inventory x = (out2, (work2, calls2)) ->
  out1 = out2 /\ work1 = work2 /\ calls1 = calls2.

(** Only true client callbacks receive an external body charge; source metadata never does. *)
Definition sr_external_callback (call : sr_producer_call) : bool :=
  match call with
  | SrProducerHome _ _ | SrProducerDefinition _ _ | SrProducerArguments _ _ => true
  | SrProducerCheck (SrCheckClosure (SrClosureEncode _ _)) => true
  | SrProducerCheck (SrCheckEncodeNode _ _) | SrProducerCheck (SrCheckBody _ _) |
    SrProducerCheck (SrCheckAdd _ _) | SrProducerCheck (SrCheckMul _ _) |
    SrProducerCheck (SrCheckConstant _ _) => true
  | _ => false
  end.

Definition sr_external_body_work (body_work : sr_producer_call -> nat)
    (calls : list sr_producer_call) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun call total =>
    ((if sr_external_callback call then body_work call else 0) + total)%nat) 0%nat calls.

End RecognizerSource.
```
