## Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditScevRecognizeTrace

Card: AUD-SR-CLOSURE

Source destination: `theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditScevRecognizeTrace.v`.

```rocq
(** * Concrete captured-environment compiler source model

    This model retains the actual map captured by every compiler-cache snapshot.
    For example, a cache hit still executes both map lookups for every support key after failure.
    Builds on: AnalysesScev and the frozen Collections audit models. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List NArith PArith ZArith Bool.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsTrie CollectionsMap
  CollectionsFinSet.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesScev.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditCost.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditTrie.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditMapFold.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditUnion.
Import List.ListNotations.

Section ClosureModel.
Context {V : Type} (EV : encoding V).

(** Encoder callbacks retain their actual inputs and returned complete positive codes. *)
Inductive sr_closure_call : Type :=
  | SrClosureEncode (input : V) (output : positive)
  | SrClosureCode (input : positive)
  | SrClosureTrees (lhs rhs : chrec V)
  | SrClosureSupport (input : FinSet.t V).

Definition sr_measure : Type := nat * list sr_closure_call.
Definition sr_run (A : Type) : Type := A * sr_measure.

Definition sr_return {A} (value : A) : sr_run A := (value, (100%nat, [])).

Definition sr_bind {A B} (first : sr_run A) (next : A -> sr_run B) : sr_run B :=
  let '(a, (work1, calls1)) := first in
  let '(b, (work2, calls2)) := next a in
  (b, ((work1 + work2)%nat, calls1 ++ calls2)).

Notation "x <- first ;; next" := (sr_bind first (fun x => next))
  (at level 100, first at next level, right associativity).

Definition sr_get {A} (key : V) (input : Map.t V A) : sr_run (option A) :=
  let code := encode EV key in
  let found := Trie.get code input in
  (Map.get EV key input,
    ((101 + audit_trie_get_source_work code input +
      match found with None => 2 | Some _ => 4 end)%nat, [SrClosureEncode key code])).

Definition sr_set {A} (key : V) (value : A) (input : Map.t V A) : sr_run (Map.t V A) :=
  let code := encode EV key in
  (Map.set EV key value input,
    ((104 + audit_trie_update_source_work code (Some (key, value)) input)%nat,
      [SrClosureEncode key code])).

Definition sr_code_get {A} (key : positive) (input : Map.t positive A) : sr_run (option A) :=
  (Map.get positive_encoding key input,
    ((104 + audit_trie_get_source_work key input)%nat, [SrClosureCode key])).

Definition sr_code_set {A} (key : positive) (value : A) (input : Map.t positive A)
    : sr_run (Map.t positive A) :=
  (Map.set positive_encoding key value input,
    ((104 + audit_trie_update_source_work key (Some (key, value)) input)%nat, [SrClosureCode key])).

(** Full structural equality is an explicit lean Boolean helper with strict child evaluation. *)
Fixpoint sr_iexpr_equal (a b : iexpr V) : sr_run bool :=
  match a, b with
  | IVar x, IVar y =>
    let xc := encode EV x in
    let yc := encode EV y in
    (Pos.eqb xc yc,
      ((102 + audit_binary_weight (Z.pos xc) (Z.pos yc))%nat,
        [SrClosureEncode x xc; SrClosureEncode y yc]))
  | IConst x, IConst y | IWordConst x, IWordConst y =>
    ((x =? y)%Z, ((100 + audit_binary_weight x y)%nat, []))
  | IAdd a1 a2, IAdd b1 b2 | IMul a1 a2, IMul b1 b2 =>
    first <- sr_iexpr_equal a1 b1 ;;
    second <- sr_iexpr_equal a2 b2 ;; sr_return (first && second)
  | _, _ => sr_return false
  end.

Fixpoint sr_chrec_equal (a b : chrec V) : sr_run bool :=
  match a, b with
  | CInv x, CInv y => sr_iexpr_equal x y
  | CRec a1 a2, CRec b1 b2 | CGeo a1 a2, CGeo b1 b2 |
    CSum a1 a2, CSum b1 b2 | CProduct a1 a2, CProduct b1 b2 =>
    first <- sr_chrec_equal a1 b1 ;;
    second <- sr_chrec_equal a2 b2 ;; sr_return (first && second)
  | _, _ => sr_return false
  end.

Definition sr_lookup_equal (a b : option (chrec V)) : sr_run bool :=
  match a, b with
  | None, None => sr_return true
  | Some x, Some y =>
    let '(out, (work, calls)) := sr_chrec_equal x y in
    (out, (work, SrClosureTrees x y :: calls))
  | _, _ => sr_return false
  end.

(** Each enriched snapshot records its real captured map rather than an opaque function. *)
Record sr_compiler_memo : Type := SrCompilerMemo {
  src_entries : Map.t positive (Map.t V (chrec V) * chrec V);
  src_hits : list positive;
  src_misses : list positive
}.

Definition sr_compiler_empty : sr_compiler_memo := SrCompilerMemo Map.empty [] [].

Definition sr_context_entry (env snapshot : Map.t V (chrec V)) (acc : bool) (x : V) (_ : unit)
    : bool * list sr_measure :=
  let '(current, (w1, c1)) := sr_get x env in
  let '(captured, (w2, c2)) := sr_get x snapshot in
  let '(equal, (w3, c3)) := sr_lookup_equal current captured in
  (acc && equal, [((100 + w1 + w2 + w3)%nat, c1 ++ c2 ++ c3)]).

Definition sr_child_work (events : list sr_measure) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun event total => (fst event + total)%nat) 0%nat events.

Definition sr_fold_calls (events : list (audit_map_fold_event V unit bool sr_measure))
    : list sr_closure_call :=
  flat_map (fun event =>
    match event with
    | AuditMapFoldCall _ _ _ _ _ children => flat_map snd children
    | _ => []
    end) events.

(** The shared fold invokes this fixed internal body for every stored key, even after false. *)
Definition sr_context_source (env snapshot : Map.t V (chrec V)) (support : FinSet.t V)
    : sr_run bool :=
  let '(out, events) := audit_map_fold (sr_context_entry env snapshot) support true in
  (out, (audit_map_fold_source_work sr_child_work events,
    SrClosureSupport support :: sr_fold_calls events)).

Definition sr_compiler_store (code : positive) (env : Map.t V (chrec V)) (value : chrec V)
    (memo : sr_compiler_memo) : sr_run sr_compiler_memo :=
  entries <- sr_code_set code (env, value) (src_entries memo) ;;
  sr_return (SrCompilerMemo entries (src_hits memo) (code :: src_misses memo)).

Definition sr_compiler_reuse (code : positive) (memo : sr_compiler_memo) : sr_run sr_compiler_memo
  :=
  sr_return (SrCompilerMemo (src_entries memo) (code :: src_hits memo) (src_misses memo)).

Fixpoint sr_add_invariant_work (e : iexpr V) (c : chrec V) : nat :=
  match c with
  | CInv _ => 100
  | CRec base _ => (100 + sr_add_invariant_work e base)%nat
  | _ => 100
  end%nat.

Fixpoint sr_add_work (a b : chrec V) : nat :=
  match a with
  | CInv e => (100 + sr_add_invariant_work e b)%nat
  | CRec base step =>
    match b with
    | CInv e => (100 + sr_add_work base (CInv e))%nat
    | CRec base2 step2 => (100 + sr_add_work base base2 + sr_add_work step step2)%nat
    | _ => 100
    end
  | _ => 100
  end%nat.

Fixpoint sr_mul_invariant_work (e : iexpr V) (c : chrec V) : nat :=
  match c with
  | CInv _ => 100
  | CRec base step =>
    (100 + sr_mul_invariant_work e base + sr_mul_invariant_work e step)%nat
  | CGeo base _ => (100 + sr_mul_invariant_work e base)%nat
  | _ => 100
  end%nat.

Fixpoint sr_mul_work (a b : chrec V) : nat :=
  match a with
  | CInv e => (100 + sr_mul_invariant_work e b)%nat
  | CRec (CInv _) (CInv _) =>
    match b with
    | CInv e => (100 + sr_mul_invariant_work e a)%nat
    | CRec (CInv _) (CInv _) => 2000
    | _ => 100
    end
  | CGeo base ratio =>
    match b with
    | CInv e => (100 + sr_mul_invariant_work e a)%nat
    | CGeo base2 ratio2 => (100 + sr_mul_work base base2 + sr_mul_work ratio ratio2)%nat
    | _ => 100
    end
  | _ =>
    match b with CInv e => (100 + sr_mul_invariant_work e a)%nat | _ => 100 end
  end%nat.

(** Every cache branch, current/captured lookup and recurrence constructor is fixed here. *)
Fixpoint sr_compile_expr_source (env : Map.t V (chrec V)) (e : scev_prepared_expr V)
    (memo : sr_compiler_memo) : sr_run (option (chrec V * sr_compiler_memo)) :=
  let code := scev_prepared_code e in
  let finish c memo' := updated <- sr_compiler_store code env c memo' ;;
    sr_return (Some (c, updated)) in
  let compile_body := fun _ : unit =>
    match e with
    | POutside _ _ x => finish (CInv (IVar x)) memo
    | PPhi _ _ x =>
      found <- sr_get x env ;;
      match found with Some c => finish c memo | None => sr_return None end
    | PAdd _ _ _ a b | PMul _ _ _ a b =>
      first <- sr_compile_expr_source env a memo ;;
      match first with
      | None => sr_return None
      | Some (lhs, ma) =>
        second <- sr_compile_expr_source env b ma ;;
        match second with
        | None => sr_return None
        | Some (rhs, mb) =>
          let '(out, work) := match e with
            | PAdd _ _ _ _ _ => (chrec_add lhs rhs, sr_add_work lhs rhs)
            | _ => (chrec_mul lhs rhs, sr_mul_work lhs rhs)
            end in
          let '(result, (later, calls)) := finish out mb in
          (result, ((100 + work + later)%nat, SrClosureTrees lhs rhs :: calls))
        end
      end
    | PConst _ _ _ z => finish (CInv (IWordConst z)) memo
    end in
  found <- sr_code_get code (src_entries memo) ;;
  match found with
  | None => compile_body tt
  | Some (snapshot, c) =>
    valid <- sr_context_source env snapshot (scev_prepared_phis e) ;;
    if valid then
      updated <- sr_compiler_reuse code memo ;; sr_return (Some (c, updated))
    else compile_body tt
  end.

(** Pointwise snapshot agreement preserves closure meaning without functional extensionality. *)
Definition sr_compiler_memo_erases (model : sr_compiler_memo)
    (native : scev_shared_compile_memo V) : Prop :=
  src_hits model = scc_hits native /\ src_misses model = scc_misses native /\
  forall code,
    match Map.get positive_encoding code (src_entries model),
        Map.get positive_encoding code (scc_entries native) with
    | None, None => True
    | Some (env, c), Some (lookup, d) =>
      c = d /\ forall x, lookup x = Map.get EV x env
    | _, _ => False
    end.

(** Lean equality returns the exact native snapshot-validation Boolean. *)
Definition sr_lookup_equal_erases_type : Prop := forall a b,
  fst (sr_lookup_equal a b) = scev_lookup_eqb EV a b.

(** Enriched compilation retains actual captured environments and preserves all native outcomes. *)
Definition sr_compile_expr_source_erases_type : Prop := forall env e memo native,
  sr_compiler_memo_erases memo native ->
  match fst (sr_compile_expr_source env e memo),
      scev_compile_shared_expr EV (fun x => Map.get EV x env) e native with
  | None, None => True
  | Some (c, model'), Some (d, native') => c = d /\ sr_compiler_memo_erases model' native'
  | _, _ => False
  end.

End ClosureModel.
```

```rocq
(** * Modular trip client composition
    Imports the independent scalar expression evaluator; the scalar owner never imports HIT.
    Builds on: TripScalar and HitWhole. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List NArith ZArith.
From Galois.Bits Require Import BitsWord.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesScev.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditScevCost.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditCost.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditScevModCount.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditScevFastSource.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditScevModSource.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditScevTripScalar.
Import List.ListNotations.
(** Both selected engines consume exactly these already evaluated actual integer inputs. *)
Definition trip_client_source {V} (modular : bool) (inv : V -> Z) w sg cmp
    (chain : chrec V) (bound : iexpr V) : option N * list (trip_event V) :=
  let prefix := [TripSource (AuditCase 403 [])] in
  match chain with
  | CRec base (CInv step) =>
    let '(a, first) := trip_chrec_zero_source inv base in
    let '(delta, second) := trip_iexpr_source inv step in
    let '(target, third) := trip_iexpr_source inv bound in
    let '(out, body) := if modular then scev_mod_first_hit_source w sg cmp a delta target
      else scev_nowrap_source w sg cmp a delta target in
    (out, prefix ++ first ++ second ++ third ++ map TripSource body)
  | _ => (None, prefix ++ [TripSource (AuditConstruct 404 [0%N])])
  end.

(** Callback body work attaches to every actual invocation, including repeated variables. *)
Definition trip_callback_work {V} (body_work : V -> Z -> nat)
    (events : list (trip_event V)) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun event total =>
    match event with
    | TripInvariant x z => (body_work x z + total)%nat
    | TripSource _ => total
    end) 0%nat events.

Definition trip_library_work {V} (modular : bool) (events : list (trip_event V)) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun event total =>
    ((match event with
    | TripInvariant _ _ => 1%nat
    | TripSource frame => if modular then hit_frame_weight frame else scalar_frame_weight frame
    end) + total)%nat) 0%nat events.

Fixpoint trip_iexpr_nodes {V} (expression : iexpr V) : nat :=
  match expression with
  | IVar _ | IConst _ | IWordConst _ => 1%nat
  | IAdd a b | IMul a b => S (trip_iexpr_nodes a + trip_iexpr_nodes b)
  end.

Fixpoint trip_chrec_nodes {V} (chain : chrec V) : nat :=
  match chain with
  | CInv e => S (trip_iexpr_nodes e)
  | CRec base _ | CGeo base _ => S (trip_chrec_nodes base)
  | CSum a b | CProduct a b => S (trip_chrec_nodes a + trip_chrec_nodes b)
  end.

(** This maximum contains actual arithmetic operands and callback results from this execution. *)
Definition trip_max_operand_bits {V} (events : list (trip_event V)) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun event total =>
    Nat.max (match event with
      | TripInvariant _ z => audit_z_bits z
      | TripSource (AuditArithmetic _ operands) =>
        fold_right (fun n m => Nat.max (audit_z_bits (count_zdecode n)) m) 1%nat operands
      | _ => 1%nat
      end) total) 1%nat events.

(** Both trip clients preserve the entire old affine result, including unsupported shapes. *)
Definition trip_client_source_erases_type : Prop := forall V modular (inv : V -> Z)
    w sg cmp chain bound,
  fst (trip_client_source modular inv w sg cmp chain bound) =
    trip_count inv w sg cmp chain bound.

(** Expression evaluation work is polynomial in input syntax and actual operand width. *)
Definition trip_expression_source_bound_type : Prop := forall V (inv : V -> Z) expression,
  let '(_, events) := trip_iexpr_source inv expression in
  let bits := trip_max_operand_bits events in
  (trip_library_work false events <=
    10 * trip_iexpr_nodes expression * (bits + 1) * (bits + 1))%nat.

(** The entire client includes expression work and any actually selected scalar engine.
    The input period bounds even an arbitrary fallback; fast-family zero-fallback laws remain
      separate. *)
Definition trip_client_source_bound_type : Prop := forall V modular (inv : V -> Z)
    w sg cmp chain bound,
  let '(_, events) := trip_client_source modular inv w sg cmp chain bound in
  let bits := (1 + Pos.to_nat w + trip_max_operand_bits events)%nat in
  let nodes := (1 + trip_chrec_nodes chain + trip_iexpr_nodes bound)%nat in
  (trip_library_work modular events <=
    100000000 * nodes * (1 + N.to_nat (N.pos (word_period w))) * Nat.pow bits 4)%nat.
```

## Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditScevTripScalar

```rocq
(** * Typed scalar trip-client source equations

    This model composes actual invariant callbacks, expression arithmetic and scalar engines.
    For example, a supported affine client evaluates base, step and bound once each.
    Builds on: ScalarWhole and AnalysesScev. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List NArith ZArith.
From Galois.Bits Require Import BitsWord.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesScev.
From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsAuditCost.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditScevCost.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditScevFastSource.
Import List.ListNotations.

Inductive trip_event (V : Type) : Type :=
  | TripInvariant (argument : V) (result : Z)
  | TripSource (event : audit_event unit).

Arguments TripInvariant {V}.
Arguments TripSource {V}.

Fixpoint trip_iexpr_source {V} (inv : V -> Z) (expression : iexpr V)
    : Z * list (trip_event V) :=
  let prefix := [TripSource (AuditCase 400 [])] in
  match expression with
  | IVar x =>
    let value := inv x in (value, prefix ++ [TripInvariant x value])
  | IConst z | IWordConst z => (z, prefix)
  | IAdd a b =>
    let '(lhs, first) := trip_iexpr_source inv a in
    let '(rhs, second) := trip_iexpr_source inv b in
    ((lhs + rhs)%Z, prefix ++ first ++ second ++ [TripSource (scalar_z 44 lhs rhs)])
  | IMul a b =>
    let '(lhs, first) := trip_iexpr_source inv a in
    let '(rhs, second) := trip_iexpr_source inv b in
    ((lhs * rhs)%Z, prefix ++ first ++ second ++ [TripSource (scalar_z 65 lhs rhs)])
  end.

(** Evaluation at zero follows only the actual base of integrated/geometric recurrences. *)
Fixpoint trip_chrec_zero_source {V} (inv : V -> Z) (chain : chrec V)
    : Z * list (trip_event V) :=
  let prefix := [TripSource (AuditCase 401 [])] in
  match chain with
  | CInv expression =>
    let '(out, body) := trip_iexpr_source inv expression in (out, prefix ++ body)
  | CRec base _ | CGeo base _ =>
    let '(out, body) := trip_chrec_zero_source inv base in
    (out, prefix ++ [TripSource (AuditCase 402 [0%N])] ++ body)
  | CSum a b =>
    let '(lhs, first) := trip_chrec_zero_source inv a in
    let '(rhs, second) := trip_chrec_zero_source inv b in
    ((lhs + rhs)%Z, prefix ++ first ++ second ++ [TripSource (scalar_z 44 lhs rhs)])
  | CProduct a b =>
    let '(lhs, first) := trip_chrec_zero_source inv a in
    let '(rhs, second) := trip_chrec_zero_source inv b in
    ((lhs * rhs)%Z, prefix ++ first ++ second ++ [TripSource (scalar_z 65 lhs rhs)])
  end.

(** The independent SA client consumes each invariant expression exactly once. *)
Definition trip_nowrap_client_source {V} (inv : V -> Z) w sg cmp
    (chain : chrec V) (bound : iexpr V) : option N * list (trip_event V) :=
  let prefix := [TripSource (AuditCase 403 [])] in
  match chain with
  | CRec base (CInv step) =>
    let '(a, first) := trip_chrec_zero_source inv base in
    let '(delta, second) := trip_iexpr_source inv step in
    let '(target, third) := trip_iexpr_source inv bound in
    let '(out, body) := scev_nowrap_source w sg cmp a delta target in
    (out,prefix ++ first ++ second ++ third ++ map TripSource body)
  | _ => (None,prefix ++ [TripSource (AuditConstruct 404 [0%N])])
  end.
Definition trip_nowrap_library_work {V} (events : list(trip_event V)) :=
  fold_right(fun event total => ((match event with TripInvariant _ _ => 1%nat
    | TripSource frame => scalar_frame_weight frame end)+total)%nat) 0%nat events.
Definition trip_nowrap_source_erases_type : Prop := forall V (inv : V -> Z) w sg cmp chain bound,
 fst(trip_nowrap_client_source inv w sg cmp chain bound)=trip_count inv w sg cmp chain bound.
Fixpoint trip_scalar_expr_nodes {V} (expression : iexpr V) : nat := match expression with
 | IVar _ | IConst _ | IWordConst _ => 1%nat
 | IAdd a b | IMul a b => S(trip_scalar_expr_nodes a+trip_scalar_expr_nodes b) end.
Fixpoint trip_scalar_chain_nodes {V} (chain : chrec V) : nat := match chain with
 | CInv e => S(trip_scalar_expr_nodes e)
 | CRec base _ | CGeo base _ => S(trip_scalar_chain_nodes base)
 | CSum a b | CProduct a b => S(trip_scalar_chain_nodes a+trip_scalar_chain_nodes b) end.
Definition trip_scalar_operand_bits {V} (events : list(trip_event V)) : nat :=
 fold_right(fun event total => Nat.max total (match event with
 | TripInvariant _ z => audit_z_bits z
 | TripSource(AuditArithmetic _ operands) => fold_right(fun n m =>
   Nat.max(audit_z_bits(count_zdecode n)) m) 1%nat operands
 | _ => 1%nat end)) 1%nat events.
Definition trip_nowrap_source_bound_type : Prop := forall V (inv : V -> Z) w sg cmp chain bound,
 let '(_,events) := trip_nowrap_client_source inv w sg cmp chain bound in
 let bits := (1+Pos.to_nat w+trip_scalar_operand_bits events)%nat in
 let nodes := (1+trip_scalar_chain_nodes chain+trip_scalar_expr_nodes bound)%nat in
 (trip_nowrap_library_work events <= 100000000*nodes*(1+N.to_nat(N.pos(word_period w)))*Nat.pow
   bits 4)%nat.
```

```rocq
 advances <= Pos.to_nat fuel /\
```

```rocq
forall (env : CollectionsMap.Map.t V (AnalysesScev.chrec V))
  (e : AnalysesScev.scev_prepared_expr V) (memo : @sr_compiler_memo V)
  (native : AnalysesScev.scev_shared_compile_memo V),
@sr_compiler_memo_erases V EV memo native ->
match
  @fst (option (AnalysesScev.chrec V * @sr_compiler_memo V)) (@sr_measure V)
    (@sr_compile_expr_source V EV env e memo)
with
| @Some _ (c, model') =>
    match
      @AnalysesScev.scev_compile_shared_expr V EV
        (fun x : V => @CollectionsMap.Map.get V (AnalysesScev.chrec V) EV x env) e native
    with
    | @Some _ (d, native') => c = d /\ @sr_compiler_memo_erases V EV model' native'
    | @None _ => False
    end
| @None _ =>
    match
      @AnalysesScev.scev_compile_shared_expr V EV
        (fun x : V => @CollectionsMap.Map.get V (AnalysesScev.chrec V) EV x env) e native
    with
    | @Some _ _ => False
    | @None _ => True
    end
end.
```

```rocq
  DomainsAuditNumericCost DomainsAuditNumericDimensions DomainsAuditProductSource

  RewriteAuditProofSelectedContracts RewriteAuditProofFactWholeContracts.
Import List.ListNotations.

Definition numeric_bodies_work {B} (weight : B -> nat) (bodies : list (list B)) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun body total => fold_right (fun event n => weight event + n) 0 body + total) 0
    bodies.

(** Invariant callback laws concern one genuine supplied invariant-read implementation. *)
Definition numeric_invariant_source_laws {V B} (inv : V -> Z)
    (source : V -> Z -> list B -> Prop) (weight : B -> nat) (budget : V -> nat) : Prop :=
  (forall x, exists body, source x (inv x) body) /\
  (forall x z body, source x z body ->
    z = inv x /\ fold_right (fun event n => weight event + n) 0 body <= budget x).

Definition numeric_trip_event_receipt {V B} (source : V -> Z -> list B -> Prop)
    (event : trip_event V) (body : list B) : Prop :=
  match event with
  | TripInvariant x z => source x z body
  | TripSource _ => body = []
  end.

Definition numeric_trip_callback_allowance {V} (budget : V -> nat) (events : list (trip_event V))
    : nat := fold_right (fun event n =>
      match event with TripInvariant x _ => budget x + n | TripSource _ => n end) 0 events.

(** Full trip work uses literal callback receipts for this same fixed source execution. *)
Definition numeric_trip_full_source_statement : Prop := forall V B (inv : V -> Z)
    source weight budget,
  @numeric_invariant_source_laws V B inv source weight budget ->
  forall modular w sg cmp chain bound,
  let '(out, events) := trip_client_source modular inv w sg cmp chain bound in
  let bits := 1 + Pos.to_nat w + trip_max_operand_bits events in
  let nodes := 1 + trip_chrec_nodes chain + trip_iexpr_nodes bound in
  exists bodies, Forall2 (numeric_trip_event_receipt source) events bodies /\
    out = trip_count inv w sg cmp chain bound /\
    trip_library_work modular events + numeric_bodies_work weight bodies <=
      100000000 * nodes * (1 + N.to_nat (N.pos (word_period w))) * Nat.pow bits 4 +
        numeric_trip_callback_allowance budget events.

Definition numeric_reduce_call_value {P Q} (D1 : word_domain P) (D2 : word_domain Q)
    (exchange : audit_exchange P Q) (call : reduce_call P Q) : Prop :=
  match call with
  | ReduceRankCall w input out => out = audit_exchange_rank exchange w input
  | ReduceStepCall w input out => out = audit_exchange_step exchange w input
  | ReduceLeftCall w a b out => out = leb (plat D1 w) a b
  | ReduceRightCall w a b out => out = leb (plat D2 w) a b
  end.

(** Generic reduction accepts source evidence only for its real dictionary and exchange calls. *)
Definition numeric_reduce_source_laws {P Q B} (D1 : word_domain P) (D2 : word_domain Q)
    (exchange : audit_exchange P Q) (source : reduce_call P Q -> list B -> Prop)
    (weight : B -> nat) (budget : reduce_call P Q -> nat) : Prop :=
  (forall call, numeric_reduce_call_value D1 D2 exchange call -> exists body, source call body) /\
  (forall call body, source call body -> numeric_reduce_call_value D1 D2 exchange call /\
    fold_right (fun event n => weight event + n) 0 body <= budget call).

Definition numeric_reduce_event_receipt {P Q B} (source : reduce_call P Q -> list B -> Prop)
    (event : audit_event (reduce_call P Q)) (body : list B) : Prop :=
  match event with AuditCall call => source call body | _ => body = [] end.

(** The fixed rank-derived reducer includes actual external bodies at its typed call occurrences. *)
Definition numeric_reduce_full_source_statement : Prop := forall P Q B
    (D1 : word_domain P) (D2 : word_domain Q) (exchange : audit_exchange P Q)
    source weight budget,
  @numeric_reduce_source_laws P Q B D1 D2 exchange source weight budget ->
  forall w input,
  let '(out, events) := audit_reduce_source D1 D2 exchange w input in
  let rank := audit_exchange_rank exchange w input in
  exists bodies, Forall2 (numeric_reduce_event_receipt source) events bodies /\
    out = audit_reduce D1 D2 exchange w input /\
    reduce_library_work events + numeric_bodies_work weight bodies <=
      50 * N.to_nat (N.succ rank) + 2 * audit_z_bits (Z.of_N rank) +
        reduce_client_body_work budget events.

Section RecognizerBodies.
Context {S O Node E V K C : Type} (EN : encoding Node) (EV : encoding V)
  (lv : loop_view S O Node E V K C) (so : scev_ops K C).

(** The callback result belongs to the same supplied view, encoders and operator dictionary. *)
Definition numeric_sr_call_value (call : @sr_producer_call Node E V K) : Prop :=
  match call with
  | SrProducerHome x out => out = home (lssa lv) x
  | SrProducerDefinition x out => out = def (lssa lv) x
  | SrProducerArguments e out => out = edge_args (lssa lv) e
  | SrProducerCheck (SrCheckClosure (SrClosureEncode x code)) => code = encode EV x
  | SrProducerCheck (SrCheckEncodeNode node code) => code = encode EN node
  | SrProducerCheck (SrCheckBody node out) => out = lbody lv node
  | SrProducerCheck (SrCheckAdd op out) => out = add_op so op
  | SrProducerCheck (SrCheckMul op out) => out = mul_op so op
  | SrProducerCheck (SrCheckConstant op out) => out = const_op so op
  | _ => False
  end.

Definition numeric_sr_source_laws {B}
    (source : @sr_producer_call Node E V K -> list B -> Prop)
    (weight : B -> nat) (budget : @sr_producer_call Node E V K -> nat) : Prop :=
  (forall call, numeric_sr_call_value call -> exists body, source call body) /\
  (forall call body, source call body -> numeric_sr_call_value call /\
    fold_right (fun event n => weight event + n) 0 body <= budget call).

Definition numeric_sr_call_receipt {B}
    (source : @sr_producer_call Node E V K -> list B -> Prop)
    (call : @sr_producer_call Node E V K) (body : list B) : Prop :=
  if sr_external_callback call then source call body else body = [].

(** The fixed lean recognizer adds genuine client bodies without assuming a whole-run bound. *)
Definition numeric_recognizer_full_source_statement : Prop := forall B source weight budget,
  @numeric_sr_source_laws B source weight budget ->
  forall inventory x,
  let '(out, (work, calls)) := scev_extra_recognize_source EN EV lv so inventory x in
  let size := Nat.succ (sr_actual_operand_width EV calls) in
  exists bodies, Forall2 (numeric_sr_call_receipt source) calls bodies /\
    out = scev_extra_recognize EN EV inventory lv so x /\
    work + numeric_bodies_work weight bodies <=
      1000000000 * Nat.pow (Nat.succ (length inventory)) 3 * Nat.pow size 8 +
        sr_external_body_work budget calls.

End RecognizerBodies.
```

```rocq
(** * A nonempty core bridge client

    This fixture checks the result and source work of one scalar trip calculation.
    For example, its invariant callback records exactly one read.
    Builds on: the scalar trip source model and its fixed budget. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List NArith ZArith.
From Galois.Bits Require Import BitsWord.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesScev AnalysesAuditScevTripScalar
  AnalysesAuditScevTrip.
Import List.ListNotations.

Definition bridge_trip_chain : chrec unit := CRec (CInv (IVar tt)) (CInv (IConst 1)).

(** The client's constant-return body retains one literal source step and its returned value. *)
Definition bridge_invariant (_ : unit) : Z := 0%Z.

Definition bridge_invariant_counted (x : unit) : Z * list unit := (bridge_invariant x, [tt]).

Definition bridge_invariant_source (x : unit) (value : Z) (body : list unit) : Prop :=
  bridge_invariant_counted x = (value, body).

(** The one-step body realizes the callback and costs exactly its unit allowance. *)
Example bridge_invariant_source_adequate :
  (forall x, exists body, bridge_invariant_source x (bridge_invariant x) body) /\
  (forall x value body, bridge_invariant_source x value body ->
    value = bridge_invariant x /\ (length body <= 1)%nat).
Proof.
  split.
  - intros x. exists [tt]. reflexivity.
  - intros x value body Hbody. unfold bridge_invariant_counted in Hbody.
    inversion Hbody. subst. split; reflexivity.
Qed.

(** One captured trip run agrees with the scalar result and meets its concrete source bound. *)
Definition audit_core_full_source_bridge_nonempty_statement : Prop :=
  let inv := bridge_invariant in
  let '(out, events) := trip_client_source true inv 3%positive Unsigned CmpLt
    bridge_trip_chain (IConst 6) in
  out = Some 6%N /\ out = trip_count inv 3%positive Unsigned CmpLt bridge_trip_chain (IConst 6) /\
  filter (fun event => match event with TripInvariant _ _ => true | _ => false end)
    events = [TripInvariant tt 0%Z] /\
  (N.of_nat (trip_library_work true events + 1) <=
    100000000 * N.of_nat (1 + trip_chrec_nodes bridge_trip_chain +
      @trip_iexpr_nodes unit (IConst 6)) *
      (1 + N.pos (word_period 3%positive)) *
      N.pow (N.of_nat (1 + Pos.to_nat 3%positive + trip_max_operand_bits events)) 4 + 1)%N.

(** This finite fixture checks the same concrete input without claiming the universal theorem. *)
Example audit_core_trip_source_fixture : audit_core_full_source_bridge_nonempty_statement.
Proof.
  vm_compute. intuition congruence.
Qed.

Example audit_core_full_source_bridge_nonempty :
  audit_core_full_source_bridge_nonempty_statement.
```

```rocq
(** * AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadeReference

    This module fixes source equations, typed observations and contract statements.
    For example, failed lookups retain their original query and selected source cost.
    Builds on: Rewrite and the canonical Collections audit models. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List Bool PArith NArith PeanoNat Lia.

From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsTrie CollectionsMap
  CollectionsFinSet CollectionsUnionFind CollectionsAuditCost CollectionsAuditTrie
  CollectionsAuditEncoding CollectionsAuditPrimitive CollectionsAuditMap CollectionsAuditFinSet
  CollectionsAuditElements CollectionsAuditUnion CollectionsAuditMapTraverse
  CollectionsAuditUnionFind.
From Galois.Rewrite Require Import RewriteSyntax RewriteRules RewriteEquality RewriteEgraph
  RewriteIndex RewriteRebuild RewriteExtract RewriteRun RewriteMatch RewriteAnalysis.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesEgraph.
From Galois.Rewrite Require Import RewriteAuditQueueReference.
Import List.ListNotations.

Inductive rw_facade_table_call (A : Type) : Type :=
  | RWFacadeTableSet : nat -> A -> Map.t nat A -> Map.t nat A -> positive ->
      list audit_nat_encoding_event -> audit_trace (audit_trie_call (nat * A)) ->
      rw_facade_table_call A
  | RWFacadeTableGet : nat -> Map.t nat A -> option A -> positive ->
      list audit_nat_encoding_event -> audit_trace (audit_trie_call (nat * A)) ->
      rw_facade_table_call A.
Arguments RWFacadeTableSet {A}.
Arguments RWFacadeTableGet {A}.


Fixpoint rw_facade_table_atomic {A} (xs : list A) (start : nat) :
    Map.t nat A * audit_trace (rw_facade_table_call A) :=
  match xs with
  | nil => (Map.empty, [AuditCase 550 []; AuditConstruct 551 []])
  | item :: rest =>
    let next := S start in
    let '(table, tail_trace) := rw_facade_table_atomic rest next in
    let '(code, enc_trace) := audit_nat_encode start in
    let '(out, trie_trace) := audit_trie_set code (start, item) table in
    (out, [AuditCase 552 []; AuditConstruct 553 []] ++ tail_trace ++
      [AuditCall (RWFacadeTableSet start item table out code enc_trace trie_trace)])
  end.


Definition rw_facade_lookup_atomic {A} (i : nat) (table : Map.t nat A) :
    option A * audit_trace (rw_facade_table_call A) :=
  let '(code, enc_trace) := audit_nat_encode i in
  let '(out, trie_trace) := audit_map_code_get code table in
  (out, [AuditCall (RWFacadeTableGet i table out code enc_trace trie_trace)]).


Fixpoint rw_facade_nth {A} (xs : list A) (n : nat) : option A * audit_trace unit :=
  match n with
  | 0 => match xs with
    | nil => (None, [AuditCase 560 []; AuditCase 561 []; AuditConstruct 562 []])
    | x :: _ => (Some x, [AuditCase 560 []; AuditCase 563 []; AuditConstruct 564 []])
    end
  | S n' => match xs with
    | nil => (None, [AuditCase 565 []; AuditCase 566 []; AuditConstruct 567 []])
    | _ :: rest => let '(out, trace) := rw_facade_nth rest n' in
      (out, [AuditCase 565 []; AuditCase 568 []] ++ trace)
    end
  end.


Inductive rw_facade_subst_call (K : Type) : Type :=
  | RWFacadeNth : list (term K) -> nat -> option (term K) -> audit_trace unit ->
      rw_facade_subst_call K.
Arguments RWFacadeNth {K}.


Fixpoint rw_facade_subst_atomic {K} (bindings : list (term K)) (t : term K) :
    term K * audit_trace (rw_facade_subst_call K) :=
  match t with
  | TVar i =>
    let '(found, nth_trace) := rw_facade_nth bindings i in
    match found with
    | None => (TVar i, [AuditCase 569 []; AuditCall (RWFacadeNth bindings i None nth_trace);
      AuditCase 570 []; AuditConstruct 571 []])
    | Some out => (out, [AuditCase 569 []; AuditCall (RWFacadeNth bindings i (Some out) nth_trace);
      AuditCase 572 []])
    end
  | TApp op args =>
    let fix visit (xs : list (term K)) : list (term K) * audit_trace (rw_facade_subst_call K) :=
      match xs with
      | nil => (nil, [AuditCase 573 []; AuditConstruct 574 []])
      | head :: rest =>
        let '(out, first_trace) := rw_facade_subst_atomic bindings head in
        let '(tail, tail_trace) := visit rest in
        (out :: tail, [AuditCase 575 []] ++ first_trace ++ tail_trace ++ [AuditConstruct 576 []])
      end in
    let '(children, trace) := visit args in
    (TApp op children, [AuditCase 577 []] ++ trace ++ [AuditConstruct 578 []])
  end.


Definition rw_facade_binding_atomic {K} (bindings : list (term K)) (index : nat) :
    term K * audit_trace unit :=
  let '(found, trace) := rw_facade_nth bindings index in
  match found with
  | None => (TVar index, trace ++ [AuditCase 710 []; AuditConstruct 711 []])
  | Some t => (t, trace ++ [AuditCase 712 []])
  end.


Inductive rw_facade_guard_action (K : Type) : Type :=
  | RWGuardExternal : nat -> rw_facade_guard_action K
  | RWGuardSubstitution : nat -> term K -> audit_trace unit -> rw_facade_guard_action K.
Arguments RWGuardExternal {K}.
Arguments RWGuardSubstitution {K}.


Inductive rw_facade_guard_program (K : Type) : Type :=
  | RWFacadeGuardReturn : bool -> nat -> rw_facade_guard_program K
  | RWFacadeGuardLookup : nat -> nat ->
      (term K -> rw_facade_guard_program K) -> rw_facade_guard_program K.
Arguments RWFacadeGuardReturn {K}.
Arguments RWFacadeGuardLookup {K}.


Record rw_facade_guard_adapter (K : Type) := RWFacadeGuardAdapter {
  rw_facade_guard_program_of : rewrite_rule K -> rw_facade_guard_program K
}.
Arguments RWFacadeGuardAdapter {K}.
Arguments rw_facade_guard_program_of {K}.


Fixpoint rw_facade_guard_interpret {K} (provider : nat -> term K * audit_trace unit)
    (program : rw_facade_guard_program K) : bool * list (rw_facade_guard_action K) :=
  match program with
  | RWFacadeGuardReturn answer body => (answer, [RWGuardExternal body])
  | RWFacadeGuardLookup body index next =>
    let '(answer, trace) := provider index in
    let '(out, later) := rw_facade_guard_interpret provider (next answer) in
    (out, RWGuardExternal body :: RWGuardSubstitution index answer trace :: later)
  end.


Definition rw_facade_guard_run {K} (adapter : rw_facade_guard_adapter K)
    (rule : rewrite_rule K) (provider : nat -> term K * audit_trace unit) :=
  rw_facade_guard_interpret provider (rw_facade_guard_program_of adapter rule).



Definition rw_facade_guard_action_valid {K} (bindings : list (term K))
    (action : rw_facade_guard_action K) : Prop :=
  match action with
  | RWGuardExternal _ => True
  | RWGuardSubstitution i out trace => rw_facade_binding_atomic bindings i = (out, trace)
  end.


Definition rw_facade_guard_adapter_adequate {K} (adapter : rw_facade_guard_adapter K)
    (external_execution : ((nat -> term K) -> bool) -> (nat -> term K) -> bool ->
      list (rw_facade_guard_action K) -> Prop)
    (r : rewrite_rule K) (bindings : list (term K)) : Prop :=
  let '(answer, actions) := rw_facade_guard_run adapter r (rw_facade_binding_atomic bindings) in
  external_execution (rule_side r) (legacy_subst bindings) answer actions /\
  answer = rule_side r (legacy_subst bindings) /\
  Forall (rw_facade_guard_action_valid bindings) actions.


Fixpoint rw_facade_vars {K} (t : term K) : list nat * audit_trace unit :=
  match t with
  | TVar i => ([i], [AuditCase 500 []; AuditConstruct 501 []; AuditConstruct 502 []])
  | TApp _ args =>
    let fix visit (xs : list (term K)) : list nat * audit_trace unit :=
      match xs with
      | nil => (nil, [AuditCase 503 []; AuditConstruct 504 []])
      | first :: rest =>
        let '(head, head_trace) := rw_facade_vars first in
        let '(tail, tail_trace) := visit rest in
        let '(out, append_trace) := rw_queue_append_atomic head tail in
        (out, [AuditCase 505 []] ++ head_trace ++ tail_trace ++ append_trace)
      end in
    let '(out, trace) := visit args in (out, AuditCase 506 [] :: trace)
  end.


Fixpoint rw_facade_leb (n m : nat) : bool * audit_trace unit :=
  match n with
  | 0 => (true, [AuditCase 507 []; AuditConstruct 508 []])
  | S n' => match m with
    | 0 => (false, [AuditCase 509 []; AuditCase 510 []; AuditConstruct 511 []])
    | S m' => let '(out, trace) := rw_facade_leb n' m' in
      (out, [AuditCase 509 []; AuditCase 512 []] ++ trace)
    end
  end.


Fixpoint rw_facade_forallb (bound : nat) (vars : list nat) : bool * audit_trace unit :=
  match vars with
  | nil => (true, [AuditCase 513 []; AuditConstruct 514 []])
  | i :: rest =>
    let '(current, current_trace) := rw_facade_leb (S i) bound in
    let '(tail, tail_trace) := rw_facade_forallb bound rest in
    let '(answer, and_trace) := if current then (tail, [AuditCase 517 []])
      else (false, [AuditCase 517 []; AuditConstruct 518 []]) in
    (answer, [AuditCase 515 []; AuditConstruct 516 []] ++ current_trace ++ tail_trace ++ and_trace)
  end.


Inductive rw_facade_gate_call (K : Type) : Type :=
  | RWFacadeGuard : rewrite_rule K -> list (term K) -> bool -> list (rw_facade_guard_action K) ->
      rw_facade_gate_call K.
Arguments RWFacadeGuard {K}.


Definition rw_facade_lift_unit {K} (event : audit_event unit) : audit_event (rw_facade_gate_call
    K) :=
  match event with
  | AuditCase site xs => AuditCase site xs
  | AuditConstruct site xs => AuditConstruct site xs
  | AuditKeyBit bit => AuditKeyBit bit
  | AuditArithmetic site xs => AuditArithmetic site xs
  | AuditCall _ => AuditCase 519 []
  end.


Definition rw_facade_gate_atomic {K} (adapter : rw_facade_guard_adapter K)
    (r : rewrite_rule K) (bindings : list (term K)) :
```

```rocq
(** * AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadeMaterialize

    This module fixes source equations, typed observations and contract statements.
    For example, failed lookups retain their original query and selected source cost.
    Builds on: Rewrite and the canonical Collections audit models. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List Bool PArith NArith PeanoNat Lia.

From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsTrie CollectionsMap
  CollectionsFinSet CollectionsUnionFind CollectionsAuditCost CollectionsAuditTrie
  CollectionsAuditEncoding CollectionsAuditPrimitive CollectionsAuditMap CollectionsAuditFinSet
  CollectionsAuditElements CollectionsAuditUnion CollectionsAuditMapTraverse
  CollectionsAuditUnionFind.
From Galois.Rewrite Require Import RewriteSyntax RewriteRules RewriteEquality RewriteEgraph
  RewriteIndex RewriteRebuild RewriteExtract RewriteRun RewriteMatch RewriteAnalysis.

  match
    source with
  | RWVar _ v => (TVar v, 64)
  | RWApp _ op children =>
    let fix visit (ts :
    list (rw_term K unit nat)) : list (term K) * nat :=
      match ts with
      | nil => (nil,
    64)
      | t :: rest => let '(head, hw) := rw_facade_materialize_project_atomic t in
          let
    '(tail, tw) := visit rest in (head :: tail, 64 + hw + tw)
      end in
    let '(args, work)
    := visit children in (TApp op args, 64 + work)
  end.

    let '(tail, work) := rw_facade_binding_max
    rest in
    match tail with
    | None => (Some index, 64 + work)
    | Some largest => let
    '(order, cw) := rw_rp_nat_compare index largest in
        (Some (match order with Gt =>
    index | _ => largest end), 64 + work + cw)
    end
  end.

    audit_map_get audit_positive_encode id (rw_provenance_nodes proof) = (Some node, trace) ->

        rw_evidence_reason_of node = RWEvidenceSym child ->
      rw_facade_materialize_run
    proof child steps child_work ->
      rw_facade_invert_onto steps nil = (out,
    inversion_work) ->
      rw_facade_materialize_run proof id out
        (64 +
    audit_map_source_work audit_basic_encoding_work trace + child_work + inversion_work)
  |
    RPFMaterializeTrans : forall id node trace first second lhs rhs lw rw out append_work,

    audit_map_get audit_positive_encode id (rw_provenance_nodes proof) = (Some node, trace) ->

        rw_evidence_reason_of node = RWEvidenceTrans first second ->

    rw_facade_materialize_run proof first lhs lw ->
      rw_facade_materialize_run proof second
    rhs rw ->
      rw_rp_append lhs rhs = (out, append_work) ->
      rw_facade_materialize_run
    proof id out
        (64 + audit_map_source_work audit_basic_encoding_work trace + lw + rw +
    append_work)
  | RPFMaterializeCongruence : forall id node trace children steps work,

    audit_map_get audit_positive_encode id (rw_provenance_nodes proof) = (Some node, trace) ->

        rw_evidence_reason_of node = RWEvidenceCongruence children ->

    rw_facade_materialize_children_run proof children 0 steps work ->

    rw_facade_materialize_run proof id steps
        (64 + audit_map_source_work
    audit_basic_encoding_work trace + work)
with rw_facade_materialize_children_run {K} (proof :
    rw_provenance K unit nat nat) :
    list positive -> nat -> list (rewrite_step K) -> nat ->
    Prop :=
  | RPFMaterializeChildrenNil : forall position,

    rw_facade_materialize_children_run proof nil position nil 64
  | RPFMaterializeChildrenCons
    : forall id rest position steps sw prefixed pw tail tw out aw,

    rw_facade_materialize_run proof id steps sw ->
      rw_facade_prefix_atomic position steps
    = (prefixed, pw) ->
      rw_facade_materialize_children_run proof rest (S position) tail tw
    ->
      rw_rp_append prefixed tail = (out, aw) ->
      rw_facade_materialize_children_run
    proof (id :: rest) position out
        (64 + sw + pw + tw + aw).

(** Every acyclic finite
    proof has exactly one materialized replay list and source cost. *)

(** This statement fixes the facade materialize total statement contract. *)
Definition rw_facade_materialize_total_statement : Prop :=
  forall K (proof : rw_provenance K unit nat
    nat) id node,
  Map.get positive_encoding id (rw_provenance_nodes proof) = Some node ->

    (forall key current,
    Map.get positive_encoding key (rw_provenance_nodes proof) = Some
    current ->
    Forall (fun child => (child < key)%positive /\
      exists previous, Map.get
    positive_encoding child (rw_provenance_nodes proof) = Some previous)

    (rw_reason_references (rw_evidence_reason_of current))) ->
  exists steps work,
    rw_facade_materialize_run proof id steps work.

(** Materialization preserves the exact
    legacy binding gaps and fallback values. *)

(** This statement fixes the facade bindings erases statement contract. *)
Definition rw_facade_bindings_erases_statement :
    Prop :=
  forall K (attempt : rw_attempt K unit nat nat),
  fst (rw_facade_bindings_atomic
    (rw_attempt_sub attempt)) =
    match fst (rw_facade_binding_max (Map.elements
    (rw_attempt_sub attempt))) with
    | None => nil
    | Some n => map (fun index =>

    match Map.get nat_encoding index (rw_attempt_sub attempt) with
      | None => TVar index

       | Some term => legacy_project term
      end) (seq 0 (S n))
    end.
```

```rocq
(** * AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadeCheckedMaterialize

    This module fixes source equations, typed observations and contract statements.
    For example, failed lookups retain their original query and selected source cost.
    Builds on: Rewrite and the canonical Collections audit models. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List Bool PArith NArith PeanoNat Lia.

From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsTrie CollectionsMap
  CollectionsFinSet CollectionsUnionFind CollectionsAuditCost CollectionsAuditTrie
  CollectionsAuditEncoding CollectionsAuditPrimitive CollectionsAuditMap CollectionsAuditFinSet
  CollectionsAuditElements CollectionsAuditUnion CollectionsAuditMapTraverse
  CollectionsAuditUnionFind.
From Galois.Rewrite Require Import RewriteSyntax RewriteRules RewriteEquality RewriteEgraph
  RewriteIndex RewriteRebuild RewriteExtract RewriteRun RewriteMatch RewriteAnalysis.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesEgraph.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadeMaterialize.
From Galois.Rewrite Require Import RewriteAuditProofCarrier RewriteAuditSharedCompare.
Import List.ListNotations.

Fixpoint rw_facade_references_valid {K} (proof : rw_provenance K unit nat nat) (parent : positive)
    (references : list positive) : bool * nat :=
  match references with
  | nil => (true, 64)
  | child :: rest =>
    let '(order, comparison_work) := rw_rd_positive_compare_cont Eq child parent in
    let '(found, lookup) := audit_map_get audit_positive_encode child (rw_provenance_nodes proof) in
    let '(tail, tail_work) := rw_facade_references_valid proof parent rest in
    let earlier := match order with Lt => true | _ => false end in
    let present := match found with Some _ => true | None => false end in
    (earlier && present && tail, 64 + comparison_work +
      audit_map_source_work audit_basic_encoding_work lookup + tail_work)
  end.


Fixpoint rw_facade_provenance_entries_valid {K} (proof : rw_provenance K unit nat nat)
    (entries : list (positive * (positive * rw_evidence_node K unit nat nat))) : bool * nat :=
  match entries with
  | nil => (true, 64)
  | (position, (stored, node)) :: rest =>
    let '(same_key, key_trace) := audit_positive_eqb position stored in
    let '(references, references_work) := rw_facade_references_valid proof position
      (rw_reason_references (rw_evidence_reason_of node)) in
    let '(tail, tail_work) := rw_facade_provenance_entries_valid proof rest in
    (same_key && references && tail, 128 + audit_positive_eqb_source_work key_trace +
      references_work + tail_work)
  end.


Definition rw_facade_materialize_shape_atomic {K} (proof : rw_provenance K unit nat nat)
    (root : positive) : bool * nat :=
  let '(found, lookup) := audit_map_get audit_positive_encode root (rw_provenance_nodes proof) in
  let '(entries, enumeration) := audit_trie_elements (rw_provenance_nodes proof) in
  let '(valid, validation_work) := rw_facade_provenance_entries_valid proof entries in
  let present := match found with Some _ => true | None => false end in
  (present && valid, 64 + audit_map_source_work audit_basic_encoding_work lookup +
    audit_elements_work enumeration + validation_work).


Inductive rw_facade_checked_materialize_run {K} (proof : rw_provenance K unit nat nat)
    (root : positive) : option (list (rewrite_step K)) -> nat -> Prop :=
  | RPFCheckedMaterializeReject : forall work,
      rw_facade_materialize_shape_atomic proof root = (false, work) ->
      rw_facade_checked_materialize_run proof root None (64 + work)
  | RPFCheckedMaterializeAccept : forall validation_work steps materialization_work,
      rw_facade_materialize_shape_atomic proof root = (true, validation_work) ->
      rw_facade_materialize_run proof root steps materialization_work ->
      rw_facade_checked_materialize_run proof root (Some steps)
        (64 + validation_work + materialization_work).

(** Checked expansion has an output, including a rejection result, for every stored input. *)

(** This statement fixes the facade checked materialize total statement contract. *)
Definition rw_facade_checked_materialize_total_statement : Prop :=
  forall K (proof : rw_provenance K unit nat nat) root,
  exists result work, rw_facade_checked_materialize_run proof root result work.

(** The fixed checked materializer has a unique value and source-work observation. *)

(** This statement fixes the facade checked materialize unique statement contract. *)
Definition rw_facade_checked_materialize_unique_statement : Prop :=
  forall K (proof : rw_provenance K unit nat nat) root first fw second sw,
  rw_facade_checked_materialize_run proof root first fw ->
  rw_facade_checked_materialize_run proof root second sw -> first = second /\ fw = sw.
```

```rocq
Definition rw_facade_table_source_work {A} (trace : audit_trace (rw_facade_table_call A)) : nat :=

    | AuditCall (RWFacadeTableSet _ _ _ _ _ enc trie) =>
      64 + audit_nat_events_work enc + audit_trie_update_trace_source_work trie
    | AuditCall (RWFacadeTableGet _ _ _ _ enc trie) =>
      64 + audit_nat_events_work enc + audit_trie_get_trace_source_work trie
    | _ => 64
    end) + total) 0 trace.

    (trace : audit_trace (rw_facade_subst_call K)) : nat :=

    | AuditCall (RWCodeAppend _ _ _ child) => 64 + 64 * audit_work child
    | AuditCall (RWCodeLength _ child) => 64 + 64 * audit_work child

      64 + audit_list_events_work audit_basic_encoding_work child
    | AuditCall (RWCodeEmbed _ _ child) => 64 + 64 * audit_work child
```

```rocq
(** * AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadePrepare

    This module fixes source equations, typed observations and contract statements.
    For example, failed lookups retain their original query and selected source cost.
    Builds on: Rewrite and the canonical Collections audit models. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List Bool PArith NArith PeanoNat Lia.

From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsTrie CollectionsMap
  CollectionsFinSet CollectionsUnionFind CollectionsAuditCost CollectionsAuditTrie
  CollectionsAuditEncoding CollectionsAuditPrimitive CollectionsAuditMap CollectionsAuditFinSet
  CollectionsAuditElements CollectionsAuditUnion CollectionsAuditMapTraverse
  CollectionsAuditUnionFind.
From Galois.Rewrite Require Import RewriteSyntax RewriteRules RewriteEquality RewriteEgraph
  RewriteIndex RewriteRebuild RewriteExtract RewriteRun RewriteMatch RewriteAnalysis.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesEgraph.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadeMaterialize
  AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadeReference.
From Galois.Rewrite Require Import RewriteAuditIndexRules RewriteAuditQueueReference.
Import List.ListNotations.

Definition rw_facade_nat_adapter : rw_queue_encoder_adapter nat :=
  RwQueueEncoderAdapter (fun index =>
    let '(code, trace) := audit_nat_encode index in (code, audit_nat_events_work trace)).


Definition rw_facade_unit_adapter : rw_queue_encoder_adapter unit :=
  RwQueueEncoderAdapter (fun _ => (1%positive, 64)).


Fixpoint rw_facade_pattern_atomic {K} (source : term K) : rw_pattern K unit nat nat * nat :=
  match source with
  | TVar index => (RWHole tt index, 64)
  | TApp op children =>
    let fix visit (terms : list (term K)) : list (rw_pattern K unit nat nat) * nat :=
      match terms with
      | nil => (nil, 64)
      | t :: rest =>
        let '(head, hw) := rw_facade_pattern_atomic t in
        let '(tail, tw) := visit rest in (head :: tail, 64 + hw + tw)
      end in
    let '(patterns, work) := visit children in (RWPApp tt op patterns, 64 + work)
  end.


Fixpoint rw_facade_holes_atomic (occurrences : list nat) :
    (list nat * FinSet.t nat) * nat :=
  match occurrences with
  | nil => ((nil, FinSet.empty), 64)
  | index :: rest =>
    let '((holes, present), tail_work) := rw_facade_holes_atomic rest in
    let '(seen, lookup) := audit_finset_mem audit_nat_encode index present in
    if seen then
      ((holes, present), 64 + tail_work + audit_finset_source_work audit_nat_events_work lookup)
    else
      let '(next, insertion) := audit_finset_add audit_nat_encode index present in
      ((index :: holes, next), 64 + tail_work +
        audit_finset_source_work audit_nat_events_work lookup +
        audit_finset_source_work audit_nat_events_work insertion)
  end.


Record rw_facade_prepared_rule (K : Type) := RwFacadePreparedRule {
  rw_facade_original_rule : rewrite_rule K;
  rw_facade_core_rule : rw_rule K unit nat nat;
  rw_facade_hole_set : FinSet.t nat
}.
Arguments RwFacadePreparedRule {K}.
Arguments rw_facade_original_rule {K}.
Arguments rw_facade_core_rule {K}.
Arguments rw_facade_hole_set {K}.


Definition rw_facade_prepare_rule_atomic {K} (rule : rewrite_rule K) :
    rw_facade_prepared_rule K * nat :=
  let '(left_vars, lv) := rw_facade_vars (rule_lhs rule) in
  let '(right_vars, rv) := rw_facade_vars (rule_rhs rule) in
  let '(occurrences, append_trace) := rw_queue_append_atomic left_vars right_vars in
  let '((holes, present), hole_work) := rw_facade_holes_atomic occurrences in
  let '(lhs, lw) := rw_facade_pattern_atomic (rule_lhs rule) in
  let '(rhs, rw) := rw_facade_pattern_atomic (rule_rhs rule) in
  let core := RwRule K unit nat nat holes
    (fun index => if existsb (Nat.eqb index) holes then Some tt else None) lhs rhs
    (fun sub => rule_side rule (legacy_total_sub sub)) in
  (RwFacadePreparedRule rule core present,
    64 + 64 * (audit_work lv + audit_work rv + audit_work append_trace) + hole_work + lw + rw).


Record rw_facade_prepared (K : Type) := RwFacadePrepared {
  rw_facade_rule_entries : list (nat * rw_facade_prepared_rule K);
  rw_facade_rule_table : Map.t nat (rw_facade_prepared_rule K);
  rw_facade_original_table : Map.t nat (rewrite_rule K);
  rw_facade_core_rules : list (rw_rule K unit nat nat)
}.
Arguments RwFacadePrepared {K}.
Arguments rw_facade_rule_entries {K}.
Arguments rw_facade_rule_table {K}.
Arguments rw_facade_original_table {K}.
Arguments rw_facade_core_rules {K}.


Fixpoint rw_facade_prepare_atomic {K} (rules : list (rewrite_rule K)) (index : nat) :
    rw_facade_prepared K * nat :=
  match rules with
  | nil => (RwFacadePrepared nil Map.empty Map.empty nil, 64)
  | rule :: rest =>
    let '(tail, tail_work) := rw_facade_prepare_atomic rest (S index) in
    let '(prepared, rule_work) := rw_facade_prepare_rule_atomic rule in
    let '(table, table_trace) := audit_map_set audit_nat_encode index prepared
      (rw_facade_rule_table tail) in
    let '(original, original_trace) := audit_map_set audit_nat_encode index rule
      (rw_facade_original_table tail) in
    (RwFacadePrepared ((index, prepared) :: rw_facade_rule_entries tail) table original
      (rw_facade_core_rule prepared :: rw_facade_core_rules tail),
      64 + tail_work + rule_work + audit_map_source_work audit_nat_events_work table_trace +
        audit_map_source_work audit_nat_events_work original_trace)
  end.


Fixpoint rw_facade_guard_plain {K} (sub : nat -> term K)
    (program : rw_facade_guard_program K) : bool :=
  match program with
  | RWFacadeGuardReturn answer _ => answer
  | RWFacadeGuardLookup _ index next => rw_facade_guard_plain sub (next (sub index))
  end.


Definition rw_facade_guard_program_laws {K} (adapter : rw_facade_guard_adapter K) : Prop :=
  forall rule sub,
    rw_facade_guard_plain sub (rw_facade_guard_program_of adapter rule) = rule_side rule sub.


Definition rw_facade_guard_add_work {K} (work : nat)
    (program : rw_rp_guard_program K unit nat nat) : rw_rp_guard_program K unit nat nat :=
  match program with
  | RPGuardReturn answer body => RPGuardReturn answer (work + body)
  | RPGuardLookup body index next => RPGuardLookup (work + body) index next
  end.


Fixpoint rw_facade_lift_guard {K} (program : rw_facade_guard_program K) :
    rw_rp_guard_program K unit nat nat :=
  match program with
  | RWFacadeGuardReturn answer body => RPGuardReturn answer body
  | RWFacadeGuardLookup body index next =>
    RPGuardLookup body index (fun found =>
      let '(observed, projection_work) :=
        match found with
        | None => (TVar index, 64)
        | Some term => rw_facade_materialize_project_atomic term
        end in
      rw_facade_guard_add_work projection_work (rw_facade_lift_guard (next observed)))
  end.


Definition rw_facade_local_callbacks {K} (guard : rw_facade_guard_adapter K)
    (prepared : rw_facade_prepared_rule K) : rw_rp_rule_callbacks K unit nat nat :=
  RwRpRuleCallbacks K unit nat nat
    (fun _ => (Some tt, 64)) (fun _ _ _ => (true, 64))
    (fun _ index =>
      let '(present, trace) := audit_finset_mem audit_nat_encode index
        (rw_facade_hole_set prepared) in
      ((if present then Some tt else None),
        64 + audit_finset_source_work audit_nat_events_work trace))
    (fun _ => rw_facade_lift_guard
      (rw_facade_guard_program_of guard (rw_facade_original_rule prepared))).

(** Prepared conversion retains the exact raw translated rule, including its condition function. *)

(** This statement fixes the facade prepare agrees statement contract. *)
Definition rw_facade_prepare_agrees_statement : Prop :=
  forall K (rules : list (rewrite_rule K)),
  let '(prepared, _) := rw_facade_prepare_atomic rules 0 in
  rw_facade_core_rules prepared = map legacy_rule rules /\
  rw_facade_original_table prepared = legacy_list_table rules 0 /\
  forall index entry,
    Map.get nat_encoding index (rw_facade_rule_table prepared) = Some entry ->
    nth_error rules index = Some (rw_facade_original_rule entry) /\
    rw_facade_core_rule entry = legacy_rule (rw_facade_original_rule entry) /\
    forall hole, FinSet.mem nat_encoding hole (rw_facade_hole_set entry) =
      existsb (Nat.eqb hole) (rw_holes (rw_facade_core_rule entry)).
```

```rocq
(** * AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadeDimensions

    This module fixes source equations, typed observations and contract statements.
    For example, failed lookups retain their original query and selected source cost.
    Builds on: Rewrite and the canonical Collections audit models. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List Bool PArith NArith PeanoNat Lia.

From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsTrie CollectionsMap
  CollectionsFinSet CollectionsUnionFind CollectionsAuditCost CollectionsAuditTrie
  CollectionsAuditEncoding CollectionsAuditPrimitive CollectionsAuditMap CollectionsAuditFinSet
  CollectionsAuditElements CollectionsAuditUnion CollectionsAuditMapTraverse
  CollectionsAuditUnionFind.

  RewriteIndex RewriteRebuild RewriteExtract RewriteRun RewriteMatch RewriteAnalysis.

From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadePrepare.
From Galois.Rewrite Require Import RewriteAuditIndexDimensions RewriteAuditIndexReference
  RewriteAuditProofCarrier RewriteAuditProofDimensions RewriteAuditProofRun
  RewriteAuditProofTick RewriteAuditSharedExtract RewriteAuditSharedReference.
Import List.ListNotations.

Fixpoint rw_facade_term_dimension {K} (value : term K) : nat :=
  match value with
  | TVar index => S index
  | TApp _ children =>
    S ((fix visit (terms : list (term K)) : nat :=
      match terms with
      | nil => 1
      | term :: rest => S (rw_facade_term_dimension term + visit rest)
      end) children)
  end.


Definition rw_facade_rule_dimension {K} (rule : rewrite_rule K) : nat :=
  S (rw_facade_term_dimension (rule_lhs rule) + rw_facade_term_dimension (rule_rhs rule)).


Fixpoint rw_facade_core_dimension {K} (value : rw_term K unit nat) : nat :=
  match value with
  | RWVar _ index => S index
  | RWApp _ _ children =>
    S ((fix visit (terms : list (rw_term K unit nat)) : nat :=
      match terms with
      | nil => 1
      | term :: rest => S (rw_facade_core_dimension term + visit rest)
      end) children)
  end.


Definition rw_facade_node_dimension {K} (node : rw_node K unit nat) : nat :=
  match node with
  | RWNVar _ index => S index
  | RWNApp _ _ children => S (rw_whole_ids_dimension children)
  end.


Definition rw_facade_graph_dimension {K} (graph : rw_graph K unit nat) : nat :=
  S (rw_whole_graph_dimension graph + rw_whole_map_dimension Pos.size_nat
    (fun entry => Pos.size_nat (fst entry) + rw_facade_node_dimension (snd entry)) (rw_nodes
    graph)).


Definition rw_facade_index_dimension {K} (state : rw_index_state K unit nat) : nat :=
  S (rw_whole_index_dimension state + rw_facade_graph_dimension (rw_index_base state) +
    rw_whole_map_dimension (fun index => S index) rw_whole_set_dimension
      (rw_index_variables state) +
    rw_whole_map_dimension rw_facade_node_dimension rw_whole_set_dimension
      (rw_index_signatures state) +
    rw_whole_map_dimension Pos.size_nat rw_facade_node_dimension (rw_index_node_keys state)).


Definition rw_facade_reason_dimension {K} (reason : rw_evidence_reason K unit nat nat) : nat :=
  match reason with
  | RWEvidenceRule index bindings => S (index +
      rw_whole_map_dimension (fun hole => S hole) rw_facade_core_dimension bindings)
  | _ => rw_whole_reason_dimension reason
  end.


Definition rw_facade_proof_dimension {K} (proof : rw_provenance K unit nat nat) : nat :=
  S (rw_whole_ids_dimension (rw_provenance_ids proof) +
    rw_whole_map_dimension Pos.size_nat (fun node =>
      rw_facade_core_dimension (rw_evidence_left node) +
      rw_facade_core_dimension (rw_evidence_right node) +
      rw_facade_reason_dimension (rw_evidence_reason_of node) +
      fst (rw_evidence_time node) + snd (rw_evidence_time node)) (rw_provenance_nodes proof)).


Definition rw_facade_witness_dimension {K} (store : rw_class_witness_store K unit nat) : nat :=
  let nodes := rw_class_witness_nodes store in
  S (rw_whole_map_dimension Pos.size_nat (fun node =>
      match node with
      | RWSharedVar _ _ _ _ index => S index
      | RWSharedApp _ _ _ _ _ children => S (rw_whole_ids_dimension children)
      end) nodes +
    rw_whole_map_dimension Pos.size_nat Pos.size_nat (rw_class_witness_roots store) +
    fold_right (fun entry total =>
      match rw_shared_unfold (RwSharedTree K unit nat (fst entry) nodes) with
      | None => S total
      | Some term => S (rw_facade_core_dimension term + total)
      end) 1 (Map.elements nodes)).


Definition rw_facade_tracked_dimension {K} (state : rw_tracked_state K unit nat nat) : nat :=
  S (rw_facade_index_dimension (rw_tracked_machine state) +
    rw_facade_proof_dimension (rw_tracked_provenance state) +
    rw_facade_witness_dimension (rw_tracked_witnesses state) +
    rw_whole_map_dimension (fun stamp => S (fst stamp + snd stamp)) Pos.size_nat
      (rw_tracked_event_nodes state)).



Definition rw_facade_prepared_dimension {K} (prepared : rw_facade_prepared K) : nat :=
  S (rw_whole_rules_dimension (rw_facade_core_rules prepared) +
    rw_whole_map_dimension (fun index => S index) (fun entry =>
      rw_facade_rule_dimension (rw_facade_original_rule entry) +
      rw_whole_map_dimension (fun index => S index) (fun _ => 1) (rw_facade_hole_set entry))
      (rw_facade_rule_table prepared) +
    rw_whole_map_dimension (fun index => S index) rw_facade_rule_dimension
      (rw_facade_original_table prepared)).


Definition rw_facade_attempt_dimension {K} (attempt : rw_attempt K unit nat nat) : nat :=
  S (rw_attempt_rule attempt + Pos.size_nat (rw_attempt_root attempt) +
    rw_whole_map_dimension (fun index => S index) rw_facade_core_dimension
      (rw_attempt_sub attempt)).


Definition rw_facade_offers_dimension {K} (offers : list (rw_attempt K unit nat nat)) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun attempt total => S (rw_facade_attempt_dimension attempt + total)) 1 offers.


Definition rw_facade_N_dimension (number : N) : nat :=
  match number with N0 => 1 | Npos value => Pos.size_nat value end.


Definition rw_facade_dp_dimension {K} (table : rw_rd_table) (store : rw_rd_store K unit nat) :
    nat :=
  S (rw_whole_map_dimension Pos.size_nat (fun candidate =>
      Pos.size_nat (rw_rd_pointer candidate) + rw_facade_N_dimension (rw_rd_cost candidate) +
      rw_facade_N_dimension (rw_rd_size candidate)) table +
    rw_whole_map_dimension Pos.size_nat (fun node =>
      match node with
      | RWSharedVar _ _ _ _ index => S index
      | RWSharedApp _ _ _ _ _ children => S (rw_whole_ids_dimension children)
      end) (rw_rd_nodes store) + Pos.size_nat (rw_rd_next store)).


Definition rw_facade_strategy_dimension {K} (prepared : rw_facade_prepared K)
    (state : rw_index_state K unit nat) (graph : rw_graph K unit nat)
    (fresh : rw_index_state K unit nat) (table : rw_rd_table) (store : rw_rd_store K unit nat)
    (offers : list (rw_attempt K unit nat nat)) : nat :=
  S (rw_facade_prepared_dimension prepared + rw_facade_index_dimension state +
    rw_facade_graph_dimension graph + rw_facade_index_dimension fresh +
    rw_facade_dp_dimension table store + rw_facade_offers_dimension offers).


Definition rw_facade_runner_dimension {K} (run : rw_rp_run_state K unit nat nat) : nat :=
  S (rw_facade_tracked_dimension (rw_rp_current run) + rw_rp_position run +
    fold_right (fun event largest => Nat.max largest
      (match event with
      | RWRunRejected attempt => rw_facade_attempt_dimension attempt
      | RWRunAccepted attempt _ => rw_facade_attempt_dimension attempt
      end)) 1 (rw_rp_events run)).


Definition rw_facade_once_dimension {K} (before after : rw_rp_run_state K unit nat nat)
    (callback_dimension : nat) : nat :=
  S (rw_facade_runner_dimension before + rw_facade_runner_dimension after + callback_dimension).


Definition rw_facade_step_dimension {K} (step : rewrite_step K) : nat :=
  S (step_rule step + fold_right (fun index total => S (index + total)) 1 (step_pos step) +
    fold_right (fun term total => S (rw_facade_term_dimension term + total)) 1 (step_subst step)).


Definition rw_facade_leaves_dimension {K} (leaves : Map.t positive (rewrite_step K)) : nat :=
  rw_whole_map_dimension Pos.size_nat rw_facade_step_dimension leaves.
```

```rocq
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool PArith NArith PeanoNat Lia.

  CollectionsFinSet CollectionsUnionFind CollectionsAuditCost CollectionsAuditTrie
  CollectionsAuditEncoding CollectionsAuditPrimitive CollectionsAuditMap CollectionsAuditFinSet
  CollectionsAuditElements CollectionsAuditUnion CollectionsAuditMapTraverse
  CollectionsAuditUnionFind.

  RewriteIndex RewriteRebuild RewriteExtract RewriteRun RewriteMatch RewriteAnalysis.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesEgraph.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadeDimensions
  AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadeMaterialize AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadePrepare
  AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadeReference AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadeSourceWork.
From Galois.Rewrite Require Import RewriteAuditIndexMatch RewriteAuditIndexPrepare
  RewriteAuditIndexRebuild RewriteAuditIndexReference RewriteAuditIndexRules
  RewriteAuditQueueReference RewriteAuditSharedExtract RewriteAuditSharedReference.
Import List.ListNotations.

Fixpoint rw_facade_make_bindings_atomic {K} (graph : rw_graph K unit nat)
    (table : rw_rd_table) (store : rw_rd_store K unit nat) (holes : list nat)
    (assignment : rw_assignment nat) : option (Map.t nat (rw_term K unit nat)) * nat :=
  match holes with
  | nil => (Some Map.empty, 64)
  | hole :: rest =>
    let '(tail, tail_work) := rw_facade_make_bindings_atomic graph table store rest assignment in
    match tail with
    | None => (None, 64 + tail_work)
    | Some bindings =>
      let '(found, lookup) := audit_map_get audit_nat_encode hole assignment in
      let prefix := 64 + tail_work + audit_map_source_work audit_nat_events_work lookup in
      let '(term, term_work) :=
        match found with
        | None => (Some (RWVar tt hole), 64)
        | Some root =>
          let '(candidate, query_work) := rw_rd_candidate_get graph table root in
          match candidate with
          | None => (None, 64 + query_work)
          | Some candidate =>
            let '(out, trace) := rw_shared_unfold_atomic
              (RwSharedTree K unit nat (rw_rd_pointer candidate) (rw_rd_nodes store)) in
            (out, 64 + query_work + rw_shared_unfold_trace_cost trace)
          end
        end in
      match term with
      | None => (None, prefix + term_work)
      | Some term =>
        let '(out, insertion) := audit_map_set audit_nat_encode hole term bindings in
        (Some out, prefix + term_work + audit_map_source_work audit_nat_events_work insertion)
      end
    end
  end.


Definition rw_facade_rule_offers_atomic {K} (op : rw_queue_encoder_adapter K)
    (state : rw_index_state K unit nat) (graph : rw_graph K unit nat)
    (table : rw_rd_table) (store : rw_rd_store K unit nat)
    (entry : nat * rw_facade_prepared_rule K) : list (rw_attempt K unit nat nat) * nat :=
  let '(index, prepared) := entry in
  let rule := rw_facade_core_rule prepared in
  rw_ri_match_flat_map (fun root =>
    let '(assignments, matching_work) := rw_ri_match_atomic op rw_facade_unit_adapter
      rw_facade_nat_adapter rw_facade_nat_adapter state root (rw_lhs rule) in
    let '(out, binding_work) := rw_ri_match_flat_map (fun assignment =>
      let '(bindings, work) := rw_facade_make_bindings_atomic graph table store
        (rw_holes rule) assignment in
      ((match bindings with None => nil | Some bindings => [RwAttempt index root bindings] end),
        64 + work)) assignments in
    (out, 64 + matching_work + binding_work)) (rw_roots graph).


Definition rw_facade_offer_gate_atomic {K} (op : rw_queue_encoder_adapter K)
    (guard : rw_facade_guard_adapter K) (prepared : rw_facade_prepared K)
    (attempt : rw_attempt K unit nat nat) : bool * nat :=
  let '(found, lookup) := audit_map_get audit_nat_encode (rw_attempt_rule attempt)
    (rw_facade_rule_table prepared) in
  let prefix := 64 + audit_map_source_work audit_nat_events_work lookup in
  match found with
  | None => (false, prefix)
  | Some entry =>
    let '(gate, gate_work) := rw_rp_rule_body_gate_atomic rw_facade_unit_adapter
    rw_facade_nat_adapter
      (rw_facade_local_callbacks guard entry) (rw_facade_core_rule entry) attempt in
    match gate with
    | None => (false, prefix + gate_work)
    | Some (lhs, rhs) =>
      let '(left_legacy, lw) := rw_facade_materialize_project_atomic lhs in
      let '(right_legacy, rw) := rw_facade_materialize_project_atomic rhs in
      let '(bindings, bw) := rw_facade_bindings_atomic (rw_attempt_sub attempt) in
      let '(replayed, trace) := rw_facade_step_atomic (rw_external_encoding_events op) guard
        (rw_facade_original_table prepared) left_legacy
        (RewriteStep nil (rw_attempt_rule attempt) true bindings) in
      let prefix := prefix + gate_work + lw + rw + bw + rw_facade_step_source_work trace in
      match replayed with
      | None => (false, prefix)
      | Some actual =>
        let '(same, comparison) := rw_facade_eq_atomic (rw_external_encoding_events op) actual
    right_legacy in
        (same, prefix + rw_facade_eq_source_work comparison)
      end
    end
  end.


Fixpoint rw_facade_choose_atomic {K} (op : rw_queue_encoder_adapter K)
    (guard : rw_facade_guard_adapter K) (prepared : rw_facade_prepared K)
    (offers : list (rw_attempt K unit nat nat)) : option (rw_attempt K unit nat nat) * nat :=
  match offers with
  | nil => (None, 64)
  | attempt :: rest =>
    let '(accepted, gate_work) := rw_facade_offer_gate_atomic op guard prepared attempt in
    if accepted then (Some attempt, 64 + gate_work)
    else let '(out, tail_work) := rw_facade_choose_atomic op guard prepared rest in
      (out, 64 + gate_work + tail_work)
  end.


Inductive rw_facade_strategy_run {K} (op : rw_queue_encoder_adapter K)
    (guard : rw_facade_guard_adapter K) (prepared : rw_facade_prepared K)
    (state : rw_index_state K unit nat) : option (rw_attempt K unit nat nat) -> nat -> nat ->
    Prop :=
  | RPFStrategyEmpty : forall graph graph_work fresh prepare_trace length_trace,
      rw_ri_graph_atomic state = (graph, graph_work) ->
      rw_ri_prepare_once op rw_facade_nat_adapter graph = (fresh, prepare_trace) ->
      rw_fuel_length (rw_roots graph) = (0, length_trace) ->
      rw_facade_strategy_run op guard prepared state None
        (64 + graph_work + rw_ri_prepare_once_work prepare_trace + audit_work length_trace)
        (S (rw_facade_prepared_dimension prepared + rw_facade_index_dimension state +
          rw_facade_graph_dimension graph + rw_facade_index_dimension fresh))
  | RPFStrategyReady : forall graph graph_work fresh prepare_trace count length_trace fuel
    fuel_trace
      entries enumeration table store dp_work offers offers_work chosen choice_work,
      rw_ri_graph_atomic state = (graph, graph_work) ->
      rw_ri_prepare_once op rw_facade_nat_adapter graph = (fresh, prepare_trace) ->
      rw_fuel_length (rw_roots graph) = (S count, length_trace) ->
      rw_fuel_to_positive count = (fuel, fuel_trace) ->
      audit_map_elements (rw_nodes graph) = (entries, enumeration) ->
      rw_rd_rounds_run op rw_facade_unit_adapter rw_facade_nat_adapter
        (fun _ => (0, 64)) (fun _ => (0, 64)) graph entries fuel Map.empty
        (RwRdStore Map.empty 1%positive) table store dp_work ->
      rw_ri_match_flat_map (rw_facade_rule_offers_atomic op fresh graph table store)
        (rw_facade_rule_entries prepared) = (offers, offers_work) ->
      rw_facade_choose_atomic op guard prepared offers = (chosen, choice_work) ->
      rw_facade_strategy_run op guard prepared state chosen
        (64 + graph_work + rw_ri_prepare_once_work prepare_trace + audit_work length_trace +
          audit_work fuel_trace + audit_elements_work enumeration + dp_work +
          offers_work + choice_work)
        (rw_facade_strategy_dimension prepared state graph fresh table store offers).
```

```rocq
    Builds on: Rewrite and the canonical Collections audit models. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List Bool PArith NArith PeanoNat Lia.

From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsTrie CollectionsMap
  CollectionsFinSet CollectionsUnionFind CollectionsAuditCost CollectionsAuditTrie
  CollectionsAuditEncoding CollectionsAuditPrimitive CollectionsAuditMap CollectionsAuditFinSet
  CollectionsAuditElements CollectionsAuditUnion CollectionsAuditMapTraverse

  RewriteIndex RewriteRebuild RewriteExtract RewriteRun RewriteMatch RewriteAnalysis.

Definition rw_facade_apply_atomic {K} (EK : encoding K) (op : rw_queue_encoder_adapter K)
    (guard : rw_facade_guard_adapter K) (prepared : rw_facade_prepared K) (position : nat)
    (state : rw_tracked_state K unit nat nat) (attempt : rw_attempt K unit nat nat) :
    option (rw_tracked_state K unit nat nat * list rw_index_event) * nat :=
  let '(found, lookup) := audit_map_get audit_nat_encode (rw_attempt_rule attempt)
    (rw_facade_rule_table prepared) in
  let prefix := 64 + audit_map_source_work audit_nat_events_work lookup in
  match found with
  | None => (None, prefix)
  | Some entry =>
    let '(gate, gate_work) := rw_rp_rule_body_gate_atomic rw_facade_unit_adapter
    rw_facade_nat_adapter
      (rw_facade_local_callbacks guard entry) (rw_facade_core_rule entry) attempt in
    match gate with
    | None => (None, prefix + gate_work)
    | Some (lhs, rhs) =>
      let '(represented, member_work) := rw_ri_member_atomic op rw_facade_unit_adapter
        rw_facade_nat_adapter (rw_tracked_machine state) lhs (rw_attempt_root attempt) in
      if represented then

        match accepted with

        | Some next =>
          let '(out, rebuild_work) := rw_rp_rebuild_atomic op rw_facade_unit_adapter
            rw_facade_nat_adapter (S position) next in
          (Some out, prefix + gate_work + member_work + acceptance_work + rebuild_work)
        end
      else (None, prefix + gate_work + member_work)
    end
  end.


Inductive rw_facade_once_run {K} (EK : encoding K) (op : rw_queue_encoder_adapter K)
    (guard : rw_facade_guard_adapter K) (prepared : rw_facade_prepared K) :

Inductive rw_facade_repeat_run {K} (EK : encoding K) (op : rw_queue_encoder_adapter K)
    (guard : rw_facade_guard_adapter K) (prepared : rw_facade_prepared K) :
    positive -> rw_rp_run_state K unit nat nat -> rw_rp_run_state K unit nat nat -> nat -> nat ->

Fixpoint rw_facade_capture_entries {K}
    (entries : list (positive * rw_evidence_node K unit nat nat))
    (leaves : Map.t positive (rewrite_step K)) : Map.t positive (rewrite_step K) * nat :=

Definition rw_facade_capture_atomic {K} (output : rw_tracked_output K unit nat nat) :

    (fuel : positive) (seed : term K) : rw_legacy_tracked_state K -> nat -> nat -> Prop :=
```
