```rocq
Definition rw_facade_legacy_dimension {K} (legacy : rw_legacy_tracked_state K) : nat :=
  S (Pos.size_nat (rw_legacy_root K legacy) +
    rw_facade_tracked_dimension (rw_tracked_final (rw_legacy_core K legacy)) +
    rw_facade_leaves_dimension (rw_legacy_leaves K legacy)).


Definition rw_facade_dag_dimension {K} (dag : rw_shared_tree K unit nat) : nat :=
  S (Pos.size_nat (rw_shared_root K unit nat dag) +
    rw_whole_map_dimension Pos.size_nat (fun node =>
      match node with
      | RWSharedVar _ _ _ _ index => S index
      | RWSharedApp _ _ _ _ _ children => S (rw_whole_ids_dimension children)
      end) (rw_shared_nodes K unit nat dag)).


Definition rw_facade_steps_dimension {K} (steps : list (rewrite_step K)) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun step total => S (rw_facade_step_dimension step + total)) 1 steps.


Inductive rw_facade_explain_core_run {K} (op : rw_queue_encoder_adapter K)
    (guard : rw_facade_guard_adapter K) (rules : list (rewrite_rule K)) (seed : term K)
    (source : rw_term K unit nat) (legacy : rw_legacy_tracked_state K)
    (tree : rw_term K unit nat) : option (list (rewrite_step K)) -> nat -> nat -> Prop :=
  | RPFExplainMissing : forall selected_work,
      rw_rp_selected_atomic op rw_facade_unit_adapter rw_facade_nat_adapter
        (rw_tracked_final (rw_legacy_core K legacy)) (rw_legacy_root K legacy) source tree =
        (None, selected_work) ->
      rw_facade_explain_core_run op guard rules seed source legacy tree None (64 + selected_work)
        (S (rw_facade_legacy_dimension legacy + rw_facade_core_dimension source +
          rw_facade_core_dimension tree))
  | RPFExplainMalformed : forall proof id selected_work materialization_work,
      rw_rp_selected_atomic op rw_facade_unit_adapter rw_facade_nat_adapter
        (rw_tracked_final (rw_legacy_core K legacy)) (rw_legacy_root K legacy) source tree =
        (Some (proof, id), selected_work) ->
      rw_facade_checked_materialize_run proof id None materialization_work ->
      rw_facade_explain_core_run op guard rules seed source legacy tree None
        (64 + selected_work + materialization_work)
        (S (rw_facade_legacy_dimension legacy + rw_facade_core_dimension source +
          rw_facade_core_dimension tree + rw_facade_proof_dimension proof + Pos.size_nat id))
  | RPFExplainChecked : forall proof id selected_work steps materialization_work
      output projection_work accepted checker_trace,
      rw_rp_selected_atomic op rw_facade_unit_adapter rw_facade_nat_adapter
        (rw_tracked_final (rw_legacy_core K legacy)) (rw_legacy_root K legacy) source tree =
        (Some (proof, id), selected_work) ->
      rw_facade_checked_materialize_run proof id (Some steps) materialization_work ->
      rw_facade_materialize_project_atomic tree = (output, projection_work) ->
      rw_facade_checker_atomic (rw_external_encoding_events op) guard rules seed output steps =
        (accepted, checker_trace) ->
      rw_facade_explain_core_run op guard rules seed source legacy tree
        (if accepted then Some steps else None)
        (64 + selected_work + materialization_work + projection_work +
          rw_facade_checker_source_work checker_trace)
        (S (rw_facade_legacy_dimension legacy + rw_facade_core_dimension source +
          rw_facade_core_dimension tree + rw_facade_proof_dimension proof + Pos.size_nat id +
          rw_facade_steps_dimension steps + rw_facade_term_dimension output +
          rw_facade_term_dimension seed)).


Inductive rw_facade_selected_run {K} (op : rw_queue_encoder_adapter K)
    (guard : rw_facade_guard_adapter K) (rules : list (rewrite_rule K)) (seed : term K)
    (legacy : rw_legacy_tracked_state K) (output : term K) :
    option (list (rewrite_step K)) -> nat -> nat -> Prop :=
  | RPFSelectedRun : forall source source_trace tree tree_trace result work dimension,
      rw_facade_embed_atomic seed = (source, source_trace) ->
      rw_facade_embed_atomic output = (tree, tree_trace) ->
      rw_facade_explain_core_run op guard rules seed source legacy tree result work dimension ->
      rw_facade_selected_run op guard rules seed legacy output result
        (64 + 64 * audit_work source_trace + 64 * audit_work tree_trace + work)
        (S (rw_facade_term_dimension seed + rw_facade_term_dimension output + dimension)).


Inductive rw_facade_extract_run {K} (op : rw_queue_encoder_adapter K)
    (cost : K -> nat * nat) (legacy : rw_legacy_tracked_state K) :
    option (rw_shared_tree K unit nat * rw_term K unit nat) -> nat -> nat -> Prop :=
  | RPFExtractMissing : forall graph graph_work extraction_work,
      rw_ri_graph_atomic (rw_tracked_machine (rw_tracked_final (rw_legacy_core K legacy))) =
        (graph, graph_work) ->
      rw_shared_extract_run op rw_facade_unit_adapter rw_facade_nat_adapter
        (fun _ => (0, 64)) cost graph (rw_legacy_root K legacy) None extraction_work ->
      rw_facade_extract_run op cost legacy None (64 + graph_work + extraction_work)
        (S (rw_facade_legacy_dimension legacy + rw_facade_graph_dimension graph))
  | RPFExtractMalformed : forall graph graph_work dag extraction_work unfolding_trace,
      rw_ri_graph_atomic (rw_tracked_machine (rw_tracked_final (rw_legacy_core K legacy))) =
        (graph, graph_work) ->
      rw_shared_extract_run op rw_facade_unit_adapter rw_facade_nat_adapter
        (fun _ => (0, 64)) cost graph (rw_legacy_root K legacy) (Some dag) extraction_work ->
      rw_shared_unfold_atomic dag = (None, unfolding_trace) ->
      rw_facade_extract_run op cost legacy None
        (64 + graph_work + extraction_work + rw_shared_unfold_trace_cost unfolding_trace)
        (S (rw_facade_legacy_dimension legacy + rw_facade_graph_dimension graph +
          rw_facade_dag_dimension dag))
  | RPFExtractFound : forall graph graph_work dag extraction_work tree unfolding_trace,
      rw_ri_graph_atomic (rw_tracked_machine (rw_tracked_final (rw_legacy_core K legacy))) =
        (graph, graph_work) ->
      rw_shared_extract_run op rw_facade_unit_adapter rw_facade_nat_adapter
        (fun _ => (0, 64)) cost graph (rw_legacy_root K legacy) (Some dag) extraction_work ->
      rw_shared_unfold_atomic dag = (Some tree, unfolding_trace) ->
      rw_facade_extract_run op cost legacy (Some (dag, tree))
        (64 + graph_work + extraction_work + rw_shared_unfold_trace_cost unfolding_trace)
        (S (rw_facade_legacy_dimension legacy + rw_facade_graph_dimension graph +
          rw_facade_dag_dimension dag + rw_facade_core_dimension tree)).


Inductive rw_facade_optimizer_run {K} (EK : encoding K) (op : rw_queue_encoder_adapter K)
    (guard : rw_facade_guard_adapter K) (cost : K -> nat * nat)
    (rules : list (rewrite_rule K)) (fuel : positive) (seed : term K) :
    option (rw_shared_tree K unit nat * list (rewrite_step K)) -> nat -> nat -> Prop :=
  | RPFOptimizerNoTree : forall legacy run_work run_dimension extraction_work extraction_dimension,
      rw_facade_tracked_run EK op guard rules fuel seed legacy run_work run_dimension ->
      rw_facade_extract_run op cost legacy None extraction_work extraction_dimension ->
      rw_facade_optimizer_run EK op guard cost rules fuel seed None
        (64 + run_work + extraction_work) (Nat.max run_dimension extraction_dimension)
  | RPFOptimizerSelected : forall legacy run_work run_dimension dag tree extraction_work
      extraction_dimension source source_trace result selection_work selection_dimension,
      rw_facade_tracked_run EK op guard rules fuel seed legacy run_work run_dimension ->
      rw_facade_extract_run op cost legacy (Some (dag, tree)) extraction_work
    extraction_dimension ->
      rw_facade_embed_atomic seed = (source, source_trace) ->
      rw_facade_explain_core_run op guard rules seed source legacy tree
        result selection_work selection_dimension ->
      rw_facade_optimizer_run EK op guard cost rules fuel seed
        (option_map (fun steps => (dag, steps)) result)
        (64 + run_work + extraction_work + 64 * audit_work source_trace + selection_work)
        (Nat.max run_dimension (Nat.max extraction_dimension selection_dimension)).
```

```rocq
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool PArith NArith PeanoNat Lia.

Definition rw_legacy_binding_limit {K} (a : rw_attempt K unit nat nat) : option nat :=
  fold_right (fun entry limit =>
    match limit with
    | None => Some (fst entry)
    | Some n => Some (Nat.max (fst entry) n)
    end) None (Map.elements (rw_attempt_sub a)).


Definition rw_legacy_binding_value {K} (a : rw_attempt K unit nat nat) (index : nat) : term K :=
  match Map.get nat_encoding index (rw_attempt_sub a) with
  | None => TVar index
  | Some value => legacy_project value
  end.


Definition rw_legacy_binding_list {K} (a : rw_attempt K unit nat nat) : list (term K) :=
  match rw_legacy_binding_limit a with
  | None => []
  | Some max_index => map (rw_legacy_binding_value a) (seq 0 (S max_index))
  end.

Definition rw_legacy_offer_gate {K} (EK : encoding K) (rules : list (rewrite_rule K))
    (a : rw_attempt K unit nat nat) : bool :=
  match nth_error rules (rw_attempt_rule a) with
  | None => false
  | Some legacy =>
    let rule := legacy_rule legacy in
    let sub := rw_attempt_substitution nat_encoding a in
    if rw_check_sub EK unit_encoding nat_encoding nat_encoding legacy_signature rule sub &&
       rw_condition rule sub then
      match rw_instantiate sub (rw_lhs rule), rw_instantiate sub (rw_rhs rule) with
      | Some lhs, Some rhs =>
        check_explanation EK rules (legacy_project lhs) (legacy_project rhs)
          [RewriteStep [] (rw_attempt_rule a) true (rw_legacy_binding_list a)]
      | _, _ => false
      end
    else false
  end.

Definition rw_legacy_prepared_gate {K} (EK : encoding K)
    (table : Map.t nat (rewrite_rule K)) (a : rw_attempt K unit nat nat) : bool :=
  match Map.get nat_encoding (rw_attempt_rule a) table with
  | None => false
  | Some legacy =>
    let rule := legacy_rule legacy in
    let sub := rw_attempt_substitution nat_encoding a in
    if rw_check_sub EK unit_encoding nat_encoding nat_encoding legacy_signature rule sub &&
       rw_condition rule sub then
      match rw_instantiate sub (rw_lhs rule), rw_instantiate sub (rw_rhs rule) with
      | Some lhs, Some rhs =>
        let step := RewriteStep [] (rw_attempt_rule a) true (rw_legacy_binding_list a) in
match legacy_replay_step EK (fun i => Map.get nat_encoding i table) (legacy_project lhs)
    step with
        | None => false
        | Some actual => term_eqb EK actual (legacy_project rhs)
        end
      | _, _ => false
      end
    else false
  end.

(** This statement fixes the legacy prepared gate agrees contract. *)
Definition rw_legacy_prepared_gate_agrees_contract : Prop := forall K (EK : encoding K) rules a,
  rw_legacy_prepared_gate EK (legacy_list_table rules 0) a = rw_legacy_offer_gate EK rules a.


Definition rw_legacy_choose {K} (EK : encoding K) (table : Map.t nat (rewrite_rule K))
    (offers : list (rw_attempt K unit nat nat)) : option (rw_attempt K unit nat nat) :=
  find (rw_legacy_prepared_gate EK table) offers.

(** This statement fixes the legacy choose sound contract. *)
Definition rw_legacy_choose_sound_contract : Prop := forall K (EK : encoding K) rules offers chosen,
  rw_legacy_choose EK (legacy_list_table rules 0) offers = Some chosen ->
  In chosen offers /\ rw_legacy_offer_gate EK rules chosen = true.

(** This statement fixes the legacy choose complete contract. *)
Definition rw_legacy_choose_complete_contract : Prop := forall K (EK : encoding K) rules offers,
  (exists offer, In offer offers /\ rw_legacy_offer_gate EK rules offer = true) ->
  exists chosen, rw_legacy_choose EK (legacy_list_table rules 0) offers = Some chosen.


Fixpoint rw_legacy_make_bindings {K} (g : rw_graph K unit nat) (trees : rw_tree_table K unit nat)
    (holes : list nat) (assignment : rw_assignment nat) : option (Map.t nat (rw_term K unit nat)) :=
  match holes with
  | [] => Some Map.empty
  | hole :: rest =>
    match rw_legacy_make_bindings g trees rest assignment with
    | None => None
    | Some bindings =>
      match Map.get nat_encoding hole assignment with
      | None => Some (Map.set nat_encoding hole (RWVar tt hole) bindings)
      | Some c =>
        match rw_tree_get g trees c with
        | None => None
        | Some candidate => Some (Map.set nat_encoding hole (rw_candidate_tree candidate) bindings)
        end
      end
    end
  end.

Definition rw_legacy_rule_offers {K} (EK : encoding K) (view : rw_snapshot_view K unit nat)
      (g : rw_graph K unit nat) (trees : rw_tree_table K unit nat) (entry : nat * rewrite_rule K) :
      list (rw_attempt K unit nat nat) :=
    let '(index, old_rule) := entry in
    let rule := legacy_rule old_rule in
    flat_map (fun root =>
      flat_map (fun assignment =>
        match rw_legacy_make_bindings g trees (rw_holes rule) assignment with
        | None => []
        | Some bindings => [RwAttempt index root bindings]
        end) (rw_view_match EK unit_encoding nat_encoding nat_encoding (rw_snapshot_base view)
    root (rw_lhs rule)))
      (rw_view_roots (rw_snapshot_base view) tt).

Definition rw_legacy_offers {K} (EK : encoding K) (rules : list (rewrite_rule K))
      (view : rw_snapshot_view K unit nat) : list (rw_attempt K unit nat nat) :=
    let g := rw_snapshot_graph view tt in
    let trees := rw_tree_rounds EK unit_encoding nat_encoding (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0)
      g (N.of_nat (length (rw_roots g))) in
    flat_map (rw_legacy_rule_offers EK view g trees) (combine (seq 0 (length rules)) rules).

Definition rw_legacy_strategy {K} (EK : encoding K) (rules : list (rewrite_rule K))
      (table : Map.t nat (rewrite_rule K)) (view : rw_snapshot_view K unit nat) :
      option (rw_attempt K unit nat nat) :=
    rw_legacy_choose EK table (rw_legacy_offers EK rules view).

(** This statement fixes the legacy strategy gate contract. *)
Definition rw_legacy_strategy_gate_contract : Prop := forall K (EK : encoding K) rules view attempt,
    rw_legacy_strategy EK rules (legacy_list_table rules 0) view = Some attempt ->
    rw_legacy_offer_gate EK rules attempt = true.

(** This statement fixes the legacy strategy complete offers contract. *)
Definition rw_legacy_strategy_complete_offers_contract : Prop := forall K (EK : encoding K) rules
    view,
    (exists attempt, In attempt (rw_legacy_offers EK rules view) /\
      rw_legacy_offer_gate EK rules attempt = true) ->
    exists attempt, rw_legacy_strategy EK rules (legacy_list_table rules 0) view = Some attempt.
```

```rocq
    This module fixes source equations, typed observations and contract statements.
    For example, failed lookups retain their original query and selected source cost.
    Builds on: Rewrite and the canonical Collections audit models. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List Bool PArith NArith PeanoNat Lia.

From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsTrie CollectionsMap
  CollectionsFinSet CollectionsUnionFind CollectionsAuditCost CollectionsAuditTrie
  CollectionsAuditEncoding CollectionsAuditPrimitive CollectionsAuditMap CollectionsAuditFinSet
  CollectionsAuditElements CollectionsAuditUnion CollectionsAuditMapTraverse
  CollectionsAuditUnionFind.
From Galois.Rewrite Require Import RewriteSyntax RewriteRules RewriteEquality RewriteEgraph
  RewriteIndex RewriteRebuild RewriteExtract RewriteRun RewriteMatch RewriteAnalysis.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesEgraph.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadeCheckedMaterialize
  AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadeDimensions AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadeOptimizer
  AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadePrepare AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadeReference

From Galois.Rewrite Require Import RewriteAuditIndexExternal RewriteAuditIndexReference
  RewriteAuditProofCarrier RewriteAuditProofRun RewriteAuditProofTick RewriteAuditQueueReference.
Import List.ListNotations.

Fixpoint rw_facade_term_ops {K} (value : term K) : list K :=
  match value with
  | TVar _ => nil
  | TApp op children =>
    op :: (fix visit (terms : list (term K)) : list K :=
      match terms with
      | nil => nil
      | term :: rest => rw_facade_term_ops term ++ visit rest
      end) children
  end.


Fixpoint rw_facade_core_ops {K} (value : rw_term K unit nat) : list K :=
  match value with
  | RWVar _ _ => nil
  | RWApp _ op children =>
    op :: (fix visit (terms : list (rw_term K unit nat)) : list K :=
      match terms with
      | nil => nil
      | term :: rest => rw_facade_core_ops term ++ visit rest
      end) children
  end.


Definition rw_facade_input_ops {K} (rules : list (rewrite_rule K)) (terms : list (term K)) :
    list K :=
  flat_map (fun rule => rw_facade_term_ops (rule_lhs rule) ++
    rw_facade_term_ops (rule_rhs rule)) rules ++ flat_map rw_facade_term_ops terms.


Definition rw_facade_binding_dimension {K} (bindings : list (term K)) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun term total => S (rw_facade_term_dimension term + total)) 1 bindings.


Fixpoint rw_facade_guard_control {K} (sub : nat -> term K)
    (program : rw_facade_guard_program K) : nat :=
  match program with
  | RWFacadeGuardReturn _ body => 64 + body
  | RWFacadeGuardLookup body index next =>
    64 + body + rw_facade_guard_control sub (next (sub index))
  end.


Fixpoint rw_facade_guard_query_bound {K} (bound : nat) (sub : nat -> term K)
    (program : rw_facade_guard_program K) : Prop :=
  match program with
  | RWFacadeGuardReturn _ _ => True
  | RWFacadeGuardLookup _ index next => index <= bound /\
      rw_facade_guard_query_bound bound sub (next (sub index))
  end.


Record rw_facade_foreign_envelope {K} (op : rw_queue_encoder_adapter K)
    (guard : rw_facade_guard_adapter K) (cost : K -> nat * nat)
    (rules : list (rewrite_rule K)) (operators : list K)
    (dimension width body weight : nat) : Prop := RwFacadeForeignEnvelope {
  rw_facade_foreign_operator : forall k, In k operators -> rw_whole_encoder_fits op width body k;
  rw_facade_foreign_weight : forall k, In k operators -> fst (cost k) <= weight /\ snd (cost k)
    <= body;
  rw_facade_foreign_guard : forall rule bindings,
    In rule rules -> rw_facade_binding_dimension bindings <= Nat.pow (S dimension) 16 ->
    Forall (fun term => Forall (rw_whole_encoder_fits op width body) (rw_facade_term_ops term))
      bindings ->
    rw_facade_guard_control (legacy_subst bindings) (rw_facade_guard_program_of guard rule)
      <= body /\
    rw_facade_guard_query_bound body (legacy_subst bindings)
      (rw_facade_guard_program_of guard rule)
}.


Definition rw_facade_whole_ceiling (fuel : N) (dimension width body weight : nat) : N :=
  (1099511627776 * (1 + fuel) * (1 + N.of_nat body) *
    N.pow (N.of_nat (S (dimension + width + body + weight)))
      (256 + 32 * N.pow (N.of_nat dimension) 4))%N.

(** Rule preparation accounts for every fixed unary-natural encoder and stored table write. *)

(** This statement fixes the facade prepare bound statement contract. *)
Definition rw_facade_prepare_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall K (rules : list (rewrite_rule K)),
  let dimension := fold_right (fun rule total => S (rw_facade_rule_dimension rule + total)) 1
    rules in
  (N.of_nat (snd (rw_facade_prepare_atomic rules 0)) <=
    65536 * N.pow (N.of_nat (S dimension)) 16)%N.

(** Leaf capture includes expanded binding lists, projection and every actual output map write. *)

(** This statement fixes the facade capture bound statement contract. *)
Definition rw_facade_capture_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall K (output : rw_tracked_output K unit nat nat),
  let '(leaves, work) := rw_facade_capture_atomic output in
  let dimension := S (rw_facade_proof_dimension
    (rw_tracked_provenance (rw_tracked_final output)) + rw_facade_leaves_dimension leaves) in
  (N.of_nat work <= 65536 * N.pow (N.of_nat dimension) 16)%N.

(** Checked proof expansion pays for repeated proof-DAG occurrences even when they emit no steps. *)

(** This statement fixes the facade materialize bound statement contract. *)
Definition rw_facade_materialize_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall K (proof : rw_provenance K unit nat nat) root result work,
  rw_facade_checked_materialize_run proof root result work ->
  let dimension := S (rw_facade_proof_dimension proof + Pos.size_nat root +
    match result with None => 1 | Some steps => rw_facade_steps_dimension steps end) in
  (N.of_nat work <= rw_facade_whole_ceiling 0%N dimension 0 0 0)%N.

(** The complete optimizer ceiling covers preparation, all callbacks and every selected-output
    phase. *)

(** This statement fixes the facade optimizer whole bound statement contract. *)
Definition rw_facade_optimizer_whole_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall K (EK : encoding K) (op : rw_queue_encoder_adapter K) guard cost rules fuel seed
    result work dimension width body weight,
  (forall k, fst (rw_queue_encoder_run op k) = encode EK k) ->
  rw_facade_guard_program_laws guard ->
  rw_facade_optimizer_run EK op guard cost rules fuel seed result work dimension ->
  rw_facade_foreign_envelope op guard cost rules (rw_facade_input_ops rules [seed])
    dimension width body weight ->
  (N.of_nat work <= rw_facade_whole_ceiling (Npos fuel) dimension width body weight)%N.


Definition rw_facade_node_ops {K} (node : rw_node K unit nat) : list K :=
  match node with RWNVar _ _ => nil | RWNApp _ op _ => [op] end.


Definition rw_facade_reason_ops {K} (reason : rw_evidence_reason K unit nat nat) : list K :=
  match reason with
  | RWEvidenceRule _ bindings =>
    flat_map (fun entry => rw_facade_core_ops (snd entry)) (Map.elements bindings)
  | _ => nil
  end.


Definition rw_facade_selected_ops {K} (rules : list (rewrite_rule K)) (seed output : term K)
    (legacy : rw_legacy_tracked_state K) : list K :=
  let state := rw_tracked_final (rw_legacy_core K legacy) in
  rw_facade_input_ops rules [seed; output] ++
  flat_map (fun entry => rw_facade_node_ops (snd (snd entry)))
    (Map.elements (rw_nodes (rw_index_base (rw_tracked_machine state)))) ++
  flat_map (fun entry => rw_facade_core_ops (rw_evidence_left (snd entry)) ++
    rw_facade_core_ops (rw_evidence_right (snd entry)) ++
    rw_facade_reason_ops (rw_evidence_reason_of (snd entry)))
    (Map.elements (rw_provenance_nodes (rw_tracked_provenance state))).

(** Selected explanation reconstruction is total, including rejection of malformed supplied
    state. *)

(** This statement fixes the facade selected total statement contract. *)
Definition rw_facade_selected_total_statement : Prop :=
  forall K (op : rw_queue_encoder_adapter K) guard rules seed
    (legacy : rw_legacy_tracked_state K) output,
  exists result work dimension,
    rw_facade_selected_run op guard rules seed legacy output result work dimension.

(** Selected reconstruction has one value, complete source work and operand observation. *)

(** This statement fixes the facade selected unique statement contract. *)
Definition rw_facade_selected_unique_statement : Prop :=
  forall K (op : rw_queue_encoder_adapter K) guard rules seed
    (legacy : rw_legacy_tracked_state K) output first fw fd second sw sd,
  rw_facade_selected_run op guard rules seed legacy output first fw fd ->
  rw_facade_selected_run op guard rules seed legacy output second sw sd ->
  first = second /\ fw = sw /\ fd = sd.

(** The selected-output ceiling includes failure paths and the final unchanged checker. *)

(** This statement fixes the facade selected whole bound statement contract. *)
Definition rw_facade_selected_whole_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall K (op : rw_queue_encoder_adapter K) guard rules seed
    (legacy : rw_legacy_tracked_state K) output result work dimension width body,
  rw_facade_selected_run op guard rules seed legacy output result work dimension ->
  let complete_dimension := S (dimension +
    fold_right (fun rule total => S (rw_facade_rule_dimension rule + total)) 1 rules) in
  rw_facade_foreign_envelope op guard (fun _ => (0, 0)) rules
    (rw_facade_selected_ops rules seed output legacy) complete_dimension width body 0 ->
  (N.of_nat work <= rw_facade_whole_ceiling 0%N complete_dimension width body 0)%N.

(** Natural and unit encoders in the facade are fixed library callees, not client prices. *)

(** This statement fixes the facade fixed encoders statement contract. *)
Definition rw_facade_fixed_encoders_statement : Prop :=
  (forall index, fst (rw_queue_encoder_run rw_facade_nat_adapter index) = encode nat_encoding
    index /\
    snd (rw_queue_encoder_run rw_facade_nat_adapter index) =
      audit_nat_events_work (snd (audit_nat_encode index))) /\
  forall value, rw_queue_encoder_run rw_facade_unit_adapter value =
    (encode unit_encoding value, 64).
```

```rocq
(** * AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadeCheckerContracts

    This module fixes source equations, typed observations and contract statements.
    For example, failed lookups retain their original query and selected source cost.
    Builds on: Rewrite and the canonical Collections audit models. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List Bool PArith NArith PeanoNat Lia.

From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsTrie CollectionsMap
  CollectionsFinSet CollectionsUnionFind CollectionsAuditCost CollectionsAuditTrie
  CollectionsAuditEncoding CollectionsAuditPrimitive CollectionsAuditMap CollectionsAuditFinSet
  CollectionsAuditElements CollectionsAuditUnion CollectionsAuditMapTraverse
  CollectionsAuditUnionFind.
From Galois.Rewrite Require Import RewriteSyntax RewriteRules RewriteEquality RewriteEgraph
  RewriteIndex RewriteRebuild RewriteExtract RewriteRun RewriteMatch RewriteAnalysis.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesEgraph.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadeDimensions
  AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadeOptimizer AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadeReference
  AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadeSourceWork AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadeWholeContracts.
From Galois.Rewrite Require Import RewriteAuditIndexDimensions RewriteAuditQueueReference.
Import List.ListNotations.

Definition rw_facade_option_dimension {K} (value : option (term K)) : nat :=
  match value with None => 1 | Some term => rw_facade_term_dimension term end.


Definition rw_facade_path_dimension (path : list nat) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun index total => S (index + total)) 1 path.


Definition rw_facade_table_operand_dimension {A} (value_dimension : A -> nat)
    (trace : audit_trace (rw_facade_table_call A)) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun event largest => Nat.max largest
    (match event with
    | AuditCall (RWFacadeTableSet index value before after code _ _) =>
      S (index + value_dimension value + Pos.size_nat code +
        rw_whole_map_dimension (fun key => S key) value_dimension before +
        rw_whole_map_dimension (fun key => S key) value_dimension after)
    | AuditCall (RWFacadeTableGet index before output code _ _) =>
      S (index + Pos.size_nat code +
        rw_whole_map_dimension (fun key => S key) value_dimension before +
        match output with None => 1 | Some value => value_dimension value end)
    | _ => 1
    end)) 1 trace.


Definition rw_facade_guard_operand_dimension {K}
    (actions : list (rw_facade_guard_action K)) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun action largest => Nat.max largest
    (match action with
    | RWGuardExternal _ => 1
    | RWGuardSubstitution index term _ => S (index + rw_facade_term_dimension term)
    end)) 1 actions.


Definition rw_facade_gate_operand_dimension {K}
    (trace : audit_trace (rw_facade_gate_call K)) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun event largest => Nat.max largest
    (match event with
    | AuditCall (RWFacadeGuard rule bindings _ actions) => S (rw_facade_rule_dimension rule +
        rw_facade_binding_dimension bindings + rw_facade_guard_operand_dimension actions)
    | _ => 1
    end)) 1 trace.


Definition rw_facade_subst_operand_dimension {K}
    (trace : audit_trace (rw_facade_subst_call K)) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun event largest => Nat.max largest
    (match event with
    | AuditCall (RWFacadeNth bindings index output _) => S (index +
        rw_facade_binding_dimension bindings + rw_facade_option_dimension output)
    | _ => 1
    end)) 1 trace.


Definition rw_facade_code_operand_dimension {K}
    (trace : audit_trace (rw_facade_code_call K)) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun event largest => Nat.max largest
    (match event with
    | AuditCall (RWCodeOp _ code _) => S (Pos.size_nat code)
    | AuditCall (RWCodeNat index code _) => S (index + Pos.size_nat code)
    | AuditCall (RWCodeAppend first second output _) => S (rw_whole_ids_dimension first +
        rw_whole_ids_dimension second + rw_whole_ids_dimension output)
    | AuditCall (RWCodeLength length _) => S length
    | AuditCall (RWCodeList input code _) => S (rw_whole_ids_dimension input + Pos.size_nat code)
    | AuditCall (RWCodeEmbed input output _) => S (rw_facade_term_dimension input +
        rw_facade_core_dimension output)
    | _ => 1
    end)) 1 trace.


Definition rw_facade_eq_operand_dimension {K} (trace : audit_trace (rw_facade_eq_call K)) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun event largest => Nat.max largest
    (match event with
    | AuditCall (RWFacadeCode term code child) => S (rw_facade_term_dimension term +
        Pos.size_nat code + rw_facade_code_operand_dimension child)
    | AuditCall (RWFacadeEqBits first second _ _) => S (Pos.size_nat first + Pos.size_nat second)
    | _ => 1
    end)) 1 trace.


Definition rw_facade_step_operand_dimension {K}
    (trace : audit_trace (rw_facade_step_call K)) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun event largest => Nat.max largest
    (match event with
    | AuditCall (RWFacadeLookup index rule child) => S (index +
        match rule with None => 1 | Some rule => rw_facade_rule_dimension rule end +
        rw_facade_table_operand_dimension rw_facade_rule_dimension child)
    | AuditCall (RWFacadeGate rule bindings _ child) => S (rw_facade_rule_dimension rule +
        rw_facade_binding_dimension bindings + rw_facade_gate_operand_dimension child)
    | AuditCall (RWFacadeSubst source output child) => S (rw_facade_term_dimension source +
        rw_facade_term_dimension output + rw_facade_subst_operand_dimension child)
    | AuditCall (RWFacadePosition path input output _) => S (rw_facade_path_dimension path +
        rw_facade_term_dimension input + rw_facade_option_dimension output)
    | AuditCall (RWFacadeEqual first second _ child) => S (rw_facade_term_dimension first +
        rw_facade_term_dimension second + rw_facade_eq_operand_dimension child)
    | AuditCall (RWFacadeReplace path input target output _) => S (rw_facade_path_dimension path +
        rw_facade_term_dimension input + rw_facade_term_dimension target +
        rw_facade_option_dimension output)
    | _ => 1
    end)) 1 trace.


Definition rw_facade_replay_operand_dimension {K}
    (trace : audit_trace (rw_facade_replay_call K)) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun event largest => Nat.max largest
    (match event with
    | AuditCall (RWFacadeReplayStep input step output child) => S (rw_facade_term_dimension input +
        rw_facade_step_dimension step + rw_facade_option_dimension output +
        rw_facade_step_operand_dimension child)
    | _ => 1
    end)) 1 trace.


Definition rw_facade_checker_operand_dimension {K}
    (trace : audit_trace (rw_facade_checker_call K)) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun event largest => Nat.max largest
    (match event with
    | AuditCall (RWFacadeCheckerTable table child) => S (
        rw_whole_map_dimension (fun key => S key) rw_facade_rule_dimension table +
        rw_facade_table_operand_dimension rw_facade_rule_dimension child)
    | AuditCall (RWFacadeCheckerReplay input steps output child) => S (
        rw_facade_term_dimension input + rw_facade_steps_dimension steps +
        rw_facade_option_dimension output + rw_facade_replay_operand_dimension child)
    | AuditCall (RWFacadeCheckerEqual first second _ child) => S (rw_facade_term_dimension first +
        rw_facade_term_dimension second + rw_facade_eq_operand_dimension child)
    | _ => 1
    end)) 1 trace.


Definition rw_facade_steps_ops {K} (steps : list (rewrite_step K)) : list K :=
  flat_map (fun step => flat_map rw_facade_term_ops (step_subst step)) steps.

(** The checker bound includes setup, replay, raw indices, intermediate terms and final
    comparison. *)

(** This statement fixes the facade checker whole bound statement contract. *)
Definition rw_facade_checker_whole_bound_statement : Prop :=
  forall K (op : rw_queue_encoder_adapter K) guard rules (input target : term K) steps width body,
  let '(_, trace) := rw_facade_checker_atomic (rw_external_encoding_events op) guard
    rules input target steps in
  let dimension := S (rw_facade_term_dimension input + rw_facade_term_dimension target +
    rw_facade_steps_dimension steps + rw_facade_checker_operand_dimension trace) in
  rw_facade_foreign_envelope op guard (fun _ => (0, 0)) rules
    (rw_facade_input_ops rules [input; target] ++ rw_facade_steps_ops steps)
    dimension width body 0 ->
  (N.of_nat (rw_facade_checker_source_work trace) <=
    rw_facade_whole_ceiling 0%N dimension width body 0)%N.
```

## Galois.Analyses.AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadePlainMaterializer

Card: AUD-RW-MODELS

Source destination: `theories/Analyses/AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadePlainMaterializer.v`.

```rocq
(** * Fixed plain proof-DAG materialization

    Literal root and positioned-child calls produce the original ordered replay list.
    For example, symmetry reverses and flips steps while congruence retains each child position.
    Builds on: original provenance data, plain facade helpers and checked shape validation. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List Bool PArith NArith Wellfounded.

From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsTrie CollectionsMap
  CollectionsFinSet CollectionsUnionFind CollectionsAuditCost CollectionsAuditTrie
  CollectionsAuditEncoding CollectionsAuditPrimitive CollectionsAuditMap CollectionsAuditFinSet
  CollectionsAuditElements CollectionsAuditUnion CollectionsAuditMapTraverse
  CollectionsAuditUnionFind.
From Galois.Rewrite Require Import RewriteSyntax RewriteRules RewriteEquality RewriteEgraph
  RewriteIndex RewriteRebuild RewriteExtract RewriteRun RewriteMatch RewriteAnalysis.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesEgraph.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadeCheckedMaterialize
  AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadeDimensions AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadeOptimizer
  AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadePlainHelpers AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadeWholeContracts.
From Galois.Rewrite Require Import RewriteAuditProofCarrier.
Import List.ListNotations.
Local Coercion encode : encoding >-> Funclass.

Inductive rw_facade_plain_materialize_call : Type :=
  | RWFacadePlainRoot (id : positive)
  | RWFacadePlainChildren (ids : list positive) (position : nat).

(** These are the potential recursive calls of the fixed provenance dispatcher. *)
Inductive rw_facade_plain_materialize_descend {K} (proof : rw_provenance K unit nat nat) :
    rw_facade_plain_materialize_call -> rw_facade_plain_materialize_call -> Prop :=
  | RWFacadeDescendSym : forall id node child,
      Map.get positive_encoding id (rw_provenance_nodes proof) = Some node ->
      rw_evidence_reason_of node = RWEvidenceSym child ->
      rw_facade_plain_materialize_descend proof (RWFacadePlainRoot child) (RWFacadePlainRoot id)
  | RWFacadeDescendFirst : forall id node first second,
      Map.get positive_encoding id (rw_provenance_nodes proof) = Some node ->
      rw_evidence_reason_of node = RWEvidenceTrans first second ->
      rw_facade_plain_materialize_descend proof (RWFacadePlainRoot first) (RWFacadePlainRoot id)
  | RWFacadeDescendSecond : forall id node first second,
      Map.get positive_encoding id (rw_provenance_nodes proof) = Some node ->
      rw_evidence_reason_of node = RWEvidenceTrans first second ->
      rw_facade_plain_materialize_descend proof (RWFacadePlainRoot second) (RWFacadePlainRoot id)
  | RWFacadeDescendCongruence : forall id node children,
      Map.get positive_encoding id (rw_provenance_nodes proof) = Some node ->
      rw_evidence_reason_of node = RWEvidenceCongruence children ->
      rw_facade_plain_materialize_descend proof
        (RWFacadePlainChildren children 0) (RWFacadePlainRoot id)
  | RWFacadeDescendChild : forall id rest position,
      rw_facade_plain_materialize_descend proof
        (RWFacadePlainRoot id) (RWFacadePlainChildren (id :: rest) position)
  | RWFacadeDescendTail : forall id rest position,
      rw_facade_plain_materialize_descend proof
        (RWFacadePlainChildren rest (S position)) (RWFacadePlainChildren (id :: rest) position).

(** Complete stored-key/reference validation makes the literal dispatcher well founded. *)
Definition rw_facade_plain_materialize_well_founded_type : Prop :=
  forall K (proof : rw_provenance K unit nat nat) root,
  rw_plain_rw_facade_materialize_shape_atomic proof root = true ->
  well_founded (rw_facade_plain_materialize_descend proof).

Definition rw_facade_plain_materialize_body {K} (proof : rw_provenance K unit nat nat)
    (call : rw_facade_plain_materialize_call)
    (recurse : forall child, rw_facade_plain_materialize_descend proof child call ->
      option (list (rewrite_step K))) : option (list (rewrite_step K)).
Proof.
  destruct call as [id | ids position].
  - destruct (Map.get positive_encoding id (rw_provenance_nodes proof)) as [node |] eqn:Hnode;
      [|exact None].
    destruct (rw_evidence_reason_of node) as [|rule bindings|child|first second|children]
      eqn:Hreason.
    + exact (Some []).
    + exact (Some [RewriteStep [] rule true (rw_plain_rw_facade_bindings_atomic bindings)]).
    + destruct (recurse (RWFacadePlainRoot child)
        (RWFacadeDescendSym proof id node child Hnode Hreason)) as [steps |]; [|exact None].
      exact (Some (rw_plain_rw_facade_invert_onto steps [])).
    + destruct (recurse (RWFacadePlainRoot first)
        (RWFacadeDescendFirst proof id node first second Hnode Hreason)) as [lhs |];
        [|exact None].
      destruct (recurse (RWFacadePlainRoot second)
        (RWFacadeDescendSecond proof id node first second Hnode Hreason)) as [rhs |];
        [|exact None].
      exact (Some (lhs ++ rhs)).
    + exact (recurse (RWFacadePlainChildren children 0)
        (RWFacadeDescendCongruence proof id node children Hnode Hreason)).
  - destruct ids as [|id rest]; [exact (Some []) |].
    destruct (recurse (RWFacadePlainRoot id)
      (RWFacadeDescendChild proof id rest position)) as [steps |]; [|exact None].
    pose (prefixed := rw_plain_rw_facade_prefix_atomic position steps).
    destruct (recurse (RWFacadePlainChildren rest (S position))
      (RWFacadeDescendTail proof id rest position)) as [tail |]; [|exact None].
    exact (Some (prefixed ++ tail)).
Defined.

(** The fixed kernel consumes only actual accessibility evidence for its literal calls. *)
Definition rw_facade_plain_materialize_execute {K} (proof : rw_provenance K unit nat nat)
    (call : rw_facade_plain_materialize_call)
    (accessible : Acc (rw_facade_plain_materialize_descend proof) call)
    : option (list (rewrite_step K)) :=
  @Fix_F rw_facade_plain_materialize_call (rw_facade_plain_materialize_descend proof)
    (fun _ => option (list (rewrite_step K))) (rw_facade_plain_materialize_body proof)
    call accessible.

(** Full shape validation guards the exact proof-DAG dispatcher without identifier fuel. *)
Definition rw_facade_checked_materialize_builder
    (Hmat : rw_facade_plain_materialize_well_founded_type)
    {K} (proof : rw_provenance K unit nat nat) (root : positive)
    : option (list (rewrite_step K)).
Proof.
  destruct (rw_plain_rw_facade_materialize_shape_atomic proof root) eqn:Hshape.
  - exact (rw_facade_plain_materialize_execute proof (RWFacadePlainRoot root)
      (Hmat K proof root Hshape (RWFacadePlainRoot root))).
  - exact None.
Defined.

(** A checked source run has exactly the fixed builder's actual replay result. *)
Definition rw_facade_plain_materialize_source_erases_type
    (Hmat : rw_facade_plain_materialize_well_founded_type) : Prop :=
  forall K (proof : rw_provenance K unit nat nat) root result work,
  rw_facade_checked_materialize_run proof root result work ->
  rw_facade_checked_materialize_builder Hmat proof root = result.

(** The builder has a fixed source execution including its validation and expanded replay work. *)
Definition rw_facade_plain_materialize_realizes_type
    (Hmat : rw_facade_plain_materialize_well_founded_type) : Prop :=
  forall K (proof : rw_provenance K unit nat nat) root,
  exists work, rw_facade_checked_materialize_run proof root
    (rw_facade_checked_materialize_builder Hmat proof root) work.

(** The plain full-store shape check agrees with its unchanged counted source mirror. *)
Definition rw_facade_plain_materialize_shape_erases_type : Prop :=
  forall K (proof : rw_provenance K unit nat nat) root,
  rw_plain_rw_facade_materialize_shape_atomic proof root =
    fst (rw_facade_materialize_shape_atomic proof root).

(** The actual builder retains the existing stored-proof plus expanded-replay source ceiling. *)
Definition rw_facade_plain_materialize_source_bound_type
    (Hmat : rw_facade_plain_materialize_well_founded_type) : Prop :=
  forall K (proof : rw_provenance K unit nat nat) root,
  let result := rw_facade_checked_materialize_builder Hmat proof root in
  exists work, rw_facade_checked_materialize_run proof root result work /\
    let dimension := S (rw_facade_proof_dimension proof + Pos.size_nat root +
      match result with None => 1 | Some steps => rw_facade_steps_dimension steps end) in
    (N.of_nat work <= rw_facade_whole_ceiling 0%N dimension 0 0 0)%N.
```

```rocq
  RewriteAuditPlainCore1 RewriteAuditPlainCore3 RewriteAuditPlainPrimitives RewriteAuditProofRun
  RewriteAuditProofTick RewriteAuditSharedExtract RewriteAuditSharedPlain
  RewriteAuditSharedReference.
Import List.ListNotations.
Local Coercion encode : encoding >-> Funclass.

Fixpoint rw_plain_facade_make_bindings {K} (graph : rw_graph K unit nat)
    (table : rw_rd_table) (store : rw_rd_store K unit nat) (holes : list nat)
    (assignment : rw_assignment nat) : option (Map.t nat (rw_term K unit nat)) :=
  match holes with
  | nil => Some Map.empty
  | hole :: rest =>
    let tail := rw_plain_facade_make_bindings graph table store rest assignment in
    match tail with
    | None => None
    | Some bindings =>
      let found := Map.get nat_encoding hole assignment in
      let observed := match found with
        | None => Some (RWVar tt hole)
        | Some root =>
          match rd_plain_candidate_get graph table root with
          | None => None
          | Some candidate => rw_shared_unfold
            (RwSharedTree K unit nat (rw_rd_pointer candidate) (rw_rd_nodes store))
          end
        end in
      match observed with
      | None => None
      | Some term => Some (Map.set nat_encoding hole term bindings)
      end
    end
  end.

Definition rw_plain_facade_rule_offers {K} (EK : encoding K)
    (state : rw_index_state K unit nat) (graph : rw_graph K unit nat)
    (table : rw_rd_table) (store : rw_rd_store K unit nat)
    (entry : nat * rw_facade_prepared_rule K) : list (rw_attempt K unit nat nat) :=
  let '(index, prepared) := entry in
  let rule := rw_facade_core_rule prepared in
  flat_map (fun root =>
    let assignments := rw_view_match EK unit_encoding nat_encoding nat_encoding
      (rw_snapshot_base (rw_index_view EK unit_encoding nat_encoding state)) root (rw_lhs rule) in
    flat_map (fun assignment =>
      match rw_plain_facade_make_bindings graph table store (rw_holes rule) assignment with
      | None => nil
      | Some bindings => [RwAttempt index root bindings]
      end) assignments) (rw_roots graph).

Definition rw_plain_facade_offer_gate {K} (EK : encoding K) (prepared : rw_facade_prepared K)
    (attempt : rw_attempt K unit nat nat) : bool :=
  match Map.get nat_encoding (rw_attempt_rule attempt) (rw_facade_rule_table prepared) with
  | None => false
  | Some entry =>
    let gate := rw_plain_rw_rp_rule_body_gate_atomic unit_encoding nat_encoding
      (rw_plain_rw_facade_local_callbacks tt entry) (rw_facade_core_rule entry) attempt in
    match gate with
    | None => false
    | Some (lhs, rhs) =>
      let left_legacy := rw_plain_rw_facade_materialize_project_atomic lhs in
      let right_legacy := rw_plain_rw_facade_materialize_project_atomic rhs in
      let bindings := rw_plain_rw_facade_bindings_atomic (rw_attempt_sub attempt) in
      match legacy_replay_step EK
        (fun index => Map.get nat_encoding index (rw_facade_original_table prepared)) left_legacy
        (RewriteStep nil (rw_attempt_rule attempt) true bindings) with
      | None => false
      | Some actual => term_eqb EK actual right_legacy
      end
    end
  end.

Fixpoint rw_plain_facade_choose {K} (EK : encoding K) (prepared : rw_facade_prepared K)
    (offers : list (rw_attempt K unit nat nat)) : option (rw_attempt K unit nat nat) :=
  match offers with
  | nil => None
  | attempt :: rest =>
    if rw_plain_facade_offer_gate EK prepared attempt then Some attempt
    else rw_plain_facade_choose EK prepared rest
  end.

Definition rw_plain_facade_strategy (Hwf : rw_rd_plain_compare_well_founded_type)
    {K} (EK : encoding K) (prepared : rw_facade_prepared K)
    (state : rw_index_state K unit nat) : option (rw_attempt K unit nat nat) :=
  let graph := rw_index_graph state in
  let fresh := rw_plain_rw_ri_prepare_once EK nat_encoding graph in
  match length (rw_roots graph) with
  | 0 => None
  | S count =>
    let entries := Map.elements (rw_nodes graph) in
    let '(table, store) := rd_plain_rounds Hwf EK unit_encoding nat_encoding
      (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) graph entries (rd_plain_nat_positive count) Map.empty
      (RwRdStore Map.empty 1%positive) in
    let offers := flat_map (rw_plain_facade_rule_offers EK fresh graph table store)
      (rw_facade_rule_entries prepared) in
    rw_plain_facade_choose EK prepared offers
  end.

Definition rw_plain_facade_once (Hwf : rw_rd_plain_compare_well_founded_type)
    {K} (EK : encoding K) (prepared : rw_facade_prepared K)
    (run : rw_rp_run_state K unit nat nat) : rw_rp_run_state K unit nat nat :=
  if rw_rp_stopped run then run
  else
    let tracked := rw_rp_current run in
    match rw_plain_facade_strategy Hwf EK prepared (rw_tracked_machine tracked) with
    | None => RwRpRunState tracked true (rw_rp_position run) (rw_rp_events run)
    | Some attempt =>
      match rw_plain_rw_facade_apply_atomic EK EK tt prepared (rw_rp_position run) tracked
  attempt with
      | None => RwRpRunState tracked false (S (rw_rp_position run))
        (RWRunRejected attempt :: rw_rp_events run)
      | Some (next, events) => RwRpRunState next false (S (rw_rp_position run))
        (RWRunAccepted attempt events :: rw_rp_events run)
      end
    end.

Fixpoint rw_plain_facade_repeat (Hwf : rw_rd_plain_compare_well_founded_type)
    {K} (EK : encoding K) (prepared : rw_facade_prepared K) (fuel : positive)
    (run : rw_rp_run_state K unit nat nat) : rw_rp_run_state K unit nat nat :=
  if rw_rp_stopped run then run
  else match fuel with
  | xH => rw_plain_facade_once Hwf EK prepared run
  | xO rest =>
    let middle := rw_plain_facade_repeat Hwf EK prepared rest run in
    rw_plain_facade_repeat Hwf EK prepared rest middle
  | xI rest =>
    let first := rw_plain_facade_once Hwf EK prepared run in
    let middle := rw_plain_facade_repeat Hwf EK prepared rest first in
    rw_plain_facade_repeat Hwf EK prepared rest middle
  end.

Definition rw_legacy_tracked_builder (Hwf : rw_rd_plain_compare_well_founded_type)
    (K : Type) (EK : encoding K) (rules : list (rewrite_rule K)) (fuel : positive)
    (seed : term K) : rw_legacy_tracked_state K :=
  let prepared := rw_plain_rw_facade_prepare_atomic rules 0 in
  let source := legacy_embed seed in
  let '(root, initial) := @rw_plain_rw_rp_seed_atomic K unit nat nat
    EK unit_encoding nat_encoding EK nat_encoding source in
  let '(ready, initial_events) := rw_plain_rw_rp_rebuild_atomic EK unit_encoding nat_encoding
    0 initial in
  let final := rw_plain_facade_repeat Hwf EK prepared fuel (RwRpRunState ready false 0 nil) in
  let output := RwTrackedOutput (rw_rp_current final)
    (if rw_rp_stopped final then RWStopped else RWFuelExhausted) initial_events (rw_rp_events
  final) in
  let leaves := rw_plain_rw_facade_capture_atomic output in
  RWLegacyTrackedState K root output leaves.
```

```rocq
Definition rw_plain_facade_explain_core
    (Hmat : rw_facade_plain_materialize_well_founded_type)

    (source : rw_term K unit nat) (legacy : rw_legacy_tracked_state K)

    (Hmat : rw_facade_plain_materialize_well_founded_type)
    (K : Type) (EK : encoding K) (rules : list (rewrite_rule K)) (seed : term K)

Definition rw_plain_facade_extract (Hwf : rw_rd_plain_compare_well_founded_type)

    (rw_legacy_root K legacy) with
  | None => None
  | Some dag =>

    | None => None
    | Some tree => Some (dag, tree)
    end
  end.

Definition rw_tracked_optimise_builder (Hwf : rw_rd_plain_compare_well_founded_type)
    (Hmat : rw_facade_plain_materialize_well_founded_type)
    (K : Type) (EK : encoding K) (rules : list (rewrite_rule K)) (cost : K -> nat)
    (fuel : positive) (seed : term K) :
    option (rw_shared_tree K unit nat * list (rewrite_step K)) :=
  let legacy := rw_legacy_tracked_builder Hwf K EK rules fuel seed in
  match rw_plain_facade_extract Hwf EK cost legacy with
```

## Galois.Tests.Analyses.AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadeExamples

Card: AUD-RP-FACADE

Test destination: `tests/Analyses/AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadeExamples.v`.

```rocq
(** * AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadeExamples

    This module fixes source equations, typed observations and contract statements.
    For example, failed lookups retain their original query and selected source cost.
    Builds on: Rewrite and the canonical Collections audit models. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List Bool PArith NArith PeanoNat Lia.

From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsTrie CollectionsMap
  CollectionsFinSet CollectionsUnionFind CollectionsAuditCost CollectionsAuditTrie
  CollectionsAuditEncoding CollectionsAuditPrimitive CollectionsAuditMap CollectionsAuditFinSet
  CollectionsAuditElements CollectionsAuditUnion CollectionsAuditMapTraverse
  CollectionsAuditUnionFind.
From Galois.Rewrite Require Import RewriteSyntax RewriteRules RewriteEquality RewriteEgraph
  RewriteIndex RewriteRebuild RewriteExtract RewriteRun RewriteMatch RewriteAnalysis.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesEgraph.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadeReference.
Import List.ListNotations.

Definition rw_facade_guard_action_cost {K} (action : rw_facade_guard_action K) : nat :=
  match action with
  | RWGuardExternal units => units
  | RWGuardSubstitution _ _ trace => 1 + audit_work trace
  end.

Definition rw_facade_guard_actions_cost {K} (actions : list (rw_facade_guard_action K)) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun action total => rw_facade_guard_action_cost action + total) 0 actions.


Definition rw_facade_fixture_op (p : positive) : positive * list nat := (p, [1]).

Definition rw_facade_fixture_guard : rw_facade_guard_adapter positive :=
  RWFacadeGuardAdapter (fun _ => RWFacadeGuardReturn true 1).

Definition rw_facade_fixture_nested_guard_rule : rewrite_rule positive :=
  RewriteRule (TVar 0) (TVar 0)
    (fun sub => match sub 1 with TVar 1 => true | _ => false end).

Definition rw_facade_fixture_nested_guard : rw_facade_guard_adapter positive :=
  RWFacadeGuardAdapter (fun _ => RWFacadeGuardLookup 1 1
    (fun out => RWFacadeGuardReturn
      (match out with TVar 1 => true | _ => false end) 0)).

Definition rw_facade_source_example_rule : rewrite_rule positive :=
  RewriteRule (TVar 0) (TApp 2%positive [TVar 0]) (fun _ => true).

(** The actual checker accepts a nonempty replay from a variable to an application. *)

Example rw_facade_checker_source_fixture :
  fst (rw_facade_checker_atomic rw_facade_fixture_op rw_facade_fixture_guard
    [rw_facade_source_example_rule] (TVar 1) (TApp 2%positive [TVar 1])
    [RewriteStep nil 0 true [TVar 1]]) = true.
Proof.
  vm_compute.
  reflexivity.
Qed.

(** A guard-only missing binding follows the actual library fallback query. *)

Example rw_facade_nested_source_fixture :
  let '(answer, actions) := rw_facade_guard_run rw_facade_fixture_nested_guard
    rw_facade_fixture_nested_guard_rule (rw_facade_binding_atomic [TVar 0]) in
  answer = true /\ rw_facade_guard_actions_cost actions = 9 /\
  Forall (rw_facade_guard_action_valid [TVar 0]) actions.
Proof.
  vm_compute.
  repeat constructor.
Qed.
```

## Galois.Tests.Analyses.AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadePlainMaterializerExamples

Card: AUD-RP-FACADE

Test destination: `tests/Analyses/AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadePlainMaterializerExamples.v`.

```rocq
(** * Concrete proof-DAG replay through the fixed plain kernel

    An actual accessibility witness drives the tested recursive root and child calls.
    For example, a shared rule proof appears once reversed at child zero and once at child one.
    Builds on: original provenance nodes, plain facade helpers and the fixed materializer. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List Bool PArith.

From Galois.Collections Require Import CollectionsEncoding CollectionsTrie CollectionsMap
  CollectionsFinSet CollectionsUnionFind CollectionsAuditCost CollectionsAuditTrie
  CollectionsAuditEncoding CollectionsAuditPrimitive CollectionsAuditMap CollectionsAuditFinSet
  CollectionsAuditElements CollectionsAuditUnion CollectionsAuditMapTraverse
  CollectionsAuditUnionFind.
From Galois.Rewrite Require Import RewriteSyntax RewriteRules RewriteEquality RewriteEgraph
  RewriteIndex RewriteRebuild RewriteExtract RewriteRun RewriteMatch RewriteAnalysis.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesEgraph.
From Galois.Analyses Require Import AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadePlainHelpers
  AnalysesAuditRewriteFacadePlainMaterializer.
From Galois.Rewrite Require Import RewriteAuditProofCarrier.
Import List.ListNotations.
Local Coercion encode : encoding >-> Funclass.

Definition facade_plain_fixture_bindings :=
  Map.set nat_encoding 2 (RWVar tt 5 : rw_term positive unit nat) Map.empty.

Definition facade_plain_fixture_rule : rw_evidence_node positive unit nat nat :=
  RWEvidenceNode (RWVar tt 0) (RWVar tt 1) (RWEvidenceRule 7 facade_plain_fixture_bindings) (0, 0).

Definition facade_plain_fixture_sym : rw_evidence_node positive unit nat nat :=
  RWEvidenceNode (RWVar tt 1) (RWVar tt 0) (RWEvidenceSym 1%positive) (0, 0).

Definition facade_plain_fixture_congruence : rw_evidence_node positive unit nat nat :=
  RWEvidenceNode (RWVar tt 1) (RWVar tt 0)
    (RWEvidenceCongruence [2%positive; 1%positive]) (0, 0).

Definition facade_plain_fixture : rw_provenance positive unit nat nat :=
  RWProvenance [1%positive; 2%positive; 3%positive]
    (Map.set positive_encoding 3%positive facade_plain_fixture_congruence
      (Map.set positive_encoding 2%positive facade_plain_fixture_sym
        (Map.set positive_encoding 1%positive facade_plain_fixture_rule Map.empty))).

Definition facade_plain_rule_accessible :
  Acc (rw_facade_plain_materialize_descend facade_plain_fixture) (RWFacadePlainRoot 1%positive).
Proof.
  constructor. intros next Hdescend.
  inversion Hdescend as
    [id node child Hnode Hreason | id node first second Hnode Hreason |
      id node first second Hnode Hreason | id node children Hnode Hreason | |]; subst;
    vm_compute in Hnode; inversion Hnode; subst; discriminate Hreason.
Defined.

Definition facade_plain_sym_accessible :
  Acc (rw_facade_plain_materialize_descend facade_plain_fixture) (RWFacadePlainRoot 2%positive).
Proof.
  constructor. intros next Hdescend.
  inversion Hdescend as
    [id node child Hnode Hreason | id node first second Hnode Hreason |
      id node first second Hnode Hreason | id node children Hnode Hreason | |]; subst;
    vm_compute in Hnode; inversion Hnode; subst.
  - inversion Hreason; subst. exact facade_plain_rule_accessible.
  - discriminate Hreason.
  - discriminate Hreason.
  - discriminate Hreason.
Defined.

Definition facade_plain_children_accessible : forall ids position,
  Forall (fun id => Acc (rw_facade_plain_materialize_descend facade_plain_fixture)
    (RWFacadePlainRoot id)) ids ->
  Acc (rw_facade_plain_materialize_descend facade_plain_fixture)
    (RWFacadePlainChildren ids position).
Proof.
  fix IH 1. intros ids position Hchildren.
  constructor. intros next Hdescend.
  destruct ids as [|id rest]; [inversion Hdescend |].
  inversion Hdescend as [| | | |child tail index|child tail index]; subst.
  - inversion Hchildren; subst. assumption.
  - apply (IH rest (S position)). inversion Hchildren; subst. assumption.
Defined.

Definition facade_plain_congruence_accessible :
  Acc (rw_facade_plain_materialize_descend facade_plain_fixture) (RWFacadePlainRoot 3%positive).
Proof.
  constructor. intros next Hdescend.
  inversion Hdescend as
    [id node child Hnode Hreason | id node first second Hnode Hreason |
      id node first second Hnode Hreason | id node children Hnode Hreason | |]; subst;
    vm_compute in Hnode; inversion Hnode; subst.
  - discriminate Hreason.
  - discriminate Hreason.
  - discriminate Hreason.
  - inversion Hreason; subst.
    apply facade_plain_children_accessible.
    constructor; [exact facade_plain_sym_accessible |].
    constructor; [exact facade_plain_rule_accessible | constructor].
Defined.

Example facade_plain_full_shape_closed :
  rw_plain_rw_facade_materialize_shape_atomic facade_plain_fixture 3%positive = true.
Proof.
  vm_compute. reflexivity.
Qed.

Example facade_plain_recursive_replay_closed :
  rw_facade_plain_materialize_execute facade_plain_fixture (RWFacadePlainRoot 3%positive)
    facade_plain_congruence_accessible =
  Some [RewriteStep [0] 7 false [TVar 0; TVar 1; TVar 5];
    RewriteStep [1] 7 true [TVar 0; TVar 1; TVar 5]].
Proof.
  vm_compute. reflexivity.
Qed.

Example facade_plain_reverse_order_closed :
  @rw_plain_rw_facade_invert_onto positive
    [RewriteStep [0] 7 true []; RewriteStep [1] 8 false []] [] =
  [RewriteStep [1] 8 true []; RewriteStep [0] 7 false []].
Proof.
  vm_compute. reflexivity.
Qed.

Definition facade_plain_cycle : rw_provenance positive unit nat nat :=
  RWProvenance [1%positive]
    (Map.set positive_encoding 1%positive facade_plain_fixture_sym Map.empty).

Example facade_plain_cycle_rejected_closed :
  rw_plain_rw_facade_materialize_shape_atomic facade_plain_cycle 1%positive = false.
Proof.
  vm_compute. reflexivity.
Qed.

Definition facade_plain_unreachable_cycle : rw_provenance positive unit nat nat :=
  RWProvenance [1%positive; 2%positive; 3%positive; 4%positive]
    (Map.set positive_encoding 4%positive
      (RWEvidenceNode (RWVar tt 0) (RWVar tt 0) (RWEvidenceSym 4%positive) (0, 0))
      (rw_provenance_nodes facade_plain_fixture)).

Example facade_plain_unreachable_cycle_rejected_closed :
  rw_plain_rw_facade_materialize_shape_atomic facade_plain_unreachable_cycle 1%positive = false.
Proof.
  vm_compute. reflexivity.
Qed.
```
